word_meanings: राघवः Raghava, इत्येवंवादिनम् thus spoken, वीरम् hero, अभिनन्द्य applauding, लक्ष्मिसम्पन्नम् endowed with prosperity, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, इदम् these, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: परिगृह्योदकं शीतं वनानि फलवन्ति च । बलौघं संविभज्येमं व्यूह्य तिष्ठेम लक्ष्मण ॥६-४१-११॥
translation: "Lakshmana! We should occupy a region with cool water and good fruits and plan to divide the army and be ready."
word_meanings: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, शीतम् cool, उदकम् water, फलवन्ति good fruits, वनानिच woods, परिगृह्य occupying, इमम् this, बलौघम् army, संविभज्य divide, व्यूह्य plan, तिष्ठाम be ready.

text: लोकक्षयकरं भीमं भयं पश्याम्युपस्थितम् । निबर्हणं प्रवीराणामृक्षवानररक्षसाम् ॥६-४१-१२॥
translation: "I foresee the terrific destruction of eminent heroes among Bears, monkeys and Rakshasas. I see the danger approaching."
word_meanings: लोकक्षयकरम् that which bodes destruction of the world, भीमम् terrific, प्रवीराणाम् eminent heroes, ऋक्षवानररक्षसाम् to Bears, monkeys and Rakshasas, निबर्हणम् danger, भयम् fear, उपस्थितम् approaching, पश्यामि see.

text: वाताश्च परुषा वान्ति कम्पते च वसुन्धरा । पर्वताग्राणि वेपन्ते पतन्ति धरणीरुहाः ॥६-४१-१३॥
translation: "The winds are blowing severely, the earth is quaking in, the mountain peaks are shaking, and the elephants bearing the earth (in the four corners) are falling."
word_meanings: वाताः winds, परुषम् severely, वान्ति blowing, वसुन्धराच in the earth, कम्पते quacking, पर्वताग्राणि mountain peaks, वेपन्ते shaking, धरणीधराः those elephants bearing the earth, पतन्ति falling.

text: मेघाः क्रव्यादसङ्काशाः परुषाः परुषस्वनाः । क्रूराः क्रूरं प्रवर्षन्ति मिश्रं शोणितबिन्दुभिः ॥६-४१-१४॥
translation: "The fierce clouds resembling wild birds are making terrible harsh sounds and rain mixed with drops of blood is showering."
word_meanings: क्रनादसङ्काशाः like wild birds, परुषाः harsh, परुषस्वनाः producing harsh sounds, क्रूराः fierce, मेघाः clouds, क्रूरम् terrific, शोणितबिन्धुभिः blood drops, मिश्रम् mixed with, प्रवर्षन्ति raining

text: रक्तचन्दनसङ्काशा सन्ध्या परमदारुणा । ज्वलच्च निपतत्येतदादित्यादग्निमण्डलम् ॥६-४१-१५॥
translation: "The twilight appears like red sander trees, the burning fire falling from the sun is like a mass of fire and frightening."
word_meanings: रक्तचन्दनसङ्काशा resembling red sanders, सन्ध्या twilight, परमदारुणा very frightening, आदित्यात् from Sun, ज्वलत् fire, एतत् all this, अग्निमण्डलम् like mass of fire, विपतति falling down.

text: आदित्यमभिवाश्यन्ति जनयन्तो महद्भयम् । दीना दीनस्वरा घोरा अप्रशस्ता मृगद्विजाः ॥६-४१-१६॥
translation: "The desperate inauspicious sounds of ominous beasts crying pitifully facing the sun are causing great fear."
word_meanings: दीनाः desperate, दीनस्वराः crying pitifully, घोराः dreadful, नप्रशस्ताः inauspicious, मृगद्विजाः ominous beasts, महत् great, भयम् fear, जनयन्तः creating, आदित्यम् from Sun, अभिवाश्यन्ति facing the Sun.

text: रजन्यामप्रकाशश्च सन्तापयति चन्द्रमाः । कृष्णरक्तान्तपर्यन्तो यथा लोकस्य सङ्क्षये ॥६-४१-१७॥
translation: "Like at the time of universal dissolution, the moon is not radiant, being surrounded by black and red halo at night and is tormenting."
word_meanings: लोकस्य of the universe, संक्ष्येयथा like the dissolution, कृष्णरक्तांशुपर्यन्तः surrounded with black and red halo, अप्रकाशः not radiant, चन्द्रमाः the moon, रजन्याम् in the night, सन्तापयति tormented.

text: ह्रस्वो रूक्षो ऽप्रशस्तश्च परिवेषः सुलोहितः ॥६-४१-१८॥
translation: "Lakshmana! Short dark spot observed in the Sun 's orbit is inauspicious. moon is surrounded by copper colour and dreary."
word_meanings: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, आदित्यमण्डले Sun 's orbit, ह्रस्वः shortened, रूक्षः dreary, अप्रशस्तः inauspicious, सुलोहितः copper coloured, परिवेषः surrounding, नीलम् dark, लक्ष्म seen, लक्षयते observable.

text: आदित्यमण्डले नीलं लक्ष्म लक्ष्मण दृश्यते । दृश्यन्ते न यथावच्च नक्षत्राण्यभिवर्तते । युगान्तमिव लोकस्य पश्य लक्ष्मण शंसति ॥६-४१-१९॥
translation: "Just as the spots on the moon, the stars are also dirty and not visible. It forebodes the end of the universe Lakshmana!"
word_meanings: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, नक्षत्राणि even stars, यथावत् so also, नदृश्यन्ते not visible, लोकस्य in the universe, युगान्तम् end of the universe, शंसतीव spots on the moon, अभिवर्तते dirty, पश्य seen.

text: काकाः श्येनास्तथा गृध्रा नीचैः परिपतन्ति च । शिवाश्चाप्यशिवा वाचः प्रवदन्ति महास्वनाः ॥६-४१-२०॥
translation: "The crows, hawks and also vultures are joining lowly animals like jackals and making loud noises which is inauspicious and not good."
word_meanings: काकाः crows, श्येनाः hawks, तथा so also, गृध्राः vultures, नीचैः lowly, परिपतन्तिच joining, महास्वनाः in loud tone, शिवाश्च jackals, अशिवाश्च inauspicious, अशुभाः not good, वाचः sounds, प्रवदन्ति making.

text: क्षिप्रमद्य दुराधर्षां लङ्कां रावणपालिताम् । अभियाम जवेनैव सर्वतो हरिभिर्वृताः ॥६-४१-२१॥
translation: Surrounded on all sides by the vanaras, let us now march swiftly upon the impregnable Lanka ruled by Ravana.
word_meanings: हरिभिः Vanaras, वृताः accompanied by, अद्य now, क्षिप्रम् immediately, दुराधर्षम् difficult to attack, रावणपालिताम् ruled by Ravana, लङ्काम् Lanka, सर्वतः all, जवेनैव with good speed, अभियाम march forward.

text: इत्येवं संवदन् वीरो लक्ष्मणं लक्ष्मणाग्रजः । तस्मादवातरच्छीव्रं पर्वताग्रान्महाबलः ॥६-४१-२२॥
translation: Mighty hero Rama, (the elder brother of Lakshmana) said to Lakshmana in this manner (as described earlier) and descended from the peak of the mountain without delay.
word_meanings: वीरः hero, महाबलः mighty, लक्ष्मणाग्रजः Lakshmana's elder brother, इत्येवम् in this manner, लक्ष्मणम् to Lakshmana, वदन् said, तस्मात् from there, पर्वताग्रात् peak of the mountain, शीघ्रम् without delay, अवातरत् descended.

text: अवतीर्यं च धर्मात्मा तस्माच्छैलात् स राघवः । परैः परमदुर्धर्षं ददर्श बलमात्मनः ॥६-४१-२३॥
translation: Climbing down the mountain, the righteous Rama reviewed in his mind the strength of his army and the enemy which is difficult to assail.
word_meanings: धर्मात्माच righteous, सःराघवः that Raghava, तस्मात् शैलात् from the mountain, अवतीर्य climbing down, परैः foes, परमदुर्धर्षम् very difficult to assail, आत्मनः in the mind, बलम् army strength, ददर्श reviewed.

text: सन्नह्य तु ससुग्रीवः कपिराजबलं महत् । कालज्ञो राघवः काले संयुगायाभ्यचोदयत् ॥६-४१-२४॥
translation: Raghava, who is knowledgeable of when to do what, motivated the army of Vanaras and Sugriva and ordered.
word_meanings: ससुग्रीवः Sugriva, कालज्ञः knower of when to do, राघवः Raghava, महत् great, कपिराजबलम् army of Vanaras, सन्नह्य ready, काले time, संयुगाय motivated, अभ्यचोदयत् ordered.

text: ततः काले महाबाहुर्बलेन महतावृतः । प्रस्थितः पुरतो धन्वी लङ्कामभिमुखः पुरीम् ॥६-४१-२५॥
translation: Surrounded by a large army in front, the broad shouldered Rama proceeded towards Lanka.
word_meanings: ततः then, महाबाहुः broad shouldered, महता great, बलेन army, वृतः surrounded by, पुरतः in front, धवनी early morning, काले time, लङ्कांपुरीं Lanka, अभिमुखः towards, प्रस्थितः proceeded.

text: तं विभीषणसुग्रीवौ हनुमान् जाम्बवान्नलः । ऋक्षराजस्तथा नीलो लक्ष्मणश्चान्वयुस्तदा ॥६-४१-२६॥
translation: Then Vibheeshana, Sugriva, Hanuman, Jambavan, Nala, Neela in the same way Lakshmana followed.
word_meanings: तदा then, विभीषणसुग्रीवौ Vibheeshana and Sugriva, हनुमान् Hanuman, ऋक्षराजः king of Bears, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, नलः Nala, तथा in the same way, नीलः Neela, लक्ष्मणश्च and Lakshmana, तम् them, अन्वयुः followed.

text: ततः पश्चात् सुमहती पृतनर्क्षवनौकसाम् । प्रच्छाद्य महतीं भूमिमनुयाति स्म राघवम् ॥६-४१-२७॥
translation: Then the bears, monkeys, covering all over the land went behind Rama.
word_meanings: ततः then, ऋक्षवनौकसाम् bears and monkeys, महती great, पृतना land महतीम् all over, भूमिम् land, प्रच्छाद्य covering, राघवम् Rama, अनुयातिस्म followed पशचात्सु behind.

text: शैलशृङ्गाणि शतशः प्रवृद्धांश्च महीरुहान् । जगृहुः कुञ्जरप्रख्या वानराः परवारणाः ॥६-४१-२८॥
translation: The monkeys who were of the size of elephants capable of warding off the enemy, bore huge grown up trees in their hands and went.
word_meanings: परवारणाः capable of warding off the enemy, कुञ्जरप्रख्याः whose body were the size of elephants, वानराः monkeys, शैलशृङ्गाणि mountain peaks, प्रवृद्धान् fully grown, शतशः in hundreds, महीरुहान् huge trees, जगृहुः bore in their hands.

text: तौ तु दीर्घेण कालेन भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ । रावणस्य पुरीं लङ्कामासेदतुररिन्दमौ ॥६-४१-२९॥
translation: In a short while the two brothers Rama and Lakshmana, tamers of foes reached the city of Lanka.
word_meanings: अरिन्दमौ tamers of foes, भ्रातरौ the two brothers, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, अदीर्घेण in a short, कालेन time, रावणस्य Ravana's, पुरीम् city, लङ्काम् of Lanka, आसेदतुः reached.

text: पताकमालिनीं रम्यामुद्यानवनशोभिताम् । चित्रवप्रां सुदुष्प्रापामुच्चैः प्राकारतोरणाम् ॥६-४१-३०॥
तां सुरैरपि दुर्धर्षां रामवाक्यप्रचोदिताः । यथानिवेशं सम्पीड्य न्यविशन्त वनौकसः ॥६-४१-३१॥
translation: Commanded by Rama's words the Vanaras remaining in their positions as ordained, entered the wonderful Lanka, which was decorated with flags, embellished with gardens. The defensive walls and arches of the boundary of Lanka were difficult to access even for Devatas.
word_meanings: रामवाक्यप्रचोदिताः commanded by Rama's words, वनौकसः gardens, पताकामालिनीम् decorated with flags, रम्याम् beautiful to look at, उद्यानवनशोभिताम् embellished with gardens, चित्रवस्राम् wonderful, सुदुष्प्रापाम् defensive walls, उच्चैः tall प्राकारतोरणाम् archways of boundary, सुरैरपि even for Devatas, दुर्धर्षाम् difficult to access, ताम् they, यथानिदेशम् as ordained, सम्पीड्य remaining, न्यविशन्त entered.

text: लङ्कायास्तूत्तरद्वारं शलशृङ्गमिवोन्नतम् । रामः सहानुजो धन्वी जुगोप च रुरोध च ॥६-४१-३२॥
translation: Accompanied by his brother Lakshmana, Rama, armed with bow, blocked the northern gate of Lanka which was like a lofty mountain peak and protected.
word_meanings: सहानुजः accompanied by his brother, रामः Rama, धन्वी armed with bow, लङ्कायाः into Lanka, शैलशृङ्गमिवोन्नतम् like a lofty mountain peak, तम् that, उत्तरद्वारम् northern gate, जुगोप blocked, रुरोधच protected.

text: लङ्कामुपनिविष्टश्च रामो दशरथात्मजः । लक्ष्मणानुचरो वीरः पुरीं रावणपालिताम् । उत्तरद्वारमासाद्य यत्र तिष्ठति रावणः ॥६-४१-३३॥
नान्यो रामाद्धि तद्द्वारं समर्थः परिरक्षितुम् । रावणाधिष्ठितं भीमं वरुणेनेव सागरम् ॥६-४१-३४॥
translation: (Dasaratha's son) Rama who had Lakshmana as follower reached the northern gate protected by Ravana. Just as the ocean is guarded by Varuna, it was guarded by terrific Rakshasas, who were secretly hiding all over like the Rakshasas in the subterranean region with small amounts of numerous armours for protection. It was not possible for anyone other than Rama to enter.
word_meanings: दशरथात्मजः Dasaratha's son, लक्ष्मणानुचरः follower Lakshmana, वीरः heroic, रामः Rama, रावणः Ravana, यत्र there, तिष्ठति settled, उत्तरद्वारम् at northern gate, आसाद्य having reached, रावणपालिताम् ruled by Ravana, तम् that, वरुणेन by Varuna, सागरम् इव like an ocean, भीमम् frightening, सायुधैः guarded by,भीमैः terrific, राक्षसैः Rakshasa, समन्ततः all over, अभिगुप्तम् secretly hidden, दानवैः Rakshasas, पाताळमिव like subterranean, लघूनाम् small pieces, त्रासजननम् numerous, तत् द्वारम् that gateway, परिरक्षितुम् highly protected, रामात् by Rama, अन्यः other than, नसमर्थःहि not possible.

text: सायुधै राक्षसैर्भीमैरभिगुप्तं समन्ततः । लघूनां त्रासजननं पातालमिव दानवैः ॥६-४१-३५॥
translation: (Dasaratha's son) Rama who had Lakshmana as follower reached the northern gate protected by Ravana. Just as the ocean is guarded by Varuna, it was guarded by terrific Rakshasas, who were secretly hiding all over like the Rakshasas in the subterranean region with small amounts of numerous armours for protection. It was not possible for anyone other than Rama to enter.
word_meanings: दशरथात्मजः Dasaratha's son, लक्ष्मणानुचरः follower Lakshmana, वीरः heroic, रामः Rama, रावणः Ravana, यत्र there, तिष्ठति settled, उत्तरद्वारम् at northern gate, आसाद्य having reached, रावणपालिताम् ruled by Ravana, तम् that, वरुणेन by Varuna, सागरम् इव like an ocean, भीमम् frightening, सायुधैः guarded by,भीमैः terrific, राक्षसैः Rakshasa, समन्ततः all over, अभिगुप्तम् secretly hidden, दानवैः Rakshasas, पाताळमिव like subterranean, लघूनाम् small pieces, त्रासजननम् numerous, तत् द्वारम् that gateway, परिरक्षितुम् highly protected, रामात् by Rama, अन्यः other than, नसमर्थःहि not possible.

text: विन्यस्तानि च योधानां बहूनि विविधानि च । ददर्शायुधजालानि तत्रैव कवचानि च ॥६-४१-३६॥
translation: Rama Saw there, numerous weapons of every kind so also shields for the combatants of war.
word_meanings: योधानाम् for the combatants of war, विन्यस्तानि of every kind, बहूनि numerous, विविधानिच and different kind, आयुधजालानि weapons, तथैव so also, कवचानिच and shields, ददर्श saw.

text: पूर्वं तु द्वारमासाद्य नीलो हरिचमूपतिः । अतिष्ठत् सह मैन्देन द्विविदेन च वीर्यवान् ॥६-४१-३७॥
translation: Neela the commanderinchief of the army of monkeys, a valiant one, also Dwivida, and Mainda reached the east gate and remained there.
word_meanings: हरिचमूपतिः commander of the army of monkeys, वीर्यवान् valiant one, नीलः Neela, मैन्देन Mainda सह and also, द्विविदेनचसह Dwivida also, पूर्वंद्वारम् east gate, आसाद्य reached, अतिष्ठत् remained there.

text: अङ्गदो दक्षिणद्वारं जग्राह सुमहाबलः । ऋषभेण गवाक्षेण गजेन गवयेन च ॥६-४१-३८॥
translation: Angada endowed with great prowess along with Rshaba, Gavaksha, Gaja, and Gavaya reached the south gate.
word_meanings: सुमहाबलः of great prowess, अङ्गदः Angada, ऋषभेण with Rshaba, गवाक्षेण and Gavaksha, गजेन Gaja, गवयेनच and Gavaya, दक्षिणद्वारम् south gate, जग्राह reached.

text: हनुमान् पश्चिमद्वारं ररक्ष बलवान् कपिः । प्रमाथिप्रघसाभ्यां च वीरैरन्यैश्च सङ्गतः ॥६-४१-३९॥
translation: Mighty monkey Hanuman united with heroes Pramati and Praghasa and others protected the west gate.
word_meanings: बलवान् mighty, कपिः monkey, हनुमान् Hanuman, प्रमाथिप्रषुभ्यांच Pramati and Praghasa, अन्यैः and others, वीरैश्च heroes, सङ्गतः united with, पश्चिमद्वारम् west gate, ररक्ष protected.

text: मध्यमे च स्वयं गुल्मे सुग्रीवः समतिष्ठत । सह सर्वैहरिश्रेष्ठैः सुपर्णश्वसनोपमैः ॥६-४१-४०॥
translation: Sugriva chief of all army and best of the monkey army who was equal to Garuda of beautiful wings, endowed with wind speed remained in the middle (of north and west) post.
word_meanings: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, सर्वैः all, सुपर्णश्वसनोपमैः equal to Garuda of beautiful wings endowed with wind speed, हरिश्रेष्ठैः chief and best of monkey army, स्वयम् himself, मध्यमे middle, गुल्मे post, समतिष्ठत remained.

text: वानाराणां तु षट्त्रिंशत् कोट्यः प्रख्यातयूथपाः । निपीड्योपनिविष्टाश्च सुग्रीवो यत्र वानरः ॥६-४१-४१॥
translation: Renowned generals of the Vanara army and thirtysix crores of Vanaras stood there camping.
word_meanings: प्रख्यातयूथपाः renowned generals, वानराणाम् of the Vanaras, षटित्रंशत्कोट्यः thirty six crores, वानरः Vanara, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, यत्र there, निपीड्य stood, उपनिविष्टाः camped.

text: शासनेन तु रामस्य लक्ष्मणः सविभीषणः । द्वारे द्वारे हरीणां तु कोटिं कोटिं न्यवेशयत् ॥६-४१-४२॥
translation: By the command of Rama, Vibheeshana accompanied by Lakshmana posted crores and crores of Vanaras there.
word_meanings: सविभीषणः Vibheeshana, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, रामस्य by Rama's, शासनेन command, द्वारेद्वारे crores and crores, हरीणाम् Vanaras, कोटिंकोटिम् crores and crores, न्यवेशयत् posted as per need.

text: पश्चिमेन तु रामस्य सुग्रीवः सहजाम्बवान् । अदूरान्मध्यमे गुल्मे तस्थौ बहुबलानुगः ॥६-४१-४३॥
translation: Sushena along with Jambavan and a large army of Vanaras were posted in the centre not far from Rama at the west by Rama's order.
word_meanings: सुषेणः Sushena, सहजाम्बवान् along with Jambavan, बहुबलानुगः with large army, रामस्य by Rama, पश्चिमेन at the west, अदूरात् not far from, मध्यमेगुल्मे in the centre, तस्थौ at the back.

text: ते तु वानरशार्दूलाः शार्दूला इव दंष्ट्रिणः । गृहीत्वा द्रुमशैलाग्रान् हृष्टा युद्धाय तस्थिरे ॥६-४१-४४॥
translation: Vanaras who resembled tigers, endowed with sharp teeth joyfully stood there holding trees and peaks of mountain waiting to combat.
word_meanings: शार्दूलाःइव resembling tiger, दंष्ट्रिणः endowed with sharp teeth, ते they, वानरशार्दूलाः tigers among Vanaras, हृष्टाः joyfully, द्रुमशैलाग्रान् trees and peaks of mountains, गृहीत्वा holding, युद्धाय to combat, तस्थिरे waited.

text: सर्वे विकृतलाङ्गूलाः सर्वे दंष्ट्रानखायुधाः । सर्वे विकृतचित्राङ्गाः सर्वे च विकृताननाः ॥६-४१-४५॥
translation: All had their tails lifted unusually, had their nails and teeth sharp as weapons, some had unnatural face, and all of them had distorted eyes (as in fury).
word_meanings: सर्वे all, विकृतालाङ्गूलाः unusually lifted up, सर्वे all, दंष्ट्रानखायुधा: had their teeth and nails as weapons, सर्वे all, विकृतचित्राङ्गाः unnatural faces, सर्वेच and all, विकृताननाः distorted eyes.

text: दशनागबलाः केचित् केचिद्दशगुणोत्तराः । केचिन्नागसहस्रस्य बभूवुस्तुल्यविक्रमाः ॥६-४१-४६॥
translation: A few of them were having the strength of ten elephants, some had ten times more than others, and a few were endowed with great strength equal to thousand elephants.
word_meanings: केचित् a few, दशनागबलाः strength of ten elephants, केचित् some, दशगुणोत्तराः ten times more strong than others, केचित् a few, नागसहस्रस्य equal to thousand elephants in strength, तुल्यविक्रमाः endowed with great strength, बभूवुः were.

text: सन्ति चौघबलाः केचित् केचिच्छतगुणोत्तराः । अप्रमेयबलाश्चान्ये तत्रासन् हरियूथपाः ॥६-४१-४७॥
translation: Few monkeys had strength of an ogha, some had a hundred times more, and the monkey commanders possessed immeasurable strength.
word_meanings: केचित् few, ओघबलाः strength of an ogha, केचित् some, शतगुणोत्तराः hundred times more, सन्ति still, तत्र there, अन्ये others, हरियूथपाः monkey commanders, अप्रमेयाबलाश्च immeasurable strength, आसन् possessed.

text: अद्भुतश्च विचित्रश्च तेषामासीत् समागमः । तत्र वानरसैन्यानां शलभानामिवोद्यमः ॥६-४१-४८॥
translation: There it seemed as if a flight of locusts had gathered, with monkey army gathered there. It was amazing and astonishing.
word_meanings: तत्र there, शलभानाम् in that place, उद्यमःइव like locusts, तेषाम् they, वानरसैन्यानाम् Vanara army, समागमः gathered, अद्भुतश्च amazing, विचित्रश्च astonishing, आसीत् seemed.

text: परिपूर्णमिवाकाशं सञ्छन्नेव च मेदिनी । लङ्कामुपनिविष्टैश्च सम्पतद्भिश्च वानरैः ॥६-४१-४९॥
translation: Vanaras settled in such a way all around Lanka completely covering the land with those already at Lanka.
word_meanings: लङ्काम् in Lanka, उपनिविष्टैः settled, वानरैः with Vanara, सम्पतद्भिश्च already staying, आकाशम् the sky, प्रतिपूर्णमिव fully around like, मेदिनीच on the land, सञ्छन्ने covering.

text: शतं शतसहस्राणां पृथगृक्षवनौकसाम् । लङ्काद्वाराण्युपाजग्मुरन्ये योद्धुं समन्ततः ॥६-४१-५०॥
translation: A hundred thousand bars and monkeys and several others already gathered at the gates of Lanka to fight proceeded.
word_meanings: ऋक्षवनौकसाम् bears and monkeys, शतसहस्राणाम् a hundred thousand, शतम् a hundred, पृथक् several, अन्ये others, समन्ततः gathered, लङ्काद्वाराणि at the gates of Lanka, योद्धुम् to fight, उपाजग्मुः proceeded.

text: आवृतः स गिरिः सर्वैस्तैः समन्तात् प्लवङ्गमैः ॥६-४१-५१॥
अयुतानां सहस्रं च पुरीं तामभ्यवर्तत ॥६-४१-५२॥
translation: All over the mountain the monkeys surrounded the boundary wall of Lanka city to collect information.
word_meanings: सःगिरिः that mountain, समन्तात् all over, तैः those, प्लवङ्गमैः monkeys, आवृतः surrounded, अयुतानाम् boundary, सहस्रम् all over, ताम् them, पुरीम् city, अभ्यवर्तत to collect information.

text: वानरैर्बलवद्भिश्च बभूव द्रुमपाणिभिः । संवृता सर्वतो लङ्का दुष्प्रवेशापि वायुना ॥६-४१-५३॥
translation: Mighty Vanaras holding uprooted trees occupied everywhere and it seemed difficult for even wind to enter Lanka.
word_meanings: द्रुमपाणिभिः with uprooted trees, बलवद्भिः might, वानरैः Vanaras, सर्वतः everywhere, सम्वृता occupied, लङ्का Lanka, वायुनापि even for wind, दुष्प्रवेशा difficult to enter, बभूव appeared.

text: राक्षसा विस्मयं जग्मुः सहसा ऽभिनिपीडिताः । वानरैर्मेघसङ्काशैः शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमैः ॥६-४१-५४॥
translation: Caught by Vanaras like clouds and equalled Indra in valour gave way to wonder for the Rakshasas.
word_meanings: मेघसङ्काशैः clouds, शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमैः Indra of great valour, वानरैः Vanaras, सहसा equalled, अभिनिपीडिताः caught, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, विस्मयम् wondered, जग्मुः gave way.

text: महान् शब्दो ऽभवत्तत्र बलौघस्याभिवर्ततः । सागरस्येव भिन्नस्य यथा स्यात् सलिलस्वनः ॥६-४१-५५॥
translation: Thereafter with the divisions of the Vanara army moving like the ocean on the mountain peak, appeared like the roaring sound of water in the ocean moving out of boundary.
word_meanings: तत्र thereafter, भिन्नस्य divisions, सागरस्येव like the ocean, बलौघस्य on the mountain peak, अभिवर्ततः appeared, सलिलस्वनः roaring sound of water, यथा like that, स्यात् , महान् great, शब्दः sound, अभवत् appeared.

text: तेन शब्देन महता सप्राकारा सतोरणा । लङ्का प्रचलिता सर्वा सशैलवनकानना ॥६-४१-५६॥
translation: By the great sound the boundary, the archways and the mountains and forests shook violently.
word_meanings: महता great, तेनशब्देन by that sound, सप्राकारा that boundary, सतोरणा the archways, सशैलवनकानना mountains forests, सर्वा all, लङ्का Lanka, प्रचलिता shook violently.

text: रामलक्ष्मणगुप्ता सा सुग्रीवेण च वाहिनी । बभूव दुर्धर्षतरा सर्वैरपि सुरासुरैः ॥६-४१-५७॥
translation: Protected by Rama and Lakshmana and Sugriva that an army of monkeys became difficult to assail even for Rakshasas and Devatas.
word_meanings: रामलक्ष्मणगुप्ता protected by Rama and Lakshmana, सुग्रीवेणच and Sugriva, सा that, हरिवाहिनी monkey army, सर्वैः all, सुरासुरैरपि Rakshasas and Devatas, दुर्धर्षतरा highly difficult, बभूव became.

text: राघवः सन्निवेश्यैव सैन्यं स्वं रक्षसां वधे । सम्मन्त्र्य मन्त्रिभिः सार्धं निश्चित्य च पुनःपुनः । आनन्तर्यमभिप्रेप्सुः क्रमयोगार्थतत्त्ववित् ॥६-४१-५८॥
translation: Deliberating on the action to be taken to kill the Rakshasas, Raghava himself called the army and gathered them and the ministers all of them again and again discussed and took the decision. Later recalling the king's duty with Vibheeshana, summoned Vali's son Angada and spoke these words.
word_meanings: क्रमयोगार्थतत्त्ववित् deliberating the action repeatedly, राघवः Raghava, स्वम् himself, सैन्यम् army, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, वधे to kill, एवम् in the same way, संनिवेश्य gathering together, मन्त्रिभिः even ministers सार्थम् all of them, पुनःपुनः again and again, सम्मन्त्ऱ्य discussing, निश्चित्य decision taken, अनन्तर्यम् later, अभिप्रेप्सुः recalling राजधर्मम् king's duty, अनुस्मरन् calling, विभीषणस्य with Vibhishana, अनुमते per mission, वालितनयम् Vali's son, अङ्गदम् Angada, समाहूय summoning, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: विभीषणस्यानुमते राजधर्मनुस्मरन् । अङ्गदं वालितनयं समाहूयेदमब्रवीत् ॥६-४१-५९॥
translation: Deliberating on the action to be taken to kill the Rakshasas, Raghava himself called the army and gathered them and the ministers all of them again and again discussed and took the decision. Later recalling the king's duty with Vibheeshana, summoned Vali's son Angada and spoke these words.
word_meanings: क्रमयोगार्थतत्त्ववित् deliberating the action repeatedly, राघवः Raghava, स्वम् himself, सैन्यम् army, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, वधे to kill, एवम् in the same way, संनिवेश्य gathering together, मन्त्रिभिः even ministers सार्थम् all of them, पुनःपुनः again and again, सम्मन्त्ऱ्य discussing, निश्चित्य decision taken, अनन्तर्यम् later, अभिप्रेप्सुः recalling राजधर्मम् king's duty, अनुस्मरन् calling, विभीषणस्य with Vibhishana, अनुमते per mission, वालितनयम् Vali's son, अङ्गदम् Angada, समाहूय summoning, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: त्य च पुनःपुनः । गत्वा सोम्य दशग्रीवं ब्रुहि मद्वचनात् कपे । लङ्घयित्वा पुरीं लङ्कां भयं त्यक्त्वा गतव्यथः ॥६-४१-६०॥
translation: "O noble Hanuman crossing over Lanka without fear, giving up the difficulties experienced earlier we reached. Admonish the tenheaded king who has lost senses, his past fortune and sovereignty."
word_meanings: सौम्य noble, कपे monkey, लङ्कांपुरीम् Lanka's, लङ्घयित्वा crossing over, भयम् fear, त्यक्त्वा giving up, गतव्यधः past difficulty, भ्रष्टश्रीक lost sovereignty, गतैश्वर्य fallen out of past fortune, मुमूर्षोनष्टचेतनः lost his sense, दशग्रीवम् tenheaded king, गत्वा gone, मद्वचनात् proudly, ब्रूहि said.

text: भ्रष्टश्रीकगतैश्वर्य मुमूर्षो नष्टचेतन । ऋषीणां देवतानां च गन्धर्वाप्सरसां तथा ॥६-४१-६१॥
नागानामथ यक्षाणां राज्ञां च रजनीचर । यच्च पापं कृतं मोहादवलिप्तेन राक्षस ॥६-४१-६२॥
translation: "O night ranger! the time has come for punishment for the sins committed by you to the sages, Devatas, so also to Gandharvas, celestial beauties, Nagas, Yakshas and the kings because of your delusion in conceit. Surely your pride about the boons begotten from the selfborn creator will be gone, said Rama.
word_meanings: रजनीचर night ranger, ऋषीणाम् for the sages, देवतानाम् Devatas, तथा so also, गन्धर्वाप्सरसाम् Gandharvas and celestial beauties, नागानाम् Nagas, अथ and, यक्षाणाम् Yakshas, राज्ञांच and kings, मोहात् because of delusion, अवलिप्तेन conceited, यत् that, पापम् sin, कृतम् done, तस्य by him, पापस्य sin's, दुरासदा dangerous to approach, व्युष्टिः boon, अद्य obtained, सम्प्राप्ता begotten, नूनम् surely, ते those, स्वयम्भुवरदानजः granted by self born creator, दर्पः pride, विगतः has gone.

text: नूनमद्य गतो दर्पः स्वयम्भूवरदानजः । यस्य दण्डधरस्ते ऽहं दाराहरणकर्शितः । दण्डं धारयमाणस्तु लङ्काद्वारे व्यवस्थितः ॥६-४१-६३॥
translation: "You, who have abducted my wife, I will punish you with a rod of punishment. I am your chastiser, O king of Lanka I have taken position."
word_meanings: दाराहरणकर्शितः one who has abducted my wife, अहम् I am, तस्य your, ते to you, दण्डधरः holding rod दण्डम् punish, धारयामाणः chastiser, लङ्काद्वारे o king of Lanka, व्यवस्थितः taken position.

text: पदवीं देवतानां च महर्षीणां च राक्षस । राजर्षीणां च सर्वेषां गमिष्यसि मया हतः ॥६-४१-६४॥
translation: "O Rakshasa! Even Devatas, sages and even royal sages have also lost their lives, killed by me."
word_meanings: राक्षस Rakshasa, मया by me, हतः killed, देवतानांच even Devatas, महर्षीणांच even sages, सर्वेषाम् all of them, राजर्षीणांच royal sages, पदवीम् position, गमिष्यसि lost.

text: बलेन येन वै सीतां मायया राक्षसाधम । मामतिक्रामयित्वा त्वं हृतवांस्तन्निदर्शय ॥६-४१-६५॥
translation: "O lowly Rakshasa! By deceiving me you took away Sita. Display that strength now."
word_meanings: राक्षसाधम lowly Rakshasa, त्वम् your, येन that, बलेन power, मायया to me, माम् me, अतिक्रामयित्वा by deceiving me, सीताम् Sita, हृतवान् took away, तत् that, द्विदर्शय display it now.

text: अराक्षसमिमं लोकं कर्तास्मि निशितैः शरैः । न चेच्छरणमभ्येषि मामुपादाय मैथिलीम् ॥६-४१-६६॥
translation: "If you do not seek my protection I will devoid this world of Rakshasas with my sharp arrows."
word_meanings: ताम् her, मैथिलीम् Mythili, आदाय seek, शरणम् my protection, नअभ्येषियदि if not take, निशितैः sharp, शरैः arrows, इमम् this, लोकम् world, अराक्षसम् devoid of Rakshasas, कर्तास्मि will make.

text: धर्मात्मा रक्षसां श्रेष्ठः सम्प्राप्तो ऽयं विभीषणः । लङ्कैश्वर्यं ध्रुवं श्रीमानयं प्राप्नोत्यकण्टकम् ॥६-४१-६७॥
translation: "This Vibheeshana, the best of Rakshasas will be glorious and fortunate undoubtedly having got the kingdom of Lanka."
word_meanings: धर्मात्मा righteous, राक्षसश्रेष्ठः best of Rakshasas, अयंविभीषणः this Vibhishana, सम्प्राप्तः having got, श्रीमान् fortunate, अकण्डकम् glorious, धृवम् undoubtedly, लङ्कैश्वर्यम् kingdom of Lanka, प्राप्नोति will get.

text: न हि राज्यमधर्मेण भोक्तुं क्षणमपि त्वया । शक्यं मूर्खसहायेन पापेनाविदितात्मना ॥६-४१-६८॥
translation: "One who is not aware of himself, an unrighteous sinner ruling with foolish mates cannot enjoy the kingdom even for a moment."
word_meanings: मूर्खसहायेन with the help of foolish mates, पापेन a sinner, अविदितात्मना not aware of himself, त्वया by you, क्षणमपि even a moment, राज्यम् kingdom, अथर्मेण unrighteousness, भोक्तुम् to enjoy, नशक्यंहि not possible.

text: युद्ध्यस्व वा धृतिं कृत्वा शौर्यमालम्ब्य राक्षस । मच्छरैस्त्वं रणे शान्तस्ततः पूतो भविष्यसि ॥६-४१-६९॥
translation: "O Rakshasa! You are resorting to fortitude and valour and embracing gallantry in war. By my arrows you will obtain peace (in death)."
word_meanings: राक्षस Rakshasa, वा or, धृतिम् fortitude, कृत्वा resorting to, शौर्यम् valour, आलम्ब्य embracing, युध्यस्व gallantry, त्वम् you, रणे in war, मच्छरैः my arrows, शान्तः peace, ततः then, भविष्यसि will obtain.

text: यद्वा विशसि लोकांस्त्रीन् पक्षिभूतो मनोजवः । मम चक्षुष्पथं प्राप्य न जीवन् प्रतियास्यसि ॥६-४१-७०॥
translation: "O Ravana! You have no control over your mind, and if you come in the range of my eyesight and enter the three worlds also you will not go alive again."
word_meanings: मनोजवः one who has no control over mind, मम my, चक्षुःपथम् range of my eyesight, प्राप्य having come in, पक्षी bird, भूत्वा range, त्रीन् three, लोकान् worlds, अविशसि entering, जीवन् with life, नप्रतियास्यसि not go alive again.

text: ब्रवीमि त्वां हितं वाक्यं क्रियतामौर्ध्वदैहिकम् । सुदृष्टा क्रियतां लङ्का जीवितं ते मयि स्थितम् ॥६-४१-७१॥
translation: Having addressed it in well meaning words, Rama said 'I will do you obsequies as no one will be left in Lanka to do your last rites'.
word_meanings: त्वाम् these, हितम् well meaning, वाक्यम् words, ब्रवीमि having spoken, और्ध्वहिकम् obsequies, क्रियताम् to do, लङ्का in Lanka, सुदृष्टा to do the last rites, क्रियताम् do तेजीवितम् for your life, मयि I, स्थितम् will do.

text: इत्युक्तः स तु तारेयो रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा । जगामाकाशमाविश्य मूर्तिमानिव हव्यवाट् ॥६-४१-७२॥
translation: Rama having spoken that way, Tara's son, Angada, who was like fire god, who was unwearied in action flew to the sky.
word_meanings: अक्लिष्टकर्मणा unwearied in action, रामेण by Rama, इति this way, उक्तः spoken, तारेयः Tara's son, मूर्तिमान् resembled, हव्यवाट् इव like fire, आकाशम् sky, आविश्य flew, जगाम went.

text: सो ऽतिपत्य मुहूर्तेन श्रीमान्रावणमन्दिरम् । ददर्शासीनमव्यग्रं रावणं सचिवैः सह ॥६-४१-७३॥
translation: Angada landed on Ravana's palace in a moment and saw the tiger like prosperous Ravana seated with his ministers.
word_meanings: श्रीमान् prosperous, सः that he, मुहूर्तेन in a moment, रावणमन्दिरम् Ravana's palace, अतिपत्य having landed, सचिवैःसह with his ministers, आसीनम् seated, रावणम् Ravana, अव्यग्रम् tiger, ददर्श saw.

text: ततस्तस्याविदूरे स निपत्य हरिपुङ्गवः । दीप्ताग्निसदृशस्तस्थावङ्गदः कनकाङ्गदः ॥६-४१-७४॥
translation: Thereafter, the leader of the monkeys, Angada adorned with golden armlets stood like a blazing fire at a distance.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, सहरिपुङ्गवः that leader of monkeys, दीप्ताग्निसदृशः blazing like fire, कनकाङ्गदः adorned with golden armlets, अङ्गदः Angada, तस्य his, अविदूरेण at a short distance, निपत्य landed, तस्थौ stood.

text: तद्रामवचनं सर्वमन्यूनाधिकमुत्तमम् । सामात्यं श्रावयामास निवेद्यात्मानमात्मना ॥६-४१-७५॥
translation: "I made known the words of Rama completely without adding or deleting. You may listen."
word_meanings: आत्मानम् I am, आत्मना myself, निवेद्य known, तत् that, उत्तमम् best, सर्वम् all, रामवचनम् Rama's words, अन्यूनाधिकम् without adding or deleting, सामात्यम् completely, श्रावयामास you may listen.

text: दूतो ऽहं कोसलेन्द्रस्य रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः । वालिपुत्रो ऽङ्गदो नाम यदि ते श्रोत्रमागतः ॥६-४१-७६॥
translation: "I am the son of Vali,by name Angada,an envoy of Rama ,the king of Kosala of unwearied action. You may know that I have landed"
word_meanings: वालिपुत्रः Vali's son, अङ्गदोनाम by name Angada, अहम् I am, कोशलेन्द्रस्य Kosala King's, अक्लिष्टकर्मणः unwearied in action, रामस्य Rama's, दूतः envoy, ते to you, श्रोत्रम् land, आगतःयदि have landed.

text: आह त्वां राघवो रामः कौसल्यानन्दवर्धनः । निष्पत्य प्रतियुद्ध्यस्व नृशंस पुरुषो भव ॥६-४१-७७॥
translation: "Raghava, the enhancer of the happiness of Kausalya speaks to you. Ruthless Rakshasa! Sallying forth, get ready for combat."
word_meanings: राघवः Raghava, कौसल्यानन्दवर्धनः enhancer of happiness of Kausalya (Rama), रामः Rama, त्वाम् to you, आह you, नृशंस ruthless, निष्पत्य sallying forth, युध्यस्व in combat, पुरुषः man, भव to me.

text: हन्तास्मि त्वां सहामात्यं सपुत्रज्ञातिबान्धवम् । निरुद्विग्नास्त्रयो लोका भविष्यन्ति हते त्वयि ॥६-४१-७८॥
translation: "You and your son's relatives and followers being killed (by me) the three worlds will be rid of fear of you."
word_meanings: सहामात्यम् along with ministers, सपुत्रज्ञातिबान्धवम् sons, relatives and followers, त्वाम् you, हन्तास्मि been killed, त्वयि of you, हते killed, त्रयः three, लोकाः worlds, निरुद्विग्नाः rid of fear, भविष्यन्ति will become.

text: देवदानवयक्षाणां गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम् । शत्रुमद्योद्धरिष्यामि त्वामृषीणां च कण्टकम् ॥६-४१-७९॥
translation: "You are an enemy of the gods, Danavas and Yakshas, Gandharvas and Nagas and being a thorn in the neck of sages, I will uproot you from here."
word_meanings: देवदानवयक्षाणाम् gods, Danavas and Yakshas, गन्धर्वोरगरक्षसाम् Gandharvas, Nagas, शत्रुम् enemy, ऋषीणाम् for the sages, कण्टकंच thorn in the neck, त्वाम् you, अद्य being, उद्धरिष्यामि uproot you.

text: विभीषणस्य चैश्वर्यं भविष्यति हते त्वयि । न चेत् सत्कृत्य वैदेहीं प्रणिपत्य प्रदास्यसि ॥६-४१-८०॥
translation: "Unless you return back Vaidehi respectfully, bowing down to me you will be killed and Vibheeshana will get the fortune."
word_meanings: प्रणिपत्य bowing down, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, सत्कृत्य respectfully, नप्रदास्यसिचेत् not return back, त्वयि by you, हते being killed, ऐश्वर्यम् fortune, विभीषणस्य to Vibhishana, भविष्यति will be getting.

text: इत्येवं परुषं वाक्यं ब्रुवाणे हरिपुङ्गवे । अमर्षवशमापन्नो निशाचरगणेश्वरः ॥६-४१-८१॥
translation: The leader of the monkeys having spoken in that manner, Ravana the ruler of night rangers was overtaken by fury.
word_meanings: हरिपुङ्गवे leader of monkey army, इत्येवम् in this way, परुषम् harsh, वाक्यम् words, ब्रुवाणे having spoken, निशाचरगणेश्वरः ruler of night rangers, अमर्षवशम् by fury, आपन्नः overtaken.

text: ततः स रोषताम्राक्षः शशास सचिवांस्तदा । गृह्यतामेष दुर्मेधा वध्यतामिति चासकृत् ॥६-४१-८२॥
translation: Thereafter, Ravana who was shaken by fury repeatedly commanded his ministers and said 'Let this evil minded monkey be seized and killed'.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, रोषम् shaken by fury, आपन्नः overtaken, सः he, तदा then, एष in this way, सचिवान् ministers, असकृत् repeatedly, शशास commanded, दुर्मेधाः evil minded, गृह्यताम् seize him, वध्यताम् kill him.

text: रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा दीप्ताग्निसमतेजसः । जगृहुस्तं ततो घोराश्चत्वारो रजनीचराः ॥६-४१-८३॥
translation: Thereafter, having heard the words of Ravana, the four Rakshasas seized Angada blazing in brilliance like fire.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, घोराः terrific, चत्वारः four, रजनीचराः night rangers, रावणस्य of Ravana, वचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, समतेजसा of equal brilliance, दीप्ताग्नि blazing like fire, तम् him, Angada, जगृहुः seized.

text: ग्राहयामास तारेयः स्वयमात्मानमात्मवान् । बलं दर्शयितुं वीरो यातुधानगणे तदा ॥६-४१-८४॥
translation: Then Angada, the son of Tara, on his own wanting to exhibit his strength in the presence of the Rakshasa army allowed himself to be caught.
word_meanings: तदा then, आत्मवान् himself, वीरः heroic, तारेयः son of Tara, यातुधानगणे in the presence of Rakshasa army, बलम् strength, दर्शयितुम् to exhibit, स्वयम् on his own, आत्मानम् by his, ग्राहयामास allowed to be caught.

text: स तान् बाहुद्वये सक्तानादाय पतगानिव । प्रासादं शैलसङ्कासमुत्पपाताङ्गदस्तदा ॥६-४१-८५॥
translation: Then Angada holding the Rakshasas by his arms came down like birds on the roof of the palace which stood like a mountain.
word_meanings: तदा then, सःअङ्गदः that Angada, बाहुद्वयसक्तान् holding the arms, तान् from that, पतगानिव like birds, आदाय came, शैलसङ्काशम् which stood like a mountain peak, प्रासादम् palace, उत्पपात came down.

text: ते ऽन्तरिक्षाद्विनिर्धूतास्तस्य वेगेन राक्षसाः । भूमौ निपतिताः सर्वे राक्षसेन्द्रस्य पश्यतः ॥६-४१-८६॥
translation: Crushed by that speed of Angada coming down as if from the sky all the Rakshasas fell down on the ground while the Rakshasa king looked on.
word_meanings: तेन by that, अन्तरिक्षात् from the sky, तस्य its, निर्धूता crushed, वेगेन speed, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य Rakshasa king's, तस्य from (the mountain), तत्र there, सर्वे all, भूमौ on the ground, निपतिताः fell.

text: ततः प्रासादशिखरं शैलशृङ्गमिवोन्नतम् । ददर्श राक्षसेन्द्रस्य वालिपुत्रः प्रतापवान् ॥६-४१-८७॥
translation: Then as the courageous Vali's son landed on the high peak of the palace which resembled a mountain peak, Ravana stood looking.
word_meanings: ततः then, प्रतापवान् courageous, वालिपुत्रः Vali's son, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य at Ravana, शैलशृङ्गमिव like the peak of mountain, उन्नतम् high, प्रासादशिखरम् peak of the palace, ददर्श saw.

text: तत्पफाल पदाक्रान्तं दशग्रीवस्य पश्यतः । पुरा हिमवतः शृङ्गं वज्रिणेव विदारितम् ॥६-४१-८८॥
translation: As Ravana was looking, Angada trampling his feet gave way to the palace just as Himalayan peak broke to hit Indra.
word_meanings: पदाक्रान्तम् trampled by, पुरा earlier, वज्रिण Indra, विदारितम् broken, हिमवतःशृङ्गमिव Himalayan peak, दशग्रीवस्य Ravana's, पश्यतः as he was looking, तत्पफाल cleft

text: भङ्क्त्वा प्रासादशिखरं नाम विश्राव्य चात्मनः । विनद्य सुमहानादमुत्पपात विहायसम् ॥६-४१-८९॥
translation: Hitting on the peak of the palace, Angada declaring his own name emitting loud sound rose up to the sky.
word_meanings: प्रासादशिखरम् peak of the palace, भङ् क्त्वा hitting, आत्मनः his own, नाम name, विश्रान्य declaring, सुमहानादम् loud sound, विनद्य emitting, विहायसा into the sky, उत्पपात rose.

text: व्यथयन् राक्षसान् सर्वान् हर्षयंश्चापि वानरान् । स वानराणां मध्ये तु रामपार्श्वमुपागतः ॥६-४१-९०॥
translation: Angada caused pain to the Rakshasas and delighted the monkeys and returned to the midst of Vanaras near Rama.
word_meanings: सः he, सर्वान् all, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, व्यथयन् causing pain, वानरान् Vanaras, हर्षयंश्चापि delighting, वानराणाम् to Vanaras, मध्ये midst, रामपार्श्वम् near Rama, उपागतः returned back.

text: रावणस्तु परं चक्रे क्रोधं प्रासादधर्षणात् । विनाशं चात्मनः पश्यन्निश्वासपरमो ऽभवत् ॥६-४१-९१॥
translation: Ravana exhibiting extreme anger at the shattering of his palace and seeing his destruction started sighing heavily.
word_meanings: रावणस्तु even Ravana, प्रासादधर्षणात् for shattering the palace, परम् very, क्रोधम् angry, चक्रे exhibiting, आत्मनः for him, विनाशम् destruction, पश्यन् seeing, निःश्वासपरमः sighing, अभवत् exhibited.

text: रामस्तु बहुभिर्हृष्टैर्निनदद्भिः प्लवङ्गमैः । वृतो रिपुवधाकाङ्क्षी युद्धायैवाभ्यवर्तत ॥६-४१-९२॥
translation: Delighted by the roaring sound of many monkeys Rama awaited surrounded by groups of monkeys desirous of starting war.
word_meanings: रामस्तु On Rama's part, हृष्टैः delighted, विनदद्भिः roaring like a lion, बहुभिः many, प्लवङ्गमैः monkey groups, वृतः surrounded, रिपुवधाकाङ्क्षी desirous of destruction of enemy, युद्धायैव for war, अभ्यवर्तत waiting.

text: सुषेणस्तु महावीर्यो गिरिकूटोपमो हरिः । बहुभिः संवृतस्तत्र वानरैः कामरूपिभिः ॥६-४१-९३॥
translation: Sushena of great prowess, who resembled a mountain in form stood there surrounded by many Vanaras who could change their form at their will.
word_meanings: महावीर्यः of great prowess, गिरिकूटोपमः resembling mountain, हरिः Monkey, सुषेणस्तु Sushena also, तत्र there, कामरूपिभिः who change their form according to their will, बहुभिः many, वानरैः Vanaras, सम्वृतः surrounded.

text: चतुर्द्वाराणि सर्वाणि सुग्रीववचनात् कपिः । पर्यक्रामत दुर्धर्षो नक्षत्राणीव चन्द्रमाः ॥६-४१-९४॥
translation: Sushena, a monkey who is difficult to encounter, went around all the four gates just like the moon goes around stars by the order of Sugriva.
word_meanings: दुर्धर्षः one who is difficult to encounter, कपिः monkey, सुग्रीववचनात् by the command of Sugriva, चतुर्द्वाराणि the four gates, सर्वाणि all, चन्द्रमाः moon, नक्षत्राणीव stars, पर्यक्रामत moves around.

text: तेषामक्षौहिणिशतं समवेक्ष्य वनौकसाम् । लङ्कामुपनिविष्टानां सागरं चाभिवर्तताम् ॥६-४१-९५॥
राक्षसा विस्मयं जग्मुस्त्रासं जग्मुस्तथा ऽपरे । अपरे समरोद्धर्षाद्धर्षमेव प्रपेदिरे ॥६-४१-९६॥
translation: Seeing the large army of a hundred Akshauhinis of monkeys staying near Lanka spreading beyond the sea waiting for war the Rakshasas were wonder struck, some feared, some were alarmed to witness the jubilant Vanaras who exhibited joy alone.
word_meanings: लङ्काम् उपनिविष्टानाम् staying near Lanka, सागरंच extending beyond the ocean, अनिवर्तताम् spreading beyond, तेषाम् them, वनौकसाम् Vanara army, अक्षौहिणिशतम् a hundred Akshauhinis, समवेक्ष्य collected together, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, विस्मयम् wonder struck, जग्मुः feared, अपरे alarmed, समरे war, हर्षात् joyful, हर्षमेव joy alone, प्रपेदिरे exhibited.

text: कृत्स्नं हि कपिभिर्व्याप्तं प्राकारपरिखान्तरम् । ददृशू राक्षसा दीनाः प्राकारं वानरीकृतम् ॥६-४१-९७॥
हाहाकारं प्रकुर्वन्ति राक्षसा भयमोहिताः ॥६-४१-९८॥
translation: The Rakshasas were desperate to see the spread of monkeys over the entire area from the boundary to moat of Lanka. The way the space between was filled with Vanaras seemed as though the Vanaras converted into boundaries. Rakshasas were seen making a loud noise.
word_meanings: राक्षसाः Rakshasa, दीनाः desperate, कपिभिः even monkeys, व्याप्तम् spread over, कृत्स्नम् dark, प्राकारपरिखान्तरम् entire area from the boundary and moat, नानरीकृतम् filled with monkeys, प्राकारम् boundary, ददृशुः saw, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, भयम् fear, आगताः reached, हाहाकारम् making noise, प्रकुर्वन्ति converted to defensive walls.

text: तस्मिन् महाभीषणके प्रवृत्ते कोलाहले राक्षसराजधान्याम् । प्रगृह्य रक्षांसि महायुधानि युगान्तवाता इव संविचेरुः ॥६-४१-९९॥
ततस्ते राक्षसास्तत्र गत्वा रावणमन्दिरम् । न्यवेदयन् पुरीं रुद्धां रामेण सह वानरैः ॥६-४२-१॥
translation: Then the Rakshasas proceeding to Ravana's abode informed that Rama along with the vanaras have occupied the whole of Lanka.
word_meanings: तत then, राक्षसा Rakshasas, स्तत्र there, रावणमन्दिरम् Ravana's abode, गत्वा proceeding to, रामेण Rama's, वानरैः Vanaras, सह along with, रुद्धां occupied, न्यवेदय informed, न्पुरीं total city.

text: रुद्धां तु नगरीं श्रुत्वा जातक्रोधो निशाचरः । विधानं द्विगुणं कृत्वा प्रासादं सो ऽध्यरोहत ॥६-४२-२॥
translation: On knowing that Lanka is occupied, the night ranger Ravana, became very furious and doubled the forces of Lanka for the protection and went to the top of Lanka palace.
word_meanings: रुद्धां occupied, तु also, नगरीं city, श्रुत्वा hearing, जातक्रोधो very furious, निशाचरः night ranger, विधानं knowing, द्विगुणं twice, श्रुत्वा hearing, प्रासादं top of the mansion, अध्यरोहत planning for the protection of Lanka.

text: स ददर्शावृतां लङ्कां सशैलवनकाननाम् । असङ्ख्येयैर्हरिगणैः सर्वतो युद्धकाङ्क्षिभिः ॥६-४२-३॥
translation: He observed a countless number of Vanara troops spread all over Lanka, mountains, and forests.
word_meanings: स: he, युद्धकाङ्क्षिभिः desirous of combat, असङ्ख्येयै countless numbers, हर्रिगणैः troops of Vanaras, सशैलवनकाननाम् mountains and forests, सर्वतो all over, अवृतां occupied, लङ्कां Lanka, ददर्शा observed.

text: स दृष्ट्वा वानरैः सर्वां वसुधां कवलीकृताम् । कथं क्षपयितव्याः स्युरिति चिन्तापरो ऽभवत् ॥६-४२-४॥
translation: Seeing the Vanaras occupying the entire earth, Ravana thought of destroying and started thinking.
word_meanings: स: he, वानरैः Vanaras, सर्वां all, वसुधां earth, कवलीकृताम् occupied, दृष्ट्वा seeing, कथं how, स्युरिति thought, क्षपयितव्याः to destroy, चिन्तापरो thinking, अभवत् started.

text: स चिन्तयित्वा सुचिरं धैर्यमालम्ब्य रावणः । राघवं हरियूथांश्च ददर्शायतलोचनः ॥६-४२-५॥
translation: Ravana, thinking over for long, picking up courage, saw Rama's Vanaras with thoughtful eyes.
word_meanings: स: he, रावणः Ravana, सुचिरं for long, चिन्तयित्वा thinking over, धैर्यमालम्ब्य picking up courage, अयतलोचनः with thoughtful eyes, राघवं Raghava, हरियूथांश्च at the Vanaras, ददर्शा saw.

text: राघवः सह सैन्येन मुदितो नाम पुप्लुवे । लङ्कां ददर्श गुप्तां वै सर्वतो राक्षसैर्वृताम् ॥६-४२-६॥
translation: Raghava accompanied by the army happily went near and witnessed Lanka filled with Rakshasas all over.
word_meanings: राघवः Raghava, मुदितो happily, सहसैन्येन with army, पुप्लुवे near, लङ्कां Lanka, सर्वतो all over, राक्षसैर्वृताम् fully filled with Rakshasas, गुप्तांवै protected, लङ्कां Lanka, ददर्श witnessed.

text: दृष्ट्वा दाशरथिर्लङ्कां चित्रध्वजपताकिनीम् । जगाम सहसा सीतां दूयमानेन चेतसा ॥६-४२-७॥
translation: The son of Dasaratha saw Lanka decorated with flags and posts and thinking of Sita he became very worried.
word_meanings: दाशरथि son of Dasaratha, चित्रध्वजपताकिनीम् decorated with flags and posts, लङ्कां Lanka, चेतसा thinking, सीतां of Sita, दूयमानेन worried, सहसा very much, जगाम remained.

text: अत्र सा मृगशावाक्षी मत्कृते जनकात्मजा । पीड्यते शोकसन्तप्ता कृशा स्थण्डिलशायिनी ॥६-४२-८॥
translation: "Here (Lanka) is the daughter of Janaka, immersed in sorrow because of me, tormented and emaciated without food and struggling."
word_meanings: अत्र here, सा she, मृगशावाक्षी dove eyed, जनकात्मजा Janaka's daughter, पीड्यते tormented, मत्कृते because of me, शोकसन्तप्ता immersed in sorrow, कृशा emaciated, स्थण्डिलशायिनी without food struggling.

text: पीड्यमानां स धर्मात्मा वैदेहीमनुचिन्तयन् । क्षिप्रमाज्ञापयामास वानरान् द्विषतां वधे ॥६-४२-९॥
translation: Thinking of Vaidehi again and again, who is pained, Rama ordered the Vanaras to kill the enemies immediately.
word_meanings: धर्मात्मा righteous, स: he (Rama), पीड्यमानां pained, वैदेहीम Vaidehi, अचिन्तयन् thinking of very much, क्षिप्रमाज्ञापयामास immediately ordered, वानरान् Vanaras, द्विषतां enemies, वधे to kill.

text: एवमुक्ते तु वचने रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा । सङ्घर्षमाणाः प्लवगाः सिंहनादैरनादयन् ॥६-४२-१०॥
translation: Ordered in that way by Rama, who does not cause sorrow, the monkeys roared like lions getting ready for war on hearing Rama's words.
word_meanings: क्लिष्टकर्मणा one who does not cause sorrow, एवमुक्ते having ordered that way तु, वचने his words, प्लवगाः monkeys, संघर्षमाणाः getting ready for war, सिम्हनादैरनादयन् roared like a lion

text: शिखरैर्विकिरामैनां लङ्कां मुष्टिभिरेव वा । इति स्म दधिरे सर्वे मनांसि हरियूथपाः ॥६-४२-११॥
translation: The monkey troops thought of crushing Lanka with their fists and mountain peaks.
word_meanings: हरियूथपाः Vanara troops, लङ्कां Lanka, शिखरैर्विकिरामैनां with mountain peaks, मुष्टिभिरेववा or with fists, इति this, स्मदधिरे will crush, सर्वे all, मनांसि thought.

text: उद्यम्य गिरिशृङ्गाणि शिखराणि महान्ति च । तरूंश्चोत्पाट्य विविधांस्तिष्ठन्ति हरियूथपाः ॥६-४२-१२॥
translation: Holding the mountain peaks, huge trees of many kinds, the Vanara leaders stood ready to fight.
word_meanings: हरियूथपाः Vanara leaders, गिरिशृङ्गाणि mountains, शिखराणि peaks, तरूंश्चोत्पाट्य holding trees, महान्तिच huge, विविधां many kinds, स्तिष्ठन्ति ready to fight.

text: प्रेक्षतो राक्षसेन्द्रस्य तान्यनीकानि भागशः । राघवप्रियकामार्थं लङ्कामारुरुहुस्तदा ॥६-४२-१३॥
translation: To make Rama happy, all the Vanara army divided into groups and started ascending the boundary (of Lanka) walls the king of Rakshasas was witnessing.
word_meanings: राक्षसेन्द्रस्य king of Rakshasas, प्रेक्षतो as he was looking, तान्यनीकानि all the Vanara army, राघवप्रियकामार्थं to make Rama happy, भागशः in divisions, लङ्काम Lanka, आरुरुहुस्तदा ascended the boundary.

text: ते ताम्रवक्त्रा हेमाभा रामार्थे त्यक्तजीविताः । लङ्कामेवाभ्यवर्तन्त सालतालशिलायुधाः ॥६-४२-१४॥
translation: Vanaras of copper colour faces and golden coloured ones, dedicating their lives for the sake of Rama holding Sala trees and rocks went towards Lanka.
word_meanings: ताम्रवक्त्रा having copper colour faces, हेमाभा golden coloured, रामार्थे for the sake of Rama, त्यक्तजीविताः giving up life, सालतालशिलायुधाः Sala, Tala trees and rocks as weapons, लङ्कामेवाभ्यवर्तन्त went to Lanka.

text: ते द्रुमैः पर्वताग्रैश्च मुष्टिभिश्च प्लवङ्गमाः । प्राकाराग्राण्यरण्यानि ममन्थुस्तोरणानि च ॥६-४२-१५॥
translation: With the means of mountain peaks, as well as their fists, the Vanaras scaled the boundary walls and gateways of the city.
word_meanings: ते they (Vanaras ), द्रुमैः trees, पर्वताग्रैश्च peaks of mountains, मुष्टिभिश्च even with fists, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, प्राकाराग्रा top of boundary, अरण्यानि forests, ममन्थुस्तोरणानिच gateways of the city

text: परिखाः पूरयन्ति स्म प्रसन्नसलिलायुताः । पांसुभिः पर्वताग्रैश्च तृणैः काष्ठैश्च वानराः ॥६-४२-१६॥
translation: The Vanaras started filling the moats with soil, pure water, logs of wood, grass, and mountain peaks.
word_meanings: वानराः Vanaras, पारिखाः with soil, पर्वताग्रैश्च with mountain peaks, तृणैः with grass, काष्ठैश्च wooden pieces, पांसुभिः moats also, प्रसन्नसलिलायुताः with pure water, पूरयन्ति filled.

text: ततः सहस्रयूथाश्च कोटीयूथाश्च वानराः । कोटीशतयुताश्चान्ये लङ्कामारुरुहुस्तदा ॥६-४२-१७॥
translation: Then the Vanaras in thousands and crores ascended Lanka.
word_meanings: ततः then, वानराः Vanaras, सहस्रयूथाश्च thousand, कोटीयूथाश्च one crore, कोटीशतयुताश्चान्ये hundred crores, लङ्काम into Lanka, आरुरुहुस्तदा ascended then.

text: काञ्चनानि प्रमृद्नन्तस्तोरणानि प्लवङ्गमाः । कैलासशिखराभाणि गोपुराणि प्रमथ्य च ॥६-४२-१८॥
translation: The Vanaras started breaking the golden gateways and crushing them which were like peaks of Kailasa mountain.
word_meanings: काञ्चनानि golden, प्रमृद्नन्तस्तोरणानि breaking the gateways, कैलासशिखराभानि like the peaks of Kailasa mountain, गोपुराणि towers, प्रमथ्यच crushing, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys went.

text: आप्लवन्तः प्लवन्तश्च गर्जन्तश्च प्लवङ्गमाः । लङ्कां तामभिधावन्ति महावारणसन्निभाः ॥६-४२-१९॥
translation: Jumping here and there like huge elephants, the Vanaras roaring like lions went into Lanka.
word_meanings: आप्लवन्तः jumping here and there, महावारणसंनिभाः like huge elephants, प्लवन्तश्च Vanaras, गर्जन्तश्च roaring like lion, लङ्कांतामभिधावन्ति went up to Lanka.

text: जयत्यतिबलो रामो लक्ष्मणश्च महाबलः । राजा जयति सुग्रीवो राघवेणाभिपालितः ॥६-४२-२०॥
translation: "Victorious is Sri Rama, who is exceedingly strong and Lakshmana who is endowed with supreme strength. Victorious is Sugriva the king of Vanaras who is protected by Raghava on all sides."
word_meanings: जयत्य victorious, अतिबलो exceedingly strong, रामो Rama, महाबलः endowed with supreme, strength, लक्ष्मणश्च Lakshmana also, राजा king, जयति victorious, सुग्रीवो Sugriva, राघवेण by Raghava, अभिपालितः protected by on all sides.

text: इत्येवं घोषयन्तश्च गर्जन्तश्च प्लवङ्गमाः । अभ्यधावन्त लङ्कायाः प्राकारं कामरूपिणः ॥६-४२-२१॥
translation: Shouting in that manner, the monkeys who could change their form at their will started roaring and rushed towards the defensive walls.
word_meanings: कामरूपिणः who could change their form at will, इत्येवं in this manner, घोषयन्तश्च shouting, गर्जन्तश्च roaring, लङ्कायाः into Lanka, प्राकारं defensive walls, अभ्यधावन्त rushed over.

text: वीरबाहुः सुबाहुश्च नलश्च वनगोचरः । निपीड्योपनिविष्टास्ते प्राकारं हरियूथपाः । एतस्मिन्नन्तरे चक्रुः स्कन्धावारनिवेशनम् ॥६-४२-२२॥
translation: Veerabahu, Subahu, Nala and the foremost of the Vanara leaders storming the boundary walls in the meantime went inside and stationed at the northeast gate.
word_meanings: वीरबाहुः Veerabahu, सुबाहुश्च and Subahu, नल Nala, वनगोचरः foremost of monkeys, निपीड्योप storming, निविष्टास्ते defensive, प्राकारं boundary walls, हरियूथपाः Vanara leaders, एतस्मिन्नन्तरे in the meantime inside, चक्रुः went, स्कन्धावारनिवेशनम् remained stationed at northeast.

text: पूर्वद्वारं तु कुमुदः कोटीभिर्दशभिर्वृतः । आवृत्य बलवांस्तस्थौ हरिभिर्जितकाशिभिः ॥६-४२-२३॥
translation: Kumuda, surrounded by ten crores of mighty monkeys, who appeared like conquerors, stationed at the east gate.
word_meanings: कुमुदः Kumuda, तु also, कोटीभि one crore, र्दशभि ten, आर्वृतः surrounded by, पूर्वद्वारं east gate, आवृत्य surrounded, बलवां mighty, स्तस्थौ remained, हरिभि monkeys also, र्जितकाशिभिः appearing victorious.

text: साहाय्यार्थं तु तस्यैव निविष्टः प्रघसो हरिः । पनसश्च महाबाहुर्वानरैर्बहुभिर्वृतः ॥६-४२-२४॥
translation: Praghasa the broad shouldered Vanara, was surrounded by Panasa for assisting him who encamped surrounded by many.
word_meanings: प्रघसो Praghasa, हरिः monkey, महाबाहु broad shouldered, पनसश्च Panasa also, वानर Vanaras, साहाय्यार्थं for assisting, तस्यैव himself, निविष्टः encamped, बहुभि many, आर्वृतः surrounded.

text: दक्षिणं द्वारमागम्य वीरः शतवलिः कपिः । आवृत्य बलवांस्तस्थौ विंशत्या कोटिभिर्वृतः ॥६-४२-२५॥
translation: Valiant Satabali with twenty crores of monkeys stood besieging the south gate.
word_meanings: वीरः valiant, शतबलिः Satabali, कपिः monkey, विंशत्या twenty, कोटिभि crores, आवृत्य surrounded by, बलवांस्तस्थौ stood besieging, दक्षिणं south, द्वारमागम्य reached the gate.

text: सुषेणः पश्चिमद्वारं गतस्तारापिता हरिः । आवृत्य बलवांस्तस्थौ षष्टिकोटिभिरावृतः ॥६-४२-२६॥
translation: Sushena, father of Tara, (Vali's wife) the mighty, stood with sixty crores of monkeys at the western gate.
word_meanings: गतस्तारापिता father of Tara (wife of Vali), बलवांस्तस्थौ the mighty, सुषेणः Sushena, आवृत्य along with, षष्टिकोटिभिरावृतः sixty crores of monkeys surrounding, पश्चिमद्वारं at the western gate.

text: उत्तरं द्वारमासाद्य रामः सौमित्रिणा सह । आवृत्य बलवांस्तस्थौ सुग्रीवश्च हरीश्वरः ॥६-४२-२७॥
translation: Reaching the north gate, Sri Rama along with Saumithri, blockading the gate stood Sugriva the Lord of monkeys.
word_meanings: उत्तरंद्वारमासाद्य reaching north gate, रामः Rama, सौमित्रिणा Saumithri, सह along with, आवृत्य accompanied by, बलवांस्तस्थौ blockading the gate, हरीश्वरः Lord of monkeys, सुग्रीवश्च Sugriva.

text: गोलाङ्गूलो महाकायो गवाक्षो भीमदर्शनः । वृतः कोट्या महावीर्यस्तस्थौ रामस्य पार्श्वतः ॥६-४२-२८॥
translation: Gavaksha of gigantic body and fierce appearance, along with one crore of Golangula species of monkeys endowed with extraordinary virility stood by the side of Sri Rama.
word_meanings: महाकायो of gigantic body, गवाक्षो Gavaksha, भीमदर्शनः of fierce appearance, गोलाङ्गूलो Golangula species of monkeys, कोट्या crore, वृतः surrounded by, महावीर्यस्तस्थौ of extraordinary virility, रामस्य Rama's, पार्श्वतः by the side of.

text: ऋक्षाणां भीमवेगानां धूम्रः शत्रुनिबर्हणः । वृतः कोट्या महावीर्यस्तस्थो रामस्य पार्श्वतः ॥६-४२-२९॥
translation: Accompanied by a crore of Bears of redoubtable fury, Dhumra (brother of Jambavan), an exterminator of foes endowed with extraordinary valour stood by Rama's side.
word_meanings: वृतः accompanied by, कोट्या one crore, ऋक्षाणां bears, भीमवेगानां of redoubtable fury, धूम्रः Dhumra (brother of Jambavan), शत्रुनिबर्हणः exterminator of his foes, महावीर्यस्तस्थौ endowed with extraordinary valour, रामस्य Rama's, पार्श्वतः by the side of.

text: सन्नद्धस्तु महावीर्यो गदापाणिर्विभीषणः । वृतो यत्तैस्तु सचिवैस्तस्थौ तत्र महाबलः ॥६-४२-३०॥
translation: Vibheeshana with defensive clamour, of extraordinary virility accompanied by his mighty ministers, stood there with his mace in hand.
word_meanings: वृतो accompanied by, सन्नद्धस्तु defensive clamour, महावीर्यो of extraordinary virility, गदापाणि wielding mace, विर्भीषणः Vibheeshana, यस्तैस्तु stood, सचिवैस्तस्थौ with ministers stood, तत्र there, महाबलः mighty.

text: गजो गवाक्षो गवयः शरभो गन्धमादनः । समन्तात् परिधावन्तो ररक्षुर्हरिवाहिनीम् ॥६-४२-३१॥
translation: Gaja, Gavaksha, Gava, Sarabha, Gandhamadana stood protecting the monkey troops wandering all over.
word_meanings: गजो Gaja, गवाक्षो Gavaksha, गवयः Gava, शरभ Sarabha, गन्धमादनः Gandamadhana, मन्तात्परिधावन्तो all over wandering, ररक्षु protecting, हर्रिवाहिनीम् monkey troops.

text: ततः कोपपरीतात्मा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः । निर्याणं सर्वसैन्यानां द्रुतमाज्ञापयत्तदा ॥६-४२-३२॥
translation: Thereafter Ravana, the Lord of Rakshasas overcome by fury ordered all his forces to advance.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, राक्षसेश्वरः Lord of Rakshasas, रावण Ravana, सर्वसैन्यानां all his forces, निर्याणं to depart, कोपपरीतात्मा overcome by fury, द्रुत to advance, आज्ञापयत्तदा ordered.

text: एतच्छुत्वा ततो वाक्यं रावणस्य मुखोद्गतम् । सहसा भीमनिर्घोषमुद्घुष्टं रजनीचरैः ॥६-४२-३३॥
translation: Hearing the command issued from Ravana's mouth, immediately a terrific roar was raised by the night rangers.
word_meanings: रावणस्य from Ravana's, मुखोद्गतम् command issued from his mouth, एतच्छ्रुत्वा as soon as it was heard, ततो that, वाक्यं words. सहसा instantly, भीमनिर्घोषमुद्घुष्टं terrific roar, रजनीचरैः night rangers.

text: ततः प्रचोदिता भेर्यश्चन्द्रपाण्डरपुष्कराः । हेमकोणाहता भीमा राक्षसानां समन्ततः ॥६-४२-३४॥
translation: Then shone the white discs like the moon beaten by the Rakshasas with gold sticks making terrific sound.
word_meanings: ततः then, प्रचोदिता shone, भेर्यश्चन्द्र like the moon, पाण्डरपुष्कराः white discs, भीमा terrific, राक्षसानां Rakshasas, हेमकोणाहता gold sticks.

text: विनेदुश्च महाघोषाः शङ्खाः शतसहस्रशः । राक्षसानां सुघोराणां मुखमारुतपूरिताः ॥६-४२-३५॥
translation: With hundred thousand Rakshasas blowing sonorous conchs, with the wind from their mouths, terrific noise arose.
word_meanings: राक्षसानां Rakshasas, सुघोराणां terrific sounds, शतसहस्रशः hundred thousand, महाघोषाः loud noise, शङ्खाः with conchs, विनेदुश्च sonorous, मुखमारुत with wind from their mouth, पूरिताः blown.

text: ते बभुः शुभनीलाङ्गाः सशङ्का रजनीचराः । विद्युन्मण्डलसन्नद्धाः सबलाका इवाम्बुदाः ॥६-४२-३६॥
translation: The night rangers with their brilliant dark limbs, with conchs, were like dark clouds provided with armour with flashes of lightning and accompanied by herons.
word_meanings: ते they, बभुः brilliant, शुभनीलाङ्गाः dark limbs, रजनीचराः night rangers, सशङ्खा with conches, इवाम्बुदाः like clouds, विद्युन्मण्डलसन्नद्धाः provided with armour with flashes of lightning, सबलाका accompanied by herons.

text: निष्पतन्ति ततः सैन्या हृष्टा रावणचोदिताः । समये पूर्यमाणस्य वेगा इव महोदधेः ॥६-४२-३७॥
translation: Urged by Ravana, the army then joyfully rushed forth swiftly like a great ocean at the time of universal destruction.
word_meanings: रावणचोदिताः urged by Ravana, सैन्या army, ततः then, हृष्टा joyfully, निष्पतन्ति rushed forth, वेगा swiftly, महोदधेः great ocean, इव like, समये at the time of, पूर्यमाणस्य universal destruction.

text: ततो वानरसैन्येन मुक्तो नादः समन्ततः । मलयः पूरितो येन स सानुप्रस्थकन्दरः ॥६-४२-३८॥
translation: Thereafter the Vanara army emitted a sound that filled all sides of Malaya Mountain, its major and minor caves.
word_meanings: ततो thereafter, वानरसैन्येन by the Vanara army, मुक्तो emitted, नादः sound, समन्ततः on all sides, पूरितो filled, मलयः Malaya mountain, येन by that, स that, सानुप्रस्थकन्दरः major and minor peaks and caves.

text: शङ्खदुन्दुभिसङ्घुष्टः सिंहनादस्तरस्विनाम् । पृथिवीं चान्तरिक्षं च सागरं चैव नादयन् ॥६-४२-३९॥
translation: By the blast of conchs and roll of drums, and roar of lions of Vanara and Rakshasa forces it resounded all over the earth, sky and up to the ocean.
word_meanings: शङ्खदुन्दुभिसंघुष्टः blast of conchs and roll of drums, सिम्हनाद roar of lions, स्तरस्विनाम् and of Vanara and Rakshasa heroes, पृथिवीं earth, चान्तरिक्षंच to sky, सागरंचैव up to ocean, नादयन् resounded.

text: गजानां बृंहितैः सार्धं हयानां हेषितैरपि । रथानां नेमिघोषैश्च रक्षसां वदनस्वनः ॥६-४२-४०॥
translation: The trumpeting of the elephants, the neighing of horses, the clatter of the wheels of the chariots and the shout of Rakshasas resounded in the air.
word_meanings: गजानां of elephants, बृंहितैः trumpeting, सार्धंहयानां neighing of horses, हेषितैरपि clatter of wheels, रथानां of chariots, नेमिघोषैश्च shout of, रक्षसाम्, Rakshasas, वदनस्वनः resounded in the air.

text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे घोरः सङ्ग्रामः समवर्तत । रक्षसां वानराणां च यथा देवासुरे पुरा ॥६-४२-४१॥
translation: In the meantime, dreadful conflict arose all over between Rakshasas and Vanaras, which was like the conflict between Devas and asuras earlier.
word_meanings: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे in the meantime, घोरः dreadful, सङ्ग्रामः conflict, समवर्तत all over, रक्षसां Rakshasas, वानराणांच between Vanaras, यथादेवासुरे like the conflict between Devas and asuras, पुरा earlier.

text: ते गदाभिः प्रदीप्ताभिः शक्तिशूलपरश्वधैः । निजघ्नुर्वानरान् घोराः कथयन्तः स्वविक्रमान् ॥६-४२-४२॥
translation: Vowing their own prowess, the Rakshasas began to strike the Vanaras with maces, flaming javelins, tridents, and pikes fiercely.
word_meanings: ते the Rakshasas, स्वविक्रमान् vaunting their own prowess, गदाभिः with maces, प्रदीप्ताभिः flaming शक्तिशूलपरश्वधैः with javelins, tridents and pikes, निजघ्नु fiercely struck, नरान्घोराः at Vanaras, कथयन्तः attacked.

text: राजा जयति सुग्रीव इति शब्दो महानभूत् ॥६-४२-४३॥
translation: "May the vanara king,triumphant Sugriva be victorious", thus sounded the cry of vanaras in the battlefield.
word_meanings: राजा king, जयति victory, सुग्रीव Sugriva, इति thus, शब्दो sound, महानभूत् be triumphant, राजन् king, जय victorious, जयेत्युक्त्वा saying victory to you, स्वस्वनामकथान्ततः arose war cry from the Vanaras.

text: राजन् जय जयेत्युक्त्वा स्वस्वनामकथान्ततः । तथा वृक्षैर्महाकायाः पर्वताग्रैश्च वानराः । निजघ्नुस्तानि रक्षांसि नखैर्दन्तैश्च वेगिताः ॥६-४२-४४॥
translation: Vanaras in the same manner attacked the Rakshasas, with trees and mountains, swiftly and with their nails and teeth.
word_meanings: तथा in the same manner, वृक्षैर्महाकायाः with trees, पर्वताग्रैश्च with mountain peaks, वानराः Vanaras, रक्षांसि at Rakshasas, नखैर्दन्तैश्च with nails and teeth, निजघ्नुस्तानि attacked, वेगिताः swiftly.

text: राक्षसास्त्वपरे भीमाः प्राकारस्था महीगतान् । भिन्दिपालैश्च खड्गैश्च शूलैश्चैव व्यदारयन् ॥६-४२-४५॥
translation: Standing on the walls, the redoubtable Rakshasas, pierced the Vanaras with swords, dreadful Bhindipalas.
word_meanings: राक्षसास्त्वपरे redoubtable Rakshasas, प्राकारस्था standing on the walls, भीमाः dreadful, भिन्दिपालैश्च Bhindipalas (javelin like weapons), खड्गैश्च and swords, शूलैश्चैव with tridents, व्यदारयन् pierced.

text: वानराश्चापि सङ्क्रुद्धाः प्राकारस्थान् महीगताः । राक्षसान् पातयामासुः समाप्लुत्य प्लवङ्गमाः ॥६-४२-४६॥
translation: The vanaras jumping up dragged the Rakshasas stationed on the boundary wall down to the ground.
word_meanings: प्राकारस्थान्महीगताः stationed on the boundary walls, वानराश्चापि Vanaras also, राक्षसान्पातयामासुः dragged down the Rakshasas, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, समाप्लुत्य jumping up.

text: स सम्प्रहारस्तुमुलो मांसशोणितकर्दमः । रक्षसां वानराणां च सम्बभूवाद्भुतोपमः ॥६-४२-४७॥
translation: The conflict that happened between the Rakshasas and Vanaras was amazing and intense and left a mire of flesh and blood. ।। इत्यार्षेश्रीमद्वाल्मीकिरामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेद्विचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the forty second sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: स that, सम्प्रहार conflict, रक्षसां of Rakshasas, वानराणांच and Vanaras, तमुलो intense, मांस flesh, शोणित blood, कर्दमः like mire, सम्बभूवा that happened, अद्भुतोपमाः was amazing.

text: युद्ध्यातां तु ततस्तेषां वानराणां महात्मनाम् । रक्षसां सम्बभूवाथ बलकोपः सुदारुणः ॥६-४३-१॥
translation: Thereafter the gigantic army of Vanaras were fighting with exceedingly terrific Rakshasas and the anguished Rakshasas could not tolerate the sight.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, महात्मानाम् gigantic, तेषांवानराणाम् those Vanaras, रक्षसांच and Rakshasas, युध्यताम् waging war, अथ while, सुदारुणः exceedingly terrific, बलरोषः anguished, सम्बभूव could not tolerate the sight.

text: ते हयैः काञ्चनापीडैर्ध्वजैश्चाग्निशिखोपमैः । रथैश्चादित्यसङ्काशैः कवचैश्च मनोरमैः ॥६-४३-२॥
translation: Wishing victory for Ravana, the tiger among ogres, the Rakshasas of terrific deeds sallied forth accompanied by horses with golden trappings and seizing posts, which were like flames of fire shining like the sun's rays on the chariots and delightful shields, roaring resounding in all the ten directions.
word_meanings: रावणस्य for Ravana, जयैषिणः desiring victory, राक्षसव्याघ्राः tiger among Rakshasas, भीमकर्माणः of terrible deeds, तेराक्षसाः those Rakshasas, काञ्चनापीडैः provided with golden trappings, हयैः horses, अग्निशिखोपमैः like flames of fire, ऊर्ध्वैः posts, आदित्यसङ्काशैः shining like sun's rays, रथैः chariots, मनोरमैः delightful, कवचैश्च shields, दश ten, दिशः directions, नादयन्तः resounding, निर्ययुः sallied forth.

text: निर्ययू राक्षसव्याघ्रा नादयन्तो दिशो दश । राक्षसा भीमकर्माणो रावणस्य जयैषिणः ॥६-४३-३॥
translation: Wishing victory for Ravana, the tiger among ogres, the Rakshasas of terrific deeds sallied forth accompanied by horses with golden trappings and seizing posts, which were like flames of fire shining like the sun's rays on the chariots and delightful shields, roaring resounding in all the ten directions.
word_meanings: रावणस्य for Ravana, जयैषिणः desiring victory, राक्षसव्याघ्राः tiger among Rakshasas, भीमकर्माणः of terrible deeds, तेराक्षसाः those Rakshasas, काञ्चनापीडैः provided with golden trappings, हयैः horses, अग्निशिखोपमैः like flames of fire, ऊर्ध्वैः posts, आदित्यसङ्काशैः shining like sun's rays, रथैः chariots, मनोरमैः delightful, कवचैश्च shields, दश ten, दिशः directions, नादयन्तः resounding, निर्ययुः sallied forth.

text: वानराणामपि चमूर्बृहती जयमिच्छताम् । अभ्यधावत तां सेनां रक्षसां कामरूपिणाम् ॥६-४३-४॥
translation: Wishing triumph even the powerful army of powerful Vanaras of terrific deeds went ahead to fight with Rakshasas.
word_meanings: जयम् triumph, इच्छताम् wishing, वानराणाम् Vanaras, बृहती powerful, चमूःअपि army too, घोरकर्मणाम् of terrible deeds, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, तांसेनाम् those army, अभ्यधावत went ahead.

text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तेषामन्योन्यमभिधावताम् । रक्षसां वानराणां च द्वन्द्वयुद्धमवर्तत ॥६-४३-५॥
translation: At that time the Vanaras and Rakshasas facing each other started a dual fight.
word_meanings: एतस्मिन् अन्तरे at that time, अन्योन्यम् one another, अभिधावताम् facing one over the other, तेषाम् those, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, वानराणांच and Vanaras, द्वन्द्वयुद्धम् duel fight, आवर्तत began.

text: अङ्गदेनेन्द्रजित् सार्धं वालिपुत्रेण राक्षसः । अयुध्यत महातेजास्त्र्यम्बकेण यथा ऽन्तकः ॥६-४३-६॥
translation: Indrajith, an exceedingly brilliant Rakshasa, contended with Angada, son of Vali just like Lord Siva with and haka, the Lord of death.
word_meanings: महातेजाः exceedingly brilliant, राक्षसः Rakshasa, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, वालिपुत्रेण with Vali's son, अङ्गदेव Angada, सार्धम् contended with, अन्तकः and haka, स्त्ऱ्यम्बकेणयथा like Lord Siva with Lord of death, अयुध्यत fought

text: प्रजङ्घेन च सम्पातिर्नित्यं दुर्मर्षणो रणे । जम्बुमालिनमारब्धो हनुमानपि वानरः ॥६-४३-७॥
translation: Sampathi , who is invariably difficult to encounter in war fought with Prajangha, and Hanuman started with Jambumali.
word_meanings: रणे in war, नित्यम् invariably, दुर्मर्षणः difficult to encounter, सम्पातिः Sampathi, प्रजङ्घेन Prajangha, वानरः Vanara, हनुमानपि Hanuman, जम्बुमालिनम् with Jambumali, आरब्दः started.

text: सङ्गतः सुमहाक्रोधो राक्षसो रावणानुजः । समरे तीक्ष्णवेगेन मित्रघ्नेन विभीषणः ॥६-४३-८॥
translation: Highly furious Rakshasa, Vibheeshana, brother of Ravana fought with Rakshasa, Mitraghna.
word_meanings: महाक्रोधः highly furious, रावणानुजः Ravana's brother, राक्षसः Rakshasa, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, समरे in war, तीक्ष्णवेगेन endowed with high speed, मित्रघ्नेन Mitraghna, सङ्गतः contended.

text: तपनेन गजः सार्धं राक्षसेन महाबलः । निकुम्भेन महातेजा नीलो ऽपि समयुद्ध्यत ॥६-४३-९॥
translation: Gaja of great strength fought with Rakshasa Tapa, and highly energetic Neela fought with Nikumbha.
word_meanings: महाबलः of great strength, गजः Gaja, तपनेन with Tapa, राक्षसेनसार्धम् with Rakshasa, महातेजाः highly energetic, नीलोऽपि Neela too, निकुम्बेन with Nikumbha, समयुध्यत fought with each other.

text: वानरेन्द्रस्तु सुग्रीवः प्रघसेन समागतः । सङ्गतः समरे श्रीमान् विरूपाक्षेण लक्ष्मणः ॥६-४३-१०॥
translation: Sugriva the Lord of Vanaras fought with Praghana and prosperous Lakshmana fought with Virupaksha.
word_meanings: वानरेन्द्र Lord of Vanaras, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, प्रघनेन with Praghana, समागतः encountered, श्रीमान् prosperous, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, विरूपाक्षेण Virupaksha, समरे in war, सङ्गतः encountered.

text: आग्निकेतुश्च दुर्धर्षो रश्मिकेतुश्च राक्षसः । सुप्तघ्नो यज्ञकोपश्च रामेण सह सङ्गताः ॥६-४३-११॥
translation: Agnikethu, a Rakshasa who is difficult to win over, Rasmikethu, Suptaghna and Yajnakepu waged war with Rama.
word_meanings: सुदुर्धर्षः difficult to win over, अग्निकेतुः Agnikethu, राक्षसः Rakshasa, रश्मिकेतुश्च and Rasmikethu, सुप्तघ्नुः Suptaghna, यज्ञकेपश्च Yajnakepu, रामेणसह along with Rama, सङ्गताः waged.

text: वज्रमुष्टिस्तु मैन्देन द्विविदानशनिप्रभः । राक्षसाभ्यां सुघोराभ्यां कपिमुख्यौ समागतौ ॥६-४३-१२॥
translation: Vajramushti with Mainda and Asaniprabhu with Dwivida, the chief of monkeys, fought with the two Rakshasas.
word_meanings: वज्रमुष्टिः Vajramushti, तु also, मैन्देन with Mainda, अशनिप्रभः Asaniprabhu, द्विविदेन with Dwivida कपिमुख्यौ chief of monkeys, सुघोराभ्याम् fearful, राक्षसाभ्याम् with the two Rakshasas, समागतौ fought.

text: वीरः प्रतपनो घोरो राक्षसो रणदुर्धरः । समरे तीक्ष्णवेगेन नलेन समयुद्ध्यत ॥६-४३-१३॥
translation: Heroic and dreadful Pratapana, who is indomitable in the battle, fought with Nala endowed with high speed.
word_meanings: वीरः heroic, घोरः dreadful, रणदुर्धरः indomitable in war, प्रतपनः Pratapana, समरे in battle, तीक्ष्णवेगेन with high speed, नळेन Nala, समयुध्यत fought with.

text: धर्मस्य पुत्रो बलवान् सुषेण इति विश्रुतः । स विद्युन्मालिना सार्धमयुध्यत महाकपिः ॥६-४३-१४॥
translation: Mighty Sushena, the righteous son fought with well known Vidyunmali. And fierce monkeys and Rakshasas fought in dual war with each other.
word_meanings: धर्मस्यपुत्रो righteous son, बलवान्सुषेण of mighty Sushena, इति so also, विश्रुतः well known, सविद्युन्मालिना with Vidyunmali, सार्धमयुध्यत fought with, महाकपिः great monkey, घोराः fierce, अपरे other, वानराश्च Vanaras also, बहुभिःसह along with many, युद्धायच fought in war, अपरैः, राक्षसैःसह Rakshasas also, द्वन्द्वंसमीयुः duel fight.

text: वानराश्चापरे भीमा राक्षसैरपरैः सह । द्वन्द्वं समीयुर्बहुधा युद्धाय बहुभिः सह ॥६-४३-१५॥
translation: Mighty Sushena, the righteous son fought with well known Vidyunmali. And fierce monkeys and Rakshasas fought in dual war with each other.
word_meanings: धर्मस्यपुत्रो righteous son, बलवान्सुषेण of mighty Sushena, इति so also, विश्रुतः well known, सविद्युन्मालिना with Vidyunmali, सार्धमयुध्यत fought with, महाकपिः great monkey, घोराः fierce, अपरे other, वानराश्च Vanaras also, बहुभिःसह along with many, युद्धायच fought in war, अपरैः, राक्षसैःसह Rakshasas also, द्वन्द्वंसमीयुः duel fight.

text: तत्रासीत् सुमहद्युद्धं तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम् । रक्षसां वानराणां च वीराणां जयमिच्छताम् ॥६-४३-१६॥
translation: Fierce war which made hair stand on end happened there, with the heroic Rakshasas and Vanaras longing for victory.
word_meanings: तत्र there, जयम् victory, इच्छताम् longing, वीराणाम् heroes, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, वानराणांच and Vanaras, रोमहर्षणम् fierce which made hair stand on end, तुमुलम् confused, सुमहत् great, युद्धम् war, आसीत् happened.

text: हरिराक्षसदेहेभ्यः प्रभृताः केशशाद्वलाः । शरीरसङ्घाटवहाः प्रसस्रुः शोणितापगाः ॥६-४३-१७॥
translation: In that war, the streams of blood that flowed from the bodies of Vanaras and Rakshasas were strewn like weeds in the form of hair, bearing logs of wood in the form of dead bodies.
word_meanings: हरिराक्षसदेहेभ्यः from the body of Rakshasas and Vanaras, प्रभूताः come out, केशशाद्वलाः in the form of hair, शरीरसङ्घाटवहाः the dead bodies like logs of wood, शोणितापगाः streams of blood, प्रसुस्रुः flown.

text: आजघानेन्द्रजित् क्रुद्धो वज्रेणेव शतक्रतुः । अङ्गदं गदया वीरं शत्रुसैन्यविदारणम् ॥६-४३-१८॥
translation: Enraged, Indrajith struck Angada with his mace, the destroyer of hostile forces which was like Indra who had done a hundred sacrifices, would strike with his thunderbolt.
word_meanings: क्रुद्धः enraged, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, शतक्रतुः who has done a hundred sacrifices, वज्रेणेव Indra thunderbolt, गदया mace, शत्रुसैन्यविदारणम् destroyer of hostile forces, वीरम् heroic, अङ्गदम् Angada, आजघान struck.

text: तस्य काञ्चनचित्राङ्गं रथं साश्वं ससारथिम् । जघान समरे श्रीमानङ्गदो वेगवान् कपिः ॥६-४३-१९॥
translation: With the same mace (snatched from the Rakshasa) Angada swiftly struck Indrajit hand destroyed the horse, chariot, and charioteer.
word_meanings: कपिः monkey, अङ्गदः Angada, वेगवान् swiftly, समरे in fight, तस्य his, काञ्चनचित्राङ्गम् bright with gold, साश्वम् horses, ससारथिम् with charioteer, रथम् chariot, जघान destroyed.

text: सम्पातिस्तु त्रिभिर्बाणैः प्रजङ्घेन समाहतः । निजघानाश्वकर्णेन प्रजङ्घं रणमूर्धनि ॥६-४३-२०॥
translation: While Prajangha injured Sampathi with three arrows, in turn Sampathi killed him with Aswakarna tree in the midst of war.
word_meanings: प्रजङ्घेन Prajangha, त्रिभिः three, बाणैः arrows, समाहतः injured, सम्पातिस्तु and Sampathi also, रणमूर्धनि in the midst of war, अश्वकर्णेन A swakarna, प्रजङ्घम् Prajangham, निजघान killed.

text: जम्बुमाली रथस्थस्तु रथशक्त्या महाबलः । बिभेद समरे क्रुद्धो हनूमन्तं स्तनान्तरे ॥६-४३-२१॥
translation: Jambumali of extraordinary might mounting on the chariot in the battle pierced Hanuman in his chest.
word_meanings: महाबलः of extraordinary mighty, रथस्थः chariot's, जम्बुमाली Jambumali, क्रुद्धः angry, समरे in the battle, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, रथशक्त्या mounting on the chariot, स्तनान्तरे in the chest, बिभेद pierced

text: तस्य तं रथमास्थाय हनूमान् मारुतत्मजः । प्रममाथ तलेनाशु सह तेनैव रक्षसा ॥६-४३-२२॥
translation: Hanuman the son of wind god, getting on to the chariot quickly destroyed that Rakshasa Jambumali with his palm.
word_meanings: मारुतात्मजः son of wind god, हनुमान् Hanuman, तस्य his, तंरथम् that chariot, आस्थाय taking position, आशु quickly, तेनरक्षसा that Rakshasa, तलेन with the palm, प्रमामथ destroyed.

text: नदन् प्रतपनो घोरो नलं सो ऽप्यन्वधावत ॥६-४३-२३॥
translation: Dreadful Pratapan roared and jumped over Nala. Nala in turn gouged out the eyes of Pratapan.
word_meanings: घोरः dreadful, सःप्रतपनः that Pratapan, नदन् roaring, नलम् on Nala, अन्वधावत jumping, नलः Nala, आशु that, प्रतपनस्य Pratapan's, चक्षुषी eyes, पातयामास gouged out.

text: नलः प्रतपनस्याशु पातयामास चक्षुषी । भिन्नगात्रः शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः क्षिप्रहस्तेन रक्षसा ॥६-४३-२४॥
ग्रसन्तमिव सैन्यानि प्रघसं वानराधिपः । सुग्रीवः सप्तपर्णेन निर्बिभेद जघान च ॥६-४३-२५॥
translation: Sugriva, the Vanara leader, taking hold of Sapataparni tree hit Pratapan who had his mouth open as if to swallow the army and killed him.
word_meanings: क्षिप्रहस्तेन as if consuming monkey troops, रक्षसा Rakshasa, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, शरैः arrows, भिन्नगात्रः opening his throat, वानराधिपः Vanara leader, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, सैन्यानि army, ग्रसन्तमिव as if swallowing, प्रघसम् Praghasan, सप्तपर्णेन Sapataparni, जघानच hit speedily, निर्भिभेद and killed.

text: अग्निकेतुश्च दुर्धर्षो रश्मिकेतुश्च राक्षसः । सुप्तघ्नो यज्ञकोपश्च रामं निर्बिभिदुः शरैः ॥६-४३-२६॥
translation: Even Agnikethu who is difficult to attack, Rakshasas Rasmikethu, also Mitarghna and Yajakopa mangled Sri Rama with arrows.
word_meanings: दुर्धर्षः difficult to attack, अग्निकेतुश्च even Agnikethu, राक्षसः Rakshasa, रश्मिकेतुश्च and Rasmi kethu, मित्रघ्नः Mitraghna, यज्ञकोपश्च Yajakopa, रामम् Rama, शरैः with arrows, निर्भिभिदुः mangled.

text: तेषां चतुर्णां रामस्तु शिरांसि निशितैः शरै । क्रुद्धश्चतुर्भिश्चिच्छेद घोरैरग्निशिखोपमैः ॥६-४३-२७॥
translation: Raged Rama with his sharp arrows which were like flames of fire destroyed all the four Rakshasas by cutting their heads.
word_meanings: निशितैः sharp, रामस्तु even Rama, क्रुद्धः anguished, घोरैः fierce, अग्निशिखोपमैः like flames of fire, चतुर्भिः all the four, शरैः by arrows, तेषाम् them, चतुर्णाम् four, शिरांसि heads, चिच्छेद shattered.

text: वज्रमुष्टिस्तु मैन्देन मुष्टिना निहतो रणे । पपात सरथः साश्वः पुराट्ट इव भूतले ॥६-४३-२८॥
translation: Even Vajramushti fell on the ground struck with the fist by Mainda and the chariot and charioteer fell like the fort.
word_meanings: वज्रमुष्टिस्तु Vajramushti also, रणे in the battle, मैन्देन Mainda, मुष्टिना with fist, निहतः killed, सरथः charioteer, साश्वः horses, पुराट्टःइव like the fort, भूतले on the ground, पपात fell.

text: निकुम्भस्तु रणे नीलं नीलाञ्जनचयप्रभम् । निर्बिभेद शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः करैर्मेघमिवांशुमान् ॥६-४३-२९॥
translation: Just as the Sun 's rays pierced through clouds Nikumbha was shattered and fell like a mass of collyrium in the battlefield.
word_meanings: निकुम्भस्तु Nikumbha also, रणे in battlefield, नीलाञ्जनचयप्रभम् like a mass of dark collyrium, नीलम् Nila, अंशुमान् Sun, करैः dark, मेघमिव cloud like, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, शरैः arrows, निर्भिभेद shattered.

text: पुनः शरशतेनाथ क्षिप्रहस्तो निशाचरः । बिभेद समरे नीलं निकुम्भः प्रजहास च ॥६-४३-३०॥
translation: Nikumbha, the night ranger who was endowed with speed in shooting arrows again shot with a thousand arrows and laughed heartily.
word_meanings: क्षिप्रहस्तः endowed with speed in shooting arrows, निशाचरः night ranger, निकुम्भः Nikumbha, अथ there, शरशतेन a thousand arrows, समरे in the battle, नीलम् Nila, पुनः again, बिभेद shattered, प्रजहासच and laughed heartily.

text: तस्यैव रथचक्रेण नीलो विष्णुरिवाहवे । शिरश्चिच्छेद समरे निकुम्भस्य च सारथेः ॥६-४३-३१॥
translation: Like Lord Vishnu, Nila took the wheels of the chariot of Nikumbha and shattered the charioteer into pieces.
word_meanings: नीलः Nila, आहवे, विष्णुरिव like Vishnu, तस्यैव his own, रथचक्रेण chariot wheels, समरे in battle, निकुम्भस्य at Nikumbha, सारथेः charioteer, शिरः head, चिच्छेदः broken to pieces.

text: वज्राशनिसमस्पर्शो द्विविदो ऽप्यशनिप्रभम् । जघान गिरिशृङ्गेण मिषतां सर्वरक्षसाम् ॥६-४३-३२॥
translation: Dwivida whose body was like a thunderbolt to feel, moved about on the mountain peak as Rakshasas were watching.
word_meanings: वज्राशनिसमस्पर्शः like thunderbolt to touch, द्विविदोपि Dwivida's body, सर्वरक्षसाम् all Rakshasas, मिषताम् watching, गिरिशृङ्गेण mountain peak, अशनिप्रभम् Asaniprabhu, जघान moved about.

text: द्विविदं वानरेन्द्रं तु नगयोधिनमाहवे । शरैरशनि सङ्काशैः स विव्याधाशनिप्रभः ॥६-४३-३३॥
translation: Asaniprabha shot arrows resembling lightning at Dwivida the Vanara Lord who was fighting with trees.
word_meanings: सःअशनिप्रभः that Asaniprabha, आहवे fighting with, नगयोधिनम् with trees, वानरेन्द्रम् Vanara Lord, तु you, द्विविधम् Dwivida, आशनिसङ्काशैः resembling lightening, शरैः arrows, विव्याध wounded

text: स शरैरतिविद्धाङ्गो द्विविदः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः । सालेन सरथं साश्वं निजघानाशनिप्रभम् ॥६-४३-३४॥
translation: Dwivida whose limbs have been injured being enraged took Sala tree and killed Asaniprabha and the charioteer as well as the horses.
word_meanings: शरैः arrows, अभिविद्धाङ्गः whose limbs have been injured, सःद्विविदः that Dwivida, क्रोधमूर्छितः enraged, सालेन Sala tree, सरथम् charioteer, साश्वम् horses, अशनिप्रभम् Asaniprabha, निजघान killed.

text: विद्युन्माली रथस्थस्तु शरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः । सुषेणं ताडयामास ननाद च मुहुर्मुहुः ॥६-४३-३५॥
translation: Vidyunmali mounting the chariot started releasing arrows covered with gold at Sushena and roared.
word_meanings: रथस्थः in the chariot, विद्युन्माली Vidyunmali, काञ्चनभूषणैः decorated with gold, शरैः arrows, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, सुषेणम् at Sushena, ताडयामास beating, ननादच roared.

text: तं रथस्थमथो दृष्ट्वा सुषेणो वानरोत्तमः । गिरिशृङ्गेण महता रथमाशु न्यपातयत् ॥६-४३-३६॥
translation: Nay, Sushena, the leader of Vanaras, saw himself down and Jambumali on top in the chariot. He crushed him with a big mountain peak.
word_meanings: अथो Nay!, वानरोत्तमः leader of Vanaras, सुषेणः Sushena, रथस्थम् chariot, तम् him, दृष्टवा top, महता great, गिरिशृङ्गेण peak of the mountain, आशु there, रथम् chariot, न्यपातयत् crushed.

text: लाघवेन तु संयुक्तो विद्युन्माली निशाचरः । अपक्रम्य रथात्तूर्णं गदापाणिः क्षितौ स्थितः ॥६-४३-३७॥
translation: Vidyunmali seeing Sushena, the monkey leader got a huge rock, and hit him on his chest with the mace.
word_meanings: लाघवेन huge, संयुक्तः, निशाचरः night ranger, विद्युन्माली Vidyunmali, रथात् from the chariot, तूर्णम् quickly, अपक्रम्य got down, गदापाणिः mace, क्षितौ placed on the chest, स्थितः remained.

text: ततः क्रोधसमाविष्टः सुषेणो हरिपुङ्गवः । शिलां सुमहतीं गृह्य निशाचरमभिद्रवत् ॥६-४३-३८॥
translation: Thereafter overtaken by anger, the monkey leader Sushena seized the huge rock from the Rakshasa and dropped it.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, क्रोधसमाविष्टः overtaken by anger, हरिपुङ्गवः monkey leader, सुषेणः Sushena, महतीम् huge, शिलाम् rock, गृह्य seizing, निशाचरम् Rakshasa, अभिद्रवत् dropped.

text: तमापतन्तं गदया विद्युन्माली निशाचरः । वक्षस्यभिजघानाशु सुषेणं हरिसत्तमम् ॥६-४३-३९॥
translation: Then Vidyunmali, seeing the leader of monkeys getting the huge rock, hit him on the chest with the mace.
word_meanings: निशाचरः night ranger, विद्युन्माली Vidyunmali, आपतन्तम् , तम् him, हरिपुङ्गवः leader of monkeys, सुषेणम् Sushena, आशु with, गदया the mace, वक्षसि on the chest, अभिजघानह hit him.

text: गदाप्रहारं तं घोरमचिन्त्य प्लवगोत्तमः । तां शिलां पातयामास तस्योरसि महामृधे ॥६-४३-४०॥
translation: The great monkey leader Sushena, not caring for the mace, dropped the rock on Vidyunmali's chest.
