text: समग्रयवमच्छिद्रं पाणिपादं च वर्णवत् । मन्दस्मितेत्येव च मां कन्यालक्षणिनो द्विजाः ॥६-४८-१३॥
translation: "My palms and feet placed together have no space which are auspicious marks and brahmins have said that my gentle smile is also a mark of auspiciousness."
word_meanings: पाणिपादंच palms and feet, समग्रयवम् with no space in between, अच्छ्रिद्रम् collected, वर्णवत् described, मन्दस्मिता gentle smile, इति thus, माम् myself, कन्यालाक्षणिनः marks of auspiciousness, द्विजाः brahmins.

text: आधिराज्ये ऽभिषेको मे ब्राह्मणैः पतिना सह । कृतान्तकुशलैरुक्तं तत्सर्वं वितथीकृतम् ॥६-४८-१४॥
translation: "The prediction of astrologers that I will be consecrated with my husband and all that is falsified."
word_meanings: पतिनासह with husband, मे I, आधिराज्याभिषेकः consecrated, कृतान्तकुशलैः astrologers prediction, ब्राह्मणैः by brahmins, उक्तम् said, तत् सर्वम् all that, वितथीकृतम् falsified.

text: शोधयित्वा जनस्थानं प्रवृत्तिमुपलभ्य च । तीर्त्वा सागरमक्षोभ्यं भ्रातरौ गोष्पदे हतौ ॥६-४८-१५॥
translation: "Having gained Janasthana and crossing the ocean which is impossible knowing about my whereabouts and getting me is impossible since the brothers have been killed by the maya of Indrajith whose footprints are like a cow's hoof."
word_meanings: जनस्थानम् Janasthana, शोधयित्वा in search of me, प्रवृततिम् knowing my where about, उपलभ्यच to get me, अक्षोभ्यम् impossible, सागरम् ocean, तीर्त्वा crossing, भ्रातरौ brothers, गोष्पदे maya of Indrajith which is like foot print of cow's hoof, हतौ killed.

text: ननु वारुणमाग्नेयमैन्द्रं वायव्यमेव च । अस्त्रं ब्रह्मशिरश्चैव राघवौ प्रत्यपद्यताम् ॥६-४८-१६॥
translation: "Raghavas knew to use Varuna's weapons, fire god's weapons, Indra's also, even wind god's and Brahma's weapons. Why have they not used?"
word_meanings: राघवौ Raghavas, वारुणम् Varuna weapons, आग्नेयम् fire weapons, ऐन्द्रम् Indra's, वायव्यमेवच and even wind god's, ब्रह्मशिरःअस्त्रंच even Brahma's, प्रत्यपद्यतांननु why have they not used

text: अदृश्यमानेन रणे मायया वासवोपमौ । मम नाथावनाथाया निहतौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ॥६-४८-१७॥
translation: "Indrajith remaining invisible in war by conjuring could kill my husband who is equal to Indra in valour. Rama and Lakshmana! I am orphaned now."
word_meanings: अनाथायाः orphaned, मम I am, नाथौ dear husband, वासनोपमौ equal to Indra in valour, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, रणे in war, मायया by conjuring trick, अदृश्यमानेन by being invisible, निहतौ killed

text: न हि दृष्टिपथं प्राप्य राघवस्य रणे रिपुः । जीवन् प्रतिनिवर्तेत यद्यपि स्यान्मनोजवः ॥६-४८-१८॥
translation: "Even if the enemy is endowed with speed of thought, if he comes in the range of Rama's sight, he will not go alive."
word_meanings: रिपुः enemy, मनोजवः who is endowed with speed in thought, स्याद्यद्यपि if seen, रणे in war, राघवस्य by Rama, दृष्टिपथम् range of sight, प्राप्य happens, जीवन् life, नप्रन्तिवर्ततेहि not go alive.

text: न कालस्यातिभारो ऽस्ति कृतान्तश्च सुदुर्जयः । यत्र रामः सह भ्रात्रा शेते युधि निपातितः ॥६-४८-१९॥
translation: "Rama along with Lakshmana has fallen in the battlefield. Time spirit is too heavy and capable of doing anything, so difficult to conquer."
word_meanings: यत्र since, रामः Rama, भ्रात्रासह with his brother, युधि in the battle, निपातितः fallen, शेते lies, कालस्य time spirit, अतिभारः too heavy, नास्ति not, कृतान्तश्च capable of doing anything, सुदुर्जयः difficult to conquer.

text: न शोचामि तथा रामं लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम् । नात्मानं जननीं वापि यथा श्वश्रूं तपस्विनीम् ॥६-४८-२०॥
translation: "When I think of Rama or even great warrior Lakshmana, or my mother or myself I am not so sad as when I think of my motherinlaw who is an observer of austerity."
word_meanings: तपस्विनीम् one who observes austerities, श्वश्रूम् motherinlaw, यथा like that, तथा so also, रामम् Rama, नशोचामि not grieve, महारथम् great warrior, लक्ष्मणंच even Lakshmana, आत्मानम् my own self, नजननींचापि even my mother, न not.

text: सा ऽनुचिन्तयते नित्यं समाप्तव्रतमागतम् । कदा द्रक्ष्यामि सीतां च लक्ष्मणं च सराघवम् ॥६-४८-२१॥
translation: "She will also be worried and wait for Rama who has completed his vow (for fourteen years) and Lakshmana and Sita to come."
word_meanings: सातु she also, समाप्तव्रतम् vow completed, आगतम् will come, सराघवम् Raghava, लक्ष्मणंच and Lakshmana, सीताम् च Sita also, कदा then, द्रक्ष्यामि will see, नित्यम् always, चिन्तयते worried

text: परिदेवयमानां तां राक्षसी त्रिजटा ऽब्रवीत् ॥६-४८-२२॥
मा विषादं कृथा देवि भर्ता ऽयं तव जीवति ॥६-४८-२३॥
translation: Looking at Sita, worried, Trijata said 'Devi, do not despair. Your husband is alive'.
word_meanings: परिदेवयमानाम् god like woman, ताम् her, राक्षसी rakshasi, त्रिजटा Trijata, अब्रवीत् said, देवी Devi, विषादम् sorrow, माकृथाः not despair, तव your, भर्ता husband, अयम् this, जीवति is alive.

text: कारणानि च वक्ष्यामि महान्ति सदृशानि च । यथेमौ जीवतो देवि भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ॥६-४८-२४॥
translation: "O Devi! Rama and Lakshmana are alive. I see great reasons for this."
word_meanings: देवी Devi, भ्रातरौ brothers, इमौ like this, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, यथा in this way, जीवतः alive, महान्ति great, सदृशानि living, कारणानिच and the reasons, वक्ष्यामि I see.

text: नहि कोपपरीतानि हर्षपर्युत्सुकानि च । भवन्ति युधि योधानां मुखानि निहते पतौ ॥६-४८-२५॥
translation: "If a husband ceases life in war, their face will not have an angry look or happy appearance."
word_meanings: पतौ husband, युधि in war, निहते ceased of life, योधानाम् in the war, मुखानि face, कोपपरीतानि angry look, हर्षपर्युत्सुकानिच happy looks, नभवन्तिहि not be there.

text: इदं विमानं वैदेहि पुष्पकं नाम नामतः । दिव्यं त्वां धारयेन्नैवं यद्येतौ गतजीवितौ ॥६-४८-२६॥
translation: "Vaidehi! Indeed, this aerial car called Pushpaka which is an auspicious one would not have brought you if they are ceased of life."
word_meanings: वैदेही Vaidehi, नामतः indeed, पुष्पकंनाम Pushpaka by name, दिव्यम् auspicious, इदंविमानम् this aerial car, एतौ if they, गतजीवितौयदि are ceased of life, त्वाम् your, नधारयेत् would not have borne.

text: हतवीरप्रधानां हि हतौत्साहा निरुद्यमा । सेना भ्रमति सङ्ख्येषु हतकर्णेव नौर्जले ॥६-४८-२७॥
translation: "The army chief killed, the interest of the troop lost, Pushpaka will move about without making an effort like the ship which lost the helmsman."
word_meanings: सङ् ख्येषु the troop, हतवीरप्रधाना chief leader dead, सेना army, गतोत्साहा lost interest, निरुद्यमा without making effort, जले in water, हतकर्णा lost helmsman, नौःइव like ship, भ्रमति moves about.

text: इयं पुनरसम्भ्रान्ता निरुद्विग्ना तरस्विनी । सेना रक्षति काकुत्स्थौ मया प्रीत्या निवेदितौ ॥६-४८-२८॥
translation: "O Lady, given to austerities! These monkeys are guarding Kakuthsa as proclaimed by me lovingly. Do not be confused. They are safe."
word_meanings: तरस्विनी O lady given to austerities, इयम् this, सेवापुनः guarding, असम्भ्रान्ता confused, निरुद्विग्ना proclaimed, मया by me, प्रीत्या lovingly, निवेदितौ telling, काकुत्स्थौ Kakuthsa, रक्षति are safe.

text: सा त्वं भव सुविस्रब्धा अनुमानैः सुखोदयैः । अहतौ पश्य काकुत्स्थौ स्नेहादेतद् ब्रवीमि ते ॥६-४८-२९॥
translation: "This army is not doubting, not perturbed also, that they are killed. They are guarding the Kakutsthas lovingly. I am telling you."
word_meanings: सा he, त्वम् you, सुखोदयैः the army, अनुमानैः not doubtful, सविस्रब्धाः not perturbed, भव you, अहतौ not killed, काकुत्स्थौ Kakutsthas, पश्य seeing, स्नेहात् lovingly, एतद् all this, ते to you, ब्रवीमि telling.

text: अनृतं नोक्तपूर्वं मे न च वक्ष्ये कदाचन । चारित्रसुखशीलत्वात् प्रविष्टा ऽसि मनो मम ॥६-४८-३०॥
translation: "I have not uttered untruth earlier nor shall I do now. Indeed, you have found entry into my mind being a woman of good disposition."
word_meanings: नउक्तपूर्वम् not uttered earlier, नचवक्ष्ये nor tell a lie, कदाचन indeed, चारित्रसुखशीलत्वात् woman of good disposition, मम I am, मनः heartily, प्रविष्टाअसि found entry into my mind.

text: नेमौ शक्यौ रणे जेतुं सेन्द्रैरपि सुरासुरैः । तादृशं दर्शनं दृष्ट्वा मया चावेदितं तव । इदं च सुमहच्चिह्नं शनैः पश्यस्व मैथिलि ॥६-४८-३१॥
translation: "These two are not capable of being won in war even by gods or demons. On observation of the indications by me I am making you realize."
word_meanings: इमौ these, सेन्द्रैः Indra, सुरासुरैरपि even Suras or Asuras also, रणे in war, जेतुम् to win, नशक्यौ not capable, तादृशम् indications of life, दर्शनम् observation, दृष्टवा seeing, मया by me, तव your, आवेदितुम् making you to know.

text: निस्सञ्ज्ञावप्युभावेतौ नैव लक्ष्मीर्वियुज्यते । प्रायेण गतसत्त्वानां पुरुषाणां गतायुषाम् । दृश्यमानेषु वक्त्रेषु परं भवति वैकृतम् ॥६-४८-३२॥
translation: "Normally when we see men who have ceased life and stopped breathing their features are unappealing."
word_meanings: प्रायेण normally, गतायुषाम् ceased of life, गतसत्त्वानाम् whose breathing has stopped, पुरुषाणाम् among men, दृश्यमानेषु when we see, वक्त्रेषु in features, परम् very, वैकृतम् unappealing, भवति will be

text: त्यज शोकं च मोहं च दुःखं च जनकात्मजे । रामलक्ष्मणयोरर्थे नाद्य शक्यमजीवितुम् ॥६-४८-३३॥
translation: "O Janaka's daughter! You give up grief and delusion about Rama and Lakshmana. They are alive, no doubt."
word_meanings: जनकात्मजे Janaki, रामलक्ष्मणयोः Rama and Lakshmana अर्थे both, शोकम् sorrow, दुःखंच and grief, मोहंच and delusion, त्यज giving up, अद्य get up, अजीवितुम् are alive, नशक्यम् not possible.

text: श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तस्याः सीता सुरसुतोपमा । कृताञ्जलिरुवाचेदमेवमस्त्विति मैथिली ॥६-४८-३४॥
translation: Sita who was like deity, on hearing the words of consolation, spoken by Trijata, greeted Trijata with palms together.
word_meanings: सुरसुतोपमा equal to deities, मैथिली Mythili, सीता Sita, तस्याः her, वचनम् words of consolation, श्रुत्वा hearing, कृताज्ञलिः greeted with both palms together, एवम् in that way, अस्, इति thus, उवाच spoke.

text: विमानं पुष्पकं तत्तु सन्निवर्त्य मनोजवम् । दीना त्रिजटया सीता लङ्कामेव प्रवेशिता ॥६-४८-३५॥
translation: Then Trijata took Sita in the Pushpaka chariot endowed with the speed of mind and entered Lanka.
word_meanings: दीना desperate, सीता Sita, त्रिजटया Trijata, मनोजवम् speed of mind, तत् there, पुष्पकंविमानम् Pushpaka chariot, सन्निवर्त्य turning, लङ्कामेव into Lanka, प्रवेशिता entered.

text: ततस्त्रिजटया सार्धं पुष्पकादवरुह्य सा । अशोकवनिकामेव राक्षसीभिः प्रवेशिता ॥६-४८-३६॥
translation: Thereafter Sita along with Trijata went to Pushpaka. Making Sita to get down, rakshasi also entered Ashoka grove.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, सा she, त्रिजटयासार्थम् along with Trijata, पुष्पकात् in Pushpaka, अनरुह्य making to get down, राक्षसीभिः rakshasi also, अशोकवनिकामेव to Ashoka grove, प्रवेशिता entered.

text: प्रविश्य सीता बहुवृक्षषण्डां तां राक्षसेन्द्रस्य विहारभूमिम् । सम्प्रेक्ष्य सञ्चिन्त्य च राजपुत्रौ परं विषादं समुपाजगाम ॥६-४८-३७॥
translation: Having entered the Rakshasa's pleasure garden which had many trees, Sita gave way to intense sorrow having keenly observed the king's sons. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेअष्टचत्वारिंशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the forty eighth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: सीता Sita, बहुवृक्षषण्डाम् with many trees, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य Rakshasa Lord's, विहारभूमिम् pleasure garden, ताम् they, प्रविश्य on entering, राजपुत्रौ king's sons, सम्प्रेक्ष्य having keenly observed, सञ्चिन्त्यच with intense agony, परम् very, विषादम् sad, उपाजगाम gave way.

text: घोरेण शरबन्धेन बद्धौ दशरथात्मजौ । निश्वसन्तौ यथा नागौ शयानौ रुधिरोक्षितौ ॥६-४९-१॥
translation: Sugriva, the very powerful one and all the best of Vanaras stood immersed in sorrow surrounding the great sons of Dasaratha, who were lying on the ground bound by a network of arrows like serpents, sighing, bodies covered with blood.
word_meanings: ससुग्रीवाः that Sugriva, महाबलाः very powerful, सर्वे all, तेवानरश्रेष्ठाः best of Vanaras, घोरेण horrible, शरबन्धेन caught in network of arrows, बद्धौ bound, नागौयथा like serpents, निःश्वसन्तौ sighing, रुधिरोक्षितौ covered with blood, शयानौ lying, महात्मानौ great souls, दशरथात्मजौ Dasaratha's sons, परिवार्य surrounding, शोकपरिप्लुताः immersed in sorrow, तस्थुः were.

text: सर्वे ते वानरश्रेष्ठाः ससुग्रीवा महाबलाः । परिवार्य महात्मानौ तस्थुः शोकपरिप्लुताः ॥६-४९-२॥
translation: Sugriva, the very powerful one and all the best of Vanaras stood immersed in sorrow surrounding the great sons of Dasaratha, who were lying on the ground bound by a network of arrows like serpents, sighing, bodies covered with blood.
word_meanings: ससुग्रीवाः that Sugriva, महाबलाः very powerful, सर्वे all, तेवानरश्रेष्ठाः best of Vanaras, घोरेण horrible, शरबन्धेन caught in network of arrows, बद्धौ bound, नागौयथा like serpents, निःश्वसन्तौ sighing, रुधिरोक्षितौ covered with blood, शयानौ lying, महात्मानौ great souls, दशरथात्मजौ Dasaratha's sons, परिवार्य surrounding, शोकपरिप्लुताः immersed in sorrow, तस्थुः were.

text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे रामः प्रत्यबुध्यत वीर्यवान् । स्थिरत्वात् सत्त्वयोगाच्च शरैः सन्दानितो ऽपि सन् ॥६-४९-३॥
translation: In the meantime, Rama, although bound, being a man of fortitude established in spiritual discipline, returned to consciousness.
word_meanings: एतस्मिन् अन्तरे in the meantime, वीर्यवान् heroic, रामः Rama, शरैः arrows, सन्दानितोऽपि although bound, स्थिरत्वात् man of fortitude, सत्त्वयोगात् च and established in spiritual discipline, प्रत्यबुध्यत returned to consciousness.

text: ततो दृष्ट्वा सरुधिरं विषण्णं गाढमर्पितम् । भ्रातरं दीनवदनं पर्यदेवयदातुरः ॥६-४९-४॥
translation: There after seeing the piteous countenance of his brother, bound, and injured, Rama lamented.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, सरुधिरम् the blood, विषण्णम् in agony, गाढम् severe, अर्पितम् bound, दीनवदनम् piteous countenance, भ्रातरम् brother, दृष्टवा seeing, आतुरः injured, पर्यदेवयत् lamented.

text: किं नु मे सीतया कार्यं किं कार्यं जीवितेन वा । शयानं यो ऽद्य पश्यामि भ्रातरं युधि निर्जितम् ॥६-४९-५॥
translation: "Of what purpose is my life when I behold my brother lying lifeless in war? What do I have with Sita? Or even with my life?"
word_meanings: यः of what, अद्य my use, युधि in war, निर्जितम् lifeless, शयानम् lying, भ्रातरम् brother, पश्यामि behold, मे my, सीतया Sita, किंनुकार्यम् What accomplishment, जीवितेनवा even of life, किंकार्यम् of what use.

text: शक्या सीतासमा नारी मर्त्यलोके विचिन्वता । न लक्ष्मणसमो भ्राता सचिवः साम्परायिकः ॥६-४९-६॥
translation: "In a mortal world I can look for a woman like Sita but not possible to find a helpful and capable brother."
word_meanings: मर्त्यलोके mortal world, विचिन्वता look for, सीतासमा equal to Sita, नारी woman, शक्या possible, सचिवः friend, साम्परायिकः capable, लक्ष्मणसमः Lakshmana like, भ्राता brother, न not.

text: परित्यक्ष्याम्यहं प्राणं वानराणां तु पश्यताम् । यदि पञ्चत्वमापन्नः सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः ॥६-४९-७॥
translation: "If Sumithra's dear son gets merged with the five elements, I will give up my life as the Vanaras are beholding."
word_meanings: सुमित्रानन्दवर्धनः Sumithra's dear son, पञ्चत्वम् killedmerging with five elements, आपन्नः happens यदि if it, अहम् I, वानराणाम् Vanaras also, पश्यताम् as they behold, प्राणान् life, परित्यक्ष्यामि will give up life.

text: किं नु वक्ष्यामि कौसल्यां मातरं किं नु कैकयीम् । कथमम्भां सुमित्रां च पुत्रदर्शनलालसाम् ॥६-४९-८॥
translation: "What can I say to mother Kausalya, Kaikeyi and mother Sumithra waiting to see her son?"
word_meanings: मातरम् mother, कौसल्याम् to Kausalya, किंनुवक्ष्यामि What can I say, कैकयीम् to Kaikeyi, किंनु What to say, पुत्रदर्शनलालसाम् waiting to see the son, अम्बाम् mother, सुमित्राम् to Sumithra, कथम् What.

text: विवत्सां वेपमानां च क्रोशन्तीं कुररीमिव । कथमाश्वासयिष्यामि यदा यास्यामि तं विना ॥६-४९-९॥
translation: "If I go to Ayodhya without him, how can I console Sumithra crying aloud like a female osprey?"
word_meanings: तंविना without him, यास्यामियदि if I go, विवत्साम् without son, वेपमानांच and trembling, कुररीमिव a female osprey, क्रोशन्तीम् crying aloud, कथम् how, आश्वासयिष्यामि can console.

text: कथं वक्ष्यामि शत्रुघ्नं भरतं च यशस्विनम् ॥६-४९-१०॥
translation: "How can I return bereft of Lakshmana who went with me to the forest? What can I tell Satrughna, also the Bharata of great fame?"
word_meanings: मयासह along with me, वनम् forest, यातः return, तेनविना bereft of him, अहम् I, आगतः go, शत्रघ्नम् Satrughna, यशस्विनम् of great fame, भरतम् Bharata, कथम् how, वक्ष्यामि can I say, पुनः again.

text: मया सह वनं यातो विना तेन गतः पुनः । उपालम्भं न शक्ष्यामि सोढुं बत सुमित्रया ॥६-४९-११॥
इहैव देहं त्यक्ष्यामि न हि जीवितुमुत्सहे ॥६-४९-१२॥
translation: "If Sumithra asks me, I can't endure. I cannot bear it. I shall give up my body, my life here itself."
word_meanings: बत tell, सुमित्रया to Sumithra, उपालम्भम् endure, सोढुम् blame, नशक्ष्यामि not tolerate, इहैव here itself, देहम् body, त्यक्ष्यामि will give up, जीवितुम् life, नउत्सहे not bear.

text: धिङ्मां दुष्कृतकर्माणमनार्यं यत्कृते ह्यसौ । लक्ष्मणः पतितः शेते शरतल्पे गतासुवत् ॥६-४९-१३॥
translation: "What a pity! Me of sinful deeds and not a noble one, because of whose action Lakshmana's life having departed and lying on the bed of arrows."
word_meanings: दुष्कृतकर्माणाम् of sinful deeds, अनार्यम् not noble, माम् me, धिक् What a pity, मत्कृते by my action, असौ Oh, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, पतितः sinful, गतासुवत् whose life has departed, शरतल्पे on bed of arrows, शेतेहि let him be burnt.

text: त्वं नित्यं स विषण्णं मामाश्वासयसि लक्ष्मण । गतासुर्नाद्य शक्नोषि मामार्तमभिभाषितुम् ॥६-४९-१४॥
translation: "You were always comforting me when I was sad. Now however much I am grieved, ceased of life you cannot comfort me."
word_meanings: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, त्वम् you were, नित्यम् always, सुविषण्णम् sad, माम् me, आश्वासयसि comforted, अद्य now, गतासुः ceased of life, आर्तम् grieved, माम् me, अभिभाषितुम् to comfort, शक्तः capable, नासि not.

text: येनाद्य निहता युद्धे राक्षसा विनिपातिताः । तस्यमेव क्षितौ वीरः स शेते निहतः परैः ॥६-४९-१५॥
translation: "You, who have struck down many Rakshasas in war, are lying unconscious on the same ground struck by arrows."
word_meanings: येन who, अद्य now, युद्धे in war, बहवः many, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, विनिपातिताः injured and thrown down, निहताः struck down, शूरः by arrows, त्वम् such you, अद्य now, परैः fallen, निहतः killed, तस्यामेव there itself, शेषे unconscious.

text: शयानः शरतल्पे ऽस्मिन् स्वशोणितपरिप्लुतः । शरजालैश्चितो भाति भास्करो ऽस्तमिव व्रजन् ॥६-४९-१६॥
translation: "Lying on the bed of arrows in the network of arrows, blood flowing out from the body he remains shining like the setting sun."
word_meanings: शरजालैः by the network of arrows, चितः lying, शोणितपरिप्लुतः blood flowing, अस्मिन् his, शरतल्पे bed of arrows, शयानः lying, सः he, अस्तम् his own, व्रजन् sinking, भास्करःइव like the sun, भासि remains shining.

text: बाणाभिहतमर्मत्वान्न शक्नोत्यभिभाषितुम् । रुजा चाब्रुवतो ऽप्यस्य दृष्टिरागेण सूच्यते ॥६-४९-१७॥
translation: "Struck in the vital parts by the arrows, it is not possible for you to speak, but your anguish is indicated in your looks."
word_meanings: बाणाभिहतमर्मत्वात् struck in the vital parts by the arrows, अभिभाषितुम् to speak, नशक्नोति, अब्रुवतोऽपि not possible, अस्य his, रुजा anguish, दृष्टिरागेण his looks, सूच्यते indicating.

text: यथैव मां वनं यान्तमनुयातो महाद्युतिः । अहमप्यनुयास्यामि तथैवैनं यमक्षयम् ॥६-४९-१८॥
translation: "This Lakshmana glowing in brightness, travelled with me following me in the forest. In the same way I shall follow him to the abode of death."
word_meanings: महाद्युतिः glowing in brightness, वनम् forest, यान्तम् travelling, माम् me, यथैव with me, अनुयातः followed, तथैव in the same way, अहमपि I will also, एनम् in that way, यमक्ष्यम् abode of death, अनुयास्यामि will follow you.

text: इष्टबन्धुजनो नित्यं मां च नित्यमनुव्रतः । इमामद्य गतो ऽवस्थां ममानार्यस्य दुर्नयैः ॥६-४९-१९॥
translation: "He who was liked by relatives, was following ignoble me ever devoutly has reached this state."
word_meanings: नित्यम् always, इष्टबन्धुजनः liked by relatives, नित्यम् ever, माम् me, अनुव्रतः following, अनार्यस्य ignoble, मम me, दुर्नयैः devoted, अद्य now, इमाम् such, अवस्थाम् state, गतः reached.

text: सुरुष्टेनापि वीरेण लक्ष्मणेन न संस्मरे । परुषं विप्रियं वापि श्रावितं तु कदाचन ॥६-४९-२०॥
translation: "Indeed, heroic Lakshmana never uttered an unpalatable word. I do not remember him speaking harsh words even when he was deeply provoked."
word_meanings: सुरुष्टेनापि even unpalatable, वीरेण heroic, लक्ष्मणेनवापि by Lakshmana, कदाचन indeed, परुषम् harsh, विप्रियम् deeply, श्रावितम् invoked, नसंस्मरे I do not remember.

text: विससर्जैकवेगेन पञ्चबाणशतानि यः । इष्वस्त्रेष्वधिकस्तस्मात् कार्तवीर्याच्च लक्ष्मणः ॥६-४९-२१॥
translation: "He who, in one go released five hundred arrows (with two hand s) is therefore superior to Kartaveerya (with thousand hands) releasing the same arrows."
word_meanings: यः he who, एकवेगेन in one go, पञ्च five, बाणशतानि fund red arrows, विससर्ज released, तस्मात् therefore, कार्तवीर्यात् च by Kartaveerya, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, इष्वस्त्रषु in discharging, अधिकः superior.

text: अस्त्रैरस्त्राणि यो हन्याच्छक्रस्यापि महात्मनः । सो ऽयमुर्व्यां हतः शेते महार्हशयनोचितः ॥६-४९-२२॥
translation: "He, who could destroy Indra's arrows also deserves to be on Indra's bed, is lying on the ground, killed."
word_meanings: यः he who, महात्मनः great soul, शक्रस्य Indra's, अस्त्राण्यपि arrows also, अस्त्रः arrows, हन्यात् destroy, महार्हशयनोचितः deserve to be esteemed, सःअयम् such a person, हतः killed, उर्व्याम् on the ground, शेते lying.

text: यन्मया न कृतो राजा राक्षसानां विभीषणः । तच्च मिथ्याप्रलप्तं मां प्रधक्ष्यति न संशयः ॥६-४९-२३॥
अस्मिन्मुहूर्ते सुग्रीव प्रतियातुमितो ऽर्हसि । मत्वा हीनं मया राजन् रावणो ऽभिद्रवेद्बली ॥६-४९-२४॥
translation: "Sugriva! You return back from here now. Strong Ravana will chase you because of my not being here."
word_meanings: सुग्रीव Sugriva, अस्मिन् his, मुहूर्ते time, इतः from here, प्रतियातुम् return back, अर्हसि I think, राजन् king, रावणः Ravana, मया by me, हीनम् weak, मत्वा chase, बली strong, अब्रवेत् said.

text: अङ्गदं तु पुरस्कृत्य ससैन्यः ससुहृज्जनः । सागरं तर सुग्रीव नीलेन च नलेन च ॥६-४९-२५॥
translation: "Sugriva! Return back from here along with the army keeping Angada in front, even Neela and Nala. Cross the ocean."
word_meanings: सुग्रीव Sugriva, ससैन्यम् with army, सपरिच्छदम् along with all, अङ्गदम् Angada, पुरस्कृत्य keeping in front, नीलेनच even Neela, नलेनच and Nala, समुद्रम् ocean, तर you may cross.

text: कृतं हनुमता कार्यं यदन्यैर्दुष्करं रणे । ऋक्षराजेन तुष्यामि गोलाङ्गूलाधिपेन च ॥६-४९-२६॥
translation: "O King of Bears! King of Golangulas! Difficult action has been done by you and others in war. I am pleased with Hanumantha's action."
word_meanings: ऋक्षराजेन king of Bears, गोलाङ्गूलाधिपेन king of Golangulas, Gavaksha, रणे in war, यत् by you, अन्यैः others, दुष्करम् difficult, हनुमता Hanumantha, कार्यं in action, कृतंहि has done, तुष्यामि pleased.

text: अङ्गदेन कृतं कर्म मैन्देन द्विविदेन च । युद्धं केसरिणा सङ्ख्ये घोरं सम्पातिना कृतम् ॥६-४९-२७॥
translation: "Formidable war was done by Angada, Mainda, Dwivida, and by all the Vanaras, Kesari and Sampathi."
word_meanings: अङ्गदेन by Angada, मैन्देन Mainda, द्विविदेनच by Dwivida, कर्म action, कृतम् done, सङ् ख्ये Vanaras केसरिणा Kesari, सम्पातिना Sampathi, घोरम् formidable, युद्धम् war, कृतम् was done.

text: गवयेन गवाक्षेण शरभेण गजेन च । अन्यैश्च हरिभिर्युद्धं मदर्थे त्यक्तजीवितैः । न चातिक्रमितुं शक्यं दैवं सुग्रीवमानुषैः ॥६-४९-२८॥
translation: "Gava, Gavaksha, Sarabha and others even Vanaras have done war sacrificing their lives for me."
word_meanings: गवयेन Gava, गवाक्षेण by Gavaksha, शरभेण By Sarabha, गजेन Gaja, मदर्थे and others, त्यक्तजीवितैः sacrificing their lives, अन्यैः others, हरिभिश्च even Vanaras, युद्धम् in war.

text: यत्तु शक्यं वयस्येन सुहृदा च परन्तप । कृतं सुग्रीव तत्सर्वं भवता धर्मभीरुणा ॥६-४९-२९॥
translation: "Sugriva! It is not possible for human beings to overcome God (destiny). O scorcher of enemies! Sugriva, my best friend, you have all done righteously that which is not possible."
word_meanings: सुग्रीव Sugriva, मानुषैः in human beings, दैवम् god, अतिक्रमितुम् to overcome, नचशक्यम् not possible, परन्तप scorcher of enemies, सुग्रीव Sugriva, सुहृदा best friend, वयस्येन by you, यत्तु that which, शक्यम् not possible, तत् that, सर्वम् all, धर्मभीरुणा righteously, त्वया by you, कृतम् was done.

text: मित्रकार्यं कृतमिदं भवद्भिर्वानरर्षभाः । अनुज्ञाता मया सर्वे यथेष्टं गन्तुमर्हथ ॥६-४९-३०॥
translation: "O Bulls among Vanaras! All of you should go permitted by me. You have done friend's work. You may go where you wish to go. I permit said Rama."
word_meanings: वानरर्षभाः bulls among Vanaras, भवद्भि: by me permitted, इदम् this, मित्रकार्यम् friend's work, कृतम् done, सर्वे all, मया by me, अनुज्ञाताः you should go, यथेष्टम् where you wish to, गन्तुम् you may go, अर्हथ I permit.

text: शुश्रुवस्तस्य ते सर्वे वानराः परिदेवनम् । वर्तयाञ्चकुरश्रूणि नेत्रैः कृष्णेतरेक्षणाः ॥६-४९-३१॥
translation: All the Vanaras started shedding tears from their tawny eyes on listening to the lamentation of Rama.
word_meanings: सर्वे all, ये you, वानराः, Vanaras तस्य their, परिदेवतम् lamentation, शुश्रुवुः tears, कृष्णेतरेक्षणाः tawny eyes, नेत्रैः eyes, अश्रूणि tears, वर्तयाञ्चक्रु: started shedding.

text: ततः सर्वाण्यनीकानि स्थापयित्वा विभीषणः । आजगाम गदापाणिस्त्वरितो यत्र राघवः ॥६-४९-३२॥
translation: Thereafter, Vibheeshana, settling all the army, hastened to reach Raghava with a mace.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, सर्वाणि all, अनीकानि many, स्थापयित्वा settled, गदापाणिः mace, राघवः Raghava, यत्र there, त्वरितम् hastily, आजगाम reached.

text: तं दृष्ट्वा त्वरितं यान्तं नीलाञ्जनचयोपमम् । वानरा दुद्रुवुः सर्वे मन्यमानास्तु रावणिम् * ॥६-४९-३३॥
translation: Seeing Vibheeshana resembling a dark mountain, thinking him to be Indrajith, all the Vanaras ran from there. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेएकोनपञ्चाशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the forty ninth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: त्वरितम् quickly, यान्तम् all, नीलाञ्जनचयोपमम् like a dark mountain, तम् him, दृष्टवा seeing, सर्व all, वानराः Vanaras, रावणिम् Ravana's son, मन्यमानाः thinking, दुद्रुवुः ran away.

text: अथोवाच महातेजा हरिराजो महाबलः । किमियं व्यथिता सेना मूढवातेव नौर्जले ॥६-५०-१॥
translation: Extremely brilliant and mighty Sugriva looking at the army of Vanaras said, "Why are you worried like a boat tossed by wind in water?"
word_meanings: अथ and now, महातेजाः extremely brilliant, महाबलः mighty, हरिराजः king of monkeys, वाच words, इयंसेना the army, जले by water, मूढवातेव tossed by wind, नौःइव like the boat, किम् why, व्यथिता worrying.

text: सुग्रीवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा वालिपुत्रो ऽङ्गदो ऽब्रवीत् ॥६-५०-२॥
translation: On hearing Sugriva's question, Angada the son of Vali said, "Did you not see Dasaratha's sons Rama and chariot warrior Lakshmana, the great souls lying on a bed of arrows bathed in blood?"
word_meanings: सुग्रीवस्य Sugriva's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, वालिपुत्रः Vali's son, अङ्गदः Angada, अब्रवीत् spoke, शरजालचितौ network of arrows, रुधिरोक्षितौ bathed in blood, शरतल्पे on a bed of arrows, शयानौ lying, महात्मानौ great souls, दशरथात्मजौ Dasaratha's sons, रामम् Rama, महारथम् chariot warrior, लक्ष्मणंच Lakshmana also, त्वम् you, नपश्यसि do you not see.

text: न त्वं पश्यसि रामं च लक्ष्मणं च महाबलम् । शरजालाचितौ वीरावुभौ दशरथात्मजौ । शरतल्पे महात्मानौ शयानौ रुधिरोक्षितौ ॥६-५०-३॥
translation: On hearing Sugriva's question, Angada the son of Vali said, "Did you not see Dasaratha's sons Rama and chariot warrior Lakshmana, the great souls lying on a bed of arrows bathed in blood?"
word_meanings: सुग्रीवस्य Sugriva's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, वालिपुत्रः Vali's son, अङ्गदः Angada, अब्रवीत् spoke, शरजालचितौ network of arrows, रुधिरोक्षितौ bathed in blood, शरतल्पे on a bed of arrows, शयानौ lying, महात्मानौ great souls, दशरथात्मजौ Dasaratha's sons, रामम् Rama, महारथम् chariot warrior, लक्ष्मणंच Lakshmana also, त्वम् you, नपश्यसि do you not see.

text: अथाब्रवीद्वानरेन्द्रः सुग्रीवः पुत्रमङ्गदम् । नानिमित्तमिदं मन्ये भवितव्यं भयेन तु ॥६-५०-४॥
translation: Then Vanara king Sugriva looking at Angada said, "I do not think that the Vanaras running like this is not without any cause. Maybe out of fear of some reason ahead."
word_meanings: अथ now, वानरेन्द्र Vanara king, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, पुत्रम् son, अङ्गदम् Angada, अब्रवीत् said, इदम् this, अनिमित्तम् without any reason, नमन्ये not think, भयेन out of fear, भवितव्यम् some reason ahead.

text: विषण्णवदना ह्येते त्यक्तप्रहरणा दिशः । प्रपलायन्ति हरयस्त्रासादुत्फुल्ललोचनाः ॥६-५०-५॥
translation: "Here, the distressed Vanaras with sad faces, their eyes downcast, are fleeing in all directions abandoning their arms."
word_meanings: अत्र in this place, एते their, हरयः Vanaras, त्रासात् distressed, उत्फुल्ललोचनाः downcast their eyes, त्यक्तप्रहरणाः abandoning arms, विषण्णवदनाः sad face, दिशः directions, प्रपलायन्ति fleeing.

text: अन्योन्यस्य न लज्जन्ते न निरीक्षन्ति पृष्ठतः । विप्रकर्षन्ति चान्योन्यं पतितं लङ्घयन्ति च ॥६-५०-६॥
translation: "Without waiting to look back at others, not shy to see one another, the Vanaras are distancing themselves from those fallen and are seen fleeing."
word_meanings: अन्योन्यस्य one to the other, नलज्जन्ते not shy to see others, पृष्ठतः the other side, ननिरीक्षन्ति not waiting to look back at others, अन्योन्यम् one another, विप्रकर्षन्ति distancing, पतितम् fallen, लङ्घयन्तिच and fleeing.

text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वीरो गदापाणिर्विभीषणः । सुग्रीवं वर्धयामास राघवं च निरैक्षत ॥६-५०-७॥
translation: In the meantime, heroic Vibheeshana holding mace came to Sugriva and Rama and cheered with victory.
word_meanings: एतस्मिन् in the mean, अन्तरे while, गदापाणिः holding mace, वीरः hero, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, विभीषणंच to Vibheeshana, राघवंच Raghava, निरैक्षत seeing, वर्धयामास cheered with victory.

text: विभीषणं तं सुग्रीवो दृष्ट्वा वानरभीषणम् । ऋक्षराजं समीपस्थं जाम्बवन्तमुवाच ह ॥६-५०-८॥
translation: Beholding Vibheeshana, the Vanaras fled, said Sugriva to the great Jambavan who stood near him.
word_meanings: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, वानरभीषणम् Vanaras beholding Vibheeshana, दृष्टवा beholding, समीपस्थम् stood near, महात्मानम् great, ऋक्षराजम् king of Bears, Jambavan, उवाचह spoke.

text: विभीषणो ऽयं सम्प्रप्तो यं दृष्ट्वा वानरर्षभाः । विद्रवन्ति परित्रस्ता रावणात्मजशङ्कया ॥६-५०-९॥
translation: "Vibheeshana has come here. Beholding him the foremost of the Vanaras fleeing suspecting him to be the son of Ravana."
word_meanings: अयम् this, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, सम्प्राप्तः having come here, यम् , दृष्टवा beholding, वानरर्षभाः foremost Vanaras, रावणात्मशङ्काया thinking him to be Ravana's son, विद्रवन्ति suspecting, परित्रस्त fleeing.

text: शीघ्रमेतान् सुसन्त्रस्तान् बहुधा विप्रधावितान् । प्रर्यवस्थापयाख्याहि विभीषणमुपस्थितम् ॥६-५०-१०॥
translation: "Call them back who are running in different directions quickly. Tell them Vibheeshana has come here."
word_meanings: सुसन्त्रस्तान् fearing, बहुधा many directions, विप्रधावितान् fleeing, एतान् all of them, शीघ्रम् quickly, पर्यवस्था running, उपस्थितम् has come here, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, आख्याहि call them.

text: सुग्रीवेणैवमुक्तस्तु जाम्बवानृक्षपार्थिवः । वानरान् सान्त्वयामास सन्निरुध्य प्रधावतः ॥६-५०-११॥
translation: Sugriva having spoken in that way, the king of Bears, Jambavan restored the confidence of Vanaras.
word_meanings: सुग्रीवेण Sugriva, एवम् in that way, उक्तः having said, ऋक्षपार्थिवः king of Bears, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, प्रधानतः chief, वानरान् of Vanaras, निरुध्य restored, सान्त्वयामास confidence.

text: ते निवृत्ताः पुनः सर्वे वानरास्त्यक्तसम्भ्रमाः । ऋक्षराजवचः श्रुत्वा तं च दृष्ट्वा विभीषणम् ॥६-५०-१२॥
translation: Having heard Jambavan, all the Vanaras finally shed their fear and returned to see Vibheeshana.
word_meanings: सर्वे all, तेवानराः the Vanaras, ऋक्षराजवचः Jambavan's words, श्रुत्वा having heard, तम् their, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, दृष्टवा beholding, त्यक्तसम्भ्रमाः finally shed their fear, पुनः again, विवृत्ताः returned.

text: विभीषणस्तु रामस्य दृष्ट्वा गात्रं शरैश्चितम् । लक्ष्मणस्य च धर्मात्मा बभूव व्यथितेन्द्रियः ॥६-५०-१३॥
translation: On seeing the body of Rama and Lakshmana fully covered by arrows, Vibheeshana also became piteous and sad.
word_meanings: धर्मात्मा righteous, विभीषणस्तु Vibheeshana also, शरैः arrows, चितम् mind, रामस्य Rama's, गात्रम् limbs, लक्ष्मणस्यच and Lakshmana's, दृष्टवा observing, तदा then, व्यथितः grievous, बभूव remained.

text: जलक्लिन्नेन हस्तेन तयोर्नेत्रे प्रमृज्य च । शोकसम्पीडितमना रुरोद विललाप च ॥६-५०-१४॥
translation: Vibheeshana, wetting his hands with water cleaned the eyes of Rama and Lakshmana. Tormented with pain he cried aloud.
word_meanings: जलक्लिन्नेन with water, हस्तेन in hand, तयोः their, नेत्रे eyes, प्रमृज्यच cleaned, शोकसम्पीडितमनाः tormented with pain, रुरोद aloud, विललापच cried.

text: इमौ तौ सत्त्वसम्पन्नौ विक्रान्तौ प्रियसंयुगौ । इमामवस्थां गमितौ राक्षसैः कूटयोधिभिः ॥६-५०-१५॥
translation: "Both the princess, who are endowed with good nature, and power are fond of combat. The Rakshasas have reduced them to this state by their deceitful ways."
word_meanings: सत्त्वसम्पन्नौ endowed with good nature, विक्रान्तौ powerful, प्रियसम्युगौ fond of combat, तौ both, इमौ thus, कूटयोधिभिः deceitful, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, इमाम् like this, अवस्थाम् predicament, गमितौ reduced to.

text: भ्रातुः पुत्रेण मे तेन दुष्पुत्रेण दुरात्मना । राक्षस्या जिह्मया बुद्ध्या चालितावृजुविक्रमौ ॥६-५०-१६॥
translation: "The princess who were guileless in their prowess were cheated by my evil minded and stupid son of my brother by his crooked thinking and cheating."
word_meanings: ऋजुविक्रमौ guileless in prowess, दुष्पुत्रेण stupid son, दुरात्मना evil minded, एतेन by him, भ्रातृपुत्रेण brother's son, राक्षस्या Rakshasa's, जिह्मया crooked, बुध्या mind, चालिता cheated.

text: शरैरिमावलं विद्धौ रुधिरेण समुक्षितौ । वसुधायामिमौ सुप्तौ दृश्येते शल्यकाविव ॥६-५०-१७॥
translation: "Pierced with arrows, fully covered with blood, the bodies of the two princes appear like porcupines sleeping on the ground."
word_meanings: शरैः arrows, अलम् body, विद्धौ fully, रुधिरेण with blood, समुक्षितौ pierced with, वसुधायाम् on the ground, सुप्तौ sleeping, इमौ these two (Rama and Lakshmana), शल्यकाविव like a porcupine, दृश्येते appears.

text: ययोर्वीर्यमुपाश्रित्य प्रतिष्ठा काङ्क्षिता मया । तावुभौ देहनाशाय प्रसुप्तौ पुरुषर्षभौ ॥६-५०-१८॥
translation: "These two bulls among men of great valour and fame whose refuge was sought by me are lying asleep wounded all over and limbs broken."
word_meanings: मया by me, ययोः whose, वीर्यम् valour, आश्रित्य sought refuge, प्रतिष्ठा of great fame, काङ्क्षिता limbs broken, ता these, उभौ both, पुरुषर्षभौ bull among men, देहनाशाय wounded all over the body, प्रसुप्तौ lying asleep.

text: जीवन्नद्य विपन्नो ऽस्मि नष्टराज्यमनोरथः । प्राप्तप्रतिज्ञश्च रिपुः सकामो रावणः कृतः ॥६-५०-१९॥
translation: "Having lost my life ambition for the kingdom, frustrated I am. My enemy Ravana, having succeeded in his vow, did this deed."
word_meanings: नष्टराज्यमनोरथः having lost kingdom, जीवन्नद्यअद्य life ambition, विपन्नः frustrated, अस्मि I am, रिपुः enemy, रावणः Ravana, प्राप्तप्रतिज्ञः having succeeded in his vow, सकामश्च this deed, कृतः did.

text: एवं विलपमानं तं परिष्वज्य विभीषणम् । सुग्रीवः सत्त्वसम्पन्नो हरिराजो ऽब्रवीदिदम् ॥६-५०-२०॥
translation: To Vibheeshana who was lamenting in that way, Sugriva, who was endowed with good qualities embraced him and spoke.
word_meanings: एवम् in that way, विलपमानम् lamenting in despair, तंविभीषणम् that Vibheeshana, परिष्वज्य embracing, सत्त्वसम्पन्नः endowed with good qualities, हरिराजः king of monkeys, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: राज्यं प्राप्स्यसि धर्मज्ञ लङ्कायां नात्र संशयः । रावणः सह पुत्रेण सकामं नेह लप्स्यते ॥६-५०-२१॥
translation: "O righteous one! there is no doubt that you will attain the kingdom of Lanka. Ravana and his sons will not attain what they desire."
word_meanings: धर्मज्ञ righteous, लङ्कायाम् in Lanka, राज्यम् kingdom, प्राप्स्यसि having got, अत्र and now, संशयः doubt, न no, रावणः Ravana, सहपुत्रेण with his sons, स्वकामम् of their desire, इह now, नलप्स्यते not attain.

text: न रुजा पीडितावेतावुभौ राघवलक्ष्मणौ । त्यक्त्वा मोहं वधिष्येते सगणं रावणं रणे ॥६-५०-२२॥
translation: "Both these heroes Raghava and Lakshmana wounded and pained having shaken off from their unconscious state will kill Ravana and his army in war."
word_meanings: एतौ these, उभौ both, राघवलक्ष्मणौ Raghava and Lakshmana, रुजा wounded, पीडितौ pained, न not, मोहम् unconscious state त्यक्त्वा shaken off, रणे in war, सगणम् his own army, रावणम् Ravana, वधिष्येते killed.

text: तमेनं सान्त्वयित्वा तु समाश्वास्य च राक्षसम् । सुषेणं श्वशुरं पार्श्वे सुग्रीवस्तमुवाच ह ॥६-५०-२३॥
translation: Thus, consoling and pacifying, the Rakshasa, Vibheeshana in that manner, Sugriva turned to his uncle Sushena and spoke.
word_meanings: सुग्रीवः Sugriva, तंराक्षसम् that Rakshasa, एवम् in that manner, सान्त्वयित्वा consoling, समाश्वास्य pacifying, पार्श्वे at, श्वशुरम् uncle, तंसुषेणम् Sushena, उवाच spoke.

text: सह शूरैर्हरिगणैर्लब्धसञ्ज्ञावरिन्दमौ । गच्छ त्वं भ्रातरौ गृह्य किष्किन्धां रामलक्ष्मणौ ॥६-५०-२४॥
translation: "On regaining consciousness, take the brothers Rama and Lakshmana, the tamers of enemies to Kishkinda accompanied by the heroic monkey army."
word_meanings: शूरैः heroes हरिगणैः monkey army, त्वम् them, लब्दसंज्ञौ on regaining consciousness, अरिन्दमौ tamers of their enemies, भ्रातरौ brothers, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, गृह्य taking, किष्किन्धाम् to Kishkinda, गच्छ proceed.

text: अहं तु रावणं हत्वा सपुत्रं सहबान्धवम् । मैथिलीमानयिष्यामि शक्रो नष्टामिव श्रियम् । श्रुत्वैतद्वानरेन्द्रस्य सुषेणो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥६-५०-२५॥
translation: "On killing Ravana and his sons along with his kin, I will on my part also bring Mythili just as Indra recovered his prosperity."
word_meanings: अहंतु I also, सपुत्रम् his sons, सहबान्दवम् with the kin, रावणम् Ravana, हत्वा having killed, शक्रः Indra, नष्टाम् loss, श्रियमिव prosperity, मैथिलीम् Mythili also, आनयिष्यामि will bring.

text: दैवासुरं महद्युद्धमनुभूतं सुदारुणम् । तदा स्म दानवा देवान् शरसंस्पर्शकोविदाः ॥६-५०-२६॥
निजघ्नुः शस्त्रविदुषश्छादयन्तो मुहुर्मुहुः ॥६-५०-२७॥
translation: "Then the Rakshasas adept in using arms went about agitating concealing themselves, attacking Devatas who were learned in using arms."
word_meanings: तदा then, शरसम्स्पर्शकोविदाः adept in using arms, दानवाः Rakshasa, शस्त्रविदुषः learned in using arms, देवान् Devatas, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, छादयन्तः concealing by tricks, निजघ्नुः went about agitated.

text: तानार्तान्नष्टसञ्ज्ञांश्च परासूंश्च बृहस्पतिः । विद्याभिर्मन्त्रयुक्ताभिरोषधीभिश्चिकित्सति ॥६-५०-२८॥
translation: "Brhaspati, the priest restored the wounded and lifeless, unconscious by means of reciting mantras, prayers and treatment by herbs."
word_meanings: बृहस्पतिः Brhaspati the sage, आर्तान् restored the affected, नष्टसंज्ञान् wounded and life less, गतासूंश्च lost consciousness, तान् them, मन्त्रयुक्ताभिः by means of mantras, विद्याभिः recitation of prayers, रोषधीभिः herbs, चिकित्सति treatment.

text: तान्यौषधान्यानयितुं क्षीरोदं यान्तु सागरम् । जवेन वानराः शीघ्रं सम्पातिपनसादयः । हरयस्तु विजानन्ति पार्वतीस्ता महौषधीः ॥६-५०-२९॥
translation: "Let Sampati and Panasa go quickly to the milky ocean in a swift phase to get those medicines."
word_meanings: औषधानि herbal medicines, आनयितुम् secured, सम्पातिपनसादयः Sampati and Panasa, वानराः Vanara, जवेन swift phase, शीघ्रम् quickly, क्षीरोदम् milky ocean, सागरम् ocean, यान्तु to get.

text: सञ्जीवकरणीं दिव्यां विशल्यां देवनिर्मिताम् .५०.२ ॥ सम्पातिपनसादयः । चन्द्रश्च नाम द्रोणश्च क्षीरोदे सागरोत्तमे । अमृतं यत्र मथितं तत्र ते परमौषधी ॥६-५०-३०॥
अयं वायुसुतो राजन् हनुमांस्तत्र गच्छतु ॥६-५०-३१॥
translation: "Both the mountains are well known. Deities have kept the herbal medicine there. Let the son of wind god, Hanuman proceed."
word_meanings: तौ both, तौपर्वतौ mountains, तत्र there, महोदधौ well known, देवैः Deities, विहितौ kept, राजन् o King, वायुसुतः son of wind God, अयम् let go, हनुमान् Hanuman, तत्र there, गच्छतु proceed.

text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वायुर्मेघांश्चापि सविद्युतः । पर्यस्यन् सागरे तोयं कम्पयन्निव मेदिनीम् ॥६-५०-३२॥
translation: In the mean while winds blew, clouds also rose up, water in the ocean was scattered about by the wind and lightning appeared in the sky.
word_meanings: एतस्मिन् in the meanwhile, अन्तरे middle, सविद्युतः wind also, मेघांश्चापि clouds also, सागरे ocean, तोयम् water, पर्यस्यन् scattered about, वायुः by the wind, मेदिनीम् in the sky, कम्पयननिव started shaking.

text: महता पक्षवातेन सर्वद्वीपमहाद्रुमाः । निपेतुर्भिन्नविटपाः समूला लवणाम्भसि ॥६-५०-३३॥
translation: All the huge trees of the island were broken by the flutter of the wings (of Garuda) and fell into the salt water of the ocean.
word_meanings: सर्ववदीपमहाद्रुमाः all the trees of the island, महता huge, पक्षवातेन by the flutter of the wings wind, भग्नविटपाः broken, लवणाम्भसि salt water of the ocean, सलिले water, निपेतुः entered.

text: अभवन् पन्नगास्त्रस्ता भोगिनस्तत्रवासिनः । शीघ्रं सर्वाणि यादांसि जग्मुश्च लवणार्णवम् ॥६-५०-३४॥
translation: All the serpents and sea monsters inhabiting there terrified at Garuda went quickly into the salty waters of the ocean.
word_meanings: पन्नगाः serpents, त्रस्ताः frightened, अभवन् in fear, तत्र there, वासिनः inhabiting, भोगिनः sea monsters, सर्वाणि all of them, यादांसि crawled, शीघ्रम् quickly, लवणार्णवम् into the salty ocean, जग्मुः went.

text: ततो मुहूर्ताद्गरुडं वैनतेयं महाबलम् ॥६-५०-३५॥
वानरा ददृशुः सर्वेज्वलन्तमिव पावकम् ॥६-५०-३६॥
translation: Then all the Vanaras perceived Garuda endowed with mighty prowess, the son of Vinatha blazing like fire.
word_meanings: ततः then, सर्वे all, वानराः Vanaras, मुहूर्तात् instantly, ज्वलन्तम् blazing like, पावकम् इव like fire, वैनतेयम् son of Vinatha, महाबलम् of mighty prowess, गरुडम् Garuda, ददृशुः perceived.

text: तमागतमभिप्रेक्ष्य नागास्ते विप्रदुद्रुवुः । यैस्तौ सत्पुरुषौ बद्धौ शरभूतैर्महाबलौ ॥६-५०-३७॥
translation: Seeing the noble Rama and Lakshmana bound by the serpents in the form of arrows (released by Indrajith), the serpents fled.
word_meanings: शरभूतैः in the form of arrows, महाबलौ mighty, यैः those, तौ both, सत्परुषौ noble, बद्धौ bound, ते those, नागाः serpents, आगतम् seeing, तम् they, प्रेक्ष्य seeing, सम्प्रदुद्रुवुः fled.

text: ततः सुपर्णः काकुत्स्थौ दृष्ट्वा प्रत्यभिनन्दितः । विममर्श च पाणिभ्यां मुखे चन्द्रसमप्रभे ॥६-५०-३८॥
translation: Thereafter Garuda paying his respects to the noble Rama and Lakshmana, touching their feet, wiped their face which shone like the moon.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, सुपर्णः Garuda, काकुत्स्थौ at Kakuthsas, Rama and Lakshmana, स्पृष्टवा touching, प्रत्यभिनन्द्यच paying respect, पाणिभ्याम् both feet, चन्द्रसमप्रख्ये like moon, मुखे face, विममर्शच wiped.

text: वैनतेयेन संस्पृष्टास्तयोः संरुरुहुर्व्रणाः । सुवर्णे च तनू स्निग्धे तयोराशु बभूवतुः ॥६-५०-३९॥
translation: Caressed by Garuda, both their bodies were cleared of wounds instantly shone like gold and turned bright.
word_meanings: वैनतेयेन by Garuda, सम्सृष्टाः caressed, तयोः both of their, व्रणाः wounds, सम्रुरुहुः cleared, आशु instantly, तयोः both, तनू bodies, सुवर्णेच like gold, स्निग्धे bright, बभूवतुः turned.

text: तेजो वीर्यं बलं चौज उत्साहश्च महागुणः । प्रदर्शनं च बुद्धिश्च स्मृतिश्च द्विगुणं तयोः ॥६-५०-४०॥
translation: Their brilliance, prowess, daring courage, intelligence, memory, and great qualities got manifested many folds.
word_meanings: तयोः their, तेजः brilliance, वीर्यम् prowess, उत्साहश्च daring courage, महागुणाः great qualities, प्रदर्शनम् manifested, बुद्धिश्च intelligence, स्मृतिश्च memory, द्विगुणम् redoubled.

text: तावुत्थाप्य महावीर्यौ गरुडो वासवोपमौ । उभौ तौ सस्वजे हृष्टौ रामश्चैनमुवाच ह ॥६-५०-४१॥
translation: Raising up both the princes who were extraordinarily brilliant and equalled Indra, Garuda embraced Rama joyfully and thus spoke.
word_meanings: महातेजाः extraordinary brilliance, गरुडः Garuda, वासनोपमौ equal to Indra, तौ them, उत्थाप्य raising up, उभौ both, सस्वजे embraced, रामश्च Rama, हृष्टः joyful, एवम् in that way, उवाचह spoke.

text: भवत्प्रसादाद्व्यसनं रावणिप्रभवं महत् । आवामिह व्यतिक्रान्तौ पूर्ववद्बलिनौ कृतौ ॥६-५०-४२॥
translation: "By your kindness, we have overcome this calamity caused by Ravana's son and regained our strength as before."
word_meanings: भवत्प्रसादाद् by your kindness, आवाम् we, रावणिप्रभवम् Ravana's son's influence, महत् great, व्यसनम् calamity, इह here, व्यतिक्रान्तौ overcome, पूर्ववत् regained like before, बलिनौ strength, कृतौ did.

text: यथा तातं दशरथं यथा ऽजं च पितामहम् । तथा भवन्तमासाद्य हृदयं मे प्रसीदति ॥६-५०-४३॥
translation: "For me to meet you is like meeting my father Dasaratha and grandfather, Aja. My heart rejoices."
word_meanings: भवन्तम् for me, आसाद्य to meet you, तातम् father, दशरथम् Dasaratha, यथा same way, पितामहम् grandfather, अजंच Aja also, यथा in the same way, तथा like that, मे my, हृदयम् in my heart, प्रसीदति rejoices.

text: को भवान् रूपसम्पन्नो दिव्यस्रगनुलेपनः । वसानो विरजे वस्त्रे दिव्याभरणभूषितः ॥६-५०-४४॥
translation: "Who are you, richly endowed with charming appearance, smeared with unguents adored in dust free garments, wearing beautiful ornaments?"
word_meanings: रूपसम्पन्नः of charming appearance, दिव्यस्रगनुलेपः smeared with wonderful unguents, विरजे free from dust, वस्त्र adored in,, वसानः garments, दिव्याभरणभूषितः wearing beautiful ornaments, भवान् yourself, कः who are you.

text: तमुवाच महातेजा वैनतेयो महाबलः । पतत्रिराजः प्रीतात्मा हर्षपर्याकुलेक्षणः ॥६-५०-४५॥
translation: To Rama whose eyes were filled with joyful tears, Vinatha, the king of birds, full of brightness and strength said.
word_meanings: महातेजाः endowed with brightness, महाबलः strong, पतत्त्रिराजः king of birds, वैनतेयः Vinatha, प्रीतात्मा delighted self, हर्षपर्याकुलेक्षणः eyes with tears of joy, तम् to him, उवाच said.

text: अहं सखा ते काकुत्स्थ प्रियः प्राणो बहिश्चरः । गरुत्मानिह सम्प्राप्तो युवाभ्यां साह्यकारणात् ॥६-५०-४६॥
translation: "O Kakuthsa! I am Garuthman, your dear friend and your outer breath. I reached here to help you."
word_meanings: काकुत्स्थ Kakuthsa, अहम् I am, ते to you, प्रियः dear, सखा friend, बहिश्चरः outer, प्राणः breath, गरुत्मान् Garuthman, युवयोः you both, साह्यकारणात् in order to help, इह here, सम्प्राप्त reached.

text: असुरा वा महावीर्या दानवा वा महाबलाः । सुराश्चापि सगन्धर्वाः पुरस्कृत्य शतक्रतुम् ॥६-५०-४७॥
translation: "For the demons endowed with great strength and of mighty valour or for Gandharvas, or Vanaras or for even Devatas, or Indra who has done a hundred sacrifices, it is not possible to get relieved from bondage of the arrows of Indrajith of cruel deeds carried out by tricks."
word_meanings: क्रूरकर्मणा of cruel deeds, इन्द्रजिता of Indrajith, मायाबलात् by his tricks, निर्मितम् for that reason, सुदारुणम् very fierce, इमम् such, शरबन्धम् bondage with arrows, मोक्षयितुम् to get freed from, महावीर्याः of mighty valour, असुराःवा demon, महाबलाः great strength, वानराःवा Vanara also, शतक्रतुम् hundred sacrifices, पुरस्कृत्य had done, सगन्धर्वाः even Gandharvas, सुरश्चापि even Devatas, नशक्ताः not possible.

text: नेमं मोक्षयितुं शक्ताः शरबन्धं सुदारुणम् । मायाबलादिन्द्रजिता निर्मितं क्रूरकर्मणा ॥६-५०-४८॥
translation: "For the demons endowed with great strength and of mighty valour or for Gandharvas, or Vanaras or for even Devatas, or Indra who has done a hundred sacrifices, it is not possible to get relieved from bondage of the arrows of Indrajith of cruel deeds carried out by tricks."
word_meanings: क्रूरकर्मणा of cruel deeds, इन्द्रजिता of Indrajith, मायाबलात् by his tricks, निर्मितम् for that reason, सुदारुणम् very fierce, इमम् such, शरबन्धम् bondage with arrows, मोक्षयितुम् to get freed from, महावीर्याः of mighty valour, असुराःवा demon, महाबलाः great strength, वानराःवा Vanara also, शतक्रतुम् hundred sacrifices, पुरस्कृत्य had done, सगन्धर्वाः even Gandharvas, सुरश्चापि even Devatas, नशक्ताः not possible.

text: एते नागाः काद्रवेया स्तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रा विषोल्बणाः । रक्षोमायाप्रभावेन शरा भूत्वा त्वदाश्रिताः ॥६-५०-४९॥
translation: "These arrows are serpents born of Kadra Devata. They have sharp fangs and are highly poisonous. By the tricks of Rakshasa, it has turned into arrows and reached you."
word_meanings: तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्राः with sharp fangs विषोल्बणाः highly poisonous, काद्रवेयाः born to Kadra Devata, एतेनागाः these serpents, रक्षोमायाप्रभावेण by the tricks applied by Rakshasas, शराः arrows, भूत्वा turned into, त्वदाश्रिताः reached you.

text: सभाग्यश्चासि धर्मज्ञ राम सत्यपराक्रम । लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा समरे रिपुघातिना ॥६-५०-५०॥
translation: "You are lucky and also Lakshmana your brother, destroyer of foes in war. Rama your strength is truth, and you are righteous."
word_meanings: धर्मज्ञ righteous, सत्यपराक्रम whose strength is truth, राम Rama, समरे in war, शत्रुघातिना destroyer of foes, भ्रात्रा brother, लक्ष्मणेनसह accompanied by Lakshmana, सभाग्यः lucky, असि you are.

text: इमं श्रुत्वा तु वृत्तान्तं त्वरमाणो ऽहमागतः । सहसा युवयोः स्नेहात् सखित्वमनुपालयन् ॥६-५०-५१॥
translation: "Having heard the information about both of you bound by serpents, out of my friendship and affection and in obedience to you I hastened and reached here."
word_meanings: अहम् I am, इमम् this, वृत्तान्तम् information, श्रुत्वा having heard, युवयोः both of you, स्नेहात् out of friendship, सखित्वम् affection, अनुपालयन् in obedience to you, सहसा at once, त्वरमाणः hastened, आगतः to reach.

text: मोक्षितौ च महाघोरादस्मात् सायकबन्धनात् । अप्रमादश्च कर्तव्यो युवाभ्यां नित्यमेव हि ॥६-५०-५२॥
translation: "Considering it as my duty to relieve you both from the frightful bondage of snakes I reached. Do not be inattentive and guileless."
word_meanings: महाघोरात् frightful, अस्मात् to you, सायकबन्धनात् from the bondage of snakes, मोक्षितौच and to relieve, युवाभ्याम् both of you, नित्यमेवच guilelessness, अप्रमादः inattentive, कर्तव्यः your duty.

text: प्रकृत्या राक्षसाः सर्वे सङ्ग्रामे कूटयोधिनः । शूराणां शुद्धभावानां भवतामार्जवं बलम् ॥६-५०-५३॥
translation: "Rakshasas by nature use tricks in war. For noble people with good nature guilelessness is strength."
word_meanings: प्रकृत्या by nature, सर्वे all, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, सङ्ग्रामे in war, कूटयोधिनः use tricks in war, शूराणाम् noble people, शुद्धभावानाम् of good nature, भवताम् for you, आर्जवम् guilelessness, बलम् strength.

text: तन्न विश्वसितव्यं वो राक्षसानां रणाजिरे । एतेनैवोपमानेन नित्यं जिह्मा हि राक्षसाः ॥६-५०-५४॥
translation: "Being so you should not trust Rakshasas. By this experience you know that Rakshasas are crooked."
word_meanings: तत् being so, रणाजिरे in war, वः them, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, नविश्वसनीयम् not to be trusted, एतेन because, उपमानेनैव by this experience, राक्षसाः of Rakshasa, नित्यम् ever, जिह्माःहि crooked.

text: एवमुक्त्वा ततो रामं सुपर्णः सुमहाबलः । परिष्वज्य सुहृत् स्निग्धमाप्रष्टुमुपचक्रमे ॥६-५०-५५॥
translation: Having said so, Suparna endowed with mighty strength embraced Rama most affectionately and took leave of him.
word_meanings: महाबलः mighty strong, सःसुपर्णः that Suparna, तदा then, रामम् to Rama, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, सुहृत्स्निग्धम् most affectionately, परिष्वज्यच embracing, अप्रष्टुम् took leave, उपचक्रमे and proceeded.

text: सखे राघव धर्मज्ञ रिपूणामपि वत्सल । अभ्यनुज्ञातुमिच्छामि गमिष्यामि यथागतम् ॥६-५०-५६॥
translation: "My dear friend! I wish to take leave of you. Truly you are knower of what is right, and you are dear even to an enemy."
word_meanings: धर्मज्ञ right, रिपूणामपि even to an enemy, वत्सल dear, सखे friend, राम Rama, अभ्यनुज्ञातुम् take leave of you, इच्छामि wish, यथामतम् truly, गमिष्यामि let me go.

text: न च कौतूहलं कार्यं सखित्वं प्रति राघव । कृतकर्मा रणे वीरः सखित्वमनुवेत्स्यसि ॥६-५०-५७॥
translation: "Heroic Rama! No question about your curiosity about our friendship now. After winning the war you will recognize."
word_meanings: वीर heroic, राघव Raghava, सखित्वम् friendship, कौतूहलम् curiosity, नकार्यम् that question, रणे in war, कृतकर्मा having won, सखित्वम् friendship, प्रतिवेत्स्यसि recognize.

text: बालवृद्धावशेषां तु लङ्कां कृत्वा शरोर्मिभिः । रावणं च रिपुं हत्वा सीतां समुपलप्स्यसे ॥६-५०-५८॥
translation: "Lanka will be left with youngsters and the aged with your arrows. The enemy Ravana killed, you will recover Sita."
word_meanings: लङ्काम् at Lanka, शरोर्मिभिः with arrows, बालवृद्धानशेषाम् left with youngsters and aged, कृत्वा having done so, रिपुम् enemy, रावणम् Ravana, हत्वा killed, त्वम् you, सीताम् Sita, समुलप्स्यते recover again.

text: इत्येवमुक्त्वा वचनं सुपर्णः शीघ्रविक्रमः । रामं च विरुजं कृत्वा मध्ये तेषां वनौकसाम् ॥६-५०-५९॥
translation: Having spoken to Rama in that manner, Suparna endowed with wind speed in flight embraced Rama and went around him as a mark of reverence and soared into the sky.
word_meanings: सुपर्णः Suparna, शीघ्रविक्रमः swift in flying, वीर्यवान् valiant, सुपर्णः Suparna, तेषाम् from there, वनौकसाम् to the forest, मध्ये middle, इत्येवम् in that way, वचनम् words, उक्त्वा having spoken, रामम् to Rama, विरुजम् embracing him, कृत्वा done, ततः thereafter, प्रदक्षिणंकृत्वा going round in reverence, परिष्वज्यच soared, पवनोयथा like wind, आकाशम् into the sky, आविश्य flew, जगाम and went.

text: प्रदक्षिणं ततः कृत्वा परिष्वज्य च वीर्यवान् । जगामाकाशमाविश्य सुपर्णः पवनो यथा ॥६-५०-६०॥
translation: Having spoken to Rama in that manner, Suparna endowed with wind speed in flight embraced Rama and went around him as a mark of reverence and soared into the sky.
word_meanings: सुपर्णः Suparna, शीघ्रविक्रमः swift in flying, वीर्यवान् valiant, सुपर्णः Suparna, तेषाम् from there, वनौकसाम् to the forest, मध्ये middle, इत्येवम् in that way, वचनम् words, उक्त्वा having spoken, रामम् to Rama, विरुजम् embracing him, कृत्वा done, ततः thereafter, प्रदक्षिणंकृत्वा going round in reverence, परिष्वज्यच soared, पवनोयथा like wind, आकाशम् into the sky, आविश्य flew, जगाम and went.

text: विरुजौ राघवौ दृष्ट्वा ततो वानरयूथपाः । सिंहनादांस्तदा नेदुर्लाङ्गूलान् दुधुवुस्तदा ॥६-५०-६१॥
translation: Thereafter the Vanara troops, seeing the Raghavas freed from anguish, roared like a lion, and lashed their tails.
word_meanings: ततः then, वानरयूथपाः Vanara troops, राघवौ Raghavas, विरुजौ freed from anguish, दृष्टवा seeing, तदा then, सिंहनादान् roared like lions, नेदुः sound, तदा then, लाङ्गूलान् tails, दुधुवुश्च lashed.

text: ततो भेरीः समाजघ्नुर्मृदङ्गांश्चाप्यनादयन् । दध्मुः शङ्खान् सम्प्रहृष्टाः क्ष्वेलन्त्यपि यथापुरम् ॥६-५०-६२॥
translation: Then the Vanaras played drums and even mridangams, blew conches and started jumping and leaping as before.
word_meanings: ततः and then, भेरीः drums, समाजघ्नुः played, मृदङ्गांश्चापि even mridangams, अवादयन् played, शङ्खान् conches, दध्मुः blew, यथापुरम् as before, क्षेवलन्त्यपि leap and jump.

text: आस्फोट्यास्फोट्य विक्रान्ता वानरा नगयोधिनः । द्रुमानुत्पाट्य विविधांस्तस्थुः शतसहस्रशः ॥६-५०-६३॥
translation: The Vanaras who can fight with trees, uprooted several trees expressing their capacity distinctly and breaking them, and cracking their fingers. Making loud noise in hundreds and thousands stood there.
word_meanings: नगयोधिनः who fight uprooting trees, विक्रान्ताः proud of their ability, आस्फोट्याः breaking forth, वानराः Vanaras, स्पोट्य cracking fingers and making loud noise, शतसहस्रशः hundreds and thousands, विविधान् several, द्रुमान् trees, उत्पाट्य uprooted, तस्थुः stood.

text: विसृजन्तो महानादांस्त्रासयन्तो निशाचरान् । लङ्काद्वारण्युपाजग्मुर्योद्धुकामाः प्लवङ्गमाः ॥६-५०-६४॥
translation: Making a lot of noise, the Vanaras reached the gates of Lanka frightening night rangers and desiring to wage war.
word_meanings: प्लवङ्गमाः Vanaras, महानादान् great noise, विसृजन्तः emitting, निशाचरान् night rangers, त्रासयन्तः frightening, युद्धकामाः desiring to wage war, लङ्काद्वाराणि gates of Lanka, उपाजग्मुः reached.

text: ततस्तु भीमस्तुमुलो निनादो बभूव शाखामृगयूथपानाम् । क्षये निदाघस्य यथा घनानां नादः सुभीमो नदतां निशीथे ॥६-५०-६५॥
translation: Thundering sounds resembling heavy clouds making terrific sounds arose, as if universal destruction was taking place at midnight. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेपञ्चाशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the fiftieth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: निदाघस्य thundering, क्षये universal destruction, निशीधे midnight, नदताम् sound, घनानाम् heavy clouds, सुभीमः terrific, नादःयथा like sound, तेषाम् from there, शाखामृगयूथपानाम् troops of Vanaras who fight with trees, सुभीमः frightening, तुमुलः loud, नादः sound, बभूव arose.

text: तेषां सुतुमुलं शब्दं वानराणां तरस्विनाम् । नदतां राक्षसैः सार्धं तदा शुश्राव रावणः ॥६-५१-१॥
translation: Then Ravana and all the Rakshasas heard the increasing and highly tumultuous sound made by the courageous Vanaras.
word_meanings: तदा then, तरस्विनाम् courageous, नर्दताम् increasing, तेषांवानराणाम् by those Vanaras, सुतुमुलम् tumultuous noise, शब्दम् sound, रावणः Ravana, राक्षसैःसार्धम् all Rakshasas, शुश्राव heard.

text: स्निग्धगम्भीरनिर्घोषं श्रुत्वा स निनदं भृशम् । सचिवानां ततस्तेषां मध्ये वचनमब्रवीत् ॥६-५१-२॥
translation: Thereafter, hearing the loud and deep sounds of roaring and seeing his (Ravana's) ministers in the midst, he spoke as follows.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, सः he, स्निग्धगम्भीरनिर्घोषम् deep and loud sound, निनदम् roaring, भृशम् swiftly, श्रुत्वा having heard, तेषाम् to them, सचिवानाम् ministers, मध्ये midst, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: यथा ऽसौ सम्प्रहृष्टानां वानराणां समुत्थितः । बहूनां सुमहानादो मेघानामिव गर्जताम् । व्यक्तं सुमहती प्रीतिरेतेषां नात्र संशयः ॥६-५१-३॥
translation: "Many Vanaras have collected together and roared making loud noises just as thunder rumbling clouds. By that there is no doubt that they are very happy. For that reason, even the wide ocean is agitated."
word_meanings: सम्प्रहृष्टानाम् very happy, बहूनाम् many of them, वानराणाम् Vanaras, समुत्थित collected:, सुमहान् very great, असौ such, नादः sound, गर्जताम् roaring, मेघानामिव like thunder of rumbling clouds, यथा just as, श्रूयते, सुव्यक्तम् , एतेषाम् by that, प्रीतिः happiness, सुमहती huge, अत्र there, संशयः doubt, न no, तथाहि for that reason, विपुलैः wide, नादैः noise, वरुणालयः ocean, चुक्षुभे agitated.

text: तथा हि विपुलैर्नादश्चुक्षुभे वरुणालयः ूनां सुमहानादो मेघानामिव गर्जताम् । तौ तु बद्धौ शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ । अयं च सुमहान्नादः शङ्कां जनयतीव मे ॥६-५१-४॥
एतत्तु वचनं चोक्त्वा मन्त्रिणो राक्षसेश्वरः । उवाच नैर्ऋतांस्तत्र समीपपरिवर्तिनः ॥६-५१-५॥
translation: Having spoken like that to the ministers, the Lord of Rakshasas said to the Rakshasas who stood waiting close by.
word_meanings: राक्षसेश्वरः Lord of Rakshasas, मन्त्रिणः to ministers, एतत्तु such, वचनम् words, तु you, उक्त्वा having spoken, तत्र there, समीपपरिवर्तिनः waiting near, नैरृतान् to Rakshasas, उवाच said.

text: ज्ञायतां तूर्णमेतेषां सर्वेषां वनचारिणाम् । शोककाले समुत्पन्ने हर्षकारणमुत्थितम् ॥६-५१-६॥
translation: "For what reason are the Vanaras (rangers of woods) rejoicing that way in the time of grief? It may be found out speedily."
word_meanings: एतेषाम् for what reason, सर्वेषाम् all of them, वनचारिणाम् rangers of woods, शोककाले in the time for grief, समुत्पन्न arisen, तूर्णम् speedily, हर्षकारणमुत्थितम् reason for rejoicing, ज्ञायताम् be found out.

text: तथोक्तास्तेन सम्भ्रान्ताः प्राकारमधिरुह्य ते । ददृशुः पालितां सेनां सुग्रीवेण महात्मना ॥६-५१-७॥
तो च मुक्तौ सुघोरेण शरबन्धेन राघवौ । समुत्थितौ महावेगौ विषेदुः प्रेक्ष्य राक्षसाः ॥६-५१-८॥
translation: Ravana having said so, the bewildered Rakshasas scaling the boundary wall beheld the army protected by great Sugriva and the prosperous Raghavas relieved from arrows and happy, he became worried.
word_meanings: तथा as, उक्ताः having said, ते his, नसम्भ्रान्ताः bewildered, प्राकारम् the boundary wall, अधिरुह्य scaling, महात्मना great, सुग्रीवेण to Sugriva, पालिताम् protected by, सेनाम् army, सुघोरेण at a distance, शरबन्धेन bound by arrows, मुक्तौ relieved, समुत्थितौ happy, महाभागौ prosperous, तौराघवौ them, the Raghavas, ददृशुः beheld, प्रेक्षराक्षसाः Rakshasas saw, विषेदुः worried.

text: सन्त्रस्तहृदयाः सर्वे प्राकारादवरुह्य ते । विषण्णवदना घोरा राक्षसेन्द्रमुपस्थिताः ॥६-५१-९॥
translation: All the dreadful Rakshasas getting down the boundary wall with pale faces, sad countenance reached the Lord of Rakshasas.
word_meanings: घोराः dreadful, सर्वे all, तेवदनाः their countenance, सन्त्रस्तहृदयाः frightened at heart, विषण्णाः pale faces, प्राकारात् boundary, अवरुह्य getting down, राक्षसेन्द्रम् to the Lord of Rakshasas, उपस्थिताः reached.

text: तदप्रियं दीनमुखा रावणस्य निशाचराः । कृत्स्नं निवेदयामासुर्यथावद्वाक्यकोविदाः ॥६-५१-१०॥
translation: Rakshasas who were well versed in talking, desperately conveyed the unpleasantness as it is to Ravana.
word_meanings: वाक्यकोविदाः capable of talking, निशाचराः Rakshasas, दीनमुखाः desperate, अप्रियम् unpleasant, तत् those, कृत्स्नम् dark, यथावत् as it is, रावणस्य to Ravana, न्यवेदयन् presented.

text: यौ ताविन्द्रजिता युद्धे भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ । निबद्धौ शरबन्धेन निष्प्रकम्पभुजौ कृतौ ॥६-५१-११॥
विमुक्तौ शरबन्धेन तौ दृश्येते रणाजिरे । पाशानिव गजौ छित्त्वा गजेन्द्रसमविक्रमौ ॥६-५१-१२॥
translation: "The two brothers, Rama and Lakshmana, who are like powerful elephants have been set free from the bondage of arrows of Indrajith in the battlefield. Their shoulders are relieved and are like elephants snapped off the rope binding them."
word_meanings: युद्धे in the battlefield, इन्द्रजिता by Indrajith, भ्रातरौ brothers, यौ those, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, शरबन्धेन from the bondage of arrows, निबद्धौ have been set free, निष्प्रकम्पभुजौ shoulders relieved, कृतौ done, गजेन्द्रसमविक्रमौ powerful elephants, तौ they, पाशान् rope, छित्वा snapped, गजौइव like elephants, रणाजिरे like elephant heroes, दृश्येते are seen.

text: तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तेषां राक्षसेन्द्रो महाबलः । चिन्ताशोकसमाक्रान्तो विषण्णवदनो ऽब्रवीत् ॥६-५१-१३॥
translation: The Rakshasa king endowed with mighty prowess became pale in face, worried and enraged on hearing the words of Rakshasas.
word_meanings: महाबलः of mighty prowess, राक्षसेन्द्रः Rakshasa king, तेषाम् by that, तत् वचनम् those words, श्रुत्वा hearing, चिन्तारोषसमाक्रान्तः very worried and enraged, विषण्णवदनः pale face, अभवत् remained.

text: घोरैर्दत्तवरैर्बद्धौ शरैराशीविषोपमैः । अमोघैः सूर्यसङ्काशैः प्रमथ्येन्द्रजिता युधि ॥६-५१-१४॥
तदस्त्रबन्धमासाद्य यदि मुक्तौ रिपू मम । संशयस्थमिदं सर्वमनुपश्याम्यहं बलम् ॥६-५१-१५॥
translation: "My enemies who are bound by the formidable and unfailing, sharp, poisonous and bright arrows like the sun of Indrajith blessed with boons, are liberated from the bondage! I doubt if my army is in danger!"
word_meanings: घोरैः dreadful, दत्तवरैः blessed with boons, आशीविषोपमैः like sharp poisonous snakes, अमोघैः amazing, सूर्यसङ्काशैः bright like the sun, शरैः arrows, युधि in battle, प्रमध्य violently, इन्द्रजिता by Indrajith, बद्धौ bound by, ममरिपू our enemies, तत् that, अस्त्रबन्धम् bondage by the arrows, आसाद्य formidable, मुक्तौयदि to liberate, इदम् this, सर्वम् everything, बलम् army, संशयस्थम् doubt, अहम् I am, अनुपश्यामि perceive.

text: निष्फलाः खलु संवृत्ताः शरा वासुकितेजसः । आदत्तं यैः सुसङ्ग्रामे रिपूणां मम जीवितम् ॥६-५१-१६॥
translation: "My arrows which are equal in brilliance to Vasuki by which my enemies' life was taken away has become in fructuous now."
word_meanings: तैः they, सङ्ग्रामे in battlefield, मम me, रिपूणाम् enemies, जीवितम् life, अदत्तम् taken away, वासुकितेजसः of equal brilliance as Vasuki, शराः arrows, निष्फलाः wasted, सम्वृत्ताःखलु become in fructuous now.

text: एवमुक्त्वा तु सङ्क्रुद्धो निःश्वसन्नुरगो यथा । अब्रवीद्रक्षसां मध्ये धूम्राक्षं नाम राक्षसम् ॥६-५१-१७॥
translation: Having said so, hissing Ravana called Dhumraksha to the midst.
word_meanings: एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, सङ्क्रुद्धः enraged, यथा just like, निश्श्वसन् hissing, रक्षसाम् Rakshasa, मध्ये midst, धूम्राक्षंनाम called Dhumraksha, राक्षसम् Rakshasa, अब्रवीत् said.

text: बलेन महता युक्तो रक्षसां भीमविक्रम । त्वं वधायाभिनिर्याहि रामस्य सह वानरैः ॥६-५१-१८॥
translation: "Dhumraksha of fierce prowess, you along with a huge Rakshasa army go just now to destroy Rama along with able Vanaras."
word_meanings: भीमविक्रमः of fierce prowess, त्वम् you, महता huge, बलेन army, राक्षसैः of Rakshasas, युक्तः able, वानरैःसह along with Vanaras, रामस्य and Rama also, वधाय destroying, अभि now, निर्याहि commanded.

text: एवमुक्तस्तु धूम्राक्षो राक्षसेन्द्रेण धीमता । कृत्वा प्रणामं संहृष्टो निर्जगाम नृपालयात् ॥६-५१-१९॥
translation: Commanded by the Intelligent king of Rakshasas in that manner, Dhumraksha offered prayers and went from there joyfully.
word_meanings: धीमता Intelligent, राक्षसेन्द्रेण by the Lord of Rakshasas, एवम् in that manner, उक्तः ordered by, धूम्राक्षः Dhumraksha, प्रणाम् prayers, कृत्वा having offered, नृपालयत् from the king, सम्हृष्ट: joyful, निर्जगाम went from there.

text: अभिनिष्कम्य तद्द्वारं बलाध्यक्षमुवाच ह । त्वरयस्व बलं तूर्णं किं चिरेण युयुत्सतः ॥६-५१-२०॥
translation: There after Dhumraksha went from the gateway and said to the CommanderinChief of the army" Get ready immediately and start quickly. Why delay?"
word_meanings: तद् thereafter, द्वारम् from the gateway, अभिनिष्क्रम्य went from there, बलाध्यक्षम् commander inchief of the army, उवाचह said so, तूर्णम् Instantly, बलम् army, युयुत्सतः get ready, त्वरयस्व speedily, चिरेण delay, किम् why.

text: धूम्राक्षवचनं श्रुत्वा बलाध्यक्षो बलानुगः । बलमुद्योजयामास रावणस्याज्ञया द्रुतम् ॥६-५१-२१॥
translation: On hearing the words of Dhumraksha, the CommanderinChief of the large army, he got ready quickly by the order of Ravana.
word_meanings: बलानुगः large army contingent, बलाध्यक्षः CommanderinChief of army, धूम्राक्षवचनम् Dhumraksha's words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, रावणस्य Ravana's, आज्ञया by the order, द्रुतम् quickly, बलम् army, उद्योजयामास got ready.

text: ते बद्धघण्टाबलिनो घोररूपा निशाचराः । विगर्जमानाः संहृष्टा धूम्राक्षं पर्यवारयन् । विविधायुधहस्ताश्च शूलमुद्गरपाणयः ॥६-५१-२२॥
translation: Mighty army bound with girdles of bells to their waist, of fierce form roaring surrounded Dhumraksha joyfully.
word_meanings: बद्धघण्टाः bound with girdles of bells, बलिनः mighty, घोररूपाः of fierce, तेनिशाचराः the Rakshasa, विगर्जमाना roaring, सम्हृष्टाः joyfully, धूम्राक्षम् with Dhumraksha, पर्यवारयन् surrounded.

text: गदाभिः पट्टिशैर्दण्डैरायसैर्मुसलैर्भृशम् ॥६-५१-२३॥
ृष्टा धूम्राक्षं पर्यवारयन् । परिघैर्बिन्दिपालैश्च भल्लैः प्रासैः परश्वधैः । निर्ययू राक्षसा दिग्भ्योनर्दन्तो जलदा यथा ॥६-५१-२४॥
translation: The dreadful Rakshasas set out roaring like rain clouds armed with different kinds of weapons, like tridents, darts, maces, spears, iron bars, rods, even clubs, spears and slings, arrows in thousands.
word_meanings: जलदायथा like rain clouds, नर्दन्तः roaring, घोराः dreadful, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, विविधायुधहस्ताश्च holding different kinds of weapons, शूलमुद्गरपाणयः tridents, spikes, गदाभिः maces too, पट्टसै: iron spears, दण्डैः rods, आयसैः armour, मुसलैरपि even clubs, परिघैः iron bars, भिण्डिवापालैश्च slings use for hurling stones, भल्लैः arrows, प्रासै: darts, परश्वधैः in thousands, निर्ययुः set out.

text: रथैः कवचिनस्त्वन्ये ध्वजैश्च समलङ्कृतैः । सुवर्णजालविहितैः खरैश्च विविधाननैः ॥६-५१-२५॥
हयैः परमशीघ्रैश्च गजैन्द्रैश्च मदोत्कटैः । निर्ययू राक्षसव्याघ्रा व्याघ्रा इव दुरासदाः ॥६-५१-२६॥
translation: And others collected together holding shields, fearless like tigers, frightful in appearance, mounted on fast horses, chariots yoked to donkeys of different kinds covered with gold mesh, on maddened elephants Set out.
word_meanings: अन्ये and others, कवचिनः holding shields, ध्वजैः flags, समलङ्कृतैः collected together, सुवर्णजालविहितैः with golden mesh, विविधाननैः many kinds, खरैश्च donkeys, रथैः chariots, परमशीघ्रैः very fast, हयैश्च horses also, मदोत्कटैः maddened, गजैश्चैव and elephants, व्याघ्राःइव like tigers, and horses दुरासदाः frightful, निर्ययुर्नैरृतव्याघ्रा fearless like tigers, निर्ययुः set out.

text: वृकसिंहमुखैर्युक्तं खरैः कनकभूषणैः । आरुरोह रथं दिव्यं धूम्राक्षः खरनिस्वनः ॥६-५१-२७॥
translation: Dhumraksha of frightful tone mounted on a chariot adorned with gold yoked to donkeys with lion and bear like faces.
word_meanings: खरनिःस्वनः of frightful tone, धूम्राक्षः Dhumraksha, वृकसिंहमुखैः having faces like lion and bear, कनकभूषणै: adorned with gold, खरैः donkeys, युक्तम् yoked, दिव्यम् awesome, रथम् chariots, आरुरोह mounted.

text: स निर्यातो महावीर्यो धूम्राक्षो राक्षसैर्वृतः । प्रहसन् पश्चिमद्वारं हनूमान् यत्र यूथपः । रथप्रवरमास्थाय खरयुक्तं खरस्वनम् ॥६-५१-२८॥
translation: Heroic Rakshasa, Dhumraksha surrounded by rakshasas set forth laughing to the west gate where Hanuman stood.
word_meanings: महावीर्यः heroic, सःधूम्राक्षः Dhumraksha, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, वृतः surrounded by, प्रहसन् laughing, यत्र there, हनूमान् Hanuman, यूधपः taken position, पश्चिमद्वारं west gate, निर्यातः set forth.

text: प्रयान्तं तु महाघोरं राक्षसं भीमविक्रमम् । अन्तरिक्षगता घोराः शकुनाः प्रत्यवारयन् ॥६-५१-२९॥
translation: While the Rakshasa was mounted on the chariot and going braying like a donkey, a fearful bird going in the sky stood before his chariot.
word_meanings: खरयुक्तम् yoked to donkeys, खरस्वनम् braying like donkeys, रथप्रवरम् chariot, आस्थाय mounting, प्रयान्तम् while going, महाघोरम् terrible, भीमदर्शनम् fearful appearance, राक्षसम् at the Rakshasa, अन्तरिक्षागताः going to the sky, घोराः fierce, शकुनाः birds, प्रत्यषेधयन् stood before.

text: रथशीर्षे महान् भीमो गृध्रश्च निपपात ह । ध्वजाग्रे ग्रथिताश्चैव निपेतुः कुणपाशनाः ॥६-५१-३०॥
translation: A foul smelling frightening vulture (that feeds on the dead body) descended on top of the chariot and fell down.
word_meanings: महान्भीमः very frightening, गृध्रश्च vultures, रथशीर्षे on the chariot, निपपातह descended on, कुणपाशनाः a foul smelling, ग्रथिताः vultures, ध्वजाग्रे from the chariot top, निपेतुः fell down.

text: रुधिरार्द्रो महान् श्वेतः कबन्धः पतितो भुवि । विस्वरं चोत्सृजन्नादं धूम्नाक्षस्य समीपतः ॥६-५१-३१॥
translation: A trunk of a white bird drenched in blood sounding discordant fell near by Dhumraksha. It appeared like a rain god shedding blood on the ground.
word_meanings: रुधिरार्द्रः drenched in blood, श्वेतः white, महान् great, कबन्धः bird, विस्वरम् discordant cry, नादम् sound, उत्सृजन् heard, धूम्राक्षस्य at Dhumraksha, समीपतः nearby, भुवि on ground, पतितः fell, देवः Deva, रुधिरम् , blood, ववर्ष rained, मेदिनी on earth.

text: ववर्ष रुधिरं देवः सञ्चचाल च मेदिनी । प्रतिलोभं ववौ वायुर्निर्घातसमनिस्वनः ॥६-५१-३२॥
तिमिरौघावृतास्तत्र दिशश्च न चकाशिरे ॥६-५१-३३॥
translation: Thunder like roar was heard. Wind blew adversely. Darkness pervaded, and directions could not be seen.
word_meanings: निर्घातसमनिस्वनः thunder like roar, वायुः wind, प्रतिलोमम् adversely, ववौ blew, तत्र there, दिशः directions, तिमिरौघवृताः darkness pervaded, नचकाशिरे directions could not be discerned.

text: स तूत्पातांस्तदा दृष्ट्वा राक्षसानां भयावहान् । प्रादुर्भूतान् सुघोरांश्च धूम्राक्षो व्यथितो ऽभवत् ॥६-५१-३४॥
मुमुहू राक्षसाः सर्वे धूम्राक्षस्य पुरस्सराः ॥६-५१-३५॥
translation: Then Rakshasa feared seeing the dreadful manifestation and got worried. All the Rakshasas walking in front of Dhumraksha lost consciousness.
word_meanings: राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, भयावहान् feared, तदा then, प्रादुद्भूतान् manifesting deities, घोरान् dreadful, उत्पातान् generated, दृष्टवा seeing, धूम्राक्षः Dhumraksha, व्यथितः worried, अभवत् became, धूम्राक्षस्य Dhumraksha's, पुरःसराः in front, सर्वे all, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, मुमुहुः lost consciousness.

text: ततः सुभीमो बहुभिर्निशाचरैर्वृतो ऽभिनिष्क्रम्य रणोत्सुको बली । ददर्श तां राघवबाहुपालितां महौघकल्पां बहुवानरीं चमूम् ॥६-५१-३६॥
translation: Thereafter many strong and powerful Rakshasas surrounding Dhumraksha, who was enthusiastic about war, beheld many Vanaras protected by Raghava like at universal dissolution. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेएकपञ्चाशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the fifty first sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, सुभीमः very powerful, बली strong, बहुभिः many, निशाचरैः Rakshasas, वृतः surrounding, रणोत्सुकः enthusiastic of war, अभिनिष्क्रम्य, राघवबाहुपालिताम् protected by Raghava, महौघकल्पाम् universal dissolution, बहुवानरीम् many Vanaras, तांचमूम् the army, ददर्श beheld.

text: धूम्राक्षं प्रेक्ष्य निर्यान्तं राक्षसं भीमविक्रमम् । विनेदुर्वानराः सर्वे प्रहृष्टा युद्धकाङ्क्षिणः ॥६-५२-१॥
translation: Seeing Dhumraksha of terrible prowess returning, the vanaras made loud noises out of joy and desire to wage war.
word_meanings: निर्यान्तम् returning, भीमविक्रमम् of terrible prowess, राक्षसम् Rakshasas, धूम्राक्षम् Dhumraksha, वीक्ष्य seeing, सर्वे all, वानराः Vanaras, युद्धकाङ् क्षिणः desirous to wage war, प्रहृष्टाः rejoicing, विनेदुः made loud noise.

text: तेषां सुतुमुलं युद्धं सञ्जज्ञे हरिरक्षसाम् । अन्योन्यं पादपैर्घोरं निघ्नतां शूलमुद्गरैः ॥६-५२-२॥
translation: Tumultuous war took place between Vanaras and Rakshasas, striking one another, monkeys with terrible trees and Rakshasas with tridents and clubs.
word_meanings: घोरैः terrible, पादपैः trees, शूलमुद्गरैः tridents and clubs, अन्योन्यम् one another, निघ्नताम् , तेषाम् in that way, कपिरक्षसाम् between the Vanaras and Rakshasas, सुतुमुलम् tumultuous, युद्धम् war, संजज्ञे happened.

text: घोरैश्च परिघैश्चित्रैस्त्रिशूलैश्चापि संहतैः । राक्षसैर्वानरा घोरैर्विनिकृत्ताः समन्ततः ॥६-५२-३॥
वानरै राक्षसाश्चापि द्रुमैर्भूमौ समीकृताः । राक्षसाश्चापि सङ्क्रुद्धा वानरान्निशितैः शरैः । विव्यधुर्घोरसङ्काशैः कङ्कपत्रैरजिह्मगैः ॥६-५२-४॥
translation: Highly enraged Rakshasas on their part fixed the Vanaras with sharp dreadful arrows with itching feathers.
word_meanings: राक्षसास्तु Rakshasas on their part, अभिसङ्क्रुद्धाः highly enraged, निशितैः sharp, घोरसङ्काशैः dreadful, कङ्कपत्रैः itching feathers, अजिह्मगैः fixed, शरैः arrows, वानरान् at Vanaras, विव्यथु attacked.

text: ते गदाभिश्च भीमाभिः पट्टिशैः कूटमुद्गरैः श्चापि सङ्क्रुद्धा वानरान्निशितैः शरैः ॥६-५२-५॥
विदार्यमाणा रक्षोभिर्वानरास्ते महाबलाः । अमर्षाज्जनितोद्धर्षाश्चक्रुः कर्माण्यभीतवत् ॥६-५२-६॥
translation: The Vanaras although strong were wielding maces, spikes, tridents, terrific iron bars and multitude of weapons of many kinds to crush the Rakshasas. They were endowed with prowess, knowledgeable of weapons and doing their duty without fear and with great enthusiasm.
word_meanings: भीमाभिः being strong, गदाभिः wielding maces, पट्टसै: spikes, कूटमुद्गरैः multitude of weapons to crush, घोरैः terrific, परिघैश्च iron bars also, चित्स्रैः many kinds, संश्रितैः wielders, त्रिशूलैश्च tridents also, रक्षोभिः guarding, विदीर्यमाणाः knowers, महाबलाः endowed with prowess, तेवानराः those Vanaras, अमर्ष bearing, जनितोद्धर्षाः with great enthusiasm, अभीतवत् without fear, कर्माणि their duty, चक्रुः doing.

text: शरनिर्भिन्नगात्रास्ते शूलनिर्भिन्नदेहिनः । जगृहुस्ते द्रुमांस्तत्र शिलाश्च हरियूथपाः ॥६-५२-७॥
translation: Vanaras 's bodies split in their necks by the terrible tridents, took up trees and rocks to fight.
word_meanings: शरनिर्भिन्नगात्राः split necks and bodies, शूलनिर्भिन्नदेहिनः by the terrible tridents, ते they, वानरयूथपाः Vanara troops, तत्र there, द्रुमान् trees, शिलाश्च rocks, जगृहुः took up to fight.

text: ते भीमवेगा हरयो नर्दमानास्ततस्ततः । ममन्थू राक्षसान् भीमान्नामानि च बभाषिरे ॥६-५२-८॥
translation: The monkeys endowed with terrific speed, proceeding from there roaring, proclaiming their names crushed the Rakshasa heroes.
word_meanings: भीमवेगाः of terrific speed, तेहरयः the monkeys, नर्दमानाः roaring, ततस्ततः proceeding from there, वीरान् heroes, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, ममन्थुः proclaiming नामानिच their names, बभाषिरे crushed.

text: तद्वभूवाद्भुतं घोरं युद्धं वानररक्षसाम् । शिलाभिर्विविधाभिश्च बहुभिश्चैव पादपैः ॥६-५२-९॥
translation: Wonderful fight took place between Vanaras and Rakshasas who held trees and rocks of several kinds.
word_meanings: विविधाभिः of several kinds, शिलाभिः rocks, बहुभिः many, पादपैः trees, तत् there, वानररक्षसाम् between Vanaras and Rakshasas, घोरम् fierce, युद्धम् war, अद्भुतम् च wonderful, बभूव took place.

text: राक्षसा मथिताः केचिद्वानरैर्जितकाशिभिः । ववमू रुधिरं केचिन्मुखै रुधिरभोजनाः ॥६-५२-१०॥
translation: Vanaras who had conquered fear crushed Rakshasas into lumps of flesh indeed the Rakshasas threw out blood from their mouths.
word_meanings: जितकाशिभिः who conquered fear, वानरैः Vanaras, केचित् indeed, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, मथिताः crushed into lumps, केचित् indeed, रुधिरभोजनाः blood thrown out, मुखैः from mouth, रुधिरम् blood, ववमूः vomited.

text: पार्श्वेषु दारिताः केचित् केचिद्राशीकृता द्रुमैः । शिलाभिश्चूर्णिताः केचित् केचिद्दन्तैर्विदारिताः ॥६-५२-११॥
translation: Some tore by the sides of the body, some crushed by the trees, some powdered by the rocks, and some were torn into pieces with teeth.
word_meanings: केचित् some, पार्श्वेषु by the sides, दारिताः tore, केचित् some, द्रुमैः by trees, राशीकृताः crushed, केचित् some, शिलाभिः with rocks, चूर्णिताः powdered, केचित् some, दन्तै with teeth, विदारिताः tore into pieces.

text: ध्वजैर्विमथितैर्भग्नैः खरैश्च विनिपातितैः । रथैर्विध्वंसितैश्चापि पतितै रजनीचरैः ॥६-५२-१२॥
translation: Indeed, the night rangers were killed, their flags were broken. They were crushed, their swords were destroyed with chariots fallen.
word_meanings: केचित् indeed, रजनीचरैः night rangers, विमथितैः killed, भग्नैः broken, ध्वजैः flags, विनिपातितैः crushed, खङ्गैश्च swords, विध्वंसितैः totally destroyed, रथैः chariots, पतितैः fallen down.

text: गजेन्द्रैः पर्वताकारैः पर्वताग्रैर्वनौकसाम् । मथितैर्वाजिभिः कीर्णं सारोहैर्वसुधातलम् ॥६-५२-१३॥
translation: By the Vanaras hurling from the mountains, the crushed elephants were like mountains and the horses with riders crushed covered the ground all over.
word_meanings: वनौकसाम् monkeys, पर्वताग्रैः from mountain tops, मथितैः crushed, पर्वताकारैः like mountains in form, गजेन्द्रैः elephants, सारोहैः riders, वाजिभिः horses, वसुधातलम् surface of the ground, कीर्णम् covered.

text: वानरैर्भीमविक्रान्तैराप्लुत्याप्लुत्य वेगितैः । राक्षसाः करजैस्तीक्ष्णैर्मुखेषु विनिकर्तिताः ॥६-५२-१४॥
translation: The Vanaras with their terrific valour jumping up wounded the Rakshasas in their face with their sharp nails.
word_meanings: भीमविक्रान्स्सैः of terrific valour, वेगितैः of high speed, वानरैः Vanaras, आप्लुत्य jumping up, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, करजैः nails, मुखेषु on the face, विनिर्तिताः wounded.

text: विवर्णवदना भूयो विप्रकीर्णशिरोरुहाः । मूढाः शोणितगन्धेन निपेतुर्धरणीतले ॥६-५२-१५॥
translation: Some others with pale faces and dishevelled hair lost senses due to rolling in blood dropped on the ground.
word_meanings: भूयः some others, विषण्णवदनाः pale faces, विप्रकीर्णशिरोरुहाः dishevelled hair, शोणितगन्धेन due to the smell of blood, मूढाः lost senses, धरणीतले on the ground, निपेतुः dropped.

text: अन्ये परमसङ्क्रुद्धा राक्षसा भीमनिस्वनाः । तलैरेवाभिधावन्ति वज्रस्पर्शसमैर्हरीन् ॥६-५२-१६॥
translation: Other Rakshasas of terrific valour, extremely enraged, hit the monkeys with their palms which were hard as diamond to touch.
word_meanings: भीमविक्रमाः of terrific valour, अन्ये others, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, परमसङ्कृक्रुद्धाः extremely enraged, वज्रस्पर्शसमैः of hard touch like diamond, तलैरेव with palms, हरीन् monkeys, अभिधावन्ति assailed.

text: वानरैरापतन्तस्ते वेगिता वेगवत्तरैः । मुष्टिभिश्चरणैर्दन्तैः पादपैश्चावपोथिताः । वानरैर्हन्यमानास्ते राक्षसा विप्रदुद्रुवुः ॥६-५२-१७॥
translation: Endowed with speed, the Vanaras also fell on the Rakshasas at greater speed, knocking them down with fists, feet, teeth and even trees.
word_meanings: वेगिताः endowed with speed, आपतन्तः falling upon, ते them, वेगवत्तरैः of greater speed, वानरैः Vanaras, मुष्टिभिः with fists, चरणैः feet, दन्स्सैः with teeth, पादपैश्च trees also, अवपोथिताः knocking.

text: सैन्यं तु विद्रुतं दृष्ट्वा धूम्राक्षो राक्षसर्षभः । क्रोधेन कदनं चक्रे वानराणां युयुत्सताम् ॥६-५२-१८॥
translation: Dhumraksha, the bull among the Rakshasas seeing the army distressed and running away, being eager to fight began to cause havoc to the Vanaras.
word_meanings: राक्षसर्षभ bull among Rakshasas, धूम्राक्षः Dhumraksha, विद्रुतम् distressed, सैन्यम् army, दृष्टवा seeing, रोषेण angrily, युयुत्सताम् eager to fight, वानराणाम् Vanaras, कदनम् havoc, चक्रे running away.

text: प्रासैः प्रमथिताः केचिद्वानराः शोणितस्रवाः । मुद्गरैराहताः केचित् पतिता धरणीतले ॥६-५२-१९॥
translation: Few Vanaras mutilated by barbed darts, some struck with mallets, blood oozing dropped down.
word_meanings: केचित् a few, वानराः Vanaras, प्रासैः by barbed darts, प्रमथिताः mutilated, शोणितस्रवाः, केचित् , मुद्गरैः, आहताः, धरणीतले on the ground, पातिताः dropped.
