text: परिघैर्मथिताः केचिद्भिन्दिपालैर्विदारिताः । पट्टिशैराहताः केचिद्विह्वलन्तो गतासवः ॥६-५२-२०॥
translation: Some were pound by iron bars, some were torn up, some split and some pierced and cut ceased in life.
word_meanings: केचित् some, परिघैः iron bars, मथिताः pounded, भिण्डिवालैः torn up, विदारिताः split, केचित् some, पट्टसैः pierced, मथिताः pounded, विह्वलन्तः cut, गतासनः ceased of life.

text: केचिद्विनिहताः शूलै रुधिरार्द्रा वनौकसः । केचिद्विद्राविता नष्टाः सबलै राक्षसैर्युधि ॥६-५२-२१॥
translation: In the battlefield some Vanaras, attacked by Rakshasas, were floating on the ground in blood, dead.
word_meanings: युधि in the battlefield, केचित् some, वनौकसः Vanaras, सङ्क्रुद्धैः attacked by, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, विनिहताः killed, रुधिरार्द्राः floating in blood, भूमौ on the ground, एचित् some, विद्राविताः split, नष्टाः destroyed.

text: विभिन्नहृदयाः केचिदेकपार्श्वेन दारिताः । विदारिता स्त्रिशूलैश्च केचिदान्त्रैर्विनिःसृताः ॥६-५२-२२॥
translation: Some with their hearts open and broken, beaten on side laid detached of their inner parts.
word_meanings: केचित् a few, विभिन्नहृदयाः hearts open and broken, एकपार्श्वेन beaten on one side, शायिताः laid, केचित् few, त्रिशूलैः by tridents, विदारिताः split, आन्स्रैः inner parts, विनिःसृताः detached.

text: तत्सुभीमं महायुद्धं हरिराक्षससङ्कुलम् । प्रबभौ शब्दबहुलं शिलापादपसङ्कुलम् ॥६-५२-२३॥
translation: The monkeys and Rakshasa groups took part in a fierce fight with rocks and trees abounding loud noise.
word_meanings: सुभीमम् very frightful, हरिराक्षससङ्कुलम् monkeys and Rakshasa groups, शिलापादमसङ्कुलम् with rocks and trees, शब्दबहुलम् loud noise, महत् great, तत् युद्धम् that battle, प्रबभौ abounded.

text: धनुर्ज्यातन्त्रिमधुरं हिक्कातालसमन्वितम् । मन्दस्तनितसङ्गीतं युद्धगान्धर्वमाबभौ ॥६-५२-२४॥
translation: It seemed like music in the form of twang of bow strings, neighing of horses like the sound of wooden cymbals, vocal music in the form of trumpeting of elephants, that battle seemed like symphony.
word_meanings: धनुर्ज्यातन्त्रिमधुरम् in the form of twang of bow strings, हिक्कातालसमन्वितम् neighing of horses in the form of wooden cymbals, मन्धस्न्तितसङ्गीतम् music in the form of trumpeting of elephants, तत् that, युद्धगान्धर्वम् , आबभौ seemed.

text: धूम्राक्षस्तु धनुष्पाणिर्वानरान् रणमूर्धनि । हसन् विद्रावयामास दिशस्तु शरवृष्टिभिः ॥६-५२-२५॥
translation: Dhumraksha with his bow in hand, showering arrows, laughing in battlefront dispersed the Vanaras in directions.
word_meanings: धूम्राक्षस्तु Dhumraksha with bow in hand, रणमूर्धनि in the battle front, धनुष्पाणिः wielding arrows and bow, हसन् laughing, शरवृष्टिभिः showers of arrows, तान् वानरान् on the Vanaras, दिशः directions, तु at, विद्रावयामास started dispersing.

text: धूम्राक्षेणार्दितं सैन्यं व्यथितं दृश्य मारुतिः । अभ्यवर्तत सङ्क्रुद्धः प्रगृह्य विपुलां शिलाम् ॥६-५२-२६॥
translation: Beholding the perturbed army, Hanuman seized a huge rock and turned towards Dhumraksha.
word_meanings: मारुतिः Hanuman, धूम्राक्षेण at Dhumraksha, अर्धितम् perturbed, व्यथितम् harassed, सैन्यम् army, प्रेक्ष्य beholding, सङ्क्रुद्धः very angry, विपुलाम् huge, शिलाम् rock, प्रगृह्य grabbing, अभ्यवर्तत turned towards.

text: क्रोधाद्द्विगुणताम्राक्षः पितृतुल्यपराक्रमः । शिलां तां पातयामास धूम्राक्षस्य रथं प्रति ॥६-५२-२७॥
translation: Endowed with mighty valour equal to his father, an angry Hanuman hurled the rock at the chariot of Dhumraksha.
word_meanings: पितृ father:, तुल्यपराक्रमः endowed with mighty valour, क्रोधात् angrily, द्विगुणताम्राक्षः copper colour red eyed, धूम्राक्षस्य at Dhumraksha, रथंप्रति at the chariot, तांशिलाम् that rock, पातयामास hurled.

text: आपतन्तीं शिलां दृष्ट्वा गदामुद्यम्य सम्भ्रमात् । रथादाप्लुत्य वेगेन वसुधायां व्यतिष्ठत ॥६-५२-२८॥
translation: Beholding the rock descending upon him, Dhumraksha rushed instantly on the ground from the chariot and stood.
word_meanings: आपतन्तीम् descending upon, शिलाम् rock, दृष्टवा beholding, सम्भ्रमात् bewildered, गदाम् mace, उद्यम्य seizing, वेगेन rushing, रथात् chariot's, आप्लुत्य mounting, वसुधायाम् on the ground, व्यतिष्ठत stood

text: सा प्रमथ्य रथं तस्य निपपात शिला भुवि । सचक्रकूबरं साश्वं सध्वजं सशरासनम् ॥६-५२-२९॥
translation: That rock fell on the chariot and got crushed along with its wheel and axle and with arrows.
word_meanings: साशिला that rock, तस्य its, सचक्रकूबरसाश्वम् with wheel and axle, सध्वजम् with posts, सशरासनम् with arrows, रथम् chariot, प्रमध्य crushed, भुवि ground, निपपात Fell.

text: स भङ्क्त्वा तु रथं तस्य हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः । रक्षसां कदनं चक्रे सस्कन्धविटपैर्द्रुमैः ॥६-५२-३०॥
translation: Hanuman the son of WindGod in that way started destroying the chariot and the Rakshasa with tree trunks and stems.
word_meanings: मारुतात्मजः son of WindGod, सःहनुमान् that Hanuman, तस्य his, रथम् chariot, भङ् क्त्वा trunks, सस्कन्धविटपैः stems of trees, द्रुमैः Dhumraksha, रक्षसाम् Rakshasa, कदनम् destruction, चक्रे started.

text: विभिन्नशिरसो भूत्वा राक्षसाः शोणितोक्षिताः । द्रुमैः प्रव्यथिताश्चान्ये निपेतुर्धरणीतले ॥६-५२-३१॥
translation: Some Rakshasas hit by trees with their heads broken, shedding blood fell on the ground.
word_meanings: राक्षसाः Rakshasa, विभिन्नशिरसः heads broken, भूत्वा hit, शोणितोक्षिताः drenched in blood, अन्ये other, द्रुमैः trees, प्रमथिताः hit by, धरणीतले on the ground, निपेतुः fell.

text: विद्राव्य रासक्षं सैन्यं हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः । गिरेः शिखरमादाय धूम्राक्षमभिदुद्रुवे ॥६-५२-३२॥
translation: Hanuman the son of WindGod, after chasing the army of Rakshasas reaching the top of the mountain, jumped on Dhumraksha.
word_meanings: मारुतात्मजः the son of Wind God, हनुमान् Hanuman, राक्षसम् at Rakshasas, सैन्यम् army, विद्राव्य chasing, गिरेः mountain, शिखरम् top, आदाय reaching, धूम्राक्षम् Dhumraksha, अभिदुद्रुवे jumped on to.

text: तमापतन्तं धूम्राक्षो गदामुद्यम्य वीर्यवान् । विनर्दमानः सहसा हनुमन्तमभिद्रवत् ॥६-५२-३३॥
translation: Lifting his mace on seeing Hanuman, heroic and brave Dhumraksha darted on Hanuman, roaring like a lion.
word_meanings: वीर्यवान् heroic, धूम्राक्षः Dhumrakshasa, गदाम् mace, उद्यम्य lifting up, विनर्दमानः roaring like a lion, सहसा brave, आपतन्तम् jumped, तंहनूमन्तम् that Hanuman, अभिद्रवत् darted.

text: ततः क्रुद्धस्तु वेगेन गदां तां बहुकण्टकाम् । पातयामास धूम्राक्षो मस्तके तु हनूमतः ॥६-५२-३४॥
translation: And then lifting his mace fixed with many nails, Dhumraksha enraged lighted on Hanuman.
word_meanings: अथ and then, धूम्राक्षः Dhumraksha, बहुकण्टकाम् fixed with many nails, तांगदाम् that mace, क्रुद्धस्य enraged, तस्यहनूमतः that Hanuman's, मस्तके head, रोषेण in anger, पातयामास alighted.

text: ताडितः स तया तत्र गदया भीमरूपया ॥६-५२-३५॥
स कपिर्मारुतबलस्तं प्रहारमचिन्तयन् । धूम्राक्षस्य शिरोमध्ये गिरिशृङ्गमपातयत् ॥६-५२-३६॥
translation: That fierce mace fell on Hanuman's head. Hanuman who was equal to wind god without caring for the hit dropped the peak of the mountain on the centre of Dhumraksha's head.
word_meanings: तत्र there, भीमवेरूपया of fierce form, तया like that, गदया mace, ताडितः fell, सः he, मारुतबलः equal to WindGod in strength, सःकपिः that monkey, तम् that, प्रहारम् hurt, अचिन्तयन् without caring, धूम्राक्षस्य Dhumraksha's, शिरोमध्ये middle of the head, गिरिशृङ्गम् peak of the mountain, अपातयत् dropped.

text: स विह्वलितसर्वाङ्गो गिरिशृङ्गेण ताडितः । पपात सहसा भूमौ विकीर्ण इव पर्वतः ॥६-५२-३७॥
translation: By the falling of the peak of the mountain on Dhumraksha, all his limbs broken to pieces and crushed fell on the ground like a mountain.
word_meanings: गिरिशृङ्गेण by the peak of the mountain, ताडितः falling, सः he, विस्फारितसर्वाङ्गः all limbs broken to pieces, सहसा along with, विकीर्णः crushed, पर्वतःइव like a mountain, भूमौ on the ground, पपात fell.

text: धूम्राक्षं निहतं दृष्टवा हतशेषा निशाचराः । त्रस्ताः प्रविविशुर्लङ्कां वध्यमानाः प्लवङ्गमैः ॥६-५२-३८॥
translation: Those Rakshasas who survived the onslaught, seeing Dhumraksha killed, reentered Lanka out of fear of being killed by Vanaras.
word_meanings: हतशेषाः those who survived, निशाचराः night rangers, धूम्राक्षम् Dhumraksha, निहतम् killed, दृष्टवा seeing, त्रस्ताः out of fear, प्लवङ्गमैः of Vanaras, वध्यमानाः killed, लङ्काम् into Lanka, प्रविविशुः reentered.

text: स तु पवनसुतो निहत्य शत्रुं क्षतजवहाः सरितश्च सन्निकीर्य । रिपुवधजनितश्रमो महात्मा मुदमगमत् कपिभिश्च पूज्यमानः ॥६-५२-३९॥
translation: The son of wind god, the great soul, having killed the enemy in the battlefield and making the river of blood to flow, was exhausted by killing enemies. The monkeys started worshipping him in joy. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेद्विपञ्चाशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the fifty second sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: महात्मा great soul, सः he, पवनसुतः son of wind god, शत्रुम् enemy, निहत्य killing, क्षतजवहाः in the battlefield, परितश्च made to flow, संनिकीर्य river of blood, रिपुवधजनितश्रमः exhausted by killing the enemies, कपिभिः even the monkeys, सुपूज्यमानः started worshipping, मुदम् in joy, आगमत् felt.

text: धूम्राक्षं निहतं श्रुत्वा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः । क्रोधेन महता ऽ ऽविष्टो निश्वसन्नुरगो यथा ॥६-५३-१॥
translation: The Lord of Rakshasas was overcome with anger on hearing about Dhumraksha's death. He was hissing like a serpent, heaving a deep burning sigh, for having done a dirty task. He spoke to cruel Vajradamshtra of mighty prowess.
word_meanings: राक्षसेश्वरः Rakshasa's Lord, धूम्राक्षम् Dhumraksha, निहतम् killed, श्रुत्वा hearing, महता very, क्रोधेन by anger, आविष्टः overcome, उरगोयथा like a serpent, निश्श्वसन् hissing, दीर्घम् deep, उष्णम् hot, विनिश्श्वस्य heaving a burning sigh, क्रोधेन in anger, कलुषीकृतः having done a dirty task, क्रूरम् cruel, महाबलम् of mighty prowess, वज्रदंष्ट्रम् Vajradamshtra, राक्षसम् Rakshasa, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: दीर्घमुष्णं विनिश्वस्य क्रोधेन कलुषीकृतः । अब्रवीद्राक्षसं शूरं वज्रदंष्ट्रं महाबलम् ॥६-५३-२॥
translation: The Lord of Rakshasas was overcome with anger on hearing about Dhumraksha's death. He was hissing like a serpent, heaving a deep burning sigh, for having done a dirty task. He spoke to cruel Vajradamshtra of mighty prowess.
word_meanings: राक्षसेश्वरः Rakshasa's Lord, धूम्राक्षम् Dhumraksha, निहतम् killed, श्रुत्वा hearing, महता very, क्रोधेन by anger, आविष्टः overcome, उरगोयथा like a serpent, निश्श्वसन् hissing, दीर्घम् deep, उष्णम् hot, विनिश्श्वस्य heaving a burning sigh, क्रोधेन in anger, कलुषीकृतः having done a dirty task, क्रूरम् cruel, महाबलम् of mighty prowess, वज्रदंष्ट्रम् Vajradamshtra, राक्षसम् Rakshasa, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: गच्छ त्वं वीर निर्याहि राक्षसैः परिवारितः । जहि दाशरथिं रामं सुग्रीवं वानरैः सह ॥६-५३-३॥
translation: "O Hero, proceed, accompanied by Rakshasa companions and kill Dasaratha's Rama and Sugriva along with Vanaras."
word_meanings: वीर hero, त्वम् you, गच्छ proceed, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, परिवारितः accompanied by companions, निर्याहि kill, दाशरथिम् Dasaratha's, रामम् Rama, सुग्रीवम् and Sugriva, वानरैः Vanaras सह along with, जहि ongoing.

text: तथेत्युक्त्वा द्रुततरं मायावी राक्षसेश्वरः । निर्जगाम बलै सार्धं बहुभिः परिवारितः ॥६-५३-४॥
translation: The king of Rakshasas, being a deceit, having spoken in that way, many generals of the army went accompanied by elephants, horses, camels, and donkeys with chariots decorated with banners and pennons, and diadems collected together.
word_meanings: मायावी deceit, राक्षसेश्वरः king of Rakshasas, तथाइति in this way, उक्त्वा having spoken, बलैःसार्थम् along with army, बहुभिः many, परिवारितः generals, नागैः elephants, अश्वैः horses, खरैः donkeys, उष्ट्रैः camels, पताकाध्वचित्रैः banners and pennons, रथैः chariots, संयुक्तः collected, सुसमाहितः collected, समलङ्कृतः decorated, द्रुततरम् armlets and diadems, निर्जगाम went.

text: नागैरश्वैः खरैरुष्ट्रैः संयुक्तः सुसामाहितः । पताकाध्वजचित्रैश्च रथैश्च समलङ्कृतः ॥६-५३-५॥
translation: The king of Rakshasas, being a deceit, having spoken in that way, many generals of the army went accompanied by elephants, horses, camels, and donkeys with chariots decorated with banners and pennons, and diadems collected together.
word_meanings: मायावी deceit, राक्षसेश्वरः king of Rakshasas, तथाइति in this way, उक्त्वा having spoken, बलैःसार्थम् along with army, बहुभिः many, परिवारितः generals, नागैः elephants, अश्वैः horses, खरैः donkeys, उष्ट्रैः camels, पताकाध्वचित्रैः banners and pennons, रथैः chariots, संयुक्तः collected, सुसमाहितः collected, समलङ्कृतः decorated, द्रुततरम् armlets and diadems, निर्जगाम went.

text: ततो विचित्रकेयूरमुकुटैश्च विभूषितः । तनुत्राणि च संरुद्ध्य सधनुर्निर्ययौ द्रुतम् ॥६-५३-६॥
translation: Thereafter adorned with wonderful crowns studded with keyura gems, wearing a co at covering the body with bow in hand went alert.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, विचित्रकेयूरमुकुटेन adorned with wonderful crown studded with keyura gems विभूषितः decorated, तनुत्राणिच co at covering the body, समावृत्य wearing, सधनुः with a bow, द्रुतम् alert, निर्वयौ went forward.

text: पताकालङ्कृतं दीप्तं तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणम् । रथं प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा समारोहच्चमूपतिः ॥६-५३-७॥
translation: The general went ascending the chariot shining with well polished shining gold, decked with flags after going around clockwise.
word_meanings: चमूपतिः general, पताकालङ्कृतम् decorated with flags, दीप्तम् glowing, तप्तकाञ्चनभूषितम् shining in polished gold, रथम् chariot, प्रदक्षिणंकृत्वा going round clockwise, समारोहत् ascended.

text: यष्टिभिस्तोमरैश्चित्रैः शूलैश्च मुसलैरपि । भिन्दिपालैश्च पाशैश्च शक्तिभिः पट्टिशैरपि ॥६-५३-८॥
translation: Armed with swords, many foot soldiers carrying poles, strange clubs, tridents, iron bars, slings and roped to throw spears and spears with sharp edges, swords, battle axes, javelins, and maces, departed.
word_meanings: शस्त्रपाणयः armed with swords, विविधाः many, पदातयश्च foot soldiers, यष्टभिः poles, चित्रैः strange, तोमरैः iron clubs, शूलैश्च tridents, मुसलैरपि iron bars, भिदनिपालैश्च slings used to throw, पाशैश्च ropes, शक्तिभिः spears, पट्टसैरपि spears with sharp edge, खडगैः swords, चक्रैः javelins, गदाभिश्च maces, निशितैः sharp, परश्वधैः battle axes, निर्यान्ति departed.

text: खड्गैश्चक्रैर्गदाभिश्च निशितैश्च परश्वधैः । पदातयश्च निर्यान्ति विविधाः शस्त्रपाणयः । विचित्रवाससः सर्वे दीप्ता राक्षसपुङ्गवाः ॥६-५३-९॥
translation: Armed with swords, many foot soldiers carrying poles, strange clubs, tridents, iron bars, slings and roped to throw spears and spears with sharp edges, swords, battle axes, javelins, and maces, departed.
word_meanings: शस्त्रपाणयः armed with swords, विविधाः many, पदातयश्च foot soldiers, यष्टभिः poles, चित्रैः strange, तोमरैः iron clubs, शूलैश्च tridents, मुसलैरपि iron bars, भिदनिपालैश्च slings used to throw, पाशैश्च ropes, शक्तिभिः spears, पट्टसैरपि spears with sharp edge, खडगैः swords, चक्रैः javelins, गदाभिश्च maces, निशितैः sharp, परश्वधैः battle axes, निर्यान्ति departed.

text: गजा मदोत्कटाः शूराश्चलन्त इव पर्वताः । ते युद्धकुशलै रूढास्तोमराङ्कुशपाणिभिः ॥६-५३-१०॥
अन्ये लक्षणसंयुक्ताः शूरारूढा महाबलाः ॥६-५३-११॥
translation: Carrying tridents, clubs, and goads eager for war the Rakshasas mounted on mahouts and horses of noble characteristics, warriors with extraordinary might departed.
word_meanings: तोमराङ्कुशपाणिभिः carrying tridents and clubs, रूढाः goads, ते they, युद्धकुशलैः eager for war, शूरारूढाः mounted, लक्षणसंयुक्ताः noble characteristics, अन्ये others, महाबलाः extraordinary might.

text: तद्राक्षसबलं घोरं विप्रस्थितमशोभत । प्रावृट्काले यथा मेघा नर्दमानाः सविद्युतः ॥६-५३-१२॥
translation: Then the entire Rakshasa army determined with a purpose roaring like clouds of the rainy season it looked splendid and crossed over the southern gate where Angada was stationed.
word_meanings: विप्रस्थितम् determined with purpose, तत् then, सर्वम् entire, राक्षसबलम् Rakshasa army, प्रावृट् काले rainy season, नर्दमानाः roaring, सविद्युतः in the vicinity, मेघाःयथा like cloud, यथा like that, अशोभत splendid, यत्र there, अङ्गदः Angada, यूथपः army, दक्षिणद्वारात् from southern gate, निःसृता crossing over.

text: निस्सृता दक्षिणद्वारादङ्गदो यत्र यूथपः । तेषां निष्क्रममाणानामशुभं समजायत ॥६-५३-१३॥
आकाशाद्विघनात्तीव्रा उल्काश्चाभ्यपतंस्तदा । वमन्त्यः पावकज्वालाः शिवा घोरं ववाशिरे ॥६-५३-१४॥
translation: As they were leaving evil portents appeared. Dreadful jackals, dazzling fire from the sky and meteors falling appeared.
word_meanings: तेषाम् in that way, निष्क्रममाणानाम् as they were leaving, अशुभम् evil, अजायत portents, विघनात् appeared, तीव्रात् intense, आकाशात् from the sky, तदा then, उल्काश्च meteors, अभ्यपतन् falling, घोराः dreadful, शिवाः jackals, पावकज्वालाः dazzling fire, वमन्तःववाशिरे giving out from the sky.

text: व्याहरन्ति मृगा घोरा रक्षसां निधनं तदा । समापतन्तो योधास्तु प्रास्खलन् भयमोहिताः ॥६-५३-१५॥
translation: Then the fierce animals indicated the death of Rakshasas, who were going deluded with war and fell down.
word_meanings: तदा then, घोराः fierce, मृगाः animals, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, निधनम् indicated, व्याहरन्त destruction, समापतन्तः fell down, योधास्तु in war, तत्र there, दारुणम् dreadful, प्रास्खलन् while going.

text: एतानौत्पातिकान् दृष्ट्वा वज्रदंष्ट्रो महाबलः । धैर्यमालम्ब्य तेजस्वी निर्जगाम रणोत्सुकः ॥६-५३-१६॥
translation: Mighty Vajradamshtra who was energetic, picking up courage seeing the portents that came up, sallied forth eager for war.
word_meanings: महाबलः mighty, तेजस्वी energetic, वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, एतान् , औत्पातिकान् portents that came out, दृष्टवा seeing, धैर्यम् courageous, आलम्भ्य picking up, रणोत्सुकः eager for war, निर्जगाम sallied forth.

text: तांस्तु निष्क्रमतो दृष्ट्वा वानरा जितकाशिनः । प्रणेदुः सुमहानादान् पूरयंश्च दिशो दश ॥६-५३-१७॥
translation: Vanaras who assumed victory, seeing the Rakshasas coming out stretching filled all the ten directions with loud noise.
word_meanings: जितकाशिनः who assumed victory, वानराः Vanaras, निष्क्रमतः coming out, तान् them, दृष्टवा seeing, सुमहानादान् loud noise, प्रणेदुः stretching, दश ten, दिशः directions, पूरयंश्च filled.

text: ततः प्रवृत्तं तुमुलं हरीणां राक्षसैः सह । घोराणां भीमरूपाणामन्योन्यवधकाङ्क्षिणाम् ॥६-५३-१८॥
translation: Then dreadful encounters of fierce form took place between Vanaras and Rakshasas each one trying to kill another.
word_meanings: ततः then, घोराणाम् dreadful, भीमरूपाणाम् fierce form, अन्योन्यवथकाङ् क्षिणाम् each one trying to kill another, हरीणाम् Vanaras, तथा in the same way, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, तुमुलम् intense, प्रवृत्तम् encounter.

text: निष्पतन्तो महोत्साहा भिन्नदेहशिरोधराः । रुधिरोक्षितसर्वाङ्गा न्यपतन् जगतीतले ॥६-५३-१९॥
translation: Proceeding Further, very eager to fight they fell on the ground with their bodies broken, heads severed, and all limbs bathed in blood.
word_meanings: निष्पतन्तः proceeding, महोत्साहाः very eager, भिन्नदेहशिरोधराः bodies broken heads severed, रुधिरोक्षितसर्वाङ्गाः all limbs bathed in blood, धरणीतले on the ground, न्यपतन् fell.

text: केचिदन्योन्यमासाद्य शूराः परिघपाणयः । चिक्षिपुर्विविधं शस्त्रं समरेष्वनिवर्तिनः ॥६-५३-२०॥
translation: Heroes in war whose hand s were like iron clubs, who never turned back in war, indeed flung weapons of many kinds on one another.
word_meanings: परिघपाणयः whose hand s resembled iron clubs, शूराः heroes, समरेषु in war, अनिवर्तिनः who never turned back, केचित् indeed, अन्योन्यम् one another, आसाद्य, विविधं many kinds, शस्त्रम् weapons, चिक्षिपुः flung.

text: द्रुमाणां च शिलानां च शस्त्राणां चापि निस्वनः । श्रूयते सुमहांस्तत्र घोरो हृदयभेदनः ॥६-५३-२१॥
translation: There, a very loud fearful noise was heard which pierced the hearts in the battlefield, that was produced by the striking of weapons with trees and rocks.
word_meanings: तत्र there, द्रुमाणांशिलानांच trees and rocks, शस्त्राणांच weapons also, घोरः fierce, हृदयभेदसः pierced hearts, सुमहान् loud, निःस्वनः in the battlefield, श्रूयते heard.

text: रथनेमिस्वनस्तत्र धनुषश्चापि निस्वनः । शङ्खभेरीमृदङ्गानां बभूव तुमुलः स्वनः ॥६-५३-२२॥
translation: Then came out tumultuous sounds of clutter of chariots, bows, conches, kettle drums and tom toms.
word_meanings: तत्र there, निस्वसत् came out, रथनेमिस्वनः clutter of chariots, धनुषश्चापि and bows, शङ्खभेरीमृदङ्गानाम् conch, and kettle drums, and tom toms तुमुलः tumultuous, स्वनः sound, बभूव heard.

text: केचिदस्त्राणि संसृज्य बाहुयुद्धमकुर्वत ॥६-५३-२३॥
translation: Indeed, abandoning the weapons, the Vanaras fought with their palms, fists, feet, trees, and knees and smashed the Rakshasas crushing their bodies like rocks.
word_meanings: केचित् indeed, अस्त्राणि weapons, सन्सृज्य abandoning, युद्धम् battle, अकुर्वत not did, तलैश्च palms, चरणैश्चापि feet, मुष्टिभिश्च fists, द्रुमैरपि trees, जानुभिश्च knees, युद्धदुर्मदैः, वानरैः Vanaras, हताः smashed, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, भिन्नदेहाः broken bodies, केचित् indeed, शिलाभिः rocks, चूर्णिताः crushed.

text: तलैश्च चरणैश्चापि मुष्टिभिश्च द्रुमैरपि । जानुभिश्च हताः केचिद्भिन्नदेहाश्च राक्षसाः । शिलाभिश्चूर्णिताः केचिद्वानरैर्युद्धदुर्मदैः ॥६-५३-२४॥
translation: Indeed, abandoning the weapons, the Vanaras fought with their palms, fists, feet, trees, and knees and smashed the Rakshasas crushing their bodies like rocks.
word_meanings: केचित् indeed, अस्त्राणि weapons, सन्सृज्य abandoning, युद्धम् battle, अकुर्वत not did, तलैश्च palms, चरणैश्चापि feet, मुष्टिभिश्च fists, द्रुमैरपि trees, जानुभिश्च knees, युद्धदुर्मदैः, वानरैः Vanaras, हताः smashed, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, भिन्नदेहाः broken bodies, केचित् indeed, शिलाभिः rocks, चूर्णिताः crushed.

text: वज्रदंष्ट्रो भृशं बाणै रणे वित्रासयन् हरीन् । चचार लोकसंहारे पाशहस्त इवान्तकः ॥६-५३-२५॥
translation: Vajradamshtra went about in the battle striking Vanaras just like death goes with a noose for destruction of the world.
word_meanings: वज्रदंष्ट्रैः Vajradamshtra, रणे in battle, बाणैः with arrows, हरीन् at Vanaras, भृशम् striking, वित्रासयन् destruction, लोकसंहारे destruction of the world, पाशहस्तः with noose in hand, अन्तकःइव like god of death, चचार went about.

text: बलवन्तो ऽस्त्रविदुषो नानाप्रहरणा रणे । जघ्नुर्वानरसैन्यानि राक्षसाः क्रोधमूर्च्छिताः ॥६-५३-२६॥
translation: Mighty Vajradamshtra, who was endowed with the skill of using every kind of weapon, deluded with anger, went after the Vanara army.
word_meanings: बलवन्तः mighty, अस्त्रविदुषः endowed with skill of weapons, नानाप्रहरणाः of every kind, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, क्रोधमूर्छिताः deluded with anger, रणे in war, वानरसैन्यानि at the Vanara army, जघ्नुः went.

text: निघ्नुतो राक्षसान् दृष्ट्वा सर्वान् वालिसुतो रणे । क्रोधेन द्विगुणाविष्टः संवर्तक इवानलः ॥६-५३-२७॥
translation: Seeing the Vanaras being destroyed, Vali's son, Angada with redoubled anger, like fire at the time of universal destruction, started to exterminate Rakshasas.
word_meanings: दृष्टवाः seeing, वालिसुतः Vali's son, क्रोधेन enraged, द्विगुणाविष्टः redoubled, संवर्तके at the time of universal destruction, अनलःइव like fire, रणे in war, तान् them, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, निघ्नतः exterminate.

text: तान् राक्षसगणान् सर्वान् वृक्षमुद्यम्य वीर्यवान् । अङ्गदः क्रोधताम्राक्षः सिंहः क्षुद्रमृगानिव । चकार कदनं घोरं शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः ॥६-५३-२८॥
translation: Heroic Angada, equal to Indra in prowess, enraged, eyes turned red in anger, seizing a tree made a fierce fight with Rakshasa army like a lion with small animals.
word_meanings: वीर्यवान् heroic, अङ्गदः Angada, क्रोथताम्राक्षः eyes turned red in anger, वृक्षम् tree, उद्यम्य seizing, सिंहः like lion, क्षुद्रमृगानिव like a lion with small animals, सर्वान् all, तान् of them, राक्षसगणान् Rakshasa army, शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः equal to Indra in prowess, घोरम् fierce, कदनम् fierce fight, चकार made.

text: अङ्गदाभिहतास्तत्र राक्षसा भीमविक्रमाः । विभिन्नशिरसः पेतुर्विकृत्ता इव पादपाः िव ॥६-५३-२९॥
translation: There, struck by Angada of fearful valour, the Rakshasas fell like trees smashed and heads broken.
word_meanings: तत्र there, अङ्गदाभिहताः struck by Angada, भीमविक्रमाः of fearful valour, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, विभिन्नशिरसः with broken heads, विकृताः smashed, पादपाःइव like trees, पेतुः fell.

text: रथैरश्वैर्ध्वजैश्चित्रैः शरीरैर्हरिरक्षसाम् । रुधिरेण च सञ्छन्ना भूमिर्भयकरी तदा ॥६-५३-३०॥
translation: Then the wonderful chariots, flags, horses, Vanaras and Rakshasas bodies bathed in blood fell on the ground looked fearful.
word_meanings: तदा then, रथैः chariots, चित्रैः wonderful, ध्वजैः flags, अश्वैः horses, हरिरक्षसाम् Vanaras and Rakshasas, शरीरैः bodies, रुधिरेण in blood, सञ्छन्ना bathed, भूमिः ground, भयकरा fearful to look.

text: हारकेयूरवस्त्रैश्च शस्त्रैश्च समलङ्कृता । भूमिर्भाति रणे तत्र शारदीव यथा निशा ॥६-५३-३१॥
translation: The battlefield with strewn armlets, necklaces and clothes, weapons looked like autumnal night decorated all over.
word_meanings: हारकेयूरवस्त्रश्च with strewn armlets, necklaces, clothes, शत्रैश्च weapons, तत्र there, रणे in the battlefield, समलङ्कृता decorated all over, भूमिः ground, शारदी night, निशेवयथा like autumnal night, भाति shone.

text: अङ्गदस्य च वेगेन तद्राक्षसबलं महत् । प्राकम्पत तदा तत्र पवनेनाम्बुदो यथा ॥६-५३-३२॥
बलस्य च निघातेन अङ्गदस्य जयेन च । राक्षसः क्रोधमाविष्टो वज्रदंष्ट्रो महाबलः ॥६-५४-१॥
translation: Vajradamshtra, the mighty Rakshasa became enraged with the destruction of his army and victory of Angada.
word_meanings: महाबलः mighty, राक्षसः Rakshasa, वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, बलस्य army, विघातेन destruction, अङ्गदस्य Angada's, जयेनच victory, क्रोधम् enraged, अविष्टः became

text: स विस्फार्य धनुर्घोरं शक्राशनिसमस्वनम् । वानराणामनीकानि प्राकिरच्छरवृष्टिभिः ॥६-५४-२॥
translation: Stretching his terrific bow which had the splendour of Indra's bow he (Vajradamshtra) showered shafts at the army troops of Vanaras and assailed them.
word_meanings: शक्राशनिसमप्रभम् had the splendour of Indra's thunderbolt, घोरम् terrific, धनुः bow, विस्फार्यः stretching, वानराणाम् at Vanaras, अनीकानि army troops, शरवृष्टिभिः showers of shafts, प्राकिरत् assailed.

text: राक्षसाश्चापि मुख्यास्ते रथेषु समवस्थिताः । नानाप्रहरणाः शूराः प्रायुद्ध्यन्त तदा रणे ॥६-५४-३॥
translation: Seated firmly on the chariots the chiefs and heroes of Rakshasas also fought steadily with different weapons in the combat.
word_meanings: रथेषु at chariots, समवस्थिताः seated, मुख्याः chief, ते they, शूराः heroes, राक्षसाश्चापि Rakshasas also, नानाप्रहरणाः different weapons, तदा then, रणे in the combat, प्रायुध्यन्त fought steadily.

text: वानराणां तु शूरा ये सर्वे ते प्लवगर्षभाः । आयुद्ध्यन्त शिलाहस्ताः समवेताः समन्ततः ॥६-५४-४॥
translation: The best of Vanara warriors also gathered together with rocks in hand contended.
word_meanings: वानराणाम् Vanaras, शूराः warriors, येसर्वे all, तेप्लवगोत्तमाः best of Vanaras, समनत्तः together, समवेताः gathered, शिलाहस्ताः with rocks in hand, अयुद्यन्त contended.

text: तत्रायुधसहस्राणि तस्मिन्नायोधने भृशम् । राक्षसाः कपिमुख्येषु पातयाञ्चक्रिरे तदा ॥६-५४-५॥
translation: Then in that battle the Rakshasas went on hurling thousands of missiles at the chiefs of Vanaras.
word_meanings: तदा then, तत्र there, तस्मिन् in that, अयोधने battle, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, कपिमुख्येषु with chiefs of Vanaras, आयुधसहस्राणि thousands of missiles, भृशम् instantly, पातयांचक्रिरे went hurling.

text: वानराश्चापि रक्षस्सु गिरीन् वृक्षान् महाशिलाः । प्रवीराः पातयामासुर्मत्तवारणसन्निभाः ॥६-५४-६॥
translation: Heroic Vanaras who resembled elephants in rut showered mountains and trees and huge rocks at Rakshasas.
word_meanings: प्रवीराः heroic, मत्तमातङ्गसन्निभाः who resembled elephants in rut, वानराश्चैव Vanaras also, रक्षःसु at Rakshasas, गिरिवृक्षान् mountains and trees, महाशिलाः huge rocks, पातयामासुः showered.

text: शूराणां युद्ध्यमानानां समरेष्वनिवर्तिनाम् । तद्राक्षसगणानां च सुयुद्धं समवर्तत ॥६-५४-७॥
translation: Between the heroes fighting the battle, who never returned, Great War continued between Rakshasas troops and Vanaras.
word_meanings: शूराणाम् between heroes, युद्यमानाम् fighting, समरेषु battle, अनिवर्तिनाम् never returned, राक्षसगणानाम् Rakshasa troops, तत् then, सुयुद्धम् great struggle, समवर्तत happened.

text: प्रभिन्नशिरसः केचिद्भिन्नैः पादैश्च बाहुभिः । शस्त्रैरर्पितदेहास्तु रुधिरेण समुक्षिताः ॥६-५४-८॥
translation: There lay strewn some monkeys and Rakshasas also with severed heads, broken feet, with many weapons mangled with bodies, bathed in blood, arms and feet looped to necks devolving as prey to buzzards, vultures and crows surrounded.
word_meanings: केचित् some, हरयः monkeys, राक्षसाश्चैव Rakshasas also, प्रभिन्नशिरसः heads severed, छिन्नैः broken, पादैः feet, बाहुभिः many, शस्त्रै weapons:, आर्दितदेहाः bodies mangled, रुधिरेण in blood, समुक्षिताः bathed in blood, कङ्कगृध्रावळैराढ्याश्च arms and feet looped over neck, गोमायुगलसङ्कुलाः as prey to buzzards, vultures and crows, गाम् devolving, समाश्रिताः surrounded by, शेरते lay strewn.

text: हरयो राक्षसाश्चैव शेरते गां समाश्रिताः । कङ्कगृध्रवलैराढ्या गोमायुगणसङ्कुलाः ॥६-५४-९॥
translation: There lay strewn some monkeys and Rakshasas also with severed heads, broken feet, with many weapons mangled with bodies, bathed in blood, arms and feet looped to necks devolving as prey to buzzards, vultures and crows surrounded.
word_meanings: केचित् some, हरयः monkeys, राक्षसाश्चैव Rakshasas also, प्रभिन्नशिरसः heads severed, छिन्नैः broken, पादैः feet, बाहुभिः many, शस्त्रै weapons:, आर्दितदेहाः bodies mangled, रुधिरेण in blood, समुक्षिताः bathed in blood, कङ्कगृध्रावळैराढ्याश्च arms and feet looped over neck, गोमायुगलसङ्कुलाः as prey to buzzards, vultures and crows, गाम् devolving, समाश्रिताः surrounded by, शेरते lay strewn.

text: कबन्धानि समुत्पेतुर्भीरुणां भीषणानि वै ॥६-५४-१०॥
भुजपाणिशिरश्छिन्नाश्छिन्नकायाश्च भूतले । वानरा राक्षसाश्चापि निपेतुस्तत्र वै रणे ॥६-५४-११॥
translation: Then in the battlefield, the timid vanaras and even rakshasas with their arms and heads cut off, bodies wounded allover dropped down.
word_meanings: भीरूणाम् timid ones, भीषणानि headless trunks, कबन्धानि arms, भूतले on the ground, समुत्पेतुः gathered, भुजपाणिशिरछशिन्नाः with arms heads and hand s severed, छिन्नकायाश्च whose trunks were cut off, वानराः Vanara, राक्षसाश्चापि even Rakshasas, तत्र there, वैरणे in the battlefield, निपेतुः lay.

text: ततो वानरसैन्येन हन्यमानं निशाचरम् । प्राभज्यत बलं सर्वं वज्रदंष्ट्रस्य पश्यतः ॥६-५४-१२॥
translation: Thereafter Rakshasas were killed by Vanaras as Vajradamshtra kept looking at them and the Rakshasas ran from there.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, निशाचरम् night rangers, सर्वंबलम् all army, वानरसैन्येन Vanara troops, हन्यमानम् killed, वज्रदंष्ट्रस्य Vajradamshtra's, पश्यतः stood looking, प्राभज्यत ran helterskelter.

text: राक्षसान् भयवित्रस्तान् हन्यमानान् प्लवङ्गमैः । दृष्ट्वा स रोषताम्राक्षो वज्रदंष्ट्रः प्रतापवान् ॥६-५४-१३॥
translation: Struck by monkeys the Rakshasas were in fear. Seeing the Rakshasas Vajraddamshtra's eyes turned red in anger with bow in hand penetrating the Vanara troops terrifying them.
word_meanings: प्लवङ्गमैः monkeys, हन्यमानान् struck by, भयवित्रस्तान् stricken with fear, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, दृष्टवा seeing, प्रतापवान् valiant, सः he, वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, रोषताम्राक्षः eyes turned red in anger, धनुष्पाणिः bow in hand, हरिवाहिनीम् Vanara troops, त्रासयन् terrifying, प्रविवेश penetrated.

text: प्रविवेश धनुष्पाणिस्त्रासयन् हरिवाहिनीम् । शरैर्विदारयामास कङ्कपत्रैरजिह्मगैः ॥६-५४-१४॥
बिभेद वानरांस्तत्र सप्ताष्टौ नव पञ्च च । विव्याध परमक्रुद्धो वज्रदंष्ट्रः प्रतापवान् ॥६-५४-१५॥
translation: Valiant Vajradamshtra became very furious and pierced with arrows of plumes of buzzard which never missed target in seven, eight, nine and five Vanaras at a time.
word_meanings: प्रतापवान् valiant one, वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, परमक्रुद्धः very furious, कङ्कपत्रैः plumes of buzzard, अजिह्मगैः which never missed the target, शरैः arrows, तत्र there, सप्त seven, अष्टौ eight, नव nine, पञ्चच five also, वानरान् Vanaras, विव्याध struck them, विदारयामास pierced.

text: त्रस्ताः सर्वे हरिगणाः शरैः सङ्कृत्तकन्धराः । अङ्गदं सम्प्रधावन्ति प्रजापतिमिव प्रजाः ॥६-५४-१६॥
translation: Struck with fear the Vanaras sought the protection of Angada just as people seek protection of Brahma, the creator of beings.
word_meanings: शरैः arrows, सङ्कृत्तकन्दरा: broken necks, सर्वे all, हरिगणाः Vanaras, त्रस्ताः out of fear, प्रजाः people, प्रजापतिमिव like creator Brahma, अङ्गदम् Angada, सम्प्रधावन्त sought protection.

text: ततो हरिगणान् भग्नान् दृष्ट्वा वालिसुतस्तदा । क्रोधेन वज्रदंष्ट्रं तमुदीक्षन्तमुदैक्षत ॥६-५४-१७॥
translation: Then the son of Vali gazing at the broken monkeys looking at Vajradamshtra in anger, faced himself.
word_meanings: तदा then, वालिसुतः Vali's son, भग्नान् broken, हरिगणान् monkeys, दृष्टवा gazing, ततः then, उदीक्षन्तम् looking at them, वज्रदंष्ट्रम् Vajradamshtra, क्रोधेन in anger, उदैक्षत faced himself.

text: वज्रदंष्ट्रो ऽङ्गदश्चोभौ सङ्गतौ हरिराक्षसौ । चेरतुः परमक्रुद्धौ हरिमत्तगजाविव ॥६-५४-१८॥
translation: Vajradamshtra and Angada both enraged and strode among Rakshasas and monkeys and fought like a lion and intoxicated elephant.
word_meanings: वज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, अङ्गदश्च Angada's, उभौ both, हरिराक्षसौ monkeys and Rakshasas, सङ्गतौ strode, हरिमत्तगजामिव like lion and elephant in rut, परमक्रुद्धौ enraged, चेरतुः fought.

text: ततः शरसहस्रेण वालिपुत्रं महाबलः । जघान मर्मदेशेषु मातङ्गमिव तोमरैः ॥६-५४-१९॥
translation: Then Angada endowed with great strength, pierced Vajradamshtra in his private parts with clubs used for piercing elephants.
word_meanings: ततः then, महाबलः endowed with great strength, हरिपुत्रम् monkey 's son, शतसहस्रेण hundred thousand, मातङ्गमिवतोमरैः like an elephants is pierced with clubs, मर्मदेशेषु private parts, जघान pierced.

text: रुधिरोक्षितसर्वाङ्गो वालिसूनुर्महाबलः । चिक्षेप वज्रदंष्ट्राय वृक्षं भीमपराक्रमः ॥६-५४-२०॥
translation: Angada who was endowed with great strength all his limbs bathed in blood and terrific valour took hold of a huge tree and shattered Vajradamshtra.
word_meanings: रुधिरोक्षितसर्वाङ्गः all limbs bathed in blood, महाबलः mighty, भीमपराक्रमः of terrific valour, वालिसूनुः Vali's son, वज्रदंष्ट्राय at Vajradamshtra, वृक्षम् tree, चिक्षेप shattered.

text: दृष्ट्वा ऽ ऽपतन्तं तं वृक्षमसम्भ्रान्तश्च राक्षसः । चिच्छेद बहुधा सो ऽपि निकृत्तः पतितो भुवि ॥६-५४-२१॥
translation: That Rakshasa (Vajradamshtra) seeing the tree coming towards him was not bewildered. He shattered it into pieces, and it fell on the ground.
word_meanings: राक्षसः Rakshasa, अपतन्तम् hurled, तंवृक्षम् that tree, दृष्टवा seeing, असम्भ्रान्तः not bewildered, बहुधा many, चिच्छेद pieces broken to, सोऽपि completed, मथितः shaken, भुवि ground, प्रापतत् fell.

text: तं दृष्ट्वा वज्रदंष्ट्रस्य विक्रमं प्लवगर्षभः । प्रगृह्य विपुलं शैलं चिक्षेप च ननाद च ॥६-५४-२२॥
translation: The bull among monkeys, Angada seeing the valour of Vajradamshtra seizing a huge hillock hurled at the Rakshasa making loud sounds and breaking.
word_meanings: प्लवगर्षभः bull of monkeys, वज्रदंष्ट्रस्य Vajradamshtra's, तंविक्रमम् that valour, दृष्टवा seeing, विपुलम् vast, शैलम् hillock, प्रगृह्य seizing, चिक्षेपच broken, ननादच making loud sound.

text: समापतन्तं तं दृष्ट्वा रथादाप्लुत्य वीर्यवान् । गदापाणिरसम्भ्रान्तः पृथिव्यां समतिष्ठत ॥६-५४-२३॥
translation: The valiant Rakshasa who was not perplexed with mace in hand leaping down the chariot looking (at the hillock hurled) sat on the ground.
word_meanings: वीर्यवान् valiant one, सः he, अपतन्तम् , तम् them, दृष्टवा looking, असम्भ्रान्तः not perplexed, गदापाणिः mace in hand, रथात् from chariot, आप्लुत्य leaping, पृथिव्याम् on ground, समतिष्ठत sat.

text: सा ऽङ्गदेन गदा ऽ ऽक्षिप्ता गत्वा तु रणमूर्धनि ॥६-५४-२४॥
सचक्रकूबरं साश्वं प्रममाथ रथं तदा ॥६-५४-२५॥
translation: The hillock discharged by Angada went right in the forefront of the battle and shattered the chariot along with its wheels and pole.
word_meanings: स he, आङ्गदेव by Angada, क्षिप्ता discharged, शिला hillock, गत्वा went, रणमूर्धनि forefront of the battle, तदा then, सचक्रकूबरम् the wheels and pole, साश्वम् totally, रथम् chariot, प्रममाथ shattered.

text: ततो ऽन्यं गिरिमाक्षिप्य विपुलं द्रुमभूषितम् । वज्रदंष्ट्रस्य शिरसि पातयामास सो ऽङ्गदः ॥६-५४-२६॥
translation: Then Angada seized a huge hillock adorned with trees hurled at Vajradamshtra.
word_meanings: ततः then, सः he, अङ्गदः Angada, द्रुमभाषितम् adorned with trees, विपुलम् huge, अन्यत् other, शिखरम् peak, गृह्य seizing, वज्रदंष्ट्रस्य on Vajradamshtra, शिरसि head, पातयामास hurled.

text: अभवच्छोणितोद्गारी वज्रदंष्ट्रः स मूर्च्छितः । मुहूर्तमभवन्मूढो गदामालिङ्ग्य निःश्वसन् ॥६-५४-२७॥
translation: Vajradamshtra vomiting blood became unconscious and clasping his mace breathing heavily he remained senseless for a while.
word_meanings: सःवज्रदंष्ट्रः Vajradamshtra, शोणितोद्गारी vomiting blood, मूर्छितः unconscious, अभवत् became, गदाम् mace, आलिङ् ग्य clasping, निश्श्वसन् breathing heavily, मुहूर्तम् for a while, मूढः senseless, अभवत् remained.

text: स लब्धसञ्ज्ञो गदया वालिपुत्रमवस्थितम् । जघान परमक्रुद्धो वक्षोदेशे निशाचरः । गदां त्यक्त्वा ततस्तत्र मुष्टियुद्धमवर्तत ॥६-५४-२८॥
translation: The night ranger regained his senses, extremely angry, stood firmly and attacked Angada, son of Vali on his chest with his mace.
word_meanings: संलब्दसंज्ञः regaining senses, निशाचरः night ranger, परमक्रुद्धः extremely angry, अवस्थितम् stood firmly, वालिपुत्रम् Vali's son, वक्षोदेशे direction of the chest, गदया with mace, जघान attacked.

text: अन्योन्यं जघ्नतुस्तत्र तावुभौ हरिराक्षसौ । रुधिरोद्गारिणो तौ तु प्रहरैर्जनितश्रमौ । बभूवतुः सुविक्रान्तावङ्गारकबुधाविव ॥६-५४-२९॥
translation: Exhausted by strain both very valiant fought like planets Angaraka and Budha and spit out blood.
word_meanings: प्रहारैः exhausted, जनितश्रमौ out of strain, रुधिरोद्गारिणौ spit out blood, तौ both, सुविक्रान्तौ very valiant, अङ्गारकबुधाविव like planets Angaraka and Budha (Mars and Mercury), बभूवतुः remained.

text: ततः परमतेजस्वी अङ्गदः कपिकुञ्जरः । उत्पाट्य वृक्षं स्थितवान् बहुपुष्पफलाञ्चितम् ॥६-५४-३०॥
translation: Then highly energetic, bull among Vanaras, Angada, uprooting a tree full of many flowers and fruits stood there.
word_meanings: ततः then, परमतेजस्वी highly energetic, प्लवगर्षभः bull among monkeys, अङ्गदः Angada, बहुपुष्प many flowers, फलाञ्चितम् and fruits, वृक्षम् trees, उत्पाट्य uprooted, स्थितवान् standing.

text: जग्राह चार्षभं चर्म खड्गं च विपुलं शुभम् । किङ्किणीजालसञ्छन्नं चर्मणा च परिष्कृतम् ॥६-५४-३१॥
translation: (The Rakshasa seized) a huge bright sword, a shield decorated with tiny bells and sword encased in hide sheath.
word_meanings: विपुलम् huge, शुभम् bright, किङ्किणीजालसञ्छन्नम् shield made of bull hide decorated with tiny bells, आर्षभंचर्म made with hide, चर्मणा hide, परिष्कृतम् encased, खडगंच sword also, जग्राह held.

text: विचित्रांश्चेरतुर्मार्गान् रुषितौ कपिराक्षसौ । जघ्नतुश्च तदा ऽन्योन्यं निर्दयं जयकाङ्क्षिणौ ॥६-५४-३२॥
translation: Then desiring victory both monkey and Rakshasa struck one another passionately in wonderful harsh ways.
word_meanings: तदा then, जयकाङ् क्षिणौ desiring victory, कपिराक्षसौ monkey and Rakshasa, निर्दयम् passionately, चित्रान् wonderful, मार्गान् ways, चेरतुः struck, अन्योन्यम् one another, जघ्नतुश्च harshly.

text: व्रणैः सास्त्रैरशोभेतां पुष्पिताविव किंशुकौ । युद्ध्यमानौ परिश्रान्तौ जानुभ्यामवनीं गतौ ॥६-५४-३३॥
translation: Their wounds streaming blood, exhausted in the battlefield, when they rested on their knees on the ground, they were like charming Kimsuka blossoms.
word_meanings: सास्त्रै: streaming, व्रणैः wounds, पुष्पितौ blossomed, किंशुकाविव Kimsuka like, शोभेताम् charming, युध्यमानौ in the battlefield, परिश्रान्तौ exhausted, जानुभ्याम् knees, अवनीम् on the ground, गतौ sat.

text: निमेषान्तरमात्रेण अङ्गदः कपिकुञ्जरः । उदतिष्ठत दीप्ताक्षो दण्डाहत इवोरगः ॥६-५४-३४॥
translation: Angada, the elephant among the monkeys rose up in the mere twinkling of eyes, like a serpent struck by staff glowing in his eyes.
word_meanings: कपिकुञ्जरः elephant among the monkeys, अङ्गदः Angada, निमेषान्तरमात्रेण time of twinkling of the eyes दीप्ताक्षः eyes glowing, दण्डाहतः struck by staff, उरगःइव serpent like, उदतिष्ठत rose up.

text: निर्मलेन सुधौतेन खड्गेनास्य महच्छिरः । जघान वज्रदंष्ट्रस्य वालिसूनुर्महाबलः ॥६-५४-३५॥
translation: Mighty son of Vali lopped off the great head of Vajradamshtra's with a sharpened stainless sword.
word_meanings: महाबलः mighty, वालिसूनुः Val['s son, सुधौतेन sharpened well, निर्मलेन stainless, खडगेन sword, अस्यवज्रदंष्ट्रस्य that Vajradamshtra's, महत् great, शिरः head, जघान lopped off.

text: रुधिरोक्षितगात्रस्य बभूव पतितं द्विधा । सरोषपरिवृत्ताक्षं शुभं खड्गहतं शिरः ॥६-५४-३६॥
translation: His (Vajradamshtra's) limbs bathed in blood, cut off by sword, eyeballs rolling cleft into two dropped down.
word_meanings: रुधिरोक्षितगात्रस्य limbs bathed in blood, तस्य his, तत् that, शुभम् decorated, शिरः head, खडगहतम् destroyed by sword, सरोषपरिवृत्ताक्षम् eyeballs rolling, द्विधा cleft into two, पतितम् dropped, बभूव remained.

text: वज्रदंष्ट्रं हतं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसा भयमोहिताः । त्रस्ताः प्रत्यपतन् लङ्कां वध्यमानाः प्लवङ्गमै । विषण्णवदना दीना ह्रिया किञ्चिदवाङ्मुखाः ॥६-५४-३७॥
translation: Deluded with fear, the Rakshasas seeing Vajradamshtra killed by monkeys, panic stricken, heads bent in shame, faces woebegone fled to Lanka.
word_meanings: राक्षसाः Rakshasa, वज्रदंष्ट्रम् Vajradamshtra, हतम् killed, दृष्टवा seeing, भयमोहिताः deluded in fear, प्लवङ्गमैः monkeys, वध्यमानाः struck by monkeys, विषण्णवदनाः panic stricken, ह्रिया in shame, किञ्चित् heads bent, अवाङ्मुखाः faces, woebegone, लङ्काम् Lanka, अभ्यद्रवन् fled.

text: निहत्य तं वज्रधरप्रभावः स वालिसूनुः कपिसैन्यमध्ये । जगाम हर्षं महितो महाबलः सहस्रनेत्रस्त्रिदशैरिवावृतः ॥६-५४-३८॥
translation: Mighty son of Vali, having killed Vajradamshtra, honoured in the midst of great Vanara army was joyful surrounded like the thousand eyed Indra, the Lord of gods. ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेचतुःपञ्चाशस्सर्गः This is the end of the fifty fourth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: वज्रधरप्रतापवान् equal to Indra in his valour, महाबलः mighty, सःवालिसूनुः that son of Vali, तम् them, निहत्य having killed, कपिसैन्यमध्ये in the midst of Vanara army, महितः great, त्रिदशैः Indra Lord of gods, आवृतः surrounded, सहस्रनेत्रःइव like thousand eyed, हर्षम् joy, जगाम became.

text: वज्रदंष्ट्रं हतं श्रुत्वा वालिपुत्रेण रावणः । बलाध्यक्षमुवाचेदं कृताञ्जलिमवस्थितम् ॥६-५५-१॥
translation: On hearing about Vajradamshtra being killed by Vali's son, Ravana spoke to the chief of the army who stood with folded hands.
word_meanings: रावणः Ravana, वज्रदंष्ट्रम् Vajradamshtra, वालिपुत्रेण by Vali's son, हतम् killed, श्रुत्वा hearing, उपस्थितम् stood, कृताञ्जलिम् with folded hand s, बलाध्यक्षम् chief of army, इदम् this, उवाच spoke.

text: शीघ्रं निर्यान्तु दुर्धर्षा राक्षसा भीमविक्रमाः । अकम्पनं पुरस्कृत्य सर्वशस्त्रप्रकोविदम् ॥६-५५-२॥
translation: "Send for Akampana quickly, who is of terrific valour, difficult to encounter and skilled in all sastras."
word_meanings: भीमविक्रमाः of terrific valour, दुर्धर्षाः difficult to encounter, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, सर्वशस्त्रप्रकोविदम् skilled in all sastras, अकम्पनम् Akampana, पुरस्कृत्य send for, शीघ्रम् quickly, निर्यान्तु assign.

text: एष शास्ता च गोप्ता च नेता च युधि सम्मतः । भूतिकामश्च मे नित्यं नित्यं च समरप्रियः ॥६-५५-३॥
translation: Akampana is a tamer of foes, protector of people, in that way capable, always desirous of welfare, lover of war.
word_meanings: युधि in war, शास्ता tamer of foes, गोप्ताच protector of his people, नेताच, एषः in that way, सत्तमः capable, नित्यम् always, मे my, भूतिकामश्च desirous of welfare, नित्यम् ever, समरप्रियः lover of war.

text: एष जेष्यति काकुत्स्थौ सुग्रीवं च महाबलम् । वानरांश्चापरान् घोरान् हनिष्यति परन्तपः ॥६-५५-४॥
translation: "Scorcher of enemies, this Akampana will win Sugriva of terrific might, Rama and Lakshmana, dreadful Vanaras, and put an end to enemies."
word_meanings: एष in that way, जेष्यति scorcher, काकत्स्थौ Rama and Lakshmana, सुग्रीवंच and Sugriva, महाबलः of mighty prowess, वानरांश्चा Vanaras, परान् घोरान् very dreadful, हनिष्यति will put an end, परन्तपः scorcher of enemies.

text: परिगृह्य स तामाज्ञां रावणस्य महाबलः । बलं सन्त्वरयामास तदा लघुपराक्रमः ॥६-५५-५॥
translation: Then accepting Ravana's order, accordingly, taking hold of the army dispatched them.
word_meanings: लघुपराक्रमः extraordinary valiance,, सः, रावणस्य that Ravana 's, ताम् them, आज्ञाम् order, परिगृह्य taking hold, तदा then, बलम् army, म्प्रेरयामास dispatched.

text: ततो नानाप्रहरणा भीमाक्षा भीमदर्शनाः । निष्पेतू रक्षसां मुख्या बलाध्यक्षप्रचोदिताः ॥६-५५-६॥
translation: Thereafter taking different weapons, Rakshasas of fearful eyes and terrific appearance rushed forward ordered by CommanderinChief of the army.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, नानाप्रहरणाः different weapons, भीमाक्षाः of fearful eyes, भीमदर्शनाः terrific appearance, मुख्याः commander, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, बलाध्यक्षप्रचोदिताः CommanderinChief of army, निष्पेतुः rushed forward.

text: रथमास्थाय विपुलं तप्तकाञ्चनकुण्डलः । मेघाभो मेघवर्णश्च मेघस्वनमहास्वनः । राक्षसैः संवृतो भीमैस्तदा निर्यात्यकम्पनः ॥६-५५-७॥
translation: Mounted on a huge chariot, Akampana, decked in pure gold jewels, like cloud in form and complexion, whose loud voice resembled thunder, surrounded by Rakshasas went forward.
word_meanings: तदा then, मेघाभः like cloud, मेघवर्णश्च of cloud complexion, मेघस्वनमहास्वनः whose loud voice resembled thunder, अकम्पनः Akampana, तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणम् decked in polished gold jewels, विपुलम् huge, रथम् chariot, आस्थाय seated, घोरैः terrific, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, सम्वृतः surrounded, निर्याति went.

text: न हि कम्पयितुं शक्यः सुरैरपि महामृधे । अकम्पनस्ततस्तेषामादित्य इव तेजसा ॥६-५५-८॥
translation: Akampana who, possibly could not be shaken in war by suras shone like the sun in that manner.
word_meanings: अकम्पनः Akampana, महामृधे in great war, सुरैरपि even for Suras, कम्पयितुम् could not be shaken, नशक्यःहि not possible, ततः then, तेषाम् in that manner, तेजसा brilliant, आदित्यःइव like Sun.

text: तस्य निर्धावमानस्य संरब्धस्य युयत्सया । अकस्माद्दैन्यमागच्छद्धयानां रथवाहिनाम् ॥६-५५-९॥
translation: As Akampana was going forth excited to wage war, an expression of desperation developed suddenly in the horses drawing the chariots and an experience of depression in him.
word_meanings: तस्य his, युयुत्सया excited, सम्रब्दस्य to wage war, निर्धानमानस्य experienced depression, अकस्मात् suddenly, रथवाहिनाम् dr awing the chariots, हयानाम् horses, दैन्यम् feeling of desperation, अगच्छत् developed

text: व्यस्फुरन्नयनं चास्य सव्यं युद्धाभिनन्दिनः । विवर्णो मुखवर्णश्च गद्गदश्चाभवत् स्वनः ॥६-५५-१०॥
translation: Himself being a lover of war, became pale with his countenance changed, voice choked, and his eyes lost its lustre.
word_meanings: युद्धाभिनन्दनः lover of war, अस्य his, सव्यम् his own, नयनम् eyes, व्यस्फुरत् lustre, मुखवर्णश्च facial colour, विवर्णः pale, स्वनः voice, गद्गदः choked, अभवत् became.

text: अभवत् सुदिने चापि दुर्दिनं रूक्षमारुतम् । ऊचुः खगा मृगाः सर्वे वाचः क्रूरा भयावहाः ॥६-५५-११॥
translation: At a time on a good day of fine weather, it became cloudy, birds and beasts were making frightening cries all over.
word_meanings: सुदिने good day, काले at a time, रूक्षमारुतम् fine wea the r, दुर्दिनम् cloudy, अभवत् became, सर्वे all over, खगमृगाः birds and beasts, क्रूराः cruel, भयावहाः frightening, वाचः words, ऊचुः cries.

text: स सिंहोपचितस्कन्धः शार्दूलसमविक्रमः । तानुत्पातानचिन्त्यैव निर्जगाम रणाजिरम् ॥६-५५-१२॥
translation: He whose shoulders were developed like that of a lion, who equalled tiger in valour, went forth not minding the evil portents.
word_meanings: सिंहापचितस्कन्धः whose shoulders were like that of a lion, शार्दूलसमविक्रमः equalled tiger in valour, सः he, तान् them, उत्पातान् developed, अविचिन्स्सैव not minding evil portents, रणाजिरम् to battle, निर्जगाम went.

text: तदा निर्गच्छतस्तस्य रक्षसः सह राक्षसैः । बभूव सुमहान्नादः क्षोभयन्निव सागरम् ॥६-५५-१३॥
translation: While that Akampana was going like that along with Rakshasas huge noise that arose was as if the ocean was agitated.
word_meanings: तस्यरक्षसः that Rakshasa, राक्षसैःसह along with Rakshasas, तथा like that, निर्गच्छदः going, सागरम् ocean, क्षोभयन्निव agitated,, सुमहान् नादः huge noise, बभूव rose.

text: तेन शब्देन वित्रस्ता वानराणां महाचमूः । द्रुमशैलप्रहरणा योद्धुं समवतिष्ठत ॥६-५५-१४॥
translation: Huge troops of Vanaras holding trees and hillocks stood prepared for waging and by that the noise that arose expanded.
word_meanings: द्रुमशैलप्रहाराणाम् trees and hillocks in hand, वानराणाम् Vanaras, महाचमूः huge troops, योद्धुम् for the combat, समुपतिष्ठतं stood prepared, तेनशब्देन by that noise, वित्रस्ता expanded.

text: तेषां युद्धं महारौद्रं सञ्जज्ञे हरिरक्षसाम् । रामरावणयोरर्थे समभित्यक्तजीविनाम् ॥६-५५-१५॥
translation: Vanaras and Rakshasas dedicated their lives for Rama and Ravana, respectively in that way were enraged and battle took place.
word_meanings: रामरावणयोः Rama and Ravana, समभित्यक्तजीविनाम् dedicated their lives तेषाम् that way, कपिराक्षसाम् Vanaras and Rakshasas, महारौद्रम् enraged, युद्धम् battle, सञ्जज्ञे took place.

text: सर्वे ह्यति बलाः शूराः सर्वे पर्वतसन्निभाः । हरयो राक्षसाश्चैव परस्परजिघांसवः ॥६-५५-१६॥
translation: Intending to kill one another both Vanaras and Rakshasas who resembled hills, also of extraordinary might and heroic fighting.
word_meanings: परस्परजिघासवः intending to kill one another, सर्वे all, हरयः Vanaras, राक्षसाश्चैव even Rakshasas, अतिबलाः of extraordinary might, शूराः warriors, सर्वे all, पर्वतसन्निभाः resembled hills.

text: तेषां विनर्दतां शब्दः संयुगे ऽतितरस्विनाम् । सुश्रुवे सुमहान् क्रोधादन्योन्यमभिगर्जताम् ॥६-५५-१७॥
translation: A tremendous sound thundered in that war when they fought with exceeding impetuosity with one another and yelled at each other.
word_meanings: विवर्धताम् exceeding, तरस्विनाम् impetuosity, कोपात् furiously, अन्योन्यम् one another, अभिगर्जताम् bawled, तेषाम् in that way, सुमहान् tremendous, शब्दः sound, संयुगे in that war, शुश्रुवे thundered.

text: रजश्चारुणवर्णाभं सुभीममभवद्भृशम् । उद्भूतं हरिरक्षोभिः संरुरोध दिशो दश ॥६-५५-१८॥
translation: Terrific dust of red colour arose instantly in all the ten directions by the Vanaras, and Rakshasas and it enveloped all over.
word_meanings: भृशम् instantly, अरुणवर्णाभम् red coloured, सुभीमम् terrific, रजश्च dust, अभवत् arose, हरिरक्षोभिः Vanaras and Rakshasas, उद्धतम् raised, दश ten, दिशः directions, संरुरोध enveloped.

text: अन्योन्यं रजसा तेन कौशेयोद्धूतपाण्डुना । संवृतानि च भूतानि ददृशुर्न रणाजिरे ॥६-५५-१९॥
translation: The combatants could not see one another in the battlefield, and it seemed as though white silk piece was shaken by the wind by the appearance of the surrounding dust.
word_meanings: कौशेयोद्धूतपाण्डुना whitish like silk shaken by wind, तेनरजसा by that dust, सम्वृतानि surrounding, भूतानि living beings, रणाजिरे in the battlefield, अन्योन्यम् one another, सददृशुः could not see.

text: न ध्वजा न पताका वा चर्म वा तुरगो ऽपि वा । आयुधं स्यन्दनं वा ऽपि ददृशे तेन रेणुना ॥६-५५-२०॥
translation: By the dust raised, the posts, flags, shields and not even horses, weapons and chariots were visible.
word_meanings: तेन by that, रेणुना form, ध्वजः posts, नददृशे not visible, पताकावा fags also, न, चर्मवा not shield, तुरगोऽपिवा not horses, आयुधम् not weapons, स्यन्दनोवापि even chariots could not be seen.

text: शब्दश्च सुमहांस्तेषां नर्दतामभिधावताम् । श्रूयते तुमुले युद्धे न रूपाणि चकाशिरे ॥६-५५-२१॥
translation: As they were rushing over one another, terrific noise was heard, and no form was discernible.
word_meanings: नर्धताम् rushing, अभिधावताम् one over the other, तेम् their, सुमहां great, तुमुलः terrific, शब्दश्च sound, युद्धे in war, श्रूयते was heard, रूपाणि forms, नचकाशिरे not discernible.

text: हरीनेव सुसङ्क्रुद्धा हरयो जघ्नुराहवे । राक्षसाश्चापि रक्षांसि निजघ्नुस्तिमिरे तदा ॥६-५५-२२॥
translation: Then in that darkness and in anger Vanaras went attacking Vanaras and Rakshasas also attacked Rakshasas (not knowing).
word_meanings: तदा then, तिमिरे darkness, आहवे attacked, सुसंरुष्टाः in anger, हरयः Vanaras, हरीनेव Vanaras, जघ्नुः went, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, राक्षसांश्चापि Rakshasas even, निजघ्नुः attacked.

text: परांश्चैव विनिघ्नन्तः स्वांश्च वानरराक्षसाः । रुधिरार्द्रां तदा चक्रुर्महीं पङ्कानुलेपनाम् ॥६-५५-२३॥
translation: Not knowing enemies and own people the Vanaras and Rakshasas terminating drenched the mud with their blood and covered the earth.
word_meanings: परांश्च enemies, स्वांश्च own people, निघ्नन्तः terminating, ते they, वानरराक्षसाः Vanaras and Rakshasas, तदा then, महीम् great, रुधिरार्द्राम् blood flow, पङ्कानुलेपनाम् covered it with mud, चक्रुः did.

text: ततस्तु रुधिरौघेण सिक्तं व्यपगतं रजः । शरीरशवसङ्कीर्णा बभूव च वसुन्धरा ॥६-५५-२४॥
translation: Then moistened with blood, the dust settled on the ground was seen covered with bodies and limbs.
word_meanings: ततः then, रुधिरौघेण moistened with blood, सिक्तम् settled, रजः dust, अपगतम् disappeared, वसुन्धरा earth, शरीरवशसङ्कीर्णा covered with bodies and limbs, बभूव appeared.

text: द्रुमशक्तिशिलाप्रासैर्गदापरिघतोमरैः । हरयो राक्षसाश्चैव जघ्नुरन्योन्यमोजसा ॥६-५५-२५॥
translation: Then Rakshasas and Vanaras fought one another vigorously with trees, javelins, maces, darts, rocks, and peaks.
word_meanings: राक्षसाः Rakshasa, हरयः Vanaras, तूर्णम् rapidly, अन्योन्यम् one another, द्रुमशक्तिगदाप्रासैः trees javelins, maces and darts, शिलापरिघतोमरैः rocks and peaks, ओजसा vigorously, जघ्नुः fought.

text: बाहुभिः परिघाकारैर्युद्ध्यन्तः पर्वतोपमाः । हरयो भीमकर्माणो राक्षसान् जघ्नुराहवे ॥६-५५-२६॥
translation: The Vanaras of terrific deeds, like hills in form, resembling iron bars attacked many Rakshasas in the battle.
word_meanings: भीमकर्माणः terrific deeds, पर्वतोपमाः hills like, हरयः Vanaras, परिघाकारैः resembling iron bars, बाहुभिः many, युध्यन्तः in battle, आहवे attacked, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, जघ्नुः went on.

text: राक्षसास्त्वपि सङ्क्रुद्धाः प्रासतोमरपाणयः । कपीन्निजघ्निरे तत्र शस्त्रैः परमदारुणैः ॥६-५५-२७॥
translation: There, the highly furious Rakshasas also exterminated the Vanaras with their weapons and darts.
word_meanings: तत्र there, अभिसङ्क्रुद्धाः highly furious, राक्षसास्तु Rakshasas also, प्रासतोमरपाणयः with clubs and darts, परमदारुणैः very dreadful, शस् त्रैः weapons, कपीन् Vanaras, निजघ्निरे exterminated.

text: अकम्पनः सुसङ्क्रुद्धो राक्षसानां चमूपतिः । संहर्षयति तान् सर्वान् राक्षसान् भीमविक्रमान् ॥६-५५-२८॥
translation: Highly enraged Akampana of fierce valour cheered all the Rakshasa troops.
word_meanings: राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, चमूपतिः troops, सुसङ्क्रुद्धः highly enraged, अकम्पनः Akampana, भीमविक्रमान् of fierce valour, सर्वान् all, तान् राक्षसान् the Rakshasas, सम्हहर्षयति cheered.

text: हरयस्त्वपि सक्षांसि महाद्रुममहाश्मभिः । विदारयन्त्यभिक्रम्य शस्त्राण्याच्छिद्य वीर्यतः ॥६-५५-२९॥
translation: Even the Vanaras mangled Rakshasas countering with weapons, huge rocks and trees and destroyed them.
word_meanings: हरयस्तुअपि even Vanaras, वीर्यतः valiant, शस्त्राणि weapons, आच्छिद्य mangled, अभिक्रम्य countering, महाद्रुममहाश्मभिः huge trees and rocks, रक्षांसि Rakshasas, विदारयन्ति destroyed.

text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वीरा हरयः कुमुदो नलः । मैन्दश्च द्विविदः क्रुद्धाश्चक्रुर्वेगमनुत्तमम् ॥६-५५-३०॥
translation: In the meantime, in the midst Kumuda, Nala, Mainda, heroic vanaras became furious and went
word_meanings: एतस्मिन् in the meantime अन्तरे in the midst, कुमुदः Kumuda, नलः Nala, मैन्धश्च Mainda, वीराः heroic, हरयः Vanaras, परमक्रुद्धाः very furious, अनुत्तमम् supreme, वेगम् speed, चक्रुः went.

text: ते तु वृक्षैर्महावेगा राक्षसानां चमूमुखे । कदनं सुमहच्चक्रुर्लीलया हरियूथपाः । ममन्थू राक्षसान् सर्वे वानरा गणशो भृशम् ॥६-५५-३१॥
translation: Great heroes of the Vanara leaders, chiefs of army sportively waged a great battle and crushed Rakshasas repeatedly. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेपञ्चपञ्चाशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the fifty fifth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: महावीराः great heroes, ते they, हरिपुङ्गवाः Vanara leaders, चमूमुखेः chiefs of army, लीलया sportively, वृक्षैः trees, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, सुमहत् very great, कदनम् battle, चक्रुः happened, सर्वे all, वानरागणशः Vanara leaders, भृशम् repeatedly, राक्षसान् Rakshasa, ममन्थुः crushed.

text: तद्दृष्ट्वा सुमहत् कर्म कृतं वानरसत्तमैः । क्रोधमाहारयामास युधि तीव्रमकम्पनः ॥६-५६-१॥
translation: Observing the great action and accomplishment of the foremost Vanaras in the battle, Akampana exhibited violent anger.
word_meanings: अकम्पनः Akampana, युधि in battle, वानरसत्तमैः foremost of Vanaras, कृतम् accomplishment, तत् that, सुमहत् great, कर्म action, दृष्टवा observing, तीव्रम् violent, क्रोधम् angry, आहारयामास exhibiting.

text: क्रोधमूर्च्छितरूपस्तु धून्वन् परमकार्मुकम् । दृष्ट्वा तु कर्म शत्रूणां सारथिं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥६-५६-२॥
translation: Looking at the deeds of enemies, deluded with violent anger, Akampana spoke these words holding the bow and looking at the charioteer.
word_meanings: शत्रूणाम् by enemies, कर्म deeds, दृष्टवा looking, क्रोधमूर्चितरूपः exhibited violent anger, परमकार्मुकम् highly furious, धून्वन् bow, सारथिम् charioteer, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: तत्रैव तावत्त्वरितं रथं प्रापय सारथे । यत्रैते बहवो घ्नन्ति सुबहून् राक्षसान् रणे ॥६-५६-३॥
translation: "O Charioteer, quickly drive the chariot to that place where many Rakshasas are destroyed in the battle."
word_meanings: सारथे O Charioteer, यत्र there, बहव: many, एते those, रणे in battle, सुबहून् many, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, घ्नन्ति destroyed, त्वरितः quickly, तत्त्रैव to that place, रथम् chariot, प्रापय drive.

text: एते ऽत्र बलवन्तो हि भीमकायाश्च वानराः । द्रुमशैलप्रहरणास्तिष्ठन्ति प्रमुखे मम ॥६-५६-४॥
translation: "Those Vanaras are mighty and terribly angry. They are using trees and hillocks as weapons. Take me where chiefs are standing."
word_meanings: बलवन्तः mighty, भीमकोपाश्च terribly angry, एते those, वानराः Vanara, द्रुमशैलप्रहरणाः using trees and hillocks as weapons, अत्र there, मम my, प्रमुखे chiefs, तिष्ठन्तिहि stand.

text: एतान्निहन्तुमिच्छामि समरश्लाघिनो ह्यहम् । एतैः प्रमथितं सर्वं दृश्यते राक्षसं बलम् ॥६-५६-५॥
translation: "I wish to see the end of Vanaras who boast of their warfare. The entire Rakshasa army is destroyed by them."
word_meanings: अहम् I, समरश्लाघिनः boast of their warfare, एतान् them, निहन्तुम् will finish, इच्छामि desire to, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, सर्वम् all, बलम् army, एतैः in the same way, प्रमथिम् end, दृश्यते wish to see.

text: ततः प्रजवनाश्वेन रथेन रथिनां वरः । हरीनभ्यहनत् क्रोधाच्छरजालैरकम्पनः ॥६-५६-६॥
translation: Then Akampana seated in the chariot drawn by fast moving horses, assailed the Vanaras with a network of arrows.
word_meanings: ततः then, रथिनाम् on the chariot, वरः foremost, अकम्पनः Akampana, प्रचलिताश्वेन by fast moving horses, रथेन from chariot, शरजालैः network of arrows, त्क्रोधात् enraged, हरीन् Vanaras, अभ्यहनत् assailed.

text: न स्थातुं वानराः शेकुः किं पुनर्योद्धुमाहवे । अकम्पनशरैर्भग्नाः सर्व एव विदुद्रुवुः ॥६-५६-७॥
translation: The Vanaras could not counter or stand nor fight in battle. What to say more? Shattered by Akampana's arrows, they all took to their heels.
word_meanings: वानराः Vanaras, आहवे counter, स्थातुम् to stand, नशेकुः not fight, योद्धुम् in battle, किंपुनः What to say again, सर्वेएव all, अकम्पनशरैः by Akampana's arrows, भग्नाः shattered, विदुद्रुवुः took to their heels.

text: तान् मृत्युवशमापन्नानकम्पनवशं गतान् । समीक्ष्य हनुमान् ज्ञातीनुपतस्थे महाबलः ॥६-५६-८॥
translation: Having observed that Vanaras are fallen under the sway of Akampana and under the sway of death, mighty Hanuman approached Akampana.
word_meanings: अकम्पनवंशगतान् kith and kin fallen under the sway of Akampana, मृत्युवशम् sway of death, आपन्नान् caught by, तान् them, ज्ञातीन् kin, समीक्ष्य observing, महाबलः mighty, हनुमान् Hanuman, उपतस्थे approached.

text: तं महाप्लवगं दृष्ट्वा सर्वे प्लवगयूथपाः । समेत्य समरे वीराः संहृष्टाः पर्यवारयन् ॥६-५६-९॥
translation: Seeing the great monkey, the Vanara troops got together and surrounded him.
word_meanings: वीराः hero, ते you, सर्वे all, प्लवगयूतपा: troops of Vanaras, महाप्लवगम् great monkey, तम् him, दृष्टवा seeing, समेत्य together, सहिताः along with, पर्यवारयन् surrounded.

text: अवस्थितं हनूमन्तं ते दृष्ट्वा हरियूथपाः । बभूवुर्बलवन्तो हि बलवन्तं समाश्रिताः ॥६-५६-१०॥
translation: Seeing Hanuman, the monkey leaders took their shelter under him, got established firmly and became strong.
word_meanings: ते to you, हरियूथपा: monkey leaders, अवस्थितम् firmly established, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, दृष्टवा seeing, बलवन्तम् strong, समाश्रिताः taken shelter, बभूवुः became.

text: अकम्पनस्तु शैलाभं हनूमन्तमवस्थितम् । महेन्द्र इव धाराभिः शरैरभिववर्ष ह ॥६-५६-११॥
translation: On Akampana, who was well established like a mountain, mighty Hanuman showered torrents of arrows like Indra showered rain.
word_meanings: अकम्पनस्तु Akampana also, अवस्थितम् established, शैलाभम् like a mountain, हनूमन्तम् Hanumantha, धाराभिः torrents, महेन्द्रःइव like Indra, शरैः arrows, अभिनवर्षह showered rain.

text: अचिन्तयित्वा बाणौघान् शरीरे पतितान् शितान् । अकम्पनवधार्थाय मनो दध्रे महाबलः ॥६-५६-१२॥
translation: Mighty Hanuman unmindful of the volley of arrows pierced in his body thought in his mind only about the destruction of Akampana.
word_meanings: महाबलः mighty, शितान् pierced, शरीरे in the body, पतितान् fallen, बाणौघान् volley of arrows, अचिन्तयित्वा un mindful, अकम्पनवधार्थाय for destroying Akampana, मनः mind, दध्रे thought.

text: स प्रसह्य महातेजा हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः । अभिदुद्राव तद्रक्षः कम्पयन्निव मेदिनीम् ॥६-५६-१३॥
translation: Hanuman, the highly energetic son of Maruthi laughing, sprung up causing the earth to shake and rushed to that Rakshasa.
word_meanings: महातेजाः highly energetic, मारुतात्मजः son of Maruti, सः he, हनुमान् Hanuman, प्रहस्य laughing, मेदिनीम् earth, कम्पयन्निव to shake, तत् रक्षः to that Rakshasa, अभिदुद्राव sprung up.

text: तस्याभिनर्दमानस्य दीप्यमानस्य तेजसा । बभूव रूपं दुर्धर्षं दीप्तस्येव विभावसोः ॥६-५६-१४॥
translation: As he roared, his brilliance was blazing, his form was burning and became formidable for others to be at him.
word_meanings: अभि super, नर्दमानस्य as he roared, तेजसा brilliance, दीप्यमानस्य blazing, तस्य his, रूपम् form, दीप्तस्य burning, विभावसोःइव like, दुर्धर्षम् formidable to win, बभूव became.

text: आत्मानमप्रहरणं ज्ञात्वा क्रोधसमन्वितः । शैलमुत्पाटयामास वेगेन हरिपुङ्गवः ॥६-५६-१५॥
translation: Vanara leader himself knowing that he is without any weapon, full of anger took up a mountain quickly.
word_meanings: हरिपुङ्गवः Vanara leader, आत्मानम् himself, अप्रहरणम् without any weapon, ज्ञात्वा knowing, क्रोधसमन्वितः full of anger, वेगेन quickly, शैलम् mountain, उत्पाटयामास took up.

text: तं गृहीत्वा महाशैलं पाणिनैकेन मारुतिः । स विनद्य महानादं भ्रामयामास वीर्यवान् ॥६-५६-१६॥
translation: He, the heroic Maruthi, with one hand alone taking a huge mountain whirled round making loud noises.
word_meanings: सः he, वीर्यवान् heroic, मारुतिः Maruthi, एकेन alone, पाणिना by hand, सुमहाशैलम् huge mountain, गृहीत्वा taking hold, महानादम् loud noise, विनद्य whirled, भ्रामयामास round.

text: ततस्तमभिदुद्राव राक्षसेन्द्रमकम्पनम् । पुरा हि नमुचिं सङ्ख्ये वज्रेणेव पुरन्दरः ॥६-५६-१७॥
translation: Then he went to Akampana and tormented him just as Indra did with his thunderbolt to Namuchi.
word_meanings: ततः then, पुरा earlier, पुरन्दरः Indra, सङ् ख्ये rushed, वज्रेण with thunderbolt, नमुचिमिव like Namuchi, राक्षसेन्द्रम् Rakshasa king, तम् him, अकम्पनम् Akampanam, अभिदुद्राव tormented.

text: अकम्पनस्तु तद्दृष्ट्वा गिरिशृङ्गं समुद्यतम् । दूरादेव महाबाणैरर्धचन्द्रैर्व्यदारयत् ॥६-५६-१८॥
translation: Seeing the peak of the mountain uplifted, Akampana also discharged halfmoon shaped great arrows from a distance.
word_meanings: अकम्पनस्तु Akampana too, समुद्यतम् uplifted, तत् that, गिरिशृङ्गम् peak of mountain, दृष्टवा seeing, दूरादेव from distance, अर्धचन्द्रैः halfmoon, महाबाणैः great arrows, व्यदारयत् discharged.

text: तत्पर्वताग्रमाकाशे रक्षोबाणविदारितम् । विशीर्णं पतितं दृष्ट्वा हनुमान् क्रोधमूर्च्छितः ॥६-५६-१९॥
translation: Hanuman seeing the peak of the mountain broken into pieces by Rakshasa's arrows and fallen was deluded with anger.
word_meanings: आकाशे in the sky, रक्षोबाणविदारितम् by Rakshasa's arrows broken, विकीर्णम् into pieces, पतितम् fallen, तत् that, पर्वताग्रम् peak of mountain, दृष्टवा gazing, हनुमान् Hanuman, क्रोधमूर्छितः deluded with anger.

text: सो ऽश्वकर्णं समासाद्य रोषदर्पान्वितो हरिः । तूर्णमुत्पाटयामास महागिरिमिवोच्छ्रितम् ॥६-५६-२०॥
translation: He (Hanuman) filled with pride and anger quickly uprooted an Aswakarana tree as huge as a mountain and held it.
word_meanings: सः he, हरिः monkey, रोषदर्पान्वितः pride and anger, महागिरिमिव like a big mountain, उच्छ्रितम् collecting, अश्वकर्णम् Aswakarana tree, समासाद्य holding, तूर्णम् quickly, उत्पाटयामास uprooted.

text: तं गृहीत्वा महास्कन्धं सो ऽश्वकर्णं महाद्युतिः । प्रहस्य परया प्रीत्या भ्रामयामास संयुगे ॥६-५६-२१॥
translation: He (Hanuman) endowed with great splendour, seizing a huge trunk of Aswakarana tree with great delight, whirled it round on the ground laughing.
word_meanings: महाद्युतिः endowed with great splendour, सः he, महास्कन्धम् with huge trunk, अश्वकर्णम् Aswakarana tree, गृहीत्वा seizing, परया great, प्रीत्या with delight, प्रहस्य laughing, भूतले on the ground, भ्रामयामास whirled it round.

text: प्रधावन्नूरुवेगेन प्रभञ्जंस्तरसा द्रुमान् । हनुमान् परमक्रुद्धश्चरणैर्दारयत् क्षितिम् ॥६-५६-२२॥
translation: Highly enraged Hanuman was running at high speed that his feet were seen breaking the trees and cleaving the earth.
word_meanings: परमक्रुद्धः highly enraged, हनुमान् Hanuman, प्रधावन् running, ऊरुवेगेन at high speed, चरणैः feet, तरसा earth, द्रुमान् trees, प्रभञ्ज breaking, दारयत्क्षितम् cleaving the earth.

text: गजांश्च सगजारोहान् सरथान् रथिनस्तथा । जघान हनुमान् धीमान् राक्षसांश्च पदातिगान् ॥६-५६-२३॥
translation: Hanuman struck the mahouts, elephants, similarly the chariots and riders of chariots as well as the terrific Rakshasas who fought standing on feet.
word_meanings: हनुमान् Hanuman, सगजारोहान् the mahouts, गजांश्च and elephants, तथा similarly, सरथान् the chariots, रथिनः and riders, भीमान् terrific, पदातिगान् on foot, राक्षसान् च with Rakshasas, जघान struck.

text: तमन्तकमिव क्रुद्धं समरे प्राणहारिणम् । हनुमन्तमभिप्रेक्ष्य राक्षसा विप्रदुद्रुवुः ॥६-५६-२४॥
translation: Hanuman, enraged like the spirit of death, took their life (Rakshasas) armed with trees and on seeing him the Rakshasas took to their heels.
word_meanings: क्रुद्धम् angry, अन्तकमिव like spirit of death, सद्रुमम् those trees, प्राणहारिणम् took life, तंहनूमन्तम् that Hanuman, अभिप्रेक्ष्य seeing, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, विप्रदुद्रुवुः took to heels.

text: तमापतन्तं सङ्क्रुद्धं राक्षसानां भयावहम् । ददर्शाकम्पनो वीरश्चुक्रोध च ननाद च ॥६-५६-२५॥
translation: The heroic Akampana saw Hanuman coming towards him very angry. Fearing Hanuman, the Rakshasas ran roaring in fear.
word_meanings: अपतन्तम् coming towards, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, भयावहम् fearing, सङ्कृद्धम् very angry, तम् him, वीरः heroic, अकम्पनः Akampana, ददर्श saw, चुक्षोधच running, ननादच roared.

text: स चतुर्दशभिर्बाणैः शितैर्देहविदारणैः । निर्बिभेद हनूमन्तं महावीर्यमकम्पनः ॥६-५६-२६॥
translation: With fourteen pointed powerful arrows, Akampana tormented and split the body of Hanuman.
word_meanings: सःअकम्पनः Akampana, निशितैः pointed, देहविदारणैः tormenting the body, चतुर्दशभि fourteen, बाणैः arrows, महावीर्यम् powerful, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, निर्बिभेद split.

text: स तदा प्रतिविद्धस्तु बह्वीभिः शरवृष्टिभिः । हनुमान् ददृशे वीरः प्ररूढ इव सानुमान् ॥६-५६-२७॥
translation: Valiant Hanuman, even though interrupted several times with rain of arrows, stood still like a mountain full of trees.
word_meanings: शरवृष्टिभिः rain of arrows, बह्वीभिः many times, तदा then, प्रतिविद्दस्तु interrupted, वीरः valiant one, सःहनुमान् that Hanuman, प्ररूढः stood still, सानुमानिव like a mountain with trees, ददृशे seemed.

text: विरराज महाकायो महावीर्यो महामनाः । पुष्पिताशोकसङ्काशो विधूम इव पावकः ॥६-५६-२८॥
translation: The gigantic Hanuman, exceedingly valiant and courageous one shone like a fully blossomed Ashoka tree, resembled smokeless fire.
word_meanings: महावीर्यः exceedingly valiant, महाकायः gigantic, महामना: courageous, पुष्पिताशोकसङ्काशः like fully blossomed Ashoka trees, विधूमः smokeless, पावकःइव like fire, विरराज shone.

text: ततो ऽन्यं वृक्षमुत्पाट्य कत्वा वेगमनुत्तमम् । शिरस्यभिजघानाशु राक्षसेन्द्रमकम्पनम् ॥६-५६-२९॥
translation: Then Hanuman performed another supreme deed by uprooting a tree and striking on the head of Akampana, the chief of Rakshasas.
word_meanings: ततः then, अनुत्तमम् supreme, वेगम् speed, कृत्वा doing, अन्यम् other, वृक्षम् tree, उत्पाट्य uprooting, आशु there upon, राक्षसेन्द्रम् Rakshasa chief, अकम्पनम् Akampana, शिरसि head, जघान struck.

text: स वृक्षेण हतस्तेन सक्रोधेन महात्मना । राक्षशो वानरेन्द्रेण पपात च ममार च ॥६-५६-३०॥
translation: Reacting in anger the great Vanara chief struck the Rakshasa with a tree, by which the Rakshasa fell down dead.
word_meanings: सक्रोधेन reacting in anger, महात्मना great self, तेनवानरेन्द्रेण by Vanara chief, वृक्षेण by the tree, हतः striking, सः he, राक्षसः Rakshasa, पपात fell, ममारच dead.

text: तं दृष्ट्वा निहतं भूमौ राक्षसेन्द्रमकम्पनम् । व्यथिता राक्षसाः सर्वे क्षितिकम्प इव द्रुमाः ॥६-५६-३१॥
translation: Seeing Akampana lying dead on the ground, the Rakshasas were shaken like the trees in the earthquake and were distressed.
word_meanings: निहतम् dead, राक्षसेन्द्रम् Rakshasa chief, तम् him, अकम्पनम् Akampana, भूमौ on the ground, दृष्टवा seeing, सर्वे all, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, क्षितिकम्पे shaken in earthquake, द्रुमाःइव like a tree, व्यथिताः distressed.

text: त्यक्तप्रहरणाः सर्वे राक्षसास्ते पराजिताः । लङ्कामभिययुस्त्रस्ता वानरैस्तैरभिद्रुताः ॥६-५६-३२॥
translation: Abandoning weapons, all Rakshasas having been defeated, chased by the Vanaras, frightened, ran away into Lanka.
word_meanings: पराजिताः defeated, ते they, सर्वे all, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, त्यक्तप्रहरणाः abandoning weapons, तैः those, वानरा: Vanaras, अभिद्रुताः chased, त्रस्ता: frightened, लङ्काम् into Lanka, अभियुयुः ran away.

text: ते मुक्तकेशाः सम्भ्रान्ता भग्नमानाः पराजिताः । स्रवच्छ्रमजलैरङ्गैः श्वसन्तो विप्रदुद्रुवुः ॥६-५६-३३॥
translation: Perplexed, broken hearted, defeated, hair loosened the Rakshasas sweating all over their limbs, sighing heavily ran away very fast.
word_meanings: सम्भ्रान्ता perplexed, भग्नमाना broken hearted, पराजिताः defeated, मुक्तकेशाः hair loosened, ते they, स्रवच्छ्रमजलैः sweating in limbs, अङ्गैः limbs, श्वसन्तः sighing heavily, विप्रदुद्रुवुः ran very fast.

text: अन्योन्यं प्रममन्थुस्ते विविशुर्नगरं भयात् । पृष्ठतस्ते सुसम्मूढाः प्रेक्षमाणा मुहुर्मुहुः ॥६-५६-३४॥
translation: Again, and again looking back in fear, covertly, bewildered, crushing one another, they went into the Lanka city.
word_meanings: ते they, भयात् in fear, पृष्ठतः covertly, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, प्रेक्षमाणाः looking back, सम्मूढाः bewildered, अन्योन्यम् one another, प्रममन्थु: crushing, नगरम् city, विविशुः went.

text: तेषु लङ्कां प्रविष्टेषु राक्षसेषु महाबलाः । समेत्य हरयः सर्वे हनुमन्तमपूजयन् ॥६-५६-३५॥
translation: Those Rakshasas, endowed with prowess, on entering Lanka got together and paid respects to Hanuman.
word_meanings: तेषुराक्षसेषु those Rakshasas, लङ्काम् into Lanka, प्रविष्टेषु on entering, सर्वे all, महाबलाः endowed with prowess, हरयः Vanaras, समेत्य getting together, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, अपूजयन् paid respects.

text: सो ऽपि प्रहृष्टस्तान् सर्वान् हरीन् प्रत्यभ्यपूजयत् । हनुमान् सत्त्वसम्पन्नो यथार्हमनुकूलतः ॥६-५६-३६॥
translation: Hanuman also who was richly endowed with goodness greatly honoured all the Vanaras accordingly.
word_meanings: सत्त्वसम्पन्नः richly endowed with goodness, सः he, हनुमानपि Hanuman also, अनुकूलतः others for their part, यथार्हम् accordingly, तान् them, सर्वान् all, हरीन् monkeys, सम्प्रत्यपूजयत् greatly honoured.

text: विनेदुश्च यथाप्राणं हरयो जितकाशिनः । चकर्षुश्च पुनस्तत्र सप्राणानपि राक्षसान् ॥६-५६-३७॥
translation: In an atmosphere of triumph, the monkeys sportively shouted again saying that they are willing to give up their life also.
word_meanings: जितकाशिनः atmosphere of triumph, हरयः monkeys, यथाप्राणम् their life, विनेदुः sportively, तत्र there, सप्राणानपि willing to give up their life, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, पुनः again, चकर्षुश्च shouted.

text: स वीरशोभामभजन्महाकपिः समेत्य रक्षांसि निहत्य मारुतिः । महासुरं भीमममित्रनाशनं यथैव विष्णुर्बलिनं चमूमुखे ॥६-५६-३८॥
translation: Great Vanara, Maruti shone like a triumphant hero and saviour in front of the army, just as Lord Vishnu, the Lord of Devatas shone after killing the foes (demons).
word_meanings: महाकपिः great Vanara, सःमारुतिः that Maruti, चमूमुखे in front army, रक्षांसि saviour, समेत्य along with, निहत्य having killed, भीमम् fierce, अमित्रनाशनम् killer of foes, यथैव in the same way, बलिनम् , महासुरम् Lord of Devatas, विष्णुर्यथा like Vishnu, वीरशोभाम् like a triumphant hero, अभजत् shone.

text: अपूजयन् देवगणास्तदा कपिं स्वयं च रामो ऽतिबलश्च लक्ष्मणः । तथैव सुग्रीवमुखाः प्लवङ्गमा विभीषणश्चैव महाबलस्तथा ॥६-५६-३९॥
translation: Thereafter Rama with the army of Devatas, Atibala and Lakshmana, in the same way Sugriva, the army chief, so also, Vibheeshana of exceeding might praised Hanuman. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेषटपञ्चाशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the fifty sixth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: तदा then, देवगणाः army of Devatas, स्वयम् themselves, रामः Rama, अतिबलः Atibala, लक्ष्मणःच and Lakshmana, तथैव in the same way, सुग्रीवमुखाः Sugriva the chief, प्लवङ्गमाः of monkeys, तथा so also, महाबलः of exceeding might, विभीषणश्चैव Vibheeshana also, कपिम् monkey, अपूजयन् praised.

text: अकम्पनवधं श्रुत्वा क्रुद्धो वै राक्षसेश्वरः । किञ्चिद्दीनमुखश्चापि सचिवांस्तानुदैक्षत ॥६-५७-१॥
translation: The king of Rakshasas hearing about the death of Akampana, was pale and a little angry and looked at his ministers.
word_meanings: राक्षसेश्वरः Rakshasa king, अकम्पनवधम् Akampana's death, श्रुत्वा having heard, क्रुद्धः angry, किञ्चित् little, दीनमुखःचअपि with pale face, तान् his, सचिवान् ministers, उदैक्षत looked at.

text: स तु ध्यात्वा मुहूर्तं तु मन्त्रिभिः संविचार्य च । ततस्तु रावणः पूर्वदिवसे राक्षसाधिपः । पुरीं परिययौ लङ्कां सर्वान् गुल्मानवेक्षितुम् ॥६-५७-२॥
translation: Ravana, the king of Rakshasas, reflected for a while and deliberated with his ministers and proceeded in the forenoon to inspect all posts in Lanka.
word_meanings: राक्षसाधिपः Rakshasa king, सःरावणः Ravana, मुहूर्तम् for a while, ध्यात्वा reflected, मन्त्रिभिः ministers too, संविचार्यच deliberated, ततः then, पूर्वदिवसे forenoon, सर्वगुल्मान् all posts, अवेक्षितुम् inspect, लङ्कांपुरीम् Lanka city, ययौ proceeded.

text: तां राक्षसगणैर्गुप्तां गुल्मैर्बहुभिरावृताम् । ददर्श नगरीं लङ्कां पताकाध्वजमालिनीम् ॥६-५७-३॥
translation: Ravana saw Lanka guarded by the Rakshasa army, surrounded by many posts, with flags, posts, and pennants.
word_meanings: लङ्कां Lanka, राक्षसगणैः by Rakshasa army, गुप्ताम् guarded, बहुभिः many, गुल्मैः posts, आवृताम् surrounded, पताकाध्वजमालिनीम् with rows of flags and posts and pennants तांनगरीम् that city, ददर्श saw.

text: रुद्धां तु नगरीं दृष्ट्वा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः । उवाचामर्षतः काले प्रहस्तं युद्धकोविदम् ॥६-५७-४॥
translation: Ravana, the Lord of Rakshasas seeing the city besieged, spoke to Prahastha who was skilled in warfare for his welfare.
word_meanings: राक्षसेश्वरः Lord of Rakshasas, रावणः Ravana, रुद्धाम् besieged, नगरीम् city, दृष्टवा seeing, काले time, युद्धकोविदम् skilled in warfare, प्रहस्तम् Prahastha, आत्महितम् for his welfare, उवाच spoke.

text: पुरस्योपनिविष्टस्य सहसा पीडितस्य वा । नान्यं युद्धात् प्रपश्यामि मोक्षं युद्धविशारद ॥६-५७-५॥
translation: "I am not able to see anyone (other than you) knowledgeable in warfare to deliver the city oppressed suddenly and can liberate from war."
word_meanings: युद्धविशारद knowledgeable in war, उपनिविष्टस्य to deliver, सहसा suddenly, पीडितस्य oppressed, पुरस्य city's, युद्धात् from war, अन्यम् others, मोक्षम् can liberate, नप्रवश्यामि not able to know.

text: अहं वा कुम्भकर्णो वा त्वं वा सेनापतिर्मम । इन्द्रजिद्वा निकुम्भो वा वहेयुर्भारमीदृशम् ॥६-५७-६॥
translation: "Either myself or Kumbhakarna, or my CommanderinChief, or you, or Indrajith, or Nikumbha can undertake such a burden."
word_meanings: अहंवा myself, कुम्भकर्णोवा or Kumbhakarna, मम my, सेनापतिः CommanderinChief, त्वंवा or you, इन्द्रजिद्वा Indrajith, निकुम्भोवा or Nikumbha, ईदृशम् such, भारम् burden, वहेयुः undertake.

text: स त्वं बलमतः शीघ्रमादाय परिगृह्य च । विजयायाभिनिर्याहि यत्र सर्वे वनौकसः ॥६-५७-७॥
translation: "Therefore, quickly get ready with the army and take charge for conquering the vanaras collected there."
word_meanings: सःत्वम् you, ततः therefore, शीघ्रम् quickly, बलम् army, आदाय getting, परिगृह्यच taking charge, वनौकसः Vanaras, सर्वे all, यत्र there, विजयाय for conquering, अभिनिर्याहि are collected.

text: निर्याणादेव ते नूनं चपला हरिवाहिनी । नर्दतां राक्षसेन्द्राणां श्रुत्वा नादं द्रविष्यति ॥६-५७-८॥
translation: As soon as you go there surely the unsettled Vanara army will run away hearing the uproar and loud noise of Rakshasas.
word_meanings: निर्याणायादेव as soon as you go, ते they, नूनम् surely, चलिता unsettled, हरिवाहिनी Vanara army, नर्दताम् uproar, राक्षसेन्द्राणाम् Rakshasas, नादम् sound, श्रुत्वा hearing, द्रविष्यति will run.

text: चपला ह्यविनीताश्च चलचित्ताश्च वानराः । न सहिष्यन्ति ते नादं सिंहनादमिव द्विपाः ॥६-५७-९॥
translation: "Vanaras, who are fickle minded, undisciplined and volatile, will not endure the roar of lions of glowing Rakshasas."
word_meanings: चपलाः fickle minded, अविनीताश्च undisciplined, चलचित्ताश्च volatile, वानराः Vanaras, द्विपाः glowing, सिंहनादमिव like lions roar, ते you, नादम् sound, नसहिष्यन्ति not endure.

text: विद्रुते च बले तस्मिन् रामः सौमित्रिणा सह । अवशस्ते निरालम्बः प्रहस्त वशमेष्यति ॥६-५७-१०॥
translation: "Prahastha! Knowing your strength, the helpless Vanaras will surely run away and along with Saumithri. Rama will fall into your power."
word_meanings: प्रहस्त Prahastha, तस्मिन् बले your force, विद्रुते knowing, सौमित्रिणासह along with Saumithri, रामः Rama, अवशः surely, निरालम्बः helpless, वशम् fall into your power, एष्यति will be.

text: आपत् संशयिता श्रेयो न तु निस्संशयीकृता । प्रतिलोमानुलोमं वा यद्वा नो मन्यसे हितम् ॥६-५७-११॥
translation: "If uncertain death comes it is good, not when it comes by not encountering. Think what is acceptable to you and what is not acceptable to you and that is acceptable to me."
word_meanings: अत्र then, संशयिता uncertain, आपत् if it comes, श्रेयः good, निस्सशयीकृता undesirable, न not, तु you, यत् that, वा or, प्रतिलोमानुलोमंवा whether acceptable or not acceptable, हितम् good, मन्यसे I think.

text: रावणेनैवमुक्तस्तु प्रहस्तो वाहिनीपतिः । राक्षसेन्द्रमुवाचेदमसुरेन्द्रमिवोशना ॥६-५७-१२॥
translation: Prahastha, the CommanderinChief having heard Ravana, replied to the king of Rakshasas just as the preceptor of Rakshasas spoke to Bali.
word_meanings: रावणेन by Ravana, एवम् in that way, उक्तः spoken, वाहिनीपतिः CommanderinChief, उशना preceptor of Rakshasas, असुरेन्द्रमिव this way to the king of Rakshasas, राक्षसेन्द्रम् Rakshasa Lord, इदम् thus, उवाच spoke.

text: राजन् मन्त्रितपूर्वं नः कुशलैः सह मन्त्रिभिः । विवादश्चापि नो वृत्तः समवेक्ष्य परस्परम् ॥६-५७-१३॥
translation: "O king! This was deliberated with capable ministers earlier, is it not It was reviewed with one another, and controversy arose."
word_meanings: राजन् O King!, कुशलैः capable, मन्त्रिभिःसह along with ministers, नः is it not, मन्त्रितपूर्वम् earlier, परस्परम् one another, समवेक्ष्य reviewed, नः is it not, विवादश्च controversy, वृत्तः arose.

text: प्रदानेन तु सीतायाः श्रेयो व्यवसितं मया । अप्रदाने पुनर्युद्धं दृष्टमेतत्तथैव नः ॥६-५७-१४॥
translation: "If Sita is given away it is beneficial and if not given war is foreseen is known to us."
word_meanings: सीतायाः Sita, प्रदानेन by giving, मया by me, श्रेयः beneficial, व्यवसितम् if not given, अप्रदानेपुनः not given, नः if not, युद्धम् war, दृष्टमेव foreseen.

text: सो ऽहं दानैश्च मानैश्च सततं पूजितस्त्वया । सान्त्वैश्च विविधैः काले किं न कुर्यां प्रियं तव ॥६-५७-१५॥
translation: "You have always given me gifts, many honours and praises earlier and worshipped me. When time comes why will I not do"
word_meanings: काले time comes, दानैश्च gifts, मानैश्च honours, विविधैः many, सान्त्वैश्च praises, सततम् always, त्वया by you, पूजितः worshipped, सःअहम् me all of you, तव your, किम् why, नकुर्याम् why will I not do

text: न हि मे जीवितं रक्ष्यं पुत्रदारधनानि वा । त्वं पश्य मां जुहूषन्तं त्वदर्थं जीवितं युधि ॥६-५७-१६॥
