translation: "I do not need to protect my life, sons, wives and wealth also. I am willing to give up my life also in war for you. You will see."
word_meanings: मे I, जीवितम् life, रक्ष्यम् protection, नहि not only, पुत्रदारधनानिच sons, wife, wealth also, त्वदर्थे will not be spared, युधि in war, जीवितम् life, जुहूषन्तम् willing to give up life, माम् by me, त्वम् for you, पश्य you may see.

text: एवमुक्त्वा तु भर्तारं रावणं वाहिनीपतिः । उवाचेदं बलाध्यक्षान् प्रहस्तः पुरतः स्थितान् ॥६-५७-१७॥
translation: Prahastha, having submitted to his king Ravana in that way, the CommanderinChief of the army commanded the army that stood before him.
word_meanings: वाहिनीपतिः O CommanderinChief, प्रहस्तः Prahastha, भर्तारम् protector, रावणम् Ravana, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, पुरतः in front, स्थितान् stood, बलाध्यक्षान् chief of army, इदम् this way, उवाच spoke.

text: समानयत मे शीघ्रं राक्षसानां महद्बलम् ॥६-५७-१८॥
translation: "Get the great Rakshasa army together with me to the battlefield speedily. By my arrows all the carnivorous birds will be killed and satisfied with the flesh (of Vanaras) today", said Prahastha.
word_meanings: राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, महाबलम् great army, मे me, समानयत together, काननौकसाम् carnivorous, पक्षिणः birds, मद्बाणाच by my arrows, वेगेन speedily, रणाजिरे to the battlefield, हतानाम् killed, मांसादाः flesh, अद्य they, तृप्यन्तु will be satisfied.

text: मद्बाणशतवेगेन हतानां च रणाजिरे । अद्य तृप्यन्तु मांसादाः पक्षिणः काननौकसाम् ॥६-५७-१९॥
translation: "Get the great Rakshasa army together with me to the battlefield speedily. By my arrows all the carnivorous birds will be killed and satisfied with the flesh (of Vanaras) today", said Prahastha.
word_meanings: राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, महाबलम् great army, मे me, समानयत together, काननौकसाम् carnivorous, पक्षिणः birds, मद्बाणाच by my arrows, वेगेन speedily, रणाजिरे to the battlefield, हतानाम् killed, मांसादाः flesh, अद्य they, तृप्यन्तु will be satisfied.

text: इत्युक्तास्ते प्रहस्तेन बलाध्यक्षाः कृतत्वराः । बलमुद्योजयामासुस्तस्मिन् राक्षसमन्दिरे ॥६-५७-२०॥
translation: As soon as the commander in chief ordered in that way, the Rakshasa troops mobilized in the abode of Rakshasas.
word_meanings: कृतत्वरा: very soon, बलाध्यक्षाः commander in chief, इत्युक्ता: spoken that way, प्रहस्तेन by Prahastha, तस्मिन् in that way, राक्षसमन्दिरे Rakshasa abode, बलम् troops, उद्योजयामासुः mobilized.

text: सा बभूव मुहूर्तेन तिग्मनानाविधायुधैः । लङ्का राक्षसवीरैस्तैर्गजैरिव समाकुला ॥६-५७-२१॥
translation: In a short while the whole of Lanka was filled with elephant size Rakshasa warriors gathered with different kinds of weapons.
word_meanings: मुहूर्तेन in a short while, सालङ्का that Lanka, गजैरिव of elephant size, भीमैः frightening, तै: they, नानाविधायुधैः different kinds of weapons, तैः they, राक्षसवीरैः Rakshasa warriors, समाकुला gathered, बभूव filled.

text: हुताशनं तर्पयतां ब्राह्मणांश्च नमस्यताम् । आज्यगन्धप्रतिवहः सुरभिर्मारुतो ववौ ॥६-५७-२२॥
translation: A fragrant breeze blew past there with Rakshasas propitiating fire god, with offerings and by the worshipping of brahmins the air was pleasant filled with the fragrance of ghee and flowers.
word_meanings: हुताशनम् propitiating fire, तर्पयताम् with offerings, ब्राह्मणांश्च to the brahmanas, नमस्यताम् worshipping, आज्यगन्धप्रतिवहः air with fragrance of ghee and flowers, सुरभः very pleasant, मारुतः blew, वनौ past.

text: स्रजश्च विविधाकारा जगृहुस्त्वभिमन्त्रिताः । सङ्ग्रामसज्जाः संहृष्टा धारयन् राक्षसास्तदा ॥६-५७-२३॥
translation: Then the Rakshasas rejoiced, wishing victory, consecrated military material with chanting and wore flower garland s.
word_meanings: तदा then, सङ्ग्रामसज्जाः military weapons and articles, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, विविधाकाराः of different form, अभिमन्त्रिताः consecrated with chanting, स्रजश्च flower garland s, जगृहुः went, सम्हृष्टाः rejoiced, धरायन् wore.

text: सधनुष्काः कवचिनो वेगादाप्लुत्य राक्षसाः । रावणं प्रेक्ष्य राजानं प्रहस्तं पर्यवारयन् ॥६-५७-२४॥
translation: Wearing bows and shields, looking at and greeting the king Ravana, they swiftly surrounded Prahastha.
word_meanings: सधनुष्काः bows, कवचिनः shields, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, राजानम् to the king, रावणम् Ravana, प्रेक्ष्य looking at, वेगात् swiftly, आप्लुत्य greeting, प्रहस्तम् Prahastha, पर्यवारयन् surrounded.

text: अथामन्त्र्य च राजानं भेरीमाहत्य भैरवाम् । आरुरोह रथं दिव्यं प्रहस्तः सज्जकल्पितम् ॥६-५७-२५॥
translation: Taking leave of the king and causing terrific sound of blowing of drums, Prahastha, ascended, laughing on to a splendorous chariot, equipped to fight, driven by horses endowed with good speed and capable charioteer, sounding like a thundering cloud, shining like the sun and moon, with a sign of serpent on flag, provided with a wooden fence for defence, which was difficult to collide, covered with gold net.
word_meanings: अथ and then, युक्तः taking leave, प्रहस्तः Prahastha, राजानम् King, आमन्त्य causing, भैरवाम् terrific, भेरीम् drums, आहत्य blowing, सज्जकल्पितम् equipped for fight, महाजवैः of good speed, हयैः horses, युक्तम् driven by, सम्यक् capable, सूतसुसंयुतम् with charioteer, महाजलदनिर्घोषम् sounding like thundering cloud, साक्षात् just as, चन्द्रार्कभास्वरम् shining like sun and moon, उरगध्वज with serpent sign on, दुर्धर्षम् difficult to overpower, सुवरूथम् provided with a wooden fence, स्ववस्करम् as defence against collision, सुवर्णजालसंयुक्तम् covered with net of gold, श्रिया splendour, प्रहसन्तमिव as if laughing, रथम् chariot, आरुरोह ascended.

text: हयैर्महाजवैर्युक्तं सम्यक् सूतसुसंयतम् । महाजलदनिर्घोषं साक्षाच्चन्द्रार्कभास्वरम् ॥६-५७-२६॥
translation: Taking leave of the king and causing terrific sound of blowing of drums, Prahastha, ascended, laughing on to a splendorous chariot, equipped to fight, driven by horses endowed with good speed and capable charioteer, sounding like a thundering cloud, shining like the sun and moon, with a sign of serpent on flag, provided with a wooden fence for defence, which was difficult to collide, covered with gold net.
word_meanings: अथ and then, युक्तः taking leave, प्रहस्तः Prahastha, राजानम् King, आमन्त्य causing, भैरवाम् terrific, भेरीम् drums, आहत्य blowing, सज्जकल्पितम् equipped for fight, महाजवैः of good speed, हयैः horses, युक्तम् driven by, सम्यक् capable, सूतसुसंयुतम् with charioteer, महाजलदनिर्घोषम् sounding like thundering cloud, साक्षात् just as, चन्द्रार्कभास्वरम् shining like sun and moon, उरगध्वज with serpent sign on, दुर्धर्षम् difficult to overpower, सुवरूथम् provided with a wooden fence, स्ववस्करम् as defence against collision, सुवर्णजालसंयुक्तम् covered with net of gold, श्रिया splendour, प्रहसन्तमिव as if laughing, रथम् chariot, आरुरोह ascended.

text: उरगध्वजदुर्द्धर्षं सुवरूथं स्वपस्करम् । सुवर्णजालसंयुक्तं प्रहसन्तमिव श्रिया ॥६-५७-२७॥
translation: Taking leave of the king and causing terrific sound of blowing of drums, Prahastha, ascended, laughing on to a splendorous chariot, equipped to fight, driven by horses endowed with good speed and capable charioteer, sounding like a thundering cloud, shining like the sun and moon, with a sign of serpent on flag, provided with a wooden fence for defence, which was difficult to collide, covered with gold net.
word_meanings: अथ and then, युक्तः taking leave, प्रहस्तः Prahastha, राजानम् King, आमन्त्य causing, भैरवाम् terrific, भेरीम् drums, आहत्य blowing, सज्जकल्पितम् equipped for fight, महाजवैः of good speed, हयैः horses, युक्तम् driven by, सम्यक् capable, सूतसुसंयुतम् with charioteer, महाजलदनिर्घोषम् sounding like thundering cloud, साक्षात् just as, चन्द्रार्कभास्वरम् shining like sun and moon, उरगध्वज with serpent sign on, दुर्धर्षम् difficult to overpower, सुवरूथम् provided with a wooden fence, स्ववस्करम् as defence against collision, सुवर्णजालसंयुक्तम् covered with net of gold, श्रिया splendour, प्रहसन्तमिव as if laughing, रथम् chariot, आरुरोह ascended.

text: ततस्तं रथमास्थाय रावणार्पितशासनः । लङ्काया निर्ययौ तूर्णं बलेन महता वृतः ॥६-५७-२८॥
translation: Then, by the order of Ravana, Prahastha set out immediately and departed from Lanka taking a se at in the chariot, surrounded by the great army.
word_meanings: ततः then, रावणार्पितशासनः by the order of Ravana, रथम् chariot, आस्थाय taking seat, महता great, बलेन army, वृतः surrounded by, तूर्णम् immediately, लङ्कायाः from Lanka, निर्ययौ departed.

text: ततो दुन्दुभिनिर्घोषः पर्जन्यनिनदोपमः । वादित्राणां च निनदः पूरयन्निव सागरम् । शुश्रुवे शङ्खशब्दश्च प्रयाते वाहिनीपतौ ॥६-५७-२९॥
translation: As the CommanderinChief was going there arose sounds of kettle drums, blasts of fanfares, and noise of blasts of conchs filling the earth was heard.
word_meanings: वाहिनीपतौ CommanderinChief of the army, प्रयाते departed, ततः there, पर्जन्यनिनदोपमः arose sounds, दुन्धुभिनिर्घोषः sounds of kettle drums, वादित्राणाम् blasts of fanfares, निनदःच noise, शङ्खशब्दश्च also sounds of conchs, मेदिनीम् earth, पूरयन्निव filling, शुश्रुवे was heard.

text: निनदन्तः स्वरान् घोरान् राक्षसा जग्मुरग्रतः । भीमरूपा महाकायाः प्रहस्तस्य पुरस्सराः ॥६-५७-३०॥
translation: Rakshasas of fierce appearance, of huge body size, making dreadful sounds went marching ahead of Prahastha.
word_meanings: भीमरूपाः of fierce appearance, महाकायाः endowed with huge body, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, घोरान् dreadful, स्वरान् voice, निनदन्तः making sound, प्रहस्तस्यः Prahastha's, पुरस्सरा marching:, अग्रतः in front, जग्मुः went.

text: नरान्तकः कुम्भहनुर्महानादः समुन्नतः । प्रहस्तसचिवा ह्येते निर्ययुः परिवार्य तम् ॥६-५७-३१॥
translation: Naranthaka, Kumbhahanu, Mahanada, Samunnatha, the adjutants of Prahastha went with him.
word_meanings: नरान्तक Naranthaka, कुम्भहनुः Kumbhahanu, महानादः Mahanada, समुन्नतः Samunnatha, प्रहस्तसचिवाः Prahastha's adjutants, एते these, तम् with, परिवार्य surrounded, निर्ययुः went.

text: व्यूढेनैव सुघोरेण पूर्वद्वारात् स निर्ययौ । गजयूथनिकाशेन बलेन महता वृतः ॥६-५७-३२॥
translation: He, emerged from the eastern gate, surrounded by a huge, formidable army formed into a battlearray, which resembled a herd of elephants.
word_meanings: सः he, व्यूढेनेव formed into battle array, सुघोरेण formidable, गजयूथनिकाशेन resembled a herd of elephants, महता huge, बलेन army, वृतः surrounded, पूर्वद्वारात् from the eastern gate, निर्ययौ emerged.

text: सागरप्रतिमौघेन वृतस्तेन बलेन सः । प्रहस्तो निर्ययौ तूर्णं कालान्तकयमोपमः ॥६-५७-३३॥
translation: Prahastha emerged in rage surrounded by his forces which was like an ocean that resembled Kala (time spirit), Anthaka (death) and Yama (God of death).
word_meanings: कालान्तकयमोपमः Kala, Anthaka and Yama, क्रुद्धः enraged, सःप्रहस्तः that Prahastha, सागरप्रतिमौघेन like an ocean, तेन by that, बलेन forces, वृतः surrounded, निर्ययौ emerged.

text: तस्य निर्याणघोषेण राक्षसानां च नर्दताम् । लङ्कायां सर्वभूतानि विनेदुर्विकृतैः स्वरैः ॥६-५७-३४॥
translation: By the sounds of roaring that emerged at the departure of the Rakshasas all beings of Lanka shrieked in unnatural ways.
word_meanings: तस्य by the, निर्याणघेषेण sounds that emerged at departure, नर्दताम् roaring, राक्षसानांच Rakshasas also, लङ्कायाम् in Lanka, सर्वभूतानि all beings, विकृतैः unnatural way, स्वरैः tone, विनेदुः shrieked.

text: व्यभ्रमाकाशमाविश्य मांसशोणितभोजनाः । मण्डलान्यपसव्यानि खगाश्चक्रू रथं प्रति ॥६-५७-३५॥
translation: The birds living on flesh and blood reached the sky and circled anticlockwise around the chariot.
word_meanings: मांसशोणितभोजनाः living on flesh and blood, खगाः birds, व्यभ्रम् circled, आकाशम् in the sky, आविश्य reaching, रथंप्रति round the chariot, अपसव्यानि in anticlockwise, मण्डलानि round, चक्रुः went.

text: वमन्त्यः पावकज्वालाः शिवा घोरं ववाशिरे । अन्तरिक्षात् पपातोल्का वायुश्च परुषो ववौ ॥६-५७-३६॥
translation: A meteor fell from the sky, the wind blew violently. Jackals howled vomiting tongues of fire.
word_meanings: घोराः dreadful, शिवाः jackals, पावकज्वालाः tongues of fire, वम्नत्यः vomiting, ववाशिरे howled, अन्तरिक्षात् from the sky, उल्का meteor, पपात fell, वायुश्च wind blew, परुषम् violent, ववौ wind blew.

text: अन्योन्यमभिसंरब्धा ग्रहाश्च न चकाशिरे ॥६-५७-३७॥
translation: The planets clashing with one another did not shine. The clouds were violent like donkeys and rained blood on top of the chariot and the marching Rakshasas drenched.
word_meanings: अन्योन्यम् one another, अभिसंरब्दाः clashing, नचकाशिरे not shine, रक्षसः Rakshasas, रथस्य chariot's, उपरि top, मेघाश्च like cloud, खरनिर्घोषाः violent like donkeys, रुधिरम् blood, ववृर्षुः rained, पुरःसरान् marching, सिषिचुश्च drenched.

text: मेघाश्च खरनिर्घोषा रथस्योपरि रक्षसः । ववृषू रुधिरं चास्य सिषिचुश्च पुरस्सरान् ॥६-५७-३८॥
translation: The planets clashing with one another did not shine. The clouds were violent like donkeys and rained blood on top of the chariot and the marching Rakshasas drenched.
word_meanings: अन्योन्यम् one another, अभिसंरब्दाः clashing, नचकाशिरे not shine, रक्षसः Rakshasas, रथस्य chariot's, उपरि top, मेघाश्च like cloud, खरनिर्घोषाः violent like donkeys, रुधिरम् blood, ववृर्षुः rained, पुरःसरान् marching, सिषिचुश्च drenched.

text: केतुमूर्धनि गृध्रो ऽस्य निलीनो दक्षिणामुखः । तुदन्नुभयतः पार्श्वं समग्रामहरत् प्रभाम् ॥६-५७-३९॥
translation: Seeing a vulture sitting on the banner (of Prahastha) facing south scratching both sides, Prahastha became pale as if the entire prosperity had been snatched away.
word_meanings: दक्षिणामुखः facing south, केतोः banner, मूर्धनि top, निलीनः surrounded, गृध्रः vulture, अस्य its, उभयतः both, पार्श्वम् sides, तुदन् scratching, समग्राम् entire, श्रियम् prosperity, अहरत् snatched.

text: सारथेर्बहुशश्चास्य सङ्ग्राममवगाहतः । प्रतोदो न्यपतद्धस्तात् सूतस्य हयसादिनः ॥६-५७-४०॥
translation: A charioteer and knower of controlling the horses, the whip slipped many times from his hand.
word_meanings: सङ्ग्रामम् war, अवगाहतः knower, सूतस्य charioteer, हयसादिनः controlling the horses, सारथेः charioteer, हस्तात् from hand, प्रतोदः whip, अस्य his, बहुशः many times, न्यपतत् slipped.

text: निर्याणश्रीश्च या ऽस्यासीद्भास्वरा वसुदुर्लभा । सा ननाश मुहूर्तेन समे च स्खलिता हयाः ॥६-५७-४१॥
translation: The splendour of Prahastha which is difficult to destroy, disappeared at that moment and the horses stumbled on even ground.
word_meanings: भास्वरा splendour, वसुदुर्लभा that which is difficult, या for, निर्याणश्री disappeared, सा that, मुहूर्तेन moment, ननाश destroyed, हयाश्च even horses, समे even ground, स्खलिताः stumbled.

text: प्रहस्तं त्वभिनिर्यान्तं प्रख्यातबलपौरुषम् । युधि नानाप्रहरणा कपिसेना ऽभ्यवर्तत ॥६-५७-४२॥
translation: Seeing Prahastha, who is well known for his valour coming towards, for war with various weapons, the monkey army stood facing.
word_meanings: प्रख्यातबलपौरुषम् well known for the valour, अभिनिर्यान्तम् coming towards, तुप्रहस्तम् on the part of Prahastha, नानाप्रहरणा various weapons, कपिसेना monkey army, युधि in war, अभ्यवर्तत stood facing.

text: अथ घोषः सुतुमुलो हरीणां समजायत । वृक्षानारुजतां चैव गुर्वीरागृह्णतां शिलाः ॥६-५७-४३॥
translation: And when the monkeys took hold of heavy rocks and trees for fighting exceedingly tumultuous clamor arose.
word_meanings: अथ and then वृक्षान् trees, आरुजतांचैव for the sake of fighting, गुर्वीः heavy, शिलाः rocks, आगृह्णताम् taking hold, हरीणाम् monkeys, सुतुमुलः exceedingly, घोषः tumultuous, समजायत arose.

text: नदतां राक्षसानां च वानराणां च गर्जताम् । उभे प्रमुदिते सैन्ये रक्षोगणवनौकसाम् ॥६-५७-४४॥
translation: The yelling noise of Rakshasas and roaring noise of Vanaras of both armies, who were powerful and seized with speed, who sought the destruction of one another, challenging noises of Rakshasas and Vanaras, highly rejoiced, was heard.
word_meanings: नदताम् yelling noise, राक्षसानांच of Rakshasas, गर्जताम् roaring, वानराणांच noise of Vanaras, उभे both, सैन्ये army, प्रमुदिते highly rejoiced, वेगितानाम् seized with speed, समर्थानाम् powerful, अन्योन्यवधकाङ् क्षिणाम् who sought the destruction of one another, परस्परम् one another, आह्वयताम् challenging, रक्षोगणवनौकसाम् armies of Rakshasas and Vanaras, महान् huge, निनादः roar, श्रूयते was heard.

text: वेगितानां समर्थानामन्योन्यवधकाङ्क्षिणाम् । परस्परं चाह्वयतां निनादः श्रूयते महान् ॥६-५७-४५॥
translation: The yelling noise of Rakshasas and roaring noise of Vanaras of both armies, who were powerful and seized with speed, who sought the destruction of one another, challenging noises of Rakshasas and Vanaras, highly rejoiced, was heard.
word_meanings: नदताम् yelling noise, राक्षसानांच of Rakshasas, गर्जताम् roaring, वानराणांच noise of Vanaras, उभे both, सैन्ये army, प्रमुदिते highly rejoiced, वेगितानाम् seized with speed, समर्थानाम् powerful, अन्योन्यवधकाङ् क्षिणाम् who sought the destruction of one another, परस्परम् one another, आह्वयताम् challenging, रक्षोगणवनौकसाम् armies of Rakshasas and Vanaras, महान् huge, निनादः roar, श्रूयते was heard.

text: ततः प्रहस्तः कपिराजवाहिनीमभिप्रतस्थे विजयाय दुर्मतिः । विवृद्धवेगां च विवेश तां चमूं यथा मुमूर्षुः शलभो विभावसुम् ॥६-५७-४६॥
translation: Thereafter, perverted Prahastha entered into that army of monkey king grown immensely, to conquer the army, just as moth enters into flame, being at the point of death. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेसप्तपञ्चाशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the fifty seventh sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, दुर्मतिः perverted, प्रहस्तः Prahastha, कपिराजवाहिनीम् army of monkey king, विजयाय to conquer, प्रहस्तः Prahastha, विवृद्धवेगःच grown immensely, मुमूर्षुः being on the point of death, शलभः moth, विभावसंयथा enters into flame, तांचमूम् that, विवेश entered.

text: ततः प्रहस्तं निर्यान्तं दृष्ट्वा भीमपराक्रमम् । उवाच सस्मितं रामो विभीषणमरिन्दमः ॥६-५८-१॥
translation: Then Rama seeing Prahastha, the tamer of enemies of terrific valour coming towards him, said to Vibheeshana, having a gentle smile.
word_meanings: ततः then, अरिन्दमः tamer of enemies, रामः Rama, निर्यान्तम् coming towards, भीमपराक्रमम् of terrific valour, प्रहस्तम् Prahastha, दृष्टवा seeing, विभीषणम् to Vibheeshana, सस्मितम् with gentle smile, उवाच said.

text: क एष सुमहाकायो बलेन महता वृतः । आचक्ष्व मे महाबाहो वीर्यवन्तं निशाचरम् ॥६-५८-२॥
translation: "Oh, Broad shouldered Vibheeshana! Who is this Rakshasa of gigantic form coming surrounded by a great army He seems to be a valiant one. Tell me."
word_meanings: महाबाहो broad shouldered, सुमहाकायः gigantic body, बलेन with army, वृतः surrounded, एषः in that way, कः who, महाबाहो is that gigantic one, वीर्यवन्तम् valiant, निशाचरम् night ranger, मे to me, आचक्ष्व tell me.

text: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रत्युवाच विभीषणः ॥६-५८-३॥
translation: On hearing Raghava's words Vibheeshana replied." He is a Rakshasa, by name Prahastha, commander in chief of the army of Rakshasa king. He is widely known for his prowess, conversant with weapons and courageous. He is heroic and a third of the army of Ravana is under his command."
word_meanings: राघवस्य Raghava's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, प्रत्युवाच replied, एषः this way, लङ्कायाम् in Lanka, त्रिभागबलसम्वृतः a third of the army, वीर्यवान् courageous, अस्त्रवित् conversant with weapons, शूरः heroic, सुप्रख्याश्चपराक्रमः widely known for his prowess, तस्यराक्षसेन्द्रस्य that Rakshasa king's, सेनापतिः CommanderinChief of army, प्रहस्तोनाम called Prahastha, राक्षसः Rakshasa.

text: एष सेनापतिस्तस्य प्रहस्तो नाम राक्षसः । लङ्कायां राक्षसेन्द्रस्य त्रिभागबलसंवृतः । वीर्यवानस्त्रविच्छूरः प्रख्यातश्च पराक्रमे ॥६-५८-४॥
translation: On hearing Raghava's words Vibheeshana replied." He is a Rakshasa, by name Prahastha, commander in chief of the army of Rakshasa king. He is widely known for his prowess, conversant with weapons and courageous. He is heroic and a third of the army of Ravana is under his command."
word_meanings: राघवस्य Raghava's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, प्रत्युवाच replied, एषः this way, लङ्कायाम् in Lanka, त्रिभागबलसम्वृतः a third of the army, वीर्यवान् courageous, अस्त्रवित् conversant with weapons, शूरः heroic, सुप्रख्याश्चपराक्रमः widely known for his prowess, तस्यराक्षसेन्द्रस्य that Rakshasa king's, सेनापतिः CommanderinChief of army, प्रहस्तोनाम called Prahastha, राक्षसः Rakshasa.

text: ततः प्रहस्तं निर्यान्तं भीमं भीमपराक्रमम् । गर्जन्तं सुमहाकायं राक्षसैरभिसंवृतम् ॥६-५८-५॥
translation: The huge army of powerful Vanaras saw Prahastha of terrific prowess, fierce, surrounded by Rakshasas coming towards them roaring.
word_meanings: ततः then, बलीयसाम् huge army, अभिसञ्जातरोषाणाम् of redoubtable prowess, प्रहस्तम् Prahastha, अभिगर्जताम् roaring, वानराणाम् Vanaras, महती powerful, सेना army, निर्यान्तम् coming towards, भीमम् fierce, भीमपराक्रमम् of terrific prowess, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, अभिसम्वृतम् surrounded, प्रहस्तम् Prahastha, ददर्श saw.

text: ददर्श महती सेना वानराणां बलीयसाम् । अतिसञ्जातरोषाणां प्रहस्तमभिगर्जताम् ॥६-५८-६॥
translation: The huge army of powerful Vanaras saw Prahastha of terrific prowess, fierce, surrounded by Rakshasas coming towards them roaring.
word_meanings: ततः then, बलीयसाम् huge army, अभिसञ्जातरोषाणाम् of redoubtable prowess, प्रहस्तम् Prahastha, अभिगर्जताम् roaring, वानराणाम् Vanaras, महती powerful, सेना army, निर्यान्तम् coming towards, भीमम् fierce, भीमपराक्रमम् of terrific prowess, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, अभिसम्वृतम् surrounded, प्रहस्तम् Prahastha, ददर्श saw.

text: खड्गशक्त्यृष्टिबाणाश्च शूलानि मुसलानि च । गदाश्च परिघाः प्रासा विविधाश्च परश्वधाः ॥६-५८-७॥
translation: The Rakshasas rushing towards Vanaras seeking victory, seizing swords, javelins, double edged swords, pikes, mallets, maces, iron bars, spears and bows of different kinds shone brightly.
word_meanings: जयैषिणाम् seeking victory, वानरान् Vanaras, अभिधावताम् rushing towards, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, प्रगृहीतानि seizing, खडगशक्त्यृष्टिबाणाश्च swords, javelins, double edged swords, arrows, शूलानि pikes, मुसलानिच mallets, गदाश्च maces, परिघाः iron bars, प्रासाः spears, विविधाः of different kind, परिश्वधाः bows, प्रगृहीतानि taking hold, आशोभन्त shone brightly.

text: धनूंषि च विचित्राणि राक्षसानां जयैषिणाम् । प्रगृहीतान्यशोभन्त वानरानभिधावताम् ॥६-५८-८॥
translation: The Rakshasas rushing towards Vanaras seeking victory, seizing swords, javelins, double edged swords, pikes, mallets, maces, iron bars, spears and bows of different kinds shone brightly.
word_meanings: जयैषिणाम् seeking victory, वानरान् Vanaras, अभिधावताम् rushing towards, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, प्रगृहीतानि seizing, खडगशक्त्यृष्टिबाणाश्च swords, javelins, double edged swords, arrows, शूलानि pikes, मुसलानिच mallets, गदाश्च maces, परिघाः iron bars, प्रासाः spears, विविधाः of different kind, परिश्वधाः bows, प्रगृहीतानि taking hold, आशोभन्त shone brightly.

text: जगृहुः पादपांश्चापि पुष्पितान् वानरर्षभाः । शिलाश्च विपुला दीर्घा योद्धुकामाः प्लवङ्गमाः ॥६-५८-९॥
translation: The Vanaras burning with desire to fight, for their part went with huge trees in bloom, huge and long rocks.
word_meanings: योद्धुकामाः burning to fight, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, पुष्पितान् in bloom, पादपांश्चापि trees, वानरर्षभाः monkeys for their part, विपुलाः huge, दीर्घाः long, शिलाःच rocks also, जगृहुः went.

text: तेषामन्योन्यमासाद्य सङ्ग्रामः सुमहानभूत् । बहूनामश्मवृष्टिं च शरवृष्टिं च वर्षताम् ॥६-५८-१०॥
translation: Each of them approached one another with showers of rocks and many arrows and by that a great war happened.
word_meanings: अन्योन्यम् one another, आसाद्य approaching, आश्मवृष्टिम् rain of rocks, शरवर्षंच and rain of arrows, वर्षताम् showered, बहूनाम् many, तेषाम् by that, सुमहान् many, सङ्ग्रामः in war, अभूत् happened.

text: बहवो राक्षसा युद्धे बहून् वानरयूथपान् । वानरा राक्षसांश्चापि निजघ्नुर्बहवो बहून् ॥६-५८-११॥
translation: In the course of war many Rakshasas killed many Vanara leaders and many Vanaras killed many Rakshasas also.
word_meanings: युद्धे in war, बहवः many, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, बहून् many, वानरयूधपान् Vanara leaders, बहवः many, वानराः Vanaras, बहून् many, राक्षसांश्चापि Rakshasas also, निजघ्नुः killed.

text: शूलैः प्रमथिताः केचित् केचिच्च परमायुधैः । परिघैराहताः केचित् केचिच्छिन्नाः परश्वधैः ॥६-५८-१२॥
translation: Indeed, some were killed by Rakshasas with pikes, some by javelins, a few with iron bars, and a few were hacked with axes.
word_meanings: केचित् indeed, शूलैः with pikes, प्रमथिताः killed, केचिच्च some, परमायुधैः javelins, केचित् some, परिघैः with iron bars, आहताः destroyed, केचित् few, परश्वधैः with axes, छिन्नाः hacked.

text: निरुच्छ्वासाः कृताः केचित् पतिता धरणीतले । विभिन्नहृदयाः केचिदिषुसन्धानसन्दिताः ॥६-५८-१३॥
translation: Few got cut and deprived of life and fell on the ground. Some struck by arrows had their hearts broken into pieces.
word_meanings: केचित् few, कृता: cut, निरुच्छवासाः deprived of life, धरणीतले on the ground, पतिताः fell, केचित् some, इषुसंधानसन्दिताः struck by arrows, विभिन्नहृदयाः hearts broken to pieces.

text: केचिद्द्विधा कृताः खड्गैः स्फुरन्तः पतिता भुवि । वानरा राक्षसैः शूलैः पार्श्वतश्चावदारिताः ॥६-५८-१४॥
translation: Few Vanaras cut into two by Rakshasas fell down and few Vanaras fell on the ground sides of the body cleft ceased life.
word_meanings: केचित् few, वानराः Vanaras, शूलैः pikes, राक्षसैः Rakshasa, खडगैः swords, द्विधा two, कृताः cut into, पार्श्वतः sides of the body, अदारिताः cleft, स्फुरन्तः ceased of life, भुवि ground, पतिताः fell.

text: वानरैश्चापि सङ्क्रुद्धै राक्षसौघाः समन्ततः । पादपैर्गिरिशृङ्गैश्च सम्पिष्टा वसुधातले ॥६-५८-१५॥
translation: Then the highly enraged Vanaras completely crushed Rakshasas in groups by crushing them on the earth's surface with trees and mountain peaks.
word_meanings: राक्षसौघाः Rakshasas in groups, सङ्क्रुद्धैः highly enraged, वानरैः by Vanaras, समन्ततः completely, पादपैः trees, गिरिशृङ्गैश्च and mountain peaks, वसुधातले on the earth's surface, सम्पिष्टाः crushed.

text: वज्रस्पर्शतलैर्हस्तैर्मुष्टिभिश्च हता भृशम् । वैमुः शोणितमास्येभ्यो विशीर्णदशनेक्षणाः ॥६-५८-१६॥
translation: Hit by fists and hands that had the impact of thunderbolt, teeth and eyes smashed and fallen out, the Rakshasas vomited blood from their mouth excessively.
word_meanings: वज्रस्पर्शतलैः whose hands had thunderbolt impact, हस्स्सैः hit, मुष्टिभिः with fists, हताः killed, विशीर्णदशनेक्षणाः teeth, eyes having been smashed, आस्येभ्यः vomited, भृशम् excessively, शोणितम् blood, वेमुः from mouth.

text: आर्तस्वनं च स्वनतां सिंहनादं च नर्दताम् । बभूव तुमुलः शब्दो हरीणां रक्षसां युधि ॥६-५८-१७॥
translation: Tumultuous noise like the roar of lions arose in the battlefield with Vanaras and Rakshasas cries of pain.
word_meanings: आर्तस्वनम् cries of pain, स्वनताम् tumultuous clamour, सिंहनादम् like roar of lions, नर्दताम् roar, हरीणाम् monkeys, रक्षसां Rakshasas, तुमुलः tumultuous, शब्दः noise, युधि in war, बभूव arose.

text: वानरा राक्षसाः क्रुद्धा वीरमार्गमनुव्रताः । विवृत्तनयनाः क्रूराश्चक्रुः कर्माण्यभीतवत् ॥६-५८-१८॥
translation: Following the path of heroes and infuriated, their eyes reeling, the vanaras and rakshasas carried out their deeds without fear.
word_meanings: क्रुद्धाः angry, वीरमार्गम् path of heroes, अनुव्रताः following, क्रूराः cruel, विवृत्तनयनाः reeling of eyes, वानराः Vanaras, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, अभीतवत् without fear, कर्माणि deeds, चक्रुः carried out.

text: नरान्तकः कुम्भहनुर्महानादः समुन्नतः । एते प्रहस्तसचिवाः सर्वे जघ्नुर्वनौकसः ॥६-५८-१९॥
translation: Naranthaka, Kumbhahanu, Mahanada, Samunnata, all these associates of Prahastha made short work of the monkeys.
word_meanings: नरान्तकः Naranthaka, कुम्भहनुः Kumbhahanu, महानादः Mahanada, समुन्नतः Samunnata, प्रहस्तसचिवाः Prahastha's associates, एतेसर्वे all these, वनौकसः monkeys, जघ्नुः made short work.

text: तेषामापततां शीघ्रं निघ्नतां चापि वानरान् । द्विविदो गिरिशृङ्गेण जघानैकं नरान्तकम् ॥६-५८-२०॥
translation: Rushing at great speed, the Rakshasas and also killing the Vanaras in that way, Dwivida alone struck down Naranthaka with a mountain peak.
word_meanings: शीघ्रम् at great speed, आपतताम् rushing, वानरान् Vanaras, निघ्नतांचापि also killing, तेषाम् in that way, एकम् one, नरान्तकम् Naranthaka, द्विविदः Dwivida, गिरिशृङ्गेण with peak of a mountain, जघान struck.

The Rakshasas and Vanaras swam across the river even though it were difficult to cross as leaders of elephant herds would cross a lotus pond covered with pollen of lotuses.

text: ते प्राप्य विशिखा नीलं विनिर्भिद्य समाहिताः । महीं जग्मुर्महावेगा रुषिता इव पन्नगाः ॥६-५८-३७॥
translation: The arrows discharged by Prahastha, penetrated piercing into Nila's body at great speed like infuriated serpents and went straight into the earth.

text: नीलः शरैरभिहतो निशितैर्ज्वलनोपमैः । स तं परमदुर्धर्षमापतन्तं महाकपिः ॥६-५८-३८॥
प्रहस्तं ताडयामास वृक्षमुत्पाट्य वीर्यवान् ॥६-५८-३९॥
translation: Great Vanara, a valiant one, Nila having been hit with arrows sharp as tongues of fire, struck Prahastha, who is most difficult to encounter and rushing towards him by uprooting a tree.
word_meanings: महाकपिः great Vanara, वीर्यवान् valiant one, सः he, नीलः Nila, निशितैः sharp, ज्वलनोपमैः glowing like tongues of fire, शरैः arrows, अभिहतः having been hit, वृक्षम् tree, उत्पाट्य uprooting, परमदुर्धर्षम् most difficult to encounter, आपतन्तम् rushing towards, तंप्रहस्तम् that Prahastha, ताडयामास struck.

text: स तेनाभिहतः क्रुद्धो नदन् राक्षसपुङ्गवः । ववर्ष शरवर्षाणि प्लवङ्गानां चमूपतौ ॥६-५८-४०॥
translation: Having been struck by Nila, the Rakshasa leader became furious, and began to roar and showered rain arrows on the monkeys.
word_meanings: तेन by that, अभिहतः having been struck, सःराक्षसपुङ्गवः that Rakshasa leader, क्रुद्धः became furious, नदन् roaring, प्लवङ्गानाम् monkeys, चमूपतौ bull among Rakshasas, शरवर्षाणि rain of arrows, ववर्ष showered.

text: तस्य बाणगणान् घोरान् राक्षसस्य महाबलः । अपारयन् वारयितुं प्रत्यगृह्णान्निमीलितः ॥६-५८-४१॥
translation: Not able to check the volley of arrows released by the Rakshasa, Nila received them with closed eyes.
word_meanings: महाबलः mighty, तस्य his, राक्षसस्य Rakshasa's, बाणगणान् volley of arrows, वारयितुम् to check, अपारयन् not able to, निमीलितः with closed eyes, प्रत्यगृह्णात् received them.

text: यथैव गोवृषो वर्षं शारदं शीघ्रमागतम् । एवमेव प्रहस्तस्य शरवर्षं दुरासदम् । निमीलिताक्षः सहसा नीलः सेहे सुदारुणम् ॥६-५८-४२॥
translation: Just as a mighty bull faces sudden downpour of autumnal rain, in the same way Nila precisely tolerated the rain of arrows of Prahastha, which are difficult to face, with eyes closed.
word_meanings: शीघ्रम् quickly, आगतम् downpour, शारदम् autumnal, वर्षम् rain, गोवृषः mighty bull, यथैव in the same way, एवमेव precisely, नीलः Nila, प्रहस्तस्य Prahastha's, दुरासदम् difficult to face, सहसा fierce, शरवर्षम् rain of arrows, निमीलिताक्षः with eyes closed, सेहे tolerated.

text: रोषितः शरवर्षेण सालेन महता महान् । प्रजघान हयान्नीलः प्रहस्तस्य मनोजवान् ॥६-५८-४३॥
translation: Neela endowed with great prowess, became angry (by the rain of arrows showered on him) and hurled a huge Sala tree at Prahastha.
word_meanings: महाबलः of great prowess, महान् great, नीलः Neela, शरवर्षेण by the rain of arrows, रोषितः angry, महता huge, सालेन Sala tree, प्रहस्तस्य at Prahastha, हयान् horses, प्रजघान hurled.

text: ततः स चापमुद्गृह्य प्रहस्तस्य महाबलः । बभञ्ज तरसा नीलो ननाद च पुनःपुनः ॥६-५८-४४॥
translation: Thereupon, Neela firmly holding the bow of mighty Prahastha broke it again and again and roared
word_meanings: ततः thereupon, सः he, चापम् bow, उद्गृह्य firmly holding, महाबलः mighty, प्रहस्तस्य Prahastha's, बभञ्ज broke, पुनः again, पुनः and again, ननादच roared

text: विधनुस्तु कृतस्तेन प्रहस्तो वाहिनीपतिः । प्रगृह्य मुसलं घोरं स्यन्दनादवपुप्लुवे ॥६-५८-४५॥
translation: Deprived of bow and chariot, Prahastha, the CommanderinChief seizing a terrific mallet jumped down from the chariot.
word_meanings: तेन by then, विधनुः deprived of bow, कृतः and chariot, वाहिनीपतिः CommanderinChief, सःप्रहस्तः that Prahastha, घोरम् terrific, मुसलम् mallet, प्रगृह्य seizing, स्यन्दनात् from the chariot, अवपुप्लुवे jumped down.

text: तावुभौ वाहिनीमुख्यौ जातवैरौ तरस्विनौ । स्थितौ क्षतजदिग्धाङ्गौ प्रभिन्नाविव कुञ्जरौ ॥६-५८-४६॥
translation: Both Nila and Prahastha, deadly enemies, CommanderinChief of the armies, their limbs disfigured, wetted with blood, stood like elephants.
word_meanings: जातवैरौ deadly enemies, तरस्विनौ strong, तौ they, उभौ both, वाहिनीमुख्यौ CommanderinChief of army, क्षतजगदिग्दाङ्गौ their limbs wetted with blood, प्रभिन्नौ disfigured, कुञ्जरौइव like elephants, स्थितौ stood.

text: उल्लिखन्तौ सुतीक्ष्णाभिर्दंष्ट्राभिरितरेतरम् । सिंहशार्दूलसदृशौ सिंहशार्दूलचेष्टितौ ॥६-५८-४७॥
विक्रान्तविजयौ वीरौ समरेष्वनिवर्तिनौ । काङ्क्षमाणौ यशः प्राप्तुं वृत्रवासवयोः समौ ॥६-५८-४८॥
translation: Tearing up each other with exceedingly sharp teeth they were behaving like a lion and tiger. They had won many wars and never turned back in war. They were heroes like Vrta and Indra desiring to conquer and attain fame.
word_meanings: सुतीक्ष्णाभिः exceedingly sharp, दंष्ट्राभिः teeth, इतरेतरम् each other, उल्लिखन्तौ tearing up, सिंहशार्दूलसदृशौ like lion and tiger, सिंहशार्दूलचेष्टितौ behaving like lion and tiger, विक्रान्तविजयौ who won many wars, समरेषु in wars, अनिवर्तिनौ never turned back, वीरौ heroes, वृत्रवासवयोः demon Vrta and Indra, यशः fame, सह to conquer, प्राप्तुम् to attain, काङ्क्षमाणाविव desiring to win.

text: आजघान तदा नीलं ललाटे मुसलेन सः । प्रहस्तः परमायत्तस्तस्य सुस्राव शोणितम् ॥६-५८-४९॥
translation: Then Prahastha struck speedily with a mallet and hit Neela on the forehead and blood flowed from there.
word_meanings: तदा then, सःप्रहस्तः Prahastha, परमायत्तः speedily, मुसलेन with mallet, नीलम् Neela, ललाटे forehead, आजघान struck, ततः then, शोणितम् blood, सुस्राव flowed.

text: ततः शोणितदिग्धाङ्गः प्रगृह्य सुमहातरुम् । प्रहस्तस्योरसि क्रुद्धो विससर्ज महाकपिः ॥६-५८-५०॥
translation: Then drenched with blood, Neela was enraged and took hold of a huge tree and hurled at the chest of Prahastha.
word_meanings: ततः then, महाकपिः great Vanara, शोणितदिग्धाङ्गः drenched with blood, क्रुद्धः enraged, सुमहातरुम् huge tree, प्रगृह्यच taking hold, प्रहस्तस्य Prahastha's, उरसि chest, विससर्ज hurled.

text: तमचिन्त्य प्रहारं स प्रगृह्य मुसलं महत् । अभिदुद्राव बलिनं बलान्नीलं प्लवङ्गमम् ॥६-५८-५१॥
translation: He (Prahastha), not caring for the wound, taking a huge mallet went towards that courageous monkey (Neela).
word_meanings: सः he, तम् that, प्रहारम् wound, अचिन्त्य not caring, महत् huge, मुसलम् mallet, प्रगृह्य taking hold, बलिनम् strong, प्लवङ्गमम् monkey, नीलम् Neela, बलात् courageous, अभिदुद्राव went towards.

text: तमुग्रवेगं संरब्धमापतन्तं महाकपिः । ततः सम्प्रेक्ष्य जग्राह महावेगो महाशिलाम् ॥६-५८-५२॥
translation: Then, seeing Prahastha waging and coming towards him, the great monkey, Neela, endowed with high speed threw a huge rock.
word_meanings: ततः then, महाकपिः great monkey, उग्रवेगम् endowed with high speed, संरब्दम् waging, आपतन्तम् coming towards, तम् him, सम्प्रेक्ष्य seeing, महावेगः endowed with speed, महाशिलाम् huge rock, जग्राह hurled.

text: तस्य युद्धाभिकामस्य मृधे मुसलयोधिनः । प्रहस्तस्य शिलां नीलो मूर्ध्नि तूर्णमपातयत् ॥६-५८-५३॥
translation: Fighting with the mallet, Neela quickly dropped the rock on that Prahastha's forehead
word_meanings: नीलः Neela, शिलाम् rock, युद्धाभिकामस्य desiring to fight, मृथे forehead, मुसलयोधिनः mallet, तस्यप्रहस्तस्य that Prahastha's, मूर्ध्नि forehead, तूर्णम् quickly, अपातयत् dropped.

text: सा तेन कपिमुख्येन विमुक्ता महती शिला । बिभेद बहुधा घोरा प्रहस्तस्य शिरस्तदा ॥६-५८-५४॥
translation: Hurled by Neela, the foremost of monkeys, the huge rock broke the head of Prahastha into pieces.
word_meanings: सातेन by that, तेनकपिमुख्येन by the foremost of Vanaras, विमुक्ता hurled, महती huge, घोरा dreadful, शिला rock, प्रहस्तस्य Prahastha's, शिरः head, बहुधा many pieces, बिभेद broken.

text: स गतासुर्गतश्रीको गतसत्त्वो गतेन्द्रियः । पपात सहसा भूमौ छिन्नमूल इव द्रुमः ॥६-५८-५५॥
translation: Life, splendour, strength, and senses departed Prahastha fell instantly on the ground like a tree cut at the bottom.
word_meanings: गतासुः life gone, गतश्रीकः splendour gone, गतसत्त्वः strength gone, गतेन्द्रियः senses gone, सः he, छिन्नमूलः tree at the bottom, द्रुमःइव like tree, सहसा instantly, भूमौ on ground, पपात fell.

text: प्रभिन्नशिरसस्तस्य बहु सुस्राव शोणितम् । शरीरादपि सुस्राव गिरेः प्रस्रवणं यथा ॥६-५८-५६॥
translation: From his shattered head much blood flowed from all over the body just as a spring from a mountain.
word_meanings: तस्य his, विभिन्नशिरसः shattered head, बहु much, शोणितम् blood, सुस्राव flowed, शरीरादपि all over the body, गिरेः mountain, प्रस्रवणंयथा like a spring from, सुस्राव flowed.

text: हते प्रहस्ते नीलेन तदकम्प्यं महद्बलम् । रक्षसामप्रहृष्टानां लङ्कामभिजगाम ह ॥६-५८-५७॥
translation: Prahastha having been killed by Neela, the cheerless Rakshasas and unshakeable troops could not stay there any more.
word_meanings: नीलेन by Neela, प्रहस्ते Prahastha, हते having been killed, अहृष्टानाम् cheerless, राक्षसानाम् of Rakshasas, अकम्प्यम् unshakeable, तत् बलम् that troops, लङ्काम् from Lanka, अभिजगामह could not stay there.

text: न शेकुः समरे स्थातुं निहते वाहिनीपतौ । सेतुबन्धं समासाद्य विकीर्णं सलिलं यथा ॥६-५८-५८॥
translation: The CommanderinChief having been killed the troops could not remain there just as water reached a breached dam.
word_meanings: वाहिनीपतौ CommanderinChief, निहते killed, विशीर्णम् breached, सेतुबन्दम् dam, समासाद्य reaching, सलिलंयथा like the water, समवस्थातुम् stationary, नशेकुः not remain.

text: हते तस्मिंश्चमूमुख्ये राक्षसास्ते निरुद्यमाः । रक्षःपतिगृहं गत्वा ध्यानमूकत्वमास्थिताः । प्राप्ताः शोकार्णवं तीव्रं निस्सञ्ज्ञा इव ते ऽभवन् ॥६-५८-५९॥
translation: CommanderinChief killed, those Rakshasas reduced to speechlessness went to the abode of their Lord and remained without consciousness.
word_meanings: चमूमुख्ये CommanderinChief, तस्मिन् his, हते killed, तेराक्षसाः those Rakshasas, निरुद्यमाः reduced to, रक्षःपतिगृहम् abode of the Lord, गत्वा went, ध्यनमूकत्वम् speechless, आगताः became, ते they, विसंज्ञाःइव without consciousness, अभवन् remained.

text: ततस्तु नीलो विजयी महाबलः प्रशस्यमानः स्वकृतेन कर्मणा । समेत्य रामेण सलक्ष्मणेन च प्रहृष्टरूपस्तु बभूव यूथपः ॥६-५८-६०॥
तस्मिन् हते राक्षससैन्यपाले प्लवङ्गमानामृषभेण युद्धे । भीमायुधं सागरतुल्यवेगं विदुद्रुवे राक्षसराजसैन्यम् ॥६-५९-१॥
translation: Commander in chief of the Rakshasa army killed by Neela, the bull of Vanaras, the army Rakshasas with dreadful weapons which were like the fury of an ocean, ran.
word_meanings: राक्षससैन्यपाले commander in chief of the army, तस्मिन् in that, युद्धे war, प्लवङ्गमानाम् ऋषभेण bull of the Vanaras, Neela निहते has been killed, भीमायुधम् with dreadful weapons, सागरतुल्यवेगम् like the ocean in fury, राक्षसराजसैन्यम् Rakshasa king's army, विदुद्रुवे ran.

text: गत्वा ऽथ रक्षोधिपतेः शशंसुः सेनापतिं पावकसूनुशस्तम् । तच्चापि तेषां वचनं निशम्य रक्षोधिपः क्रोधवशं जगाम ॥६-५९-२॥
translation: Having gone to the king of Rakshasas, the survivors said, "Prahastha is killed by the son of fire god." Thereafter, the king of Rakshasas fell prey to anger.
word_meanings: अथ and then, गत्वा having gone, सेनापतिम् commander in chief, पावकसूनुशस्तम् son of firegod killed, रक्षोधिपतेः king of Rakshasas, शशंसुः the survivors, रक्षोधिपः king of Rakshasas, तेषाम् in that way, तत् thereafter, वचनम् words, निशम्य revealed, क्रोधवशम् under the spell of anger, जगाम became.

text: सङ्ख्ये प्रहस्तं निहतं निशम्य शोकार्दितः क्रोधपरीतचेताः । उवाच तान्नैर्ऋतयोधमुख्यानिन्द्रो यथा चामरयोधमुख्यान् ॥६-५९-३॥
translation: Even as Rakshasas revealed about Prahastha's death, tormented by grief and anger Ravana spoke to Rakshasa troops just as Indra spoke to celestial troops.
word_meanings: सङ् ख्ये relating to, प्रहस्तम् Prahastha, निहतम् death, निशम्य revealed, शोकार्दितः sorrowful, क्रोधपरीतचेताः tormented with anger, इन्द्रः Indra, निर्जरयोथमुख्याविव commanders of celestial troops, तान् to them, राक्षसयूथमुख्यान् to the Rakshasa troops, उवाच said.

text: नावज्ञा रिपवे कार्या यैरिन्द्रबलसूदनः । सूदितः सैन्यपालो मे सानुयात्रः सकुञ्जरः ॥६-५९-४॥
translation: "No low opinion to be entertained with regard to an enemy by whom my commander in chief of the army was killed, who is capable of killing the army of Indra with his followers and elephants."
word_meanings: इन्द्रबलसादनः one who is capable of destroying Indra's army, सानुयात्रः followers, सकुञ्जरः elephants, मेसैन्यपालः my commander in chief, यैः he who, सूदितः capable of killing, रिपवे with regard to enemy, अवज्ञा low opinion, नकार्या not to think.

text: सो ऽहं रिपुविनाशाय विजयायाविचारयन् । स्वयमेव गमिष्यामि रणशीर्षं तदद्भुतम् ॥६-५९-५॥
translation: "I shall go myself without thinking to that wonderful battle scene and put an end to the enemy and succeed."
word_meanings: सः he अहम् I, अविचारयन् without thinking, रिपुविनाशाय to put an end to the enemy, विजयाय for success, अद्भुतम् wonderful, तत् that, रणशीर्षम् battle scene, स्वयमेव I shall myself, गमिष्यामि will go.

text: अद्य तद्वानरानीकं रामं च सहलक्ष्मणम् । निर्दहिष्यामि वाणौघैर्वनं दीप्तैरिवाग्निभिः ॥६-५९-६॥
translation: "Now I will go and burn up that army of Vanaras along with Lakshmana and Rama with the stream of my arrows just as forest fire without the use of fire."
word_meanings: अद्य now, तत् that, वानरानीकम् army of Vanaras, सहलक्ष्मणम् along with Lakshmana, रामंच and Rama, दीप्स्सैः burn, अनगिभिः without the use of fire, वनमिव like a forest, बाणौघैः with streams of arrows, निर्धहिष्यामि burn up.

text: स एवमुक्त्वा ज्वलनप्रकाशं रथं तुरङ्गोत्तमराजयुक्तम् । प्रकाशमानं वपुषा ज्वलन्तं समारुरोहामरराजशत्रुः ॥६-५९-७॥
translation: Ravana, the enemy of the king of Devatas, having spoken like that ascended a chariot yoked to the best of horses, shining by virtue of its form (golden) and luminous like fire.
word_meanings: अमरराजशत्रुः enemy of king of Devatas, सः he, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having said, ज्वलनप्रकाशम् luminous like fire, तुरङ्गोत्तमराजयुक्तम् yoked to the best of horses, प्रकाशमानम् blazing, वपुषा by virtue of its form (golden), ज्वलन्तम् shining, रथम् chariot, समारुरोह ascended.

text: स शङ्खभैरीपणवप्रणादैरास्फोटितक्ष्वेलितसिंहनादैः । पुण्यैः स्तवैश्चाप्यभिपूज्यमानस्तदा ययौ राक्षसराजमुख्यः ॥६-५९-८॥
translation: As the foremost king of the Rakshasas went forth, a blast of sounds of conchs, beat of drums and clapping of arms and the roaring sounds followed by the chanting of auspicious verses sung by the Rakshasas eulogizing and honouring the king highly.
word_meanings: तदा then, राक्षसराजमुख्यः foremost king of the Rakshasas, सः he, शङ्खभेरीपणवप्रणादैः blast of conchs, beat of drums, and clapping of arms अस्फोटितक्षेळ्वितसिंहनादैः clapping of arms and sounds like the roar of a lion, पुण्यैः chanting sounds of agreeable verses, स्तवैश्चापि eulogizing, अभिपूज्यमानः honoured very highly, ययौ went forth.

text: स शैलजीमूतनिकाशरूपैर्मांसादनैः पावकदीप्तनेत्रेः । बभौ वृतो राक्षसराजमुख्यो भूतैर्वृतो रुद्र इवासुरेशः ॥६-५९-९॥
translation: The Rakshasa king surrounded by Rakshasas who resembled mountains and clouds in form seemed like Rudra surrounded by asuras.
word_meanings: शैलजीमून्तिकाशरूपैः by forms that resembled mountains and clouds, पावक दीप्तनेत्रैः whose eyes were like fire, मांसाशनैः flesh eaters, सः he, राक्षसराजमुख्यः Rakshasa king, भूतैः by Rakshasas, वृतः surrounded, असुरेशः asuras, रुद्रुःइव like Rudra, बभौ seemed.

text: ततो नगर्याः सहसा महौजा निष्क्रम्य तद्वानरसैन्यमुग्रम् । महार्णवाभ्रस्तनितं ददर्शं समुद्यतं पादपशैलहस्तम् ॥६-५९-१०॥
translation: Thereafter, Ravana possessed with great splendour stopped at the city and saw the army of Vanaras collected together looking like an ocean of clouds wielding trees and rocks.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, महौजाः possessed with great splendour, सहसा forcibly, नगर्याः at the city, निष्क्रम्य stopped, उग्रम् in front, महार्णवाभ्रस्तनितम् resembling great ocean and cloud, समुद्यतम् collected together, पादपशैलहस्तम् taking trees and rocks, तत् वानरसैन्यम् the Vanara army, ददर्श saw.

text: तद्राक्षसानीकमतिप्रचण्डमालोक्य रामो भुजगेन्द्रबाहुः । विभीषणं शस्त्रभृतां वरिष्ठमुवाच सेनानुगतः पृथुश्रीः ॥६-५९-११॥
translation: Rama, whose arms were like the king of serpents, shining with splendour, followed by army, seeing the army of Rakshasas exceedingly furious, spoke to Vibheeshana the foremost of the wielder of weapons.
word_meanings: भुजगेन्द्रबाहुः whose arms are like king of serpents (smooth and strong), सेवानुगतः followed by army, पृथुश्रीः shining with splendour, रामः Rama, अतिप्रचण्डम् exceedingly furious, तत् that, राक्षसानीकम् Rakshasa army, आलोक्य seeing, शस्त्रभृताम् wielder of weapons, वरिष्ठम् foremost, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, उवाच spoke.

text: नानापताकाध्वजशस्त्रजुष्टं प्रासासिशूलायुधशस्त्रजुष्टम् । सैन्यं गजेन्द्रोपमनागजुष्टं कस्येदमक्षोभ्यमभीरुजुष्टम् ॥६-५९-१२॥
translation: "Under whose command is this unshakeable army with several kinds of flags, posts and weapons armed with missiles, tridents, swords spikes and darts, with elephants the size of Mahendra mountain"
word_meanings: नानापताकध्वजशस्त्रजुष्टम् several kinds of flags, posts and weapons, प्रासासिशूलायुथवज्रजुष्टम् armed with missiles, tridents, and weapons like darts, swords and spikes, अभीरुजुष्टम् unshakeable, महेन्द्रोपमनागजुष्टम् elephants of the size of Mahendra mountain, अक्षोभ्यम् soldiers, इदम् this, सैन्यम् army, कस्य whose.

text: ततस्तु रामस्य निशम्य वाक्यं विभीषणः शक्रसमानवीर्यः । शशंस रामस्य बलप्रवेकं महात्मनां राक्षसपुङ्गवानाम् ॥६-५९-१३॥
translation: Thereupon, Vibheeshana, equal to Indra in valour, on hearing the great soul Rama, revealed about the Rakshasa army endowed with great strength.
word_meanings: ततः thereupon, शक्रसमानवीर्यः hero equal to Indra, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, रामस्य Rama's, वाक्यम् words, निशम्य on hearing, महात्मनाम् great soul, राक्षसपुङ्गवानाम् among the Rakshasa leaders, बलप्रवेगम् endowed with great strength, रामस्य to Rama, शशंस revealed.

text: यो ऽसौ गजस्कन्धगतो महात्मा नवोदितार्कोपमताम्रवक्त्रः । प्रकम्पयन्नागशिरो ऽभ्युपैति ह्यकम्पनं त्वेनमवेहि राजन् ॥६-५९-१४॥
translation: "O King! the one seated on the elephant, by whose weight the elephant head is shaking, whose coppery face is like the rising sun, a gigantic one is Akampana."
word_meanings: राजन् king!, गजस्कन्धगतः by whom seated on the elephant, is shaking (by his weight) the elephant's head, नवोदितार्कोपमताम्रवक्त्रः coppery face resembles rising Sun, महात्मा great, यःअसौ he who, नागशिरः mounted on elephant, संकम्पयन् Akampana, अभ्युपैति gigantic, एनम् he is, अकम्पनम् Akampana, अवेहि know.

text: यो ऽसौ रथस्थो मृगराजकेतुर्धून्वन् धनुः शक्रधनुःप्रकाशम् । करीव भात्युग्रविवृत्तदंष्ट्रः स इन्द्रजिन्नाम वरप्रधानः ॥६-५९-१५॥
translation: "The one on the chariot, distinguished by the sign of a lion, and making sound with his bow, splendid as Indra's bow with terrific teeth projected forward looks like an elephant, eminent by virtue of the boons bestowed is Indrajith by name."
word_meanings: रथस्थः from the chariot, मृगराजकेतुः distinguished by the sign of lion, शक्रधनुःप्रकाशम् splendid as the bow of Indra, धनुः bow, धुन्वन् making sound, यःअसौ he who, उग्रविवृत्तदंष्ट्रः with terrific teeth projected forward, करीव elephant, भाति looks like, सः he, वरप्रधानः eminent by the boons bestowed, इन्द्रजित् नाम Indrajith by name.

text: यश्चैष विन्ध्यास्तमहेन्द्रकल्पो धन्वी रथस्थो ऽतिरथो ऽतिवीरः । विस्फारयंश्चापमतुल्यमानं नाम्ना ऽतिकायो ऽतिविवृद्धकायः ॥६-५९-१६॥
translation: "He who resembles Vindhya Mountain in the west (where the sun sets) and the Mahendra mountain (in size) seated on the chariot, is a great chariotwarrior, a hero unequalled in size, wielding a bow whose body is grown out of size, who is coming in sight is by name Atikaya."
word_meanings: व्निध्यास्तमहेन्द्रकल्पः resembles Vindhya mountain in the west and Mahendra mountain, धन्वी stretching his bow and making sound, रथस्थः from the chariot, अतिरथः great chariot warrior, अतिवीरः great hero, अतुल्यमानम् unequalled in size, चापम् bow, विष्पारयन् yonder, अतिविवृद्धकायः body grown out of size, यःएषः he in that way, अयम् coming in sight, नाम्ना named, अतिकायः Atikaya.

text: यो ऽसौ नवार्कोदितताम्रचक्षुरारुह्य घण्टानिनदप्रणादम् । गजं खरं गर्जति वै महात्मा महोदरो नाम स एष वीरः ॥६-५९-१७॥
translation: "He whose eyes are coppery red in anger, who rides on elephant resembles the beating of bells, roars in harsh tone are a great courageous one by the name Mahodara."
word_meanings: नवार्कोदितताम्रचक्षुः whose eyes are coppery red in anger, यःअसौ he Oh!, घण्टनिनदप्रणादम् whose trumpeting resembles beating of bells, गजम् elephant, आरुह्य mounted, खरम् harsh, गर्जति roars, महात्मा great, सःएषःवीरः he in that way a courageous one, महोदरोनाम by name Mahodara.

text: यो ऽसौ हयं काञ्चनचित्रभाण्डमारुह्य सन्ध्याभ्रगिरिप्रकाशम् । प्रासं समुद्यम्य मरीचिनद्धं पिशाच एषो ऽशनितुल्यवेगः ॥६-५९-१८॥
translation: "He who is mounted on horses decorated with gold shining, like a mountain crowned with cloud, radiant as the Sun holding the shining yokes coming at high speed is by name Pisacha."
word_meanings: सन्ध्याभ्रगिरिप्रकाशम् shining like a mountain crowned with cloud, यः he, असौ Oh!, काञ्चनचित्रभाण्डम् decorated with gold jewels, हयम् horses, आरुह्य mounted, मरीचिनद्धम् radiant like the Sun, प्रासम् holding the yoke, समुद्यम्य ascended, एषः in that way, अशनितुल्यवेगः of high speed, पिशाचः Pisacha.

text: यश्चैष शूलं निशितं प्रगृह्य विद्युत्प्रभं किङ्करवज्रवेगम् । वृषेन्द्रमास्थाय गिरिप्रकाशमायाति यो ऽसौ त्रिशिरा यशस्वी ॥६-५९-१९॥
translation: "He who comes firmly shining like lightning, surpassing thunderbolt in speed, seizing a trident, riding a Lordly bull shining like a mountain is the famous Trisira."
word_meanings: यःएषः he in that way, निशितम् firmly, विद्युत्प्रभम् shining like lightning, किङ्करवज्रवेगम् surpassing the thunderbolt in speed, शूलम् trident, प्रगृह्य seizing, गिरिप्रकाशम् shining like mountain, वृषेन्द्रम् Lordly bull, आरुह्य riding, आयाति coming, सःअसौ he is, यशस्वी famous, यः he, त्रिशिराः Trisira.

text: असौ च जीमूतनिकाशरूपः कुम्भः पृथुव्यूढसुजातवक्षाः । समाहितः पन्नगराजकेतुर्विस्फारयन् भाति धनुर्विधून्वन् ॥६-५९-२०॥
translation: "There comes Kumbha whose form is like a cloud in form, whose chest is fleshy and broad. He is fully prepared, coming with a sign of the king of serpents (Vasuki) stretching his bow."
word_meanings: जीमूतनिकाशरूपः in the form of cloud, पृथुव्यूढसुजातवक्षाः of fleshy well shaped broad chest, समाहितः fully prepared, पन्नगराजकेतुः with the sign of the king of serpents, असौ he is, कुम्भं Kumbha, धनुः bow, विधून्वन् , विष्पारयन् stretching, याति there comes.

text: यश्चैष जाम्बूनदवज्रजुष्टं दीप्तं सधूमं परिघं प्रगृह्य । आयाति रक्षोबलकेतुभूतस्त्वसौ निकुम्भो ऽद्भुतघोरकर्मा ॥६-५९-२१॥
translation: "There comes Nikumbha, studded with gold and diamonds, shining and smoky, who is the chief of Rakshasa army seizing an iron club, is capable of wonderful and terrific deeds."
word_meanings: यःएषः he in that way, जाम्बूनदवज्रजुष्टम् studded with gold and diamonds, दीप्तम् shining, सधूमम् smoky, परिघम् iron club, प्रगृह्य seizing, आयाति comes, सःअसौ he is, रक्षोबलकेतुभूतः chief of all Rakshasa army, अद्भुतघोरकर्मा capable of wonderful and terrible deeds, निकुम्भः Nikumbha.

text: यश्चैष चापासिशरौघजुष्टं पताकिनं पावकदीप्तरूपम् । रथं समास्थाय विभात्युदग्रो नरान्तको ऽसौ नगशृङ्गयोधी ॥६-५९-२२॥
translation: Again, comes Naranthaka, with multitude of swords and arrows, mounted on top of a chariot with flags, blazing like fire, who fights with mountain peaks.
word_meanings: चापासिशरौघजुष्टम् with multitude of swords and arrows, पताकिनम् with flags, पावकदीप्तरूपम् blazing like fire, रथम् chariot, समास्थाय mounted on, यःएषः he that way, विभाति glorious, उदग्रः on top, असौ he is, नगशृङ्गयोधी fights with mountain peaks, नरान्तकः Naranthaka.

text: यश्चैष नानाविधघोररूपैर्व्याघ्रोष्ट्रनागेन्द्रमृगाश्ववक्त्रैः । भूतैर्वृतो भाति विवृत्तनेत्रैः सो ऽसौ सुराणामपि दर्पहन्ता ॥६-५९-२३॥
translation: "One who is surrounded by several hideous forms, like heads of tigers, camels, Lordly elephants and horses, rolling eyes, just as Rudra by his attendants, who is surrounded by Rakshasas and is humbled by the pride of even Devatas, over him shines the white canopy resembling the moon with slender ribs is the king of Rakshasas."
word_meanings: यःएषः he that way, नानाविधघोररूपैः surrounded by several hideous forms, व्याघ्रोष्ट्रनागेन्द्रमृगाश्ववक्स्रैः heads of tigers, camels, Lordly elephants, deer and horses, विवृत्तनेत्रैः rolling eyes, भूतैः ghosts, वृतः surrounded, भाति remains, सःअसौ he is, सुराणामपि even for Devatas, दर्पहन्ता humbles pride, एषः that way, महात्मा great, रक्षोधिपतिः king of Rakshasas, इन्दुप्रतिमम् like moon, सूक्ष्मशलाकम् white canopy, अग्य्रम् slender, सितम् ribs, छत्रम् umbrella, यत्र there, विभाति shines, अत्र there, भूतैः beings, वृतः surrounded, रुद्रःइव like Rudra, विभाति shines.

text: यत्रैतदिन्दुप्रतिमं विभाति च्छत्रं सितं सूक्ष्मशलाकमग्र्यम् । अत्रैष रक्षोधिपतिर्महात्मा भूतैर्वृतो रुद्र इवावभाति ॥६-५९-२४॥
translation: "One who is surrounded by several hideous forms, like heads of tigers, camels, Lordly elephants and horses, rolling eyes, just as Rudra by his attendants, who is surrounded by Rakshasas and is humbled by the pride of even Devatas, over him shines the white canopy resembling the moon with slender ribs is the king of Rakshasas."
word_meanings: यःएषः he that way, नानाविधघोररूपैः surrounded by several hideous forms, व्याघ्रोष्ट्रनागेन्द्रमृगाश्ववक्स्रैः heads of tigers, camels, Lordly elephants, deer and horses, विवृत्तनेत्रैः rolling eyes, भूतैः ghosts, वृतः surrounded, भाति remains, सःअसौ he is, सुराणामपि even for Devatas, दर्पहन्ता humbles pride, एषः that way, महात्मा great, रक्षोधिपतिः king of Rakshasas, इन्दुप्रतिमम् like moon, सूक्ष्मशलाकम् white canopy, अग्य्रम् slender, सितम् ribs, छत्रम् umbrella, यत्र there, विभाति shines, अत्र there, भूतैः beings, वृतः surrounded, रुद्रःइव like Rudra, विभाति shines.

text: असौ किरीटी चलुकुण्डलास्यो नगेन्द्रविन्ध्योपमभीमकायः । महेन्द्रवैवस्वतदर्पहन्ता रक्षोधिपः सूर्य इवावभाति ॥६-५९-२५॥
translation: "There is the king of Rakshasas shining like Sun, whose countenance shines with hanging earrings, of terrible form like the Himalayas and Vindhya, who has humbled the pride of Mahendra and Yama."
word_meanings: किरीटी decked with crown, चलकुण्डलास्यः countenance with hanging earrings, नगेन्द्रविन्ध्योपमभीमकायः of terrible form like Himalayas and Vindhya, महेन्द्रवैवस्वतदर्पहन्ता who has humbled the pride of Mahendra and Yama, रक्षोधिपः king of Rakshasas, सूर्यःइव like Sun, अवभाति shining.

text: प्रत्युवाच ततो रामो विभीषणमरिन्दमम् । अहो दीप्तो महातेजा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः ॥६-५९-२६॥
translation: Then Rama the scourge of enemies replied Vibheeshana, "Oh! Ravana! King of Rakshasas is endowed with luminous glory."
word_meanings: ततः then, अरिन्दमः scourge of enemies, रामः Rama, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, प्रत्युवाच replied, अहो Oh, राक्षसेश्वरः Rakshasa king, रावणः Ravana, दीप्तमहातेजाः endowed with great luminous glory.

text: आदित्य इव दुष्प्रेक्षो रश्मिभिर्भाति रावणः । सुव्यक्तं लक्षये ह्यस्य रूपं तेजस्समावृतम् ॥६-५९-२७॥
translation: "Ravana blazing like the sun is difficult to gaze even. His shine is spread all over and not perceptible to discern."
word_meanings: रावणः Ravana, रश्मिभिः blazing, आदित्यःइव like the Sun, दुष्प्रेक्ष्य difficult to gaze, भाति shining, अस्य his, तेजःसमावृतम् brilliance spread all over, रूपम् form, सुव्यक्तम् to discern, लक्ष्यतेहि not perceptible.

text: देवदानववीराणां वपुर्नैवंविधं भवेत् । यादृशं राक्षसेन्द्रस्य वपुरेतत् प्रकाशते ॥६-५९-२८॥
translation: Among the Devas and Danavas such brilliance is not there. He shines so brightly.
word_meanings: देवदावनवीराणाम् among the Devas and Danavas, वपुः brilliance, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य Ravana's, एतत् such, वपुः brilliance, यादृशम् , प्रकाशते shines, एवंविधम् like this, नभवेत् not brightly.

text: सर्वे पर्वतसङ्काशाः सर्वे पर्वतयोधिनः । सर्वे दीप्तायुधधरा योधाश्चास्य महौजसः ॥६-५९-२९॥
translation: "The great warriors of Ravana fighting in war are like mountains and all fought with mountains and glowing weapons."
word_meanings: महोजस: great warriors, अस्य of him, योधाः in war, सर्वे all, पर्वतसङ्काशाः like mountain, सर्वे all, पर्वतयोधिनः fight with mountains, सर्वे all, दीप्तायुधधराः glowing weapons.

text: भाति राक्षसराजो ऽसौ प्रदीप्तैर्भीमविक्रमैः । भूतैः परिवृतस्तीक्ष्णैर्देहवद्भिरिवान्तकः ॥६-५९-३०॥
translation: "The Rakshasa king is surrounded by sharp, furious beings of terrible valour shining like the god of death."
word_meanings: प्रदीप्त्तै: shining brilliance, भीमविक्रमैः of terrible valour, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, देहवद्भिः furious forms, परिवृत surrounded by, भूतैः beings, असौ oh, रक्षोराजः Rakshasa king, अन्तकःइव like god of death, भाति shining.

text: दिष्ट्या ऽयमद्य पापात्मा मम दृष्टिपथं गतः । अद्य क्रोधं विमोक्ष्यामि सीताहरणसम्भवम् ॥६-५९-३१॥
translation: "By his good luck, this sinful one has come under my sight. I will give vent to my wrath born of Sita's abduction."
word_meanings: दिष्ट्या by good luck, पापात्मा sinful, अयम् he, मम my, दृष्टिपथम् my sight, गतः gone, अद्य come, सीताहरणसम्भवम् Sita's abduction, क्रोधम् wrath, विमोक्ष्यामि give vent.

text: एवमुक्त्वा ततो रामो धनुरादाय वीर्यवान् । लक्ष्मणानुचरस्तस्थौ समुद्धृत्य शरोत्तमम् ॥६-५९-३२॥
translation: Indomitable Rama having spoken in that manner, followed by Lakshmana got ready and took out an excellent bow and stood.
word_meanings: वीर्यवान् indomitable, रामः Rama, एवम् in that manner, उक्त्वा having spoken, ततः then, धनुः bow, आदाय taking out, शरोत्तमम् excellent, समुद्धृत्य got ready, लक्ष्मणानुचरः Lakshmana as follower, तस्थौ stood.

text: ततः स रक्षोधिपतिर्महात्मा रक्षांसि तान्याह महाबलानि । द्वारेषु चर्यागृहगोपुरेषु सुनिर्वृतास्तिष्ठत निर्विशङ्काः ॥६-५९-३३॥
translation: There upon the great soul, the king of Rakshasas thus spoke to the strong army of Rakshasas, "Fully complacent, free from any apprehension be stationed at the gates and the buildings of the four main streets."
word_meanings: ततः thereupon, महात्मा great soul, सः he, रक्षोधिपतिः Rakshasa king, महाबलानि strong army, तानि them, रक्षांसि Rakshasas, आह you, द्वारेषु at gates, चर्यागृहगोपुरेणु buildings on the four main streets, सुनिर्वृताः fully complacent, निर्विशङ्काः free from apprehension, तिष्ठत stationed.

text: इहागतं मां सहितं भवद्भिर्वनौकसश्छिद्रमिदं विदित्वा । शून्यां पुरीं दुष्प्रसहां प्रमथ्य प्रधर्षयेयुः सहसा समेताः ॥६-५९-३४॥
translation: "Coming to know that I am here with you, this side, considering it to be a weak point, the forest dwellers may enter the vacant city and Devastate all united."
word_meanings: भवद्भिः me also, सहितम् with you, माम् me, इह here, आगतम् coming to know my coming, इदम् this, छिद्रम् weak side, विदित्वा knowing, वनौकसः forest dwellers, समेताः together, दुष्प्रसहाम् enter, शून्याम् vacant, पुरीम् City, प्रमथ्य Devastate, सहसा united, प्रधर्षयेयुः storm.

text: विसर्जयित्वा सहितांस्ततस्तान् गतेषु रक्षस्सु यथानियोगम् । व्यदारयद्वानरसागरौघं महाझषः पूर्णमिवार्णवौघम् ॥६-५९-३५॥
translation: After the counsellors departed from there Ravana pierced through the ocean of Vanaras just as gigantic fish would pierce in the sea.
word_meanings: तान् them, सचिवान् counsellors, विसर्जयित्वा sent away, ततः there upon, रक्षःसु Rakshasa, यथानियोगम् as instructed, गतेषु having departed, वानरसागरौघम् ocean of Vanaras, महाझषः gigantic fish, पूर्णम् totally, अर्णवौघम् इव like the war in the ocean, व्यदारयत् pierced through.

text: तमापतन्तं सहसा समीक्ष्य दीप्तेषुचापं युधि राक्षसेन्द्रम् । महत् समुत्पाट्य महीधराग्रं दुद्राव रक्षोधिपतिं हरीशः ॥६-५९-३६॥
translation: Watching Ravana advancing suddenly on the battlefield with great speed, Sugriva took a huge mountain top and went towards Rakshasa king.
word_meanings: युधि on the battlefield, सहसा speedily, आपतन्तम् advancing suddenly, दीप्तेषुचापम् with radiant bow, राक्षसेन्द्रम् Rakshasa king, समीक्ष्य watching, हरीशः monkey, महत् great, महीधराग्रम् huge mountain top, समुत्पाट्य lifting up, रक्षोधिपतिम् towards Rakshasa king, दुद्राव went.

text: तच्छैलशृङ्गं बहुवृक्षसानुं प्रगृह्य चिक्षेप निशाचराय । तमापतन्तं सहसा समीक्ष्य बिभेद बाणैस्तपनीयपुङ्खैः ॥६-५९-३७॥
translation: Seizing mountain tops whose slopes were filled with trees Sugriva hurled at the night rangers. Watching this Ravana quickly broke them with his arrows fixed with golden shafts.
word_meanings: बहुवृक्षसानुम् whose slopes were crowded with many trees, तत् that, शैलशृङ्गम् mountain top, प्रगृह्य seizing, निशाचराय at night rangers, चिक्षेप hurled, आपतन्तम् towards, तम् him, समीक्ष्य watching, सहसा quickly, तपनीयपुङ्खैः arrows with gold shafts, बाणैः arrows, चिच्छेद broke.

text: तस्मिन् प्रवृद्धोत्तमसानुवृक्षे शृङ्गे विकीर्णे पतिते पृथिव्याम् । महाहिकल्पं शरमन्तकाभं समाददे राक्षसलोकनाथः ॥६-५९-३८॥
translation: After that slope covered with excellent trees had fallen on the ground and broken, Ravana got readied with an arrow as if for arranging destruction like the spirit of death.
word_meanings: तस्मिन् in that, प्रवृद्धोत्तमसानुवृक्षे slope covered with excellent trees, शृङ्गे peak, विदीर्णे broken, पृथिव्याम् on the ground, पतिते fallen, राक्षसलोकनाथः king of Rakshasa world, महाहिकल्पम् arranging for destruction, अन्तकाभम् like the spirit of death, शरम् arrow, समादधे got ready.

text: स तं गृहीत्वा ऽनिलतुल्यवेगं सविस्फुलिङ्गज्वलनप्रकाशम् । बाणं महेन्द्राशनितुल्यवेगं चिक्षेप सुग्रीववधाय रुष्टः ॥६-५९-३९॥
translation: Seizing an arrow which shone like sparks of fire and had the speed of wind, nay vied with thunderbolt of Indra in speed, he (Ravana) released an arrow in anger.
word_meanings: रुष्टः angry, सः he, अनिलतुल्यवेगम् like the wind in speed, सविस्फुलिङ्गज्वलनप्रकाशम् shone like sparks of fire, महेन्द्राशनितुल्यवेगम् vied with thunderbolt of Indra in speed, तंबाणम् that arrow, गृहीत्वा seizing, सुग्रीववधाय for the destruction of Sugriva, चिक्षेप released.

text: स सायको रावणबाहुमुक्तः शक्राशनिप्रख्यवपुः शिताग्रः । सुग्रीवमासाद्य बिभेद वेगाद् गुहेरिता क्रौञ्चमिवोग्रशक्तिः ॥६-५९-४०॥
translation: That arrow released from Ravana's arm, which was hard and sharp as the thunderbolt of Indra, pierced Sugriva just as the sharp thorn edged spear of Guha penetrated Krauncha mountain.
word_meanings: रावणबाहुमुक्तः released from Ravana's arms, सःसायकः that arrow, शक्रशनिप्रख्यवपुः hard and sharp like Indra's thunderbolt, शिताग्रः sharp thorn edged spear, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, आसाद्य reaching, गुहेरिता like Guha's, उग्रशक्तिः fierce, क्रौञ्चमिव Krauncha like, वेगात् violently, बिभेद pierced.

text: स सायकार्तो विपरीतचेताः कूजन् पृथिव्यां निपपात वीरः । तं प्रेक्ष्य भूमौ पतितं विसञ्ज्ञं नेदुः प्रहृष्टा युधि यातुधानाः ॥६-५९-४१॥
translation: That hero (Sugriva) hurt by the arrow lost senses and fell on the ground groaning in the battlefield. Seeing that the Rakshasas shouted joyfully overtaken by evil spirits.
word_meanings: सःवीरः that hero, सायकार्तः hurt by arrow, विपरीतचेताः lost sense, कूजन् groaning, पृथिव्याम् on the ground, निपपात fell, युधि in battle, विसंज्ञम् sent forth, भूमौ on the ground, पतितम् fallen, तम् they, प्रेक्ष्य seeing, यातुधानाः an evil spirit, प्रहृष्टाः joyfully, नेदुः shouted.

text: ततो गवाक्षो गवयः सुदंष्ट्रस्तथर्षभो ज्योतिमुखो नभश्च । शैलान् समुद्यम्य विवृद्धकायाः प्रदुद्रुवुस्तं प्रति राक्षसेन्द्रम् ॥६-५९-४२॥
translation: Thereafter Gavaksha, Gavaya, Sudamshtra, Rshaba, Jyothimukha and Nala increasing their body size rushed towards the king of Rakshasas.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, गवयः Gavaya, सुदंष्ट्र Sudamshtra, अथ and, ऋषभः Rshaba, ज्योतिमुखः Jyothimukha, नलश्च Nala, शैलान् rock, समुत्पाट्य taking mountains, विवृद्धकायाः raising their body size, तम् they, राक्षसेन्द्रंप्रति over the king of Rakshasas, प्रदुद्रुवुः rushed.

text: तेषां प्रहारान् स चकार मोघान् रक्षोधिपो बाणगणैः शिताग्रैः । तान् वानरेन्द्रानपि बाणजालैर्बिभेद जाम्बूनदचित्रपुङ्खैः ॥६-५९-४३॥
translation: The Rakshasa Lord made the mountain peaks useless by the hundreds of arrows released by him. The streams of arrows with golden shafts could resist the Rakshasas and strike the Vanara king.
word_meanings: सःरक्षोधिपः the Rakshasa Lord, शिताग्रैः mountain peaks, बाणशतैः hundreds of arrows, तेषाम् by that, प्रहारान् released, मोघान् useless, चकार resist, जाम्बूनदचित्रपुङ्खैः arrows with golden shafts, बाणजालैः streams of arrows, तान् them, वानरेन्द्रानपि even Vanara king, बिभेद struck.

text: ते वानरेन्द्रास्त्रिदशारिबाणैर्भिन्ना विपेतुर्भुवि भीमकायाः । ततस्तु तद्वानरसैन्यमुग्रं प्रच्छादयामास स बाणजालैः ॥६-५९-४४॥
translation: The Vanara leaders of fierce form torn by the streams of sharp arrows discharged in the three directions fell covering the ground.
word_meanings: भीमकायाः fierce form, तेवानरेन्द्राः of that Vanara leaders, त्रिदशारिबाणैः in the three directions, भिन्नाः torn, भुवि ground, निपेतुः fell, ततः that, सः he, बाणजालैः streams of arrows, उग्रम् sharp, तत् वानरसैन्यम् the army of Vanaras, प्रच्छादयामास covered.

text: ते वध्यमानाः पतिताः प्रवीरा नानद्यमाना भयशल्यविद्धाः । शाखामृगा रावणसायकार्ता जग्मुः शरण्यं शरणं स्म रामम् ॥६-५९-४५॥
translation: Those monkeys struck and fallen by the piercing of arrows shrieking went to seek refuge from Rama.
word_meanings: वध्यमानाः those struck, पतिताः fallen, नावद्यमानाः shrieking, भयशल्यविद्धाः fear of pain by piercing, प्रवीराः heroes, तेशाखामृगाः the monkeys, रावणसायकार्ताः pressed by Ravana's arrows, शरण्यम् refuge रामम् Rama, शरणंजुग्मुः went to seek refuge.

text: ततो महात्मा स धनुर्धनुष्मानादाय रामः सहसा जगाम । तं लक्ष्मणः प्राञ्जलिरभ्युपेत्य उवाच वाक्यं परमार्थयुक्तम् ॥६-५९-४६॥
translation: The great soul Rama who was holding a bow went seizing it. Lakshmana approached him immediately with folded hands and addressed Rama with words consonant with truth.
word_meanings: ततः that, महात्मा great soul, धनुष्मान् holding bow, सःरामः that Rama, धनुः bow, आदाय taking, सहसा immediately, जगाम went, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, तम् him, अभ्युपेत्य addressed, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hand s, परमार्थयुक्तम् consonant with truth, वाक्यम् words, उवाच spoken.

text: काममार्यः सुपर्याप्तो वधायास्य दुरात्मनः । विधमिष्याम्यहं नीचमनुजानीहि मां प्रभो ॥६-५९-४७॥
translation: "I will exterminate the evil minded Ravana. Oh! noble brother, may I be permitted to complete the task"
word_meanings: दुरात्मनः evil minded, अस्य his, वधाय destruction, आर्यः noble, सुपर्याप्तःकामम् complete the task, विभो glory, अहम् I, एतम् thus, विधमिष्यामि will exterminate, माम् me, अनुजानीहि I may be permitted.

text: तमब्रवीन्महतेजा रामः सत्यपराक्रमः ॥६-५९-४८॥
translation: Sri Rama, who was highly energetic and truthful in enthusiasm to succeed, told Lakshmana, "You go and be careful in the battle."
word_meanings: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, सत्यपराक्रमः truthful in enthusiasm to succeed, महातेजाः highly energetic, रामः Rama, तम् to him, अब्रवीत् said, गच्छ going, संयुगे in the battle, यत्नपरश्चापि be careful, भव you.

text: गच्छ यत्नपरश्चापि भव लक्ष्मण संयुगे । रावणो हि महावीर्यो रणे ऽद्भुतपराक्रमः । त्रैलोक्येनापि सङ्क्रुद्धो दुष्प्रसह्यो न संशयः ॥६-५९-४९॥
translation: "Ravana is a great hero in the battlefield. His valour in war is wonderful. He is angry but none can withstand him in the three worlds."
word_meanings: रावणः Ravana, महावीर्यंरणे is a great hero in the battle, अद्भुतपराक्रमः wonderful valour, संक्रुद्धः angry, त्रैलोक्येनापि in the three worlds, दुष्प्रसह्यः difficult to resist, संशयः doubt, न not.

text: तस्य च्छिद्राणि मार्गस्व स्वच्छिद्राणि च लक्षय । चक्षुषा धनुषा यत्नाद्रक्षात्मानं समाहितः ॥६-५९-५०॥
translation: "Remaining alert, apply your arrows in the direction of his arrows. Looking at his arrows carefully, making an effort to protect yourself, set your bow."
word_meanings: तस्य his, छिद्राणि arrows, मार्गस्व in the direction of, स्वच्छिद्राणि your arrows, लक्ष्य aim, समाहितः being alert, चक्षुषा your sight, धनुषा bow, यत्ना making effort, आत्मानम् yourself.

text: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा परिष्वज्याभिपूज्य च । अभिवाद्य ततो रामं ययौ सौमित्रिराहवम् ॥६-५९-५१॥
translation: On hearing Raghava's words, son of Sumitra embraced him and offered prayers, paying respects sallied forth for the encounter.
word_meanings: सौमित्रिः son of Sumitra, राघवस्य Raghava's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, सपरिष्वज्य embracing, अभिपूज्य offering prayers, तं that, रामम् Rama, अभिवाद्यच paying respects, अहवम् for encounter, ययौ sallied forth.

text: स रावणं वारणहस्तबाहुर्ददर्श दीप्तोद्यतभीमचापम् । प्रच्छादयन्तं शरवृष्टिजालैस्तान् वानरान् भिन्नविकीर्णदेहान् ॥६-५९-५२॥
translation: He saw Ravana, endowed with round shoulders like elephant trunks, with fierce bow glowing and the broken bodies of Vanaras spread all over. Ravana was showering nets of arrows and instigating vanaras.
word_meanings: सः he, वारणहस्तबाहुम् endowed with elephant trunk like round shoulders, भीमोद्यतदीप्तचापम् fierce bow glowing, भिन्नविकीर्णदेहान् broken bodies of Vanaras spread over, तान् them, वानरान् Vanaras, शरवृष्टिजालैः showering net of arrows, प्रच्छादयन्तम् instigating, रावणम् Ravana, ददर्श saw.

text: तमालोक्य महातेजा हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः । निवार्य शरजालानि प्रदुर्द्राव स रावणम् ॥६-५९-५३॥
translation: The son of the wind god, Hanuman, a brilliant one seeing Ravana, obstructed the stream of arrows and darted towards him.
word_meanings: महातेजाः very brilliant, मारुतात्मजः son of wind god, सः he, हनूमान् Hanuman, तम् him, आलोक्य seeing, शरजालानि stream of arrows, निवार्य obstructing, रावणम् Ravana, प्रदुद्राव darted towards.

text: रथं तस्य समासाद्य भुजमुद्यम्य दक्षिणम् । त्रासयन् रावणं धीमान् हनुमान् वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥६-५९-५४॥
translation: Courageous Hanuman seeing the chariot of Ravana lifting his right arm menacing him spoke these words.
word_meanings: धीमान् courageous, हनुमान् Hanuman, तस्य his, रथम् chariot, समासाद्य approaching near, दक्षिणम् right, बाहुम् arm, उद्यम्य lifting, त्रासयन् menacing, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: देवदानवगन्धर्वैर्यक्षैश्च सह राक्षसैः । अवध्यत्वं त्वया प्राप्तं वानरेभ्यस्तु ते भयम् ॥६-५९-५५॥
translation: "Your life is surely secure from gods, demons, Gandharvas and Yakshas and Rakshasas but you fear Vanaras."
word_meanings: देवदावनगन्धर्वैः gods, demons and Gandharvas, सहराक्षसैः along with Rakshasas, यक्षैश्च Yakshas also, अवश्यंतु surely, त्वया by you, भग्ना death, ते to you, वानरेभ्यस्तु from Vanaras also, भयम् fear.

text: एष मे दक्षिणो बाहुः पञ्चशाखः समुद्यतः । विधमिष्यति ते देहाद्भूतात्मानं चिरोषितम् ॥६-५९-५६॥
translation: "I raised this right arm that way with five branches (five fingers) at you that will expel your subtle self (made up of the five subtle elements) from your body."
word_meanings: मे I, पञ्चशाखः five branches, एषः that way, समुद्यतः together, दक्षिणःबाहुः right arm, ते to you, देहात् body, चिरोषितम् for long, भूतात्मानम् subtle body, विधमिष्यति will expel.

text: श्रुत्वा हनुमतो वाक्यं रावणो भीमविक्रमः । संरक्तनयनः क्रोधादिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥६-५९-५७॥
translation: Ravana of truly fierce valour, hearing Hanuman's words, his eyes became blood red and spoke to Hanuman this way.
word_meanings: भीमविक्रमः truly fierce, रावणः Ravana, हनुमतः Hanuman's, वाक्यम् words, श्रुत्वा hearing, क्रोधात् in anger, संरक्तनयनः with blood red eyes, इदम् thus, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: क्षिप्रं प्रहर निश्शङ्कं स्थिरां कीर्तिमवाप्नुहि । ततस्त्वां ज्ञातविक्रान्तं नाशयिष्यामि वानर ॥६-५९-५८॥
translation: "O Vanara! Go about without any hesitation. Attain the fame of a Vanara hitting Ravana permanently. Thereafter knowing your prowess, I shall put an end to you."
word_meanings: वानर Vanara, निःशङ्कम् without any hesitation, क्षिप्रम् at once, प्रहर go about, स्थिराम् permanent, कीर्तिम् fame, अवाप्नुहि will attain, ततः thereafter, ज्ञातविक्रान्तम् knowing your prowess, त्वाम् you, नाशयिष्यामि shall destroy.

text: रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा वायुसूनुर्वचो ऽब्रवीत् । प्रहृतं हि मया पूर्वमक्षं स्मर सुतं तव ॥६-५९-५९॥
translation: Having heard Ravana's words, Hanuman said, "Think of your son Akshaya killed by me earlier."
word_meanings: रावणस्य Ravana's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, वायुसूनुः son of wind god, वचः words, अब्रवीत् spoke, मया by me, पूर्वम् earlier, प्रहृतम् killed, तवसुतम् your son, अक्षम् Akshaya, तव your.

text: एवमुक्तो महातेजा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः । आजघानानिलसुतं तलेनोरसि वीर्यवान् ॥६-५९-६०॥
translation: Having spoken that way by Hanuman, the Lord of Rakshasas slapped his hand on Hanuman's chest.
word_meanings: एवम् that manner, उक्तः having spoken, महातेजाः highly energetic, वीर्यवान् valiant, राक्षसेश्वरः Rakshasa Lord, रावणः Ravana, अनिलसुतम् son of wind god, तलेन with hand, उरसि on the chest, आजघान slapped.

text: स तलाभिहतस्तेन चचाल च मुहुर्मुहुः । स्थित्वा मुहूर्तं तेजस्वी स्थैर्यं कृत्वा महामतिः । आजघानाभिसंक्रुद्धस्तलेनैवामरद्विषम् ॥६-५९-६१॥
translation: Smacked by him (Ravana), Hanuman, a brilliant and intelligent one stood firm for a while and picking up courage, highly enraged struck the enemy of gods with his palm.
word_meanings: तेन by him, तलाभिहतः smacked by, सः he (Hanuman), मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, चचालच with hand, तेजस्वी brilliant, महामतिः intellectual, मुहूर्तम् for a minute, स्थित्वा stood firm, स्थैर्यम् picking up courage, अभि very, कृत्वा did, सङ्कृद्धः enraged, तलेनैव with his palm, अमरद्विषम् enemy of gods, आजघान struck.

text: ततस्तलेनाभिहतो वानरेण महात्मना । दशग्रीवः समाधूतो यथा भूमिचले ऽचलः तिः ॥६-५९-६२॥
translation: Thereupon, struck by the great soul, Vanara, the ten headed Ravana was shaken like the earthquake on the mountain together.
word_meanings: ततः thereupon, महात्मना great soul, तेनवानरेण by the Vanara, अभिहतः struck, दशग्रीवः ten headed, भूमिचले shaken like an earthquake, अचलःयथा like mountain, समाधूतः shaken together, तते afterwards.

text: सङ्ग्रामे तं तथा दृष्ट्वा रावणं तलताडितम् । ऋषयो वानराः सिद्धा नेदुर्देवाः सहासुरैः ॥६-५९-६३॥
translation: Ravana hit by hand in that way in a hard manner, the siddhas, demons as well and even Devatas raised their voice.
word_meanings: सङ्ग्रामे in that war, तथा that way, तलताडितम् hit by hand, तंरावणम् that Ravana, दृष्टवा hard, ऋषयः sages, वानराः Vanara, सिद्धाः siddhas, असुरैःसह demons as well, देवा Devas, नेदुः shouted.

text: अथाश्वास्य महातेजा रावणो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥६-५९-६४॥
translation: And thereafter, thus spoke extremely energetic Ravana recovering from breath, "Well done vanara. You are courageous and praiseworthy, my enemy!"
word_meanings: अथ and then, महातेजाः extremely energetic, रावणः Ravana, आश्वास्य from breath, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, वानर Vanara, साधु well done, वीर्येण courageous, श्लाघनीय praise worthy, मेरिपुः my enemy, असि you are.

text: साधु वानर वीर्येण श्लाघनीयो ऽसि मे रिपुः । रावणेनैवमुक्तस्तु मारुतिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥६-५९-६५॥
धिगस्तु मम वीर्येण यस्त्वं जीवसि रावण । सकृत्तु प्रहरेदानीं दुर्बुद्धे किं विकत्थसे । ततस्त्वां मामिका मुष्टिर्नयिष्यति यमक्षयम् ॥६-५९-६६॥
translation: "O evil minded one, why do you brag You do this once more I will strike you once again with my fist and send you to the abode of Yama."
word_meanings: दुर्भुद्धे evil minded, किंविकत्थसे why do you brag, इदानीम् like this, सकृत् once more you do, प्रहर strike, ततः then, मामिकः I will once again, मुष्टिः fist, त्वाम् you, यमक्षयम् to the abode of Yama, नयिष्यति I wish.

text: ततो मारुतिवाक्येन क्रोदस्तस्य तदा ऽज्वलत् दानीं दुर्बुद्धे किं विकत्थसे । संरक्तनयनो यत्नान्मुष्टिमुद्यम्य दक्षिणम् । पातयामास वेगेन वानरोरसि वीर्यवान् ॥६-५९-६७॥
translation: Consequent to Maruti speaking like that, Ravana's eyes turned red, burning with anger. The powerful Ravana lifted his right fist instantly and brought it down on his powerful enemy.
word_meanings: ततः then, मारुतिवाक्येन consequent to Maruti's words, तदा then, तस्य his, कोधः anger, अज्वलत् burning, संरक्तनयनः red eyes, यत्नात् effort, दक्षिणम् right, मुष्टिम् fist, उद्यम्य lifting, वीर्यवान् powerful, वेगेन instantly, वानरोरपि Vanara's enemy, पातयामास brought down.

text: हनुमान् वक्षसि व्यूढे सञ्चचाल पुनःपुनः ॥६-५९-६८॥
विह्वलं तु तदा दृष्ट्वा हनुमन्तं महाबलम् । रथेनातिरथः शीघ्रं नीलं प्रति समभ्यगात् ॥६-५९-६९॥
translation: Hit on his chest, Hanuman got hurt again and reeled. Seeing Hanuman's power, overcome with fear, the best charioteer Ravana drove quickly towards Neela.
word_meanings: व्यूढे hit, वक्षसि on chest, हनूमान् Hanuman, हतःपुनः again hurt, सञ्चचाल reeled, विह्वलम् overcome with fear, महाबलम् very powerful, तंहनूमन्तम् that Hanuman, दृष्टवा seeing, अतिरथः best charioteer, रथेन chariot, शीघ्रम् quickly, नीलंप्रति towards Neela, समभ्यगात् drove.

text: राक्षसानामधिपतिर्दशग्रीवः प्रतापवान् । पन्नगप्रतिमैर्भीमैः परमर्मातिभेदिभिः । शरैरादीपयामास नीलं हरिचमूपतिम् ॥६-५९-७०॥
translation: The ten headed indomitable Lord of Rakshasas with his arrows that resembled serpents, dreadful, capable of piercing into vital parts began to strike at Neela, the leader of monkeys.
word_meanings: राक्षसानाम् for Rakshasas, अधिपतिः Lord, प्रतापवान् indomitable, दशग्रीवः ten headed, पन्नगप्रतिमैः resembling serpents, भीमैः dreadful, परमर्माभिभेदनैः which can pierce through vital parts, शरैः arrows, हरिचमूपतिम् leader of monkeys, नीलम् Nila, आदीपयामास began to strike.

text: स शरौघसमायस्तो नीलः कपिचमूपतिः । करेणैकेन शेलाग्रं रक्षोधिपतये ऽसृजत् ॥६-५९-७१॥
translation: Pressured by the streams of arrows, the monkey leader, Neela single handed took up a peak of a mountain and hurled at the Lord of Rakshasas.
word_meanings: शरौघसमायस्तः pressurized by streams of arrows, कपिचमूपतिः monkey leader, सःनीलः that Nila, एकेन alone, करेण tearing up, शैलाग्रम् mountain peak, रक्षोधिपतये on the Rakshasa Lord, असृजत् hurled.

text: हनुमानपि तेजस्वी समाश्वस्तो महामनाः । विप्रेक्षमाणो युद्धेप्सुः सरोषमिदमब्रवीत् ॥६-५९-७२॥
नीलेन सह संयुक्तं रावणं राक्षसेश्वरम् । अन्येन युद्ध्यमानस्य न युक्तमभिधावनम् ॥६-५९-७३॥
translation: Endowed with a great mind and energetic Hanuman became alert and seeking to fight with Ravana, feeling fresh, enraged, looking at Nila said "It is not correct to attack one who is fighting with another."
word_meanings: तेजस्वी energetic, महामनाः great minded, हनूमानपि Hanuman, समाश्वस्तः became alert, युद्धेप्सुः seeking a fight, विप्रेक्षमाणः gazing, नीलेनसह Nila, संसक्तम् feeling fresh, राक्षसेश्वरम् to Rakshasa Lord, रावणम् Ravana, सरोषम् angrily, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke, अन्येन with other, युध्यमानस्य doing a fight, अभिधावनम् attack, नयुक्तम् not correct.

text: रावणो ऽपि महातेजास्तच्छृङ्गं सप्तभिः शरैः । आजघान सुतीक्ष्णाग्रैस्तद्विकीर्णं पपात ह ॥६-५९-७४॥
translation: Ravana, endowed with extraordinary energy attacked that peak hurled by Neela with seven sharp arrows and it fell broken into pieces.
word_meanings: अथ and then, महातेजाः endowed with extraordinary energy, रावणः Ravana, तंशृङ्गम् that peak, सुतीक्ष्णाग्रैः with sharp arrows, सप्तभिः seven, शरैः arrows, आजघान attacked, तत् then, विकीर्णं broken, पपातह fell.

text: तद्विकीर्णं गिरेः शृङ्गं दृष्ट्वा हरिचमूपतिः । कालाग्निरिव जज्वाल क्रोधोन परवीरहा ॥६-५९-७५॥
translation: On seeing the crushed peak, Neela, the killer of stupendous foes, shone like fire at universal destruction in anger.
word_meanings: परवीरहा killer of stupendous foes, चमूपतिः leader, विकीर्णम् broken, तत् that, गिरेःशृङ्गम् mountain peak, दृष्टवा seeing, कोपेन in anger, कालानगिरिव like fire at the universal destruction, जज्वाल shone.

text: सो ऽश्वकर्णान् धवान् सालांश्चूतांश्चापि सुपुष्पितान् । अन्यांश्च विविधान् वृक्षान्नीलश्चिक्षेप संयुगे ॥६-५९-७६॥
translation: In the battle Neela hurled Aswakarana, Sala and Mango trees in good bloom and several other trees at Ravana.
word_meanings: सःनीलः that Neela, संयुगे in battle, अश्वकर्णान्धान् Aswakarana, शालान् Sala, सुपुष्पितान् in bloom, चूतानपि and Mango trees, अन्यान् and other, विविधान् several, वृक्षान् trees, चिक्षेप hurled.

text: स तान् वृक्षान् समासाद्य प्रतिचिच्छेद रावणः । अभ्यवर्षत् सुघोरेण शरवर्षेण पावकिम् ॥६-५९-७७॥
translation: Ravana broke those trees in return and showered rain of formidable arrows at Neela.
word_meanings: सःरावणः that Ravana, तान् those, वृक्षान् trees, प्रतिसमासाद्य broke in return, चिच्छेद broke, घोरेण formidable, शरवर्षेण rain of arrows, पावकिम् on son of fire god (Neela), अभ्यवर्षच्छ rained.

text: अभिवृष्टः शरौघेण मेघेनेव महाचलः । ह्रस्वं कृत्वा तदा रूपं ध्वजाग्रे निपपात ह ॥६-५९-७८॥
translation: When Neela was covered by Ravana's arrows, it was just as clouds cover mountain peaks. Neela reduced his size and landed on top of Ravana's bow.
word_meanings: शरौघेण hail of shafts, मेघेनेव by cloud, अभिवृष्टः when rained, महाबलः mighty strong, ततः that, रूपम् form, ह्रस्वम् small size, कृत्वा reducing, ध्वजाग्रे top of bow, निपपातह landed.

text: पावकात्मजमालोक्य ध्वजाग्रे समुपस्थितम् । जज्वाल रावणः क्रोधात्ततो नीलो ननाद च ॥६-५९-७९॥
translation: Neela stood on top of the post of the bow of Ravana. On seeing that Ravana was burning in anger while Neela roared.
