word_meanings: ध्वजाग्रे on top of the post of bow, समवस्थितम् standing, पावकात्मजम् son of fire god, आलोक्य seeing, रावणः Ravana, क्रोधात् in anger, जज्वाल burning, ततः then, नीलः Neela, ननादच roared.

text: ध्वजाग्रे धनुषश्चाग्रे किरीटाग्रे च तं हरिम् । लक्ष्मणो ऽथ हनूमांश्च दृष्ट्वा रामश्च विस्मिताः ॥६-५९-८०॥
translation: Then, when Ravana was unable to release the arrow from the bow on Neela, who was shifting from the top of the post to the crown. Seeing that Lakshmana, Rama and Hanuman were amazed.
word_meanings: ध्वजाग्रे on top of bow, धनुषः unable to release the arrow from the bow, अग्रे top, किरीटाग्रेच on top of the crown, तंहरिम् that monkey, दृष्टवा seeing, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अथ and then, हनुमांश्च and Hanuman, रामश्च Rama, विस्मिताः amazed.

text: रावणो ऽपि महातेजाः कपिलाघवविस्मितः । अस्त्रमाहारयामास दीप्तमाग्नेयमद्भुतम् ॥६-५९-८१॥
translation: Ravana endowed with extraordinary energy was also wonder struck at Neela's agility. Then he took up the shining shaft presided over by fire god.
word_meanings: महातेजाः of extraordinary energy, रावणः Ravana, अपि also, कपिलाघवविस्मितः Nila's ability to move, दीप्तम् shining, अद्भुतम् wondered, आग्नेयम् shaft presided by fire god, अस्त्रम् , आहारयामास took up.

text: ततस्ते चुक्रुशुर्हृष्टा लब्धलक्षाः प्लवङ्गमाः । नीललाघवसम्भ्रान्तं दृष्ट्वा रावणमाहवे ॥६-५९-८२॥
translation: Thereafter, seeing Neela's feat in the war, Ravana was agitated and the Vanaras were cheerful for having achieved their wish and shouted in joy.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, आहवे war, नीललाघवसम्भ्रान्तम् agitated about Neela's feats, रावणम् Ravana, दृष्टवा seeing, लब्दलक्षाः having achieved their wish, तेप्लवङ्गमाः those monkeys, हृष्टाः cheerful, चुक्रुशुः shouted.

text: वानराणां च नादेन संरब्धो रावणस्तदा । सम्भ्रमाविष्टहृदयो न किञ्चित् प्रत्यपद्यत ॥६-५९-८३॥
translation: Provoked by the clamour of the vanaras, Ravana's heart was full of anger and did not know what to do.
word_meanings: तदा then, वानराणाम् Vanaras, नादेन clamour, संरब्धः provoked, रावणः Ravana, सम्फ्रमाविष्टहृदयः heart filled with anger, किञ्चित् a little, नप्रत्यपद्यत not know what to do in turn.

text: आग्नेयेनाथ संयुक्तं गृहीत्वा रावणः शरम् । ध्वजशीर्षस्थितं नीलमुदैक्षत निशाचरः । ततो ऽब्रवीन्महातेजा रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः ॥६-५९-८४॥
translation: And then the night ranger Ravana taking up, fitting the arrow charged with fire, looked at Neela resting on top of the bow.
word_meanings: अध and then, निशाचरः night ranger, रावणः Ravana, आग्नेयेन arrow charged with fire, संयुक्तम् fitting, गृहीत्वा taking, ध्वजशीर्षस्थितम् resting on top of the bow, नीलम् Neela, उदैक्षत looked.

text: कपे लाघवयुक्तो ऽसि मायया परया ऽनया । जीवितं खलु रक्षस्व यदि शक्तो ऽसि वानर ॥६-५९-८५॥
तानि तान्यात्मरूपाणि सृजसि त्वमनेकशः ॥६-५९-८६॥
translation: "Oh monkey! You are taking different forms and doing different deeds. If you have the ability, save your life."
word_meanings: वानर monkey, त्वम् your, अनेकशः many, तानितानि different, आत्मरूपाणि forms of you, सृजसि create, शक्तः have the ability, अपि also यदि which, जीवितम् life, रक्षस्वखलु save your life.

text: तथापि त्वां मया युक्तः सायको ऽस्त्रप्रयोजितः । जीवतं परिरक्षन्तं जीविताद् भ्रंशयिष्यति ॥६-५९-८७॥
translation: "The arrow released by me now is charged with a missile and will destroy your life. You have been protecting (changing your forms) your life."
word_meanings: तथापि like that, मया by me, मुक्तः released, अस्त्रयोजितः charged with missile, सायकः arrow, जीवितम् life, परिरक्षन्तम् protecting, त्वाम् your, जीवितात् life, भ्रंशयिष्यति will destroy.

text: एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहू रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः । सन्धाय बाणमस्त्रेण चमूपतिमताडयत् ॥६-५९-८८॥
translation: Speaking like that, Ravana, the king of Rakshasas chanting the mantras and fixing the arrow struck the commander in chief (Neela) of the Vanara army.
word_meanings: महाबाहुः broad shouldered, राक्षसेश्वरः Rakshasa king, रावणः Ravana, एवम् like that, उक्त्वा spoken, बाणम् arrow, अस्त्रण chanting the mantras, सन्धाय fixing the arrow, चमूपतिम् commander in chief, अताडयत् struck.

text: सो ऽस्त्रयुक्तेन बाणेन नीलो वक्षसि ताडितः । निर्दह्यमानः सहसा निपपात महीतले ॥६-५९-८९॥
translation: Struck by the arrow propelled by the missile (of Ravana) on the chest, Neela fell on the ground.
word_meanings: सःनीलः that Neela, अस्त्रयुक्तेन struck by the arrow, बाणेन arrow, वक्षसि on the chest, ताडितः burnt, निर्धह्यमानः propelled by the missile, सहसा, महीतले on ground, निपपात fell.

text: पितृमाहात्म्यसंयोगादात्मनश्चापि तेजसा । जानुभ्यामपतद्भूमौ न च प्राणैर्व्ययुज्यत ॥६-५९-९०॥
translation: By virtue of his father's greatness and his own power, his life did not cease but he fell on the ground.
word_meanings: पितृमहात्म्यसंयोगात् by virtue of father's greatness, आत्मनः himself, तेजसाचापि own power, जानुभ्याम् knees, भूमौ to the ground, न्यपतत् fell, तु but, प्राणैः life, नव्ययुज्यत not ceased.

text: विसञ्ज्ञं वानरं दृष्ट्वा दशग्रीवो रणोत्सुकः । रथेनाम्बुदनादेन सौमित्रिमभिदुद्रुवे ॥६-५९-९१॥
translation: Finding the vanara unconscious the ten headed Ravana who was eager to fight went towards Saumithri in the chariot making sounds that resembled the sound of rattling of clouds.
word_meanings: दशग्रीवः ten headed, वानरम् at the Vanaras, विसंज्ञम् unconscious, दृष्टवा watching, रणोत्सुकः eager to fight, अम्बुदनादेन resembling the rattling sound of cloud, रथेन chariot, सौमित्रिम् to Saumithri, अभिदुद्रुवे went towards.

text: आसाद्य रणमध्ये तु वारयित्वा स्थितो ज्वलन् । धनुर्विस्फारयामास कम्पयन्निव मेदिनीम् ॥६-५९-९२॥
translation: In the midst of the battlefield stood Ravana, intercepting with his glowing bow making loud sounds as though shaking the earth.
word_meanings: तम् him, मीदिनीम् as if the earth, रणमध्ये in the midst of war, आसाद्य reaching, वारयित्वा intercepting, स्थितः stood, ज्वलन् glowing, धनुः bow, कम्पयन्निव shaking.

text: तमाह सौमित्रिरदीनसत्त्वो विस्फारयन्तं धनुरप्रमेयम् । अभ्येहि मामेव निशाचरेन्द्र न वानरांस्त्वं प्रतियोद्धुमर्हः ॥६-५९-९३॥
translation: Saumithri who was not depressed in spirit (by Ravana's attack) addressing Ravana who was stretching his bow said "Oh! Lord of night rangers, Be aware. You ought not to fight with vanaras."
word_meanings: अदीनसत्त्वः not depressed in spirit, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, अप्रमेयम् immeasurable, धनुः bow, विष्फारयन्तम् stretching, तम् him, आह Oh, निशाचरेन्द्र Lord of night rangers, माम् me, अभ्येहि aware, त्वम् you, वानरान् Vanaras, प्रतियोद्धुम् fighting war, अर्हः you ought not.

text: स तस्य वाक्यं प्रतिपूर्णघोषं ज्याशब्दमुग्रं च निशम्य राजा । आसाद्य सौमित्रिमवस्थितं तं कोपान्वितो वाक्यमुवाच रक्षः ॥६-५९-९४॥
translation: Hearing the challenging statement of the king of Rakshasas and hearing the vibrating sound, Saumithri standing close by spoke these wrathful words.
word_meanings: राजा king, सःरक्षः that Rakshasa, तस्य his, वाक्यम् words, प्रतिपूर्णघोषम् challenging statement, उग्रम् violent, ज्याशब्दम् vibrating sound, निशम्य hearing, उपस्थितम् standing near, तंसौमित्रिम् to Saumithri, आसाद्य reaching near, कोपान्वितम् wrathful, वाचम् words, उवाच spoke.

text: दिष्ट्या ऽसि मे राघव दृष्टिमार्गं प्राप्तो ऽन्तगामी विपरीतबुद्धिः । अस्मिन् क्षणे यास्यसि मृत्युदेशं संसाद्यमानो मम बाणजालैः ॥६-५९-९५॥
translation: "Oh Raghava! You have come under the path of my sight. You are going to meet your end. You who are perverted in mind, struck by a stream of my arrows will reach the abode of death this very moment."
word_meanings: राघव Raghava, विपरीतबुद्धिः perverted mind, अन्तगामी reaching the end, दिष्ट्या sight, मे my, दृष्टिमार्गम् my sight, प्राप्तः attained, मम me, बाणजालैः stream of arrows, संसाद्यमानः struck by my arrows, अस्मिन् you, क्षणे this very moment, मृत्युदेशम् abode of death, यास्यसि will go.

text: तमाह सौमित्रिरविस्मयानो गर्जन्तमुद्वृत्तसिताग्रदंष्ट्रम् । राजन्न गर्जन्ति महाप्रभावा विकत्थसे पापकृतां वरिष्ठ ॥६-५९-९६॥
translation: Saumithri, not surprised at the screaming of Ravana with his projected teeth, said, "You are great in sinful action. People of great valour do not display such bluster. Do not shout like that."
word_meanings: सौमित्रिः Saumithri, अविस्मयानः not surprised, उद्वृत्तसिताग्रदंष्ट्रम् projected teeth, गर्जन्तम् screaming, तम् you, आह great, पापकृताम् sinful action, वरिष्ठ displaying, राजन् king, विकत्थसे bluster, महाप्रभावाः of great valour, नगर्जन्ति not shout like that.

text: जानामि वीर्यं तव राक्षसेन्द्र बलं प्रतापं च पराक्रमं च । अवस्थितो ऽहं शरचापपाणिरागच्छ किं मोघविकत्थनेन ॥६-५९-९७॥
translation: "Your valour, heroism, strength and prowess are known to me. I stand firmly with bow and arrow come on. What is the use of bragging"
word_meanings: राक्षसेन्द्र Rakshasa king तव your, वीर्यम् valour, बलम् strength, प्रतापंच and heroism, पराक्रमंच and prowess, जानामि not known to me, अहम् I am, शरचापपाणिः arrow and bow in hand, अवस्थितः stand firmly, आगच्छ come on, मोघविकत्थेन by bragging, किम What.

text: स एवमुक्तः कुपितः ससर्ज रक्षोधिपः सप्त शरान् सुपुङ्खान् । तान् लक्ष्मणः काञ्चनचित्रपुङ्खैश्चिच्छेद बाणैर्निशिताग्रधारैः ॥६-५९-९८॥
translation: Lakshmana, having spoken in that manner, the Lord of Rakshasas released seven arrows with beautiful plumes. Lakshmana tore them into pieces with sharp pointed and sharpheaded arrows with gold shafts.
word_meanings: एवम् in that manner, उक्तः having said, सःरक्षोधिपः that Lord of Rakshasas, कुपितः angrily, सुपुङ्खान् beautiful plumes, सप्त seven, शरान् arrows, ससर्ज released, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, काञ्चनमित्रपुङ्खैः gold shafted, निशिताग्रधारैः sharp pointed and sharp headed, बाणैः arrows, तान् them, चिच्छेद tore to pieces.

text: तान् प्रेक्षमाणः सहसा निकृत्तान्निकृत्तभोगानिव पन्नगेन्द्रान् । लङ्केश्वरः क्रोधवशं जगाम ससर्ज चान्यान्निशितान् पृषत्कान् ॥६-५९-९९॥
translation: Seeing the arrows cut down with force broken pieces like coils of serpents, the Lord of Lanka overtaken by anger let go another sharp arrow.
word_meanings: सहसा with force, निकृत्तान् broken down, निकृत्तभोगान् whose coils have been broken, पन्नगेन्द्रानिव like serpent Lords, तान् them, प्रेक्षमाणः seeing, लङ्केश्वरः Lord of Lanka, क्रोधवशम् overtaken by wrath, जगाम fallen down, अन्यान् other, निशितान् sharp, पृषत्कान् let go.

text: स बाणवर्षं तु ववर्ष तीव्रं रामानुजः कार्मुकसम्प्रयुक्तम् । क्षुरार्धचन्द्रोत्तमकर्णिभल्लैः शरांश्च चिच्छेद न चुक्षुभे च ॥६-५९-१००॥
translation: The brother of Rama stretched his bow into a circle and showered rain of piercing arrows. He tore the arrows of his enemy with his arrows Kshura, Ardhachandra, karni and Balan without nay, perturbance.
word_meanings: सःरामानुजः that Rama's brother, कार्मुसम्प्रयुक्तम् stretching the bow into a round shape, तीव्रम् piercing, बाणवर्षम् rain of arrows, ववर्ष showered, क्षुरार्थचन्द्रोत्तमकर्णिभल्लैः Kshura, Ardhachandra, karni and Balan, शरान् च arrows, चिच्छेद tore, चचुक्षुभेच not perturbed.

text: स बाणजालान्यथ तानि तानि मोघानि पश्यं स्त्रिदशारिराजः । विसिष्मिये लक्ष्मणलाघवेन पुनश्च बाणान्निशितान् मुमोच ॥६-५९-१०१॥
translation: Ravana, the enemy of gods seeing all his streams of arrows ineffective, was astonished at Lakshmana's skill, and let go sharp arrows again and again.
word_meanings: सः he, त्रिदशारिराजः Ravana the enemy of gods, मोघानि in effective, तानितानि all of them, बाणजालानि stream of arrows, पश्यन् seeing, लक्ष्मणलाघवेन Lakshman's skill, विसिस्मिये astonished, पुनःच again and, निशितान् sharp, बाणान् arrows, मुमोच let go.

text: स लक्ष्मणश्चाशु शरान् शिताग्रान् महेन्द्रवज्राशनितुल्यवेगान् । सन्धाय चापे ज्वलनप्रकाशान् ससर्ज रक्षोधिपतेर्वधाय ॥६-५९-१०२॥
translation: Lakshmana also, who is comparable to Mahendra, fitting his bow and arrows that shone like fire released sharp and pointed arrows to put an end to Rakshasa king.
word_meanings: महेन्द्रतुल्यः comparable to Mahendra, सः he, लक्ष्मणश्चापि Lakshmana also, शिताग्रान् sharp pointed, अशनितुल्यवेगान् flying at high speed, ज्वलनप्रकाशान् shining like fire, शरान् arrows, चापे bow, सन्धाय fitting, रक्षोधिपतेः Lord of Rakshasas, वधाय to put an end, ससर्ज loosed.

text: स तान् प्रचिच्छेद हि राक्षसेन्द्रश्छित्त्वा च ताँल्लक्ष्मणमाजघान । शरेण कालाग्निसमप्रभेण स्वयम्भुदत्तेन ललाटदेशे ॥६-५९-१०३॥
translation: The Rakshasa king broke into pieces those arrows of Lakshmana and struck him on the forehead with the arrow gifted to him by Brahma, that was bright like the fire at the time of universal destruction.
word_meanings: सः he, राक्षसेन्द्रः Rakshasa king, छित्वा broken, तान् those, चतान् arrows, प्रचिच्छेदहि covered, कालाग्निसमप्रभेण bright as the fire at universal destruction, स्वयम्भुदत्तेन given by Brahma, शरेण by arrow, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana's, ललाटदेशे forehead, आजघान struck.

text: स लक्ष्मणो रावणसायकार्तश्चचाल चापं शिथिलं प्रगृह्य । पुनश्च सञ्ज्ञां प्रतिलभ्य कृच्छ्राच्चिच्छेद चापं त्रिदशेन्द्रशत्रोः ॥६-५९-१०४॥
translation: Lakshmana hurt by Ravana's dart, shaken up, seizing the bow feebly with great difficulty regaining consciousness tore the bow of the enemy of Indra into pieces in return.
word_meanings: सःलक्ष्मणः that Lakshmana, रावणसायकार्तः hurt by Ravana's dart, चापम् bow, शिथिलम् feebly, प्रगृह्य seizing, चचाल shaken, पुनःच and again, कृच्छ्रात् with great difficulty, संज्ञाम् regaining consciousness, प्रतिलभ्य back in return, त्रिदशेन्द्रशत्रोः enemy of Indra, चापम् dart, चिच्छेद tore to pieces

text: निकृत्तचापं त्रिभिराजघान बाणैस्तदा दाशरथिः शिताग्रः । स सायकार्तो विचचाल राजा कृच्छ्राच्च सञ्ज्ञां पुनराससाद ॥६-५९-१०५॥
translation: Then Lakshmana son of Dasaratha, struck the bow of the king into pieces with three sharp and pointed arrows. The king swooned and recovered with great difficulty.
word_meanings: दाशरथिः son of Dasaratha, तदा then, निकृत्तचापम् bow cut into pieces, शिताग्रैः sharp and pointed tops, त्रिभिः three, बाणैः arrows, आजघान taking, सःराजा that king, सायकार्तः bow, पुनः again, कृच्छ्रात् with great difficulty, संज्ञाम् swooned, आससादंच and recovered.

text: स कृत्तचापः शरताडितश्च मेदार्द्रगात्रो रुधिरावसिक्तः । जग्राह शक्तिं समुदग्रशक्तिः स्वयम्भुदत्तां युधि देवशत्रुः ॥६-५९-१०६॥
translation: Hurt by the arrows, bow cut, bathed in blood, limbs splattered with fat, Ravana the enemy of gods, himself being endowed with formidable energy gifted by the Self born creator seized javelin on the battlefield.
word_meanings: कृत्तचापः bow being cut, शरताडितश्च hurt by the arrows, मेदार्द्रगात्रः limbs splattered with fat, रुधिरावसिक्तः bathed in blood, स्वयम् his own, उग्रशक्तिः formidable energy, सः he, देवशत्रुः enemy of god, युधि in the battlefield, स्वयम्भुदत्ताम् gifted by the self born, शक्तिम् javelin जग्राह seized.

text: स तां विधूमानलसन्निकाशां वित्रासिनीं वानरवाहिनीनाम् । चिक्षेप शक्तिं तरसाज्वलन्तीं सौमित्रये राक्षसराष्ट्रनाथः ॥६-५९-१०७॥
translation: The Lord of the world of Rakshasas instantly flung javelin, emitting fire without smoke, on Saumithri, which created fear among Vanaras.
word_meanings: राक्षसराष्ट्रनाथः Lord of the world of Rakshasas, सः he, सधूमानलसन्निकाशाम् like fire without smoke, संयति similar, वानराणाम् Vanaras, वित्रासनीम् create fear, ज्वलन्तीम् emitting fire, तांशक्तिम् that javelin, तरसा instantly, सौमित्रये on Saumithri, चिक्षेप flung.

text: तामापतन्तीं भरतानुजोग्रैर्जघान बाणैश्च हुताग्निकल्पैः । तथापि सा तस्य विवेश शक्तिर्बाह्वन्तरं दाशरथेर्विशालम् ॥६-५९-१०८॥
translation: Lakshmana, the brother of Bharata struck the fierce weapon coming towards him like flames of fire fuelled by ghee, even then it struck him on his broad chest.
word_meanings: भरतानुजः Bharata's brother, Lakshmana, अपतन्तीम् coming towards, ताम् that, अस्त्रै: weapon, हुताग्निकल्पैः with shafts like flames of fire fuelled by ghee, बाणैश्च dart, जघान coming, तथापि even so, साशक्तिः that javelin, दाशरथेः Lakshmana, विशालम् broad, भुजान्तरम् chest, विवेश entered.

text: स शक्तिमान् शक्तिसमाहतः सन् मुहुः प्रजज्वाल रघुप्रवीरः । तं विह्वलन्तं सहसा ऽभ्युपेत्य जग्राह राजा तरसा भुजाभ्याम् ॥६-५९-१०९॥
translation: Lakshmana the eminent hero of Raghu's was badly hurt by the javelin and was burning in pain. King Ravana caught him who was losing consciousness, violently and held him by his shoulders.
word_meanings: शक्तिसमाहतःसन् badly hurt by the javelin, शक्तिम् powerful, सः he, रघुप्रवीरः eminent hero of Raghu's, मुहुः many a times, प्रजज्वाल burnt, राजा king, सहसा violently, अभ्युपेत्य caught, विह्वलन्तम् losing consciousness, तम् him, तरसा speedily, भुजाभ्याम् shoulders, जग्राह held.

text: हिमवान् मन्दरो मेरुस्त्रैलोक्यं वा सहामरैः । शक्यं भुजाभ्यामुद्धर्तु न सङ्ख्ये भरतानुजः ॥६-५९-११०॥
translation: It may be possible to lift Himalayas, Mandara, Meru mountains or even the Devatas of the three worlds but not possible to lift Lakshmana by shoulders.
word_meanings: हिमवान् Himalayas, मन्दरः Mandara, मेरुः Meru, सहामरैः Devatas, त्रैलोक्यंवा even the three worlds, भुजाभ्याम् shoulders, उद्धर्तुम् to lift, शक्यम् possible, भरतानुजः Lakshmana, नसङ् ख्यः not possible.

text: शक्त्या ब्राह्म्या ऽपि सौमित्रिस्ताडितस्तु स्तनान्तरे । विष्णोरचिन्त्यं स्वं भागमात्मानं प्रत्यनुस्मरत् ॥६-५९-१११॥
translation: Even though Saumithri was wounded in the chest and the power of Brahma entered (into his chest) he recalled himself as an inconceivable form of Vishnu.
word_meanings: सौमित्रिः Saumithri, ब्राह्म्या shoulders, शक्त्या by the javelin, स्तनान्तरे in the chest, ताडितास्तु wounded, विष्णोः Vishnu, अचिन्त्यम् inconceivable, स्वम् him, आत्मानम् own self, अनुस्मरत् recalled.

text: ततो दानवदर्पघ्नं सौमित्रिं देवकण्टकः । तं पीडयित्वा बाहुभ्यामप्रभुर्लङ्घने ऽभवत् । अथैवं वैष्णवं भागं मानुषं देहमास्थितम् ॥६-५९-११२॥
translation: Thereafter, Ravana the enemy of Devatas was not capable of lifting Lakshmana's shoulders. Lakshmana could crush the pride of Rakshasas.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, देवकण्टकः enemy of Devatas, तम् him, दानवदर्पघ्नम् pride of Rakshasas, सौमित्रिम् Saumithri, बाहुभ्याम् shoulders, पीडयित्वा capable of crushing, लङ्घने to lift, प्रभुः king, नाभवत् not do.

text: अथ वायुसुतः क्रुद्धो रावणं समभिद्रवत् । आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो वज्रकल्पेन मुष्टिना ॥६-५९-११३॥
translation: Then the son of the wind god, enraged, came towards Ravana. Full of anger, he struck him with his thunderbolt like fist on the chest of Ravana.
word_meanings: अथ and then, क्रुद्धः angry, वायुसुतः son of wind god, रावणम् Ravana, समभिद्रवत् came towards, क्रुद्धः angry, वज्रकल्पेन by thunderbolt, मुष्टिना fist, उरसि on the chest, आजघान struck.

text: तेन मुष्टिप्रहारेण रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः । जानुभ्यामपतद्भूमौ चचाल च पपात च ॥६-५९-११४॥
translation: By the blow of Hanuman's fist, Ravana the Lord of Rakshasas was shaken and fell on the ground on his knees.
word_meanings: तेन by that, मुष्टिप्रहारेण blow of the fist, राक्षसेश्वरः Rakshasa Lord, रावणः Ravana, चचाल shaken, जानुभ्याम् on his knees, भूमौ on the ground, अपतत् च fell.

text: आस्यैः सनेत्रश्रवणैर्ववाम रुधिरं बहु ॥६-५९-११५॥
विघूर्णमानो निश्चेष्टो रथोपस्थ उपाविशत् । विसञ्ज्ञो मूर्च्छितश्चासीन्न च स्थानं समालभत् ॥६-५९-११६॥
विसञ्ज्ञं रावणं दृष्ट्वा समरे भीमविक्रमम् । ऋषयो वानराः सर्वे नेदुर्देवाः सवासवाः ॥६-५९-११७॥
translation: Ravana of fierce valour having lost senses and waking up from unconscious state, perturbed, did not know where he was. Seeing this the sages, even Vanaras, the demons as well as Devatas shouted in joy.
word_meanings: विसंज्ञः lost senses, मूर्छितश्च unconscious, आसीन्न perturbed, स्थानम् location, नचसमालभत् not knowing, समरे in the combat, भीमविक्रमम् fierce valour, रावणम् Ravana, दृष्टवा seeing, ऋषयः sages, वानराश्चैव Vanaras also, सवासवाःसह demons also, देवाश्चैव even Devatas, नेदुः shouted in joy.

text: हनुमानपि तेजस्वी लक्ष्मणं रावणार्दितम् । अनयद्राघवाभ्याशं बाहुभ्यां परिगृह्य तम् ॥६-५९-११८॥
translation: Brilliant Hanuman holding Lakshmana wounded by Ravana in both shoulders brought him to Rama.
word_meanings: अथ and, तेजस्वी brilliant, हनूमानपि Hanuman, रावणार्धितम् wounded by Ravana, तंलक्ष्मणम् that Lakshmana, बाहुभ्याम् both shoulders, परिगृह्य holding, राघूभ्याशम् near Rama, आनयत् brought.

text: वायुसूनोः सुहृत्त्वेन भक्त्या परमया च सः । शत्रूणामप्रकम्प्यो ऽपि लघुत्वमगमत् कपेः ॥६-५९-११९॥
translation: Lakshmana though unshakeable for enemies, became light for the son of wind god by his friendship and high devotion.
word_meanings: सः he, शत्रूणाम् for the enemies, अप्रकम्पःअपि unshakeable by enemies, वायुसूनोः son of wind god, सुहृत्त्वेन friend, परमया highly, भक्त्याच being devoted, कपेः monkey, लघुत्वम् became light, आगमत् became.

text: तं समुत्सृज्य सा शक्तिः सौमित्रिं युधि दुर्जयम् । रावणस्य रथे तस्मिन् स्थानं पुनरुपागता ॥६-५९-१२०॥
translation: That power returned back to Ravana's chariot to its position, leaving Lakshmana, who was difficult to vanquish.
word_meanings: साशक्तिः that power, युधि in war, दुर्जयम् vanquish, सौमित्रिम् Saumithri, रावणस्य Ravana's, तस्मिन् रथे in his chariot, पुनः again, स्थानम् position, उपागता returning back.

text: आश्वस्तश्च विशल्यश्च लक्ष्मणः शत्रुसूदनः । विष्णोर्भागममीमांस्यमात्मानं प्रत्यनुस्मरन् ॥६-५९-१२१॥
translation: Lakshmana who could destroy foes, recovering from unconsciousness, relieved of wounds again remembered himself to be part of Vishnu of immeasurable power.
word_meanings: शत्रुसूदनः could destroy foes, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अमीमांस्यम् immeasurable, विष्णोःभागम् part of Vishnu, आत्मानम् himself, प्रत्यनुस्मरन् again remembering, आश्वस्तःच from consciousness, विशल्यःच relieved of wounds.

text: रावणो ऽपि महातेजाः प्राप्य सञ्ज्ञां महाहवे । आददे निशितान् बाणान् जग्राह च महद्धनुः ॥६-५९-१२२॥
translation: Ravana of mighty prowess waking up from consciousness took over his sharp arrows and the great bow also.
word_meanings: महातेजाः of mighty prowess, रावणोऽपि Ravana too, महाहवे huge combat संज्ञाम् waking up, प्राप्य endured, निशितान् sharp, बाणान् arrows, आददे, महत् great, धनुःच bow also, आददे took over.

text: निपातितमहावीरां द्रवन्तीं वानरीं चमूम् । राघवस्तु रणे दृष्ट्वा रावणं समभिद्रवत् ॥६-५९-१२३॥
translation: Raghava also assailed Ravana seeing the fallen Vanara heroes struck in the combat.
word_meanings: राघवस्तु Raghava also, रणे in the combat, निपातितमहावीराम् fallen heroes, द्रवन्तीम् struck down, वानरीम् Vanaras, चमूम् leaders, दृष्टवा seeing, रावणम् Ravana, समभिद्रवत् assailed.

text: अथैनमुपसङ्गम्य हनुमान् वाक्यमब्रवीत् । मम पृष्टं समारुह्य राक्षसं शास्तुमर्हसि ॥६-५९-१२४॥
translation: And then Hanuman submitted to Rama, "Just as Lord Vishnu mounted on mighty Garuda, you should also be mounted on my back and subdue Ravana."
word_meanings: अथ and then, हनूमान् Hanuman, एनम् , उपसङ्गम्य submitted, वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke, विष्णुः Vishnu, गरुत्मन्तम् Garuda, बलवंन्तं mighty, समाहितः mounted, यथा so also, मम my, पृष्ठम् back, समारुह्य mounting, राक्षसम् Rakshasa, शास्तुम् subdue, अर्हसि ought to.

text: विष्णुर्यथा गरुत्मन्तं बलवन्तं समाहितः । तच्छुत्वा राघवो वाक्यं वायुपुत्रेण भाषितम् । आरुरोह महाशूरो बलवन्तं महाकपिम् ॥६-५९-१२५॥
रथस्थं रावणं सङ्ख्ये ददर्श मनुजाधिपः ॥६-५९-१२६॥
translation: On hearing the sub mission of Hanuman, Sri Rama, the Lord of humans climbed on the great monkey and saw Ravana on the chariot.
word_meanings: राघवः Raghava, वायुपुत्रेण to the son of wind god, भाषितम् spoken, तत् those, वाक्यम् words, श्रुत्वा hearing, आरुरोहमहाशूरं climbed on the hero, महाकपिम् great monkey, बलवन्तम् strong, आरुरोह on climbing, मनुजाधिपः Lord of humans, सङ् ख्ये in war, रथस्थम् on the chariot, रावणम् Ravana, ददर्श saw.

text: ा राघवो वाक्यं वायुपुत्रेण भाषितम् । तमालोक्य माहतेजाः प्रदुद्राव स राघवः । वैरोचनमिव क्रुद्धो विष्णुरभ्युद्यतायुधः ॥६-५९-१२७॥
translation: Beholding Ravana, highly energetic Rama wielding his bow went furiously towards him just as Lord Vishnu went with his discuss against Virochana.
word_meanings: महातेजाः highly energetic, सः he, तम् him, आलोक्य beheld, क्रुद्धः furious, अभ्युद्यतायुधः rushed towards, विष्णुः Vishnu, वैरोचनिव like Virochana, राघवः Raghava, प्रदुद्राव wielding bow.

text: ज्याशब्दमकरोत्तीवं वज्रनिष्पेषनिस्वनम् ॥६-५९-१२८॥
गिरा गम्भीरया रामो राक्षसेन्द्रमुवाच ह ॥६-५९-१२९॥
translation: Rama created a sound like a clap of thunder ringing intensely, a majestic one and spoke in a deep voice to the king.
word_meanings: रामः Rama, वज्रनिष्पेषनिस्वनम् like the clap of thunder sound, तीव्रम् intense, ज्याशब्दम् echoing the sound, अकरोत् caused, गम्भीरया majestic, गिरा in deep voice, राक्षसेन्द्रम् Rakshasa king, उवाचह spoke.

text: तिष्ठ तिष्ठ मम त्वं हि कृत्वा विप्रियमीद्दशम् । क्व नु राक्षसशार्दूल गतो मोक्षमवाप्स्यसि ॥६-५९-१३०॥
translation: "Oh! Tiger among Rakshasas, forbear, forbear. Having done such an offence to me, where are you going for deliverance"
word_meanings: राक्षसशार्दूल tiger among Rakshasas, तिष्ठतिष्ठ forbear, त्वम् you, मम to me, ईदृशम् such, विप्रियम् delivered, कृत्वा having done, क्वनु where, गत्वा going, मोक्षम् deliverance, अवाप्स्यसि after the offence.

text: यदीन्द्रवैवस्वतभास्करान् वा स्वयम्भुवैश्वानरशङ्करान् वा । गमिष्यसि त्वं दश वा दिशो ऽथवा तथापि मे नाद्य गतो विमोक्ष्यसे ॥६-५९-१३१॥
translation: "If you go to Indra or Yama or Sun God or the selfborn Brahma or fire God or Shankara or the ten directions like that, and if you run in front of me you cannot escape."
word_meanings: इन्द्रवैवस्वतभास्करान्वा either to Indra, or Yama or sun god, स्वयम्भुवैश्वानरशंकरान्वा to selfborn Brahma or to fire god or Shankara, दशवा ten, दिशोवा directions, त्वम् you, गमिष्यसियदि even if you run, तथापि like that, अद्य front, मे of me, गतः gone, नविमोक्ष्यसे not escape.

text: यश्चैव शक्त्या ऽभिहतस्त्वया ऽद्य इच्छन् विषादं सहसा ऽभ्युपेतः । स एव रक्षोगणराज मृत्युः सपुत्रदारस्य तवाद्ययुद्धे ॥६-५९-१३२॥
translation: "Oh! king of Rakshasa troop! He, who was struck without support now, even if he were to come now in front, you with your sons and grandsons will be struck to death by him."
word_meanings: रक्षोगणराज king of Rakshasa troop, अद्य in front, यःएषः he who like that, त्वया by you, शक्त्या support, अभिहतः struck now, विषादम् sorrow, इच्छन् , सःएव he himself, सहसा now, अभ्युपेत्य come, अद्य in front, युद्धे to combat, सपुत्रपौत्रस्य sons and grandsons, तव your, मृत्युः death.

text: एतेन चात्यद्भुतदर्शनानि शरैर्जनस्थानकृतालयानि । चतुर्दशान्यात्तवरायुधानि रक्षस्सहस्राणि निषूदितानि ॥६-५९-१३३॥
translation: "By me, who is your adversary, fourteen thousand Rakshasas of fierce forms, who had taken abode at Janasthana and used choicest weapons were exterminated."
word_meanings: एतेन by me, अद्भुतदर्शनानि of fierce form, जनस्थानकृतालयानि taken abode at Janasthana, अत्तवरायुधानि used choicest weapons, चतुर्धशानि fourteen, रक्षःसहस्राणि thousands of Rakshasas, शरैः weapons, निषूदितानि were destroyed by me.

text: राघवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रो महाकपिम् । वायुपुत्रं महावीर्यं वहन्तं राघवं रणे । आजघान शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः कालानलशिखोपमैः ॥६-५९-१३४॥
translation: On hearing Raghava's words, the mighty strong king of Rakshasas seized with violent anger, recalling earlier enmity, struck with blazing arrows like tongues of fire at the time of universal destruction while Hanuman bore Rama.
word_meanings: महाबलः mighty strong, राक्षसेन्द्रः Lord of Rakshasas, राघवस्य Raghava's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, महता violent, रोषेण anger, आविष्टः seized with, पूर्ववैरम् earlier enmity, अनुस्मरन् recalling, रणे in combat, राघवम् Raghava, वहन्तम् struck, महावेगम् at high speed, वायुपुत्रम् son of wind god, कालानलशिखोपमैः like tongues of fire at universal destruction, दीप्स्सैः blazing, शरैः darts, आजघान discharged.

text: राक्षसेनाहवे तस्य ताडितस्यापि सायकैः । स्वभावतेजोयुक्तस्य भूयस्तेजो ऽभ्यवर्धत ॥६-५९-१३५॥
translation: Even though Hanuman was hurt by the arrows discharged by the Rakshasa king, being endowed with energy by nature, his energy went on increasing.
word_meanings: राक्षसेन by the Rakshasa, आहवे discharged, सायकैः arrows, ताडितस्यापि when hurt him also, स्वभावतेजोयुक्तस्य by nature endowed with energy, तस्य his, तेजः energy, भूयः exceedingly, अभ्यवर्धत went on increasing.

text: ततो रामो महातेजा रावणेन कृतव्रणम् । दृष्ट्वा प्लवगशार्दूलं कोपस्य वशमेयिवान् ॥६-५९-१३६॥
translation: Seeing the wounds caused by Ravana to Hanuman, the tiger among monkeys, possibly Rama was seized with anger.
word_meanings: ततः then, महातेजाः of extraordinary energy, रामः Rama, रावणेन Ravana, कृतव्रणम् wounds caused, प्लवगशार्दूलम् tiger among monkeys, दृष्टवा seeing, क्रोधस्य in anger, वशम् seized, एयिवान् possibly.

text: तस्याभिचङ्क्रम्य रथं सचक्रं साश्वध्वजच्छत्रमहापताकम् । ससारथिं साशनिशूलखड्गं रामः प्रचिच्छेद शरैः सुपुङ्खैः ॥६-५९-१३७॥
translation: Advancing towards him, (Ravana), Rama tore into pieces his chariot, wheels, horses, standard and canopy including the charioteer and the darts and swords.
word_meanings: रामः Rama, अभिसङ्क्रम्य advancing forward, तस्य his, सचक्रम् the wheel of chariot, साश्वध्वजच्छत्रमहापताकम् horses, standard, canopy, ससारथिम् the charioteer, साशनिशूलखडगम् tridents and weapons, रथम् chariot, शरैः darts, पुङ्खैः swords, प्रचिच्छेद tore into pieces.

text: अथेन्द्रशत्रुं तरसा जघान बाणेन वज्राशनिसन्निभेन । भुजान्तरे व्यूढसुजातरूपे वज्रेण मेरुं भगवानिवेन्द्रः ॥६-५९-१३८॥
translation: Then with a shining thunderbolt like arrows Rama struck with the weapon of Indra into the fine chest in between the shoulders just as Indra would strike the Meru Mountain with his thunderbolt.
word_meanings: अथ and, वज्राशनिसन्निभेन resembling thunderbolt in shining, बाणेन arrows, इन्द्रशत्रुम् weapon of Indra, तरसा sharp, व्यूढसुजातरूपे broad fine looking chest,भुजान्तरे in between the shoulders, भगवान् divine, इन्द्रः Indra, वज्रेण with thunderbolt, मेरुम् इव like the Meru mountain, जघान struck.

text: यो वज्रपाताशनिसन्निपातान्न चुक्षुभे नापि चचाल राजा । स रामबाणाभिहतो भृशार्तश्चचाल चापं च मुमोच वीरः ॥६-५९-१३९॥
translation: He, that heroic king, who was not disturbed hurt by thunderbolt of lightning, was agonized when struck by Rama's arrow and let his bow fall.
word_meanings: यः he, राजा king, वज्रपाताशनिसन्निपातात् one who is not disturbed hit by thunderbolt or by lightning, नचुक्षुभे not disturbed, नापिचचाल arrow, सः he, वीरः hero, रामबाणाभिहतः struck by Rama's arrow, भृशार्तः reeled, चचाल agonized, चापंच bow also, मुमोच let go.

text: तं विह्वलन्तं प्रसमीक्ष्य रामः समाददे दीप्तमथार्धचन्द्रम् । तेनार्कवर्णं सहसा किरीटं चिच्छेद रक्षोधिपतेर्महात्मा ॥६-५९-१४०॥
translation: Seeing Ravana swooning, great soul Rama took up a crescent shaped arrow and hastily broke his crown into pieces which were shining bright red like the Sun.
word_meanings: रामः Rama, विह्वलन्तम् swooning, तम् him, प्रसमीक्ष्य seeing, अथ then, दीप्तम् flaming, अर्थचन्द्रम् crescent shaped, समाददे took up, तेन by that, महात्मा great soul, सहसा hastily, अर्कवर्णम् red like sun, किरीटम् crown, चिच्छेद broke into pieces.

text: तं निर्विषाशीविषसन्निकाशं शान्तार्चिषं सूर्यमिवाप्रकाशम् । गतश्रियं कृत्तकिरीटकूटमुवाच रामो युधि राक्षसेन्द्रम् ॥६-५९-१४१॥
translation: Rama said to the king of Rakshasas, who was like a serpent rid of poison without (head) crown, without splendour like the Sun without brightness, his glory lost with the crown broken in the combat.
word_meanings: रामः Rama, युधि in combat, निर्विषाशीविषसन्निकाशम् resembling a serpent rid of poison without his crown, शान्तार्चिषम् without splendour, सूर्यमिव like sun, अप्रकाशम् without brightness, गतश्रियम् glory lost, कृत्तकिरीटकूटम् crown being torn, तंराक्षसेन्द्रम् that king of Rakshasas, उवाच said.

text: कृतं त्वया कर्म महत् सुभीमं हतप्रवीरश्च कृतस्त्वया ऽहम् । तस्मात् परिश्रान्त इव व्यवस्य न त्वां शरैर्मृत्युवशं नयामि ॥६-५९-१४२॥
translation: A great task of killing mighty heroes has been accomplished by you. Therefore, you are exhausted. I declare that I will not send you to death.
word_meanings: त्वया by you, सुभीमम् exceedingly difficult, महत् great, कर्म task, कृतम् done, त्वया by you, अहम् I, हतप्रवीरः mighty heroes killed, कृतःच done, तस्मात् therefore, परिशान्तःइति exhausted, व्यवस्य declare, त्वाम् you, मृत्युवशम् to death, ननयामि not sent.

text: गच्छानुजानामि रणार्दितस्त्वं प्रविश्य रात्रिंचरराज लङ्काम् । आश्वास्य निर्याहि रथी च धन्वी तदा बलं द्रक्ष्यसि मे रथस्थः ॥६-५९-१४३॥
translation: "King of night rangers! I know you are agonized after the war. Go to Lanka and rest and reenter, mounted on your chariot with bow. You will witness my strength."
word_meanings: रात्रिंचरराज king of night rangers, जानामि I know, त्वम् you, रणार्धितः are agonized after war, गच्छ go, लङ्काम् to Lanka, प्रविश्य reenter, अश्वस्य resting, रथी chariot, धन्वीच and bow, निर्याहि depart, तदा then, रथस्थः mounted on chariot, मे my, बलम् strength, प्रेक्ष्यसि witness.

text: स एवमुक्तो हतदर्पहर्षो निकृत्तचापः स हताश्वसूतः । शरार्दितः कृत्तमहाकिरीटो विवेश लङ्कां सहसा स राजा ॥६-५९-१४४॥
translation: Rama having spoken in that way (consoling), the king with his vanity and pride crushed, bow broken into pieces, horses and charioteer killed, wounded by arrows, crown broken entered Lanka hastily.
word_meanings: एवम् in that way, उक्तः having spoken, सः by him, हतदर्पहर्षः vanity and joy crushed, निकृत्तचापः bow broken into pieces, हताश्वसूतः horses and charioteer killed, शरार्धितः wounded by arrows, कृत्तमहाकिरीटः crown broken, सःराजा that king, सहसा hastily, लङ्काम् Lanka, विवेश entered.

text: तस्मिन् प्रविष्टे रजनीचरेन्द्रे महाबले दानवदेवशत्रौ । हरीन् विशल्यान् सह लक्ष्मणेन चकार रामः परमाहवाग्रे ॥६-५९-१४५॥
translation: After the king of prowlers, the enemy of Danavas and Devas entered Lanka, Rama and Lakshmana also drew out the arrows from monkeys in the forefront of the battlefield and went.
word_meanings: महाबले endowed with great prowess, दानवदेवशत्रौ enemy of Danavas and Devas, तस्मिन् his, रजनीचरेन्द्रे king night prowlers, प्रविष्टे entering, रामः Rama, परमाहवाग्रे in the forefront, लक्ष्मणेनसह with Lakshmana, हरीन् monkeys ', विशल्यान् removed, चकार went.

text: तस्मिन् प्रभिन्ने त्रिदशेन्द्रशत्रौ सुरासुरा भूतगणा दिशश्च । ससागराः सर्षिमहोरागाश्च तथैव भूम्यम्बुचराश्च हृष्टाः ॥६-५९-१४६॥
translation: The enemy of Indra having been routed, the suras and asuras, the guardians of the four quarters, including the sea, the large serpents, and sages so also the creatures of land and water were joyful. ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेएकोनषष्टितमस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the fifty ninth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: त्रिदशेन्द्रशत्रौ enemy of Indra, तस्मिन् his, प्रभन्ने having been routed, सुरासुराः suras and Asuras, भूतगणाः guardians, दिशश्च of four quarters, हसागराः including sea, सर्षिमहोरगाःच including the sages and serpents, तथैव so also, भूम्यम्बुचराः creatures of land and water, प्रहृष्टाः joyful.

text: स प्रविश्य पुरीं लङ्कां रामबाणभयार्दितः । भग्नदर्पस्तदा राजा बभूव व्यथितेन्द्रियः ॥६-६०-१॥
translation: Then the king of Lanka after entering the city of Lanka, felt humiliated by Rama's arrow, vanity crushed and had lost control over his senses.
word_meanings: तदा then, सः he, राजा king, लङ्कांपुरीम् Lanka, प्रविश्य entered, रामबाणभयार्धितः fearing the arrow of Rama, भग्नदर्पः vanity crushed, व्यथितेन्द्रियः lost control over senses, बभूव felt.

text: मातङ्ग इव सिंहेन गरुडेनेव पन्नगः । अभिभूतो ऽभवद्राजा राघवेण महात्मना ॥६-६०-२॥
translation: Overcome by humiliation from the high souled Rama, Ravana remained like an elephant rejected by a lion and a serpent rejected by Garuda.
word_meanings: राजा king, सिंहेन lion, मातङ्गःइव like an elephant, गरुडेन by Garuda, पन्नगइव like a serpent, महात्मना high souled, राघवेण at Rama, अभिभूतः humiliated, अभवत् remained.

text: ब्रह्मदण्डप्रकाशानां विद्युत्सदृशवर्चसाम् । स्मरन् राघवबाणानां विव्यथे राक्षसेश्वरः ॥६-६०-३॥
translation: The Lord of Rakshasas remained disquieted recalling the arrows of Rama which emitted light like lightning, resembling Brahmadanda.
word_meanings: राक्षसेश्वरः Lord of Rakshasas, ब्रह्मदण्डप्रतीकानाम् resembling Brahmadanda (A comet seen at the time of dissolution), विद्युत्सदृशवर्चसाम् emitted an unsteady light like lightning, राघवमाणानम् Rama on his part, स्मरन् recalling, विव्यथे disquieted.

text: स काञ्चनमयं दिव्यमाश्रित्य परमासनम् । विप्रेक्षमाणो रक्षांसि रावणो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥६-६०-४॥
translation: Ravana seated on the wonderful golden magnificent throne gazing at Rakshasas spoke these words.
word_meanings: सःरावणः Ravana, काञ्चनमयम् golden, दिव्यम् wonderful, परमासनम् magnificent, आश्रित्य seated, रक्षांसि at Rakshasas, विप्रेक्षमाणः gazing at, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: सर्वं तत् खलु मे मोघं यत्तप्तं परमं तपः । यत् समानो महेन्द्रेण मानुषेणास्मि निर्जितः ॥६-६०-५॥
translation: " All the penance which I have done, and the asceticism practised by me equal to Mahendra has become purposeless and defeated."
word_meanings: रमम् Rama, यत् that which, तपः penance, तप्तम् asceticism, मे my, तत् सर्वम् all that, मोघंखलु purposeless, यत् that which, महेन्द्रेण by Mahendra, समानः equal to, मानुषेण human, िर्जितः defeated.

text: इदं तद्ब्रह्मणो घोरं वाक्यं मामभ्युपस्थितम् । मानुषेभ्यो विजानीहि भयं त्वमिति तत्तथा ॥६-६०-६॥
translation: The dreadful words of Brahma spoken to me" know that danger from humans is coming to be true.
word_meanings: त्वम् you, मानुषेभ्यः from humans, भयम् fear, विजानीहि coming to be true, इति thus, ब्रह्मणः Brahma, इदम् these, घोरम् dreadful, वाक्यम् words, माम् to me, उपस्थितम् warning given, तत् that, तथा like that.

text: देवदानवगन्धर्वैर्यक्षराक्षसपन्नगैः । अवध्यत्वं मया प्राप्तं मानुषेभ्यो न याचितम् ॥६-६०-७॥
translation: "I sought protection from Devas, Danavas, Gandharvas, Rakshasas and serpents but not asked for protection from humans."
word_meanings: देवदानवगन्धर्वैः Devas, Danavas and Gandharvas, यक्षराक्षसपन्नगैः Yakshas, Rakshasas and serpents, अवध्यत्वम् not to be killed, मया by me, प्राप्तम् sought, मानुषेभ्यः from humans, नयाचितम् not asked for.

text: विदितं मानुषं मन्ये रामं दशरथात्मजम् । इक्ष्वाकुकुलनाथेन अनरण्येन यत्पुरा ॥६-६०-८॥
translation: "I think that Dasaratha's son Rama, a human being is about whom king Anaranya born in Ikshvaku race, who cursed me earlier saying, 'In my race will be born a man who will kill you in war, with your sons, your horses, charioteers, all army, O evil minded lowest of Rakshasas, and the vilest of Rakshasas."
word_meanings: राक्षसाधम lowest Rakshasa, कुलाधम vilest of the clan, दुर्मते evil minded, यः he who, सपुत्रम् your sons, सामात्यम् altogether, सबलम् all army, साश्वसारथिम् your horses and charioteers, त्वाम् you, सङ्ग्रामे in war, निहनिष्यति will perish, पुरुषः man, मद्वंशे in my race, उत्पत्स्यतेहि will be born, पुरा in the past, इक्ष्वाकुकलजातेन in the race of Ikshvaku, अनरण्येनयत् like that by Anaranya, विदितम् made known, दशरथात्मजम् Dasaratha's son, रामम् Rama, मानुषम् human, मन्ये I think.

text: उत्पत्स्यते हि मद्वंशे पुरुषो राक्षसाधम । यस्त्वां सपुत्रं सामात्यं सबलं साश्वसारथिम् । निहनिष्यति सङ्ग्रामे त्वां कुलाधम दुर्मते ॥६-६०-९॥
translation: "I think that Dasaratha's son Rama, a human being is about whom king Anaranya born in Ikshvaku race, who cursed me earlier saying, 'In my race will be born a man who will kill you in war, with your sons, your horses, charioteers, all army, O evil minded lowest of Rakshasas, and the vilest of Rakshasas."
word_meanings: राक्षसाधम lowest Rakshasa, कुलाधम vilest of the clan, दुर्मते evil minded, यः he who, सपुत्रम् your sons, सामात्यम् altogether, सबलम् all army, साश्वसारथिम् your horses and charioteers, त्वाम् you, सङ्ग्रामे in war, निहनिष्यति will perish, पुरुषः man, मद्वंशे in my race, उत्पत्स्यतेहि will be born, पुरा in the past, इक्ष्वाकुकलजातेन in the race of Ikshvaku, अनरण्येनयत् like that by Anaranya, विदितम् made known, दशरथात्मजम् Dasaratha's son, रामम् Rama, मानुषम् human, मन्ये I think.

text: शप्तो ऽहं वेदवत्या च यदा सा धर्षिता पुरा । सेयं सीता महाभागा जाता जनकनन्दिनी ॥६-६०-१०॥
translation: "In the past, I violated Vedavathi and got cursed by her. The same Woman born as Sita, the daughter of Janaka, is a highly blessed one."
word_meanings: यदा that way, पुरा in the past, सा she, धर्षिता violated, वेदवत्या by Vedavathi, अहम् I am, शप्तः cursed, सा she, इयम् thus, महाभागा highly blessed, जनकनन्दिनी loved by Janaka, सीता Sita, जाता born.

text: उमा नन्दीश्वरश्चापि रम्भा वरुणकन्यका । यथोक्तास्तपसा प्राप्तं न मिथ्या ऋषिभाषितम् ॥६-६०-११॥
translation: "Uma, Nandeeswara, Rambha and daughter of Varuna have cursed me like that and the prediction of those endowed with vision has been attained by me."
word_meanings: उमा Uma, नन्दीश्वरश्चापि Nandeeswara (monkey faced attendant of Siva) also, रम्भ Rambha, वरुणकन्यका daughter of Varuna, यथा like that, उक्ताः spoken, तत् that, मया by me, प्राप्तम् attained, ऋषिभाषितम् spoken by those endowed with vision, मिथ्या untrue, न not.

text: एतदेवाभ्युपागम्य यत्नं कर्तुमिहार्हथ । राक्षसाश्चापि तिष्ठन्तु चर्यागोपुरमूर्द्धसु ॥६-६०-१२॥
translation: "Knowing all this, make effort doing what ought to be done and let the Rakshasas strive to succeed positioned on top of the gates."
word_meanings: एतत् एव all this, अभ्युपागम्य knowing, इह here, यत्नम् make effort, कर्तुम् will do, अर्हथ ought to, राक्षसाश्चापि even Rakshasas, चर्यागोपुरमूर्धसु strive to succeed positioned at the top of gates, तिष्ठन्तु positioned.

text: स चाप्रतिमगाम्भीरो देवदानवदर्पहा । ब्रह्मशापाभिभूतस्तु कुम्भकर्णो विबोध्यताम् ॥६-६०-१३॥
translation: "Let Kumbhakarna of unparalleled profundity, capable of crushing Devas and Danavas, who is in slumber owing to the curse of Brahma be awakened."
word_meanings: अप्रतिमगाम्भीर्यः unparalleled in profundity, देवदानवदर्पहाः capable of crushing the vanity of Devas and Danavas, ब्रह्मशापाभिभूतः cursed by Brahma, सः he, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, विबोध्यताम् be aroused.

text: स पराजितमात्मानं प्रहस्तं च निषूदितम् । ज्ञात्वा रक्षोबलं भीममादिदेश महाबलः ॥६-६०-१४॥
translation: "Let him be instructed that Prahastha endowed with mighty prowess has been defeated and killed."
word_meanings: महाबलः endowed with mighty prowess, सः he, पराजितम् defeated, आत्मानम् himself, प्रहस्तम् Prahastha, निषूदितम् killed, भीमम् terrific, बलम् strength, आदिदेश be instructed.

text: द्वारेषु यत्नः क्रियतां प्राकारश्चाधिरुह्यताम् । निद्रावशसमाविष्टः कुम्भकर्णो विबोध्यताम् ॥६-६०-१५॥
translation: "Let the Rakshasas climb up the defensive walls and attempt to guard. Also let Kumbhakarna be aroused from sleep."
word_meanings: द्वारेषु gates, यत्नः attempt, क्रियताम् carryout, प्राकारश्च defensive walls, अधिरुह्यताम् climbing up, निद्राववसमाविष्टः fully awakened from sleep, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, विबोध्यताम् aroused.

text: सुखं स्वपिति निश्चिन्तः कालोपहतचेतनः । नव षट् सप्त चाष्टौ च मासान् स्वपिति राक्षसः ॥६-६०-१६॥
translation: "The Rakshasa, Kumbhakarna, lost consciousness is slumbering at ease and has been sleeping for six to nine months happily."
word_meanings: राक्षसः Rakshasa, कालोपहतचेतनः lost consciousness for long, निश्चिन्तः slumbering at ease, नव nine, सप्त seven, षट् six, अष्टौ eight च and, मासान् months, सुखम् happily, स्वपिति sleeping.

text: मन्त्रयित्वा प्रसुप्तो ऽयमितस्तु नवमे ऽहनि । तं तु बोधयत क्षिप्रं कुम्भकर्णं महाबलम् ॥६-६०-१७॥
translation: "Deliberating like this with me, Kumbhakarna is sleeping for the ninth day from now. He may be quickly informed (aroused)."
word_meanings: मन्त्रयित्वा deliberating like this, अयम् I am, इतः here, नवमे nine, अहनि day and night, प्रसुप्तः sleeping, महाबलम् great strength, तंकुम्बकुर्णम् that Kumbhakarna, क्षिप्रम् quickly, बोधयत may be informed

text: स तु सङ्ख्ये महाबाहुः ककुदः सर्वरक्षसाम् । वानरान् राजपुत्रौ च क्षिप्रमेव वधिष्यति ॥६-६०-१८॥
translation: "Endowed with broad shoulders, he is the foremost of Rakshasas. He will crush many Vanaras immediately and the two princes (Rama and Lakshmana)."
word_meanings: सर्वरक्षसाम् among the Rakshasas, ककुदम् foremost, महाबाहुःतु endowed with broad shoulders, सः he, सङ् ख्ये many, वानरान् Vanaras, राजपुत्रौच princes, क्षिप्रमेव instantly, हनिष्यति will crush them.

text: एष केतुः परः सङ्ख्ये मुख्यो वै सर्वरक्षसाम् । कुम्भकर्णः सदा शेते मूढो ग्राम्यसुखे रतः ॥६-६०-१९॥
translation: "He, (Kumbhakarna) is the foremost chief among all Rakshasas enumerated. In that way he is distinguished. But he is insensate, remains addicted always to indecent delight in the form of sleep."
word_meanings: सर्वरक्षसाम् all Rakshasas, मुख्यः chief, सङ् ख्ये enumerated, परम् distinguished, केतुः foremost, एषः in that way कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, मूढः insensate, ग्राम्यसुखे in indecent delight in the form of sleep, रतः remains, सदा always, शेते addicted.

text: रामेण हि निरस्तस्य सङ्ग्रामे ऽस्मिन् सुदारुणे । भविष्यति न मे शोकः कुम्भकर्णे विबोधिते ॥६-६०-२०॥
translation: " After Kumbhakarna is fully aroused, my sorrow impelled in this terrible comb at with Rama will not be there."
word_meanings: कुम्भकर्णे Kumbhakarna, विबोधिते aroused, सुदारुणे very dreadful, अस्मिन् this, सङ्ग्रामे combat, रामेण with Rama, हिनिरस्तस्य to impel, मे to me, शोकः sad, नभविष्यति not take place.

text: किं करिष्याम्यहं तेन शक्रतुल्यबलेन हि । ईद्दशे व्यसने प्राप्ते यो न साह्याय कल्पते ॥६-६०-२१॥
translation: "What can I do if he does not assist me in such a dreadful comb at because of his weakness, even though he is equal to Indra in strength"
word_meanings: यः he who, ईदृशे in such, घोरे dreadful, व्यसने weakness, साह्याय assistance, नकल्पते not able to, शक्रतुल्यबलेन equal to Indra in his strength, तेन by that, अहम् I am, किम् what, करिष्यामि can I do.

text: ते तु तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य राक्षसाः । जग्मुः परमसम्भ्रान्ताः कुम्भकर्णनिवेशनम् ॥६-६०-२२॥
translation: On listening to the Rakshasa king's words, the Rakshasas went to the abode of Kumbhakarna highly puzzled.
word_meanings: ते they, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य at king of Rakshasas, तत् वाक्यम् those words, श्रुत्वा on listening, परमसम्भ्रान्ताः highly puzzled, कुम्भकर्णनिवेशनम् Kumbhakarna's abode, जग्मुः went.

text: ते रावणसमादिष्टा मांसशोणितभोजनाः । गन्धमाल्यांस्तथा भक्ष्यानादाय सहसा ययुः ॥६-६०-२३॥
तां प्रविश्य महाद्वारां सर्वतो योजनायताम् । कुम्भकर्णगुहां रम्यां सर्वगन्धप्रवाहिनीम् ॥६-६०-२४॥
कुम्भकर्णस्य निश्वासादवधूता महाबलाः । प्रतिष्ठमानाः कृच्छ्रेण यत्नात् प्रविविशुर्गुहाम् ॥६-६०-२५॥
translation: The Rakshasas entered the beautiful residence of Kumbhakarna which was one yojana on all sides with huge gates, taking fragrant garlands and foods (to wake up Kumbhakarna) from where they were pushed out by the breath of Kumbhakarna. The Rakshasas endowed with mighty strength pushed their way into the residence of Kumbhakarna and entered.
word_meanings: महाद्वाराम् huge gates, सर्वतः all over, योजनायुताम् one yojana on all sides, सर्वगन्धप्रवाहिनीम् with all fragrant flowers food etc, रम्याम् beautiful, कुम्भकर्णगुहाम् residence of Kumbhakarna, प्रविश्य entered, कुम्भकर्णस्य Kumbhakarna's, निःश्वासात् by the breath, अवधूताः attendants, महाबलाः of mighty strength, कृच्छ्रेण pushed out, प्रतिष्ठमानाः pushed their way, यत्नात् attempt, गुहाम् residence, प्रविविशुः entered.

text: तां प्रविश्य गुहां रम्यां शुभां काञ्चनकुट्टिमाम् । ददृशुर्नैर्ऋतव्याघ्रं शयानं भीमदर्शनम् ॥६-६०-२६॥
translation: The tigers among Rakshasas entered the residence paved with gold and precious stones, a delightful one and saw sleeping Kumbhakarna of great prowess.
word_meanings: नैरृतव्याघ्रं tigers among Rakshasas, शुभाम् काञ्चनकुट्टिमाम् paved with gold and precious stones, रम्याम् delightful, तांगुहाम् home, प्रविव्य entered, शयानम् sleeping, भीमविदर्शनम् of terrible prowess, ददृशुः saw.

text: ते तु तं विकृतं सुप्तं विकीर्णमिव पर्वतम् । कुम्भकर्णं महानिद्रं सहिताः प्रत्यबोधयन् ॥६-६०-२७॥
translation: Those Rakshasas collected together started to awaken Kumbhakarna, who was like a scattered mountain in dead sleep.
word_meanings: ते those, सहिताः collected together, विकृतम् of unnatural form, सुप्तम् sleeping on bed, विकीर्णम् scattered, पर्वतम् इव mountain like, महानिद्रम् in dead sleep, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, प्रत्यबोधयन् to awaken.

text: ऊर्ध्वरोमाञ्चिततनुं श्वसन्तमिव पन्नगम् । त्रासयन्तं महाश्वासैः शयानं भीमदर्शनम् ॥६-६०-२८॥
translation: The Rakshasas saw Kumbhakarna, destroyer of enemies, the tiger of the southwest, tamer of foes, with his body fully covered with bristling hair, breathing heavily like a serpent with horrible nostrils, turning back with facemouth as vast as underworld all limbs stretched out, emitting smell of fat and blood, arms adorned with gold bracelets, wearing a crown, and sleeping.
word_meanings: ऊर्ध्वरोमाञ्चिततनुम् body covered with bristling hair, पन्नगमिव like a serpent, श्वसन्तम् breathing, न्वििश्श्वसैः hissing heavily, भ्रामयन्तम् turning back, शयानम् sleeping, भीमविदर्शमम् of terrible, नीमनासापुटम् horrible nostrils, पातालविपुलाननम् face as vast as underworld, वयने, न्यस्तसर्वाङ्गम् all limbs stretched out, मेदोरुधिरगन्धिनम् emitting smell of fat and blood, काञ्चनाङ्गदनद्धाङ्गम् arms adorned with gold bracelets, किरीटिनम् wearing a crown, अरिन्दमम् tamer of foes, नैरृतव्याघ्रम् tiger of southwest, अरिमर्धनम् destroyer of enemies, तंकुम्भकर्णम् that Kumbhakarna, ददृशुः saw.

text: भीमनासापुटं तं तु पातालविपुलाननम् । शय्यायां न्यस्तसर्वाङ्गं मेदोरुधिरगन्धिनम् ॥६-६०-२९॥
काञ्चनाङ्गदनद्धाङ्गं किरीटिनमरिन्दमम् । ददृशुर्नैर्ऋतव्याघ्रं कुम्भकर्णं महाबलम् ॥६-६०-३०॥
translation: The Rakshasas saw Kumbhakarna, destroyer of enemies, the tiger of the southwest, tamer of foes, with his body fully covered with bristling hair, breathing heavily like a serpent with horrible nostrils, turning back with facemouth as vast as underworld all limbs stretched out, emitting smell of fat and blood, arms adorned with gold bracelets, wearing a crown, and sleeping.
word_meanings: ऊर्ध्वरोमाञ्चिततनुम् body covered with bristling hair, पन्नगमिव like a serpent, श्वसन्तम् breathing, न्वििश्श्वसैः hissing heavily, भ्रामयन्तम् turning back, शयानम् sleeping, भीमविदर्शमम् of terrible, नीमनासापुटम् horrible nostrils, पातालविपुलाननम् face as vast as underworld, वयने, न्यस्तसर्वाङ्गम् all limbs stretched out, मेदोरुधिरगन्धिनम् emitting smell of fat and blood, काञ्चनाङ्गदनद्धाङ्गम् arms adorned with gold bracelets, किरीटिनम् wearing a crown, अरिन्दमम् tamer of foes, नैरृतव्याघ्रम् tiger of southwest, अरिमर्धनम् destroyer of enemies, तंकुम्भकर्णम् that Kumbhakarna, ददृशुः saw.

text: ततश्चक्रुर्महात्मानः कुम्भकर्णाग्रतस्तदा । मांसानां मेरुसङ्काशं राशिं परमतर्पणम् ॥६-६०-३१॥
translation: Thereafter the Rakshasas placed a heap of me at the size of Meru Mountain to please him immensely.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, महात्मानः great soul, कुम्भकर्णस्य Kumbhakarna's, अग्रतः before, मांसानाम् meat, मेरुसङ्काशम् of the size of Meru mountain, परमतर्पणम् for pleasing immensely, राशिम् heap, चक्रुः placed.

text: मृगाणां महिषाणां च वराहाणां च सञ्चयान् । चकुर्नैर्ऋतशार्दूला राशिमन्नस्य चाद्भुतम् ॥६-६०-३२॥
translation: The tigers of the south west Rakshasas piled up a mass of marvellous food like the me at of buffaloes, swine, and antelopes.
word_meanings: नैरृतशार्दूलाः tiger of southwest, मृगाणाम् antelopes, महिषाणांच buffaloes also, वराहाणांच swine also, सञ्चयान् in heaps, अन्नस्य food, अद्भुतम् marvellous, राशिंच a mass, चक्रुः placed.

text: ततः शोणितकुम्भांश्च मद्यानि विविधानि च ॥६-६०-३३॥
translation: Then the Rakshasas placed thirty three kinds of meat, pails of blood, and a variety of wines in front of Kumbhakarna.
word_meanings: ततः then, त्रिदशत्रवः thirty three kinds, शोणितकुम्भांश्च pails of blood, विविधानि variety, मद्यानि wines, कुम्भकर्णस्य at Kumbhakarna, पुरस्तात् in front of, चक्रुः placed.

text: पुरस्तात् कुम्भकर्णस्य चकुस्त्रिदशशत्रवः । लिलिपुश्च परार्ध्येन चन्दनेन परन्तपम् ॥६-६०-३४॥
दिव्यैराच्छादयामासुर्माल्यैर्गन्धैः सुगन्धिभिः । धूपं सुगन्धं ससृजुस्तुष्टुवुश्च परन्तपम् ॥६-६०-३५॥
जलदा इव चोन्नेदुर्यातुधानास्ततस्ततः । शङ्खानापूरयामासुः शशाङ्कसदृशप्रभान् । तुमुलं युगपच्चापि विनेदुश्चाप्यमर्षिताः ॥६-६०-३६॥
translation: They blew moon size conches shining brightly. Intolerant Rakshasas raised loud noise simultaneously.
word_meanings: शशाङ्कसदृशप्रभान् like moon and shining brightly, शङ्खान् conchs, आपूरयामासुः blew, अमर्षिताः intolerant, युगपत् simultaneously, तुमुलम् loudly, विनेदुःचापि raised noise.

text: नेदुरास्फोटयामासुश्चिक्षिपुस्ते निशाचराः । कुम्भकर्णविबोधार्थं चक्रुस्ते विपुलं स्वनम् ॥६-६०-३७॥
translation: Those night rangers drawing the limbs of Kumbhakarna pushed his arms, clapping loudly to awaken him making a sound.
word_meanings: तेनिशाचराः those night rangers, नेदुः drawing near, अस्फोटयामासुः pushed the limbs, चिक्षिपुः clapped, कुम्भकर्णविबोधार्थम् to make Kumbhakarna wake up, विपुलम् loud, स्वनम् sound, चक्रुः did.

text: सशङ्खभेरीपणवप्रणादमास्फोटितक्ष्वेलितसिंहनादम् । दिशो द्रवन्तस्त्रिदिवं किरन्तः श्रुत्वा विहङ्गाः सहसा निपेतुः ॥६-६०-३८॥
translation: On hearing the conchs, and of the clapping of arms, and thundering like a lion, the birds playing in the sky got scattered and fell.
word_meanings: विहंगाः birds, सशङ्खभेरीपणवप्रणादम् by the sound of the conchs, आस्फोटितक्षेवळितसिंहनादम् clapping of arms, thundering and lion roar, श्रुत्वा hearing, दिशः direction, द्रवन्तः playing, त्रिदिवम् in the sky, कीरन्तः scattered, सहसा forcibly, निपेतुः fell down.

text: यदा भृशार्तैर्निनदैर्महात्मा न कुम्भकर्णो बुबुधे प्रसुप्तः । ततो मुसुण्ठीर्मुसलानि सर्वे रक्षोगणास्ते जगृहुर्गदाश्च ॥६-६०-३९॥
translation: Kumbhakarna sleeping like that, could not be awakened. Angry Rakshasas roared and hit him with mallets and maces.
word_meanings: प्रसुप्तः sleeping, महात्मा great soul, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, भृशम् angry, तैः they, निनदैः roared, यदा that way, नबुबुधे not awakened, ततः then सर्वे all, रक्षोगणाः Rakshasas, तम् him, मुसुण्ठीः mallets, मुसलानि bars, गदाश्च and maces, जगृहुः hit.

text: तं शैलशृङ्गैर्मुसलैर्गदाभिर्वृक्षैस्तलैर्मुद्गरमुष्टिभिश्च । सुखप्रसुप्तं भुवि कुम्भकर्णं रक्षांस्युदग्राणि तदा निजघ्नुः ॥६-६०-४०॥
translation: Then the excited Rakshasas could not wake up Kumbhakarna happily sleeping on the ground in spite of hitting with rocks and trees and their fists.
word_meanings: तदा then, उदग्राणि exited, रक्षांसि Rakshasas, भुवि on the ground, सुखप्रसुप्तम् happily sleeping, तंकुम्भकर्णम् that Kumbhakarna, शैलशृङ्गैः with rocks and trees, मुसलैः bars, गदाभिः maces, मुद्गरमुष्टिभिःच with fists, निजघ्नुः not got up.

text: तस्य निःश्वासवातेन कुम्भकर्णस्य रक्षसः । राक्षसा बलवन्तो ऽपि स्थातुं नाशक्नुवन् पुरः ॥६-६०-४१॥
translation: Unable to bear the force of the breathing out of Kumbhakarna, the Rakshasas could not stand.
word_meanings: रक्षसः Rakshasa, तस्यकुम्भकर्णस्य that Kumbhakarna's, निःश्वासवातेन by the breathing out, बलवन्तःअपि with such force, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, पुरः earlier, स्दातुम् to stand, नशक्नुवन् not possible.

text: ततः परिहिता गाढं राक्षसा भीमविक्रमाः ॥६-६०-४२॥
translation: The Rakshasas of terrible valour resorted to abandoned drums and tom toms that way and pails of clay.
word_meanings: ततः that, भीमविक्रमः of terrible valour, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, गाढम् resorted to, परिहिताः abandoned, मृदङ्गपणवान् drums and tom toms, भेरीः drums, तथा that way, शङ्खकुम्भगणान् pails of clay.

text: मृदङ्गपणवान् भेरीः शङ्खकुम्भगणांस्तदा । दशराक्षससाहस्रा युगपत् पर्यवादयन् ॥६-६०-४३॥
नीलाञ्जनचयाकारास्ते तु तं प्रत्यबोधयन् । अभिघ्नन्तो नदन्तश्च नैव संविविदे तु सः ॥६-६०-४४॥
translation: Ten thousand Rakshasas surrounded him all at once like a mass of antimony striking him and even made a loud noise. But he never responded.
word_meanings: दशराक्षससाहस्रम् ten thousand Rakshasas, युगपत् all together simultaneously, पर्यवारयन् surrounded, तेतु but he, नीलाञ्जनचयाकारम् like a mass of antimony, तम् him, अभिघ्नन्तः striking, नदन्तःनैव even made loud noise, तम् him, प्रत्यबोधयन् tried to wake, बोधयन् shouted, सः he, संविविदे not responded.

text: यदा चैनं न शेकुस्ते प्रतिबोधयितुं तदा । ततो गुरुतरं यत्नं दारुणं समुपाक्रमन् ॥६-६०-४५॥
translation: They called him again and again, but he never got up. Then they made a difficult and dreadful effort approaching him.
word_meanings: ते they, यदा that way, एनम् in that way, प्रतिबोधयितुम् called him again and again, नशेकुः not got up, तदा then, ततः thereafter, गुरुतरम् difficult, दारुणम् dreadful, यत्नम् effort, समुपाक्रमन् approaching.

text: अश्वानुष्ट्रान् खरान्नागान् जघ्नुर्दण्डकशाङ्कुशैः । भेरीशङ्खमृदङ्गांश्च सर्वप्राणैरवादयन् ॥६-६०-४६॥
translation: They urged horses, elephants, camels, and donkeys to pounce on him, whipping with staff, whips, and goads.
word_meanings: आश्वान् horses, उष्ट्रान् camels, खरान् donkeys, नागान् elephants, दण्डकशाङ्कुशैः with staffs whips and goads, आजघ्नुः urged, भेरीशङ्खमृदङ्गान् च kettle drums, conchs, clay tom toms, सर्वप्राणैः with all their might, अवादयन् pounded on him.

text: निजघ्नुश्चास्य गात्राणि महाकाष्ठकटङ्करैः । मुद्गरैर्मुसलैश्चैव सर्वप्राणसमुद्यतैः ॥६-६०-४७॥
translation: The city of Lanka including the woods was filled with that noise. They pushed him with mallets with all their strength, but he did not wake up.
word_meanings: अस्य his, गात्राणि voice, माहाकाष्ठकङ्करैः with heavy logs of wood, सर्वप्राणसमुद्यतैः with all their strength, मुसलैश्चापि with mallets, निजघ्नुः not wake up.

text: तेन शब्देन महता लङ्का समभिपूरिता । सपर्वतवना सर्वा सो ऽपि नैव प्रबुध्यते ॥६-६०-४८॥
translation: All Lanka and mountains were filled by the great noise made by the Rakshasas. Even then Kumbhakarna did not wake up.
word_meanings: महता great, तेननादेन by that noise, सपर्वतवना all mountains, सर्वा all, लङ्का Lanka, समभिपूरिता filled with, सःअपि even then, नैवप्रबुध्यते did not wake up.

text: ततः सहस्रं भेरीणां युगपत् समहन्यत । मृष्टकाञ्चनकोणानामासक्तानां समन्ततः ॥६-६०-४९॥
translation: Then was collected a thousand drums and beaten with polished gold sticks on all sides continuously.
word_meanings: ततः then, मृष्टकाञ्चनकोणानाम् polished gold sticks, समन्ततः everywhere,आसक्तानाम् continuously, भेरीणाम् drums, सहस्रम् thousand, समहन्यत collected.

text: एवमप्यतिनिद्रस्तु यदा नैव प्रबुध्यते । शापस्य वशमापन्नस्ततः क्रुद्धा निशाचराः । महाक्रोधसमाविष्टाः सर्वे भीमपराक्रमाः ॥६-६०-५०॥
translation: Wrapped in sleep like that because of the spell of the curse, he had not wakened. The Rakshasas got enraged.
word_meanings: एवमपि like that, शासस्य because of curse, वशम् under the spell of, आपन्नः wrap, अन्तिद्रिः, यदा like that, नैवप्रबुध्यते not wakened, ततः then, निशाचराः Rakshasas, क्रुद्धाः enraged.

text: तद्रक्षो बोधयिष्यन्तश्चक्रुरन्ये पराक्रमम् ॥६-६०-५१॥
translation: All the Rakshasas endowed with mighty prowess became enraged and others started to arouse with all their strength.
word_meanings: भीमपराक्रमाः endowed with mighty valour, सर्वे all, महाक्रोधसमाविष्टाः, अन्ये others, तत् that, रक्षः guards, बोधयिष्यन्तः rousing, पराक्रमम् prowess, चक्रुः started.

text: स्ततः क्रुद्धा निशाचराः । अन्ये भेरीः समाजघ्नुरन्ये चक्रुर्महास्वनम् । केशानन्ये प्रलुलुपुः कर्णावन्ये दशन्ति च ॥६-६०-५२॥
translation: While some were beating the drums, some shouted at the pitch of their voice, some started pulling his hair and some bit his ears.
word_meanings: अन्ये others, भेरीः drums, समाजघ्नुः beat, अन्ये some others, महास्वनम् shouted at the pitch of their voice, चक्रुः started, अन्ये some others, केशान् hair, प्रलुलुपुः pulled, अन्ये some, कर्णौ ears, दशन्तिच bit.

text: उदकुम्भशतान्यन्ये समसिञ्चन्त कर्णयोः । न कुम्भकर्णः पस्पन्दे महानिद्रावशं गतः ॥६-६०-५३॥
translation: Some poured hundreds of pails of water into ears, distressed that he did not wake up under the spell of deep sleep.
word_meanings: अन्ये others, उदकुम्भशतानि hundreds of pails of water, कर्णयोः in the ears, समसिञ्चन्त distressed, महानिद्रावशंगतः under the spell of deep sleep, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, नपस्पन्दे not wake up.

text: अन्ये च बलिनस्तस्य कूटमुद्गरपाणयः । मूर्ध्नि वक्षसि गात्रेषु पातयन् कूटमुद्गरान् ॥६-६०-५४॥
translation: Some had their nails fixed with mallets, letting their mallets fall on the forehead, on the chest and throw at of Kumbhakarna.
word_meanings: कूटमुद्गरपाणयः mallet fixed in the nails, अन्ये others, बलिनः strong, तस्य his, मूर्ध्नि forehead, वक्षसि on chest, गात्रेषु on throat, कूटमुद्गरान् mallets, पातयन् let fall.

text: रज्जुबन्धनबद्धाभिः शतघ्नीभिश्च सर्वतः । वध्यमानो महाकायो न प्राबुध्यत राक्षसः ॥६-६०-५५॥
translation: Some struck with sataghni (mace) all over his huge body fastened with cords.
word_meanings: रज्जुबन्धनबद्धाभिः fastened with cords, शतघ्नीभिः Satagnhi, सर्वशः all over, वध्यमानः fastened with, महाकायः the huge body, राक्षसः Rakshasa, नप्राबुध्यत not awakened.

text: वारणानां सहस्रं तु शरीरे ऽस्य प्रधावितम् । कुम्भकर्णस्ततो बुद्धः स्पर्शं परमबुध्यत ॥६-६०-५६॥
translation: A thousand elephants were made to walk over his body. Then Kumbhakarna felt the touch but did not understand.
word_meanings: वारणानाम् elephants, सहस्रम् a thousand, अस्य his, शरीरे body, प्रधावितम् walk over, तदा then, कुम्बकर्णः Kumbhakarna, बुद् ध्वा felt, स्पर्शंपरम् felt the touch, अबुध्यत not understand.

text: स पात्यमानैर्गिरिशृङ्गवृक्षैरचिन्तयंस्तान् विपुलान् प्रहारान् । निद्राक्षयात् क्षुद्भयपीडितश्च विजृम्भमाणः सहसोत्पपात ॥६-६०-५७॥
translation: Tormented by hunger and hit by mountain peaks and huge trees he sprang up suddenly descended and awakened.
word_meanings: सः he, पात्यमानैः descending, गिरिशृङ्गवृक्षैः mountain peaks, trees, तान् sensation, विपुलान् huge, प्रहारान् hitting, अचिन्तयन् not knowing, निद्राक्ष्यात् getting out of sleep, क्षुद्भयपीडितश्च tormented by hunger, विजृम्भमाणः sprang up, सहसा suddenly, उत्पपात awakened.

text: स नागभोगाचलशृङ्गकल्पौ विक्षिप्य बाहू गिरिशृङ्गसारौ । विवृत्य वक्त्रं वडवामुखाभं निशाचरो ऽसौ विकृतं जजृम्भे ॥६-६०-५८॥
translation: Kumbhakarna, devoid of any beauty threw out his limbs which were like the coils of cobra and as hard as mountain tops, his mouth was unnatural like a submarine fire as he yawned.
word_meanings: सः he, असौ devoid of beauty, निशाचरः Rakshasas, नागभोगाचलशृङ्गकृतौ like the coils of cobra, गिरिशृङ्गसारौ hard as mountain tops, बाहू limbs, विक्षिप्य thrown about, वडवामुखाभम् like submarine fire, वक्त्रम् mouth, विकृतम् unnatural, जजृम्भे yawned.

text: तस्य जाजृम्भमाणस्य वक्त्रं पातालसन्निभम् । ददृशे मेरुशृङ्गाग्रे दिवाकर इवोदितः ॥६-६०-५९॥
translation: As he yawned his mouth resembling the underworld, it was like the Sun rose over the top of Mount Meru.
word_meanings: जाजृम्भमाणस्य as he yawned, तस्य his, पातालसन्निभम् resembling the underworld, वक्त्रम् mouth, मेरुशृङ्गाग्रे top of the Meru mountain, उदितः risen over, दिवाकरःइव like the sun, ददृशे appeared.

text: स जृम्भमाणो ऽतिबलः प्रतिबुद्धो निशाचरः । निःश्वासश्चास्य सञ्जज्ञे पर्वतादिव मारुतः ॥६-६०-६०॥
translation: As the mighty night ranger awakened and yawned continuously his breath was like wind blowing from the mountain.
word_meanings: अतिबलः very strong, सःनिशाचरः that night ranger, जृम्भमाणः as he yawned continuously, प्रबुद्धः awakened, पर्वतात् from the mountain, मारुतः wind इव like, अस्य his, निःश्वासः breath सञ्जज्ञे blowing.

text: रूपमुत्तिष्ठतस्तस्य कुम्भकर्णस्य तद्बभौ । तपान्ते सबलाकस्य मेघस्येव विवर्षतः ॥६-६०-६१॥
translation: As Kumbhakarna woke up he appeared like the time spirit at the time of dissolution of the universe like a rainy cloud at twilight as if seeking to consume all beings.
word_meanings: उत्तिष्ठतः as he woke up, कुम्भकर्णस्य Kumbhakarna's, तत् रूपम् form, युगान्ते universal dissolution, सबलाकस्य twilight, सर्वभूतानि all beings, मेघस्येव like cloud, विवर्षितः about to rain, बभौ appeared.

text: तस्य दीप्ताग्निसदृशे विद्युत्सदृशवर्चसी । ददृशाते महानेत्रे दीप्ताविव महाग्रहौ ॥६-६०-६२॥
translation: His huge eyes were like blazing fire dazzling like lightning glowing like two huge planets.
word_meanings: तस्यदीप्ताग्निसदृशे like blazing fire, विद्युत्सदृशवर्चसी dazzling like lightning, तस्यमहानेत्रे his huge eyes, दीप्तौ glowing, महाग्रहौइव like huge planets, ददृशाते looked.

text: ततस्त्वदर्शयन् सर्वान् भक्ष्यांश्च विविधान् बहून् । वराहान् महिषांश्चैव स बभक्ष महाबलः ॥६-६०-६३॥
translation: Thereafter having seen several kinds of food items of hogs, buffaloes he ate them.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, विविधान् several, बहून् many, सर्वान् all kinds, भक्ष्यान् च food items, वराहान् hogs, महिषांश्चैव buffaloes also, अदर्शयन् having seen, सः he, बभक्ष ate.

text: अदन् बुभुक्षितो मांसं शोणितं तृषितः पिबन् । मेदःकुम्भांश्च मद्यं च पपौ शक्ररिपुस्तदा ॥६-६०-६४॥
translation: After eating the meat and feeling thirsty, the enemy of Indra drank blood, pails of fat and wine.
word_meanings: तदा then, बुभुक्षितः after eating, शक्ररिपुः enemy of Indra, मांसम् meat, आददुन् thirsty, तृषितः being thirsty, शोणितम् blood, पिबन् drank, मेदःकुम्भाश्च pails of fat, मद्यांश्च wine, पपौ drank.

text: ततस्तृप्त इति ज्ञात्वा समुत्पेतुर्निशाचराः । शिरोभिश्च प्रणम्यैनं सर्वतः पर्यवारयन् ॥६-६०-६५॥
translation: There upon the night rangers realizing that he got up, came before him, and greeted him with heads bent down.
word_meanings: ततः there upon, निशाचराः night ranger, तृप्तःइति satisfied in that way, ज्ञात्वा realizing, समुत्पेतुः got up, एनम् all of them, शिरोभिः heads bent down, प्रणम्य greeting, सर्वतः all, पर्यवारयन् surrounded.

text: निद्राविश ऽदनेत्रस्तु कलुषीकृतलोचनः । चारयन् सर्वतो दृष्टिं तान् ददर्श निशाचरान् ॥६-६०-६६॥
translation: With sleepy eyes casting his glance at the night rangers looked at all of them.
word_meanings: निद्राविशदनेत्रस्तु, with sleepy eyes, कलुषीकृतलोचनः casting his glance, सर्वतः all over, दृष्टिम् gaze, चारयन् rangers, तान् extended, निशाचरान् night rangers, ददर्श looked at.

text: स सर्वान् सान्त्वयामास नैर्ऋतान्नैर्ऋतर्षभः । बोधनाद् विस्मितश्चापि राक्षसानिदमब्रवीत् ॥६-६०-६७॥
translation: He, the bull among the south west region, astonished at his awakening, soothed, and spoke to all the Rakshasas in this way.
word_meanings: सः he, नैरृतर्षभः bull of the south west, सर्वान् all, नैरृतान् south west, सान्त्वयामास soothed, बोधनात् awakened, विस्मितश्चापि astonished of his waking up, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: किमर्थमहमादृत्य भवद्भिः प्रतिबोधितः । कच्चित् सुकुशलं राज्ञो भयवानेष वा न किम् ॥६-६०-६८॥
translation: "What have you done to wake me Hope King is fine and has no fear of danger"
word_meanings: अहम् I am, भवद्भिः by you, आदृत्य taken effort, किमर्थम् What for, प्रतिबोधितः made known, राज्ञः king, सुकुशलंकच्छित् hope he is fine, एष any, किम् why, भयम् fear of danger, न not.

text: अथवा ध्रुवमन्येभ्यो भयं परमुपस्थितम् । यदर्थमेवं त्वरितैर्भवद्भिः प्रतिबोधितः ॥६-६०-६९॥
translation: "Is there any fear of some enemies Is it because of that you have woken me up Let me know."
word_meanings: अथवा or else, अन्येभ्यः by any one, परम् great, भयम् fear, उपस्थितम् has come, ध्रुवम् from enemies, यदर्थमेव for that cause, त्वरितैः hastily, भवद्भिः by you, प्रतिबोधितः you may let me know.

text: अद्य राक्षसराजस्य भयमुत्पाटयाम्यहम् । पातयिष्ये महेन्द्रं वा शातयिष्ये तथा ऽनलम् ॥६-६०-७०॥
translation: "I will devour Rakshasa king's fear. I will eradicate even Mahendra (mountain) or alleviate fire."
word_meanings: अद्य devour, अहम् I will, राक्षसराजस्य Rakshasa king's, भयम् fear, उत्पाटयामि eradicate, महेन्द्रम् Mahendra, दारयिष्ये destroy, तथा like that, अनलम् fire, शातयिष्ये alleviate

text: न ह्यल्पकारणे सुप्तं बोधयिष्यति मां गुरुः । तदाख्यातार्थतत्त्वेन मत्प्रबोधनकारणम् ॥६-६०-७१॥
translation: "For a small reason he will not awaken me. Tell me the reason truly for waking me."
word_meanings: सुप्तम् sleeping, माम् me, अल्पकारणे for small reason, नबोधयिष्यतिहि awaken, तत् that, मत्प्रबोधनकारणम् the reason for waking me, अर्थतत्त्वेन truly, गुरुः guru, अख्यात tell me.

text: एवं ब्रुवाणं संरब्धं कुम्भकर्णं महाबलम् । यूपाक्षः सचिवो राज्ञः कृताञ्जलिरुवाच ह ॥६-६०-७२॥
translation: Kumbhakarna, tamer of enemies having spoken in that way in anger, Yupaksha, a minister joined palms and replied to him.
word_meanings: एवम् in that manner, ब्रुवाणम् spoken, सम्रब्दम् full of anger, अरिन्दमम् tamer of enemies, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, राज्ञः king, सचिवः minister, यूपाक्षः Yupaksha, कृताञ्जलिः joined palms, अभाषत replied.

text: न नो दैवकृतं किञ्चिद्भयमस्ति कदाचन । मानुषान्नो भयं राजंस्तुमुलं सम्प्रबाधते ॥६-६०-७३॥
translation: "O King! there is no danger from Devas. Only a small destruction done by a human is pressing and causing pain."
word_meanings: राजन् king, नः no, कदाचन danger, देवकृतम् Devas did, भयम् fear, किंचित् a small, नास्ति destruction, मानुषात् by human, तुमुलम् is pressing, भयम् danger, सम्प्रबाधते causing pain.

text: न दैत्यदानवेभ्यो वा भयमस्ति हि तादृशम् । यादृशं मानुषं राजन् भयमस्मानुपस्थितम् ॥६-६०-७४॥
translation: "O King! This kind of fear from humans has not arisen for us either from Daityas or Danavas."
word_meanings: राजन् king, मानुषम् human, यादृशम् this kind, भयम् danger, अस्मान् for us, उपस्थितम् has arisen, तादृशम् the kind of, भयम् fear, दैत्यदानवेभ्योवा either from Daityas or Danavas, नास्तिहि not there.

text: वानरैः पर्वताकारैर्लङ्केयं परिवारिता । सीताहरणसन्तप्ताद्रामान्नस्तुमुलं भयम् ॥६-६०-७५॥
translation: This Lanka is seized by a mountain like army of Vanaras. By the abduction of Sita, there is little fear from Rama.
word_meanings: इयंलङ्का this Lanka, पर्वताकारैः mountain like form, वानरैः Vanaras, परिवारिता accompanied by, सीताहरणसन्तप्तात् by abduction of Sita, रामात् from Rama, नः not, तुमुलम् little, भयम् fear.

text: एकेन वानरेणेयं पूर्वं दग्धा महापुरी । कुमारो निहतश्चाक्षः सानुयात्रः सकुञ्जरः ॥६-६०-७६॥
translation: "Earlier this great city was burnt by a single Vanara who killed Prince Aksha, and his elephants and followers."
word_meanings: एकेन alone, वानरेण by Vanara, पूर्वम् earlier, इयम् this, महापुरी great city, दग्धा burnt, सानुयात्रः followers, सकुञ्जरः his elephants, कुमारः son अक्षःच Aksha, निहतः killed.

text: स्वयं रक्षोधिपश्चापि पौलस्त्यो देवकण्टकः । मृतेति संयुगे मुक्तो रामेणादित्यतेजसा ॥६-६०-७७॥
translation: "Rakshasa king, scion of sage Paulastya, an enemy of Devatas, was let off from death by Rama who has the splendour of Sun."
word_meanings: रक्षोधिपः Lord of Rakshasas, देवकण्टकः enemy of Devatas, स्वयम् himself, पौलस्त्यः Paulastya, अपि and, संयुगे in encounter, आदित्यतेजसा having the splendour of sun, रामेण to Rama, मृतिइति subjected to death, मुक्तः let go.

text: यन्न दैवैः कृतो राजा नापि दैत्यैर्न दानवैः । कृतः स इह रामेण विमुक्तः प्राणसंशयात् ॥६-६०-७८॥
translation: "The king could escape from the verge of death and such an act was never done by Daityas or Danavas earlier in the encounter."
word_meanings: सःराजा that king, देवैः Devas, यत् such, नकृतः not done, दैत्यैः Daityas, न not, दानवैः Danavas, न not, इह here, रामेण by Rama, कृतः done, प्राणसंशयात् from the verge of death, विमुक्तः escaped.

text: स यूपाक्षवचः श्रुत्वा भ्रातुर्युधि पराजयम् । कुम्भकर्णो विवृत्ताक्षो यूपाक्षमिदमब्रवीत् ॥६-६०-७९॥
translation: On hearing the words of Yupaksha, regarding the insult of his brother Kumbhakarna said this rolling his eyes.
word_meanings: सःकुम्भकर्णः that Kumbhakarna, यूपाक्ष्वचः Yupaksha's words, युधि in encounter, भ्रातुः brother, पराभवम् insult, श्रुत्वा hearing, विवृत्ताक्षः rolling his eyes, यूपाक्षम् to Yupaksha, इदम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: सर्वमद्यैव यूपाक्ष हरिसैन्यं सलक्ष्मणम् । राघवं च रणे हत्वा पश्चाद्द्रक्ष्यामि रावणम् ॥६-६०-८०॥
translation: "I will conquer now the Vanara army along with Lakshmana and Raghava in war and see Ravana."
word_meanings: यूपाक्ष Yupaksha, अद्यैव now itself, सर्वम् all, हरिसैन्यम् Vanara army, सलक्ष्मणम् along with Lakshmana, राघवंच and Raghava, रणे in war, जित्वा conquering, ततः then, रावणम् Ravana, द्रक्ष्यामि will see.

text: राक्षसांस्तर्पयिष्यामि हरीणां मांसशोणितैः । रामलक्ष्मणयोश्चापि स्वयं पास्यामि शोणितम् ॥६-६०-८१॥
translation: "I will satisfy the Rakshasas with the flesh and blood of Rama and Lakshmana. You will see."
word_meanings: हरीणाम् Vanaras, मांसशोणितैः by flesh and blood, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, तर्पयिष्यामि make them contended, रामलक्ष्मणयोः Rama and Lakshmana, शोणितम् blood, स्वयम् I will, पास्यामि you may see.

text: तत्तस्य वाक्यं ब्रुवतो निशम्य सगर्वितं रोषविवृद्धदोषम् । महोदरो नैर्ऋतयोधमुख्यः कृताञ्जलिर्वाक्यमिदं बभाषे ॥६-६०-८२॥
translation: Hearing the words of the reply of Kumbhakarna, filled with arrogance and pride, Mahodara, chief of the army, submitted with folded hands and said.
word_meanings: ब्रुवतः replied, तस्य his, गर्वितम् proudly, रोषविवृद्धदोषम् words full of arrogance, तत् वाक्यम् his words, निशम्य submitted, नैरृतयोधमुख्यः chief of army of Rakshasas, सः he, महोदरः Mahodara, कृताञ्जलिः offering salutations, इदंवाक्यम् these words, बभाषे spoke.

text: रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा गुणदोषौ विमृश्य च । पश्चादपि महाबाहो शत्रून् युधि विजेष्यसि ॥६-६०-८३॥
translation: "O Mighty Armed One! You hear from Ravana the advantages and disadvantages and thereafter assess the enemy to conquer."
word_meanings: महाबाहो mighty armed, रावणस्य Ravana's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, गुणदोषौ advantages and disadvantages, विमृश्यच assessing, पश्चात् अपि after that, युधि in war, शत्रून् enemy, विजेष्यसि conquer.

text: महोदरवचः श्रुत्वा राक्षसैः परिवारितः । कुम्भकर्णो महातेजाः सम्प्रतस्थे महाबलः ॥६-६०-८४॥
translation: Kumbhakarna of extraordinary energy, mighty strong, on hearing Mahodara went in surrounded by Rakshasas.
word_meanings: महातेजाः extraordinarily energetic, महाबलः mighty strong, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, महोदरवचः to Mahodara, श्रुत्वा hearing, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, परिवारितः surrounded, सम्प्रतस्थे went in.

text: तं समुत्थाप्य भीमाक्षं भीमरूपपराक्रमम् । राक्षसास्त्वरिता जग्मुर्दशग्रीवनिवेशनम् ॥६-६०-८५॥
translation: After rousing up Kumbhakarna of frightful eyes and fierce strength from sleep the Rakshasas quickly went to the abode of the ten headed king.
word_meanings: राक्षसाः Rakshasas, भीमाक्षम् frightful eyes, भीमरूपपराक्रमम् of fierce strength, सुप्तम् sleeping, उत्थाप्य arousing, त्वरिताः quickly, दशग्रीन्विवेशनम् abode of ten headed king, जग्मुः went.

text: ततो गत्वा दशग्रीवमासीनं परमासने । ऊचुर्बद्धाञ्जलिपुटाः सर्वे एव निशाचराः ॥६-६०-८६॥
translation: All those night rangers, approaching the tenheaded king seated on an excellent se at greeted with folded hands and said.
word_meanings: सर्वे all, तेनिशाचराः those night rangers, परमासने excellent seat, आसीनम् seated, दशग्रीवम् tenheaded king, अनिगम्य reaching, बद्धाञ्जलिपुटाः greeting with folded hands, ऊचुः spoke.

text: प्रबुद्धः कुम्भकर्णो ऽयं भ्राता ते राक्षसर्षभ । कथं तत्रैव निर्यातु द्रक्ष्यस्येनमिहागतम् ॥६-६०-८७॥
translation: "O Rakshasa Lord! Your brother Kumbhakarna has come here. Greetings to you. Tell us what to do."
word_meanings: राक्षसेश्वर Rakshasa Lord, तेभ्राता your brother, अयंकुम्भकर्णः this Kumbhakarna, प्रबुद्धः greetings, तत्रैव to you, निर्यातुकथम् tell me what to do, इह now, आगतम् have come, तम् to you, द्रक्ष्यसे What order.

text: रावणस्त्वब्रवीद्धृष्टो राक्षसांस्तानुपस्थितान् । द्रष्टुमेनमिहेच्छामि यथान्यायं च पूज्यताम् ॥६-६०-८८॥
translation: Ravana on his part said this to the Rakshasas feeling cheerful. "Honour him as propriety demands. I wish to see him."
word_meanings: रावणस्तु Ravana on his part, हृष्टः cheerful, उपस्थितान् seated, तान् him, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, अब्रवीत् said, एवम् in that way, इह now, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छामि desire, यथान्यायम् as propriety demands, पूज्यताम् to honour.

text: तथेत्युक्त्वा तु ते सर्वे पुनरागम्य राक्षसाः । कुम्भकर्णमिदं वाक्यमूचू रावणचोदिताः ॥६-६०-८९॥
translation: All the Rakshasas taking leave from Ravana said this again approaching Kumbhakarna.
word_meanings: रावणचोदिताः taking leave from Ravana, ते they, सर्वे all, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, तथेति returning back, उक्त्वा said, पुनः again, आगम्य approaching, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, इदम् these, वाक्यम् words, ऊचुः said.

text: द्रष्टुं त्वां काङ्क्षते राजा सर्वराक्षसपुङ्गवः । गमने क्रियतां बुद्धिर्भ्रातरं सम्प्रहर्षय ॥६-६०-९०॥
translation: All the Rakshasa leaders said to Kumbhakarna," the king desires to see you. Start. Make up your mind. Be pleased to depart to your brother."
word_meanings: सर्वराक्षसपुङ्गवः all Rakshasa leaders, राजा king, त्वाम् you, द्रष्टुम् to see, कांक्षते desiring, गमने to start, बुद्धिः make up your mind, क्रियताम् to depart, भ्रातरम् brother, सम्प्रहर्षय be pleased.

text: कुम्भकर्णस्तु दुर्धर्षो भ्रातुराज्ञाय शासनम् । तथेत्युक्त्वा महाबाहुः शयनादुत्पपात ह ॥६-६०-९१॥
translation: Formidable and courageous Kumbhakarna also got up from sleep saying 'yes' and rose up.
word_meanings: दुर्धर्षः formidable, महावीर्यः courageous, कुम्भकर्णस्तु Kumbhakarna also, भ्रातुः brother, शासनम् order, आज्ञाय instruction, तथाइति saying yes, उक्त्वा said, शयनात् from the bed, उत्पपातह rose up.

text: प्रक्षाल्य वदनं हृष्टः स्नातः परमभूषितः । पिपासुस्त्वरयामास पानं बलसमीरणम् ॥६-६०-९२॥
translation: Joyful Kumbhakarna, washed his face, had a bath and being thirsty ordered a drink that can increase his strength.
word_meanings: हृष्टः joyful, वदनम् face, प्रक्षाल्य washing, स्नातः bath, परमभूषितः decked with best of ornaments, पिपासुः thirsty, बलसमीरणम् that which increases strength, पानम् drink, त्वरयामास ordered to get soon.

text: ततस्ते त्वरितास्तस्य राक्षसा रावणाज्ञया । मद्यकुम्भांश्च विविधान् क्षिप्रमेवोपहारयन् ॥६-६०-९३॥
translation: By the order of Ravana hurriedly they got several kinds of wine in pots.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, रावणाज्ञयाः by the order of Ravana, त्वरिताः quickly, ते they, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, तत्र then, विविधान् several, मद्यकुम्भांश्च pots of wine, क्षिप्रमेव immediately, उपहारयन् presented.

text: पीत्वा घटसहस्रे द्वे गमनायोपचक्रमे । ईषत्समुत्कटो मत्तस्तेजोबलसमन्वितः । कुम्भकर्णो बभौ हृष्टः कालान्तकयमोपमः ॥६-६०-९४॥
translation: (Kumbhakarna) Having drunk two thousand pots of wine, slightly excited and inebriated and replenished with strength and energy was ready to depart.
word_meanings: द्वे two, घटसहस्रे thousand pots, पीत्वा drinking, ईषत् slightly, समुत्कटः excited, मत्तः inebriated, तेजोबलसमन्वितः replenished with strength and energy, गमनाय started, उपचक्रमे readied to depart.

text: भ्रातुः स भवनं गच्छन् रक्षोगणसमन्वितः । कुम्भकर्णः पदन्यासैरकम्पयत मेदिनीम् ॥६-६०-९५॥
translation: Kumbhakarna surrounded by Rakshasas going to his brother's abode happily looked like the Lord of death bent on destroying the creation. He took strides which shook the earth.
word_meanings: रक्षोबलसमन्वितः surrounded by Rakshasa army, भ्रातुः brother, भवनम् residence, गच्छन् going, हृष्टः happily, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, कालान्तकयमोपमः like the Lord of death, बभौ looked, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, न्यासैः strides, मेन्दिीम् earth, अकम्पयत shook.

text: स राजमार्गं वपुषा प्रकाशयन् सहस्ररश्मिर्धरणीमिवांशुभिः । जगाम तत्राञ्जलिमालया वृतः शतक्रतुर्गेहमिव स्वयम्भुवः ॥६-६०-९६॥
translation: Kumbhakarna went like the thousand rayed Sun illuminating the earth by his splendour brightening the royal path, greeted by a circle of Rakshasas joining palms like Indra who has done a hundred sacrifices went to the abode of selfborn Brahma.
word_meanings: सहस्ररश्मिः thousand rayed luminary, धरणीमिव like the earth, सः he, राजमार्गम् royal path, वपुषा deity, प्रकाशयन् brightened, तत्र there, अञ्जलिमालया garland of joined palms, वृतः circle, गेहम् home, शतक्रतुः performed a hundred horse sacrifices, स्वयम्भुव: like the Brahma, जगाम went.

text: तं राजमार्गस्थममित्रघातिनं वनौकसस्ते सहसा बहिः स्थिताः । दृष्ट्वा ऽप्रमेयं गिरिशृङ्गकल्पं वितत्रसुस्ते हरियूथपालाः ॥६-६०-९७॥
translation: And then the Vanaras and the leaders of the Vanara army who were present looked at the immeasurably tall form of Kumbhakarna walking through the royal path and got alarmed.
word_meanings: अमित्रघातिनम् destroyer of enemies, अप्रमेयम् immeasurably tall, गिरिशृङ्गकल्पम् looked like the mountain peak, राजमार्गस्थम् through the royal path, तम् him, बहिःस्थिताः those who were there, तेवनौकसः those Vanaras, दृष्टवा seeing, हरियूथपालाःसह including the Vanara leaders, वितत्रसुः got alarmed.

text: केचिच्छरण्यं शरणं स्म रामं व्रजन्ति केचिद्व्यथिताः पतन्ति । केचिद्दिशः स्म व्यथिताः प्रयान्ति केचिद्भयार्ता भुवि शेरते स्म ॥६-६०-९८॥
translation: Indeed, some took refuge from Rama who could give shelter, some fell down in panic, some went in all directions in panic, and some out of fear lay down on the ground.
word_meanings: केचित् indeed, शरण्यम् refuge, रामम् Rama, शरणंव्रजन्तिस्म who was capable of giving shelter, केचित् some, व्यथिताः became panicked, पतन्तिस्म fell down, केचित् some, व्यथिताः panic, दिशः directions, पतन्तिस्म ran, केचित् भयार्ताः some out of fear, भुवि ground, शेरतेस्म lay down.

text: तमद्रिशृङ्गप्रतिमं किरीटिनं स्पृशन्तमादित्यमिवात्मतेजसा । वनौकसः प्रेक्ष्य विवृद्धमद्भुतं भयार्दिता दुद्रुविरे ततस्ततः ॥६-६०-९९॥
translation: Oppressed with fear the Vanaras ran here and there seeing the form of Kumbhakarna that was like the peak of a mountain as if touching the selfluminous Sun, crowned and wonderful, grown in size. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेषष्टितमस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the sixtieth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
