word_meanings: अद्रिशृङ्गप्रतिमम् like the peak of a mountain, किरीटिनम् crowned, आत्मतेजसा selfluminous, आदित्यम् like the Sun, स्पृशन्तमिव as if touching, अद्भुतम् wonderful, विवृद्धम् grown in size, तम् him, वनौकसः Vanaras, प्रेक्ष्य seeing, भयार्दिताः oppressed with fear, ततस्ततः here and there, दुद्रुविरे ran.

text: ततो रामो भहातेजा धनुरादाय वीर्यवान् । किरीटिनं महाकायं कुम्भकर्णं ददर्श ह ॥६-६१-१॥
translation: On taking up a bow Rama saw Kumbhakarna of extraordinary energy, prodigious, and of large body, adorned with a crown.
word_meanings: ततः then, महातेजाः of extraordinary energy, वीर्यवान् prodigious, रामः Rama, धनुः bow, आदाय taking, किरीटिनम् adorned with crown, महाकायम् of large size, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, ददर्श saw.

text: तं दृष्ट्वा राक्षसश्रेष्ठं पर्वताकारदर्शनम् । क्रममाणमिवाकाशं पुरा नारायणं प्रभुम् । सतोयाम्बुदसङ्काशं काञ्चनाङ्गदभूषणम् ॥६-६१-२॥
translation: That foremost of Rakshasas was like a mountain in appearance, it was like Lord Narayana taking steps to the sky earlier.
word_meanings: पर्वताकारदर्शनम् like a mountain in appearance, पुरा earlier, आकाशम् sky, क्रममाणम् taking steps, प्रभुम् Lord, नारायणं Narayana, यथा so also, तंराक्षसश्रेष्ठम् that foremost of Rakshasas, दृष्टव I witnessed.

text: दृष्ट्वा पुनः प्रदुद्राव वानराणां महाचमूः ॥६-६१-३॥
translation: Seeing the Rakshasa who was like a rainy cloud with water, decked with gold ornaments, the commander in chief of Vanaras ran.
word_meanings: सतोयाम्बुदसङ्काशम् like rainy cloud with water, काञ्चनाङ्गदभूषणम् decked with gold ornaments, दृष्टवा seeing, वानराणाम् Vanaras, महाचमूः commander in chief, पुनः again, प्रदुद्राव ran.

text: विद्रुतां वाहिनीं दृष्ट्वा वर्धमानं च राक्षसम् । सविस्मयमिदं रामो विभीषणमुवाच ह ॥६-६१-४॥
translation: Seeing the army scared away and the army of Rakshasas growing in size, Rama was astonished and thus spoke to Vibheeshana.
word_meanings: रामः Rama, विद्रुताम् scared, वाहिनीम् army, वर्धमानम् growing big, राक्षसं च and Rakshasas, दृष्टवा seeing, सविस्मय astonished, विभीषणम् Vibheeshana, इदम् thus, उवाच ह spoke.

text: को ऽसौ पर्वतसङ्काशः किरीटी हरिलोचनः । लङ्कायां दृश्यते वीर सविद्युदिव तोयदः ॥६-६१-५॥
translation: "Who is that hero resembling a mountain, a crowned one with tawny eyes, looking like a rainy cloud driven by lightning? He is seen in Lanka."
word_meanings: पर्वतसङ्काशः resembling mountain, किरीटी crowned, हरिलोचनः of tawny eyes, सविद्युत् by lightning, तोयदःइव like rainy cloud, वीरः hero, लङ्कायाम् at Lanka, दृश्यते seen, असौ oh, क who is he.

text: पृथिव्याः केतुभूतो ऽसौ महानेको ऽत्र दृश्यते । यं दृष्ट्वा वानराः सर्वे विद्रवन्ति ततस्ततः ॥६-६१-६॥
translation: "He is seen here like a lone comet on earth. Seeing him the Vanaras are fleeing hither and thither."
word_meanings: महान् remarkable, असौ he is, एकः lone, अत्र there, पृथिव्याम् earth, केतुभूतः comet, दृश्यते appears, यम् him, दृष्टवा on seeing, सर्वे all, वानराः Vanaras, ततस्ततः hither and thither, विद्रवन्ति fleeing.

text: आचक्ष्व मे महान् को ऽसौ रक्षो वा यदि वा ऽसुरः । न मयैवंविधं भूतं दृष्टपूर्वं कदाचन ॥६-६१-७॥
translation: "Who is he, that gigantic Rakshasa? Is he a demon or perhaps a colossus? No such being was seen by me earlier."
word_meanings: सुमहान् gigantic, असौ he is, क who, रक्षःवा that Rakshasa, यदिवा perhaps, असुरः demon, आचक्षव colossus, मया by me, एवंविधम् this kind, धूतम् messenger, कदाचन not seen, न दृष्टपूर्वम् not seen earlier.

text: स पृष्टो राजपुत्रेण रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा । विभीषणो महाप्राज्ञः काकुत्स्थमिदमब्रवीत् ॥६-६१-८॥
translation: Asked by the prince Rama, of unwearied action, highly intelligent Vibheeshana spoke.
word_meanings: राजपुत्रेण by the prince, अक्लिष्टकर्मण of unwearied action, रामेण by Rama, संपृष्टः having been asked, महाप्राज्ञः highly intelligent, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, काकुत्थ्सम् to Kakuthsa, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: येन वैवस्वतो युद्धे वासवश्च पराजितः । सैष विश्रवसः पुत्रः कुम्भकर्णः प्रतापवान् । अस्य प्रमाणात् सदृशो राक्षसो ऽन्यो न विद्यते ॥६-६१-९॥
translation: "Vyvasvatha (Lord of death) as well as Vasava (Indra) were defeated by him in war. He is Kumbhakarna, the son of sage Visrava, a stupendous one and there is no other Rakshasa who equals him in size."
word_meanings: येन by him, युद्धे war, वैवस्वतः Vyvasvatha, वासवश्च Vasava's, पराजितः defeated, सः he, एषः that way, विश्रवसः Visrava, पुत्रः son, प्रतापवान् stupendous, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, अस्य his, प्रमाणसदृशः in size, अन्यःराक्षसः other Rakshasas, न विद्यते not known.

text: एतेन देवा युधि दानवाश्च यक्षा भुजङ्गाः पिशिताशनाश्च । गन्धर्वविद्याधरकिन्नराश्च सहस्रशो राघव सम्प्रभग्राः ॥६-६१-१०॥
translation: "O Raghava! In war Devas, Danavas, Yakshas, Nagas, ogres, Gandharvas, Vidydharas, Kinneras in thousands were defeated by him."
word_meanings: राघव Raghava, एतेन by him, युधि in war, देवाः Devas, दानवाश्च and Danavas, यक्षाः yaksha, भुजङ्गाः Nagas, पिशिताशनाश्च ogres, गन्धर्व Gandharvas, विद्याधर Vidyadharas, किन्नरैश्च Kinneras, सहस्रशः in thousands, सम्प्रभग्नाः were all defeated.

text: शूलपाणिं विरूपाक्षं कुम्भकर्णं महाबलम् । हन्तुं न शेकुस्त्रिदशाः कालो ऽयमिति मोहिताः ॥६-६१-११॥
translation: "This Kumbhakarna with pike in hand and fierce eyes, is mighty strong. All the Devatas could not kill him, deluded that he is death personified."
word_meanings: शूलपाणिम् with pike in hand, विरूपाक्षम् fierce eyes, महाबलम् mighty strong, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, स्त्रिदशाः all Devatas, अयम् this, कालःइति death personified, मोहिताः deluded, हन्तुम् to think of killing, न शेकुः not kill.

text: प्रकृत्या ह्येष तेजस्वी कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः । अन्येषां राक्षसेन्द्राणां वरदानकृतं बलम् ॥६-६१-१२॥
translation: "Kumbhakarna is by nature (by birth) energetic and mighty. The strength of other Rakshasas is on account of their boons received by them."
word_meanings: एषः in that way, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, प्रकृत्याः by nature, तेजस्वी energetic, महाबलः mighty, अन्येषाम् of others, राक्षसेन्द्राणाम् Rakshasa kings, बलम् strength, वरदानकृतम् is on account of boons.

text: एतेन जातमात्रेण क्षुधार्तेन महात्मना । भक्षितानि सहस्राणि सत्त्वानां सुबहून्यपि ॥६-६१-१३॥
translation: " As soon as he was born, he was hungry and this great soul being strong consumed thousands of created beings."
word_meanings: जातमात्रेण as he was born, क्षुधार्तेन due to hunger, एतेन all, महात्मना great soul, सत्त्वानाम् created beings, सुबहूनिअपि being strong, सहस्राणि thousands, भक्षितानि were consumed.

text: तेषु सम्भक्ष्यमाणेषु प्रजा भयनिपीडिताः । यान्ति स्म शरणं शक्रं तमप्यर्थं न्यवेदयन् ॥६-६१-१४॥
translation: "In that way when Kumbhakarna was devouring, out of fear all people sought the refuge of Indra and represented."
word_meanings: तेषु that way, सम्भक्षयमाणेषु was eating every one, प्रजाः people, भयनिपीडिताः out of fear, शक्रम् Indra, शरणंयान्तिस्म sought refuge, तम् they, अर्धम् अपि all about, न्यवेदयन् represented.

text: स कुम्भकर्णं कुपितो महेन्द्रो जघान वज्रेण शितेन वज्री । स शक्रवज्राभिहतो महात्मा चचाल कोपाच्च भृशं ननाद ॥६-६१-१५॥
translation: "Mahendra who was armed with thunderbolt got enraged and hurt Kumbhakarna with thunderbolt. He reeled and roared with the strike."
word_meanings: वज्री armed with thunderbolt, सः he, महेन्द्रः Mahendra, कुपितः enraged, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, वज्रेण at Indra, जघान hurt, शक्रवज्राभिहतः with thunderbolt, महात्मा great self, सः he, चचाल reeled, कोपात् in anger, भृशम् intense, ननाद च roared.

text: तस्य नानद्यमानस्य कुम्भकर्णस्य धीमतः । श्रुत्वा ऽतिनादं वित्रस्ता भूयो भूमिर्वितत्रसे ॥६-६१-१६॥
translation: "People were already afraid of Kumbhakarna, and after hearing the lion roar of this Rakshasa they were even more scared."
word_meanings: वित्रस्ताः alarmed, प्रजाः people, नानद्यमानस्य hearing the lion roar, रक्षसः Rakshasa, तस्यकुम्भकर्णस्य that Kumbhakarna's, निनादम् roar, श्रुत्वा hearing, भूयः became, वितत्रसे scared.

text: तत्र कोपान्महेन्द्रस्य कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः । विकृष्यैरावताद्दन्तं जघानोरसि वासवम् ॥६-६१-१७॥
translation: "Then mighty Kumbhakarna, who was enraged, pulled out the tusk of Airavatham and struck at the chest of Indra."
word_meanings: तत्र then, महेन्द्रस्य Mahendra's, कोपात् anger, महाबलः mighty, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, ऐरावतात् Airavatham, दन्तम् tusk, विकृष्य tearing, वासवम् from the mouth, उरसि chest, जघान struck.

text: कुम्भकर्णप्रहारार्तो विजज्वाल स वासवः । ततो विषेदुः सहसा देवब्रह्मर्षिदानवाः ॥६-६१-१८॥
translation: "Hit by Kumbhakarna Indra felt tormented. The Devatas, Brahmarshis and Danavas became despondent. Accompanied by created beings they complained to Brahma."
word_meanings: सः he, वासवः Indra, कुम्भकर्णप्रहारार्तः for Kumbhakarna's hit, विजज्वाल tormented, ततः then, देवाः Devatas, ब्रह्मर्षिदानवाः Brahmarshis, Danavas, सहसा with force, निषेदुः despondent, शक्रश्च Indra's, प्रजाभिःसह accompanied with created beings, स्वयम्भुवः to Brahma, स्थानम् place, ययौ complained.

text: प्रजाभिः सह शक्रश्च ययौ स्थानं स्वयम्भुवः । कुम्भकर्णस्य दौरात्म्यं शशंसुस्ते प्रजापतेः ॥६-६१-१९॥
प्रजानां भक्षणं चापि देवानां चापि धर्षणम् । आश्रमध्वंसनं चापि परस्त्रीहरणं भृशम् ॥६-६१-२०॥
translation: "They reported to Brahma about Kumbhakarna's ruthless deeds, devouring created beings, insulting, harsh and also destroying the abodes of sages violently and abducting others' wives."
word_meanings: ते you, प्रजापतेः Brahma, कुम्भकर्णस्य Kumbhakarna's, दौरात्म्यम् ruthless deeds, प्रजानाम् created beings, भक्षणंचापि devouring, दिवौकसाम् insulting, धर्षणं च harshness, आश्रमध्वंसनंचापि also destroying the abodes of sages, भृशम् violently, परस्त्रीहरणम् abducted others' wives, शशंसुः reported.

text: एवं प्रजा यदि त्वेष भक्षयिष्यति नित्यशः । अचिरेणैव कालेन शून्यो लोको भविष्यति ॥६-६१-२१॥
translation: "If he consumes created beings every day like that, in the course of time the world will be devoid of beings."
word_meanings: एषः if he, एवम् in that way, नित्यशः every day, प्रजाः created beings, भक्षयिष्यतियदि if consumes, अचिरेण soon, कालेनैव in course of time, लोकः world, शून्यः empty, भविष्यति will become.

text: वासवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सर्वलोकपितामहः । रक्षांस्यावाहयामास कुम्भकर्णं ददर्श ह ॥६-६१-२२॥
translation: Hearing the words of Indra, Brahma conjured the Rakshasas and saw Kumbhakarna with them.
word_meanings: सर्वलोकपितामहः Brahma (the grandfather of the whole universe), वासवस्य Indra, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, रक्षांसि Rakshasas, आवाहयामास conjured, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, ददर्शह saw.

text: कुम्भकर्णं समीक्ष्यैव वितत्रास प्रजापतिः । दृष्ट्वा विश्वास्य चैवेदं स्वयम्भूरिदमब्रवीत् ॥६-६१-२३॥
translation: "Beholding Kumbhakarna, Brahma was alarmed and spoke to him to restore the confidence of Kumbhakarna."
word_meanings: कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, समीक्ष्यैव beholding, प्रजापतिः Brahma, वितत्रास alarmed, स्वयम्भूः Brahma, दृष्टवा seeing, विश्वास्यचैवैनम् to restore confidence, इदं, this अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: ध्रुवं लोकविनाशाय पौलस्त्येनासि निर्मितः । तस्मात्त्वमद्यप्रभृति मृतकल्पः शयिष्यसे ॥६-६१-२४॥
translation: "Surely you are begotten by Paulastya for the destruction of the universe. Therefore, remain sleeping like a dead one from today, ' said Brahma and cursed him."
word_meanings: लोकविनाशाय for the destruction of the universe, पौलस्त्येन by Paulastya, निर्मितःअपि begotten, ध्रुवम् surely, तस्मात् therefore, त्वम् you, अद्यप्रभृति remain from today, मृतकल्पः sleep like a dead one, शयिष्यसे lying down.

text: ब्रह्मशापाभिभूतो ऽथ निपपाताग्रतः प्रभोः । ततः परमसम्भ्रान्तो रावणो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥६-६१-२५॥
translation: "Thereafter, by the curse of Lord Brahma, Kumbhakarna fell in front. Highly agitated at this Ravana spoke these words to Brahma."
word_meanings: अथ and then, ब्रह्मशापाभिभूतः by the curse of Brahma, प्रभोः Lord, अग्रतः front, ततः then, परमसम्भ्रान्तः highly agitated, रावणः Ravana, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: विवृद्धः काञ्चनो वृक्षः फलकाले निकृत्यते । न नप्तारं स्वकं न्याय्यं शप्तुमेवं प्रजापते ॥६-६१-२६॥
translation: "Oh Brahma! Cutting a golden tree at the stage of fruiting is not fair. It is not proper for you to curse your great grandson in that way."
word_meanings: प्रजापते Brahma, विवृद्धः developing, काञ्चनःवृक्षः golden tree, फलकाले at the stage of fruiting, निकृत्यते cutting, स्वकम् by you, नप्तारम् great grandson, एवम् in that way, शप्तुम् son, न न्यायम् not proper.

text: न मिथ्यावचनश्च त्वं स्वप्स्यत्येष न संशयः । कालस्तु क्रियतामस्य शयने जागरे तथा ॥६-६१-२७॥
translation: "Your words will not become untrue, no doubt. Sleep, he must but waking time may be fixed."
word_meanings: त्वम् by you, मिथ्यावचनः untrue, न च not be, संशयः न no doubt, स्वप्स्यत्येष sleep he must, अस्य his, शयने sleep, तथा like that, जागरे waking, कालः time, क्रियताम् may be fixed.

text: रावणस्य वचः श्रुत्वा स्वयम्भूरिदमब्रवीत् ॥६-६१-२८॥
translation: On hearing Ravana's words, Brahma said" He will sleep for six months and stay awake for a day."
word_meanings: रावणस्य Ravana's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, स्वयम्भूः Brahma, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke, एषः if, षट् six, मासान् months, शयिताहि he sleeps, एकाहम् one day, जागरिष्यति will be awake.

text: शयति ह्येष षण्मासानेकाहं जागरिष्यति । एकेनाह्ना त्वसौ वीरश्चरन् भूमिं बुभुक्षितः । व्यात्तास्यो भक्षयेल्लोकान् सक्रुद्ध इव पावकः ॥६-६१-२९॥
translation: "This hero will open his mouth wide and move about and alone he will consume the world like the swollen fire."
word_meanings: असौवीरः This hero, एकेन alone, आह्ना mouth, बुभुक्षितः will consume, भूमिम् the earth, चरन् moving about, व्यात्तास्यः opening the mouth wide, सङ्कृद्धः like the swollen fire, पावकःइव like fire, लोकान् the world, भक्षयेत् will consume.

text: सो ऽसौ व्यसनमापन्नः कुम्भकर्णमबोधयत् । त्वत्पराक्रमभीतश्च राजा सम्प्रति रावणः ॥६-६१-३०॥
translation: "Overtaken by worry, the king out of fear of your prowess just awakened sleeping Kumbhakarna."
word_meanings: व्यसनम् worry, आपन्नः overtaken, राजा king, सः he, असौ is, रावणः Ravana, त्वत्पराक्रमभीतः च by the fear of your prowess, सम्प्रति sleeping, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, अबोधयत् is awakened.

text: स एष निर्गतो वीरः शिबिराद्भीमविक्रमः । वानरान् भृशसङ्क्रुद्धो भक्षयन् परिधावति ॥६-६१-३१॥
translation: "This heroic Kumbhakarna has come out of his residence extremely angry and going to and from to consume all Vanaras."
word_meanings: भीमविक्रमः fierce valour, सः he, एषः if, वीरः heroic, शिभिरात् from his residence, निर्गतः come out, भृशसङ्कृद्धः extremely angry, वानरान् Vanaras, भक्षयन् to consume, परिधावति going to and from.

text: कुम्भकर्णं समीक्ष्यैव हरयो ऽद्य प्रविद्रुताः । कथमेनं रणे क्रुद्धं वारयिष्यन्ति वानराः ॥६-६१-३२॥
translation: "On merely seeing Kumbhakarna, the monkeys are running away. How will they check him who is enraged in war?"
word_meanings: अद्य running, हरयः monkeys, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, प्रतीक्ष्यैव on seeing itself, प्रविद्रुतुः, रणे war, क्रुद्धम् angry, एनम् these, वानराः Vanaras, कथम् how, वारयिष्यन्ति check.

text: उच्यन्तां वानराः सर्वे यन्त्रमेतत् समुच्छ्रितम् । इति विज्ञाय हरयो भविष्यन्तीह निर्भयाः ॥६-६१-३३॥
translation: "Let all the Vanaras be told, that this one standing high is a machine then the Vanaras will not be scared of victory."
word_meanings: एतत् this, समुच्छ्रितम् standing high, यन्त्रम् machine, सर्वे all, वानराः Vanaras, उच्यन्ताम् having told, हरयः Vanaras, इति this, विज्ञाय victory, निर्भयाः not scared, इह here, भविष्यन्ति will be.

text: विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा हेतुमत् सुमुखेरितम् । उवाच राघवो वाक्यं नीलं सेनापतिं तदा ॥६-६१-३४॥
translation: Hearing the words of Vibheeshana, which was reasonable and, in their favour, Raghava said this to Nila, the commander in chief of the army.
word_meanings: सुमुखेरितम् which was in favour, हेतुमत् reasonable, विभीषणवचः Vibheeshana's words, श्रुत्वा hearing, राघवः Raghava, तदा then, सेनापतिम् commander in chief of army, नीलम् Nila, वाक्यम् these words, उवाच said.

text: गच्छ सैन्यानि सर्वाणि व्यूह्य तिष्ठस्व पावके । द्वाराण्यादाय लङ्कायाश्चर्याश्चाप्यथ सङ्क्रमान् ॥६-६१-३५॥
translation: "Pavaka, go and organize all the army and get together to occupy all the gates, highways, bridges in Lanka."
word_meanings: पावके Pavaka (the son of fire god), गच्छ go, सर्वाणि all, सैन्यानि army, व्यूह्य organizing, लङ्काया Lanka, द्वाराणि gates, चर्याश्चापि highways, अथ and, सङ्क्रमान् bridges, आदाय getting together, तिष्ठ occupying.

text: शैलशृङ्गाणि वृक्षांश्च शिलाश्चाप्युपसंहर । तिष्ठन्तु वानराः सर्वे सायुधाः शैलपाणयः ॥६-६१-३६॥
translation: "Be ready staying on mountain tops, trees, rocks armed with weapons and rocks in hand."
word_meanings: शैलशृङ्गाणि mountain tops, वृक्षांश्च trees also, शिलाश्चापि rocks too, उपसंहार be ready, सर्वे all, सायुधाः armed with weapons, शैलपाणयः rocks in hand, तिष्ठन्तु stay.

text: राघवेण समादिष्टो नीलो हरिचमूपतिः । शशास वानरानीकं यथावत् कपिकुञ्जरः ॥६-६१-३७॥
translation: As instructed by Raghava, the monkey leader Nila, elephant among the monkeys, ordered the monkey troops as instructed.
word_meanings: राघवेण by Raghava, समादिष्टः instructed, हरिचमूपतिः monkey leader, कपिकुञ्जरः elephant among monkeys, नीलः Nila, वानरानीकम् monkey troops, यथावत् as instructed, शशास ordered.

text: ततो गवाक्षः शरभो हनुमानङ्गदस्तथा । शैलशृङ्गाणि शैलाभा गृहीत्वा द्वारमभ्ययुः ॥६-६१-३८॥
translation: Then taking mountains, Gavaksha, Sarabha, Hanuman, Angada who looked like mountains themselves marched to the gate.
word_meanings: ततः then, शैलाभाः mountains, गवाक्षः Gavaksha, शरभं Sarabha, हनूमन् Hanuman, तथा so also, अङ्गदः Angada, शैलशृङ्गाणि looked like mountains, गृहीत्वा taking, द्वारम् gate, अभ्ययुः marched.

text: रामवाक्यमुपश्रुत्य हरयो जितकाशिनः । पादपैरर्दयन् वीरा वानराः परवाहिनीम् ॥६-६१-३९॥
translation: The monkeys desiring to be triumphant, took trees and began to strike at the enemies on hearing Rama's control.
word_meanings: जितकाशिनः desiring to be triumphant, हरयः monkeys, रामवाक्यम् Rama's command, उपश्रुत्य hearing, वीराः heroes, वानराः Vanara, पादपैः trees, परवाहिनीम् enemies, अर्धयन् began to strike.

text: ततो हरीणां तदनीकमुग्रं रराज शैलोद्यतदीप्तहस्तम् । गिरेः समीपानुगतं यथैव महन्महाम्भोधरजालमुग्रम् ॥६-६१-४०॥
translation: Then Vanaras taking trees and mountains in their shining hand s marching close to each other seemed like a huge mass of terrible clouds hanging close to a mountain. ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेषष्टितमस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the sixty first sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: ततः then, शैलोद्यतदीप्तहस्तम् taking trees and rocks in their shining hand s, हरीणाम् the Vanaras, उग्रम् front, तत् that, गिरेः mountain, समीपानुगतम् close to each other, उग्रम् terrible, महत् huge, महाम्भोधरजालंयथैव like mass of clouds hanging, रराज seemed.

text: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे एकषष्टितमः सर्गः ॥ ६१ ॥६-६१-४१॥
स तु राक्षसशार्दूलो निद्रामदसमाकुलः । राजमार्गं श्रिया जुष्टं ययौ विपुलविक्रमः ॥६-६२-१॥
translation: He (Kumbhakaran), who was endowed with indomitable prowess, a tiger among Rakshasas, was sleepy and inebriated, marched along the splendid royal path.
word_meanings: विपुलविक्रमः of indomitable prowess, सः he, राक्षसशार्दूलः tiger among Rakshasas, निद्रामदसमाकुलः sleepy and inebriated, श्रिया prosperous, जुष्टम् splendid, राजमार्गम् royal path, ययौ marched.

text: राक्षसानां सहस्रैश्च वृतः परमदुर्जयः । गृहेभ्यः पुष्पवर्षेण कीर्यमाणस्तदा ययौ ॥६-६२-२॥
translation: Then, Kumbhakarna, who is very difficult to win over, walked violently surrounded by Rakshasas, covered with showers of flowers from houses.
word_meanings: तदा then, परमदुर्जयः very difficult to win, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, सहस्रैः violently, वृतः surrounded, गृहेभ्यः from the houses, पुष्पवर्षेण rain of flowers, कीर्यमाणः covered, ययौ went.

text: स हेमजालिविततं भानुभास्वरदर्शनम् । ददर्श विपुलं रम्यं राक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशनम् ॥६-६२-३॥
translation: He saw the vast abode of the king of Rakshasas, with lattice work of gold and looking bright like the morning Sun
word_meanings: सः he, हेमजालविततम् latticework of gold, भानुभास्वरदर्शनम् bright as morning Sun, विपुलम् vast, रम्यम् delightful, राक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशनम् Rakshasa king's abode, ददर्श saw.

text: स तत्तदा सूर्य इवाभ्रजालं प्रविश्य रक्षोधिपतेर्निवेशम् । ददर्श दूरे ऽग्रजमासनस्थं स्वयम्भुवं शक्र इवासनस्थम् ॥६-६२-४॥
translation: He saw entering the abode of Lord of Rakshasas like the Sun penetrating into a mass of clouds, from a distance his elder brother seated on the throne just like Indra saw the SelfBorn Brahma on the throne.
word_meanings: सः he, तदा then, सूर्यः Sun, अभ्रजालम् mass of clouds, इव like, रक्षोधिपतेः Lord of Rakshasas, निवेशम् abode, प्रविश्य entered, दूरे from distance, आसनस्थम् seated on the throne, अग्रजम् elder brother, शक्रः Indra, आसनस्थम् throne, स्वयम्भुवम् इव like Selfborn Brahma, ददर्श saw.

text: भ्रातुः स भवनं गच्छन् रक्षोगणसमन्वितम् । कुम्भकर्णः पदन्यासैरकम्पयत मेदिनीम् ॥६-६२-५॥
translation: While Kumbhakarna accompanied by troops of Rakshasas, was taking strides to his brother's abode, even the earth was shaken.
word_meanings: रक्षोगणसमन्वितम् accompanied by the troops of Rakshasas, सःकुम्भकर्णः that Kumbhakarna, भ्रातुः brother, भवनम् mansion, गच्छन् going, पदन्यासैः by the strides, मेदिनीम् earth, अम्पयत shaken.

text: सो ऽभिगम्य गृहं भ्रातुः कक्ष्यामभिविगाह्य च । ददर्शोद्विग्नमासीनं विमाने पुष्पके गुरुम् ॥६-६२-६॥
translation: Having gone to his brother's residence, stepping into the enclosure, he saw his brother seated in a perturbed state.
word_meanings: सः he, भ्रातुः brother, गृहम् residence, अभिगम्य having gone, कक्ष्याम् enclosure, अभिविगाह्य च stepping in, पुष्पकेविमाने Aerial chariot, आसीनम् seated, उद्विग्नम् perturbed, गुरुम् state, ददर्श saw.

text: अथ दृष्ट्वा दशग्रीवः कुम्भकर्णमुपस्थितम् । तूर्णमुत्थाय संहृष्टः सन्निकर्षमुपानयत् ॥६-६२-७॥
translation: The ten headed Ravana seeing Kumbhakarna, was delighted and got up quickly and made him come close to him.
word_meanings: अथ and then, दशग्रीवः ten headed, उपस्थितम् getting up, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, दृष्टवा seeing, तूर्णम् quickly, उत्थाय getting up, संहृष्टः delighted, सन्निकर्षम् close to him, उपानयत् brought.

text: अथासीनस्य पर्यङ्के कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः । भ्रातुर्ववन्दे चरणौ किं कृत्यमिति चाब्रवीत् ॥६-६२-८॥
translation: Getting up from his seat, Kumbhakarna endowed with extraordinary might bowed down and clasped his brother's feet and asked him, what task he had to do?
word_meanings: अथ and then, महाबलः endowed with extraordinary might, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, पर्यङ्के getting up, आसीनस्य from his seat, भ्रातुः brother, चरणौ feet, ववन्दे clasped, किम् what, कृत्यम् task to do, इति च now, अब्रवीत् said.

text: उत्पत्य चैनं मुदितो रावणः परिषस्वजे । स भ्रात्रा सम्परिष्वक्तो यथावच्छाभिनन्दितः ॥६-६२-९॥
translation: Getting up from his seat Ravana embraced and greeted Kumbhakarna. So also, he duly rejoiced and occupied the seat.
word_meanings: रावणः Ravana, उत्पत्य getting up, एनम् in that way, परिषस्वजे filled with joy, भ्रात्रा brother, परिष्वक्तः embraced, यथावत् similarly, अभिनन्दितः greeted, सःकुम्भकर्णः that Kumbhakarna, शुभम् auspicious, दिव्यम् wonderful, वरासनम् excellent seat, प्रतिपेदे occupied.

text: कुम्भकर्णः शुभं दिव्यं प्रतिपेदे वरासनम् । स तदासनमाश्रित्य कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः । संरक्तनयनः कोपाद्रावणं वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥६-६२-१०॥
translation: Mighty Kumbhakarna, duly took the seat. Enraged Ravana with blood shot eyes spoke these words.
word_meanings: महाबलः mighty, सःकुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, तत् that, आसनम् seat, आश्रित्य taking, क्रोधात् enraged, संरक्तनयनः blood shot eyes, रावणम् Ravana, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: किमर्थमहमादृत्य त्वया राजन् विबोधितः । शंस कस्माद्भयं ते ऽस्ति को ऽद्य प्रेतो भविष्यति ॥६-६२-११॥
translation: "O King! For what purpose have I been awakened by you? Whom are you fearing? I wish to know who is to be ceased in life?"
word_meanings: राजन् king, अहम् I, अदृत्य awakened, त्वया by you, किमर्थम् for what purpose, विबोधितः tell me, अद्य you may, ते to you, कस्मात् with the task, भयम् fear, शंस doubt, प्रेतः to be ceased, भविष्यति I wish to know.

text: भ्रातरं रावणः कुद्धं कुम्भकर्णमवस्थितम् । ईषत्तु परिवृत्ताभ्यां नेत्राभ्यां वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥६-६२-१२॥
translation: Kumbhakarna, was overcome with anger, and asked his brother Ravana, who was seated and rolling his eyes in anger.
word_meanings: रावणः Ravana, क्रुद्धम् angry, अवस्थितम् seated, भ्रातरम् brother, कुम्भकर्णम् Kumbhakarna, ईषत्तु overcome with anger, परिवृत्ताभ्याम् rolling, नेत्राभ्याम् eyes, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: अद्य ते सुमहान् कालः शयानस्य महाबल । सुखितस्त्वं न जानीषे मम रामकृतं भयम् ॥६-६२-१३॥
translation: "Oh! Kumbhakarna of extraordinary prowess! You were asleep for long happily. You do not know that I am afraid of Rama."
word_meanings: महाबल extraordinary prowess, शयानस्य from sleep, ते you, अद्य arouse, सुमहान् long, कालः time, सुखितः sleeping, त्वम् you, मम me, रामकृतम् of Rama, भयम् fear, न जानीषे not know.

text: एष दाशरथी रामः सुग्रीवसहितो बली । समुद्रं सबलस्तीर्त्वा मूलं नः परिकृन्तति ॥६-६२-१४॥
translation: "Rama, the son of Dasaratha accompanied by Sugriva, crossed the ocean with an army that was cutting our roots."
word_meanings: दाशरथिः Dasarathi, बली strong, एषः he, रामः that Rama, सुग्रीवसहितः accompanied by Sugriva, समुद्रम् ocean, सबलम् with army, नःमूलम् at our roots, परिकृन्तति crossed.

text: हन्त पश्यस्व लङ्कायां वनान्युपवनानि च । सेतुना सुखमागम्य वानरैकार्णवीकृतम् ॥६-६२-१५॥
translation: " Alas! You see how the Vanaras, arriving at Lanka, crossing the bridge have done away with groves and gardens."
word_meanings: हन्त alas, पश्यस्व you see, लङ्कायाः Lanka, वनानि groves, पवनानि च gardens, सेतुना bridge happily, आगम्य having come, वानरैकार्णवीम् Vanaras work, कृतम् done.

text: ये रक्षसां मुख्यतमा हतास्ते वानरैर्युधि । वानराणां क्षयं युद्धे न पश्यामि कदाचन ॥६-६२-१६॥
translation: "Of the Rakshasas, the chiefs have been killed in war by Vanaras. But I did not see even one Vanara to have been killed in war. Vanaras have not failed to succeed in war."
word_meanings: मुख्यतमाः of the chief, येराक्षसाः the Rakshasas, ते to you, युधि in war, वानरैः Vanara, हताः killed, युद्धे in combat, वानराणाम् Vanaras, क्षयम् killed, कदाचन but even, न पश्यामि did not see, वानराः Vanaras, युद्धे in war, कदाचन even, जितपूर्वाः not failed to succeed, न चापि not seen.

text: न चापि वानरा युद्धे जितपूर्वाः कदाचन ॥६-६२-१७॥
translation: "Of the Rakshasas, the chiefs have been killed in war by Vanaras. But I did not see even one Vanara to have been killed in war. Vanaras have not failed to succeed in war."
word_meanings: मुख्यतमाः of the chief, येराक्षसाः the Rakshasas, ते to you, युधि in war, वानरैः Vanara, हताः killed, युद्धे in combat, वानराणाम् Vanaras, क्षयम् killed, कदाचन but even, न पश्यामि did not see, वानराः Vanaras, युद्धे in war, कदाचन even, जितपूर्वाः not failed to succeed, न चापि not seen.

text: तदेतद्भयमुत्पन्नं त्रायस्वेमां महाबल । नाशय त्वमिमानद्य तदर्थं बोधितो भवान् ॥६-६२-१८॥
translation: "Mighty strong I am, but such is the fear that has been created in me from them. You have been awakened, to destroy them. Reported Ravana."
word_meanings: महाबल mighty strong, तत् you, एतत् this, भयम् fear, उत्पन्नम् that is created, इह here, माम् me, त्रायस्व from them, तम् you, अद्य rising, इमान् these, नाशय destroy, तदर्थम् by that, भवान् you, बोधितः reported.

text: सर्वक्षपितकोशं च स त्वमभ्यवपद्य माम् । त्रायस्वेमां पुरीं लङ्कां बालवृद्धावशेषिताम् ॥६-६२-१९॥
translation: " All resources of mine are exhausted. These children and aged are only left in Lanka city, knowing that you will save the city of Lanka."
word_meanings: सः he, त्वम् you, सर्वक्षपितकोशम् all resources exhausted, माम् my me, अभ्यवपद्य striking at the enemy, बालवृद्धावशेषिताम् children and aged are only left, इमाम् these, लङ्कां Lanka, पुरीम् city, त्रायस्व by you.

text: भ्रातुरर्थे महाबाहो कुरु कर्म सुदुष्करम् । मयैवं नोक्तपूर्वो हि कच्चिद् भ्रातः परन्तप ॥६-६२-२०॥
translation: "O broad shouldered brother! Do this task which is difficult for others. O Scourge of enemies! I have not asked you before for such a task."
word_meanings: महाबाहो broad shouldered, भ्रात brother:, परन्तप scourge, अर्थे you are, सुदुष्करम् difficult, कर्म task, कुरु do, भ्रातः brother, मया my, कश्चित् indeed, एवम् in that way, न उक्तपूर्वःहि not asked you before.

text: त्वय्यस्ति तु मम स्नेहः परा सम्भावना च मे । दैवासुरेषु युद्धेषु बहुशो राक्षसर्षभ । त्वया देवाः प्रतिव्यूह्य निर्जिताश्चासुरा युधि ॥६-६२-२१॥
translation: "O Bull among Rakshasas! Being my brother, do this for me. I always have affection for you. Considering that you have encountered war with Devas and Asuras and won both Devas and Asuras, do this help."
word_meanings: राक्षसर्षभ bull among Rakshasas, मम my, त्वयि you, स्नेहः affection, अस्ति being, मे to me, परा others, सम्भावना च considering, दैवासुरेषु Devas and Asuras, युद्धेषु in war, प्रतिव्यूह्य encountered, त्वया by you, देवाः Devas, असुराः Asuras, युधि in war, बहुशः perhaps, निर्जिताः won.

text: तदेतत् सर्वमातिष्ठ वीर्यं भीमपराक्रम । न हि ते सर्वभूतेषु दृश्यते सदृशो बली ॥६-६२-२२॥
translation: "O Brother of fierce valour! Get up. I have not seen anyone stronger than you among all beings."
word_meanings: भीमपराक्रमः of fierce valour, तत् that, एतत् this, सर्वम् all, वीर्यम् heroism, आतिष्ठ get up, सर्वभूतेषु among all beings, ते to you, सदृशः, बली stronger, न दृश्यतेहि not seen.

text: कुरुष्व मे प्रियहितमेतदुत्तमं यथाप्रियं प्रियरणबान्धवप्रिय । स्वतेजसा विधम सपत्नवाहिनीं शरद्घनं पवन इवोद्यतो महान् ॥६-६२-२३॥
translation: "You are a lover of wars. You are a lover of relations. You are always my dear well wisher. O self glorious one! Do this task of throwing out the torrent army just like wind throws rainy clouds." ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेष्टितमस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the sixty second sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: प्रियरण lover of war, बान्धवप्रिय lover of relations, मे to me, प्रियहितम् well wisher, एतत् these, यथाप्रियम् always loving, कुरुष्व do this, स्वतेजसा self glorious, सपत्नवाहिनीम् torrent army, उद्यतः throws, महान् great, पवनः wind, शरद्घनम् इव rainy cloud, विधम in that way.

text: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे द्विषष्टितमः सर्गः ॥ ६२ ॥६-६२-२४॥
तस्य राक्षसराजस्य निशम्य परिदेवितम् । कुम्भकर्णो बभाषेदं वचनं प्रजहास च ॥६-६३-१॥
translation: Hearing the lament of the Rakshasa king, Kumbhakarna replied laughing.
word_meanings: तस्य his, राक्षसराजस्य Rakshasa king's, परिदेवितम् lamentation, निशम्य hearing, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, इदंवचनम् these words, बभाषे replied, प्रजहास च laughing.

text: दृष्टो दोषो हि यो ऽस्माभिः पुरा मन्त्रविनिर्णये । हितेष्वनभिरक्तेन सो ऽयमासादितस्त्वया ॥६-६३-२॥
translation: "While we were discussing earlier and taking decisions, that disaster foreseen by me has reaped for having not trusted the well wishers."
word_meanings: पुरा earlier, मन्त्रन्वििर्णये while we were discussing and taking decision, अस्माभिः you, यः that, दोषः disaster, दृष्टः foreseen, सःअयम् that I, हितेषु wellwishers, अनभियुक्तेन not trusted, त्वया by you, आसादितः reaped.

text: शीघ्रं खल्वभ्युपेतं त्वां फलं पापस्य कर्मणः । निरयेष्वेव पतनं यथा दुष्कृतकर्मणः ॥६-६३-३॥
translation: "Those who do sinful deeds fall unobstructed so also the fruit of your sinful action has come upon you."
word_meanings: दुष्कृतकर्मणः those who do sinful deeds, निरयेषु unobstructed, पतनमेव fall down, यथा so also, पापस्य by the sinful, कर्मणः action, फलम् fruit, त्वाम् you, शीघ्रम् quickly, उपेतंखलु come upon you.

text: प्रथमं वै महाराज कृत्यमेतदचिन्तितम् । केवलं वीर्यदर्पेण नानुबन्धो विचारितः ॥६-६३-४॥
translation: "O king! All this action was not thought of at the beginning, nor the consequences of action weighed in the pride of your prowess."
word_meanings: महाराज king, एतत् all this, कृत्यम् action, प्रथमम् first, अचिन्तितम् not thought of, केवलम् only, वीर्यदर्पेण pride of your prowess, अनुबन्धः consequence, नविचिन्तितः not weighed.

text: यः पश्चात् पूर्वकार्याणि कुर्यादैश्वर्यमास्थितः । पूर्वं चापरकार्याणि न स वेद नयानयौ ॥६-६३-५॥
translation: "Confident of prosperity, he who defers action earlier, he does not know what is right and wrong later on."
word_meanings: यः he who, ऐश्वर्यम् prosperity, आस्थितः confident, पूर्वकार्याणि earlier duties, पश्चात् defers, कुर्यात् action, उत्तरकार्याणि later action, पूर्वं च earlier, सः he, नयानया right or wrong, न वेद does not know.

text: देशकालविहीनानि कर्माणि विपरीतवत् । क्रियमाणानि दुष्यन्ति हवींष्यप्रयतेष्विव ॥६-६३-६॥
translation: " Actions performed without regard for time and place will be disastrous like the oblations offered into fire without consecration, gets wasted."
word_meanings: देशकालविहीनानि without regard for time and place, विपरीतवत् disastrous, क्रियमाणानि the actions performed, कर्माणि actions, अप्रयतेषु not sanctified, हवींषीव like the oblations, प्रयतेष्यिव offered to fire, दुष्यन्ति wasted.

text: त्रयाणां पञ्चधा योगं कर्मणां यः प्रपश्यति । सचिवैः समयं कृत्वा स सभ्ये वर्तते पथि ॥६-६३-७॥
translation: He who thinks with ministers and considers the five aspects of threefold duties and moves in the right path performs (Five aspects of action are the method of initiating action, material to be worked upon, time and place of action, provision against mischance and the chances of success). Threefold duties with reference to enemies are Sama, Daana, and Bedha."
word_meanings: यः he who, सचिवैः ministers, समयम् timely, कृत्वा does, त्रयाणाम् threefold, कर्मणाम् actions, पञ्चधा five aspects, योगम् unites, प्रपश्यति considering, सः he, पधिइव like the path, वर्तते performs.

text: यथागमं च यो राजा समयं विचिकीर्षति । बुध्यते सचिवान् बुद्ध्या सुहृदश्चानुपश्यति ॥६-६३-८॥
translation: "The king who does his duty in time in accordance with justice and thinking intelligently with his ministers, understands rightly."
word_meanings: यः he who, राजा king, यथागमं च controlling, समयं proper time, विचिकीर्षति in accordance with justice, बुध्या intelligently, सचिवान् ministers, बुध्यते thinking, सुहृदश्च with friends, अनुपश्यति understands rightly.

text: धर्ममर्थं च कामं च सर्वान् वा रक्षसां पते । भजेत पुरुषः काले त्रीणि द्वन्द्वानि वा पुनः ॥६-६३-९॥
translation: "O Rakshasa king! A man should pursue his duty or worldly gain or sensual pleasures all the three combined or at least any two in time (the scriptures lay down that duty should be pursued in the morning, wealth in the afternoon and sensual pleasures at night)."
word_meanings: रक्षसांपते Rakshasa king, पुरुषः man, धर्मम् duty, अर्थं च worldly gain, कामं च sensual pleasures, सर्वान्वा or all, त्रीणि three, द्वन्द्वानिवा at least two, काले in time, भजते should pursue.

text: त्रिषु चैतेषु यच्छ्रेष्ठं श्रुत्वा तन्नावबुध्यते । राजा वा राजमात्रो वा व्यर्थं तस्य बहुश्रुतम् ॥६-६३-१०॥
translation: " A sovereign king or a king hearing these three does not recognize the best of the three is in vain even though he heard many."
word_meanings: राजावा king or, राजमात्रोवा equal to king, एतेषु of these, त्रिषु three, यत् that, श्रेष्ठम् best, श्रुत्वा hearing, तत् that, नावबुध्यते not recognize it, तस्य his, बहु many, श्रुतम् heard, व्यर्थम् is in vain.

text: उपप्रदानं सान्त्वं वा भेदं काले च विक्रमम् । योगं च रक्षसां श्रेष्ठ तावुभौ च नयानयौ ॥६-६३-११॥
translation: "You are the foremost of the Rakshasas! After discussing with ministers, a king either by gifting or conciliation or dissension or resorting to all of them at the appropriate time takes resort to pursue virtue, wealth, or sensual pleasures at the right time, never meets with sorrow."
word_meanings: रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, श्रेष्ठ foremost, यः you are, उपप्रदानम् gifting, सान्त्वं च conciliation, भेदं च dissension, उभौ both, तौ together, नयानयौ at the appropriate time, काले right time, धर्मार्थकामान् virtue, wealth and sensual pleasures, सचिवैःसह with ministers, सम्मन्त्ऱ्य discussing, निषेवेत resorts to, आत्मवान् self, सः he, व्यसनम् sorrow, नाप्नुयात् not meet.

text: काले धर्मार्थकामान् यः सम्मन्त्र्य सचिवैः सह । निषेवेतात्मवान् लोके न स व्यसनमाप्नुयात् ॥६-६३-१२॥
translation: "You are the foremost of the Rakshasas! After discussing with ministers, a king either by gifting or conciliation or dissension or resorting to all of them at the appropriate time takes resort to pursue virtue, wealth, or sensual pleasures at the right time, never meets with sorrow."
word_meanings: रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, श्रेष्ठ foremost, यः you are, उपप्रदानम् gifting, सान्त्वं च conciliation, भेदं च dissension, उभौ both, तौ together, नयानयौ at the appropriate time, काले right time, धर्मार्थकामान् virtue, wealth and sensual pleasures, सचिवैःसह with ministers, सम्मन्त्ऱ्य discussing, निषेवेत resorts to, आत्मवान् self, सः he, व्यसनम् sorrow, नाप्नुयात् not meet.

text: हितानुबन्धमालोच्य कार्याकार्यमिहात्मनः । राजा सहार्थतत्त्वज्ञैः सचिवैः स हि जीवति ॥६-६३-१३॥
translation: "That king who knows the reality of things and makes decisions in consultation with his ministers, who make their living with their intelligence will live happily."
word_meanings: राजा king, अर्थतत्त्वज्ञैः reality of things, सचिवैःसहि with ministers, आत्मनः himself, हितानुबन्धम् What is beneficial, आलोक्य thinking well, इह here, कार्यम् action, कार्यात् by their action, जीवति living.

text: अनभिज्ञाय शास्त्रार्थान् पुरुषाः पशुबुद्धयः । प्रागल्भ्याद्वक्तुमिच्छन्ति मन्त्रेष्वभ्यन्तरीकृताः ॥६-६३-१४॥
translation: "People whose intelligence level is no better than animals, who have been included to express their views, who do not know the meaning of shastras express their views out of impudence."
word_meanings: मन्त्रेषु with ministers, अभ्यन्तरीकृताः being included in to express their views, पशुबुद्धयः those who have the intelligence level of animals, पुरुषाः men, शास्त्रार्थान् meaning of shastras, अनभिज्ञाय not knowing, प्रागल्भ्यात् impudence, वक्तुम् expressing, इच्छन्ति desire.

text: अशास्त्रविदुषां तेषां न कार्यमहितं वचः । अर्थशास्त्रानभिज्ञानां विपुलां श्रियमिच्छताम् ॥६-६३-१५॥
translation: "Those who have no knowledge of shastras are ignorant of the science of wealth and desire huge wealth. Their advice ought not to be followed."
word_meanings: अशास्त्रविदुषाम् who having no knowledge of shastras, अर्धशास्त्रानभिज्ञानाम् ignorant of science of wealth, विपुलाम् huge, श्रियम् wealth, इच्छताम् desire, तेषाम् their, अभिहितम् advice, वचः words, न कार्यम् not to be followed.

text: अहितं च हिताकारं धार्ष्ट्याज्जल्पन्ति ये नराः । अवेक्ष्य मन्त्रबाह्यास्ते कर्तव्याः कृत्यदूषणाः ॥६-६३-१६॥
translation: "Those who tender advice, which is unwholesome but in wholesome grab, out of their impudence should be kept away from discussion examining early as they mar the purpose."
word_meanings: ये those, नराः people, हिताकारम् in wholesome grab, अहितम् not good, धार्ष्ट्यात् out of impudence, जल्पन्ति prattle, कृत्यदूषणा: mar the purpose, ते they, अवेक्ष्य examining early, मन्त्रबाह्याः keep them away from discussion, कर्तव्याः is essential duty.

text: विनाशयन्तो भर्तारं सहिताः शत्रुभिर्बुधैः । विपरीतानि कृत्यानि कारयन्तीह मन्त्रिणः ॥६-६३-१७॥
translation: "Some ministers in order to ruin the king, collide with enemies and make the king take wrong actions."
word_meanings: इह some, मन्त्रिणः ministers, भर्तारम् king's, विनाशयन्तः to ruin, बुधैः, शत्रुभिः enemies, सहिताः collide, विपरीतानि wrong, कृत्यानि actions, कारयन्ति will undertake.

text: तान् भर्ता मित्रसङ्काशानमित्रान् मन्त्रनिर्णये । व्यवहारेण जानीयात् सचिवानुपसंहितान् ॥६-६३-१८॥
translation: " A ruler should know those ministers bribed by the enemy, who have become close to the enemy and appear as friends. Those ministers must be known through their behaviour in the deliberations."
word_meanings: भर्ता ruler, उपसम्हितान् who have become close to enemy, मित्रसङ्काशान् appearing as friends, अमित्रान् enemies, तान् they, सचिवान् ministers, मन्त्रनिर्णये through their behaviour, व्यवहारेण in deliberations, जानीयात् must know.

text: चपलस्येह कृत्यानि सहसानुप्रधावतः । छिद्रमन्ये प्रपद्यन्ते क्रौञ्चस्य स्वमिव द्विजाः ॥६-६३-१९॥
translation: "Enemies find out the weakness of the king who is unsteady and rush after the actions forcibly without thinking like brahmins just as birds find the holes in Krauncha mountain and elaborate to others."
word_meanings: चपलस्य unsteady, कृत्यानि actions, सहसा forcibly, अनुप्रधावतः rush after, छिद्रम् containing holes, क्रौञ्चस्य Krauncha mountain, खम् birds, द्विजाःइव like brahmins, अन्ये other, प्रपद्यन्ते elaborate.

text: यो हि शत्रुमविज्ञाय नात्मानमभिरक्षति । अवाप्नोति हि सो ऽनर्थान् स्थानाच्च व्यवरोप्यते ॥६-६३-२०॥
translation: "He who knowing fully the actions of the enemy does not protect himself he attains reverses and is also dragged down from position."
word_meanings: यः he who, शत्रुम् enemy, अवज्ञाय knowing fully, आत्मानम् himself, नाभिरक्षति does not protect himself, सः he, अनर्थान् reverses, अवाप्नोतिहि attains, स्थानात् from position, व्यवरोप्यते च is dragged

text: यदुक्तमिह ते पूर्वं क्रियतामनुजेन च । तदेव नो हितं कार्यं यदिच्छसि च तत् कुरु ॥६-६३-२१॥
translation: "The advice given to you in the past by your brother alone is good. That is good for you. Or you may do what you wish."
word_meanings: पूर्वम् in the past, ते you, अनुजेन brother's, यत् that which, उक्तम् was told, क्रियताम् do that, नः not, तत् that, वाक्यमेव that advice alone, हितम् is good, यत् that, इच्छसि you wish, तत् that, कुरु you may do.

text: तत्तु श्रुत्वा दशग्रीवः कुम्भकर्णस्य भाषितम् । भ्रुकुटिं चैव सञ्चक्रे क्रुद्धश्चैनमभाषत ॥६-६३-२२॥
translation: Kumbhakarna having spoken that way, the ten headed Ravana frowned, shaking his eyebrows in anger and spoke this way.
word_meanings: दशग्रीवःतु ten headed Ravana, कुम्भकर्णस्य Kumbhakarna's, तत् that, भाषितम् spoken, श्रुत्वा having heard, भ्रुकुटिम् eyebrows, सञ्चक्रे shaking frowned, क्रुद्धश्च in anger, एनम् this way, अभाषत spoke.

text: मान्यो गुरुरिवाचार्यः किं मां त्वमनुशाससि । किमेवं वाक्छ्रमं कृत्वा युक्तं विधीयताम् ॥६-६३-२३॥
translation: "Why do you, who are worthy of respect, instruct me like a father or teacher? These words express your cleverness in speaking. It is time to do what is appropriate now. Follow what is to be done."
word_meanings: मान्यः worthy of respect, गुरुः father, आचार्यःइव like teacher, त्वम् you, माम् me, किम् why, अनुशाससे instruct, एवम् in that way, वाक्छ्रमम् cleverness in speaking, कृत्वा doing, किम् why, काले time, युक्तम् is appropriate, विधीयताम् follow.

text: विभ्रमाच्चित्तमोहाद्वा बलवीर्याश्रयेण वा । नाभिपन्नमिदानीं यद्व्यर्थास्तस्य पुनः कथाः ॥६-६३-२४॥
translation: "Due to delusion, or lack of understanding or due to pride of my strength I did something. To talk of it now again is futile."
word_meanings: विभ्रमात् due to delusion, चित्तमोहाद्वा lack of understanding, बलवीर्यश्रयेणवा or due to pride of strength, यत् that, नाभिपन्नम् did something, तस्य that, इदानीम् now to talk of it, पुःकथाः again the same story, व्यर्था is futile

text: अस्मिन् काले तु यद्युक्तं तदिदानीं विधीयताम् । गतं तु नानुशोचन्ति गतं तु गतमेव हि ॥६-६३-२५॥
translation: "You may speak of only what is proper to do now. Do not think of the past as it is gone."
word_meanings: अस्मिन् that alone, काले time, यत् that, युक्तम् which is proper, तत् that, इदानीम् to do now, विधीयताम् you may speak, गतम् past, न अनुशोचन्ति not think of again, गतम् past, गतमेवहि is past.

text: ममापनयजं दोषं विक्रमेण समीकुरु । यदि खल्वस्ति मे स्नेहो विक्रमं वा ऽवगच्छसि । यदि वा कार्यमेतत्ते हृदि कार्यतमं मतम् ॥६-६३-२६॥
translation: "If at all there is any affection in you for me now, you recognize your strengths and think what action is justified in your heart. You may nullify the evil that sprung from my heart."
word_meanings: मे to me, स्नेहः affection, अस्तिखलुयदि if at all it is there now, विक्रमम् valour, अवगच्छसिवा if you recognize, मम to me, एतत् this, कार्यम् action, ते you हृदि at heart, कार्यतमम् What ought to be done, मतंयदि if you deem it right, मम to me, अपनयजम् justified, दोषम् evil, विक्रमेण by valour, समीकुरु nullify.

text: स सुहृद् यो विपन्नार्थं दीनमभ्यवपद्यते । स बन्धुर्यो ऽपनीतेषु साहाय्यायोपकल्पते ॥६-६३-२७॥
translation: " A friend is one who helps when one's fortune is lost and is desperate. Deviating from morals the one who is prepared to help is a relation."
word_meanings: यः he who, विपन्नार्थम् fortune at loss, दीनम् desperate, अभ्यवपद्यते, सः he, सुहृत् out of love, यः he, अपनीतेषु deviating from morals, साहाय्याय one who helps, उपकल्पते prepared, सः he, बन्धुः is a relation.

text: तमथैवं ब्रुवाणं तु वचनं धीरदारुणम् । रुष्टो ऽयमिति विज्ञाय शनैः श्लक्ष्णमुवाच ह ॥६-६३-२८॥
translation: Thereafter knowing that Ravana is agitated and arguing in a grave and harsh manner, Kumbhakarna, spoke slowly in a gentle tone.
word_meanings: अथ and then, एवम् in that way, धीरदारुणम् grave and harsh, वचनम् tone, ब्रुवाणम् arguing, तम् him, अयम् exceedingly, रुष्टः agitated, इति thus, विज्ञाय knowing, सः he, शनैः slowly, श्लक्षणम् gentle tone, उवाच ह spoke.

text: अतीव हि समालक्ष्य भ्रातरं क्षुभितेन्द्रियम् । कुम्भकर्णः शनैर्वाक्यं बभाषे परिसान्त्वयन् ॥६-६३-२९॥
translation: Sensing that Ravana is disturbed very much, Kumbhakarna taking hold of the brother and consoling him slowly said these words.
word_meanings: भ्रातरम् brother, अतीव very much, क्षुभितेन्द्रियम् disturbed senses, समालक्ष्य taking hold, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, परिसान्त्वयन् consoling, शनैः slowly, वाक्यम् words, बभाषे said.

text: अलं राक्षसराजेन्द्र सन्तापमुपपद्य ते । रोषं च सम्परित्यज्य स्वस्थो भवितुमर्हसि ॥६-६३-३०॥
translation: "Listen to my words, Rakshasa king! You are a scourge of enemies. Put aside this sorrow. Give up the agony also. Be normal. You ought to be your normal self again."
word_meanings: राक्षसराजेन्द्र Rakshasa king, अरिन्दम scourge of enemies, राजन् king, अवहितः putting aside, मम my, वाक्यम् words, शृणु listen, ते you, सन्तापम् sorrow, उपपद्य arrive at, अलम् even, रोषं च agony, सम्परित्यज्य, स्वस्थः normal, भवितुम् you be, अर्हसि ought to.

text: नैतन्मनसि कर्तव्यं मयि जीवति पार्थिव । तमहं नाशयिष्यामि यत्कृते परितप्यसे ॥६-६३-३१॥
translation: "While I am (my body is) with life you need not entertain despondency. I will exterminate him, by whose account you are agitated."
word_meanings: पार्थिव my body, मयि I am, जीवति life, एतत् all this, मनसि in mind, न कर्तव्यम् not to be entertained, यत्कृते by whose account, परितप्यते you are agitated, तम् him, अहम् I, नाशयिष्यामि will exterminate.

text: अवश्यं तु हितं वाच्यं सर्वावस्थं मया तव । बन्धुभावादभिहितं भ्रातृस्नेहाच्च पार्थिव ॥६-६३-३२॥
translation: "O king! I will give you good advice in all circumstances being a relation. Salutary advice has been given to you out of brotherly affection."
word_meanings: पार्थिव king, सर्वावस्थां in all circumstances, तवम् to you, मया I am, अवश्यम् certainly, हितम् good advice, तु to you, वाच्यम् give, बन्धुभावत् being a relation, भ्रातृस्नेहाच्छ brotherly affection, अभिहितम् salutary advice.

text: सदृशं यत्तु काले ऽस्मिन् कर्तुं स्निग्धेन बन्धुना । शत्रूणां कदनं पश्य क्रियमाणं मया रणे ॥६-६३-३३॥
translation: " At this time, you will see a relation doing that which is right out of affection. All enemies will be destroyed."
word_meanings: अस्मिन् at this, काले time, बन्दुना relation, स्निग्धेन out of affection, यत्, कर्तुम् will do, सदृशम् right, रणे in war, मया by me, क्रियमाणम् action, शत्रूणाम् enemies, कदनम् destruction, पश्य you will see.

text: अद्य पश्य महाबाहो मया समरमूर्धनि । हते रामे सह भ्रात्रा द्रवन्तीं परवाहिनीम् ॥६-६३-३४॥
translation: "O mighty armed King! You see Rama along with his brother being killed by me and Vanaras fleeing away from the forefront of war."
word_meanings: महाबाहो mighty armed, मया by me, अद्य, रणमूर्धनि in war front, रामे Rama, भ्रात्रासह along with brother, हते kill, द्रवन्तीम् fleeing, हरिवाहिनीम् Vanara army, पश्य you see.

text: अद्य रामस्य तद् दृष्ट्वा मया ऽ ऽनीतं रणाच्छिरः । सुखी भव महाबाहो सीता भवतु दुःखिता ॥६-६३-३५॥
translation: "Be happy today, O Mighty armed brother! I will bring Rama's head from the battlefield. Sita will be sad. You will see."
word_meanings: महाबाहो mighty armed, अद्य now, रणात् from war, आनीतम् will bring, रामस्य Rama's, तत् that, शिरः head, दृष्टवा seeing, सुखी be happy, भव you, सीता Sita, दुःखिता sad, भवतु will be.

text: अद्य रामस्य पश्यन्तु निधनं सुमहत् प्रियम् । लङ्कायां राक्षसाः सर्वे ये ते निहतबान्धवाः ॥६-६३-३६॥
translation: " All the Rakshasas in Lanka whose relations have been killed will witness Rama's death which will be very welcome."
word_meanings: लङ्कायाम् at Lanka, ये those, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, निहतबान्धवाः relations killed, तेसर्वे all of them, अद्य now, रामस्य Rama's, सुमहत्प्रियम् very welcome, निधनम् death, पश्यन्तु witness.

text: अद्य शोकपरीतानां स्वबन्धुवधकारणात् । शत्रोर्युधि विनाशेन करोम्यास्रप्रमार्जनम् ॥६-६३-३७॥
translation: Now I will wipe the tears of Rakshasas who lost their kin and are bewailing their loss.
word_meanings: अद्य now, युधि in war, शत्रोः enemy, विनाशेन abode, स्वबन्धुवध and their kin कारणात् for that reason, शोकपरीतानाम् bewailing loss, अस्रप्रमार्जनम् wipe their tears, करोमि will do.

text: अद्य पर्वतसङ्काशं ससूर्यमिव तोयदम् । विकीर्णं पश्य समरे सुग्रीवं प्लवगोत्तमम् ॥६-६३-३८॥
translation: "Now you will see Sugriva the foremost of monkeys in mountain shape, resembling mountains bathed in blood like evening Sun illumined like the cloud."
word_meanings: अद्य now, समरे in war, प्रकीर्णम् of mountain shape, पर्वतसङ्काशम् resembling mountain, ससूर्यम् illumined by evening Sun, तोयदम् इव like a cloud water, प्लवगोत्तम foremost of the monkeys, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, पश्य see.

text: कथं त्वं राक्षसैरेभिर्मया च परिरक्षितः । जिघांसुभिर्दाशरथिं वध्यसे त्वमिहानघ ॥६-६३-३९॥
translation: "O Sinless Ravana! As I am going to kill this son of Dasaratha whom Rakshasas are intending to kill, how can Rama kill you now?"
word_meanings: अनघ sinless Ravana, दाशरथिम् Son of Dasaratha, जिघांसुभिः intending to kill, एभिःराक्षसैः these Rakshasas, मयाच I am also, परिरक्षितः protecting, त्वम् you, इह here, कथं च why, वध्यसे can kill.

text: अथ पूर्वं हते तेन मयि त्वां हन्ति राघवः । नाहमात्मनि सन्तापं गच्छेयं राक्षसाधिप ॥६-६३-४०॥
translation: "Rakshasa king! Raghava will kill you only after killing me. Never give way for distress."
word_meanings: राक्षसाधिप Rakshasa king, राघवः Raghava, माम् me, निहत्य not kill, त्वाम् you, निहनिष्यतिकिलहि will kill you after killing me, अहम् I, आत्मनि myself, सन्तापम् distress, न गच्छेयम् never give way.

text: कामं त्विदानीमपि मां व्यादिश त्वं परन्तप । न परः प्रेषणीयस्ते युद्धायातुलविक्रम ॥६-६३-४१॥
translation: "Command me to wage war at this moment, O Scorcher of enemies. There is no one better than me to be sought for O hero endowed with extraordinary strength."
word_meanings: परन्तप scorcher of enemies, अतुलविक्रम endowed with extraordinary strength, इदानीमपि at this moment, कामम् better than me, माम् me, व्यादिश command, युद्धाय to wage war, परः others, न प्रेषणीयः no one to besought for.

text: अहमुत्सादयिष्यामि शत्रूंस्तव महाबल ॥६-६३-४२॥
यदि शक्रो यदि यमो यदि पावकमारुतौ । तानहं योधयिष्यामि कुबेरवरुणावपि ॥६-६३-४३॥
translation: "I shall exterminate your enemies, however mighty they may be. I can contend with Indra or fire god or Yama or wind god, Kubera or even Varuna."
word_meanings: अहम् I am, महाबल: mighty strong, तवशत्रून् your enemy, उत्सादयिष्यामि contend with, शक्रः Indra यदि or, यमः Yama यदि or, पावकमारुतौयदि fire god or wind god, कुबेरवरुणावपि Kubera or Varuna also, तान् them, अहम् I, योथयिष्यामि exterminate them.

text: गिरिमात्रशरीरस्य शितशूलधरस्य मे । नर्दतस्तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रस्य बिभीयाच्च पुरन्दरः ॥६-६३-४४॥
translation: "Even Indra with a body as big as a mountain, with pointed teeth like a spike, with sharp teeth will fear me and run if I roar.
word_meanings: गिरिमात्रशरीरस्य body as big as a mountain, शितशूरधरस्य with spike like pointed teeth, तीक्षणदंष्ट्रस्य sharp too the d, नर्दतः roar, मे my, पुरन्दरः Indra, भिभीयात् च will run out of fear.

text: अथवा त्यक्तशस्त्रस्य मृद्नतस्तरसा रिपून् । न मे प्रतिमुखे स्थातुं कश्चिच्छक्तो जिजीविषुः ॥६-६३-४५॥
translation: "Or else giving up weapons and swords using my arms indeed I can crush, and no one can stand in front of me."
word_meanings: अथवा or else, त्यक्तशस्त्रस्य giving up weapons, तरसा crush, रिपून् enemy, मृद्नतः with swords and shafts, मे I, जिजीविषुः with arms, कश्चित् indeed, प्रतिमुखे opposite to me, स्थातुम् to stand, न शक्तः not possible.

text: नैव शक्त्या न गदया नासिना निशितैः शरैः । हस्ताभ्यामेव संरब्धो हनिष्याम्यपि वज्रिणम् ॥६-६३-४६॥
translation: "I shall not fight with javelin or mace or sword or sharp arrows. Enraged, alone I can strike down even Indra."
word_meanings: शक्त्या javelin, नैव not, गदया mace, न not, असिना sword, निशितैः sharp, शरैः arrows, नैव not, सम्रब्दः enraged, हस्ताभ्यामेव with hand s alone, वज्रिणमपि even Indra, हनिष्यामि strike down.

text: यदि मे मुष्टिवेगं स राघवो ऽद्य सहिष्यते । ततः पास्यन्ति बाणौघा रुधिरं राघवस्य तु ॥६-६३-४७॥
translation: "Now if that Raghava can withstand the force of my fists, you will see volleys of Rama's arrows will drink my blood."
word_meanings: अद्य now, राघवः Raghava, तु you, मुष्टिवेगम् force of my fists, सहिष्यतियदि can with stand, ततः that he, मे my, बाणौघाः volleys of arrows, राघवस्य Raghava's, रुधिरम् blood, पाश्यन्ति see.

text: चिन्तया बाध्यसे राजन् किमर्थं मयि तिष्ठति । सो ऽहं शत्रुविनाशाय तव निर्यातुमुद्यतः ॥६-६३-४८॥
translation: "O King! while I am here for what reason do you worry and have anxiety? I will go now and decidedly destroy your enemy."
word_meanings: राजन् king, मयि I am, तिष्ठति here, किमर्थम् for what purpose, चिन्तया worry, बाध्यसे anxiety, सः he, अहम् I, तव your, शत्रुविनाशाय will destroy your enemy, निर्यातुम् decidedly, उद्यतः going now.

text: मुञ्च रामाद्भयं राजन् हनिष्यामीह संयुगे । राघवं लक्ष्मणं चैव सुग्रीवं च महाबलम् । हनुमन्तं च रक्षोघ्नं लङ्का येन प्रदीपिता ॥६-६३-४९॥
translation: "O King! Give up the fear, as both Rama and Lakshmana will be made short of work in the battlefield, as also mighty Sugriva and dispose of Hanuman, the destroyer of many Rakshasas and who set fire to Lanka."
word_meanings: राजन् king, भयम् fear, मुञ्च give up, इह here, सम्युगे battlefield, राघवम् Rama, लक्ष्मणं Lakshmana, महाबलम् mighty, सुग्रीवं च Sugriva also, येन our, लङ्का Lanka, प्रदीपिता who set fire, रक्षोघ्नम् many Rakshasas, हनूमन्तं च Hanuman also, निहनिष्यामि dispose of.

text: हरींश्चापि हनिष्यामि संयुगे समवस्थितान् । असाधारणमिच्छामि तव दातुं महद्यशः ॥६-६३-५०॥
translation: "I will remain steady in the battlefield and devour monkeys also. I wish to confer an unusual and great glory on you."
word_meanings: समवास्थिवान् remain steady, संयुगे in the battlefield, हरीन् च अपि even monkeys also, हनियिष्यामि confer, तव your, असाधारणम् unusual, महत् great, यशः glory, दातुम् confer, इच्छामि wish to.

text: यदि चेन्द्राद्भयं राजन् यदि वापि स्वयम्भुवः ॥६-६३-५१॥
translation: "Even if there is fear of Indra and Brahma that haunts you, I shall destroy them away like the sun dispels darkness. Devas will fall flat on earth when I am enraged."
word_meanings: राजन् king, इन्द्रात् with Indra, भयंयदि if there is fear, स्वयम्भुवःचापि even if there is fear with Brahma, ततः that, अहम् I, नैशम् haunts, तमः them, अंशुमानिव like Sun, नाशयिष्यामि will destroy, मयि by me, क्रुद्धे by my anger, देवाः Deva अपि also, महीतले on the earth, शयिष्यन्ते fall flat.

text: अपि देवाः शयिष्यन्ते क्रुद्धे मयि महीतले । यमं च शमयिष्यामि भक्षयिष्यामि पावकम् । आदित्यं पातयिष्यामि सनक्षत्रं महीतले ॥६-६३-५२॥
translation: "I shall quell Lord Yama also, devour fire god, make the Sun including stars fall on earth."
word_meanings: यमं च Yama also, शमयिष्यामि quell, पावकम् fire god, भक्षयिष्यामि will devour, सनक्षत्रम् including stars, आदित्यम् Sun, महीतले on the earth, पातयिष्यामि make them fall.

text: शतक्रतुं वधिष्यामि पास्यामि वरुणालयम् । पर्वतांश्चूर्णयिष्यामि दारयिष्यामि मेदिनीम् ॥६-६३-५३॥
translation: "I shall kill Indra who has done a hundred sacrifices, drink up the ocean the abode of Varuna, crush the mountains totally, and break the earth."
word_meanings: शतक्रतुम् Indra who has done hundred sacrifices, वधिष्यामि will kill, वरुणालयम् ocean the abode of god Varuna, पास्यामि will drink up, पर्वतान् mountains, चूर्णयिष्यामि will crush them totally, मेदिनीम् earth, दारयिष्यामि break.

text: दीर्घकालं प्रसुप्तस्य कुम्भकर्णस्य विक्रमम् । अद्य पश्यन्तु भूतानि भक्ष्यमाणानि सर्वशः ॥६-६३-५४॥
नन्विदं त्रिदिवं सर्वमाहारस्य न पूर्यते ॥६-६३-५५॥
translation: " All beings all over will be eaten now. For a long time Kumbhakarna was sleeping. Now you will see that the food of all the three worlds, earth, heaven and intermediate region will not be enough to fill my stomach."
word_meanings: अद्य now, सर्वशः all over, भक्ष्यमाणानि will be eaten, भूतानि beings, दीर्घकालम् for long time, प्रसुप्तस्य has been sleeping, कुम्भकर्णस्य Kumbhakarna's, विक्रमम् prowess, पश्यन्तु will see, इदम् now, सर्वम् all, त्रिदिवम् three worlds (earth, heaven and intermediate region), आहारस्य food, न पूर्यतेननु my stomach will not be filled.

text: वधेन ते दाशरथेः सुखार्हं सुखं समाहर्तुमहं व्रजामि । निहत्य रामं सह लक्ष्मणेन खादामि सर्वान् हरियूथमुख्यान् ॥६-६३-५६॥
translation: "Through the destruction of Rama, I will bring happiness to you who are worthy of happiness. I will collect Rama along with Lakshmana and all the Vanara leaders and devour all."
word_meanings: दाशरथेः son of Dasaratha, वधेन destruction of, ते you, सुखावहम् worthy of happiness, सुखम् for your happiness, समहर्तुम् will collect, अहम् I, व्रजामि in the battlefield, लक्ष्मणेनसह along with Lakshmana, रामम् Rama, निहत्य on killing, सर्वान् all, हरियूथमुख्यान् Vanara leaders, खादामि will devour.

text: रमस्व कामं पिब चाग्र्यवारुणीं कुरुष्व कृत्यानि विनीयतां ज्वरः । मया ऽद्य रामे गमिते यमक्षयं चिराय सीता वशगा भविष्यति ॥६-६३-५७॥
इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे त्रिषष्टितमः सर्गः ॥ ६३ ॥६-६३-५८॥
तदुक्तमतिकायस्य बलिनो बाहुशालिनः । कुम्भकर्णस्य वचनं श्रुत्वोवाच महोदरः ॥६-६४-१॥
translation: Hearing the words of mighty Kumbhakarna, of massive body and round arms Mahodara said.
word_meanings: अतिकायस्य of massive body, बलिनः mighty, बाहुशालिनः of wellformed shoulders, कुम्भकर्णस्य Kumbhakarna's, उक्तम् spoken, तत् that, वचनम् words, आकर्ण्य having heard, महोदरः Mahodara, उवाच said.

text: कुम्भकर्ण कुले जातो धृष्टः प्राकृतदर्शनः । अवलिप्तो न शक्नोषि कृत्यं सर्वत्र वेदितुम् ॥६-६४-२॥
translation: "Kumbhakarna! Although you are born of noble race, you are insolent, seeing your low intellect in all aspects you have no knowledge of what should be done or not to be done."
word_meanings: कुम्भकर्ण Kumbhakarna, कुले noble, जातः race, धृष्टः seeing, प्राकृतदर्शनः insolent, अवलिप्तः of low intellect, सर्वत्र all aspects कृत्यम् actions, वेदितुम् knowledge, नशक्नोषि not know what should be done.

text: न हि राजा न जानीते कुम्भकर्ण नयानयौ । त्वं तु कैशोरकाद्धृष्टः केवलं वक्तुमिच्छसि ॥६-६४-३॥
स्थानं वृद्धिं च हानिं च देशकालविभागवित् । आत्मनश्च परेषां च बुध्यते राक्षसर्षभः ॥६-६४-४॥
translation: "Ravana, a bull among Rakshasas is conversant with rules of time and place and knows his own enemies, his progress and decline also."
word_meanings: देशकालविभागवित् conversant with rules of time and place, राक्षसर्षभः bull among Rakshasas, आत्मनः च his own, परेषां च enemies also, स्थानम् place, वृद्धिं च progress, हानिं च and decline also, बुध्यते knows.

text: यत्तु शक्यं बलवता कर्तुं प्राकृतबुद्धिना । अनुपासितवृद्धेन कः कुर्यात्तादृशं बुधः ॥६-६४-५॥
translation: " A strong person of unsophisticated intellect, who is progressive, a knower of everything will do such a task which is not possible to do?"
word_meanings: बलवता strong, प्राकृतबुद्धिना of unsophisticated intellect, अनुपासितवृद्धेन who is progressive, यत् such, अशक्यम् not possible, तादृशम् knower of everything, कः how, नरः a person, कुर्यात् will do.

text: यांस्तु धर्मार्थकामांस्त्वं ब्रवीषि पृथगाश्रयान् । अनुबोद्धुं स्वभावे तान्नहि लक्षणमस्ति ते ॥६-६४-६॥
translation: "The virtues, worldly gain and sensuous pleasures give results separately as you said. They are incompatible with what you said and that it is its nature you said. what is the proof?"
word_meanings: त्वम् you, यान् such, धर्मार्थकामान् virtue worldly gain and sensuous pleasures, पृथगाश्रयान् separately as incompatible, ब्रवीषि told, तान् such qualities, स्वभावेन in their true nature, अवबोद्धुम् known, लक्षणम् qualities, नास्तिहि not exist.

text: कर्म चैव हि सर्वेषां कारणानां प्रयोजकम् । श्रेयः पापीयसां चात्र फलं भवति कर्मणाम् ॥६-६४-७॥
translation: " Actions alone are the means of happiness. Being so how can sinful actions accrue good results?"
word_meanings: सर्वेषाम् for all, कारणानाम् means, कर्मचै action alone, प्रयोजकंहि happiness, अत्र and that, पापीयसाम् sinful, कर्मणां च actions also, श्रेयः good, फलम् result, भवति will accrue.

text: निश्श्रेयसफलावेव धर्मार्थावितरावपि । अधर्मानर्थयोः प्राप्तिः फलं च प्रत्यवायिकम् ॥६-६४-८॥
translation: " All virtues and worldly pleasures and even otherwise give only benefit. But if done with disinterest and unrighteousness it can give a result which is other than prosperity."
word_meanings: धर्मार्थौ virtues and worldly pleasures, इतरौअपि even other, निश्श्रेयसफलौएव only give benefit, अधर्मानर्थयोः if done in unrighteous manner with disinterest, प्रत्यवायिकम् other than prosperity, फलं च the result also, प्राप्तम् will give.

text: एहलौकिकपारत्रं कर्म पुम्भिर्निषेव्यते । कर्माण्यपि तु कल्याणि लभते काममास्थितः ॥६-६४-९॥
translation: " All beings reap the fruit of their actions in this world as well as in other worlds. He, who remains to be pleasure seeking, devoted to actions will receive blessings and attain pleasures in this life only (not here after)."
word_meanings: पुम्भिः men, ऐहलौकिकपारक्यम् the fruit of actions in this world and the other world, कर्म action, निषेव्यते remains, कामम् pleasure seeking, आस्थितः will reap,कल्यानि blessings, कर्माण्यपितु devoted to actions, लभते attain pleasures.

text: तत्र क्लृप्तमिदं राज्ञा हृदि कार्यं मतं च नः । शत्रौ हि साहसं यत् स्यात् किमिवात्रापनीयताम् ॥६-६४-१०॥
translation: " At that time the king intended in his heart (to abduct Sita), and we approved his action, and it was done. What is wrong in doing such a courageous action against an enemy?"
word_meanings: तत्र then, राज्ञा king, हृदि in heart, इदम् these, कार्यम् actions, कृतम् done, नः च also approved by us, मतम् opinion, शत्रौ enemy, यत् such, साहसम् courageous, तत् that action, अत्र and then, किम् अपनीयते w hat is wrong in that.

text: एकस्यैवाभियाने तु हेतुर्यः प्रकृतस्त्वया । तत्राप्यनुपपन्नं ते वक्ष्यामि यदसाधु च ॥६-६४-११॥
translation: "You have set out alone (for war) and the reason adduced by you is ill conceived and improper. I shall tell you."
word_meanings: एकस्यैव you alone, अभियाने set out, त्वया by you, यः that, हेतुः reason, कथितः adduced, तत्रापि by you, यत् that, अनुपपन्नम् illconceived असाधु च improper, ते to you, वक्ष्यामि will reveal.

text: येन पूर्वं जनस्थाने बहवो ऽतिबला हताः । राक्षसा राघवं तं त्वं कथमेको जयिष्यसि ॥६-६४-१२॥
translation: "How is it possible for you single handed to win Raghava of exceeding might, who killed many Rakshasas in the past at Janasthana?"
word_meanings: पूर्वम् in the past, जनस्थाने Janasthana, येन he who, अतिबलाः exceeding might, बहवः many, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, हताः killed, तम् him, राघवम् Raghava, त्वम् you, एकः single handed, कथम् how, जयिष्यसि won.

text: ये पुरा निर्जितास्तेन जनस्थाने महौजसः । राक्षसांस्तान् पुरे सर्वान् भीतानद्यापि पश्यसि ॥६-६४-१३॥
translation: "Look! Those highly energetic Rakshasas, who were won by Rama at Janasthana are scared of him even now."
word_meanings: पुरा earlier, जनस्थाने at Janasthana, महौजसः highly energetic, ये those, निर्जिताः won, भीतान् scared, सर्वान् all, तान् राक्षसान् those Rakshasas, अद्यापि even now, पुरे earlier, पश्यसि look.

text: तं सिंहमिव सङ्क्रुद्धं रामं दशरथात्मजम् । सर्पं सुप्तमिवाबुध्य प्रबोधयितुमिच्छसि ॥६-६४-१४॥
translation: "Do you desire to awaken Rama, who is like an enraged lion knowingly, who is like a sleeping snake?"
word_meanings: सङ्क्रुद्धम् enraged, सिंहमिव like lion, दशरथात्मजम् Dasaratha's son, तंरामम् that Rama, सुप्तम् इव like sleeping, सर्पम् snake, बुद्ध्य knowingly, प्रबोधयितुम् to awaken, इच्छसि do you desire.

text: ज्वलन्तं तेजसा नित्यं क्रोधेन च दुरासदम् । कस्तं मृत्युमिवासह्यमासादयितुमर्हति ॥६-६४-१५॥
translation: "Who can dare to approach Rama, who is difficult to encounter, unbearable and burning in anger like the spirit of death."
word_meanings: तेजसा burning, नित्यम् ever, ज्वलन्तम् burning, क्रोधेन in anger, दुरासदम् difficult to encounter, मृत्युमिव like spirit of death, असह्यम् unbearable, तम् him, कः who, आसादयितुम् approach, अर्हति be able.

text: संशयस्थमिदं सर्वं शत्रोः प्रतिसमासने । एकस्य गमनं तत्र नहि मे रोचते भृशम् ॥६-६४-१६॥
translation: "Face to face with the enemy this total army will be in danger. You're going alone is certainly not desirable."
word_meanings: शत्रोः enemy, प्रतिसमासने face to face, इदंसर्वम् all army, संशयस्थम् will be in danger, एकस्य going alone, तत्र there, गमनम् going, मे to me, भृशम् certainly, न रोचतेहि not desirable.

text: हीनार्थः सुसमृद्धार्थं को रिपुं प्राकृतं यथा । निश्चित्य जीवितत्यागे वशमानेतुमिच्छति ॥६-६४-१७॥
translation: "How can a weak person desire to go to the enemy who is rich in resources, determined to sacrifice his life several times and submit himself?"
word_meanings: हीनार्थस्तु one who is weak, कः who, जीवितत्यागे sacrifice life, निश्चित्य determined, समृद्धार्थम् rich in resources, रिपुम् to the enemy, प्राकृतंयथा like a common enemy, वशम् submit, अनेतुम् to go several times, इच्छति desires.

text: यस्य नास्ति मनुष्येषु सदृशो राक्षसोत्तम । कथमाशंससे योद्धुं तुल्येनेन्द्रविवस्वतोः ॥६-६४-१८॥
translation: "O Best of Rakshasas! How would you enter into combat with one who is great among all human beings and while even Indra and Sun God are not equal to him in war?"
word_meanings: राक्षसोत्तम best of Rakshasas, यस्य his, सदृशः great, मनुष्येषु of all the human beings, नास्ति not, इन्द्रविवस्वतोः Indra and Sun god, तुल्येन equal, योद्धुम् in war, कथम् how, आशंससे enter into combat.

text: एवमुक्त्वा तु संरब्धः कुम्भकर्णं महोदरः । उवाच रक्षसां मध्ये रावणं लोकरावणम् ॥६-६४-१९॥
translation: Mahodara having spoken to agitated Kumbhakarna in the midst of Rakshasas in this way, submitted to Ravana, who makes people cry.
word_meanings: महोदरः Mahodara, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, मध्ये midst, सम्रब्दम् agitated, कुम्भकर्णम् to Kumbhakarna, एवम् in this way, उक्त्वा having spoken, लोकरावणम् one who makes people cry, रावणम् Ravana, उवाच replied.

text: लब्ध्वा पुनस्त्वं वैदेहीं किमर्थं सम्प्रजल्पसि । यदीच्छसि तदा सीता वशगा ते भविष्यति ॥६-६४-२०॥
translation: "Having got Vaidehi, why are you talking like that? Sita will submit to you if you desire."
word_meanings: पुनस्तात् again, त्वम् you, वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, लब्ध्वा having got, किम् why, सम्प्रजल्पसि talking so, इच्छसियदि desire so, तदा then, सीता Sita, ते you, वशगा submit to, भविष्यति will.

text: दृष्टः कश्चिदुपायो मे सीतोपस्थानकारकः । रुचिरश्चेत् स्वया बुद्ध्या राक्षसेश्वर तं शृणु ॥६-६४-२१॥
translation: "O King of Rakshasas! A means of bringing her round is known to me. Listen, think over with your intellect."
word_meanings: राक्षसेन्द्र king of Rakshasas, सीतपस्थानकारकः a way of bringing her round, कश्चित् see, उपायः means, मे to me, दृष्टः see, स्वया yourself, बुध्या knowing, रुचितःचेत् like it with your intellect, तम् you may, शृणु listen.

text: अहं द्विजिह्वः संह्रादी कुम्भकर्णो वितर्दनः । पञ्च रामवधायैते निर्यान्तीत्यवघोषय ॥६-६४-२२॥
translation: "You pronounce that I, Dwijihva, Samhradri, Kumbhakarna and Vitardana, five of us will go forth to kill Rama."
word_meanings: अहम् I, द्विजिह्वः Dwijihva, सम्ह्रादी Samhradri, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, वितर्दनः Vitardana, एते all these, पञ्च five, रामवधाय for killing Rama, निर्यान्तु decided, इति this, अवघोषय pronounce.

text: ततो गत्वा वयं युद्धं दास्यामस्तस्य यत्नतः । जेष्यामो यदि ते शत्रून्नोपायैः कृत्यमस्ति नः ॥६-६४-२३॥
translation: "Thereafter, proceeding forth we shall try to win your enemy. If we win, there will be no purpose for you to do any action."
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, वयम् you, गत्वा proceeding, यत्नतः make effort, तस्य his, युद्धम् war, दास्यामः win over, ते to you, शत्रून् with enemy, जेष्यामःयदि if we win, नः no, उपायैः means, कृत्यम् to do any action, नास्ति will not be.

text: अथ जीवति नः शत्रुर्वयं च कृतसंयुगाः । ततस्तदभिपत्स्यामो मनसा यत् समीक्षितम् ॥६-६४-२४॥
translation: "If our enemy survives in combat, we too will survive and review as we planned and see."
word_meanings: थ if, नः not, शत्रुः enemy, जीवति survives, कृतसम्युगाः in the combat, वयं च we too, ततः that, मनसा mind, यत् like that, समीक्षितम् will review, तदभिपत्स्यामः we will see.

text: वयं युद्धादिहैष्यामो रुधिरेण समुक्षिताः । विदार्यं स्वतनुं बाणै रामनामाङ्कितैः शितैः ॥६-६४-२५॥
translation: "Bathed in blood, wounded by the arrows marked with Rama's name, bodies torn cruelly we will come here from war."
word_meanings: वयम् we, रामनामाङ्कितैः marked with Rama's name, बाणैः arrows, शितैः torn, स्वतनुम् our bodies, विदार्य cruelly, रुधिरेण blood, समुक्षिताः wounded, युद्धात् from war, इहे here, एष्यामः will come.

text: भक्षितो राघवो ऽस्माभिर्लक्ष्मणश्चेति वादिनः । तव पादौ ग्रहीष्यामस्त्वं नः कामं प्रपूरय ॥६-६४-२६॥
translation: "We too will hold your feet saying 'Rama and Lakshmana have been devoured by us'. Then you will grant our desires."
word_meanings: अस्माभिः we too, राघवः Raghava, लक्ष्मणश्च Lakshmana's, भक्षितः devoured, इति thus, वादिनः saying, तव your, पादौ feet, ग्रहीष्यावः holding, त्वम् your, नः not, कामम् desires, प्रपूरय grant.

text: ततो ऽवघोषय पुरे गजस्कन्धेन पार्थिव । हतो रामः सह भ्रात्रा ससैन्य इति सर्वतः ॥६-६४-२७॥
translation: "Thereafter mounted on elephant backs all over the city will make a rakshasa pronounce that Rama accompanied by his brother are killed."
word_meanings: पार्थिव ruler of the earth, ततः thereafter, ससैन्यः that army, रामः Rama, भ्रात्रासह accompanied by brother, हतः killed, इति here, पुरे city, सर्वतः all over, गजस्कन्धे mounted on elephant back, अवघोषय pronounce.

text: प्रीतो नाम ततो भूत्वा भृत्यानां त्वमरिन्दम । भोगांश्च परिवारांश्च कामांश्च वसु दापय ॥६-६४-२८॥
translation: "O tamer of enemies! In the name of expression of happiness, thereafter gift items of enjoyment to the attendants, and companions and granting wealth as per their desire.
word_meanings: अरिन्दम tamer of enemies, त्वम् you, प्रीतोनाम in the name of happiness, भूत्वा servants, ततः after that, भृत्यानाम् to the servants, भोगान् च items of enjoyment, परिवारांश्च to the companions, कामांश्च as per their desire, वसुदापय granting wealth

text: ततो माल्यानि वासांसि वीराणामनुलेपनम् । पेयं च बहु योधेभ्यः स्वयं च मुदितः पिब ॥६-६४-२९॥
translation: "Thereafter give your warriors, garlands, cosmetics and many drinks and drink yourself happily."
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, माल्यानि garland s, वीराणाम् warriors, अनुलेपनम् cosmetics, बहु many, योधेभ्यः give, पेयम् drinks, स्वयम् yourself, मुदितः happy, पिब drink.

text: ततो ऽस्मिन् बहुलीभूते कौलीने सर्वतो गते । भक्षितः ससुहृद्रामो राक्षसैरिति विश्रुते ॥६-६४-३०॥
translation: Thereafter, when the scandal that Rama and Lakshmana with all his friends have been devoured is widely spread everywhere, approaching Sita privately, restoring confidence and consoling her, tempt her with offering wealth, grain and gems and conciliate.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, ससुहृत् Lakshmana and friends, रामः Rama, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, भक्षितः devoured, इति this, अस्मिन् other, बहुलीभूते spread, कौलीने sc and al, सर्वतोग e very where, विश्रुते widely, त्वम् you, प्रविश्य entering, सीताम् to Sita, आश्वास्य consoling, रहसि privately, सान्त्वय restoring confidence, एनाम् in that way, धनधान्यैश्च grain and wealth, कामैश्च tempting, रत्नैश्च gems, प्रलोभय conciliate.

text: प्रविश्याश्वास्य चापि त्वं सीतां रहसि सान्त्वय । धनधान्यैश्च कामैश्च रत्नैश्चैनां प्रलोभय ॥६-६४-३१॥
translation: Thereafter, when the scandal that Rama and Lakshmana with all his friends have been devoured is widely spread everywhere, approaching Sita privately, restoring confidence and consoling her, tempt her with offering wealth, grain and gems and conciliate.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, ससुहृत् Lakshmana and friends, रामः Rama, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, भक्षितः devoured, इति this, अस्मिन् other, बहुलीभूते spread, कौलीने sc and al, सर्वतोग e very where, विश्रुते widely, त्वम् you, प्रविश्य entering, सीताम् to Sita, आश्वास्य consoling, रहसि privately, सान्त्वय restoring confidence, एनाम् in that way, धनधान्यैश्च grain and wealth, कामैश्च tempting, रत्नैश्च gems, प्रलोभय conciliate.

text: अनयोपधया राजन् भयशोकानुबन्धया । अकामा त्वद्वशं सीता नष्टनाथा गमिष्यति ॥६-६४-३२॥
translation: "O King! By conjuring her like this, helpless Sita overtaken by fear and sorrow having lost her husband will submit to you in spite of no desire to you."
word_meanings: राजन् king, भयशोकानुबन्धया overtaken by fear and sorrow, अनया helpless, उपधया by conjuring, नष्टनाथाः having lost husband, सीता Sita, अकामा having no desire, त्वद्वशम् submit to you, भविष्यति will be

text: रञ्जनीयं हि भर्तारं विनष्टमवगम्य सा । नैराश्यात् स्त्रीलघुत्वाच्च त्वद्वशं प्रतिपत्स्यते ॥६-६४-३३॥
translation: "Her charming husband ceased to live and thinking of no alternate, being a fickle woman, will accept your dependence."
word_meanings: सा she, रञ्जनीयम् charming, भर्तारम् husband, विनष्टम् ceased, अवगम्य thinking, नैराश्यात् with no alternative, स्त्रीलघुत्वाच्च fickle being woman, त्वद्वशम् accept, प्रतिपत्स्यते your dependence.

text: सा पुरा सुखसंवृद्धा सुखार्हा दुःखकर्शिता । त्वय्यधीनं सुखं ज्ञात्वा सर्वथोपगमिष्यति ॥६-६४-३४॥
translation: "That Sita having grown up in much comfort, deserved felicity. Tormented with grief, desperate, depending on you alone for happiness, will submit to you completely."
word_meanings: पुरा in the past, सुखसम्वृद्धा grew up with much comfort, सुखार्हा deserved felicity, दुःखकर्शिता tormented with grief, सा she, सुखम् happiness, त्वयि you alone, अधीनम् desperate, ज्ञात्वा knowing, सर्वधा always, उपगमिष्यति will submit to your will.

text: एतत् सुनीतं मम दर्शनेन रामं हि दृष्ट्वैव भवेदनर्थः । इहैव ते सेत्स्यति मोत्सुको भूर्महानयुद्धेन सुखस्य लाभः ॥६-६४-३५॥
translation: "To me this is the best course. As soon as you see Rama, do not be eager for war. It is meaningless. Great gain will accrue to you from here."
word_meanings: एतत् this, मम to me, दर्शने by witnessing, सुनीतम् best course, रामम् Rama, दृष्टवैव as soon as you see, अनर्थः meaningless, भवेत् हि will be, ते to you, अयुद्धेन war, सुखस्य best, महान् great, लाभः gain, इहैव from here, सेत्स्यति accrue, उत्सुकः eager, माभूः do not be.

text: अदृष्टसैन्यो ह्यनवाप्तसंशयो रिपूनयुद्धेन जयन् नराधिपः । यशश्च पुण्यं च महन्महीपते श्रियं च कीर्तिं च चिरं समश्नुते ॥६-६४-३६॥
translation: "O Lord of the people! If a king conquers his enemy without any loss of army, without facing any dangerand without war, such a mighty ruler of the earth will indeed earn fame and merit and attain prosperity." ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेचतुष्षष्टितमस्सर्गः।। This is the end of the sixty fourth sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: जनाधिप Lord of the people, अनष्टसैन्यः without any loss of army, अनवाप्तसंशयः without facing any danger, अयुद्धेन without war, रिपून् enemy, जयन् win, महीपतिः king of the earth, महत् great, यशश्च fame, पुण्यं च and merit, श्रियं च prosperity, कीर्तिं च indeed, चिरम् ever, अश्नुते will attain.

text: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे चतुष्षष्ठितमः सर्गः ॥ ६४ ॥६-६४-३७॥
अद्य पर्वतसङ्काशं ससूर्यमिव तोयदम् । विकीर्णं पश्य समरे सुग्रीवं प्लवगोत्तमम् ॥६-६४-३८॥
कथं त्वं राक्षसैरेभिर्मया च परिरक्षितः । जिघांसुभिर्दाशरथिं वध्यसे त्वमिहानघ ॥६-६४-३९॥
अथ पूर्वं हते तेन मयि त्वां हन्ति राघवः । नाहमात्मनि सन्तापं गच्छेयं राक्षसाधिप ॥६-६४-४०॥
कामं त्विदानीमपि मां व्यादिश त्वं परन्तप । न परः प्रेषणीयस्ते युद्धायातुलविक्रम ॥६-६४-४१॥
अहमुत्सादयिष्यामि शत्रूंस्तव महाबल ॥६-६४-४२॥
यदि शक्रो यदि यमो यदि पावकमारुतौ । तानहं योधयिष्यामि कुबेरवरुणावपि ॥६-६४-४३॥
गिरिमात्रशरीरस्य शितशूलधरस्य मे । नर्दतस्तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रस्य बिभीयाच्च पुरन्दरः ॥६-६४-४४॥
अथवा त्यक्तशस्त्रस्य मृद्नतस्तरसा रिपून् । न मे प्रतिमुखे स्थातुं कश्चिच्छक्तो जिजीविषुः ॥६-६४-४५॥
नैव शक्त्या न गदया नासिना निशितैः शरैः । हस्ताभ्यामेव संरब्धो हनिष्याम्यपि वज्रिणम् ॥६-६४-४६॥
यदि मे मुष्टिवेगं स राघवो ऽद्य सहिष्यते । ततः पास्यन्ति बाणौघा रुधिरं राघवस्य तु ॥६-६४-४७॥
चिन्तया बाध्यसे राजन् किमर्थं मयि तिष्ठति । सो ऽहं शत्रुविनाशाय तव निर्यातुमुद्यतः ॥६-६४-४८॥
मुञ्च रामाद्भयं राजन् हनिष्यामीह संयुगे । राघवं लक्ष्मणं चैव सुग्रीवं च महाबलम् । हनुमन्तं च रक्षोघ्नं लङ्का येन प्रदीपिता ॥६-६४-४९॥
हरींश्चापि हनिष्यामि संयुगे समवस्थितान् । असाधारणमिच्छामि तव दातुं महद्यशः ॥६-६४-५०॥
यदि चेन्द्राद्भयं राजन् यदि वापि स्वयम्भुवः ॥६-६४-५१॥
अपि देवाः शयिष्यन्ते क्रुद्धे मयि महीतले । यमं च शमयिष्यामि भक्षयिष्यामि पावकम् । आदित्यं पातयिष्यामि सनक्षत्रं महीतले ॥६-६४-५२॥
शतक्रतुं वधिष्यामि पास्यामि वरुणालयम् । पर्वतांश्चूर्णयिष्यामि दारयिष्यामि मेदिनीम् ॥६-६४-५३॥
दीर्घकालं प्रसुप्तस्य कुम्भकर्णस्य विक्रमम् । अद्य पश्यन्तु भूतानि भक्ष्यमाणानि सर्वशः ॥६-६४-५४॥
नन्विदं त्रिदिवं सर्वमाहारस्य न पूर्यते ॥६-६४-५५॥
वधेन ते दाशरथेः सुखार्हं सुखं समाहर्तुमहं व्रजामि । निहत्य रामं सह लक्ष्मणेन खादामि सर्वान् हरियूथमुख्यान् ॥६-६४-५६॥
रमस्व कामं पिब चाग्र्यवारुणीं कुरुष्व कृत्यानि विनीयतां ज्वरः । मया ऽद्य रामे गमिते यमक्षयं चिराय सीता वशगा भविष्यति ॥६-६४-५७॥
इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे त्रिषष्टितमः सर्गः ॥ ६३ ॥६-६४-५८॥
स तथोक्तस्तु निर्भर्त्स्य कुम्भकर्णो महोदरम् । अब्रवीद्राक्षसश्रेष्ठं भ्रातरं रावणं ततः ॥६-६५-१॥
translation: Kumbhakarna having heard Mahodara, warned him not to speak that way and spoke to Ravana, the foremost of Rakshasas.
word_meanings: तथा in that way, उक्तः having said, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, महोदरम् to Mahodara, निर्भर्त्स्य warned, ततः then, राक्षसश्रेष्ठम् foremost of Rakshasas, रावणम् to Ravana, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: सो ऽहं तव भयं घोरं वधात्तस्य दुरात्मनः । रामस्याद्य प्रमार्जामि निर्वैरो हि सुखी भव ॥६-६५-२॥
translation: "You know me. I will get rid of your enmity killing the cruel minded Rama. Be fearless and happy now."
word_meanings: सःअहम् you, my, दुरात्मनः cruel minded, तस्यरामस्य that Rama's, वधात् with killing, तव your, घोरम् dreadful, भयम् fear, अद्य now, प्रमार्जामि will get rid of, निर्वैरः enmity, सुखी happily, भव you be.

text: गर्जन्ति न वृथा शूरा निर्जला इव तोयदाः । पश्य सम्पाद्यमानं तु गर्जितं युधि कर्मणा ॥६-६५-३॥
translation: "Warriors will not roar wastefully like waterless clouds. You will see me roaring after having completed the action."
word_meanings: शूराः warriors, निर्जलाः waterless, तोयदाःइव cloud like, वृथा wasteful, न गर्जन्ति not roar, युधि in war, कर्मणा action, सम्पद्यमानम् having completed, गर्जितम् will roar, पश्य see.

text: न मर्षयति चात्मानं सम्भावयति नात्मना । अदर्शयित्वा शूरास्तु कर्म कुर्वन्ति दुष्करम् ॥६-६५-४॥
translation: "Warriors do not tolerate even when glorified. They never praise themselves. They accomplish difficult deeds without displaying them."
word_meanings: शूराः warriors, आत्मानम् themselves, न आत्मना not themselves, सम्भावयतिम् glorify, न मर्षयन्ति not seek, अदर्शयित्वा without displaying, दुष्करम् difficult to accomplish, कर्म action, कुर्वन्ति will do.

text: विक्लवानामबुद्धीनां राज्ञा पण्डितमानिनाम् । शृण्वता सादितमिदं त्वद्विधानां महोदर ॥६-६५-५॥
translation: "O Mahodara! Your words of appeal will be accepted as cowardly, devoid of intellect and to those who do not know anything, it looks as if you know."
word_meanings: महोदर Mahodara, विक्लबानाम् cowardly, पण्डितमानिनाम् devoid of intellect, अबुद्धीनाम् not knowing anything, त्वद्विधानाम् as if knowing, श्रृण्वता on hearing, इदं this, सादितम् appeal.

text: युद्धे कापुरुषैर्नित्यं भवद्भिः प्रियवादिभिः । राजानमनुगच्छद्भिः कृत्यमेतद्धि सादितम् ॥६-६५-६॥
translation: "You, who always fear in combat, are talking pleasingly to the king , going after him happily brought the matter to this state."
word_meanings: युद्धे in combat, कापुरुषैः those men, नित्यम् ever, प्रियवादिभिः pleasing in talk, राजानम् to king, अनुगच्छद्भिः after going, भवद्भिः you also, सर्वम् all, कृत्यम् task, मोद्धि happy, सादितम् brought it to this state.

text: राजशेषा कृता लङ्का क्षीणः कोशो बलं हतम् । राजानमिममासाद्य सुहृच्चिह्नममित्रकम् ॥६-६५-७॥
translation: "The king is left alone in Lanka, which is divested of its wealth, and treasury reduced, and the army destroyed by unfriendly people pretending as good friends around him."
