word_meanings: निर्याताः determined, महात्मानः great Rakshasas, युद्धदुर्मदाः fierce in combat, जगर्जुश्च roaring, प्रणेदुश्च shouted loudly, सायकान् arrows, चिक्षिपुश्च discharged, जगृहुः च went.

text: क्ष्वेलितास्फोटनिनदैश्चचाल च वसुन्धरा । रक्षसां सिंहनादैश्च पुस्फोटेव तदा ऽम्बरम् ॥६-६९-४०॥
translation: By the sound of their clapping of arms and their lion roar it was as though the sky was breaking and the earth was shaking.
word_meanings: क्ष्वेळिडितास्फोटितः by the sound of clapping of arms, रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, सिंहनादैः lion roar, संस्फोटितइव as though breaking like अम्बरम् sky, निनदैः by the roar, वसुन्दरा earth, चचाल shook.

text: ते ऽभिनिष्क्रम्य मुदिता राक्षसेन्द्रा महाबलाः । ददृशुर्वानरानीकं समुद्यतशिलानगम् ॥६-६९-४१॥
translation: Departing from there the Rakshasa army saw Vanara army ready with many rocks.
word_meanings: महाबलाः possessed of extraordinary might, ते they, राक्षसेन्ध्राः Rakshasa army, अभिनिष्क्रम्य departing from there, समुद्यतशिलानगम् ready with many rocks, वानरानीकम् Vanara army, ददृशुः witnessed.

text: हरयो ऽपि महात्मानो ददृशुर्नैर्ऋतं बलम् । हस्त्यश्वरथसम्बाधं किङ्किणीशतनादितम् ॥६-६९-४२॥
नीलजीमूतसङ्काशं समुद्यतमहायुधम् । दीप्तानलपविप्रख्यैः सर्वतो नैर्ऋतैर्वृतम् ॥६-६९-४३॥
translation: The huge monkeys also saw groups of elephants, horses and chariots and heard hundreds of bells of the chariots and Rakshasas all over like groups of dark clouds with huge weapons glowing like fire and Sun surrounded by Rakshasa army.
word_meanings: महात्मानः huge gigantic, हरयोऽपि Vanaras also, हस्त्यश्वरथसम्भाधम् groups of elephants, horses and chariots, किङ्किणीशतनादितम् sounds of hundreds of bells of the chariots, नीलजीमूतसङ्काशम् like group of dark clouds, समुद्यतमहायुधम् with huge weapons, सर्वतः all, दीप्तानलरविप्रख्यैः glowing like fire and Sun, नैरृतैः Rakshasas, वृतम् surrounded, राक्षसम् Rakshasas, बलम् army, ददृशुः saw.

text: तद् दृष्ट्वा बलमायान्तं लब्धलक्षाः प्लवङ्गमाः । समुद्यतमहाशैलाः सम्प्रणेदुर्महाबलाः । अमृष्यमाणा रक्षांसि प्रतिनर्दन्ति वानराः ॥६-६९-४४॥
translation: Seeing the Rakshasa army approaching, the monkeys found an opportunity to attack them and collected huge mountains, deadly strong trees in great joy unable to tolerate roared in return.
word_meanings: आयातम् approaching, तत् that, बलम् army, दृष्टवा seeing, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, लब्धलक्षाः found their target to attack, समुद्यतमहाशैलाः collected huge mountains, दुर्महाबला deadly strong, सम्प्रणेदुः in great joy, वानराः Vanara, रक्षांसि at Rakshasas, अमृष्यमाणाः unable to tolerate, प्रतिनर्दन्त roared in return.

text: ततः समुद्घुष्टरवं निशम्य रक्षोगणा वानरयूथपानाम् । अमृष्यमाणाः परहर्षमुग्रं महाबला भीमतरं विनेदुः ॥६-६९-४५॥
translation: There upon the Vanara leaders, endowed with extraordinary prowess, beholding the joy of Rakshasa troops, unable to bear roared dreadfully.
word_meanings: ततः there upon, उग्रमहाबलाः endowed with extraordinary prowess, रक्षोगणाः Rakshasa troop, वानरयूथपानाम् Vanara leaders, समुद्घुष्टरवम् joy of the troops, निशम्य beholding, परहर्षम् their joy, अमृष्यमाणाः unable to bear, भीमतरम् dreadfully, विनेदुः roared.

text: ते राक्षसबलं घोरं प्रविश्य हरियूथपाः । विचेरुरुद्यतैः शैलैर्नगाः शिखरिणो यथा ॥६-६९-४६॥
translation: Those monkey leaders entering dreadful Rakshasa army uplifted rocks and mountains with trees and shone.
word_meanings: ते those, हरियूथपाः monkey leaders, घोरम् dreadful, राक्षसबलम् Rakshasa army, प्रविश्य entering, उद्यतैः uplifted, शैलैः rocks, शिखरिणः peaks of mountains, नगाःयथा forest trees, विचेरुः shone.

text: केचिदाकाशमाविश्य केचिदुर्व्यां प्लवङ्गमाः । रक्षस्सैन्येषु सङ्क्रुद्धाश्चेरुर्द्रुमशिलायुधाः ॥६-६९-४७॥
translation: Some monkeys springing into the sky, while some staying on earth, with trees, rocks as weapons, enraged, ranged the Rakshasa army.
word_meanings: केचित् some, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, आकाशम् sky, आविश्य springing, केचित् some, उर्व्याम् staying on earth, सङ्कृद्धाः highly enraged, द्रुमशिलायुधाः trees and rocks as weapons, रक्षस्सैन्येषु Rakshasa army, चेरुः ranged.

text: द्रुमांश्च विपुलस्कन्धान् गृह्य वानरपुङ्गवाः । तद्युद्धमभवद् घोरं रक्षोवानरसङ्कुलम् ॥६-६९-४८॥
translation: Vanara leaders seizing huge branches of trees fought a frightening war with Rakshasas.
word_meanings: वानरपुङ्गवाः Vanara leaders, विपुलस्कन्धान् huge branches of stems, द्रुमान् च trees also, गृह्य seizing, तत् those, रक्षोवानरसङ्कुलम् Rakshasa and Vanara troops, युद्धम् war, घोरम् frightening, अभवत् happened.

text: ते पादपशिलाशैलैश्चक्रुर्वृष्टिमनूपमाम् । बाणौघैर्वायमाणाश्च हरयो भीमविक्रमाः ॥६-६९-४९॥
translation: The Vanaras of dreadful valour and unparalleled might waged with trees, rock and mountain when obstructed by the Rakshasas।।
word_meanings: बाणौघैः arrows, वार्यमाणाः heroic, भीमविक्रमाः of dreadful valour, ते those, हरयः monkeys, पादपशिलाश्शैलैः trees, rocks and mountains, अनूपमाम् unparalleled, वृष्टिम् rain, चक्रुः showered.

text: सिंहनादान् विनेदुश्च रणे वानरराक्षसाः । शिलाभिश्चूर्णयामासुर्यातुधानान् प्लवङ्गमाः ॥६-६९-५०॥
translation: The Rakshasas and Vanaras enthusiastic in the battlefield roared like lion. The Vanaras pounded the Rakshasas with rocks.
word_meanings: रणे in the battlefield, राक्षसवानराः Rakshasas and Vanaras, सिंहनादान् roaring like lions, विनेदुः enthusiastic, प्लवंवङ्गमाः Vanaras, यातुधानान् pounded, शिलाभिः rocks, चूर्णयामासुः crushed.

text: निजघ्नुः संयुगे क्रुद्धाः कवचाभरणावृतान् । केचिद्रथगतान् वीरान् गजवाजिगतानपि ॥६-६९-५१॥
translation: In the combat, the enraged Vanaras killed Rakshasas decked with shields and ornaments. Some killed the ones mounted on chariots, elephants, and horses.
word_meanings: क्रुद्धाः angered, संयुगे in combat, कवचाभरणावृतान् decked with shields and ornaments, निर्जजघ्नुः killed, केचित् some, रथगतान् seated on chariots, वीरान् heroes, गजवाजिगतानपि mounted on elephants and horses.

text: निजघ्नुः सहसा ऽ ऽप्लुत्य यातुधानान् प्लवङ्गमाः । शैलशृङ्गाचिताङ्गाश्च मुष्टिभिर्वान्तलोचनाः ॥६-६९-५२॥
translation: The Rakshasa leaders, hit by the blows of Vanaras, fell down on the mountain peaks, trembling with their eyes protruded by the blows of fists.
word_meanings: प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, वीरान् leaders, यातुधानान् troop leaders, सहसा also, निर्जघ्नुः blows, तत्र there, ते they, राक्षसपुङ्गवाः Rakshasa leaders, शृङ्गाचितांङ्गाश्च bodies covered by mountain peak, मुष्टिभिः with fists, वान्तलोचनाः eyeballs protruded, चेलुः trembled, पेतुश्च shrieked, नेदुश्च fell down.

text: चेरुः पेतुश्च नेदुश्च तत्र राक्षसपुङ्गवाः । राक्षसाश्च शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्बिभिदुः कपिकुञ्जरान् ॥६-६९-५३॥
शूलमुद्गरखड्गैश्च जघ्नुः प्रासैश्च शक्तिभिः । अन्योन्यं पातयामासुः परस्परजयैषिणः ॥६-६९-५४॥
रिपुशोणितदिग्धाङ्गास्तत्र वानरराक्षसाः । ततः शैलैश्च खड्गैश्च विसृष्टैर्हरिराक्षसैः ॥६-६९-५५॥
मुहूर्तेनावृता भूमिरभवच्छोणिताप्लुता । विकीर्णपर्वताकारै रक्षोभिररिमर्दनैः । आसीद्वसुमती पूर्णा तदा युद्धमदान्वितैः ॥६-६९-५६॥
translation: There, the battlefield was filled with mountain like forms of Rakshasas drunk with the pride of warfare, lying scattered all over.
word_meanings: तदा then, वसुमती earth, विकीर्णैः filled, पर्वताकारैः of mountain like, अभिमर्दितैः crushed, युद्धमदान्वितैः drunk pride of warfare, रक्षोभिः Rakshasas also, पूर्णा fully, आसीत् lying scattered.

text: आक्षिप्ताः क्षिप्यमाणाश्च भग्नशूलाश्च वानरैः । पुनरङ्गैस्तथा चक्रुरासन्ना युद्धमद्भुतम् ॥६-६९-५७॥
translation: Vanaras, were lifting and dropping the scattered Rakshasas, breaking the tridents and a wonderful war went on using their limbs.
word_meanings: वानरैः Vanaras, भग्नशूलाः breaking the tridents, आक्षिप्ताः lifting and dropping, क्षिप्यमाणाश्च scattered, तदा then, आसन्नाः went over, तदा then, अद्भुतम् wonderful, युद्धम् war, अङ्गैः limbs, चक्रुः carried out.

text: वानरान् वानरैरेव जघ्नुस्ते रजनीचराः । राक्षसान् राक्षसैरेव जघ्नुस्ते वानरा अपि ॥६-६९-५८॥
translation: The bull among Rakshasas struck at Vanaras with other Vanaras and the monkeys struck Rakshasas with other Rakshasas.
word_meanings: ते they, नैरृतर्षभाः bull of Rakshasas, वानरान् at Vanaras, वानरैरेव with monkeys, जघ्नुः struck, वानराः Vanaras अपि and also, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, राक्षसैरेव with Rakshasas, जघ्नुः struck.

text: आक्षिप्य च शिलास्तेषां निजघ्नू राक्षसा हरीन् । तेषां चाच्छिद्य शस्त्राणि जघ्नू रक्षांसि वानराः ॥६-६९-५९॥
translation: The monkeys struck at the Rakshasas taking the weapons left over and tearing the weapons of the Rakshasas and the Vanaras also struck the Rakshasas.
word_meanings: हरीन् monkeys, तेराक्षसाः those Rakshasas, शिलाः rocks, सेषाम् left over, आक्षिप्य taking, जघ्नुः struck, वानराः च Vanaras also, तेषाम् while they, शस्त्राणि weapons, आछचिद्य tearing, रक्षांसि Rakshasas, निजघ्नुः struck.

text: निजघ्नुः शैलशूलास्त्रैर्बिभिदुश्च परस्परम् । सिंहनादान् विनेदुश्च रणे वानरराक्षसाः ॥६-६९-६०॥
translation: In the battlefield both Vanaras and Rakshasas struck at one another with their head, rocks and swords and emitted lion roar.
word_meanings: रणे in the battlefield, वानरराक्षसा Vanaras and Rakshasas, शैलशूलान् with rocks and swords, परस्परम् one another, बिभुदुः struck, सिंहनादैः lion roar, विनेदुश्च emitted, निजघ्नु one another (with their head).

text: छिन्नवर्मतनुत्राणा राक्षसा वानरैर्हताः । रुधिरं प्रस्रुतास्तत्र रससारमिव द्रुमाः ॥६-६९-६१॥
translation: The Rakshasas killed by Vanaras, their shields and weapons broken, blood flowed from their limbs just as sap exudes from broken trees.
word_meanings: वानरैः Vanaras, हताः killed, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, छिन्नवर्णतनुत्राणाः shields and weapons broken, द्रुमाः trees, रससारम् sap exudes from stem, तत्र there, रुधिरम् blood, प्रसृताः flowed.

text: रथेन च रथं चापि वारणेनैव वारणम् ॥६-६९-६२॥
translation: In the battlefield a chariot with another chariot, an elephant with another elephant, a horse with another horse struck one another.
word_meanings: रणे in the battlefield, केचित् , some वानराः Vanaras, रथेन on chariot, रथम् another chariot, वारणेनापि elephant, वारणम् with another elephant, हयेन horse, हयम् with another horse, निजघ्नुः struck.

text: हयेन च हयं केचिन्निजघ्नुर्वानरा रणे । प्रहृष्टमनसः सर्वे प्रगृहीतमनःशिलाः ॥६-६९-६३॥
हरयो राक्षसान् जघ्नुर्द्रुमैश्च बहुशाखिभिः । तद्युद्धमभवद् घोरं रक्षोवानरसङ्कुलम् ॥६-६९-६४॥
क्षुरप्रैरर्धचन्द्रैश्च भल्लैश्च निशितैः शरैः । राक्षसा वानरेन्द्राणां चिच्छिदुः पादपान् शिलाः ॥६-६९-६५॥
translation: Rakshasas shattered the Vanara leaders with horseshoe shaped, halfmoon shaped, spear shaped sharp arrows, as well as trees and rocks.
word_meanings: राक्षसाः Rakshasa, क्षुरप्रैः horse shoe shaped, अर्धचन्द्रेःच halfmoon shaped, भल्लैश्च spear shaped heads, निशितैः sharp, शरैः arrows, वानरेन्द्राणाम् Vanara leaders, पादपान् trees, शिलाः rocks, बिभिदुः shattered.

text: विकीर्णैः पर्वताग्रैश्च द्रुमैश्छिन्नैश्च संयुगे । हतैश्च कपिरक्षोबिर्दुर्गमा वसुधा ऽभवत् ॥६-६९-६६॥
translation: The battlefield, covered with broken trees and mountains, fallen vanaras and rakshasas, seemed difficult to tread on ground.
word_meanings: संयुगे in combat, तैः they, पर्वत mountains चिनैः broken, द्रुमैः trees, हतैः killed, कपिरक्षोभिः च Vanaras and Rakshasas, विकीर्णै covered, वसुधा earth, दुर्गमा difficult to tread, अभवत् seemed.

text: ते वानरा गर्वितहृष्टचेष्टाः सङ्ग्राममासाद्य भयं विमुच्य । युद्धं तु सर्वे सह राक्षसैस्तैर्नानायुधाश्चक्रुरदीनसत्त्वाः ॥६-६९-६७॥
translation: Those Vanaras leaving behind fear, reaching the war field, rejoicing with pride, not at all depressed, carried out war with Rakshasas.
word_meanings: तेवानराः those Vanaras, सङ्ग्रामम् war field, आसाद्य reaching, गर्वितहृष्टचेष्टाः rejoicing full of pride, भयम् feared, विमुच्य leaving behind, सर्वे all, अदीनसत्त्वाः not depressed at all, नानायुधैः several kinds, राक्षसैस्सह with Rakshasas, युद्धम् war, चक्रुःस्म carried out.

text: तस्मिन् प्रवृत्ते तुमुले विमर्दे प्रहृष्यमाणेषु वलीमुखेषु । निपात्यमानेषु च राक्षसेषु महर्षयो देवगणाश्च नेदुः ॥६-६९-६८॥
translation: As the conflict progressed and tumultuous fighting was on, Vanaras were feeling exultant and seeing Rakshasas struck down the ascetics and Devatas made loud noises in joy.
word_meanings: प्रवृत्ते as the fight progressed, तस्मिन् their, तुमुले tumultuous, विमर्धे crushed, वलीमुखेषु feeling exultant, प्रहृष्यमाणेषु rejoiced, राक्षसेषु Rakshasas too, निपात्यमानेषु were being struck down, महर्षयः ascetics, देवगणाः Devatas, श्चनेदुः made loud noise.

text: ततो हयं मारुततुल्यवेगमारुह्य शक्तिं निशितां प्रगृह्य । नरान्तको वानरराजसैन्यं महार्णवं मीन इवाविवेश ॥६-६९-६९॥
translation: Then Naranthaka, mounted on horseback went at wind speed taking hold of javelin and entered Vanara army just as fish entered the ocean.
word_meanings: ततः then, नरान्तकः Naranthaka, मारुततुल्यवेगम् at wind speed, हयम् horse, आरुह्य mounting on top, निशिताम् sharp, शक्तिम् javelin, प्रगृह्य taking hold, मीनः fish, महार्णवम् इव like the ocean, वानरराजसैन्यम् Vanara kingdom army, आविवेश entered.

text: स वानरान् सप्त शतानि वीरः प्रासेन दीप्तेन विनिर्बिभेद । एकक्षणेनेन्द्ररिपुर्महात्मा जघान सैन्यं हरिपुङ्गवानाम् ॥६-६९-७०॥
translation: Great hero (Naranthaka) single handed persistently destroyed seven hundred Vanaras with his glowing spear. In that way the enemy of Indra shattered Vanara army and monkey leaders.
word_meanings: वीरः hero, महात्मा great, सः he, एकः alone, दीप्तेन glowing, प्रासेन spear, क्षणेन in a moment, सप्तशतानि seven hundred, वानरान् Vanaras, वनिर्बिभेद destroyed persistently, इन्द्ररिपुः Indra's enemy, हरिपुङ्गवानाम् monkey leaders, सैन्यम् army, जघान shattered.

text: ददृशुश्च महात्मानं हयपृष्ठे प्रतिष्ठितम् । चरन्तं हरिसैन्येषु विद्याधरमहर्षयः ॥६-६९-७१॥
translation: Vidhyadhara, the great sage, witnessed Naranthaka moving seated on the horseback firmly.
word_meanings: विद्याधरमहर्षयः sage Vidhyadhara, हयपृष्ठेप्रतिष्ठितम् seated on horseback firmly, हरिसैन्येषु monkey army too, चरन्तम् moving, महात्मानम् great, ददृशुः witnessed.

text: स तस्य ददृशो मार्गो मांसशोणितकर्दमः । पतितैः पर्वताकारैर्वानरैरभिसंवृतः ॥६-६९-७२॥
translation: On the way he saw flesh and blood fallen like a heap of a mountain covered fully with Vanaras.
word_meanings: मांसशोणितकर्दमः flesh and blood like mire, पतितैः fallen, पर्वताकारैः like a mountain in shape, वानरैः Vanaras, अभिसंवृतः covered fully, तस्य their, सःमार्गः on the way, ददृशे saw.

text: यावद्विक्रमितुं बुद्धिं चक्रुः प्लवगपुङ्गवाः । तावदेतानतिक्रम्य निर्बिभेद नरान्तकः ॥६-६९-७३॥
translation: Naranthaka went past the Vanara leaders all over even before they attempted, he destroyed them.
word_meanings: प्लवगपुङ्गवाः leaders of monkeys, विक्रमितुम् going past, यावत् all over, बुधदिम् before knowing, चक्रुः went, तावदेव before their attempt, एतान् them, अतिक्रम्य overcoming, नरान्तकः Naranthaka, निर्बिभेद destroyed.

text: ज्वलन्तं प्रासमुद्यम्य सङ्ग्रामाग्रे नरान्तकः । ददाह हरिसैन्यानि वनानीव विभावसुः ॥६-६९-७४॥
यावदुत्पाटयामासुर्वृक्षान् शैलान् वनौकसः । तावत् प्रासहताः पेतुर्वज्रकृत्ता इवाचलाः ॥६-६९-७५॥
translation: Uplifting his lance in the battle, Naranthaka consumed the Vanara troops as fire would burn up forests even before the Vanaras uprooted trees and rocks. many Vanaras fell like mountains hit by a thunderbolt.
word_meanings: विभावसुः like burning, वनानीव forests, हरिसैन्यानि Vanara army, ददाह burnt, वनौकसः Vanaras, वृक्षान् trees, शैलान् rocks, यावत everything, उत्पाटयामासुः uplifting, तावत् many, प्रासहताः lance, वज्रकृत्ताः like thunderbolt, अचलाःइव mountain like, पेतुः fell.

text: दिक्षु सर्वासु बलवान् विचचार नरान्तकः । प्रमृद्नन् सर्वतो युद्धे प्रावृट्काले यथा ऽनिलः ॥६-६९-७६॥
translation: Mighty Naranthaka, the destroyer of humans, ranged over all sides in all directions in the battlefield, like the wind in the rainy season, taking a burning spear and crushing everything.
word_meanings: नरान्तकः Naranthaka, बलवान् mighty, नरान्तकः capable of killing humans, सङ्ग्रामान्ते in the battle, ज्वलन्तम् burning, प्रासम् spear, उद्यम्य taking up, युद्धे in battle, अनिलः wind, प्रावृटकालेइव like in the rainy season, सर्वतः everything, प्रमृद्नन् crushing, सर्वासु all sides, दिक्षु directions, विचचार ranged about.

text: न शेकुर्धावितुं वीरा न स्थातुं स्पन्दितुं भयात् । उत्पतन्तं स्थितं यान्तं सर्वान् विव्याध वीर्यवान् ॥६-६९-७७॥
translation: The gallant monkeys got terrified and could not flee, nor stand, nor move. The audacious Naranthaka marching ahead pierced the Vanaras either marching or jumping or stationary.
word_meanings: वीराः gallant, र्भाषितुम् terrified, न शेकुः not flee, स्थातुम् stand, न not, स्पन्दितुम् move, भयात् out of fear, वीर्यवान् audacious, उत्पतन्तम् jumping up, स्थितम् stationary, यान्तम् marching, सर्वान् all, विव्याध pierced.

text: एकेनान्तककल्पेन प्रासेनादित्यतेजसा । भिन्नानि हरिसैन्यानि निपेतुर्धरणीतले ॥६-६९-७८॥
translation: With lance that looked like death and the spear glowing like the Sun, Naranthaka routed the Vanaras, who fell down.
word_meanings: अनन्तकल्पेन lance which was like death, एकेन alone, आदित्यतेजसा glowing like the Sun, प्रासेन spear, हरिसैन्यानि at Vanara army, भग्नानि routed, धरणीतले on the ground, निपेतुः fell.

text: वज्रनिष्पेषसदृशं प्रासस्याभिनिपातनम् । न शेकुर्वानराः सोढुं ते विनेदुर्महास्वनम् ॥६-६९-७९॥
translation: Unable to bear the very severe impact of the strike of the spear which was like the strike of thunderbolt the Vanaras cried making loud noise.
word_meanings: ते those, वानराः Vanaras, वज्रनिष्पेषसदृशम् like the strike of thunderbolt, प्रासस्य spear's, अभिनिपातनम् very severe, सोढुम् impact, न शेकुः not bear, महास्वनम् very loud voice, विनेदुः cried.

text: पततां हरिवीराणां रूपाणि प्रचकाशिरे । वज्रभिन्नाग्रकूटानां शैलानां पततामिव ॥६-६९-८०॥
translation: The forms of the monkey heroes fallen down unconscious shone like mountain peaks struck by the thunderbolt and fallen.
word_meanings: पतताम् fallen, हरिवीराणाम् monkey heroes, रूपाणि forms, वज्रभिन्नाग्रकूटानाम् like mountain peaks struck by thunderbolt, पतताम् fallen, शैलानाम् इव like mountains, प्रचकाशिरे shone.

text: ये तु पूर्वं महात्मानः कुम्भकर्णेन पातिताः । ते स्वस्था वानरश्रेष्ठाः सुग्रीवमुपतस्थिरे ॥६-६९-८१॥
translation: The Vanaras who were struck by Kumbhakarna and fallen unconscious, came and stood before Sugriva.
word_meanings: पूर्वम् earlier, ये by, महात्मानः great soul, कुम्भकर्णेन Kumbhakarna, पातिताः struck, ते those, वानरश्रेष्ठाः foremost of Vanaras, स्वस्थाः for their part, सुग्रीवम् to Sugriva, उपतस्थिरे stood before.

text: विप्रेक्षमाणः सुग्रीवो ददर्श हरिवाहिनीम् । नरान्तकभयत्रस्तां विद्रवन्तीमितस्ततः ॥६-६९-८२॥
translation: Sugriva looked around all over the monkey troops running here and there out of fear of Naranthaka.
word_meanings: विप्रेक्षमाणः looking all around, सःसुग्रीवः that Sugriva, नरान्तकभयत्रस्ताम् fear of Naranthaka, इतस्ततः here and there, विद्रवन्तीम् running, हरिवाहिनीम् monkey troops, ददर्श saw.

text: विद्रुतां वाहिनीं दृष्ट्वा स ददर्श नरान्तकम् । गृहीतप्रासमायान्तं हयपृष्ठे प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥६-६९-८३॥
translation: (Sugriva) saw the Vanaras troops running and Naranthaka seated on horseback advancing with a spear.
word_meanings: सः he, Sugriva, विद्रुताम् running, वाहिनीम् troops, दृष्टवा seeing, गृहीतप्रासम् taking hold of spear, हयपृष्ठेप्रतिष्ठितम् seated on horseback, आयान्तम् advancing, नरान्तकम् Naranthaka, ददर्श saw.

text: अथोवाच महातेजाः सुग्रीवो वानराधिपः । कुमारमङ्गदं वीरं शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमम् ॥६-६९-८४॥
translation: Sugriva, the Lord of Vanaras seeing (Naranthaka advancing) spoke to his son Angada who resembled Indra in valour.
word_meanings: महातेजाः highly energetic, वानराधिपः Lord of Vanaras, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, अथ now, वीरम् gallant, शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमम् who resembled Indra in valour, कुमारम् son, अङ्गदम् Angada, उवाच spoke.

text: गच्छ त्वं राक्षसं वीरो यो ऽसौ तुरगमास्थितः । क्षोभयन्तं हरिबलं क्षिप्रं प्राणैर्वियोजय ॥६-६९-८५॥
translation: "Oh! March ahead and immediately release the life of the Rakshasa seated on horseback terrifying the Vanara army."
word_meanings: गच्छै march, असौ Oh, तुरगम् horse, आस्थितः seated there, हरिबलम् Vanara army, त्वम् you, क्षोभयन्तम् terrifying, एनम् these, वीरः heroes, राक्षसम् Rakshasa, क्षिप्रम् immediately, प्राणैः life, वियोजय relieve.

text: स भर्तुर्वचनं श्रुत्वा निष्पपाताङ्गदस्ततः । अनीकान्मेघसङ्काशान्मेघानीकादिवांशुमान् ॥६-६९-८६॥
translation: On hearing the king's words, Angada went just as the sun rays comes out of a cluster of clouds.
word_meanings: तदा then, वीर्यवान् heroic, सःअङ्गदः that angada, भर्तुः king's, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा hearing, मेघसङ्काशात् resembling cluster of clouds, अनीकात् Sun, अंशुमानिव rays, निष्पपात comes out.

text: शैलसङ्घातसङ्काशो हरीणामुत्तमो ऽङ्गदः । रराजाङ्गदसन्नद्धः सधातुरिव पर्वतः ॥६-६९-८७॥
translation: Angada, the best of the Vanaras, adorned with arm lets resembled masses of rocks and shone like a mountain with metal streaks.
word_meanings: शैलसङ्घातसङ्काशः who resembled mass of rocks, हरीणाम् Vanaras, उत्तमः best, अङ्गदसन्नद्धः Angada adorned with armlets, अङ्गदः Angada, सधातुः metal streaks, पर्वतःइव like mountain, रराज shone.

text: निरायुधो महातेजाः केवलं नखदंष्ट्रवान् । नरान्तकमभिक्रम्य वालिपुत्रो ऽब्रवीद्वचः ॥६-६९-८८॥
translation: Brilliant Angada, unarmed only with nails and teeth (to fight) advanced towards Naranthaka and spoke these words.
word_meanings: निरायुधः deprived of any weapon, महातेजाः brilliant, केवलम् with only, नखदंष्ट्रवान् nails and teeth, वालिपुत्रः Vali's son, नरान्तकम् Naranthakam, अभिक्रम्य advancing towards, वचः words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: तिष्ठ किं प्राकृतैरेभिर्हरिभिस्त्वं करिष्यसि । अस्मिन् वज्रसमस्पर्शं प्रासङ्क्षिप ममोरसि ॥६-६९-८९॥
translation: "Stop! What can you do with these common monkeys? Throw your spear at me, which equals thunderbolt."
word_meanings: तिष्ठ stop, एभिः with these, प्राकृतैः common, हरिभिः monkeys, त्वम् you, किम् what, करिष्यसि can you do, मम me, अस्मिन् with you, वज्रसमस्पर्शम् spear equalling thunderbolt, प्रासम् spear, क्षिप throw.

text: अङ्गदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा प्रचुक्रोध नरान्तकः । सन्दश्य दशनैरोष्ठं विनिश्वस्य भुजङ्गवत् ॥६-६९-९०॥
अभिगम्याङ्गदं क्रुद्धो वालिपुत्रं नरान्तकः ॥६-६९-९१॥
प्रासं समाविध्य तदा ऽङ्गदाय समुज्ज्वलन्तं सहसोत्ससर्ज । स वालिपुत्रोरसि वज्रकल्पे बभूव भग्नो न्यपतच्च भूमौ ॥६-६९-९२॥
translation: Hearing Angada's words Naranthaka flew into a rage. Biting his lips with teeth, hissing like a serpent Naranthaka stood before Angada. He hurled his spear glowing like fire on Angada's chest violently. It struck Angada and shattered, went round, and fell.
word_meanings: नरान्तकः Naranthaka, अङ्गदस्य Angada's, वचः words, श्रुत्वा hearing, प्रचुक्रोध flew in rage, सः he नरान्तकः Naranthaka, क्रुद्धः enraged, दशनैः ten, ओष्ठम् lips, सन्दश्य biting, भुजङ्गवत् like a serpent, न्वििश्श्वस्य च hissing, वालिपुत्रम् Vali's son, अङ्गदम् Angada, अभिगम्य going forward, समुज्ज्वलन्तम् glowing like fire, प्रासम् spear, समाविध्य hurled, तदा then, अङ्गदाय Angada, सहसा violently, उत्ससर्ज chest, सः he, वज्रकल्पे struck, वालिपुत्रोरसि chest of Vali's son, भग्नःबभूव shattered, भूमौ on ground, न्यपतच्च went round and fell.

text: तं प्रासमालोक्य तदा विभग्नं सुपर्णकृत्तोरगभोगकल्पम् । तलं समुद्यम्य स वालिपुत्रस्तुरङ्गमं तस्य जघान मूर्ध्नि ॥६-६९-९३॥
translation: Then Vali's son beholding the broken and shattered spear fallen like the coils of serpent, raised his palm and struck at the head of Naranthaka's horse.
word_meanings: सःवालिपुत्रः that Vali's son, तदा then, विभग्नम् broken and fallen, सुवर्णकृत्तोरगभोगकल्पम् like the coils of the serpent, प्रासम् spear, आलोक्य beholding, तलम् palm, उद्यम्य raising, तुरङ्गमस्य at the horse, मूर्ध्नि at the head, तस्यजघान struck at.

text: निमग्नतालुः स्फुटिताक्षितारो निष्क्रान्तजिह्वो ऽचलसन्निकाशः । स तस्य वाजी निपपात भूमौ तलप्रहारेण विशीर्णमूर्धा ॥६-६९-९४॥
translation: His horse, which closely resembled a mountain, fell on the ground, its head broken, cheeks drawn in, eyeballs broken, tongue got ejected by the stroke of the palm of Angada.
word_meanings: तस्य his, अचलसन्नकाशः closely resembling mountain, सःवाजी that Angada, तलप्रहारेण by the stroke of the palm, विशीर्णमूर्धा head broken, निमग्नतालुः cheeks drawn in, स्फुटिताक्षितारः eyeballs broken, निष्क्रान्तजिह्वः tongue ejected, भूमौ on ground, निपपात fell.

text: नरान्तकः क्रोधवशं जगाम हतं तुरङ्गं पतितं निरीक्ष्य । स मुष्टिमुद्यम्य महाप्रभावो जघान शीर्षे युधि वालिपुत्रम् ॥६-६९-९५॥
translation: Observing the horse fallen, Naranthaka, endowed with great power, overcome by anger raised his fist and struck at the head of Vali's son.
word_meanings: हतम् killed, पतितम् fallen, तुरङ्गम् horse, निरीक्ष्य observing, नरान्तकः Naranthaka, क्रोधवशम् overcome by anger, जगाम went, महाप्रभावः great power, सः he, मुष्टिम् fist, उद्यम्य raising, युधि battle, वालिपुत्रम् Vali's son, शीर्षे head, जघान struck.

text: अथाङ्गदो मुष्टिविभिन्नमूर्धा सुस्राव तीव्रं रुधिरं भृशोष्णम् । मुहुर्विजज्वाल मुमोह चापि सञ्ज्ञां समासाद्य विसिष्मिये च ॥६-६९-९६॥
translation: Angada's head smashed by the blow of the fist of Naranthaka, hot blood flowed rapidly for a while. Recovering from delusion, gaining consciousness he wondered at the strength of Naranthaka.
word_meanings: अथ now, मुष्टिविशीर्णमूर्धा head smashed by the blow of the fist, अङ्गदः Angada, भृशोष्णम् burning sensation, रुधिरम् blood, तीव्रम् intensely, सुस्राव flowed rapidly, मुहुः for a while, विजज्वाल recovering, मुमोहचापि from delusion, संज्ञाम् recovering, समासाद्य consciousness, विसिष्मिये च wondered.

text: अथाङ्गदो वज्रसमानवेगं संवर्त्य मुष्टिं गिरिशृङ्गकल्पम् । निपातयामास तदा महात्मा नरान्तकस्योरसि वालिपुत्रः ॥६-६९-९७॥
translation: Angada clenching his fist, whose vehemence was equal to vehemence of death coming down from the top of the mountain peak, brought down Naranthaka.
word_meanings: अथ now, महात्मा great, वालिपुत्रः son of Vali, अङ्गदः Angada, तदा then, मृत्युसमानवेगम् equalling vehemence of death, गिरिशृङ्गकल्पम् mountain peak, मुष्टिम् fist, संवर्त्य clenching, नरान्तकस्य Naranthaka's, उपिरि top, निपातयामास brought.

text: स मुष्टिनिष्पष्टविभिन्नवक्षा ज्वालावमच्छोणितदिग्धगात्रः । नरान्तको भूमितले पपात यथा ऽचलो वज्रनिपातभग्नः ॥६-६९-९८॥
translation: Naranthaka's chest having been split by a blow on his chest, vomiting flaming blood from his throat was as if shattered by the stroke of lightning fell down like a mountain.
word_meanings: सःनरान्तकः that Naranthaka, मुष्टिनिष्पिष्टविभिन्नवक्षाः chest having been split by the blow of the fist, ज्वालाः flaming, वमन् vomit, शोणितदिग्धगात्रः blood from throat, वज्रनिपातभग्नः shattered by stroke of lightning, अचलःयथा like mountain, पपात fell.

text: अथान्तरिक्षे त्रिदशोत्तमानां वनौकसां चैव महाप्रणादः । बभूव तस्मिन्निहते ऽग्र्यवीरे नरान्तके वालिसुतेन सङ्ख्ये ॥६-६९-९९॥
translation: Naranthaka, the foremost of the heroes, having been killed in combat, the Devatas and gods of the three worlds experienced great joy.
word_meanings: अग्रवीर्ये of foremost among heroes, तस्मिन् his, नरान्तके Naranthaka, संख्ये in combat, वालिसुतेन by Vali's son, निहते killed, अथा and then, अन्तरिक्षे sky, त्रिदशोत्तमानाम् Devatas and gods of three worlds, वनौकसांचैव including Vanaras, महान् great, प्रणादः happiness, बभूव radiated.

text: अथाङ्गदो राममनःप्रहर्षणं सुदुष्करं तत् कृतवान् हि विक्रमम् । विसिष्मिये सो ऽप्यतिवीर्यविक्रमः पुनश्च युद्धे स बभूव हर्षितः ॥६-६९-१००॥
इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे एकोनसप्ततितमः सर्गः ॥ ६९ ॥६-६९-१०१॥
नरान्तकं हतं दृष्ट्वा चुक्रुशुर्नैर्ऋतर्षभाः । देवान्तकस्त्रिमूर्धा च पौलस्त्यश्च महोदरः ॥६-७०-१॥
translation: Seeing the bulls among Rakshasas Naranthaka, Devanthaka, Trisira and Mahodara a scion of Paulastya and Mahodara, killed the Rakshasas cried aloud.
word_meanings: नरान्तकम् Naranthaka, हतम् killed, दृष्टवा seeing, नैरृतर्षभाः bull among Rakshasas, देवान्तकः Devanthaka, त्रिमूर्धा च Trisira, पौलस्त्यः of Paulastya, महोदरः च and Mahodara, चुक्रुशुः cried aloud.

text: आरूढो मेघसङ्काशं वारणेन्द्रं महोदरः । वालिपुत्रं महावीर्यमभिदुद्राव वीर्यवान् ॥६-७०-२॥
translation: Mahodara who closely resembled a cloud, mounted on the best of elephants chased brave and courageous son of Vali.
word_meanings: महोदरः Mahodara, मेघसङ्काशम् resembling cloud, वारणेन्द्रम् best of elephants, आरूढः mounted, वीर्यवान् courageous, महावीर्यम् brave, वालिपुत्रम् Vali's son, अभिदुद्राव chased.

text: भ्रातृव्यसनसन्तप्तस्तथा देवान्तको बली । आदाय परिघं दीप्तमङ्गदं समभिद्रवत् ॥६-७०-३॥
translation: Then, powerful Devanthaka who was immersed in grief of his brother, taking hold of a glowing iron bar rushed forward towards Angada.
word_meanings: तदा then, भ्रातृव्यसनसन्तप्तः immersed in the grief of brother, बली powerful, देवान्तकः Devanthaka, दीप्तम् glowing, परिघम् iron bar, आदाय taking hold of, अङ्गदम् at Angada, समभिद्रवत् rushed forward.

text: रथमादित्यसङ्काशं युक्तं परमवाजिभिः । आस्थाय त्रिशिरा वीरो वालिपुत्रमथाभ्ययात् ॥६-७०-४॥
translation: Then Trisira, seated on the chariot, effulgent as the Sun, yoked to the best horse marched towards Angada.
word_meanings: अथ and then, वीरः hero, त्रिशिराः Trisira, वाजिभिः best horse, युक्तम् yoked, आदित्यसङ्काशम् effulgent as the Sun, रथम् chariot, आस्थाय taking seat, वालिपुत्रम् Vali's son, अभ्ययात् marched.

text: स त्रिभिर्देवदर्पघ्नैर्नैर्ऋतेन्द्रैरभिद्रुतः । वृक्षमुत्पाटयामास महाविटपमङ्गदः ॥६-७०-५॥
translation: Angada observed that all the three chiefs of Rakshasas, who were capable of crushing the pride of gods marching towards him and uprooted a huge tree.
word_meanings: देवदर्पघ्नेः capable of crushing the pride of gods, त्रिभिः all the three, नैरृतेन्द्रः chiefs of Rakshasas अभिद्रुतः marching towards, सः he, अङ्गदः Angada, महाविटपम् huge, वृक्षम् tree, उत्पाटयामास uprooted.

text: देवान्तकाय तं वीरश्चिक्षेप सहसा ऽङ्गदः । महावृक्षं महाशाखं शक्रो दीप्तमिवाशनिम् ॥६-७०-६॥
translation: Just as Indra took a flaming thunderbolt, Angada, the hero took hold of huge branches of trees and hurled at Devanthaka with force.
word_meanings: वीरः hero, अङ्गदः Angada, महाशाखम् huge branches, तम् those, महावृक्षम् huge tree, शक्रः branches, दीप्तम् flaming, अशनम् इव flaming thunderbolt, सहसा with force, देवान्तकाय Devanthaka, चिक्षेप hurled.

text: त्रिशिरास्तं प्रचिच्छेद शरैराशीविषोपमैः । स वृक्षं कृत्तमालोक्य उत्पपात तदा ऽङ्गदः ॥६-७०-७॥

text: स वायुसूनुः कुपितश्चिक्षेप शिखरं गिरेः । त्रिशिरास्तच्छरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्बिभेद बहुधा बली ॥६-७०-३४॥
translation: The son of the wind god in anger hurled a top of the mountain on mighty Trisira, who split the mountain into several pieces with an arrow.
word_meanings: सः he, वायुसूनुः son of wind god, कुपितः in anger, गिरेः mountain, शिखरम् top, चिक्षेप hurled, बली mighty, त्रिशिराः Trisira, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, शरैः arrow, बहूधा several pieces, बिभेद split into.

text: तद्व्यर्थं शिखरं दृष्ट्वा द्रुमवर्षं महाकपिः । विससर्ज रणे तस्मिन् रावणस्य सुतं प्रति ॥६-७०-३५॥
translation: Then seeing that the top of the mountain hurled was ineffective in that battle over Ravana's son, Hanuman discharged rain of trees.
word_meanings: तदा then, कपिः monkey, तत् that, शिखरम् top of mountain, व्यर्थम् ineffective, दृष्टवा seeing, तस्मिन् over him, रणे battle, रावणस्य Ravana's, सुतंप्रति over the son, द्रुमवर्षम् rain of trees, विससज्ज discharged.

text: तमापन्तमाकाशे द्रुमवर्षं प्रतापवान् । त्रिशिरा निसितैर्बाणैश्चिच्छेद च ननाद च ॥६-७०-३६॥
translation: Stupendous Trisira tore with his whetted arrows the rain of trees through the sky and roared.
word_meanings: प्रतापवान् stupendous, त्रिशिराः Trisira, आ पतन्तम् tore, तम् them, द्रुमवर्षम् rain of trees, निशितैः whetted, बाणैः rain, आकाशे the sky, चिच्छेद shattered, ननादच roared.

text: ततो हनूमानुत्प्लुत्य हयांत्रिशिरसस्तदा । विददार नखैः क्रुद्धो गजेन्द्रं मृगराडिव ॥६-७०-३७॥
translation: Then Hanuman also jumped up in anger and tore the horse off Trisira just as the lion would tear the lordly elephant with nails.
word_meanings: तदा then, हनुमान् तु Hanuman also, क्रुद्धः angry, उत्प्लुत्य jumping up, त्रिशिरसः at Trisira, हयम् horse, मृगराट् lion, नागेन्द्रम् इव like lordly elephant, नखैः nails, विददार tore.

text: अथ शक्तिं समादाय कालरात्रिमिवान्तकः । चिक्षेपानिलपुत्राय त्रिशिरा रावणात्मजः ॥६-७०-३८॥
translation: In the same manner, Trisira, the son of Ravana sprung up and seized a javelin, just as God of death in dark night and hurled at the son of wind god and shattered.
word_meanings: तथ in the same way, रावणात्मजः Ravana's son, त्रिशिराः Trisira, अन्तकः Death, काळरात्रिम् इव like Kalaratri (Kaala, the deity presiding over the night of dissolution) शक्तिम् javelin, समादाय seizing, अनिलपुत्राय at the son of wind god, चिक्षेप shattered.

text: दिवः क्षिप्तामिवोल्कां तां शक्तिं क्षिप्तामसङ्गताम् । गृहीत्वा हरिशार्दूलो बभञ्ज च ननाद च ॥६-७०-३९॥
translation: Hanuman, the best of monkeys, snapped the javelin flung by Trisira on him, which came down unobstructed like a meteor from heaven and the monkeys roared.
word_meanings: हरिश्रेष्ठः best of the monkeys, दिवः heaven, क्षिप्ताम् flung, उल्कामिव like a meteor, तांशक्तिम् that javelin, असङ्गताम् obstructed, गृहीत्वा taking, बभञ्ज च snapped, ननाद च and roared.

text: तां दृष्ट्वा घोरसङ्काशां शक्तिं भग्नां हनूमता । प्रहृष्टा वानरगणा विनेदुर्जलदा इव ॥६-७०-४०॥
translation: Seeing the dreadful form of shattered javelin, all Vanaras rejoiced and thundered like rain clouds.
word_meanings: घोरसङ्काशाम् dreadful form, तांशक्तिम् of that javelin, हनूमता by Hanuman, भग्नाम् shattered, दृष्टवा seeing, प्रहृष्टाःवानरगणाः all Vanaras rejoiced, जलदाःइव like the rain clouds, विनेदुः thundered.

text: ततः खड्गं समुद्यम्य त्रिशिरा राक्षसोत्तमः । निजघान तदा व्यूढे वायुपुत्रस्य वक्षसि ॥६-७०-४१॥
translation: Trisira, the foremost of Rakshasas then lifted his sword, placed it on the chest of Hanuman and dug into it.
word_meanings: राक्षसोत्तमः foremost of Rakshasas, त्रिशिराः Trisira, ततः that, व्यूढं placed, समुद्यम्य lifting up, तदा then, खडगम् sword, वायुपुत्रस्य into son of wind god, वक्षसि chest of, निजघा dug into.

text: खड्गप्रहाराभिहतो हनूमान् मारुतात्मजः । आजघान त्रिशिरसं तलेनोरसि वीर्यवान् ॥६-७०-४२॥
translation: Heroic Hanuman hit by Trisira, attacked him with his palm on the chest.
word_meanings: खडगप्रहाराभिहतः hit by sword, वीर्यवान् hero, मारुतात्मजः wind god's son, हनुमान् Hanuman, तलेन palm, तिशिरसम् Trisira, उरसि chest, आजघान attacked.

text: स तलाभिहतस्तेन स्रस्तहस्तायुधो भुवि । निपपात महातेजास्त्रिशिरास्त्यक्तचेतनः ॥६-७०-४३॥
translation: Trisira, a highly energetic one, hit by Hanuman with his palm, dropped the weapon from his hand, lost his senses and fell on the ground.
word_meanings: महातेजाः highly energetic, सःत्रिशिराः that Trisira, तेन by that, तलाभिहतः hit by palm, स्रस्तहस्तायुधः weapon dropped from hand, त्यक्तचेतनः senses lost, भुवि ground, निपपात fell.

text: स तस्य पततः खड्गं समाच्छिद्य महाकपिः । ननाद गिरिसङ्काशस्त्रासयन् सर्वनैर्ऋतान् ॥६-७०-४४॥
translation: Taking the sword from Trisira, as he was falling, the great Vanara who resembled a mountain roared, creating terror in all, surrounded there.
word_meanings: रिसङ्काशः who resembled mountain, सः he, महाकपिः great Vanara, पततः falling down, तस्य his, तंखङ्गम् that sword, अच्छिद्य taking, सर्वनारृता all those surrounded, त्रासयन् creating terror, ननाद roared.

text: अमृष्यमाणस्तं घोषमुत्पपात निशाचरः । उत्पत्य च हमूमन्तं ताडयामास मुष्टिना ॥६-७०-४५॥
translation: Unable to bear that roar, that Rakshasa got up jumping and struck Hanuman with his fist.
word_meanings: निशाचरः Rakshasa, तंघोषम् that roar, अमृष्यमाणः unable to bear, उत्पपात got up, उत्पत्य jumping, हनूमन्तम् Hanuman, मुष्टिना fist, ताडयामास struck.

text: तेन मुष्टिप्रहारेण सञ्चुकोप महाकपिः । कुपितश्च निजग्राह किरीटे राक्षसर्षभम् ॥६-७०-४६॥
translation: The great monkey hit by the fist (of Trisira) became furious and in anger he got hold of Trisira's head with crown.
word_meanings: महाकपिः great monkey, तेन by that, मुष्टिप्रहारेण by the hit with fist, सञ्चुकोप became furious, कुपितः च and angry, राक्षसर्षभम् bull among Rakshasas, किरीटे crown, निजग्राह got hold of.

text: स तस्य शीर्षाण्यसिना शितेन किरीटजुष्टानि सकुण्डलानि । क्रुद्धः प्रचिच्छेद सुतो ऽनिलस्य त्वष्टुः सुतस्येव शिरांसि शक्रः ॥६-७०-४७॥
translation: Enraged wind god's son, cut off the three heads of Trisira adorned with earrings just as Indra cut off the heads of Vishwarupa, son of Twashta.
word_meanings: क्रुद्धः enraged, सः he, अनिलस्यसुतः wind god's son, तस्य his, कीरीटजुष्टानि along with crown, सकुण्डलानि and earrings, शीर्षाणि three heads (of Vishwarupa), शक्रः Indra, त्वष्टुः Twashsta's, सुतस्य son's, शिरांसिइव three heads like that, शितेन sharp, असिना cut off, प्रचिच्छेद severed.

text: तान्यायताक्षाण्यगसन्निभानि प्रदीप्तवैश्वानरलोचनानि । पेतुः शिरांसीन्द्ररिपोर्धरण्यां ज्योतींषि मुक्तानि यथा ऽर्कमार्गात् ॥६-७०-४८॥
translation: The heads of Trisira, an enemy of Indra, resembling mountains with incongruous eyes glowing like Vyshvanara's eyes, fell into wilderness like stars fallen from the path of Sun.
word_meanings: आयताक्षाणि incongruous eyes, अगसन्निभानि resembling mountains, प्रदीप्तवैश्वानरलोचनानि glowing like Vyshvanara's eyes, इन्द्ररिपोः Indra's enemy, तानिशिरांसि those heads, अर्कमार्गात् from the path of the Sun, मुक्तानि like pearls, ज्योतींषियथा like stars, अरण्याम् wilderness, पेतुः fallen.

text: तस्मिन् हते देवरिपौ त्रिशीर्षे हनूमता शक्रपराक्रमेण । नेदुः प्लवङ्गाः प्रचचाल भूमी रक्षांस्यथो दुद्रुविरे समन्तात् ॥६-७०-४९॥
translation: Trisira, the enemy of gods, endowed with the prowess of Indra got killed by Hanuman. The earth shook, the monkeys roared and the Rakshasas from all sides took to their heels.
word_meanings: देवरिपौ enemy of gods, तस्मिन् his, त्रिशीर्षे Trisira's, शक्रपराक्रमेण endowed with the prowess of Indra, हनूमता Hanuman, हते killed, प्लवंगाः monkeys, नेदुः roared, भूमिः earth, प्रचचाल shook, अथो and, रक्षांसि Rakshasas, समन्तात् in all sides, दुद्रुविरे took to their heels.

text: हतं त्रिशिरसं दृष्ट्वा तथैव च महोदरम् । हतौ प्रेक्ष्य दुराधर्षौ देवान्तकनरान्तकौ ॥६-७०-५०॥
translation: Witnessing Trisira killed, earlier Mahodara also, Devanthaka and Naranthaka who are difficult to encounter killed, monkeys roared in joy seeing that Matta became very angry.
word_meanings: त्रिशिरसं Trisira, हतम् killed, दृष्टवा witnessing, अथापि च earlier, महोदरम् Mahodara, दुराधर्षौ difficult to encounter, देवान्तकनरान्तकौ Devanthaka and Naranthaka, हतौ killed, प्रेक्ष्य seeing, परमामर्षी roared in joy, राक्षसपुङ्गवः Rakshasa leaders, मत्तः Matta, चुकोप very angry.

text: चुकोप परमामर्षी मत्तो राक्षसपुङ्गवः । जग्राहार्चिष्मतीं घोरां गदां सर्वायसीं शुभाम् ॥६-७०-५१॥
translation: Mahaparsva seized hold of a good venerable, allpowerful mace plated with gold, smeared with flesh and blood, shining with lustre, shining red with enemy's blood, an effulgent one whose head has been glowing decorated with red flower garlands that brought terror to Airavatam, Mahapadma, and Sarvabhuama, the three elephants guarding the three of the four quarters.
word_meanings: शुभाम् good, अर्चिष्मतीम् venerable, सर्वायसीम् all powerful, हेमपरिक्षिप्ताम् plated with gold, मांसशोणितफेनिलाम् smeared with flesh and blood, विराजमानाम् shining with lustre, वपुषाम् by enemy's, शत्रुशोणितरंजिताम् shining in red colour with enemy's blood, तेजसा effulgent, संप्रदीप्ताग्राम् whose head has been glowing, रक्तमाल्यविभूषिताम् decorated with red flower garland s, ऐरावतमहापद्मसार्वभौमभयावहाम् brought terror to Airavata, Mahapadma and Sarvabhauma (three of the four elephants guarding the quarters), गदाम् mace, जग्राह seized hold of.

text: हेमपट्टपरिक्षिप्तां मांसशोणितफेनिलाम् । विराजमानां वपुषा शत्रुशोणितरञ्जिताम् ॥६-७०-५२॥
translation: Mahaparsva seized hold of a good venerable, allpowerful mace plated with gold, smeared with flesh and blood, shining with lustre, shining red with enemy's blood, an effulgent one whose head has been glowing decorated with red flower garlands that brought terror to Airavatam, Mahapadma, and Sarvabhuama, the three elephants guarding the three of the four quarters.
word_meanings: शुभाम् good, अर्चिष्मतीम् venerable, सर्वायसीम् all powerful, हेमपरिक्षिप्ताम् plated with gold, मांसशोणितफेनिलाम् smeared with flesh and blood, विराजमानाम् shining with lustre, वपुषाम् by enemy's, शत्रुशोणितरंजिताम् shining in red colour with enemy's blood, तेजसा effulgent, संप्रदीप्ताग्राम् whose head has been glowing, रक्तमाल्यविभूषिताम् decorated with red flower garland s, ऐरावतमहापद्मसार्वभौमभयावहाम् brought terror to Airavata, Mahapadma and Sarvabhauma (three of the four elephants guarding the quarters), गदाम् mace, जग्राह seized hold of.

text: तेजसा सम्प्रदीप्ताग्रां रक्तमाल्याविभूषिताम् । ऐरावतमहापद्मसार्वभौमभयावहाम् ॥६-७०-५३॥
translation: Mahaparsva seized hold of a good venerable, allpowerful mace plated with gold, smeared with flesh and blood, shining with lustre, shining red with enemy's blood, an effulgent one whose head has been glowing decorated with red flower garlands that brought terror to Airavatam, Mahapadma, and Sarvabhuama, the three elephants guarding the three of the four quarters.
word_meanings: शुभाम् good, अर्चिष्मतीम् venerable, सर्वायसीम् all powerful, हेमपरिक्षिप्ताम् plated with gold, मांसशोणितफेनिलाम् smeared with flesh and blood, विराजमानाम् shining with lustre, वपुषाम् by enemy's, शत्रुशोणितरंजिताम् shining in red colour with enemy's blood, तेजसा effulgent, संप्रदीप्ताग्राम् whose head has been glowing, रक्तमाल्यविभूषिताम् decorated with red flower garland s, ऐरावतमहापद्मसार्वभौमभयावहाम् brought terror to Airavata, Mahapadma and Sarvabhauma (three of the four elephants guarding the quarters), गदाम् mace, जग्राह seized hold of.

text: गदामादाय सङ्क्रुद्धो मत्तो राक्षसपुङ्गवः । हरीन् समभिदुद्राव युगान्ताग्निरिव ज्वलन् ॥६-७०-५४॥
translation: Matta, the Rakshasa leader became very furious and took hold of the mace glowing like fire, at the time of dissolution of the universe and scattered the monkeys.
word_meanings: सङ्कृद्धः very furious, राक्षसपुङ्गवः Rakshasa leader, मत्तः Matta, गदाम् mace, आदाय taking, ज्वलन् fire, युगान्तानगिरिव like at the time of the end of universe, हरीन् monkeys, समभिदुद्राव scattered.

text: अथर्षभः समुत्पत्य वानरो रावणानुजम् । मत्तानीकमुपागम्य तस्थौ तस्याग्रतो बली ॥६-७०-५५॥
translation: Rshaba, the bull among Vanaras endowed with prowess, springing up came and stood in front of Mahaparsva.
word_meanings: अथ and then, बली endowed with prowess, र्षभः bull, वानरः among Vanaras, उत्पत्य springing up, रावणानुजम् Ravana's brother, मत्तानीकम् Mahaparsva (Mattaneekam), उपागम्य coming near, तस्य his, अग्रतः anger, तस्थौ his, तस्याग्रतो stood in his front.

text: तं पुरस्तात् स्थितं दृष्ट्वा वानरं पर्वतोपमम् । आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो गदया वज्रकल्पया ॥६-७०-५६॥
translation: Again, seeing Rshaba standing in front like a mountain, enraged Mahaparsva hit him on the chest with the mace that was like a thunderbolt.
word_meanings: पुरस्तात् again, स्थितम् standing, पर्वतोपमम् like a mountain, वानरम् Vanara, दृष्टवा seeing, क्रुद्धः angry, वज्रकल्पया close to thunderbolt, गदया with mace, उरसि on the chest, आजघान hit.

text: स तया ऽभिहतस्तेन गदया वानरर्षभः । भिन्नवक्षाः समाधूतः सुस्त्राव रुधिरं बहु ॥६-७०-५७॥
translation: Hit in that way by the mace, Rshaba, bull of Vanaras, with chest broken, blood flowed excessively.
word_meanings: तेन by that, तया by the, गदया mace, अभिहतः hit that way, सः he, वानरर्षभः bull of Vanaras, भिन्नवक्षाः chest broken, समाधूतः moved, बहु excessively, रुधिरम् blood, सुस्राव flowed.

text: स सम्प्राप्य चिरात् सञ्ज्ञामृषभो वानरर्षभः । अबिदुद्राव वेगेन गदां तस्य महात्मनः ॥६-७०-५८॥
गृहीत्वा तां गदां भीमामाविध्य च पुनःपुनः । मत्तानीकं महात्मानं जघान रणमूर्धनि ॥६-७०-५९॥
translation: The great Rakshasa Mahaparsva went towards the mace held by Rshaba, the great soul. Taking hold of the mace, Rshaba struck the Rakshasa again and again and pierced him in the forefront of the battlefield.
word_meanings: महात्मा great, सः he, महात्मनः great soul, तस्य his, गदाम् mace, अभिदुद्राव went towards, भीमाम् dreadful, तांगदाम् that mace, गृहीत्वा taking hold, पुनःपुनः again and again, आविध्य pierced, रणमूर्धनि in the forefront of the battle, मत्तानीकम् Mattanikam, जघान struck.

text: स स्वया गदया भग्नो विशीर्णदशनेक्षणः । निपपात ततो मत्तो वज्राहत इवाचलः ॥६-७०-६०॥
translation: Shattered by his own mace, Matta (Mahaparsva), whose eyes had been crushed, had fallen like a mountain struck by lightning.
word_meanings: स्वया his own, गदया mace, भग्नः shattered by, सः he, मत्तः Matta विशीर्णदशनेक्षणः whose eyes had been crushed, तदा then, वज्राहतः struck by lightning, अचलःइव like a mountain, निपपात fallen.

text: विशीर्णनयने भूमौ गतसत्त्वे गतायुषि । पतिते राक्षसे तस्मिन् विद्रुतं राक्षसं बलम् ॥६-७०-६१॥
translation: Strength gone, life ceased, eyes crushed, his own Rakshasas fallen on the ground, the Rakshasa army fled.
word_meanings: गतसत्त्वे strength gone, गतायुषि life ceased, विदीर्णनयने eyes crushed, तस्मिन् राक्षसे his Rakshasas, भूमौ ground, पतिते fallen, राक्षसम् Rakshasa, बलम् army, विद्रुतम् ran in fear.

text: तस्मिन् हते भ्रातरि रावणस्य तन्नैर्ऋतानां बलमर्णवाभम् । त्यक्तायुधं केवलजीवितार्थं दुद्राव भिन्नार्णवसन्निकाशम् ॥६-७०-६२॥
इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे सप्ततितमः सर्गः ॥ ७० ॥६-७०-६३॥
स्वबलं व्यथितं दृष्ट्वा तुमुलं रोमहर्षणम् । भ्रातऽंश्च निहतान् दृष्ट्वा शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमान् ॥६-७१-१॥
translation: Highly energetic Atikaya, who was like a mountain in form, had huge body, obtained boons from Brahma, subdued the pride of Devas and Danavas, was equal to Indra in valour. Seeing his own army of Rakshasas that caused horripilation, uncles who were bulls among Rakshasas struck down in the battlefield and his own brothers Yuddhotama (Mahodara) and Matta (Mahaparsva) struck down, he flew in rage.
word_meanings: महातेजाः highly energetic, ब्रह्मदत्तवरः who had obtained boons from Brahma, अद्रिसङ्काशः mountain like form, युधि in battle, देवदानवदर्पहा who subdued the pride of Devas and Danavas, अतिकायः of huge body, तुमुलम् making a tumultuous sound, रोमहर्षणम् horripilation, स्वबलम् his own army, व्यथितम् killed, दृष्टवा seeing, शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमान् equal to Indra in valour, भ्रातृ़न् च brothers, निहतान् killed, दृष्टवा seeing, पितृव्वौ uncles, राक्षसर्षभौ bulls among Rakshasas, भ्रातरौ brothers, युद्धोन्मतं च Yuddhomatta, मत्तं च Matta, समरे in conflict, सन्निघादितौ collected together, सन्द्दृश्य seeing, चुकोप च was furious.

text: पितृव्यौ चापि सन्दृश्य समरे सन्निषूदितौ । युद्धोन्मत्तं च मत्तं च भ्रातरौ राक्षसर्षभौ ॥६-७१-२॥
translation: Highly energetic Atikaya, who was like a mountain in form, had huge body, obtained boons from Brahma, subdued the pride of Devas and Danavas, was equal to Indra in valour. Seeing his own army of Rakshasas that caused horripilation, uncles who were bulls among Rakshasas struck down in the battlefield and his own brothers Yuddhotama (Mahodara) and Matta (Mahaparsva) struck down, he flew in rage.
word_meanings: महातेजाः highly energetic, ब्रह्मदत्तवरः who had obtained boons from Brahma, अद्रिसङ्काशः mountain like form, युधि in battle, देवदानवदर्पहा who subdued the pride of Devas and Danavas, अतिकायः of huge body, तुमुलम् making a tumultuous sound, रोमहर्षणम् horripilation, स्वबलम् his own army, व्यथितम् killed, दृष्टवा seeing, शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमान् equal to Indra in valour, भ्रातृ़न् च brothers, निहतान् killed, दृष्टवा seeing, पितृव्वौ uncles, राक्षसर्षभौ bulls among Rakshasas, भ्रातरौ brothers, युद्धोन्मतं च Yuddhomatta, मत्तं च Matta, समरे in conflict, सन्निघादितौ collected together, सन्द्दृश्य seeing, चुकोप च was furious.

text: चुकोप च महातेजा ब्रह्मदत्तवरो युधि । अतिकायो ऽद्रिसङ्काशो देवदानवदर्पहा ॥६-७१-३॥
translation: Highly energetic Atikaya, who was like a mountain in form, had huge body, obtained boons from Brahma, subdued the pride of Devas and Danavas, was equal to Indra in valour. Seeing his own army of Rakshasas that caused horripilation, uncles who were bulls among Rakshasas struck down in the battlefield and his own brothers Yuddhotama (Mahodara) and Matta (Mahaparsva) struck down, he flew in rage.
word_meanings: महातेजाः highly energetic, ब्रह्मदत्तवरः who had obtained boons from Brahma, अद्रिसङ्काशः mountain like form, युधि in battle, देवदानवदर्पहा who subdued the pride of Devas and Danavas, अतिकायः of huge body, तुमुलम् making a tumultuous sound, रोमहर्षणम् horripilation, स्वबलम् his own army, व्यथितम् killed, दृष्टवा seeing, शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमान् equal to Indra in valour, भ्रातृ़न् च brothers, निहतान् killed, दृष्टवा seeing, पितृव्वौ uncles, राक्षसर्षभौ bulls among Rakshasas, भ्रातरौ brothers, युद्धोन्मतं च Yuddhomatta, मत्तं च Matta, समरे in conflict, सन्निघादितौ collected together, सन्द्दृश्य seeing, चुकोप च was furious.

text: स भास्करसहस्रस्य सङ्घातमिव भास्वरम् । रथमास्थाय शक्रारिरभिदुद्राव वानरान् ॥६-७१-४॥
translation: Adorned with a crown, Ravana glowing like a thousand suns collected together mounted the chariot and darted towards Vanaras.
word_meanings: शक्रारिः crowned, सः he, भासरसहस्रस्य thousand suns, सङ्घातमिव collected, भास्वरम् glowing, रथम् chariot, आस्थाय mounted, वानरान् Vanaras, अभिदुद्राव darted towards.

text: स विस्फार्य महच्चापं किरीटी मृष्टकुण्डलः । नाम विश्रावयामास ननाद च महास्वनम् ॥६-७१-५॥
translation: Adorned with crown, and polished earrings, twanging his bow, proclaimed his name and roared sounding aloud.
word_meanings: किरीटी adorned with crown, मृष्टकुण्डलः polished earrings, सः he, महा great, चापम् bow, विस्फार्य twanging,नाम name, विश्रावयामास proclaimed, महास्वनम् sounding aloud, ननाद च roared.

text: तेन सिंहप्रणादेन नामविश्रावणेन च । ज्याशब्देन च भीमेन त्रासयामास वानरान् ॥६-७१-६॥
translation: By that lionroar, and proclamation of his name (by the sound of the twang) frightening the Vanaras he struck terror.
word_meanings: तेन by that, सिंहप्रणादेन lion roar, नामविश्रावणेन च proclamation of his name, भीमेन frightening, ज्याशब्देन च by that sound, वानरान् Vanaras, त्रासयामास struck terror.

text: ते दृष्ट्वा देहमाहात्म्यं कुम्भकर्णो ऽयमुत्थितः । भयार्ता वानराः सर्वे संश्रयन्ते परस्परम् ॥६-७१-७॥
translation: Those Vanaras seeing the huge body thought, "This is Kumbhakarna, who has got up and come'. Out of fear, they sought the help of one another.
word_meanings: सर्वे all, तेवानराः those Vanaras, देहमाहात्म्यं huge body, दृष्टवा seeing, अयम् this, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, उथतितः got up and come, भयार्ताः in fear, परस्परम् one another, संश्रयन्ते sought help.

text: ते तस्य रूपमालोक्य यथा विष्णोस्त्रिविक्रमे । भयाद्वानरयूथास्ते विद्रवन्ति ततस्ततः ॥६-७१-८॥
translation: The Vanara troops, observing his form resembling the Trivikram form assumed by Vishnu, the monkey troops fled here and there in panic.
word_meanings: ते they, वानरयूधाः Vanara troops, त्रिविक्रमे Trivikrama form assumed, विष्णोःयथा by Vishnu, तस्य his, रूपम् form, आलोक्य observing, भयात् in panic, ततस्ततः here and there, विद्रवन्ति fled in panic.

text: ते ऽतिकायं समासाद्य वानरा मूढचेतसः । शरण्यं शरणं जग्मुर्लक्ष्मणाग्रजमाहवे ॥६-७१-९॥
translation: The Vanaras were deluded on reaching the huge body and went to Sri Rama to seek refuge.
word_meanings: तेवानराः those Vanaras, अतिकायम् huge body, समासाद्य reaching, मूढचेतसः deluded, आहवे sought, शरण्यम् refuge, लक्ष्मणाग्रजम् brother of Lakshmana, जग्मुः went.

text: ततो ऽतिकायं काकुत्स्थो रथस्थं पर्वतोपमम् । ददर्श धन्विनं दूराद्गर्जन्तं कालमेघवत् ॥६-७१-१०॥
translation: Then Kakutstha saw from a distance form of huge body looking like a mountain, wielding bow, rumbling like a cloud at universal destruction.
word_meanings: ततः then, काकुत्थ्सः Kakutstha, रथस्थम् on the chariot, पर्वतोपमम् looking like mountain, धवनिन wielding bow, कालमेघवत् rumbling like cloud at the time of universal destruction, गर्जन्तम् roaring, अतिकायम् huge body, दूरात् from a distance, ददर्श saw.

text: स तं दृष्ट्वा महात्मानं राघवस्तु विसिष्मिये । वानरान् सान्त्वयित्वा ऽथ विभीषणमुवाच ह ॥६-७१-११॥
translation: Raghava the great, seeing the form of a huge body, was amazed, reassured by the Vanaras, and spoke to Vibheeshana.
word_meanings: सः he, राघवस्तु Raghava, महात्मानं great self, तम् him, दृष्टवा seeing, विसिस्मिये. amazed, वानरान् Vanaras, सान्त्वयित्वा च reassuring, विभीषणम् to Vibheeshana, उवाच ह spoke.

text: को ऽसौ पर्वतसङ्काशो धनुष्मान् हरिलोचनः । युक्ते हयसहस्रेण विशाले स्यन्दने स्थितः ॥६-७१-१२॥
translation: "Who is he, the yelloweyed, resembling a mountain, seated in the broad chariot drawn by a thousand horses?"
word_meanings: पर्वतसङ्काशः resembling mountain, धनुष्मान् holding a bow, हरिलोचनः yellow eyes, हयसहस्रेण by a thousand horses, युक्ते drawn, विशाले broad, स्यन्दने chariot, स्थितः seated, असौ is, कः who.

text: य एष निशितैः शूलैः सुतीक्ष्णैः प्रासतोमरैः । अर्चिष्मद्भिर्वृतो भाति भूतैरिव महेश्वरः ॥६-७१-१३॥
translation: "Who is he in the midst, with sharp tridents and shining spears, like Maheswara surrounded by beings?"
word_meanings: यः he who, एषः that way, अर्चिष्मद्भिः in the midst, निशितैः sharp, शूलैः tridents, सुतीक्णैः shining, प्रासमुग्दरैः spears, वृतः surrounded, भूतैः beings, महेश्वरःइव like Maheswara, भाति seems.

text: कालजिह्वाप्रकाशाभिर्य एषो ऽतिविराजते । आवृतो रथशक्तीभिर्विद्युद्भिरिव तोयदः ॥६-७१-१४॥
translation: "Who is he, gleaming like the tongues of time spirit (Kala spirit), with flashes of javelins, encircled with lightning and looking like a cloud shining very bright?"
word_meanings: यः he who, एषः in that way, कालजिह्वाप्रकाशाभिः gleaming like the tongues of Kala, रथशक्तीभिः with flashes of javelins, आवृतः encircled, विद्युद्भिः lightning, तोयदःइव like a cloud, अतिविराजते shining very bright.

text: धनूंषि चास्य सज्यानि हेमपृष्ठानि सर्वशः । शोभयन्ति रथश्रेष्ठं शक्रचाप इवाम्बरम् ॥६-७१-१५॥
translation: "His bows decorated with gold on the back, are like a rainbow in the sky on all sides and makes the chariot excellent."
word_meanings: सज्जानि all bows, हेमपृष्ठानि with golden backs, धनूंषि च bows, अस्य his, रथश्रेष्ठम् excellent chariot, शक्रचापम् rainbow, अम्बरम् इव in the sky like, सर्वशः all sides, शोभयन्ति beautiful.

text: क एष रक्षश्शार्दूलो रणभूमिं विराजयन् । अभ्येति रथिनां श्रेष्ठो रथेनादित्यतेजसा ॥६-७१-१६॥
translation: "The tiger among the Rakshasas seated in the chariot is the foremost car warrior. He is illuminating the battlefield like the brightness of the Sun, resplendent like Sun 's rays. By his arrows he is illuminating the ten directions. The Rahu emblem on top of the pole of the chariot is very splendid."
word_meanings: कः he, रक्षश्शार्दूलः tiger among Rakshasas, रथिनाम् on the chariot, श्रेष्ठः foremost, एषः in that way, रणभूमिम् battlefield, विराजयन् illuminating, आदित्यतेजसा like the brightness of the Sun, रथेन on chariot, अभ्येति coming, सूर्यरमशिनभैः resplendent like Sun 's rays, बाणैः by arrows, दश ten, दिशः directions, विराजयन् illuminating, ध्वजशृङ्घप्रतिष्ठेन on top of the pole of the chariot, राहुणा by the Rahu, अभिविराजते very splendid.

text: ध्वजशृङ्गप्रतिष्ठेन राहुणा ऽभिविराजते । सूर्यरश्मिनिभैर्बाणैर्दिशो दश विराजयन् ॥६-७१-१७॥
translation: "The tiger among the Rakshasas seated in the chariot is the foremost car warrior. He is illuminating the battlefield like the brightness of the Sun, resplendent like Sun 's rays. By his arrows he is illuminating the ten directions. The Rahu emblem on top of the pole of the chariot is very splendid."
word_meanings: कः he, रक्षश्शार्दूलः tiger among Rakshasas, रथिनाम् on the chariot, श्रेष्ठः foremost, एषः in that way, रणभूमिम् battlefield, विराजयन् illuminating, आदित्यतेजसा like the brightness of the Sun, रथेन on chariot, अभ्येति coming, सूर्यरमशिनभैः resplendent like Sun 's rays, बाणैः by arrows, दश ten, दिशः directions, विराजयन् illuminating, ध्वजशृङ्घप्रतिष्ठेन on top of the pole of the chariot, राहुणा by the Rahu, अभिविराजते very splendid.

text: त्रिणतं मेघनिर्ह्रादं हेमपृष्ठमलङ्कृतम् । शतक्रतुधनुःप्रख्यं धनुश्चास्य विराजते ॥६-७१-१८॥
translation: "His bow with three curves, covered with gold, decorated, is close to a thundering cloud, casting its splendour."
word_meanings: अस्य his, त्रिणतम् curved in three places, मेघसन्नादम् close to thundering cloud, हेमवृष्ठम् golden, अलङ्कृतम् decorated, धनुः bow, प्रख्यम् casting, विराजते splendour.

text: सध्वजः सपताकश्च सानुकर्षो महारथः । चतुस्सादिसमायुक्तो मेघस्तनितनिस्वनः ॥६-७१-१९॥
translation: "His chariot with standard, flag and axletree is a great one driven by four charioteers emitting sound like the rumblings of clouds."
word_meanings: सध्वजः the standard, सपताकश्च and the flag, सानुकर्षः axletree, मेघस्तनितानि emitting sound like the rumblings of cloud, महारथः great chariot, चतुस्सादिसमायुक्तः driven by four charioteers.

text: विंशतिर्दश चाष्टौ च तूण्यो ऽस्य रथमास्थिताः । कार्मुकानि च भीमानि ज्याश्च काञ्चनपिङ्गलाः ॥६-७१-२०॥
translation: "This chariot has twenty quivers, ten frightening bows, and eight bow strings of golden colour lay arranged in the chariot."
word_meanings: विंशतिः twenty, दश च ten, अष्टौ च eight, तूण्यः quivers, भीमानि frightening, कार्मुकानि च bows, काञ्चनपिङ्गळाः golden coloured, ज्याश्च bowstrings अस्य his, रथम् chariot, आस्थिताः lay arranged.

text: द्वौ च खड्गौ रथगतौ पार्श्वस्थौ पार्श्वशोभितौ । चतुर्हस्तत्सरुयुतौ व्यक्तहस्तदशायतौ ॥६-७१-२१॥
translation: "It has two swords off our cubits and ten cubits long swords provided with hilts hanging on its sides as decoration."
word_meanings: पार्श्वस्थौ on the sides, पार्श्वशोभितौ decorating the sides, चतुर्हस्तत्सरुयुतौ measuring four cubits, व्यक्तहस्तदशायतौ ten cubits long, द्वौ two, घडगौ च swords, रथगतौ decorating it.

text: रक्तकण्ठगुणो धीरो महापर्वतसन्निभः । कालः कालमहावक्त्रो मेघस्थ इव भास्करः ॥६-७१-२२॥
translation: "Wearing red garland s round the neck, brave, like a mountain in form, dark with large mouth, like death, like sun veiled by clouds he seems."
word_meanings: रक्तकण्ठगुणः wearing red garland s around his neck, धीरः brave, महापर्वतसन्निभः as if he is a mountain, कालः death, कालमहावक्त्रः dark with large mouth, मेघस्थः veiled by cloud, भास्करःइव like Sun.

text: काञ्चनाङ्गदनद्धाभ्यां भुजाभ्यामेष शोभते । शृङ्गाभ्यामिव तुङ्गाभ्यां हिमवान् पर्वतोत्तमः ॥६-७१-२३॥
translation: "By adorning armlets, his both arms are like high peaks of Himalaya mountain shining away."
word_meanings: काञ्चनाङ्गदनद्धाभ्याम् by adorning golden armlets, भुजाभ्याम् both arms, एषः that way, तुङ्गाभ्याम् high, शृङ्गाभ्याम् peak, पर्वतोत्तमः like a mountain, हिमवान् इव like Himalaya mountain, शोभते shining.

text: कुण्डलाभ्यां तु यस्यैतद्भाति वक्त्रं शुभेक्षणम् । पुनर्वस्वन्तरगतं पूर्णं बिम्बमिवैन्दवम् ॥६-७१-२४॥
translation: "He who shines like the full moon between two Punarvasu stars, his auspicious eyes and countenance shines with both earrings."
word_meanings: शुभेक्षणम् auspicious eyes, वक्त्रम् countenance, यस्स्वैतध्बाति whose is shining, कुण्डलाभ्याम् both ear rings, पुनर्वस्वन्तरगतः between Punarvasu stars, पूर्णंबिंबमिवैंदवम् like the full moon.

text: आचक्ष्व मे महाबाहो त्वमेनं राक्षसोत्तमम् । यं दृष्ट्वा वानराः सर्वे भयार्ता विद्रुता दिशः ॥६-७१-२५॥
translation: "Oh! Vibheeshana, a mighty armed one! Show me that foremost of Rakshasas, whom all Vanaras feared and fled in all directions."
word_meanings: महाबाहो mighty armed one, यं him, दृष्टवा seeing, सर्वे all, वानराः Vanara, भयार्ताः fear, दिशः direction, विद्रुताः fled, एनम् such, राक्षसोत्तमम् foremost of the Rakshasas, त्वम् you, मे to me, आचक्ष्व show him.

text: स पृष्टो राजपुत्रेण रामेणामिततेजसा । आचचक्षे महातेजा राघवाय विभीषणः ॥६-७१-२६॥
translation: Interrogated by the highly brilliant prince Raghava, energetic Vibheeshana revealed.
word_meanings: राजपुत्रेण prince, अमिततेजसा highly brilliant, रामेण by Rama, पृष्टः interrogated, सः he, महातेजाः highly energetic, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, राघवाय to Raghava, आचचक्षे revealed.

text: दशग्रीवो महातेजा राजा वैश्रवणानुजः । भीमकर्मा महोत्साहो रावणो राक्षसाधिपः ॥६-७१-२७॥
translation: "The tenheaded and highly brilliant king Ravana, who is the brother of Vysravana, is of terrible deeds and highly exploitative."
word_meanings: दशग्रीवः tenheaded, महातेजाः highly brilliant, राजा king, वैश्रवणानुजः brother of Vysravana, भीमकर्मा of terrible deeds, महोत्साहः highly exploitative, रावणः Ravana, राक्षसाधिपः king of Rakshasas.

text: तस्यासीद्वीर्यवान् पुत्रो रावणप्रतिमो रणे । वृद्धसेवी श्रुतिधरः सर्वास्त्रविदुषां वरः ॥६-७१-२८॥
translation: "To him was born a blessed son, valiant one, compeer of Ravana, who served elders, learned and well versed in sastras."
word_meanings: तस्य to him, वीर्यवान् valiant, रणे in war, रावणप्रतिमः compeer of Ravana, वृद्धसेवी served elders, श्रुतिधरः learned, सर्वास्त्रविदुषाम् well versed in all sastras, वरः blessed, पुत्रः son, आसीत् born.

text: अश्वपृष्ठे रथे नागे खड्गे धनुषि कर्षणे । भेदे सान्त्वे च दाने च नये मन्त्रे च सम्मतः ॥६-७१-२९॥
translation: "He is best in riding on horseback, on elephant back and in the use of sword and bow. He is capable of sowing dissension, making peace, giving charity and statecraft."
word_meanings: अश्वपृष्ठे best in riding on horseback, नागेरथे on elephant, खडगे in the use of sword, सान्त्वे च and bow also, भेदे sowing dissension, दाने च in making charity, नये in making peace, मन्त्रे च in statecraft, सम्मतः capable.

text: यस्य बाहू समाश्रित्य लङ्का वसति निर्भया । तनयं धान्यमालिन्या अतिकायमिमं विदुः ॥६-७१-३०॥
translation: "He is known as Atikaya, son of Dhanyamalini. Lanka remains fearless on his shoulders, you may know."
word_meanings: यस्य his, बाहुम् shoulders, समाश्रित्य seeking refuge, लङ्का Lanka, निर्भया fearless, वसति remains, इमम् he is, धान्यमालिन्याः Dhanyamalini's, तनयम् son, अतिकायम् Atikaya, विदुः you may know.

text: एतेनाराधितो ब्रह्मा तपसा भावितात्मना । अस्त्राणि चाप्यवाप्तानि रिपवश्च पराजिताः ॥६-७१-३१॥
translation: "By penance on supreme self he propitiated Brahma, who blessed him with mystic missiles by way of boons by which his enemies were subdued."
word_meanings: तपसा by penance, भावितात्मना of supreme intellect, एतेन by him, ब्रह्मा Brahma, आराधितः propitiated, अस्त्राणि च mystic missiles, अवाप्तानि presented, रिपवश्च enemies, पराजिताः defeated.

text: सुरासुरैरवध्यत्वं दत्तमस्मै स्वयम्भुवा । एतच्च कवचं दिव्यं रथश्चैषो ऽर्कभास्वरः ॥६-७१-३२॥
translation: "Exemption from death from gods and demons was given to him and all this wonderful shield and chariot as bright as the sun."
word_meanings: स्वयम्भूव selfborn, अस्मै to him, सुरासुरैः gods and demons, अवध्यत्वम् exemption from death, दत्तम् was given, एतत् all this, दिव्यम् wonderful, कवचं च shield, रभास्वरः bright as the Sun, रथश्च chariot.

text: एतेन शतशो देवा दानवाश्च पराजिताः । रक्षितानि च रक्षांसि यक्षाश्चापि निषूदिताः ॥६-७१-३३॥
translation: "By this (boon) hundreds of Devatas and demons were defeated by him, Yakshas were killed, nay Rakshasas were protected."
word_meanings: एतेन by this, शतशः hundreds, देवाः Devatas, दानवाश्च Danavas also, पराजिताः defeated, यक्षाश्चा , Yakshas, रक्षितानि च protected,, रक्षांसि Rakshasas, निषूदिताः killed.

text: वज्रं विष्टम्भितं येन बाणैरिन्द्रस्य धीमतः । पाशः सलिलराजस्य रणे प्रतिहतस्तथा ॥६-७१-३४॥
translation: "Here is strong Atikaya, a wise son of Ravana, bull among Rakshasas, who is a subduer of the pride of Devas and Danavas, by whom thunderbolt of Indra was obstructed firmly in battle and likewise the noose of Varuna was repelled in war."
word_meanings: येन by him, रणे in battle, बाणैः arrows, धीमतः wise, इन्द्रस्य Indra's, वज्रम् thunderbolt, विष्टम्भितम् obstructed firmly, तथा likewise, सलिलराजस्य Varuna's, पाशः noose, प्रतिहतः repelled, एषः in that way, अतिकायः Atikaya, बलवान् strong, अथ now, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, र्षभः bull यः he who, धीमान् wise, रावणसुतः Ravana's son, देवदानवदर्पहा subduer of the pride of Devas and Danavas.

text: एषो ऽतिकायो बलवान् राक्षसानामथर्षभः । रावणस्य सुतो धीमान् देवदानवदर्पहा ॥६-७१-३५॥
translation: "Here is strong Atikaya, a wise son of Ravana, bull among Rakshasas, who is a subduer of the pride of Devas and Danavas, by whom thunderbolt of Indra was obstructed firmly in battle and likewise the noose of Varuna was repelled in war."
word_meanings: येन by him, रणे in battle, बाणैः arrows, धीमतः wise, इन्द्रस्य Indra's, वज्रम् thunderbolt, विष्टम्भितम् obstructed firmly, तथा likewise, सलिलराजस्य Varuna's, पाशः noose, प्रतिहतः repelled, एषः in that way, अतिकायः Atikaya, बलवान् strong, अथ now, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, र्षभः bull यः he who, धीमान् wise, रावणसुतः Ravana's son, देवदानवदर्पहा subduer of the pride of Devas and Danavas.

text: तदस्मिन् क्रियतां यत्नः क्षिप्रं पुरुषपुङ्गव । पुरा वानरसैन्यानि क्षयं नयति सायकैः ॥६-७१-३६॥
translation: "Oh, best of men! Quickly make efforts to put an end to him before he puts down Vanara army."
word_meanings: पुरुषपुङ्गव best of men, तत् therefore, अस्मिन् his, क्षिप्रम् quickly, यत्नः efforts, क्रियताम् be exhibited, वानरसैन्यानि Vanara army, सायकैः by arrows, क्षयंपुरानयति before he puts an end.

text: ततो ऽतिकायो बलवान् प्रविश्य हरिवाहिनीम् । विस्फारयामास धनुर्ननाद च पुनःपुनः ॥६-७१-३७॥
translation: Thereafter, mighty Atikaya entered the monkey army, twanged his bow again and again and made a loud noise.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, बलवान् mighty, अतिकायः Atikaya, हरिवाहिनीम् monkey army, प्रविश्य entered, धनुः bow, विस्फारयामास twanged, पुनःपुनः again and again, ननाद च made loud noise.

text: तं भीमवपुषं दृष्ट्वा रथस्थं रथिनां वरम् । अभिपेतुर्महात्मानो ये प्रधाना वनौकसः ॥६-७१-३८॥
translation: Observing the dreadful enemy seated on the chariot, the foremost of the great Vanaras rushed towards him.
word_meanings: अथस्थम् seated, रथिनाम् on the chariot, परम् supreme, भीमवपुषम् dreadful enemy, तम् him, दृष्टवा observing, प्रधानाः foremost, महात्मानः great, ये those, वनौकसः Vanaras, अभिपेतुः rushed towards him.

text: कुमुदो द्विविदो मैन्दो नीलः शरभ एव च । पादपैर्गिरिशृङ्गैश्च युगपत् समभिद्रवन् ॥६-७१-३९॥
translation: Kumuda, Dwivida, Mainda, Neela, even Sarabha, all at once assailed him with trees and mountain peaks.
word_meanings: कुमुदः Kumuda, द्विविदः Dwivida, मैन्दः Mainda, नीलः Neela, शरभःएव च even Sarabha, पादपैः with trees, गिरिशृङ्गैःच and mountain peaks, युगपत् assailed समभिद्रवन् all at once.

text: तेषां वृक्षांश्च शैलांश्च शरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः । अतिकायो महातेजाश्चिच्छेदास्त्रविदां वरः ॥६-७१-४०॥
translation: Atikaya, endowed with extraordinary energy, efficient in the use of weapons, shattered the trees and rocks hurled by the Vanaras with his arrows adorned with gold.
word_meanings: महातेजाः endowed with extraordinary energy, अस्त्रविदाम् efficient in use of weapons, वरः foremost, अतिकायः Atikaya, काञ्चनभूषणैः adorned with gold, शरैः arrows, तेषाम् by that, वृक्षान्च trees, शैलान् च and rocks, चिच्छेद shattered.

text: तांश्चैव सर्वान् स हरीन् शरैः सर्वायसैर्बली । विव्याधाभिमुखः सङ्ख्ये भीमकायो निशाचरः ॥६-७१-४१॥
translation: The powerful night ranger of terrible form, pierced all monkeys who were facing him in the battlefield with iron arrows.
word_meanings: बली powerful, भीमकायः of terrible form, निशाचर night anger, सङ्ख्ये in the battlefield, अभिमुखान् facing, तान् them, सर्वान् all, हरीन् monkeys, सर्वायसैः iron, शरैः arrows, विव्याध pierced.

text: ते ऽर्दिता बाणवर्षेण भग्नगात्राः प्लवङ्गमाः । न शेकुरतिकायस्य प्रतिकर्तुं महारणे ॥६-७१-४२॥
translation: The monkeys were hard pressed by Atikaya's hail of arrows. Their limbs broke and were unable to resist.
word_meanings: महारणे great war, अतिकायस्य Atikaya's, बाणवर्णेण by a hail of arrows, अर्दिताः hard pressed, भिन्नगात्राः limbs broken, ते they, प्लवङ्गमाः monkeys, प्रतिकर्तुम् to resist, न शेकुः not possible.

text: तत्सैन्यं हरिवीराणां त्रासयामास राक्षसः । मृगयूथमिव क्रुद्धो हरिर्यौवनदर्पितः ॥६-७१-४३॥
translation: Just as a young lion with youthful pride would strike a group of deer, the enraged Rakshasa struck the army of monkey heroes.
word_meanings: यौवनदर्पितः lion with youthful pride, राक्षसः Rakshasa, क्रुद्धः enraged, हरिः monkey, मृगयूथमिव group of deer, हरिवीराणाम् monkey heroes, तत् that, सैन्यम् army, त्रासयामास struck.

text: स राक्षसेन्द्रो हरिसैन्यमध्ये नायुध्यमानं निजघान कञ्चित् । उपेत्य रामं सधनुः कलापी सगर्वितं वाक्यमिदं बभाषे ॥६-७१-४४॥
translation: The Rakshasa lord, wielding a weapon in the midst of the monkey army, indeed did not strike any, but armed with bow and quiver went with pride towards Rama and spoke.
word_meanings: सः he, राक्षसेन्द्रः Rakshasa Lord, हरिसैन्यमध्ये in the midst of monkey army, अयुध्यमानम् wielding weapon, कञ्चित् indeed, निजाघान not strike, सधम: कलापी armed with bow and quiver, सः he, उपेत्य taking, रामम् Rama, गर्वितम् with pride, इदम् this, वाक्यम् words, बभाषे spoke.

text: रथे स्थितो ऽहं शरचापपाणिर्न प्राकृतं कञ्चन योधयामि । यश्चास्ति कश्चिद्व्यवसाययुक्तो ददातु मे क्षिप्रमिहाद्य युद्धम् ॥६-७१-४५॥
translation: "I am with a bow and arrow seated in the chariot. Indeed, I am not strong in fighting with common warriors. Whoever is interested to fight now can come speedily to fight with me."
word_meanings: अहम् I, शरचापपाणिः with bow and arrow, रथे chariot, स्थितः seated, प्राकृतम् common warrior, कञ्चन indeed, नयोधयामि not give war, यस्य to him कश्चित् indeed, अस्ति now, व्यवसाययुक्तः whoever is interested, अद्य now इह here, क्षिप्रम् speedily, मे to me, युद्धम् fight, ददातु give me.

text: तत्तस्य वाक्यं ब्रुवतो निशम्य चुकोप सौमित्रिरमित्रहन्ता । अमृष्यमाणश्च समुत्पपात जग्राह चापं च ततः स्मयित्वा ॥६-७१-४६॥
translation: On hearing Atikaya, Saumithri the destroyer of enemies, became angry, not enduring and not able to tolerate went towards him taking a sword.
word_meanings: ब्रुवतः having spoken, तस्य his, वाक्यम् that word, निशम्य hearing, अमित्रहन्ता destroyer of enemies, सौमित्रिः Saumithri, चुकोप in anger, ततः then, स्मयित्वा not enduring, अमृष्यमाणः not able to tolerate, समुत्पपात went towards, चापम् sword, जग्राह took up.

text: क्रुद्धः सौमित्रिरुत्पत्य तूणादाक्षिप्य सायकम् । पुरस्तादतिकायस्य विचकर्ष महद्धनुः ॥६-७१-४७॥
translation: Furious Saumithri, springing up, took up his arrow from the quiver, stretching to full length before he discharged the arrow.
word_meanings: क्रुद्धः furious. सौमित्रिः Saumithri, उत्पत्य springing up, तूणात् from quiver, सायकम् arrow, आक्षिप्य stretching, अतिकायस्य full length, पुरस्तात् before, महत् great, धनुः bow, चकर्ष discharged.

text: पूरयन् स महीं शैलानाकाशं सागरं दिशः । ज्याशब्दो लक्ष्मणस्योग्रस्त्रासयन् रजनीचरान् ॥६-७१-४८॥
translation: The twang of Lakshmana filled the mountains, earth, ocean, and all directions striking terrible fear in the night ranger.
word_meanings: लक्ष्मणस्य Lakshmana's, सः that, ज्याशब्दः sound of twang, शैलान् mountains, महीम् earth, आकाशम् sky, सागरम् ocean, दिशः directions, पूरयन् filled, रजनीचरान् night ranger, त्रासयन् terror, उग्रः terrible.

text: सौमित्रेश्चापनिर्घोषं श्रुत्वा प्रतिभयं तदा । विसिष्मिये महातेजा राक्षसेन्द्रात्मजो बली ॥६-७१-४९॥
translation: Then the extraordinarily energetic and powerful son of Rakshasa king was in turn frightened at the sound of Saumithri's bow and was astonished.
word_meanings: तदा then, बली powerful, महातेजाः extraordinary energetic, राक्षसेन्द्रात्मजः Rakshasa king's son, प्रतिभयम् in turn frightened, सौमित्रेः Saumithri's, चापनिर्घोषम् sound of his bow, श्रुत्वा hearing, विसिष्मिये astonished.

text: अथातिकायः कुपितो दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणमुत्थितम् । आदाय निशितं बाणमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥६-७१-५०॥
translation: Seeing Atikaya, furious Lakshmana sprang up and took a sharp shaft and spoke as follows.
word_meanings: अथा and then, उत्थितम् sprang up, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, दृष्टवा seeing, अतिकायः Atikaya, कुपितः angry, निशितम् sharp, बाणम् shaft, आदाय taking, इदंवचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: बालस्त्वमसि सौमित्रे विक्रमेष्वविचक्षणः । गच्छ किं कालसदृशं मां योधयितुमिच्छसि ॥६-७१-५१॥
translation: "O Saumithri! You are valiant but young, not able to discriminate. I am equal to the Lord of death. Why do you desire to comb at with me?"
word_meanings: सौमित्रे O! Saumithri, त्वम् you, विक्रमेषु are valiant, अविचक्षणः not discriminative, असि are, बालः young, कालसदृशम् equal to death, माम् I am, योधयितुम् to combat with, किम् why, इच्छसि do you desire.

text: नहि मद्बाहुसृष्टानामस्त्राणां हिमवानपि । सोढुमुत्सहते वेगमन्तरिक्षमथो मही ॥६-७१-५२॥
translation: The shafts discharged from my arm can't be borne, by the Himalayas, even the atmosphere between the sky and earth can't bear the force.
word_meanings: मद्बाहुसृष्टानाम् discharged by my arm, आस्त्राणाम् shafts, वेगम् speed, हिमनानपि even Himalayas, सोढुम् force, न उत्सहतेहि not able to bear, अन्तरिक्षम् sky, अथो on the other hand, मही earth.

text: सुखप्रसुप्तं कालाग्निं निबोधयितुमिच्छसि । न्यस्यचापं निवर्तस्व मा प्राणान् जहि मद्गतः ॥६-७१-५३॥
translation: "Why do you want to arouse the fire of dissolution sleeping comfortably? Return, casting away your bow, without confronting. Go away."
word_meanings: सुखप्रसुप्तम् sleeping comfortably, कालाग्निम् fire of dissolution, विबोधयितुम् why do you arouse, इच्छसि desire, चापम् bow, न्यस्य casting away, निवर्तस्व return back, मद्गतः confronting me प्राणान् life, माजहि go away.

text: अथवा त्वं प्रतिष्टब्धो न निवर्तितुमिच्छसि । तिष्ठ प्राणान् परित्यज्य गमिष्यसि यमक्षयम् ॥६-७१-५४॥
translation: "Or else if you want to oppose and not return, give up your life and proceed to Yama's abode."
word_meanings: अथवा or else, त्वम् you, प्रतिष्टब्धः you want to oppose, निवर्तितुम् to return, न इच्छसि not wish, तिष्ठ stay, प्राणान् life, परित्यज्य giving up, यमक्ष्यम् Yama's abode, गमिष्यसि proceed.

text: पश्य मे निशितान् बाणानरिदर्पनिषूदनान् । ईश्वरायुधसङ्काशांस्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणान् ॥६-७१-५५॥
translation: "See my sharp shafts capable of reducing enemy's pride like Ishwara's trident, ornamented with polished gold."
word_meanings: मे my, नरिदर्पनिषूदनान् capable of reducing the ride of enemy, ईश्वरायुधसङ्काशान् like the Ishwara's trident, तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणान् ornamented with polished gold, निशितान् sharp, बाणान् shafts, पश्य see.

text: एष ते सर्पसङ्काशो बाणः पास्यति शोणितम् । मृगराज इव क्रुद्धो नागराजस्य शोणितम् । इत्येवमुक्त्वा सङ्क्रुद्धः शरं धनुषि सन्दधे ॥६-७१-५६॥
translation: "These arrows are like serpents and can drink your blood just as an angry lion drinks the blood of elephants. Therefore, I tell you", said Atikaya to Lakshmana."
word_meanings: सर्पसंकाशः like serpents, एषःबाणाः these arrows, क्रुद्धः angry, मृगराजः lion, नागराजस्य elephant's, शोणितम् blood, ते to you, शोणितम् blood, पास्यति drink, इत्येवम् therefore, उक्त्वा told, संक्रुद्धः furious, शरम् arrow, धनुषि bow, संदधे fixed.

text: श्रुत्वा ऽतिकायस्य वचः सरोषं सगर्वितं संयति राजपुत्रः । स सञ्चुकोपातिबलो बृहच्छ्रीरुवाच वाक्यं च ततो महार्थम् ॥६-७१-५७॥
translation: Prince Atikaya, having spoken as said before, fitted his bow in wrath. Hearing the proud statement of Atikaya, the highminded Lakshmana, endowed with strength, enraged, and spoke these words of great meaning.
word_meanings: राजपुत्रः prince, सम्यति fitted, अतिकायस्य Atikaya, सरोषम् in wrath, सगर्वितम् proud, वचः utterance, श्रुत्वा hearing, सञ्चुकोप enraged, अतिबलः very strong, मनस्वी high minded, महार्थम् great meaning, सः he, ततः those, वाक्यम् words, उवाच spoke.

text: न वाक्यमात्रेण भवान् प्रधानो न कत्थनात् सत्पुरुषा भवन्ति । मयि स्थिते धन्विनि बाणपाणौ निदर्शय स्वात्मबलं दुरात्मन् ॥६-७१-५८॥
translation: "You are evil minded. By mere statement you people can't become good chiefs. I stand armed with a bow and arrow. Prove your strength."
word_meanings: दुरात्मन् evil minded, भवान् you are, वाक्यमात्रेण by mere statement, प्रधानः chief, न not, कत्थनात् speech, सत्पुरुषाः good people, न भवन्ति not do, धन्विनि bow, बाणपाणौ armed with a bow, स्थिते stand, मयि my, आत्मबलम् your strength, निदर्शयस्य prove.

text: कर्मणा सूचयात्मानं न विकत्थितुमर्हसि । पौरुषेण तु यो युक्तः स तु शूर इति स्मृतः ॥६-७१-५९॥
translation: "Reveal yourself by action not by indication. You do not deserve it. He who is with prowess is a right hero."
word_meanings: कर्मणा by action, आत्मानम् yourself, सूचय indicated, विकत्थितुम् reveal, न अर्हसि not deserve, यः he who, पौरुषेण with prowess, युक्तः right, सः he, शूरःइति is a hero, स्मृतः are known as.

text: सर्वायुधसमायुक्तो धन्वी त्वं रथमास्थितः । शरैर्वा यदि वाप्यस्त्रैर्दर्शयस्व पराक्रमम् ॥६-७१-६०॥
translation: "You are seated in the chariot with all kinds of weapons collected. By that alone you do not become capable. Show your capacity."
word_meanings: त्वम् you, धन्वी bow, सर्वायुधसमायुक्तः collecting all kinds of weapons, रथम् chariot, आस्थितः seated, शरैःवा with arrows, यदिवापि by that alone, अस्त्रै: weapons, पराक्रमम् capable, दर्शयस्य show.

text: ततः शिरस्ते निशितैः पातयिष्याम्यहं शरैः । मारुतः कालसम्पक्वं वृन्तात्तालफलं यथा ॥६-७१-६१॥
translation: "Then I will strike down his head with sharp arrows and throw him just as ripened palm fruit drops in the process of time."
word_meanings: ततः then, अहम् I, निशितैः sharp, शरैः arrows, तेशिरः his head, मारुतः wind, कालसम्पक्वम् in the process of time when ripened, ताळफलम् palm fruit, वृन्तात् यथा drops, पातयिष्यामि will throw.

text: अद्य ते मामका बाणास्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणाः । पास्यन्ति रुधिरं गात्राद्बाणशल्यान्तरोत्थितम् ॥६-७१-६२॥
translation: "Now, you will drink the blood ejected from your neck by the holes made with my pointed arrows decked with polished gold."
word_meanings: अद्य now, तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणाः decked with polished gold, मामकाः my बाणाः arrows, तेगात्रात् from your neck, बाणशल्यान्तरोत्थितम् by the holes made by pointed arrows, रुधिरम् blood, पास्यन्ति will drink.

text: अतिकायं हतं श्रुत्वा लक्ष्मणेन महौजसा । उद्वेगमगमद्राजा वचनं चेदमब्रवीत् ॥६-७२-१॥
translation: On hearing that Atikaya was killed by highly energetic Lakshmana, the king was overtaken by emotion and spoke as follows.
word_meanings: महौजसा highly energetic, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, अतिकायम् Atikaya, हतम् killed, श्रुत्वा on hearing, राजा king, उद्वेगम् emotional, अगमत् overtaken by, इदम् these, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् च spoke.

text: धूभ्राक्षः परमामर्षी धन्वी शस्त्रभृतां वरः । अकम्पनः प्रहस्तश्च कुम्भकर्णस्तथैव च ॥६-७२-२॥
translation: "Dhumraksha, a highly intolerant one, Akampana, the foremost of the Rakshasas and skilled in the use of bow and arms, in the same way Prahastha, Kumbhakarna of stupendous valour and heroes among Rakshasas desiring for combat, who have never been defeated and conquerors of hostile armies, have been killed. Great heroes of huge body, skilled in the use of many weapons and other warriors have been killed by Rama."
word_meanings: अक्लिष्टकर्मणा of unwearied action, रामेण to Rama, धुम्राक्षः Dhumraksha, परमामर्षी highly intolerant, धन्वीशस्त्रभृताम् skilled in the use of bow and arms, वरः foremost, अकम्पनः Akampana, प्रहस्तश्च Prahastha, तथैव च in the same way, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, महाबलाः of stupendous valour, वीराः heroes, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, युद्धकाङ्क्षिणः desiring to combat, परसैन्यानाम् with enemy army. जेतारः not defeated, परैः hostile, नित्यापराजिताः conquerors of enemies, निहता killed, महावीर्याः great heroes, हताः killed, सुमहाकायाः of huge body, नानाशस्त्रविशारदाः skilled in the use of several weapons, महात्मानः great, अन्ये others, बहवः many, शूराः warriors, विनिपातिताः have been killed.

text: एते महाबला वीरा राक्षसा युद्धकाङ्क्षिणः । जेतारः परसैन्यानां परैर्नित्यापराजिताः ॥६-७२-३॥
translation: "Dhumraksha, a highly intolerant one, Akampana, the foremost of the Rakshasas and skilled in the use of bow and arms, in the same way Prahastha, Kumbhakarna of stupendous valour and heroes among Rakshasas desiring for combat, who have never been defeated and conquerors of hostile armies, have been killed. Great heroes of huge body, skilled in the use of many weapons and other warriors have been killed by Rama."
word_meanings: अक्लिष्टकर्मणा of unwearied action, रामेण to Rama, धुम्राक्षः Dhumraksha, परमामर्षी highly intolerant, धन्वीशस्त्रभृताम् skilled in the use of bow and arms, वरः foremost, अकम्पनः Akampana, प्रहस्तश्च Prahastha, तथैव च in the same way, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, महाबलाः of stupendous valour, वीराः heroes, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, युद्धकाङ्क्षिणः desiring to combat, परसैन्यानाम् with enemy army. जेतारः not defeated, परैः hostile, नित्यापराजिताः conquerors of enemies, निहता killed, महावीर्याः great heroes, हताः killed, सुमहाकायाः of huge body, नानाशस्त्रविशारदाः skilled in the use of several weapons, महात्मानः great, अन्ये others, बहवः many, शूराः warriors, विनिपातिताः have been killed.

text: निहतास्ते महावीर्या रामेणाक्लिष्टकर्मणा । राक्षसाः सुमहाकाया नानाशस्त्रविशारदाः । अन्ये च बहवः शूरा महात्मानो निपातिताः ॥६-७२-४॥
translation: "Dhumraksha, a highly intolerant one, Akampana, the foremost of the Rakshasas and skilled in the use of bow and arms, in the same way Prahastha, Kumbhakarna of stupendous valour and heroes among Rakshasas desiring for combat, who have never been defeated and conquerors of hostile armies, have been killed. Great heroes of huge body, skilled in the use of many weapons and other warriors have been killed by Rama."
