word_meanings: अक्लिष्टकर्मणा of unwearied action, रामेण to Rama, धुम्राक्षः Dhumraksha, परमामर्षी highly intolerant, धन्वीशस्त्रभृताम् skilled in the use of bow and arms, वरः foremost, अकम्पनः Akampana, प्रहस्तश्च Prahastha, तथैव च in the same way, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, महाबलाः of stupendous valour, वीराः heroes, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, युद्धकाङ्क्षिणः desiring to combat, परसैन्यानाम् with enemy army. जेतारः not defeated, परैः hostile, नित्यापराजिताः conquerors of enemies, निहता killed, महावीर्याः great heroes, हताः killed, सुमहाकायाः of huge body, नानाशस्त्रविशारदाः skilled in the use of several weapons, महात्मानः great, अन्ये others, बहवः many, शूराः warriors, विनिपातिताः have been killed.

text: प्रख्यातबलवीर्येण पुत्रेणेन्द्रजिता मम । यौ हि तौ भ्रातरौ वीरौ बद्धौ दत्तवरैः शरैः ॥६-७२-५॥
translation: "Both the famous brothers, Rama and Lakshmana were bound with arrows by my heroic son Indrajith who is conferred with boons and whose strength is well known.
word_meanings: प्रख्यातबलवीर्येण whose strength and prowess is well known, ममपुत्रेण by my son इन्द्रजिता Indrajith, तदा then, यौहि famous, वीरैः heroes, दत्तवरैः blessed with boons, शरैः arrows, तौ both, भ्रातरौ brothers, बद्धौ bond.

text: यन्न शक्यं सुरैः सर्वैरसुरैर्वा महाबलैः । मोक्तुं तद्बन्धनं घोरं यक्षगन्धर्वकिन्नरैः ॥६-७२-६॥
translation: "That formidable bond which could not be undone by Devatas, mighty Demons, Yakshas, Gandharvas, and Kinnaras got released by both the brothers, Rama and Lakshmana by their powers and conjuring tricks which are not known to me."
word_meanings: यत् that which, सर्वैः all, सुरैः Devatas, महाबलैः mighty, असुरैर्वा demons, यक्षगन्धर्वकिन्नरैः Yaksha, Gandharva, and Kinnaras, मोक्तुम् to release, शक्यम् possible, तत् that, बन्धनम् bond, घोरम् formidable, शरबन्धात् bound by arrows, भ्रातरौ brothers, तौ both, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, प्रभावैःवै powers, मायया conjuring, मोहनेनवा by tricks, विमुक्तौ released, तत् which, न जाने not known to me.

text: तन्न जाने प्रभावैर्वा मायया मोहनेन वा । शरबन्धाद्विमुक्तौ तौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ॥६-७२-७॥
translation: "That formidable bond which could not be undone by Devatas, mighty Demons, Yakshas, Gandharvas, and Kinnaras got released by both the brothers, Rama and Lakshmana by their powers and conjuring tricks which are not known to me."
word_meanings: यत् that which, सर्वैः all, सुरैः Devatas, महाबलैः mighty, असुरैर्वा demons, यक्षगन्धर्वकिन्नरैः Yaksha, Gandharva, and Kinnaras, मोक्तुम् to release, शक्यम् possible, तत् that, बन्धनम् bond, घोरम् formidable, शरबन्धात् bound by arrows, भ्रातरौ brothers, तौ both, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, प्रभावैःवै powers, मायया conjuring, मोहनेनवा by tricks, विमुक्तौ released, तत् which, न जाने not known to me.

text: ये योधा निर्गताः शूरा राक्षसा मम शासनात् । ते सर्वे निहता युद्धे वानरैः सुमहाबलैः ॥६-७२-८॥
translation: " All those heroes who have gone by my order for combat, have been killed in the battle by mighty Vanaras."
word_meanings: मम my, शासनात् by orders, ये they, शूराः heroes, योधाः to battle, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, निर्गताः dead, तेसर्वे all of them, युद्धे in battle, सुमहाबलैः mighty, वानरैः by Vanaras, निहताः killed.

text: तं न पश्याम्यहं युद्धे यो ऽद्य रामं सलक्ष्मणम् । शासयेत् सबलं वीरं ससुग्रीवविभीषणम् ॥६-७२-९॥
translation: "I do not see any warrior who will be able to wage with that Lakshmana, or his army, or with Sugriva, Vibheeshana or with Rama to put an end to them."
word_meanings: अद्य now, यः in that, युद्धे battle, सलक्ष्मणम् with that Lakshmana, सबलम् his army, ससुग्रीव with Sugriva, विभीषणम् with Vibheeshana, वीरम् heroes, रामम् with Rama, नाशयेत् to put an end, तम् them, अहम् I, न पश्यामि do not see any one.

text: अहो नु बलवान् रामो महदस्त्रबलं च वै । यस्य विक्रममासाद्य राक्षसा निधनं गताः ॥६-७२-१०॥
translation: "Rama's valour is great the strength of his missiles is great, and his valour is formidable. Rakshasas can't stand his range."
word_meanings: यस्य their, विक्रमम् valour, आसाद्य formidable, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, निधनम् stand the range, गताः gone, रामः Rama, सुबलवान् of great prowess, अस्त्रबलं च strength of missiles also, महत् वै how great, अहो Oh.

text: तं मन्ये राघवं वीरं नारायणमनामयम् । तद्भयाद्धि पुरी लङ्का पिहितद्वारतोरणा ॥६-७२-११॥
अप्रमत्तैश्च सर्वत्र गुप्तै रक्ष्या पुरी त्वियम् ॥६-७२-१२॥
translation: "This city and even the Ashoka grove where Sita is kept secretly to be guarded by being vigilant on all sides."
word_meanings: इयम् this, पुरी city, यत्र where, सीता Sita, अभिरक्ष्यते is guarded, अशोकवनिकायांच even the Ashoka grove, गुप्सैः secretly, अप्रमत्सैः being vigilant, सर्वत्र all sides, रक्ष्यातु protect.

text: अशोकवनिकायां च यत्र सीता ऽभिरक्ष्यते । निष्क्रामो वा प्रवेशो वा ज्ञातव्यः सर्वथैव नः ॥६-७२-१३॥
यत्र यत्र भवेद् गुल्मस्तत्रतत्र पुनःपुनः । सर्वतश्चापि तिष्ठध्वं स्वैःस्वैः परिवृता बलैः ॥६-७२-१४॥
द्रष्टव्यं च पदं तेषां वानराणां निशाचराः । प्रदोषे वा ऽर्धरात्रे वा प्रत्यूषे वापि सर्वतः ॥६-७२-१५॥
नावज्ञा तत्र कर्तव्या वानरेषु कदाचन । द्विषतां बलमुद्युक्तमापतत् किं स्थितं सदा ॥६-७२-१६॥
translation: " At all times, whether it is evening or midnight or early morning, Vanaras movements are to be watched by the army without indifference. Indeed, the army should be active or inactive, standing, advancing constantly and staying wherever they are."
word_meanings: प्रदोषेवा evening or, अर्धरात्रेवा or midnight, प्रत्यूषेवा early morning, सर्वत at all times:, कदाचन indeed, तेषु at these, वानरेषु Vanaras, नावज्ञा no indifference, कर्तव्या not active, द्विषताम् watched, बलम् army, उद्युक्तम् standing, आपतत्advancing, सदा constantly, स्थितम् stands where it was.

text: ततस्ते राक्षसाः सर्वे श्रुत्वा लङ्काधिपस्य तत् । वचनं सर्वमातिष्ठन् यथावत्तु महाबलाः ॥६-७२-१७॥
translation: On hearing the words of the king of Lanka all Rakshasas and the great army got up.
word_meanings: ततः then, महाबलाः great army, सर्वे all, तेराक्षसाः those Rakshasas, लङ्काधिपस्य at the king of Lanka, तत् his, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा hearing, सर्वम् all, आतिष्ठन् got up.

text: स तान् सर्वान् समादिश्य रावणो राक्षसाधिपः । मन्युशल्यं वहन् दीनः प्रविवेश स्वमालयम् ॥६-७२-१८॥
translation: Ravana, the king of Rakshasas, enjoined the Rakshasas and himself bearing the thorn of wrath, entered the abode desperately.
word_meanings: सः he, राक्षसाधिपः Rakshasa king, रावणः Ravana, तान् them, सर्वान् all, सन्दिश्य enjoined, मन्युशल्यम् thorn of wrath, वहन् bearing, दीनः desperate, स्वम् himself, आलयम् abode, प्रविवेश entered.

text: ततः स सन्दीपितकोपवह्निर्निशाचराणामधिपो महाबलः । तदेव पुत्रव्यसनं विचिन्तयन् मुहुर्मुहुश्चैव तदा व्यनिश्वसत् ॥६-७२-१९॥
इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे द्विसप्ततितमः सर्गः ॥ ७२ ॥६-७२-२०॥
ततो हतान् राक्षसपुङ्गवांस्तान् देवान्तकादित्रिशिरोतिकायान् । रक्षोगणास्तत्र हतावशिष्टास्ते रावणाय त्वरितं शशंसुः ॥६-७३-१॥
translation: Then the Rakshasas who survived the killings, hurriedly reported to the Rakshasa king, Ravana about the killing of Devanthaka, Trisira and Atikaya.
word_meanings: ततः then, स्तत्र there, हतावशिष्टाः those survived the killings, ते they, रक्षोगणाः Rakshasa troops, त्वरिताः hurriedly, राक्षसपुङ्गवान् Rakshasas leader, तान् him, देवान्तकादित्रिशिरोतिकायन् Devanthaka, Trisira, Atikaya, हतान् having been killed, रावणाय to Ravana, शशंसुः reported.

text: ततो हतांस्तान् सहसा निशम्य राजा मुमोहाश्रुपरिप्लुताक्षः । पुत्रक्षयं भ्रातृवधं च घोरं विचिन्त्य राजा विपुलं प्रदध्यौ ॥६-७३-२॥
translation: There upon the king, getting to know suddenly about the dreadful killing of his son and brother lost his senses. His eyes were filled with tears, and he was thinking seriously.
word_meanings: ततः there upon, राजा king, तान् them, हतान् killed, सहसा suddenly, निशम्य getting to know, मुमोहपरिप्लुताक्षः lost senses by the eyes bathed in tears, घोरम् dreadful, पुत्रक्षयम् and son, भ्रातृवधं च about killing of his brother, विचिन्त्य thinking, विपुलम् seriously, प्रदध्यौ held.

text: ततस्तु राजानमुदीक्ष्य दीनं शोकार्णवे सम्परिपुप्लुवानम् । रथर्षभो राक्षसराजसूनुस्तमिन्द्रजिद्वाक्यमिदं बभाषे ॥६-७३-३॥
translation: Thereafter, seeing the desperate Rakshasa king immersed in a sea of sorrow, Indrajith, son of Ravana, foremost of the chariot riders, submitted as follows.
word_meanings: ततः then, दीनम् desperate, शोकार्णवे sea of sorrow, सम्परीपुप्लुवानम् immersed in, राजानम् Oh king, उदीक्ष्य submitted, रथर्षभः foremost of chariot riders, राक्षसराजसूनुः Rakshasa king's son, इन्द्रन्द्रजित् Indrajith, तम् him, इदंवाक्यम् these words, बभाषे spoke.

text: न तात मोहं प्रतिगन्तुमर्हसि यत्रेन्द्रजिज्जीवति राक्षसेन्द्र । नेन्द्रारिबाणाभिहतो हि कश्चित् प्राणान् समर्थः समरे ऽभिपातुम् ॥६-७३-४॥
translation: "Dear king of Rakshasas! Do not give way to despair when Indrajith is alive. Indeed, struck by Indrajith's arrows in battle it is not possible for anyone to be with life."
word_meanings: राक्षसेन्द्र Rakshasa king,तात् dear, यत्र there, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, जीवति alive, मोहम् delusion, परिगन्तुम् to despair, न अर्हसि not give way, समरे in battle, इन्द्रारिबाणाभिहतः struck with arrows of Indra, कश्चित् indeed, प्राणान् life, अभिपातुम् strike, न समर्थःहि not capable.

text: पश्याद्य रामं सह लक्ष्मणेन मद्बाणनिर्भिन्नविकीर्णदेहम् । गतायुषं भूमितले शयानं शितैः शरैराचितसर्वगात्रम् ॥६-७३-५॥
translation: "Now you will see Rama along with Lakshmana also, their body torn into pieces along with their army their life ceased, lying on the ground pierced with arrows all over the limbs."
word_meanings: अद्य now, मद्बाणनिर्भिन्नविकीर्णदेहम् body torn to pieces along with his army, गतायुषम् life ceased, भूमितले on the ground, शयानम् lying, शितैः pierced, शरैः arrows, आचितसर्वगात्रम् all limbs covered with arrows clung, लक्ष्मणेनसह along with Lakshmana also, रामम् Rama, पश्य you will see.

text: इमां प्रतिज्ञां शृणु शक्रशत्रोः सुनिश्चितां पौरुषदैवयुक्ताम् । अद्यैव रामं सह लक्ष्मणेन सन्तर्पयिष्यामि शरैरमोघैः ॥६-७३-६॥
translation: "Listen to this vow of Indra's enemy, which is fully determined and combined with manliness and divinity. I shall put an end to Rama and Lakshmana with my wonderful arrows."
word_meanings: शक्रशत्रोः Indra's enemy, सुनिश्चिताम् fully determined, पौरुषदैवयुक्ताम् manliness and divinity combined, इमाम् this, प्रतिज्ञाम् vow, शृणु listen, अद्यैव now itself, लक्ष्मणेनसह along with Lakshmana, रामम् Rama, अमोघैः wonderful, शरौघैः arrows, सन्तर्पयिष्यामि will put an end.

text: अद्येन्द्रवैवस्वतविष्णुमित्रसाध्याश्विवैश्वानरचन्द्रसूर्याः । द्रक्ष्यन्तु मे विक्रममप्रमेयं विष्णोरिवोग्रं बलियज्ञवाटे ॥६-७३-७॥
translation: "Today, Indra, Vishnu, Mitra, Sadhyas, Vysvanara, moon and Sun will witness my immeasurable prowess as they witnessed the terrible prowess of Vishnu at the fire sacrifice of Bali."
word_meanings: अद्य today, इन्द्रवैवस्वतविष्णुमित्रसाध्याः च Indra, Vishnu, Mitra, Sadhyas वैश्वानरसूर्यचंद्राः Vysvanara, moon, Sun, अप्रमेयम् immeasurable, मेविक्रमम् my prowess, बलियज्ञवाटे in the place of fire sacrifice of Bali, विष्णोः Vishnu, उग्रम् इव terrible prowess like, द्रक्ष्यन्तु will witness.

text: स एवमुक्त्वा त्रिदशेन्द्रशत्रुरापृच्छ्य राजानमदीनसत्त्वः । समारुरोहानिलतुल्यवेगं रथं खरश्रेष्ठसमाधियुक्तम् ॥६-७३-८॥
translation: (Indrajith) having spoken in that manner, taking leave of the king, the enemy of Indra (the ruler of gods), ascended the chariot swift as wind in speed, drawn by the best of donkeys.
word_meanings: त्रिदशेन्द्रशत्रुः enemy of Indra, the ruler of gods, अदीनसत्त्वः unshaken in spirit, एवम् in that manner, उक्त्वा having spoken, राजानम् to the king, आपृच्छय taking leave, अनिलतुल्यवेगम् swift as wind in speed, खरश्रेष्ठसमाधियुक्तम् drawn by best of donkeys, रथम् chariot, समारुरोह ascended.

text: तमास्थाय महातेजा रथं हरिरथोपमम् । जगाम सहसा तत्र यत्र युद्धमरिन्दमः ॥६-७३-९॥
translation: Highly energetic he (Indrajith) was, a tamer of enemies, seated in the chariot that was like Indra's, quickly went to the battlefield from there.
word_meanings: महातेजाः highly energetic, अरिन्दमः tamer of enemies, हरिरथोपमम् like that of Indra, रथम् chariot, तम: he, आस्थाय taking seat, यत्र there, युद्धम् battle, तत्र there, सहसा quickly, जगाम went.

text: तं प्रस्थितं महात्मानमनुजग्मुर्महाबलाः । संहर्षमाणा बहवो धनुःप्रवरपाणयः ॥६-७३-१०॥
translation: Many Rakshasas of terrific valour, endowed with extraordinary strength, happily, wielding excellent bows, taking barbed missiles, hammers, whetted axes, maces, Bhusandi mallets, Ayasthis, Sataghnis, and Parighas, making noise, went following great Indrajith. Some went on the back of elephants and horses, tigers as large as mountains, scorpions, cats, donkeys, and camels. As well as on serpents, lions, tigers, and jackals.
word_meanings: महाबलाः mighty strong, भीमविक्रमाः of terrific valour, बहवः many, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, सम्हर्षमाणा very happy, धनुःप्रवरपाणयः wielding excellent bows, प्रासमुद्गरनिस्त्रिंशपरश्वथगदाधराः barbed missiles, hammers whetted axes, maces भुशण्डिमुद्गरा Bhusandi, mallets ष्टिशतघ्नीपरिघायुधाः Ayashtis, Satahgnis and Parighas, प्रस्थितम् making noise, महात्मानम् great Indrajith, तम् they, अनुजग्मुः went, केचित् some, गजस्कन्धगताः back of elephants and horses, केचित् some, प्रवरवाजिभिः horses, पर्वतोपमैः like mountains, व्याघ्रवृश्चिकमार्जारखरोष्ट्रै tigers, scorpions, cats, donkeys and camels, भुजङ्गमैः serpents, सिंहैः lions, जम्बुकैः Jackals.

text: गजस्कन्धगताः केचित् केचित् प्रवरवाजिभिः । प्रासमुद्गरनिस्त्रिंशपरश्वधगदाधराः ॥६-७३-११॥
स शङ्खनिनदैः पूर्णैर्भेरीणां चापि निस्वनैः । जगाम त्रिदशेन्द्रारिः स्तूयमानो निशाचरैः ॥६-७३-१२॥
translation: The Rakshasas went on praising the enemy of Indra, Indrajith, making noise, blowing conchs in full blast, beating drums.
word_meanings: सः he, त्रिदशेन्द्रारिः enemy of Indra and gods, Indrajith, पूर्णैः fully, शङ्खनिनदैः making noise with blowing conchs, भेरीणाम् and drums, निस्स्वनैः making noise, निशाचरैः night ranger, तूयमानः praising, जगाम went.

text: स शङ्खशशिवर्णेन छत्रेण रिपुसूदनः । रराज प्रतिपूर्णेन नभश्चान्द्रमसा यथा ॥६-७३-१३॥
translation: He, the destroyer of foes went with white parasols like a full moon shine in the sky.
word_meanings: रिपुसूदनः destroyer of foes, सः he, शङ्खशशिवर्णेन white parasol, छत्रेण parasol, प्रतिपूर्णेन full moon, चन्द्रमसा moon like, सभः sky, यथा like that, रराज shone.

text: अवीज्यत ततो वीरो हैमैर्हेमविभूषितैः । चारुचामरमुख्यैश्च मुख्यः सर्वधनुष्मताम् ॥६-७३-१४॥
translation: Thereafter the chief hero went decked with golden ornaments, fanned by archers holding whisks with gold handles.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, हेमविभूषितैः decked with gold ornaments, सर्वधनुष्मताम् archers, मुख्यः chief, वीरः hero, हैमैः gold, चारुचामरमुख्यैः whisks with golden handles, अवीज्यत fanning.

text: ततस्त्विन्द्रजिता लङ्का सूर्यप्रतिमतेजसा । रराजा प्रतिवीरेण द्यौरिवार्केण भास्वता ॥६-७३-१५॥
translation: Then Lanka shone like the Sun in the sky with Indrajith who was effulgent like the Sun and matchless in valour shone.
word_meanings: ततः then, सूर्यप्रतिमतेजसा effulgent like the Sun, अप्रतिवीर्येण matchless in valour, इन्द्रजिता Indrajith, लङ्का Lanka, भास्वता shone, अर्केण by Sun, द्यौःइव like sky, रराज shone.

text: स सम्प्राप्य महातेजा युद्धभूमिमरिन्दमः । स्थापयामास रक्षांसि रथं प्रति समन्ततः ॥६-७३-१६॥
translation: Upon reaching the battlefield, he, the tamer of foes, highly energetic Indrajith, ranged the Rakshasas around the chariot.
word_meanings: महातेजाः very energetic, अरिन्दमः tamer of foes, सः he, युद्धभूमिम् battlefield, सम्प्राप्य reaching, रक्षांसि Rakshasa, रथंप्रतिसमन्ततः ranged around the chariot, स्थापयामास looked around the chariot.

text: ततस्तु हुतभोक्तारं हुतभुक्सदृशप्रभः । जुहाव राक्षसश्रेष्ठो मन्त्रवद्विधिवत्तदा ॥६-७३-१७॥
translation: Then the foremost of Rakshasas, who was like fire god in brilliance worshipped fire god with chanting of mantras as per tradition.
word_meanings: ततः then, हुतभुक्सदृशप्रभः equal to fire in brilliance, राक्षसश्रेष्ठः foremost of the Rakshasas, मन्त्रसत्तमैः best of mantras, हुतभोक्तारम् fire god, मन्त्रवत् with mantras, विधिवत् as per tradition, तदा then, जुहव worshipped.

text: स हविर्लाजसंस्कारैर्माल्यगन्धपुरस्कृतैः । जुहुवे पावकं तत्र राक्षसेन्द्रः प्रतापवान् ॥६-७३-१८॥
translation: The heroic Rakshasa king worshipped according to tradition with flowers and fragrance followed by parched grain and fire god.
word_meanings: प्रतापवान् heroic, सः he, राक्षसेन्द्रः Rakshasa king, माल्यगन्धपुरस्कृतैः with flowers and fragrance, हविर्लाजसंस्कारैः with parched grain, तत्र then, पावकम् fire, जुहुवे worshipped.

text: शस्त्राणि शरपत्राणि समिधो ऽथ विभीतकाः । लोहितानि च वासांसि स्रुवं कार्ष्णायसं तथा ॥६-७३-१९॥
translation: In that fire sacrifice, weapons were leaves, bibika sticks were fuel, red pieces of cloth were used, and in the same way the ladle for sacrifice was made of iron.
word_meanings: स्त्राणि reed, शरपत्राणि weapons as leaves, अथ and, विभीतकाः bibitika, समिधः sticks, लोतानि red coloured, वासांसि च cloth, तथा same way, कार्ष्णायसम् ladle made of black iron, स्रुवम् to spread.

text: स तत्राग्निं समास्तीर्य शरपत्रैः सतोमरैः । छागस्य कृष्णवर्णस्य गलं जग्राह जीवतः ॥६-७३-२०॥
translation: There he strewed into the fire, lances as leaves, dark coloured live go at clasped by its neck and consigned.
word_meanings: सः he, तत्र there, सतोमरैः lances, शरपत्रैः leaves in the form of weapons, अग्निम् into fire, समास्तीर्य consigning, कृष्णवर्णस्य dark coloured, जीवतः live, छागस्य goat, गळम् neck, जग्राह clasped.

text: सकृदेव समिद्धस्य विधूमस्य महार्चिषः । बभूवुस्तानि लिङ्गानि विजयं यान्यदर्शयन् ॥६-७३-२१॥
translation: From the fire set ablaze by the of fearing of fire sticks into it was free from smoke burst into flames indicating victory.
word_meanings: सकृदेव from the fire set ablaze, समिद्धस्य fire sticks, विधूमस्य free from smoke, महार्चिषः burst into flames, यानि those, विजयम् victory, अदर्शयन् indicating, तानि those, लिङ्गानि mark of, बभूवुः appeared.

text: प्रदक्षिणावर्तशिखस्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणः । हविस्तत् प्रतिजग्राह पावकः स्वयमास्थितः ॥६-७३-२२॥
translation: The fire god himself, decked in polished gold ornaments turned round and accepted the offerings.
word_meanings: तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणः ornaments of polished gold, पावकः fire, स्वयम् itself, अस्थितः accepted, प्रदक्षिणावर्तशिखः turned round towards, तत् that, हविः fire, प्रतिजग्राह in turn.

text: सो ऽस्त्रमाहारयामास ब्राह्ममिन्द्ररिपुस्तदा । धनुश्चात्मरथं चैव सर्वं तत्राभ्यमन्त्रयत् ॥६-७३-२३॥
translation: He, with whom weapons are adept invoked weapon presided over by Brahma and charged his own chariot with it.
word_meanings: अस्त्ररिपुः enemy of weapons, सः he, ब्राह्मम् Brahma's, इन्द्रम् weapon, आहारयामास invoked, तत्र there, धनुश्च bow, आत्मरथंचैव his own chariot also, सर्वम् all, अभ्यमन्त्रयत् charged with invocation of Brahma.

text: तस्मिन्नाहूयमाने ऽस्त्रे हूयमाने च पावके । सार्धं ग्रहेन्दुनक्षत्रैर्वितत्रास नभःस्थलम् ॥६-७३-२४॥
translation: While the missile was being invoked and fire sacrifice was done, all planets, moon, Sun, and Stars in the sky shook in fear.
word_meanings: तस्मिन् while, अस्त्रे missile, आहूयमाने invoking, पावके fire god, हूयमाने च doing fire sacrifice, सार्धंग्रहेन्दुनक्षत्रै all planets, moon, Sun and Stars, नभस्थ्सलम् in the sky, वितत्रास shook in fear.

text: स पावकं पावकदीप्ततेजा हुत्वा महेन्द्रप्रतिमप्रभावः । सचापबाणासिरथाश्वसूतः खे ऽन्तर्दधेत्मानमचिन्त्यरूपः ॥६-७३-२५॥
translation: Flaming like fire god, endowed with the prowess of Indra, possessing inconceivable form, Indrajith with his bow, arrows and chariot disappeared into the sky.
word_meanings: पावकदीप्ततेजाः flaming like fire god, महेन्द्रप्रतिमप्रभावः endowed with the prowess of Indra, अचिन्त्यरूपः of inconceivable form, सः he, सचापबाणासिरथाश्वसूतः with bow, arrows and chariot, खे into the sky, आत्मानम् himself, अन्तर्दधे disappeared.

text: ततो हयरथाकीर्णं पताकाध्वजशोभितम् । निर्ययौ राक्षसबलं नर्दमानं युयुत्सया ॥६-७३-२६॥
translation: Then, the Rakshasa army filled with horses and chariots, graced with pennants and flags, desiring to fight went roaring aloud.
word_meanings: ततः then, हयरथाकीर्णम् filled with horses and chariot, पताकाध्वजशोभितम् graced with pennants and flags, राक्षसबलम् Rakshasa army, ययुत्सया desiring to fight, नर्दमानम् roaring aloud, निर्ययौ went.

text: ते शरैर्बहुभिश्चित्रैस्तीक्ष्णवेगैरलङ्कृतैः । तोमरैरङ्कुशैश्चापि वानरान् जघ्नुराहवे ॥६-७३-२७॥
translation: They began to strike Vanaras, with many wonderfully decorated, sharp and swift arrows, lances, and tridents.
word_meanings: ते they, आहवे began, चित्रैः wonderful, तीक्ष्णवेगैः sharp and swift, अलङ्कृतैः decorated, बहुभिः many, शरैः arrows, तोमरैः lances, अङ्कुशैश्चापि tridents also, वानरान् Vanaras, जघ्नुः to strike.

text: रावणिस्तु ततः क्रुद्धस्तान्निरीक्ष्य निशाचरान् । हृष्टा भवन्तो युद्ध्यन्तु वानराणां जिघांसया ॥६-७३-२८॥
translation: Thereafter enraged Ravana's son looking at the Rakshasas said, "Be happy and kill the Vanaras in fight."
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, सङ्कृद्धः enraged, रावणिःतु at Ravana's son, तान् him, निशाचरान् night ranger, निरीक्ष्य looking at, भवन्तः you, हृष्टाः happily, वानराणाम् with Vanaras, जिघांसया kill, युध्यन्तु fight.

text: ततस्ते राक्षसाः सर्वे नर्दन्तो जयकाङ्क्षिणः । अभ्यवर्षंस्ततो घोरान् वानरान् शरवृष्टिभिः ॥६-७३-२९॥
translation: Thereafter the Rakshasas roaring and longing for victory rained arrows in a terrific manner at the Vanaras.
word_meanings: ततः then, सर्वे all, तेराक्षसाः those Rakshasas, गर्जन्तः roaring, जयकाङ्क्षिणः longing for victory, ततः then, शरवृष्टिभिः rained arrows, घोरन् terrific manner, वानरान् at Vanaras, अभ्यवर्षन् rained.

text: स तु नालीकनाराचैर्गदाभिर्मुसलैरपि । रक्षोभिः संवृतः सङ्ख्ये वानरान् विचकर्त ह ॥६-७३-३०॥
translation: Indrajith, remaining concealed and surrounded by Rakshasas, destroyed the Vanaras with nalikas, steel arrows and maces.
word_meanings: स तु they, सङ्ख्ये in fight, रक्षोभिः concealed, सम्वृतः surrounded by, नालिकनाराचैः nalikas, गदाभिः maces, मुसलैरपि steel arrows, वानरान् at Vanaras, विचकर्त ह destroy.

text: ते वध्यमानाः समरे वानराः पादपायुधाः । अभ्यद्रवन्त सहिता रावणिं रणकर्कशम् ॥६-७३-३१॥
translation: Struck in the battle by Indrajith, the Vanaras rained heavily armed with trees and rocks.
word_meanings: समरे in battle, वध्यमानाः struck, पादपायुधाः armed with trees, ते they, वानराः Vanaras, सहसा suddenly, शैलपादपैः rocks and trees, रावणिम् Indrajith, अभ्यवर्षन्त rained heavily.

text: इन्द्रजित्तु ततः क्रुद्धो महातेजा महाबलः । वानराणां शरीराणि व्यधमद्रावणात्मजः ॥६-७३-३२॥
translation: Mighty and energetic son of Ravana, Indrajith became angry and began to attack the Vanaras.
word_meanings: महातेजाः energetic, महाबलः mighty, रावणात्मजः Ravana's son, इन्द्रजित्तु Indrajith, तदा then, क्रुद्धः became angry, वानराणाम् at Vanaras, शरीराणि body, व्यधमत् attacked.

text: शरेणैकेन च हरीन् नव पञ्च च सप्त च । चिच्छेद समरे क्रुद्धो राक्षसान् सम्प्रहर्षयन् ॥६-७३-३३॥
translation: Filled with anger, Indrajith alone with nine, five, seven arrows tore the Vanaras into pieces.
word_meanings: क्रुद्धः angry, समरे in battlefield, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, संप्रहर्षयन् rejoiced, एकेन alone, शरेण with arrows, न्नव nine, पञ्च five, सप्त च and seven, हरीन् Vanaras, बिभेद tore into pieces.

text: स शरैः सूर्यसङ्काशैः शातकुम्भविभूषितैः । वानरान् समरे वीरः प्रममाथ सुदुर्जयः ॥६-७३-३४॥
translation: Hero Indrajith, who is difficult to conquer in battle, killed the Vanaras with sun like arrows decorated with gold.
word_meanings: सुदुर्जयः who is difficult to conquer, सःवीरः that hero, समरे in battle, सूर्यसङ्काशैः like the Sun, शातकुम्भविभूषितैः decorated with gold, शरैः arrows, वानरान् Vanaras, प्रममाथ killed.

text: ते भिन्नगात्राः समरे वानराः शपपीडिताः । पेतुर्मथितसङ्कल्पाः सुरैरिव महासुराः ॥६-७३-३५॥
translation: Pierced by arrows in the battle, those Vanaras with their necks broken, giving up hopes of winning, frustrated, fell like the demons oppressed by great gods.
word_meanings: समरे in battle, शरपीडिताः pierced by arrows, तेवानराः those Vanaras, भिन्नगात्राः necks broken, सुरैः by asuras, महासुराःइव like great suras, मथितसङ्कल्पाः frustrated in mind, पेतुः fallen.

text: तं तपन्तमिवादित्यं घोरैर्बाणगभस्तिभिः । अभ्यधावन्त सङ्क्रुद्धाः संयुगे वानरर्षभाः ॥६-७३-३६॥
translation: Then the bulls among Vanaras rushed in the battlefield towards Indrajith whose arrows were dreadful and blazing like the Sun 's rays.
word_meanings: ते they, वानरर्षभाः bulls among Vanaras, सम्युगे in battle, घोरैः dreadful, बाणगभस्तिभिः arrows like Sun 's rays, तपन्तम् blazing, आदित्यम् इव like the Sun's rays, सङ्कृद्धा highly enraged, अभ्यधावन्त rushed.

text: ततस्तु वानराः सर्वे भिन्नदेहा विचेतसः । व्यथिता विद्रवन्ति स्म रुधिरेण समुक्षिताः ॥६-७३-३७॥
translation: Then Vanaras with their bodies broken, courage and consciousness lost, blood flowed from mutilated bodies.
word_meanings: ततः then, सर्वे all, वानराः Vanaras, भिन्नदेहाः broken bodies, विचेतसः lost consciousness, व्यथिताः lost courage, रुधिरेण by blood, समुक्षिताः mutilated, विद्रवन्तिस्म flowed.

text: रामस्यार्थे पराक्रम्य वानरास्त्यक्तजीविताः । नर्दन्तस्ते ऽभिवृत्तास्तु समरे सशिलायुधाः ॥६-७३-३८॥
translation: Vanaras, armed with rocks in the battle, roaring and not turning back, stood for the cause, giving up their life.
word_meanings: तेवानराः those Vanaras, समरे in battle, सशिलायुधाः armed with rocks, नर्दन्तः roaring, अभिवृत्ताः not turning back, अर्थे for the cause, पराक्रम्य by their valour, त्यक्तजीविताः giving up life.

text: ते द्रुमैः पर्वताग्रैश्च शिलाभिश्च प्लवङ्गमाः । अभ्यवर्षन्त समरे रावणिं पर्यवस्थिताः ॥६-७३-३९॥
translation: The Vanaras retreated back to the battle and rained on Ravana's son, trees, mountains and rocks.
word_meanings: तेप्लवङ्गमाः those Vanaras, समरे in battle, पर्यवस्थिताः retraced back, रावणिम् Ravana's son, द्रुमैः trees, पर्यताग्रैश्च peaks of mountains, शिलाभिश्च and rocks, अभ्यवर्षन्त rained again.

text: तद्द्रुमाणां शिलानां च वर्षं प्राणहरं महत् । व्यपोहत महातेजा रावणिः समितिञ्जयः ॥६-७३-४०॥
translation: Energetic Indrajith, who is ever victorious in battle dispersed the deadly rain of rocks and trees capable of taking out life.
word_meanings: महातेजाः energetic, समितिञ्जयः ever victorious in war, रावणिः Indrajith, द्रुमाणाम् trees, शिलानां च and at rocks, प्राणहरम् that which can take out life, महत् deadly, तंवर्षम् rain, व्यपोहत dispersed.

text: ततः पावकसङ्काशैः शरैराशीविषोपमैः । वानराणामनीकानि बिभेद समरे प्रभुः ॥६-७३-४१॥
translation: Then the Lord of Rakshasas dispersed the complete army of Vanaras with arrows burning like fire and resembling venomous serpents.
word_meanings: ततः then, प्रभुः Lord, समरे in battle, पावकसङ्काशैः burning like fire, आशीविषोपमैः like venomous serpents, शरैः arrows, वानराणाम् on Vanaras, अनीकानि complete army, बिभेद shattered.

text: अष्टादशशरैस्तीक्ष्णैः स विद्ध्वा गन्धमादनम् । विव्याध नवभिश्चैव नलं दूरादवस्थितम् ॥६-७३-४२॥
translation: He shattered Gandhamadana with eighteen very sharp arrows and Nala standing at far with nine arrows.
word_meanings: सः he, तिक्ष्णै very sharp, अष्टादशशरैः eighteen, गन्धमादनम् Gandhamadana, विद्ध्वा shattered, दूरात् far away, अवस्थितम् standing, नलम् Nala also, नवभिः nine, विव्याथ shattered.

text: सप्तभिस्तु महा वीर्यो मैन्दं मर्मविदारणैः । पञ्चभिर्विशिखैश्चैव गजं विव्याध संयुगे ॥६-७३-४३॥
translation: Indrajith, the eminent hero, hurt Mainda in private parts and even afflicted Gaja with five spades in the battle.
word_meanings: महावीर्यः eminent hero, मर्मविदारणैः private parts, सप्तभिः seven, मैन्दम् Mainda, पञ्चभिः five, विशिखैः by spade, गजंचैव even Gaja, संयुगे in battle, विव्याथ afflicted.

text: जाम्बवन्तं तु दशभिर्नीलं त्रिंशद्भिरेव च । सुग्रीवमृषभं चैव सो ऽङ्गदं द्विविदं तथा । घोरैर्दत्तवरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्निष्प्राणानकरोत्तदा ॥६-७३-४४॥
translation: Then he struck Jambavan with ten, Neela with thirty, and Sugriva, Rshaba and Angada. In the same way Dwivida with sharp and terrific arrows that were bestowed upon him as boons and made them lose consciousness.
word_meanings: तदा then, सः he, जाम्बवन्तम् Jambavantha, दशभिः ten, नीलम् Neela, त्रिंशद्भिरेव च thirty, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, ऋषभंचैव and Rshaba, अङ्गदम् Angada, तथा in the same way, द्विविदम् Dwivida, दत्तवरैः con fired with boons, घोरैः terrific, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, निष्प्राणान् lose consciousness, अकरोत् did.

text: अन्यानपि तदा मुख्यान् वानरान् बहुभिः शरैः । अर्दयामास सङ्क्रुद्धः कालाग्निरिव मूर्च्छितः ॥६-७३-४५॥
translation: Highly enraged like the fire at the time of universal destruction, he tormented many chiefs of Vanaras and others.
word_meanings: सङ्कृद्धः highly enraged, मूर्छितः lost senses, कालानगिरिव like fire at the time of destruction, बहुभिः many, शरैः arrows, तदा then, मुख्यान् chief, अन्यान् others, वानरानपि Vanaras also, अर्दयामास tormented.

text: स शरैः सूर्यसङ्काशैः सुमुक्तैः शीघ्रगामिभिः । वानराणामनीकानि निर्ममन्थ महारणे ॥६-७३-४६॥
translation: He, with his swift moving arrows, bright like the Sun , stretching to the ear hurt many vanaras in that great war.
word_meanings: सः he, सूर्यसङ्काशैः like the Sun, सुमुक्सैः stretching to the ear, शीघ्रगामिभिः swift moving, शरैः arrows, महारणे in the great war, वानराणाम् at Vanaras, अनीकानि many, निर्ममन्थ hurt.

text: आकुलां वानरीं सेनां शरजालेन मोहिताम् । हृष्टः स परया प्रीत्या ददर्श क्षतजोक्षिताम् ॥६-७३-४७॥
translation: Seeing the vast Vanara army deluded by the net of arrows, Indrajith was very happy.
word_meanings: हृष्टः happy, सः he, शरजालेन net of arrows, मोहिताम् deluded, क्षतजोक्षिताम् lost senses, आकुलाम् vast, वानरीम् Vanaras, सेवान् army, परया very, प्रीत्या happy, ददर्श appeared.

text: पुनरेव महातेजा राक्षसेन्द्रात्मजो बली । संसृज्य बाणवर्षं च शस्त्रवर्षं च दारुणम् । ममर्द वानरानीकमिन्द्रजित्त्वरितो बली ॥६-७३-४८॥
translation: Highly energetic, mighty, and swift Indrajith raining sharp arrows and weapons quickly Devastated the Vanara army.
word_meanings: महातेजाः highly energetic, बली strong, राक्षसेन्द्रात्मजः Rakshasa king's son, पुरेव swift, दारुणम् dreadful, बाणवर्षं च rain of arrows, शस्त्रवर्षं च and shower of weapons, संसृज्य dropping, बली mighty, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, त्वरितः swiftly, वानरानीकम् Vanara army, ममर्द devastated.

text: स्वसैन्यमुत्सृज्य समेत्य तूर्णं महारणे वानरवाहिनीषु । अदृश्यमानः शरजालमुग्रं ववर्ष नीलाम्बुधरो यथा ऽम्बु ॥६-७३-४९॥
translation: Leaving from his own army space, moving swiftly, remaining concealed in the blue sky like a rain cloud, Indrajith rained a net of arrows.
word_meanings: स्वसैन्यम् his own army, उत्सृज्य leaving, तूर्णम् moving swiftly, महारणे great battle, समेत्य staying, अदृश्यमानः concealed, वानरवाहिनीषु from Vanara army, उग्रम् sharp, शरजालम् arrows of net, नीलाम्बुधरः from the blue sky, अम्बुयथा like rainy cloud, ववर्ष rained.

text: ते शक्रजिद्बाणविशीर्णदेहा मायाहता विस्वरमुन्नदन्तः । रणे निपेतुर्हरयो ऽद्रिकल्पा यथेन्द्रवज्राभिहता नगेन्द्राः ॥६-७३-५०॥
translation: In the battle, the Vanaras who were like mountains, became victims of cheating, and were struck by Indrajith's thunderbolt like arrows. Their bodies were broken and shrieking in discordant tones they fell like mountains.
word_meanings: रणे in battle, शक्रजिद्बाणविशीर्णदेहाः struck by Indrajith, bodies broken to pieces, मायाहताः victims of cheating, अद्रिकल्पाः like mountains, ते they, हरयः Vanaras, विस्वरम् discordant tones, उन्नदन्तः shrieking, इन्द्रवज्राभिहताः hit by Indra's thunderbolt, नगेन्द्राःयथा mountains like, निपेतुः fell.

text: ते केवलं सन्ददृशुः शिताग्रान् बाणान् रणे वानरवाहिनीषु । मायानिगूढं तु सुरेन्द्रशत्रुं न चावृतं राक्षसमभ्यपश्यन् ॥६-७३-५१॥
translation: The Vanara troops saw only the sharp pointed arrows covering them. They could not see the enemy of Indra being concealed by magical power.
word_meanings: रणे in war, ते they, वानरवाहिनीषु only Vanara troops, केवलम् alone, सिताग्रान् sharp pointed, बाणान् arrows, सन्ददृशुः saw, आवृतम् covering them, मायाविगूढम् magical power, सुरेन्द्रशत्रुम् enemy of Indra, तंराक्षसम् अपि those Rakshasas also, न अपश्यन् not seen.

text: ततः स रक्षोधिपतिर्महात्मा सर्वे दिशो बाणगणैः शिताग्रैः । प्रच्छादयामास रविप्रकाशैर्विषादयामास च वानरेन्द्रान् ॥६-७३-५२॥
translation: Thereafter the mighty Lord of Rakshasas despatched volley of sharp tipped arrows bright like the Sun, at Vanara leaders on all sides and eradicated.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, रक्षोधिपतिः Rakshasa Lord, महात्मा great self, सः he, शिताग्रैः sharp tipped, रविप्रकाशैः bright like the Sun, बाणगणैः volleys of arrows, सर्वाः all, दिशः sides, प्रच्छादयामास despatched, वानरेन्द्रान् Vanara leaders, विपादयामास च eradicated.

text: स शूलनिस्त्रिंशपरश्वधानि व्याविध्य दीप्तानलसन्निभानि । सविस्फुलिङ्गोज्ज्वलपावकानि ववर्ष तीर्व्रं प्लवगेन्द्रसैन्ये ॥६-७३-५३॥
translation: He rained a violent shower of tridents, swords and axes burning like sacrificial fire shedding flames with fire sparks on the Vanara army.
word_meanings: सः he, व्याविध्यदीप्तानिलसन्निभानि glowing like fire sacrifice, सविस्फुलिङ्गोज्ज्वलपावकानि flames with sparks of fire, शूलनिस्त्रिंशपरश्वधानिtridents, swords and axes, तीव्रम् violent, प्लवगेन्द्रसैन्ये Vanara army, ववर्ष rained.

text: ततो ज्वलनसङ्काशैः शरैर्वानरयूथपाः । ताडिताः शक्रजिद्बाणैः प्रफुल्ला इव किंशुकाः ॥६-७३-५४॥
translation: Struck by Indrajith's arrows, the (bodies of) Vanara troops were glowing like Kimsuka trees (red in colour) bearing flowers.
word_meanings: ततः then, ज्वलनसङ्काशैः glowing like, शरैः arrows, शक्रजिद्भाणैः by Indrajith's arrows, ताडिताः struck, वानरयूथपाः Vanara troops, प्रफुल्लाः bearing flowers, किंशुकाःइव like Kimsuka trees.

text: ते ऽन्योन्यमभिसर्पन्तो निनदन्तश्च विस्वरम् । राक्षसेन्द्रास्त्रनिर्भिन्ना निपेतुर्वानरर्षभाः ॥६-७३-५५॥
translation: Hit by the Rakshasa king, the bulls among Vanaras gliding towards one another roared in discordant tones and fell down.
word_meanings: राक्षसेन्द्राभिनिर्भिन्नाः hit by the king of Rakshasas one over the other, ते they, वानरर्षभाः bulls among Vanaras, अन्योन्यम् one another, अभिसर्पन्तः gliding towards, विस्वरम् discordant tones, निनदन्तश्च roared, निपेतुः fell down.

text: उदीक्षमाणा गगनं केचिन्नेत्रेषु ताडिताः । शरैर्विविशुरन्योन्यं पेतुश्च जगतीतले ॥६-७३-५६॥
translation: Some Vanaras looking up to the sky eyes pierced with arrows held one another and fell on the ground.
word_meanings: गगनम् sky, उदीक्षमाणाः looking up, केचित् some, शरैः arrows, नेत्रेषु in the eyes, ताडिताः pierced, अन्योन्यम् one another, विविशुः holding, जगतीतले on the ground, पेतुश्च fell.

text: हनुमन्तं च सुग्रीवमङ्गदं गन्धमादनम् । जाम्बवन्तं सुषेणं च वेगदर्शिनमेव च ॥६-७३-५७॥
मैन्दं च द्विविदं नीलं गवाक्षं गजगोमुखौ । केसरिं हरिलोमानं विद्युदृंष्ट्रं च वानरम् ॥६-७३-५८॥
सूर्याननं ज्योतिमुखं तथा दधिमुखं हरिम् । पावकाक्षं नलं चैव कुमुदं चैव वानरम् ॥६-७३-५९॥
प्रासैः शूलैः शितैर्बाणैरिन्द्रजिन्मन्त्रसंहितैः । विव्याध हरिशार्दूलान् सर्वांस्तान् राक्षसोत्तमः ॥६-७३-६०॥
translation: Indrajith, the foremost of the Rakshasas, with lances, tridents, sharp arrows charged with mantras pierced at all the tigers among Vanaras --Hanuman, Sugriva, Angada, Gandhamadanam, Jambavantha, Sushena, Vegadarsi, Mainda, Dwivida, Neela, Gavaksha, Vidyuuhamshtra, and monkeys Suryanana, Jyothimukha, Dadhimukha, Pavaksha, and also Nala, Kumuda.
word_meanings: राक्षसोत्तमः foremost of Rakshasas, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, हनूमन्तं च at Hanuman, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, अङ्गदम् Angada, गन्धमादनम् Gandhamadanam, जाम्बवन्तम् Jambavantha, सुषेणंच Sushenu, वेगदर्शिनमेव च Vegadarsi, मैन्दं च and Mainda, द्विविदम् Dwivida, नीलम् Neela, गवाक्षम् Gavaksha, विद्युद्दंष्ट्रम् Vidyuddhamshtra, वानरंच Vanaras, सूर्याननम् Suryanana, ज्योतिमुखम् Jyothimukha, तथा that way, दधिमुखम् Dadhimukha, हरिम् monkeys, पावकाक्षम् Pavakasha, नळंचैव Nala also, कुमुदम् Kumuda, वानरंचैव Vanaras, सर्वान् all, तान् of them, हरिशार्दूलान् tigers among Vanaras, मन्त्रसम्हितैः charged with mantras, प्रास्सैः lances, शूलैः tridents, शितैः sharp, बाणैः arrows, विव्याध pierced.

text: स वै गदाभिर्हरियूथमुख्यान् निर्भिद्य बाणैस्तपनीयपुङ्खैः । ववर्ष रामं शरवृष्टिजालैः सलक्ष्मणं भास्कररश्मिकल्पैः ॥६-७३-६१॥
translation: Having hurt the Vanara leaders with maces and arrows shining like gold, he rained volley of arrows shining like sun rays on Lakshmana and Rama.
word_meanings: सः he, गदाभिः maces, तपनीयवङ्खैः arrows shining with golden colour, बाणैः arrows, हरियूथमुख्यान् leaders of Vanara troops, निर्भिद्य wounded, सलक्ष्मणम् Lakshmana, रामम् Rama, भास्कररमशिकल्पैः shining like Sun 's rays, शरवृष्टिजालैः volley of arrows, ववर्ष rained.

text: स बाणवर्षैरभिवर्ष्यमाणो धारानिपातानिव तानचिन्त्य । समीक्षमाणः परमाद्भुतश्री रामस्तदा लक्ष्मणमित्युवाच ॥६-७३-६२॥
translation: Most wonderful and prosperous Rama, looking at the rain of arrows continuing to shower, not minding it as if they are rain of water drops, spoke this to Lakshmana.
word_meanings: परमाद्भुतश्रीः most wonderful and prosperous, सःरामः that Rama, बाणवर्षैः rain of arrows, अभिवर्ष्यमाणः while continuing to rain, तान् them, धारानिपातानिन like rain of water drops, अच्नित्य not minding, समीक्षमाणः was looking at, ततः that, लक्ष्मणम् Lakshman, इति this, उवाच spoke.

text: असौ पुनर्लक्ष्मण राक्षसेन्द्रो ब्रह्मास्त्रमाश्रित्य सुरेन्द्रशत्रुः । निपातयित्वा हरिसैन्यमुग्रमस्मान् शरैरर्दयति प्रसक्तः ॥६-७३-६३॥
translation: "Lakshmana! Rakshasa king, an enemy of Indra afflicted the Vanaras with the Brahmastram secured by him. Using that power, he is tormenting us with sharp arrows."
word_meanings: लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, राक्षसेन्द्रः Rakshasa king, असौ that, सुरेन्द्रशत्रुः enemy of Indra, ब्रह्मास्त्रम् Brahmastram, आश्रित्य secured, हरिसैन्यम् Vanara army, निपातयित्वा having pained, अस्मान् by that, शितैः sharp, शरैः arrows, प्रसक्तम् using that power, अर्दयति tormenting.

text: स्वयम्भुवा दत्तवरो महात्मा खमास्थितो ऽन्तर्हितभीमकायः । कथं नु शक्यो युधि नष्टदेहो निहन्तुमद्येन्द्रजिदुद्यतास्त्रः ॥६-७३-६४॥
translation: "How can it be possible now to destroy that great Indrajith who is conferred with boons of invincibility by the creator Brahma, who is steadfast and is concealed in dreadful form with weapons uplifted?"
word_meanings: स्वयम्भूवा creator, दत्तवरः who is conferred with boon of invincibility, महात्मान great, समाहितः steadfast, अन्तर्हितभीमकायः concealed in dreadful form, युधि in combat, नष्टदेहः body not visible, उद्यतास्त्रः with weapons uplifted, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, अद्य now, निहन्तुम् to destroy, कथम् how can it be, शक्यः possible.

text: मन्ये स्वयम्भूर्भगवानचिन्त्यो यस्यैतदस्त्रं प्रभवश्च यो ऽस्य । बाणावपातांस्त्वमिहाद्य धीमन् मया सहाव्यग्रमनाः सहस्व ॥६-७३-६५॥
translation: "This weapon of him (Indrajith) is that of the glorious creator and is presided by Him. By that reason he is inconceivable. O! Wise Lakshmana, remain calm and undisturbed at this hail of arrows."
word_meanings: एतत् this, अस्त्रम् weapon, यस्य his, यः that which, अस्य whose, प्रभवः glorious, भगवान् god, स्वयम्भुः creator, अच्नित्यः inconceivable, मन्ये remain calm, धीमन् wise, त्वम् you, इह here, अद्य now, अव्यग्रमनाः undisturbed, बाणावपातम् hail of arrows, मयासह with me, सहस्व tolerate.

text: प्रच्छादयत्येष हि राक्षसेन्द्रः सर्वा दिशः सायकवृष्टिजालैः । एतच्च सर्वं पतिताग्र्यशूरं न भ्राजते वानरराजसैन्यम् ॥६-७३-६६॥
translation: "This Rakshasa king is covered thickly with volley of arrows on all sides. Able warriors of Vanaras are falling and not happy."
word_meanings: सर्वाधिकः all sides, एषः in that way, राक्षसेन्द्रः Rakshasa king, सायकवृष्टिजालैः with volley of arrows, प्रच्छादयतु covering thickly, पतिताग्य्रशूरम् able warriors falling, एतत् this, सर्वम् all, वानरराजसैन्यम् Vanara king's army, च भ्राजते not shining.

text: आवां तु दृष्ट्वा पतितौ विसञ्ज्ञौ निवृत्तयुद्धौ गतरोषहर्षो । ध्रुवं प्रवेक्ष्यत्यमरारिवासमसौ समादाय रणाग्रलक्ष्मीम् ॥६-७३-६७॥
translation: "This Indrajith is desisting from comb at on seeing us. As the Vanaras have lost pride and happiness and fallen into unconscious state, he would surely think that he has attained prosperity after victory in war and surely enter Lanka, the abode of enemies of god."
word_meanings: असौ to us, निवृत्तयुद्धौ desisted from combat, गतरोषहर्षे lost pride and happiness, विसंज्ञौ lost consciousness, पतितौ fallen, आवाम् both of us, दृष्टवा seeing, रणाग्य्रलक्ष्मीम् attained prosperity after war, समादाय come, ध्रुवम् surely, अमरारिवासम् abode of enemies of gods, प्रवेक्ष्यति will enter.

text: ततस्तु ताविन्द्रजिदस्त्रजालैर्बभूवतुस्तत्र तथा विशस्तौ । स चापि तौ तत्र विदर्शयित्वा ननाद हर्षाद्युधि राक्षसेन्द्रः ॥६-७३-६८॥
translation: Seeing the two princes severed and fallen down struck by the net of arrows of Indrajith, he roared happily in the battle.
word_meanings: ततः then, तौ the two, इन्द्रजितः Indrajith, अस्त्रजालैः net of arrows, तत्रthere, तथा that way, विशस्तौ fallen down, बभूवतुः severed, सः he, राक्षसेन्द्रश्चापि even the Rakshasa king, तत्र there, तौ the two, विदर्शयित्वा seeing them, युधि battle, हर्षात् happy, ननाद roared.

text: स तत्तदा वानरसैन्यमेवं रामं च सङ्ख्ये सह लक्ष्मणेन । विषादयित्वा सहसा विवेश पुरीं दशग्रीवभुजाभिगुप्ताम् ॥६-७३-६९॥
translation: Thereafter Vanara army withdrew from the battle along with Rama and Lakshmana. Indrajith for his part moved to the abode protected by Ravana's arms, while being praised. He at once entered the city happily and related everything to the father. ।। इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेत्रिसप्ततितमस्सर्गः ।। This is the Seventy third sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by Sage Valmiki.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, सः he, तदा then, वानरसैन्यम् Vanara army, लक्ष्मणेनसह accompanied by Lakshmana, रामं च and Rama, सङ्ख्ये from the battle, एवम् in that way, विषादयित्वा withdrew, यातुधानैः moved to abode, संस्तूयमानः while being praised, दशग्रीवभुजाभिगुप्ताम् protected by Ravana's arms, पुरीम् city, सहसा at once, विवेश entered, हृष्टितः happily, सर्वम् all, पित्रे to father, अभ्वुवाद related.

text: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे त्रिसप्ततितमः सर्गः ॥ ७३ ॥६-७३-७०॥
तयोस्तदा सादितयो रणाग्रे मुमोह सैन्यं हरिपुङ्गवानाम् । सुग्रीवनीलाङ्गदजाम्बवन्तो न चापि किञ्चित् प्रतिपेदिरे ते ॥६-७४-१॥
translation: The two brothers (Rama and Lakshmana) become unconscious in the forefront of the battle the monkey leaders lose senses. Sugriva, Neela, Angada and Jambavantha did not know What to do.
word_meanings: रणाग्रे in the forefront of the battle, तदा then, तयोः both, सादितयोः unconscious, हरिपुङ्गवानाम् monkey leaders, सैन्यम् army, मुमोह lost senses, ते they, सुग्रीवनीलाङ्गदजाम्बवन्तोऽपि Sugriva, Neela, Angada and Jambavantha, किञ्चित् indeed, न प्रतिपेदिरे not known what to do.

text: ततो विषण्णं समवेक्ष्य सैन्यं विभीषणो बुद्धिमतां वरिष्ठः । उवाच शाखामृगराजवीरानाश्वासयन्नप्रतिमैर्वचोभिः ॥६-७४-२॥
translation: Thereafter, foremost among the wise, Vibheeshana observing the despondency of the monkey leaders spoke to them reassuring in incomparable words.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, बुद्धिमताम् wise, वरिष्ठः foremost, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, विषण्णम् despondent, सैन्यम् army, समवेक्ष्य observing, अप्रतिमैः incomparable, वचोभिः words, शाखामृगराजवीरान् the monkey leaders, आश्वासयन् reassuring, उवाच spoke.

text: मा भैष्ट नास्त्यत्र विषादकालो यदार्यपुत्रौ ह्यवशौ विषण्णौ । स्वयम्भुवो वाक्यमथोद्वहन्तौ यत् सादिताविन्द्रजिदस्त्रजालैः ॥६-७४-३॥
translation: "O Noble men! Do not fear. Rama and Lakshmana are afflicted by Indrajith's volley of arrows and have lost senses. They are despondent to honour the statement of the creator not otherwise."
word_meanings: आर्यपुत्रौ noble men, स्वयम्भुवः creator, वाक्यम् statement, उद्वहन्तौ to honour, अथ now, इन्द्रजित् Indrajith, अस्त्रजालैः network of arrows, यत् that which, सादितौ helpless, यत् that, अवशौ lost senses, विषण्णौ despondent, माभैष्ट you need not fear, तत्रthere, विषादकालः sorrowful, नास्ति not.

text: तस्मै तु दत्तं परमास्त्रमेतत् स्वयम्भुवा ब्राह्मममोघवेगम् । तन्मानयन्तौ युधि राजपुत्रौ निपातितौ को ऽत्र विषादकालः ॥६-७४-४॥
translation: To him (Indrajith), the creator has conferred this weapon of Brahma endowed with terrific speed. To respect the missile both the princes have fallen. Why do you grieve?
word_meanings: तस्मै to him, एतत् this, अमोघवेगम् terrific speed, ब्राह्मंपरमास्त्रम् Brahma's weapon, स्वयम्भुवा creator, दत्तम् conferred, तत् that, मानयन्तौ to respect, राजपुत्रौ the princes, युधि in battle, निपातितौ fallen, अत्र there, विषादकालः to grieve for, कः why.

text: ब्राह्ममस्त्रं ततो धीमान् मानयित्वा तु मारुतिः । विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा हनुमांस्तमथाब्रवीत् ॥६-७४-५॥
translation: Thereafter, hearing Vibheeshana's words, wise Hanuman spoke this with respect to the missile of Brahma.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, धीमान् wise, मारुतिः Maruthi, हनूमान् Hanuman, ब्राह्मम् Brahma, अस्त्रम् missile, मानयित्वा to respect, विभीषणवचः Vibheeshana's words, श्रुत्वा hearing, अथ this, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: एतस्मिन्निहते सैन्ये वानराणां तरस्विनाम् । यो यो धारयते प्राणांस्तन्तमाश्वासयावहै ॥६-७४-६॥
translation: "Whoever is strong among Vanaras, have been struck and are alive breathing among the Vanaras. Let us restore their confidence."
word_meanings: एतन्निहते who has been struck, तरस्विनाम् who are strong, वानराणाम् Vanaras, अस्मिन् those, सैन्ये army, यःयः who so ever, प्राणान् are with life, धारयते breathing, तंतम् all of them, आश्वासयाम restore confidence.

text: तावुभौ युगपद्वीरौ हनुमद्राक्षसोत्तमौ । उल्काहस्तौ तदा रात्रौ रणशीर्षे विचेरतुः ॥६-७४-७॥
translation: The two heroes, Hanuman and Vibheeshana, and the foremost of Rakshasas with torch in hand searched for the left over Vanaras in the battlefield.
word_meanings: वीरौ heroes, तौ those, उभौ two, हनूमद्राक्षसोत्तमौ Hanuman and foremost of Rakshasas (Vibheeshana), तदा then, रात्रौ night, उल्काहस्तौ torch in hand, रणशीर्षे left in the battlefield, विचेरतुः searched.

text: भिन्नलाङ्गूलहस्तोरुपादाङ्गुलिशिरोधरैः । स्रवद्भिः क्षतजं गात्रैः प्रस्रवद्भिस्ततस्ततः ॥६-७४-८॥
translation: Two of them saw the ground covered with Vanaras of mountainlike forms, who had fallen with tails cut off, some with broken thighs, broken legs and fingers, necks severed, letting off blood, discharging urine and glowing weapons lying on the ground.
word_meanings: भिन्नलाङ्गूलहस्तोरुपादाङ्गुलिशिरोधरैः tails cut off, hand severed, some with broken thighs, legs and fingers, गात्रैः necks, क्षतजम् cut off, स्रवद्भिः letting out blood, प्रस्रवद्भिः discharging urine, समन्ततः all over, पतितैः fallen, पर्वताकारैः of mountain form, वानरैः Vanaras, अभिसङ्कुलाम् filled with, पतितैः fallen, दीप्तेः glowing, शस्त्रैश्च weapons, वसुन्धराम् on the ground, ददृशाते saw.

text: पतितैः पर्वताकारैर्वानरैरभिसङ्कुलाम् । शस्त्रैश्च पतितैर्दीप्तैर्ददृशाते वसुन्धराम् ॥६-७४-९॥
translation: Two of them saw the ground covered with Vanaras of mountainlike forms, who had fallen with tails cut off, some with broken thighs, broken legs and fingers, necks severed, letting off blood, discharging urine and glowing weapons lying on the ground.
word_meanings: भिन्नलाङ्गूलहस्तोरुपादाङ्गुलिशिरोधरैः tails cut off, hand severed, some with broken thighs, legs and fingers, गात्रैः necks, क्षतजम् cut off, स्रवद्भिः letting out blood, प्रस्रवद्भिः discharging urine, समन्ततः all over, पतितैः fallen, पर्वताकारैः of mountain form, वानरैः Vanaras, अभिसङ्कुलाम् filled with, पतितैः fallen, दीप्तेः glowing, शस्त्रैश्च weapons, वसुन्धराम् on the ground, ददृशाते saw.

text: सुग्रीवमङ्गदं नीलं शरभं गन्धमादनम् । गवाक्षं च सुषेणं च वेगदर्शिनमाहुकम् ॥६-७४-१०॥
translation: Vibheeshana and Hanuman saw in the battlefield Sugriva, Angada, Neela, Sarabha, Gandhamadana, Gavaksha, Sushena, Vegadarsi, Ahuka, Mainda, Nala, Jyothimukha, Dwivida and Panasa struck down.
word_meanings: विभीषणः Vibheeshana, हनूमान् च and Hanuman, रणे in battle, हतान् struck down, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, अङ्गदम् Angada, नीलम् Neela, शरभम् Sarabha, गन्धमादनम् Gandhamadanam, गवाक्षम् Gavaksha, सुषेणं च and Sushena, वेगदर्शिनमाहुकम् Vegadarsi, Ahuka, मैन्दम् Mainda, नळम् Nala, ज्योतिमुखम् Jyothimukha, द्विविदम् Dwivida, पनसंतथा Panasa, ददृशाते saw.

text: मैन्दं नलं ज्योतिमुखं द्विविदं पनसं तथा । एतांश्चान्यांस्ततो वीरौ ददृशाते हतान् रणे ॥६-७४-११॥
translation: Vibheeshana and Hanuman saw in the battlefield Sugriva, Angada, Neela, Sarabha, Gandhamadana, Gavaksha, Sushena, Vegadarsi, Ahuka, Mainda, Nala, Jyothimukha, Dwivida and Panasa struck down.
word_meanings: विभीषणः Vibheeshana, हनूमान् च and Hanuman, रणे in battle, हतान् struck down, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, अङ्गदम् Angada, नीलम् Neela, शरभम् Sarabha, गन्धमादनम् Gandhamadanam, गवाक्षम् Gavaksha, सुषेणं च and Sushena, वेगदर्शिनमाहुकम् Vegadarsi, Ahuka, मैन्दम् Mainda, नळम् Nala, ज्योतिमुखम् Jyothimukha, द्विविदम् Dwivida, पनसंतथा Panasa, ददृशाते saw.

text: सप्तषष्टिर्हताः कोट्यो वानराणां तरस्विनाम् । अह्नः पञ्चमशेषेणः वल्लभेन स्वयम्भुवः ॥६-७४-१२॥
translation: By the creator's missile Indrajith struck down sixtyseven crores of strong Vanaras between the fifth and last part of the day.
word_meanings: स्वयम्भुवः creator's, वल्लभेन by Indrajith, अह्नः struck down, पञ्चमशेषेण fifth and last period of the day, तरस्विनाम् strong, वानराणाम् Vanaras, सप्तषष्टिः sixtyseven, कोट्यः crores, हताः killed.

text: सागरौघनिभं भीमं दृष्ट्वा बाणार्दितं बलम् । मार्गते जाम्बवन्तं स हनुमान् सविभीषणः ॥६-७४-१३॥
translation: Vibheeshana and Hanuman seeing the ocean of Vanara army and the glowing arrows on them, looked for Jambavantha.
word_meanings: सविभीषणः Vibheeshana, हनूमान् Hanuman, सागरौघनिभम् ? resembling ocean, बाणार्दितम् glowing arrows, बलम् army, दृष्टवा seeing, जाम्बवन्तम् Jambavantha, मार्गते looked for.

text: स्वभावजरया युक्तं वृद्धं शरशतैश्चितम् । प्रजापतिसुतं वीरं शाम्यन्तमिव पावकम् ॥६-७४-१४॥
translation: Paulastya (Vibheeshana of Paulastya clan), seeing the son of Prajapathi (Jambavan), who by nature was wise and aged, afflicted by hundreds of arrows, like a cooling fire sacrifice, went close by and spoke these words.
word_meanings: पौलस्त्यः Paulastaya, स्वभावजरया by nature, युक्तम् wise, वृद्धम् aged, शरशतैः hundreds of arrows, चितम् pained, शाम्यन्तम् cooling, पावकम् इव like fire, वीरम् heroic, प्रजापतिसुतम् son of Prajapathi, दृष्टवा seeing, तमुपसङ्ग्रम्य going close, वाक्यम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: दृष्ट्वा तमुपसङ्गम्य पौलस्त्यो वाक्यमब्रवीत् । कच्चिदार्य शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः प्राणा न ध्वंसितास्तव ॥६-७४-१५॥
विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा जाम्बवानृक्षपुङ्गवः । कृच्छ्रादभ्युद्गिरन् वाक्यमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥६-७४-१६॥
translation: "O Noble Jambavan! Indeed, your life has not been afflicted with these sharp arrows." Hearing this, Jambavan uttered these words with difficulty."
word_meanings: आर्य noble, तीक्ष्णैः pointed, शरैः arrows, तव yours, प्राणाः life, कच्चित् indeed, ऋक्षपुङ्गवः foremost of Bears, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, विभीषणवचः Vibheeshana's words, श्रुत्वा hearing, कृच्छ्रात् difficulty, वाक्यम् words, अभ्युगदिरन् uttering, इदंवचनम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke।।

text: नैर्ऋतेन्द्र महावीर्य स्वरेण त्वा ऽभिलक्षये । पीड्यमानः शितैर्बाणैर्न त्वां पश्यामि चक्षुषा ॥६-७४-१७॥
translation: "Great hero, Vibheeshana! I recognise you by your voice. Pierced with sharp arrows I am not able to see you."
word_meanings: महावीर्य great hero, नैरृतेन्द्र ruler of Rakshasas, स्वरेण by voice, त्वा your, अभिलक्ष्ये, शितैः sharp, बाणैः arrows, पीड्यमान pierced, त्वाम् you, चक्षुषा eyes, नपश्यामि not see.

text: अञ्जना सुप्रजा येन मातरिश्वा च नैर्ऽत । हनुमान् वानरश्रेष्ठः प्राणान् धारयते क्वचित् ॥६-७४-१८॥
translation: Vibheeshana (Rakshasa)! Indeed, Hanuman, the foremost of Vanaras, by whose birth, Anjana and Supraja are blessed as parents, are they alive?
word_meanings: नैरृत Rakshasa, येन by whom, अञ्जना Anjana, सुप्रजाः Supraja, मातरिश्वाच blessed as parents, वानरश्रेष्ठः of Rakshasa, हनुमान् Hanuman, क्वचित् indeed, प्राणान् life, धारयते alive.

text: श्रुत्वा जाम्बवतो वाक्यमुवाचेदं विभीषणः । आर्यपुत्रावतिक्रम्य कस्मात् पृच्छसि मारुतिम् ॥६-७४-१९॥
translation: After hearing Jambavantha, Vibheeshana said "Noble son, why are you enquiring about Hanuman?"
word_meanings: जाम्बवतः Jambavatha, वाक्यम् words, श्रुत्वा hearing, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, इदम् these, वाक्यम् words, उवाच said, आर्यपुत्रौ noble son, अतिक्रम्य leaving, मारुतिम् Hanuman, कस्मात् why, पृच्छसि enquiring.

text: नैव राजनि सुग्रीवे नाङ्गदे नापि राघवे । आर्य सन्दर्शितः स्नेहो यथा वायुसुते परः ॥६-७४-२०॥
translation: "Noble one! You are showing affection to Hanuman but not to King Sugriva, or Angada or even Raghava?"
word_meanings: आर्य noble, वायुसुते son of wind god, यथा that way, परः others, स्नेहः affection, सन्दर्शितः showing, राजा king, सुग्रीवे Sugriva, नैव not, आङ्गदे Angada, , राघवेऽपि even Raghava

text: विभीषणवचः श्रुत्वा जाम्बवान् वाक्यमब्रवीत् । शृणु नैर्ऋतशार्दूल यस्मात् पृच्छामि मारुतिम् ॥६-७४-२१॥
translation: On hearing Vibheeshana, the tiger among Rakshasas, Jambavan replied, "Listen why I enquired about Maruthi."
word_meanings: जाम्बवान् Jambavan, विभीषणवचः Vibheeshana's words, श्रुत्वा hearing, वाक्यम् spoken, अब्रवीत् said, नैरृतशार्दूल tiger among Rakshasas, मारुतिम् Maruthi, यस्मात् your, पृच्छामि enquiry, शृणु listen.

text: तस्मिन् जीवति वीरे तु हतमप्यहतं बलम् । हनुमत्युज्झितप्राणे जीवन्तो ऽपि वयं हताः ॥६-७४-२२॥
translation: If this hero Hanuman is alive, even if the army is destroyed and if we are alive, it is like dead only.
word_meanings: तस्मिन्वीरे if this hero, जीवितliving, हतमपि destroyed, बलम् army, अहतम् intact, हनूमति Hanuman, उज्झितप्राणे is still alive, वयम् we, जीवन्तःअपि living also, हृताः like dead only.

text: धरते मारुतिस्तात मारुतप्रतिमो यदि । वैश्वानरसमो वीर्ये जीविताशा ततो भवेत् ॥६-७४-२३॥
translation: "Dear! If Hanuman who is equal to wind god, resembles Vyshvanara (God of fire) is breathing, then we can hope to live (for life)."
word_meanings: तात dear, मारुतप्रतिमः equal to wind god, वीर्ये in valiance, वैश्वानरसमः equal to Vysvanara's, मारुतिः Maruthi, धरतेयदि is breathing, ततः then, जीविताशा hope for life, भवेत् will be.

text: ततो वृद्धमुपागम्य नियमेनाभ्यवादयत् । गृह्य जाम्बवतः पादौ हनुमान् मारुतात्मजः ॥६-७४-२४॥
translation: Thereafter, Hanuman the son of the wind god coming close to the aged Jambavan clasped his feet in accordance with tradition and greeted him.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, मारुतात्मजः son of wind god, हनूमान् Hanuman, वृद्धम् aged, उपागम्य coming close, नियमेना in accordance with tradition, जाम्बवतः Jambavantha, पादौ feet, गृह्य clasped, अभ्यवादयत् greeted.

text: श्रुत्वा हनुमतो वाक्यं तथापि व्यथितेन्द्रियः । पुनर्जातमिवात्मानं मन्यते स्मर्क्षपुङ्गवः ॥६-७४-२५॥
translation: Then again, Jambavan whose senses were affected, on hearing the statement of Hanuman, the foremost of Vanaras, felt as though he was born again.
word_meanings: तदा then, अपि again, व्यथितेन्द्रियः whose senses were affected, प्लवगोत्तमः foremost of Vanaras, हनुमतः Hanuman, वाक्यम् statement, श्रुत्वा hearing, आत्मानम् himself, पुनः again, पुन once again born, मन्यते felt।।

text: ततो ऽब्रवीन्महातेजा हनुमन्तं स जाम्बवान् ॥६-७४-२६॥
translation: Then brilliant Jambavan spoke to Hanuman, the tiger among Vanaras, on reaching him. "You ought to protect the Vanaras."
word_meanings: ततः then, महातेजा brilliant, सः he, जाम्बवान् Jambavan, हनूमन्तम् to Hanuman, अब्रवीत् spoke, हरिशार्दूल tiger of Vanaras, आगच्छ reaching, वानरान् Vanaras, त्रातुम् protect, अर्हसि you ought.

text: आगच्छ हरिशार्दूल वानरांस्त्रातुमर्हसि । नान्यो विक्रमपर्याप्तस्त्वमेषां परमः सखा ॥६-७४-२७॥
त्वत्पराक्रमकालो ऽयं नान्यं पश्यामि कञ्चन । ऋक्षवानरवीराणामनीकानि प्रहर्षय । विशल्यौ कुरु चाप्येतौ सादितौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ॥६-७४-२८॥
translation: For the Bears and Vanaras, create excessive happiness. For Rama and Lakshmana who are unconscious, make them comfortable.
word_meanings: ऋक्ष्वानरवीराणाम् for the Bears and Vanaras, अनीकानि excessive, प्रहर्षय happiness, सादितौ unconscious, एतौ for them, रामलक्ष्मणौ च and for Rama and Lakshmana, विशल्यौ comfortable, कुरु make them.

text: गत्वा परममध्वानमुपर्युपरि सागरम् । हिमवन्तं नगश्रेष्ठं हनुमन् गन्तुमर्हसि ॥६-७४-२९॥
translation: "Hanuman, you ought to go very far over the sea to the Himalayas, the highest mountain."
word_meanings: हनूमान् Hanuman, सागरम् उपर्युपरि over the sea, परमम् very, अध्वानम् far, गत्वा going, नगश्रेष्ठम् highest mountain, हिमवन्तम् Himalayas, गन्तुम् going, अर्हसि ought to.

text: ततः काञ्चनमत्युच्चमृषभं पर्वतोत्तमम् । कैलासशिखरं चापि द्रक्ष्यस्यरिनिषूदन ॥६-७४-३०॥
translation: "O Destroyer of enemies! there on top you will see the foremost of the mountain Rshaba and on the peak of Kailasa."
word_meanings: अरिनिषूदन destroyer enemies, ततः there, काञ्चनम् golden, अत्युग्रम् top of, पर्वतोत्तमम् foremost of the mountains, ऋषभम् Rshaba, कैलासशिखरं च on the peak of Kailasa, द्रक्ष्यसि will see।।

text: तयोः शिखरयोर्मध्ये प्रदीप्तमतुलप्रभम् । सर्वौषधियुतं वीर द्रक्ष्यस्योषधिपर्वतम् ॥६-७४-३१॥
translation: "Heroic Hanuman! In the middle of those two mountains, you will see a highly splendid mountain covered with all kinds of medicinal herbs."
word_meanings: वीरhero, तयोः those two, शिखयोः peaks, मध्ये middle, प्रदीप्तम् glowing, अतुलप्रभम् very splendid, सर्यौषधियुतम् all kinds of medicinal herbs, ओषधिपर्वतम् mountain covered with medicinal herbs, द्रक्ष्यसि will see.

text: तस्य वानरशार्दूल चतस्रो मूर्ध्निसम्भवाः । द्रक्ष्यस्योषधयो दीप्ता दीपयन्त्यो दिशो दश ॥६-७४-३२॥
translation: "O Tiger among monkeys! You will see on the summit four medicinal herbs growing there illuminating the ten directions."
word_meanings: वनरशार्दूल tiger of monkeys, तस्य your, मूर्ध्नि on the summit, सम्भवाः growing there, दीप्ताः illuminating, चतस्रः four, ओषधयः medicinal hebs, दशो ten, दीपय्नत्यो flaming, द्रक्ष्यसि will see.

text: मृतसञ्जीवनीं चैव विशल्यकरणीमपि । सावर्ण्यकरणीं चैव सन्धानकरणीं तथा ॥६-७४-३३॥
translation: "Mrtasanjivani, Visalyakarani, Suvarnakarani, Sandhani, all these herbs are grown there."
word_meanings: मृतसञ्जीवनींचैव Mrtasanjivani (restoring life of the dead), विशल्यकरणीम् अपि Visalyakarani (capable of healing wounds inflicted by weapons), सुवर्णकरणींचैव Suvarna karani (restoring original complexion after injury), सन्धानम् Sandhani (capable of joining broken bones), करणीम् herbs, तथा that way.

text: ताः सर्वा हनुमन् गृह्य क्षिप्रमागन्तुमर्हसि । आश्वासय हरीन् प्राणैर्योज्य गन्धवहात्मज ॥६-७४-३४॥
translation: "Hanuman, taking the four herbs you, the son of wind god ought to return immediately with the speed of wind, to unite the life of the monkeys and reassure."
word_meanings: हनुमन् Hanuman, ताः you, सर्वाः all, गृह्य taking, क्षिप्रम् immediately, आगन्तुम् return, अर्हसि ought to, गन्धवहात्मज son of wind god, हरीन् monkeys, प्राणैः life, योज्य uniting, आश्वसय reassuring.

text: श्रुत्वा जाम्बवतो वाक्यं हनुमान् हरिपुङ्गवः । आपूर्यत बलोद्धर्षैस्तोयवेगैरिवार्णवः ॥६-७४-३५॥
translation: "Hearing the instruction of Jambavantha, the son of the wind god, infused with wind speed as the ocean, heaves with the force of wind increasing his strength fully."
word_meanings: मारुतात्मजः son of wind god, हनुमन् Hanuman, जाम्बवतः Jambvatha, वाक्यम् instruction, श्रुत्वा on hearing, अर्णवः ocean,, स्तोयवेगैःइव like infused with wind speed, बलोद्धर्षैः increased his strength, आपूर्यत completely.

text: स पर्वततटाग्रस्थः पीडयन् पर्वतोत्तमम् । हनुमान् दृश्यते वीरो द्वितीय इव पर्वतः ॥६-७४-३६॥
translation: Standing on the summit of the foremost of the mountains, hero Hanuman pressing his feet seemed like a second mountain
word_meanings: पर्वतताटाग्रस्थः standing on top of the mountain, पर्वतोत्तमम् foremost of the mountains, पीडयन् pressing, वीरः hero, सःहनूमान् that Hanuman, द्वितीय second, पर्वतःइव like mountain, दृश्यते appeared.

text: हरिपादविनिर्भग्नो निषसाद स पर्वतः । न शशाक तदा ऽ ऽत्मानं सोढुं भृशनिपीडितः ॥६-७४-३७॥
translation: Trodden by the feet of Hanuman that mountain pressed forcibly by himself could not bear his strength.
word_meanings: हरिपादविनिर्भग्नः trodden by the feet of Hanuman, सःपर्वतः that mountain, भृशपीडितः sank down, तदा then, आत्मानम् himself, वोढुम् forcibly pressed, न शशाक not bear, निषसाद his strength.

text: तस्य पेतुर्नगा भूमौ हरिवेगाच्च जज्वलुः । शृङ्गाणि च व्यशीर्यन्त पीडितस्य हनूमता ॥६-७४-३८॥
translation: Oppressed by the speed of Hanuman, the mountain fell to the ground and by the impetuosity of his speed the mountain got shattered.
word_meanings: हनूनता Hanuman, पीडितस्य pressurised, तस्य by his, नगाः mountain, हरिवेगात् by the speed Hanuman, भूमौ ground, पेतुः fallen, जज्वलुः च started fire, शृङ्गाणि च by the impetuosity of his speed, व्यशीर्यन्त shattered.

text: तस्मिन् सम्पीड्यमाने तु भग्नद्रुमाशिलातले । न शेकुर्वानराः स्थातुं घूर्णमाने नगोत्तमे ॥६-७४-३९॥
translation: As the foremost of the mountain got oppressed it crushed the trees and rocks on it and Vanaras were unable to stand on it.
word_meanings: सम्पीड्यमाने began to get oppressed, भग्नद्रुमशिलातले trees and rocks broken, तस्मिन् नगोत्तमे that foremost of mountain, घूर्णमाने crushed, वानराः Vanaras, स्थातुम् to stand, न शेकुः not possible.

text: सा घूर्णितमहाद्वारा प्रभग्नगृहगोपुरा । लङ्का त्रासाकुला रात्रौ प्रवृत्तेवाभवत्तदा ॥६-७४-४०॥
translation: Then the mighty gates of Lanka shaking, homes shattered, stricken with fear that night it seemed Lanka was dancing.
word_meanings: तदा then, घूर्णितमहाद्वारा mighty gates shaken, प्रभग्नगृहगोपुरा shattered the homes and gates, त्रासाकुला stricken with fear, लङ्का Lanka, रात्रौ night, प्रवृत्तेव dancing and shaking, अभवत् seemed.

text: पृथिवीधरसङ्काशो विपीड्य धरणीधरम् । पृथिवीं क्षोभयामास सार्णवां मारुतत्मजः ॥६-७४-४१॥
translation: Son of the wind god, who was like a mountain supported by earth, pressing hard caused the earth with its ocean to shake.
word_meanings: पृथिवीधरसङ्काशः like a mountain, मारुतात्मजः wind god's son, धरणीधरम् supported by earth, निपीड्य pressing, सार्णवाम् ocean, पृथिवीम् earth, क्षोभयामास made to shake.

text: आरुरोह तदा तस्माद्धरिर्मलयपर्वतम् । मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशं नानाप्रस्रवणाकुलम् ॥६-७४-४२॥
translation: From that mountain the monkey sprang to Malaya Mountain which was like Meru and Mandara mountains. It was set with various springs, covered with various trees and creepers, abounded with lotuses, frequented by Devas, Gandharvas. It was sixty yojanas high and visited by Vidhyadharas, celestial nymphs, and sages, filled with various species of deer and numerous caves. Yakshas, Gandharvas, and Kinnaras were living there. There the son of the wind god grew in size like a cloud.
word_meanings: तदा then, हरिः monkey, तस्मात्? from that, मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशम् resembling Meru and Mandara mountains, नानाप्रस्रवणाकुलम् set with various springs, नाना es, देवगन्धर्वैः Devas and Gandharvas, षष्टियोजनम् ? sixty yojanas, उच्छ्रितम् high, विद्याधरैः by Vidhyadharas, मुनिगणैः sages, अप्सरोभिः celestials, निषेवितम् frequented, नानामृगगणाकीर्णम् filled with various species of deer, बहुकन्दरशोभितम् numerous caves, मलयपर्वतम् Malaya mountain, आरुरोह living there, मारुतात्मजः son of windgod, हनूमान् Hanuman, तत्र there, सर्वान् all, यक्षगन्धर्वकिन्नरान् Yakshas, Gandharvas and Kinnaras, आकुलयन् filled with, मेघसङ्काशः like a cloud, ववृधे grew.

text: नानाद्रुमलताकीर्णं विकासिकमलोत्पलम् । सेवितं देवगन्धर्वैः षष्टियोजनमुच्छ्रितम् ॥६-७४-४३॥
translation: From that mountain the monkey sprang to Malaya Mountain which was like Meru and Mandara mountains. It was set with various springs, covered with various trees and creepers, abounded with lotuses, frequented by Devas, Gandharvas. It was sixty yojanas high and visited by Vidhyadharas, celestial nymphs, and sages, filled with various species of deer and numerous caves. Yakshas, Gandharvas, and Kinnaras were living there. There the son of the wind god grew in size like a cloud.
word_meanings: तदा then, हरिः monkey, तस्मात्? from that, मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशम् resembling Meru and Mandara mountains, नानाप्रस्रवणाकुलम् set with various springs, नाना es, देवगन्धर्वैः Devas and Gandharvas, षष्टियोजनम् ? sixty yojanas, उच्छ्रितम् high, विद्याधरैः by Vidhyadharas, मुनिगणैः sages, अप्सरोभिः celestials, निषेवितम् frequented, नानामृगगणाकीर्णम् filled with various species of deer, बहुकन्दरशोभितम् numerous caves, मलयपर्वतम् Malaya mountain, आरुरोह living there, मारुतात्मजः son of windgod, हनूमान् Hanuman, तत्र there, सर्वान् all, यक्षगन्धर्वकिन्नरान् Yakshas, Gandharvas and Kinnaras, आकुलयन् filled with, मेघसङ्काशः like a cloud, ववृधे grew.

text: विद्याधरैर्मुनिगणैरप्सरोभिर्निषेवितम् । नानामृगगणाकीर्णं बहुकन्दरशोभितम् ॥६-७४-४४॥
translation: From that mountain the monkey sprang to Malaya Mountain which was like Meru and Mandara mountains. It was set with various springs, covered with various trees and creepers, abounded with lotuses, frequented by Devas, Gandharvas. It was sixty yojanas high and visited by Vidhyadharas, celestial nymphs, and sages, filled with various species of deer and numerous caves. Yakshas, Gandharvas, and Kinnaras were living there. There the son of the wind god grew in size like a cloud.
word_meanings: तदा then, हरिः monkey, तस्मात्? from that, मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशम् resembling Meru and Mandara mountains, नानाप्रस्रवणाकुलम् set with various springs, नाना es, देवगन्धर्वैः Devas and Gandharvas, षष्टियोजनम् ? sixty yojanas, उच्छ्रितम् high, विद्याधरैः by Vidhyadharas, मुनिगणैः sages, अप्सरोभिः celestials, निषेवितम् frequented, नानामृगगणाकीर्णम् filled with various species of deer, बहुकन्दरशोभितम् numerous caves, मलयपर्वतम् Malaya mountain, आरुरोह living there, मारुतात्मजः son of windgod, हनूमान् Hanuman, तत्र there, सर्वान् all, यक्षगन्धर्वकिन्नरान् Yakshas, Gandharvas and Kinnaras, आकुलयन् filled with, मेघसङ्काशः like a cloud, ववृधे grew.

text: सर्वानाकुलयंस्तत्र यक्षगन्धर्वकिन्नरान् । हनुमान् मेघसङ्काशो ववृधे मारुतात्मजः ॥६-७४-४५॥
translation: From that mountain the monkey sprang to Malaya Mountain which was like Meru and Mandara mountains. It was set with various springs, covered with various trees and creepers, abounded with lotuses, frequented by Devas, Gandharvas. It was sixty yojanas high and visited by Vidhyadharas, celestial nymphs, and sages, filled with various species of deer and numerous caves. Yakshas, Gandharvas, and Kinnaras were living there. There the son of the wind god grew in size like a cloud.
word_meanings: तदा then, हरिः monkey, तस्मात्? from that, मेरुमन्दरसङ्काशम् resembling Meru and Mandara mountains, नानाप्रस्रवणाकुलम् set with various springs, नाना es, देवगन्धर्वैः Devas and Gandharvas, षष्टियोजनम् ? sixty yojanas, उच्छ्रितम् high, विद्याधरैः by Vidhyadharas, मुनिगणैः sages, अप्सरोभिः celestials, निषेवितम् frequented, नानामृगगणाकीर्णम् filled with various species of deer, बहुकन्दरशोभितम् numerous caves, मलयपर्वतम् Malaya mountain, आरुरोह living there, मारुतात्मजः son of windgod, हनूमान् Hanuman, तत्र there, सर्वान् all, यक्षगन्धर्वकिन्नरान् Yakshas, Gandharvas and Kinnaras, आकुलयन् filled with, मेघसङ्काशः like a cloud, ववृधे grew.

text: पद्भ्यां तु शैलमापीड्य वडवामुखवन्मुखम् । विवृत्योग्रं ननादोच्चैस्त्रासयन्निव राक्षसान् ॥६-७४-४६॥
translation: Pressing the mountain hard by his feet, opening his largemouth wide, he roared like Rakshasas to make Rakshasas fearful.
word_meanings: शैलम् mountain, पद्भ्याम् by feet, आविध्य pressing, बडबामुखवत् opening his largemouth, उग्रम् angry, मुखम् face, विवृत्य opening, इवराक्षसान् like Rakshasas, त्रासयन् fearful, उच्चैः loudly, ननाद roared.

text: तस्य नानद्यमानस्य श्रुत्वा निनदमद्भुतम् । लङ्कास्था राक्षसाः सर्वे न शेकुः स्पन्दितुं भयात् ॥६-७४-४७॥
translation: All the Rakshasas in Lanka hearing the loud roar of Hanuman were afraid and could not stir from there.
word_meanings: नानाद्यमानस्य by the roaring, तस्य its, उत्तमम् loud, निनदम् sound, श्रुत्वा hearing, लङ्कास्थाः Lanka's, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, सर्वे all, भयात् in fear, स्पन्दितुम् stir, न शेकुः not possible.

text: नमस्कृत्वा ऽथ रामाय मारुतिर्भीमविक्रमः । राघवार्थे परं कर्म समीहतपरन्तपः ॥६-७४-४८॥
translation: Maruti, scorcher of enemies, endowed with terrific valour offered prayers to Sri Rama and made up his mind to embark on the stupendous task for Raghava.
word_meanings: भीमविक्रमः of terrific valour, परन्तपः scorcher of enemies, मारुतिः Maruthi, रामाय Rama's, नमस्कृत्वा offering his prayer, राघवार्थे for Raghava, परम् stupendous, कर्म task, समीहत made up his mind.

text: स पुच्छमुद्यम्य भुजङ्गकल्पं विनम्य पृष्ठं श्रवणे निकुञ्ज्य । विवृत्य वक्त्रं वडवामुखाभमापुप्लुवे व्योमनि चण्डवेगः ॥६-७४-४९॥
translation: Raising his tail which resembled a serpent, bending his back, and ears, opening his mouth wide expounded Hanuman sprang up at terrific speed.
word_meanings: सः he, भुजङ्गकल्पम् resembling a serpent, पुच्छम् bending his back, उद्यम्य raising, पृष्ठम् tail, विनम्य bent down, श्रवणे ears, निकुञ्च्य bending, बडबामुखाभम् opening widely, वक्त्रम् mouth, विवृत्य expounded, निचण्डवेगः terrible speed, व्योम्नि sky, आपुफ्लुवे sprang up.

text: स वृक्षषण्डांस्तरसा जहार शैलान् शिलाः प्राकृतवानरांश्च । बाहूरुवेगोद्धतसम्प्रणुन्नास्ते क्षीणवेगाः सलिले निपेतुः ॥६-७४-५०॥
translation: By the speed of his arms and thighs clusters of branches of trees, mountains, rocks, and common monkeys were attracted, and with reduction of speed along the way the rocks fell.
word_meanings: स: he, तरसा speed, वृक्षखण्डान् clusters of trees, शैलान् mountains, शिलाः rocks, प्राकृतवानरांश्च common monkeys, जहार attracted, बाहूरुवेगोद्धतसम्प्रणुन्नाः by the speed of his arms and thighs, ते they, क्षीणवेगाः speed reduced, सलिले rocks, निपेतुः fell.

text: तौ प्रसार्योरगभोगकल्पौ भूजौ भुजङ्गारिनिकाशवीर्यः । जगाम मेरुं नगराजमग्र्यं दिशः प्रकर्षन्निव वायुसूनुः ॥६-७४-५२॥
translation: Stretching his arms which resembled coils of serpents, whose valour equalled Garuda, enemy of serpents, as if attracting all the directions went to the summit of the foremost mountain which equalled Meru mountain.
word_meanings: भुजङ्गारिनिकाशवीर्यः whose valour equalled Garuda enemy of serpents, सःवायुसूनुः that son of wind god, उरगभोगकल्पौ resembling coils of serpents, भुजौ arms, प्रसार्य stretching, दिशः directions, प्रकर्षन्निव as if attracting, अग्य्रम् summit, मेरुम् Meru, नगराजम् king of mountains, जगाम went.

text: स सागरं घूर्णितवीचिमालं तदा भृशं भ्रामितसर्वसत्त्वम् । समीक्षमाणः सहसा जगाम चक्रं यथा विष्णुकराग्रमुक्तम् ॥६-७४-५३॥
translation: Observing the ocean whose waves were made to revolve round (by his speed), exceedingly, whose creatures were made to whirl round violently (by the wind force generated by his speed), he went forth like the wheel loosened from Vishnu's hand.
word_meanings: सः he, घूर्णितवीचिमालम् whose waves were made to revolve, तथा that way, अभृशम् exceedingly, भ्रामितसर्वसत्त्वम् whose creatures were made to whirl round, सागरम् ocean, समीक्षमाणः observing, सहसा violently, विष्णुकराग्रमुक्तम् loosened from Vishnu's hand, चक्रंयथा like the wheel of Vishnu, जगाम went.

text: स पर्वतान् वृक्षगणान् सरांसि नदीस्तटाकानि पुरोत्तमानि । स्फीतान् जनान्तानपि सम्प्रवीक्ष्य जगाम वेगात् पितृतुल्यवेगः ॥६-७४-५४॥
translation: Watching the mountains, trees, birds, rivers, tanks, the best of cities, all of them and prosperous people, he went at his father's speed.
word_meanings: पितृतुल्यवेगः like his father in speed, सः he, पर्वतान् mountains, वृक्षगवान् trees, सरांसि birds, नदीः rivers, तटाकानि tanks, पुरोत्तमानि best of cities, तान् them, स्फीतान् prosperous, जनान्तान् अपि people, सम्प्रवीक्ष्य watching, वेगात् speedily, जगाम went.

text: आदित्यपथमाश्रित्य जगाम स गतक्लमः । हनुमांस्त्वरितो वीरः पितृतुल्यपराक्रमः ॥६-७४-५५॥
translation: Hanuman who was equal to his father in prowess, went unwearied, hurriedly in the path of the Sun.
word_meanings: पितुः father, तुल्यपराक्रमः equal in prowess, वीरः heroic, सःहनुमान् that Hanuman, गतक्लमः unwearied, त्वरितः hurriedly, आदित्यपथम् the path of the Sun, आश्रित्य following, जगाम went.

text: जवेन महता युक्तो मारुतिर्मारुतो यथा । जगाम हरिशार्दूलो दिशः शब्देन पूरयन् ॥६-७४-५६॥
translation: Maruthi, the tiger among monkeys went like the wind possessing great speed filling sound in all directions.
word_meanings: हरिशार्दूलः tiger among monkeys, मारुतिः Maruthi, मारुतोयथा like the wind, महता great, जवेन speed, युक्तः possessing, शब्देन sound, दिशः in all directions, पूरयन् filling, जगाम went.

text: स्मरन् जाम्बवतो वाक्यं मारुतिर्वातरंहसा । ददर्श सहसा चापि हिमवन्तं महाकपिः ॥६-७४-५७॥
translation: Going at wind speed, the great monkey Maruthi, remembering Jambavantha's words, reached and sighted the Himalayas.
word_meanings: वातरंहसा going at wind speed, महाकपिः great monkey, मारुतिः Maruthi, जाम्बवतः Jambavantha, वाक्यम् words, स्मरन् remembering, सहसागत्वा reaching speedily, हिमवन्तम् Himalayas, ददर्श sighted.

text: नानाप्रस्रवणोपेतं बहुकन्दरनिर्झरम् । श्वेताभ्रचयसङ्काशैः शिखरैश्चारुदर्शनैः । शोभितं विविधैर्वृक्षैरगमत् पर्वतोत्तमम् ॥६-७४-५८॥
translation: He reached the foremost of mountains, which was adorned with different kinds of springs, many caves and cascades and graced with trees. The peaks were like masses of white autumn clouds graced with splendour and beautiful to look at.
word_meanings: नानाप्रस्रवणोपेतम् adorned with different springs, बहुकंदरनिर्घरम् many caves and cascares, श्वेताभ्रचयसङ्काशैः like masses of white clouds, चारुदर्शनैः beautiful to look at, शिखरैः peak, विविधैः several, वृक्षैः trees, शोभितम् graced with splendour, पर्वतोत्तमम् foremost of mountains, अगमत् reached.

text: स तं समासाद्य महानगेन्द्रमतिप्रवृद्धोत्तमघोरशृङ्गम् । ददर्श पुण्यानि महाश्रमाणि सुरर्षिसङ्घोत्तमसेवितानि ॥६-७४-५९॥
translation: Reaching there he saw the tall and terrifying peaks of the Lord of mountains frequented by Devatas and sages, meritorious hermitages.
word_meanings: सः he, अतिप्रवृद्धोत्तमघोरशृङ्गम् tall and terrifying peaks, तंमहानगेन्द्रम् that Lord of mountains, समासाद्य reaching, सुररिसंघोत्तमसेवितानि frequented by Devatas and sages पुण्यानि meritorious, महाश्रमाणि hermitages, ददर्श saw.

text: स ब्रह्मकोशं रजतालयं च शक्रालयं रुद्रशरप्रमोक्षम् । हयाननं ब्रह्मशिरश्च दीप्तं ददर्श वैवस्वतकिङ्करांश्च ॥६-७४-६०॥
translation: He saw the seat of Brahma, the abode of Rajathanabha, the abode of Indra, the location from which Rudra discharged an arrow (at Tripura), the abode of Lord Hayagriva, and glowing abode of the deity presiding over Brahmastra and Vyvasvatah's attendants.
word_meanings: सः he, भ्रह्मकोशम् seat of Brahma, रजतालयं च the abode of Rajathanabha, शक्रालयम् abode of Indra, रुद्रशरप्रमोक्षम् the location from which Rudra discharged an arrow (at Tripura), हयाननं Lord Hayagriva, दीप्तम् glowing, ब्रह्मशिरः च abode of the deity presiding over Brahmastra, वैवस्वतकिङ्करांश्च Vyvasvatah's attendants, ददर्श witnessed.

text: वज्रालयं वैश्रवणालयं च सूर्यप्रभं सूर्यनिबन्धनं च । ब्रह्मासनं शङ्करकार्मुकं च ददर्श नाभिं च वसुन्धरायाः ॥६-७४-६१॥
translation: He saw Vajralayam (where Brahma gave Indra the thunderbolt), the abode of Kubera shining like the Sun, the spot where the Sun was bound, Brahma's abode and the abode of the bow of Lord Siva, and the earth navel.
word_meanings: वज्रालयम् Vajralayaam (where Brahma gave Indra thunderbolt), सूर्यप्रभम् shining like the Sun, वैश्रवणालयं च the abode of Kubera, सूर्यनिबन्धनं च the spot where Sun was bound, ब्रह्मासनम् Brahma's abode, शङ्करकार्मुकं च the abode of the bow belonging to Lord Siva, वसुन्धरायाः the earth's, नाभिं च navel, ददर्श saw.

text: कैलासमग्र्यं हिमवच्छिलां च तथर्षभं काञ्चनशैलमग्र्यम् । सन्दीप्तसर्वौषधिसम्प्रदीप्तं ददर्श सर्वौषधिपर्वतेन्द्रम् ॥६-७४-६२॥
translation: He saw Kailas, the rocks of Himalayas, that way on the Rshaba the foremost Lord Siva, the golden mountain, and the great mountain on which grew, glowing medicinal herbs.
word_meanings: उग्रम् elevated Siva, कैलासम् Kailas, हिमवच्छिलां च rocks of Himavat, तथा that way, ऋषभम् Rshaba, अग्य्रम् foremost काञ्चनशैलम् golden mountain, सन्दीप्तसर्वौषधिसम्प्रदीप्तम् glowing medicinal herbs illumining, सर्वौषधिपर्वतेन्द्रम् great mountain on which all medicinal herbs were, ददर्श saw.

text: स तं समीक्ष्यानलरश्मिदीप्तं विसिष्मिये वासवदूतसूनुः । आवृत्य तं चौषधिपर्वतेन्द्रं तत्रौषधीनां विचयञ्चकार ॥६-७४-६३॥
translation: Observing the herbs blazing like fire, he was astonished at the herbs on the mountain and went round thinking of the names of herbs (asked by Jambavan).
word_meanings: सः he, अनलरश्मिदीप्तम् blazing like fire, तम् those, समीक्ष्य observed, विसिष्मिये astonished, ओषधिपर्वतेन्द्रम् mountain filled with herbs, आवृत्य going round, तत्र there, ओषधीनाम् names of herbs, विचयम् thinking, चकार went.

text: स योजनसहस्राणि समतीत्य महाकपिः । दिव्यौषधिधरं शैलं व्यचरन्मारुतात्मजः ॥६-७४-६४॥
translation: The great monkey, son of the wind god, having traversed a thousand yojanas began to range the wonderful herbs and went about searching.
word_meanings: महाकपिः great monkey, सःमारुतात्मजः that son of wind god, योजनसहस्राणि a thousand yojanas, समतीत्य having travelled, दिव्यौषधिधरम् began to range the wonderful herbs, शैलम् mountain, व्यचरत् went about searching.

text: महौषध्यस्ततः सर्वास्तस्मिन् पर्वतसत्तमे । विज्ञायार्थिनमायान्तं ततो जग्मुरदर्शनम् ॥६-७४-६५॥
translation: Perceiving a seeker coming for them, the herbs all over the wonderful mountain disappeared.
word_meanings: ततः then, तस्मिन् in that, पर्वतसत्तमे wonderful mountain, सर्वाः all over, महौषध्यः among the herbs, अर्थिनम् seeker, आयान्तम् coming, विज्ञाय perceiving, ततः those, अदर्शनम् disappeared, जग्मुः disappeared.

text: स ता महात्मा हनुमानपश्यन् चुकोप कोपाच्च भृशं ननाद । अमृष्यमाणो ऽग्निनिकाशचक्षुर्महीधरेन्द्रं तमुवाच वाक्यम् ॥६-७४-६६॥
translation: The great soul Hanuman was not able to see, those herbs, became angry and his eyes were burning like fire in anger. He jumped up and roared and said to the lordly mountain.
word_meanings: महात्मा great soul, सःहनुमान् that Hanuman, ताः those, अपश्यन् not able to see, चुकोप became angry, कोपात् in anger, भृशम् jumping up, ननाद च roared, अनगिनिकाशचक्षुः eyes burning like like, अमृष्यमाणः , तम् , महीधरेन्द्रम् to the lordly mountain, वाक्यम् words, उवाच said.

text: किमेतदेवं सुविनिश्चितं ते यद्राघवे नासि कृतानुकम्पः । पश्याद्य मद्बाहुबलाभिभूतो विकीर्णमात्मानमथो नगेन्द्र ॥६-७४-६७॥
translation: "O King of mountains! You are not showing compassion to Raghava. Is it your determination to be like this? Overcome by my shoulder strength I shall crush you now. You may see."
word_meanings: नगेन्द्र king of mountains, राघवे to Raghava, कृतानुकम्पः compassionate, न असिइतियत् not showing this way, एतत् all this, एवम् in that way, ते you, सुविनिश्चितंकिम् your determination, अथो is it, अद्य now, मद्बाहुबलाभिभूतः overcome by my shoulder strength, आत्मानम्? myself, विकीर्णम् crush, पश्य you may see.

text: स तस्य शृङ्गं सनगं सनागं सकाञ्चनं धातुसहस्रजुष्टम् । विकीर्णकूटज्वलिताग्रसानुं प्रगृह्य वेगात् सहसोन्ममाथ ॥६-७४-६८॥
translation: Seizing hold of the peaks vehemently, its trees, elephants, gold mines withthousands of minerals he crushed the projections and set fire and burnt and uprooted swiftly.
word_meanings: सः he, तस्य its, सनगम् trees, सनागम् elephants, सकाञ्चनम् with gold mines, धातुसहस्रजुष्टम् thousands of minerals, विकीर्णकूटम् crushed projections, ज्वलिताग्रसानुम् set fire and burn the peaks, शृङ्गम् peak, प्रगृह्य seizing, साहसा vehemently, वेगात् swiftly, उन्ममाथ uprooted.

text: स तं समुत्पाट्य खमुत्पपात वित्रास्य लोकान् ससुरासुरेन्द्रान् । संस्तूयमानः खचरैरनेकैर्जगाम वैगाद् गरुडोग्रवेगः ॥६-७४-६९॥
translation: Striking terror among Devatas and demons and leaders inhabiting the world, uprooting the mountain he hurried at Garuda's speed into the sky praised by aerial creatures.
word_meanings: सः he, तम् them, समुत्पाट्य striking terror, ससुरासुरेन्द्रान् leaders, Devatas and demons, लोकान् world, वित्रास्य inhabiting, खम् sky, उत्पापात uprooting, अनेकैः many, खचरैः aerial creatures, संस्तूयमानः praised, गरुडोग्रवेगः at terrible speed of Garuda, वेगात् hurried, जगाम went.

text: स भास्कराध्वानमनुप्रपन्नस्तं भास्कराभं शिखरं प्रगृह्य । बभौ तदा भास्करसन्निकाशो रवेः समीपे प्रतिभास्कराभः ॥६-७४-७०॥
translation: Resembling the Sun closely, radiant like the Sun he was taking the top of the mountain, betaking himself in the vicinity of the Sun he was like another Sun.
word_meanings: भास्करसन्निकाशः resembling Sun, सः he, भास्कराभम् radiant like Sun, तंशिखरम् that top, प्रगृह्य taking, भास्कराध्वानम् in the vicinity of Sun, अनुप्रपन्नः betaking himself, तदा then, रवेः Sun, समीपे close, प्रतिभास्कराभः another sun like, बभौ seemed.

text: स तेन शैलेन भृशं रराज शैलोपमो गन्धवहात्मजस्तु । सहस्रधारेण सपावकेन चक्रेण खे विष्णुरिवार्पितेन ॥६-७४-७१॥
translation: He, the son of the wind god sitting upon the crag, was delightful like Vishnu with a flaming wheel shining.
word_meanings: शैलापमः that crag, सः he, गन्धवहात्मजः son of wind god, तेनशैलेन with that crag, खे sky, अर्पितेन setting upon, सहस्रधारेण with thousand edges, सपावकेन with flaming fire, चक्रेण wheel, विष्णुरिव like Vishnu, भृशम् delightful, रराजshining.

text: तं वानराः प्रेक्ष्य विनेदुरुच्चैः स तानपि प्रेक्ष्य मुदा ननाद । तेषां समुद्घुष्टरवं निशम्य लङ्कालया भीमतरं विनेदुः ॥६-७४-७२॥
