translation: Observing him high the Vanaras became joyful, and he also saw them. Hearing their loud noise becoming aware of the Rakshasas of Lanka also roared in terrible fear.
word_meanings: उच्चैः high, वानराः Vanaras, तं they, प्रेक्ष्य seeing, विनेदुः joyful, सःपि he also, तान् them, प्रेक्ष्य seeing, ननाद roared, तेषाम् their समुध्घुष्टरवम् raising loud noise, निशम्य Rakshasas becoming aware, लङ्कालयाः of Lanka, भीमतरम् terrible fear, विनेदुः roar.

text: ततो महात्मा निपपात तस्मिन् शैलोत्तमे वानरसैन्यमध्ये । हर्युत्तमेभ्यः शिरसा ऽभिवाद्य विभीषणं तत्र स सस्वजे च ॥६-७४-७३॥
translation: The great Hanuman along with the mountain descended in the midst of the Vanara army, and greeted the army head bent down and embraced Vibheeshana standing there.
word_meanings: ततः then, महात्मा great, तस्मिन् with that, शैलोत्तमे foremost mountain, वानरसैन्यमध्ये in the midst of Vanara army, निपपात descended, सः he, हर्युत्तमेभ्यः best of Vanaras, शिरसा head bent down, अभिवाद्य greeting, तत्र there, विभीषणम् ? Vibheeshana, सस्वजे च embraced.

text: तावप्युभौ मानुषराजपुत्रौ तं गन्धमाघ्राय महौषधीनाम् । बभूवतुस्तत्र तदा विशल्यावुत्तस्थुरन्ये च हरिप्रवीराः ॥६-७४-७४॥
translation: The two sons of the ruler of men inhaling the fragrance of the herbs became free from wounds. Other Vanara heroes also got restored.
word_meanings: तौ the two, मानुषराजपुत्रौ sons of ruler of men, उभौ both, महौषधीनाम् of the great herbs, तंगन्धम् that fragrance, आघ्राय inhaling, तदा then, विशल्यौ free from wounds, बभूवतुः restored, अन्ये others, हरिप्रहीराश्च Vanara heroes, उत्तस्थुः got up.

text: सर्वे विशल्या विरुजः क्षणेन हरिप्रवीरा निहताश्च ये स्युः । गन्धेन तासां प्रवरौषधीनां सुप्ता निशान्तेष्विव सम्प्रबुद्धाः ॥६-७४-७५॥
translation: All those Vanara warriors killed were restored with life instantly by the fragrance. Those who were asleep also got up when they became fully awake.
word_meanings: सर्वे all, ये those, हरिप्रवीराः Vanara warriors, हताः killed, स्युः instant, तासाम् their, प्रवरौषधीनाम् rid of their pain, गन्धेन by the fragrance, क्षणेन in seconds, विशल्याः restored, विरुजाः life, सुप्ताः asleep, निशान्तेष्विव from sleep, सम्प्रबुद्धाः will get up when fully awake.

text: यदाप्रभृति लङ्कायां युद्ध्यन्ते कपिराक्षसाः । तदाप्रभृति मानार्थमाज्ञया रावणस्य च ॥६-७४-७६॥
ये हन्यन्ते रणे तत्र राक्षसाः कपिकुञ्जरैः । हता हतास्तु क्षिप्यन्ते सर्व एव तु सागरे ॥६-७४-७७॥
translation: From the beginning of the war in Lanka till the end without exception, all the Rakshasas were killed in war by the Vanara leaders then and there were thrown into the ocean by Ravana's instruction, not to have means of proof.
word_meanings: यदाप्रभृति from the beginning, लङ्कायाम् in Lanka, हरिराक्षसाः monkeys and Rakshasas, युध्यन्ते at the end of war, तदाप्रभृति in the same way without exception, मानार्थम् means of proof, रावणस्य Ravana's, आज्ञया instruction, तत्ररणे there in war, ये those, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, कपिकुञ्जरैः Vanara leaders, हन्यन्ते killed, सर्वेएवतु all of them, हताःहताः then and there, सागरे ocean, क्षिप्यन्ते thrown.

text: ततो हरिर्गन्धवहात्मजस्तु तमोषधीशैलमुदग्रवीर्यः । निनाय वेगाद्धिमवन्तमेव पुनश्च रामेण समाजगाम ॥६-७४-७८॥
इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे चतुस्सप्ततितमः सर्गः ॥ ७४ ॥६-७४-७९॥
ततो ऽब्रवीन्महातेजाः सुग्रीवो वानराधिपः । अर्थ्यं विज्ञापयंश्चापि हनुमन्तमिदं वचः ॥६-७५-१॥
translation: Sugriva, the king of Vanaras called Hanuman to make him know the task ahead and said these words.
word_meanings: ततः then, वानराधिपः Vanara king, महातेजाः intelligent, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, विज्ञापयन् च अपि the task ahead, हनूमन्तम् Hanumantha, अर्थ्यम् make known, इदम् these, वचः words, अब्रवीत् said.

text: यतो हतः कुम्भकर्णः कुमाराश्च निषूदिताः । नेदानीमुपनिर्हारं रावणो दातुमर्हति ॥६-७५-२॥
translation: " As Kumbhakarna is killed and his sons are destroyed, Ravana may not putup defence again. I think."
word_meanings: यतः since, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, हतः killed, कुमाराश्च son, निषूदिताः destroyed, रावणः Ravana, इदानीम् no longer, उपनिर्हारम् put up defence, दातुम् again, न अर्हति I think.

text: ये ये महाबलाः सन्ति लघवश्च प्लवङ्गमाः । लङ्कामभ्युत्पतन्त्वाशु गृह्योल्काः प्लवगर्षभाः ॥६-७५-३॥
translation: "Of the bulls among vanaras, endowed with prowess, whoever is quick, able and foremost, let them go to Lanka, the abode of Ravana."
word_meanings: महाबलाः endowed with prowess, लघवश्च and quick, प्लवगर्षभाः bulls among Vanaras, येये whoever, प्लवङ्गमाः Vanaras, सन्ति able, हरिसङ्काशाः foremost, हरयः monkeys, उल्काः torch, गृह्य taking, रावणालयम् Ravana's abode, प्रदग्धुम् invade, अशु go, लङ्काम् Lanka, अभिपतन्तु let them.

text: ततो ऽस्तं गत आदित्ये रौद्रे तस्मिन्निशामुखे । लङ्कामभिमुखाः सोल्का जग्मुस्ते प्लवगर्षभाः ॥६-७५-४॥
translation: Thereafter the bulls among Vanaras turned their faces towards Lanka and went holding torches in hand, after the Sun set as the frightening night started.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, आदित्ये Sun, अस्तंगते having set, रौद्रे frightening, तस्मिन् their, निशामुखे faces turned, ते they, प्लवगर्षभाः Vanara bulls, सोल्काः holding torches, लङ्काम् अभिमुखाः facing Lanka, जग्मुः went.

text: उल्काहस्तैर्हरिगणैः सर्वतः समभिद्रुताः । आरक्षस्था विरूपाक्षाः सहसा विप्रदुद्रुवुः ॥६-७५-५॥
translation: Vanara troops went all over with torches and chased by them, the Rakshasas at the gates ran instantly.
word_meanings: उल्काहस्सैः torches in hand, हरिगणैः Vanara troops, सर्वतः all over, समभिद्रुताः chased, आरक्षस्थाः at the gates, विरूपाक्षाः Rakshasas, सहसा instantly, विप्रदुद्रुवुः ran.

text: गोपुराट्टप्रतोलीषु चर्यासु विविधासु च । प्रासादेषु च संहृष्टाः ससृजुस्ते हुताशनम् । तेषां गृहसस्राणि ददाह हुतभुक् तदा ॥६-७५-६॥
translation: Rejoiced Vanaras set fire to the towering gates, attics, different streets as well as mansions to send away Rakshasas.
word_meanings: सम्हृष्टाः rejoiced, ते they, गोपुराट्टप्रतोलीषु towering gates and attics, विविधासु different, चर्यासु streets, प्रासादेषु च mansions, हुताशनम् set fire, ससृजुः to send away.

text: प्रासादाः पर्वताकाराः पतन्ति धरणीतले । अगरुर्दह्यते तत्र वर च हरिचन्दनम् ॥६-७५-७॥
मौक्तिका मणयः स्निग्धा वज्रं चापि प्रवालकम् । क्षौमं च दह्यते तत्र कौशेयं चापि शोभनम् ॥६-७५-८॥
आविकं विविधं चौर्णं काञ्चनं भाण्डमायुधम् । नानाविकृतसंस्थानं वाजिभाण्डपरिच्छदौ ॥६-७५-९॥
गजग्रैवेयकक्ष्याश्च रथभाण्डाश्च संस्कृताः । तनुत्राणि च योधानां हस्त्यश्वानां च वर्म च ॥६-७५-१०॥
खड्गा धनूंषि ज्याबाणास्तोमराङ्कुशशक्तयः । रोमजं वालजं चर्म व्याघ्रजं चाण्डजं बहु ॥६-७५-११॥
मुक्तामणिविचित्रांश्च प्रासादांश्च समन्ततः । विविधानस्त्रसंयोगानग्निर्दहति तत्र वै ॥६-७५-१२॥
translation: With fire all over, rugs made of hair of animals, whisks made of fur of animals, tiger skins, musk, wonderful pearls, and gems in laid dwellings of many kinds, and clusters of war weapons were burnt.
word_meanings: अग्निः fire, समन्ततः all over, रोमजम् rugs made of hair of animals, वालजम् whisks made of fur of animals, व्याघ्रजम् tiger, चर्म skins, बहु many, चण्डजम् musk, मुक्तामणिविचित्रान् wonderful pearls and gems, प्रासादान् च dwellings, विविधान् many kinds, संयोगान् clusters of war weapons, तत्र there, दहतिवै were burnt.

text: नानाविधान् गृहच्छन्दान् ददाह हुतभूक् तदा । आवासान् राक्षसानां च सर्वेषां गृहगर्धिनाम् ॥६-७५-१३॥
हेमचित्रतनुत्राणां स्रग्दामाम्बरधारिणाम् । शीधुपानचलाक्षाणां मदविह्वलगामिनाम् ॥६-७५-१४॥
translation: The fire consumed many kinds of wonderful homes of Rakshasas, with loved ones on the best beds, their armour made of gold Rakshasas decked with garland s and best of attire their eyes inebriated with intoxication, shaking while walking slowly, holding their loved ones, seized with anger against enemies, holding mace and tridents in hand, eating, drinking and sleeping on the best beds, fast asleep some out of fear taking their sons going quickly and all of them dwelling there in hundreds and thousands were burning again and again.
word_meanings: तदा then, हुतभुक् consumed by fire, चित्रान् wonderful, नानाविधान् of many kinds, गृहान् homes, गृहगर्थिनाम् well known Rakshasas, सर्वेषाम् all of them, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, आवासान् homes, ददाह burnt, तत्र there, पावकः by fire, हेमचित्रतनुत्राणाम् armour made of gold, स्रग्धामांम्बरधारिणाम् decked with garland s and best of attire, शीधुपानचलाक्षाणाम् their eyes wild with inebriation, मद्विह्वलगामिनाम् walked slowly being intoxicated, कान्तालम्बितवस्त्राणां holding the robes of loved ones, शत्रुसञ्जातमन्यूनाम् seized with anger against enemies, गदाशूलसिहस्तानाम् holding maces and tridents in hand, खादताम् eating, पिबतामपि drinking, प्रियैस्सह with loved ones, महार्हेषु fast asleep, शयनेषु on the best beds, प्रसुप्तानाम् sleeping, त्रस्तानाम् out of fear, पुत्रान् sons, आदाय taking, सर्वतः all sides, तूर्णम् quickly, गच्छताम् going, तेषाम् all of them, निवासिनाम् dwelling there, शतसहस्राणि hundreds and thousands, अदहत् burnt, पुनःपुनः again and again, जज्वाल च burning.

text: कान्तालम्बितवस्त्राणां शत्रुसञ्जातमन्युनाम् । गदाशूलासिहस्तानां खादतां पिबतामपि ॥६-७५-१५॥
translation: The fire consumed many kinds of wonderful homes of Rakshasas, with loved ones on the best beds, their armour made of gold Rakshasas decked with garland s and best of attire their eyes inebriated with intoxication, shaking while walking slowly, holding their loved ones, seized with anger against enemies, holding mace and tridents in hand, eating, drinking and sleeping on the best beds, fast asleep some out of fear taking their sons going quickly and all of them dwelling there in hundreds and thousands were burning again and again.
word_meanings: तदा then, हुतभुक् consumed by fire, चित्रान् wonderful, नानाविधान् of many kinds, गृहान् homes, गृहगर्थिनाम् well known Rakshasas, सर्वेषाम् all of them, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, आवासान् homes, ददाह burnt, तत्र there, पावकः by fire, हेमचित्रतनुत्राणाम् armour made of gold, स्रग्धामांम्बरधारिणाम् decked with garland s and best of attire, शीधुपानचलाक्षाणाम् their eyes wild with inebriation, मद्विह्वलगामिनाम् walked slowly being intoxicated, कान्तालम्बितवस्त्राणां holding the robes of loved ones, शत्रुसञ्जातमन्यूनाम् seized with anger against enemies, गदाशूलसिहस्तानाम् holding maces and tridents in hand, खादताम् eating, पिबतामपि drinking, प्रियैस्सह with loved ones, महार्हेषु fast asleep, शयनेषु on the best beds, प्रसुप्तानाम् sleeping, त्रस्तानाम् out of fear, पुत्रान् sons, आदाय taking, सर्वतः all sides, तूर्णम् quickly, गच्छताम् going, तेषाम् all of them, निवासिनाम् dwelling there, शतसहस्राणि hundreds and thousands, अदहत् burnt, पुनःपुनः again and again, जज्वाल च burning.

text: शयनेषु महार्हेषु प्रसुप्तानां प्रियैः सह । त्रस्तानां गच्छतां तूर्णं पुत्रानादाय सर्वतः ॥६-७५-१६॥
translation: The fire consumed many kinds of wonderful homes of Rakshasas, with loved ones on the best beds, their armour made of gold Rakshasas decked with garland s and best of attire their eyes inebriated with intoxication, shaking while walking slowly, holding their loved ones, seized with anger against enemies, holding mace and tridents in hand, eating, drinking and sleeping on the best beds, fast asleep some out of fear taking their sons going quickly and all of them dwelling there in hundreds and thousands were burning again and again.
word_meanings: तदा then, हुतभुक् consumed by fire, चित्रान् wonderful, नानाविधान् of many kinds, गृहान् homes, गृहगर्थिनाम् well known Rakshasas, सर्वेषाम् all of them, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, आवासान् homes, ददाह burnt, तत्र there, पावकः by fire, हेमचित्रतनुत्राणाम् armour made of gold, स्रग्धामांम्बरधारिणाम् decked with garland s and best of attire, शीधुपानचलाक्षाणाम् their eyes wild with inebriation, मद्विह्वलगामिनाम् walked slowly being intoxicated, कान्तालम्बितवस्त्राणां holding the robes of loved ones, शत्रुसञ्जातमन्यूनाम् seized with anger against enemies, गदाशूलसिहस्तानाम् holding maces and tridents in hand, खादताम् eating, पिबतामपि drinking, प्रियैस्सह with loved ones, महार्हेषु fast asleep, शयनेषु on the best beds, प्रसुप्तानाम् sleeping, त्रस्तानाम् out of fear, पुत्रान् sons, आदाय taking, सर्वतः all sides, तूर्णम् quickly, गच्छताम् going, तेषाम् all of them, निवासिनाम् dwelling there, शतसहस्राणि hundreds and thousands, अदहत् burnt, पुनःपुनः again and again, जज्वाल च burning.

text: तेषां शतसहस्राणि तदा लङ्कानिवासिनाम् । अदहत् पावकस्तत्र जज्वाल च पुनःपुनः ॥६-७५-१७॥
translation: The fire consumed many kinds of wonderful homes of Rakshasas, with loved ones on the best beds, their armour made of gold Rakshasas decked with garland s and best of attire their eyes inebriated with intoxication, shaking while walking slowly, holding their loved ones, seized with anger against enemies, holding mace and tridents in hand, eating, drinking and sleeping on the best beds, fast asleep some out of fear taking their sons going quickly and all of them dwelling there in hundreds and thousands were burning again and again.
word_meanings: तदा then, हुतभुक् consumed by fire, चित्रान् wonderful, नानाविधान् of many kinds, गृहान् homes, गृहगर्थिनाम् well known Rakshasas, सर्वेषाम् all of them, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, आवासान् homes, ददाह burnt, तत्र there, पावकः by fire, हेमचित्रतनुत्राणाम् armour made of gold, स्रग्धामांम्बरधारिणाम् decked with garland s and best of attire, शीधुपानचलाक्षाणाम् their eyes wild with inebriation, मद्विह्वलगामिनाम् walked slowly being intoxicated, कान्तालम्बितवस्त्राणां holding the robes of loved ones, शत्रुसञ्जातमन्यूनाम् seized with anger against enemies, गदाशूलसिहस्तानाम् holding maces and tridents in hand, खादताम् eating, पिबतामपि drinking, प्रियैस्सह with loved ones, महार्हेषु fast asleep, शयनेषु on the best beds, प्रसुप्तानाम् sleeping, त्रस्तानाम् out of fear, पुत्रान् sons, आदाय taking, सर्वतः all sides, तूर्णम् quickly, गच्छताम् going, तेषाम् all of them, निवासिनाम् dwelling there, शतसहस्राणि hundreds and thousands, अदहत् burnt, पुनःपुनः again and again, जज्वाल च burning.

text: सारवन्ति महार्हाणि गम्भीरगुणवन्ति च । हेमचन्द्रार्धचन्द्राणि चन्द्रशालोन्नतानि च ॥६-७५-१८॥
रत्नचित्रगवाक्षाणि साधिष्ठानानि सर्वशः । मणिविद्रुमचित्राणि स्पृशन्तीव दिवाकरम् ॥६-७५-१९॥
translation: The fire consumed the houses which were strong and impenetrable, with many enclosures, magnificent ones, constructed in gold in the shape of a half moon and full moon, windows endowed with wonderful pictures. All over the rooms were high on top, decorated with gems, and as if touching the Sun. It was rendered noisy with notes of herons and peacocks, playing of Veena, and jingling of ornaments like the vibration of sounds. The dwellings which looked like mountains were consumed by fire.
word_meanings: तत्र there, अग्निः fire, सारवन्ति strong and impenetrable, महार्हाणि many enclosures, गम्बीरगुणवन्ति च magnificent, हेमचन्ध्रार्धचन्द्राणि constructed in gold in the shape of the crescent moon, चन्द्रशालोत्तमानि च in the shape of moon, चित्रगवाक्षाणि windows endowed with wonderful pictures, सर्वशः all over, साधिष्ठानानि were high with rooms on top, मणिविद्रुमचित्राणि decorated with gems, दिवाकरम् Sun, स्पृशन्तीव as if touching the Sun, क्रौञ्चबर्हिणवीणानाम् rendered noisy with notes of herons and peacocks and veena, भूषणानां च of ornaments, निस्वनैः sounds, नादितानि vibrating sounds, अचलाभानि looked like mountain in shape, वेश्मानि dwellings, ददाह ह burnt.

text: क्रौञ्चबर्हिणवीणानां भूषणानां च निस्वनैः । नादितान्यचला भानि वेश्मान्यग्निर्ददाह सः ॥६-७५-२०॥
translation: The fire consumed the houses which were strong and impenetrable, with many enclosures, magnificent ones, constructed in gold in the shape of a half moon and full moon, windows endowed with wonderful pictures. All over the rooms were high on top, decorated with gems, and as if touching the Sun. It was rendered noisy with notes of herons and peacocks, playing of Veena, and jingling of ornaments like the vibration of sounds. The dwellings which looked like mountains were consumed by fire.
word_meanings: तत्र there, अग्निः fire, सारवन्ति strong and impenetrable, महार्हाणि many enclosures, गम्बीरगुणवन्ति च magnificent, हेमचन्ध्रार्धचन्द्राणि constructed in gold in the shape of the crescent moon, चन्द्रशालोत्तमानि च in the shape of moon, चित्रगवाक्षाणि windows endowed with wonderful pictures, सर्वशः all over, साधिष्ठानानि were high with rooms on top, मणिविद्रुमचित्राणि decorated with gems, दिवाकरम् Sun, स्पृशन्तीव as if touching the Sun, क्रौञ्चबर्हिणवीणानाम् rendered noisy with notes of herons and peacocks and veena, भूषणानां च of ornaments, निस्वनैः sounds, नादितानि vibrating sounds, अचलाभानि looked like mountain in shape, वेश्मानि dwellings, ददाह ह burnt.

text: ज्वलनेन परीतानि तोरणानि चकाशिरे । विद्युद्भिरिव नद्धानि मेघजालानि धर्मगे ॥६-७५-२१॥
translation: The archways covered with a touch of fire shone like lightning in summer, girt round like clusters of clouds.
word_meanings: ज्वलनेन by the touch of fire, परीतानि covered, तोरणानि archways, घर्मगे in summer, विद्युद्भिः lightning, नद्धानि girt round, मेघजालानीव like clusters of clouds, चकाशिरे shone.

text: ज्वलनेन परीतानि निपेतुर्भवनान्यथ । वज्रिवज्रहतानीव शिखराणि महागिरेः ॥६-७५-२२॥
translation: The mansions burnt by fire fell down like a huge mountain struck by a thunderbolt.
word_meanings: ज्वलनेन burnt, परीतानि by fire, निपेतुः fell down, भवनानि mansions, महागिरेः large mountain, वज्रिवज्रहतानीव burnt by thunderbolt, शिखराणि peaks, यथा that way, महागिरेः like huge mountains.

text: विमानेषु प्रसुप्ताश्च दह्यमाना वराङ्गनाः । त्यक्ताभरणसर्वाङ्गा हा हेत्युच्चैर्विचुक्रुशुः ॥६-७५-२३॥
translation: The lovely women sleeping in burnt mansion tops screamed loudly in desperation saying 'Alas! Oh Oh!' and removing their ornaments.
word_meanings: विमानेषु in the mansion tops, प्रसुप्ताः sleeping, दह्वमानाः burnt, वराङ्गनाः lovely women, त्यक्ताभरणसर्वाङ्गाः removing the ornaments, हाहाइति alas! Oh Oh!! like this, उच्चैः screamed, विचुक्रुशुः loudly in despair.

text: तानि निर्दह्यमानानि दूरतः प्रचकाशिरे । हिमवच्छिखराणीव दीप्तौषधिवनानि च ॥६-७५-२४॥
translation: As the mansions were burning, they shone like the peaks of Himalayas glowing at a distance.
word_meanings: निर्दह्यमानानि as they were burning, तानि those, दिवशः on all sides, दीप्तौषनानि while glowing, हिमवच्छिखराणीव Himalaya peaks, दूरतः in distance, प्रचकाशिरे as. if shining,

text: हर्म्याग्रैर्दह्यमानैश्च ज्वालाप्रज्वलितैरपि । रात्रौ सा दृश्यते लङ्का पुष्पितैरिव किंशुकैः ॥६-७५-२५॥
translation: While the tops of dwellings were burning, flames were blazing, and Lanka seemed adorned with Kimsuka blossoms.
word_meanings: दह्यमानैः while burning, ज्वालाप्रज्वलितैः flames were blazing, हर्म्याग्रैः tops of dwellings, सा they, लङ्का Lanka, रात्रौ night, पुष्पितैः blossoms, किंशुकैःइव Kimsuka, दृश्यते appeared.

text: हस्त्यध्यक्षैर्गजैर्मुक्तैर्मुक्तैश्च तुरगैरपि । बभूव लङ्का लोकान्ते भ्रान्तग्राह इवार्णवः ॥६-७५-२६॥
translation: In Lanka with the elephants set free, horses set free by the guards, it was like an agitated ocean at the end of the world cycle.
word_meanings: लङ्का Lanka, हस्त्यध्यक्षैः guards of horses, मुक्सैः let loose, गजैः elephants, मुक्सैः let loose, तुरङ्गमैः horses, लोकान्ते at the end of world cycle, भ्रान्तग्राहः agitated, अर्णवःइव ocean like, बभूव seemed.

text: अश्वं मुक्तं गजो दृष्ट्वा क्वचिद्भीतो ऽपसर्पति । भीतो भीतं गजं दृष्ट्वा क्वचिदश्वो निवर्तते ॥६-७५-२७॥
translation: Some horses that were released, went in different directions afraid of elephants. Some elephants seeing horses ran away in fear.
word_meanings: क्वचित् some, मुक्तम् released, अश्वम् horses, दृष्टवा seeing, गजः elephants, भीतः feared, अपसर्पति went in different direction, क्वचित् some, भीतम् in fear, गजम् elephants, दृष्टवा seeing, अश्वः horses, भीतः fearing, निवर्तते ran away.

text: लङ्कायां दह्यमानायां शुशुभे स महार्णवः । छायासंसक्तसलिलो लोहितोद इवार्णवः ॥६-७५-२८॥
translation: While Lanka was burning its image reflected in the ocean made the ocean look like an ocean of red waters.
word_meanings: लङ्कायाम् in Lanka, दह्यमानायाम् while burning, छायासंसक्तसलिलः the image of reflected in water, महार्णवः of the ocean, लोहितोदः red coloured, महार्णवःइव like ocean, शुशुभे appeared.

text: सा बभूव मुहूर्तेन हरिभिर्दीपिता पुरी । लोकस्यास्य क्षये घोरे प्रदीप्तेव वसुन्धरा ॥६-७५-२९॥
translation: Set fire by the monkeys, in a short while, the city was like a land flaming out of dreadful destruction in the world.
word_meanings: मुहूर्तेन in a short while, हरिभिः monkeys also, दीपिता set fire, सापुरी that city, अस्य its, लोकस्य in the world, घोरे dreadful, क्ष्ये destruction, प्रदीप्ता flaming, वसुन्धराइव like land, बभूव was.

text: नारीजनस्य धूमेन व्याप्तस्योच्चैर्विनेदुषः । स्वनो ज्वलनतप्तस्य शुश्रुवे दशयोजनम् ॥६-७५-३०॥
translation: By the smoke that spread, scorched by the fire, the clamour of the women folk at the top of their voice was heard at a hundred yojanas.
word_meanings: धूमेन smoke, व्याप्तस्य spread, ज्वलनतप्तस्य scorched by fire, उच्चैः at the top of, विनेदुषः clamour, नारीजनस्य of the women folk, स्वनः sound, शतयोजनम् a hundred yojanas, शुश्रुवे heard.

text: प्रदग्धकायानपरान् राक्षसान्निर्गतान् बहिः । सहसा ऽभ्युत्पतन्ति स्म हरयो ऽथ युयुत्सवः ॥६-७५-३१॥
translation: And thereafter the monkeys who were eager to fight assailed the Rakshasas who came out suddenly unable to bear the burning of the bodies.
word_meanings: अथ and then, प्रदग्धकायान् burnt bodies, बहिः outside, निर्गतान् unable to bear, अपरान् continued, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, हरयः monkeys, युयुत्सवः eager to fight, सहसा suddenly, उत्पतन्तिस्म assailed.

text: उद्घुष्टं वानराणां च राक्षसानां च निस्वनः । दिशो दश समुद्रं च पृथिवीं चान्वनादयत् ॥६-७५-३२॥
translation: The clamour of the monkeys and the sighing of the Rakshasas resounded in all the ten directions including the ocean as well as the earth.
word_meanings: वानराणाम् monkeys, उद्घुष्टं च clamour, राक्षसानाम् of the Rakshasas, निस्स्वसः च sighing, दश ten, दिशः directions, समुद्रं च ocean, पृथिवीं च earth, व्यनादयत् resound.

text: विशल्यौ तु महात्मानौ तावुभौ रामलक्ष्मणौ । असम्भ्रान्तौ जगृहतुस्तदोभे धनुषी वरे ॥६-७५-३३॥
translation: The two great souls, Rama, and Lakshmana, both relieved of pain seized hold of excellent and wellknown bows.
word_meanings: महात्मानौ great souls, तौ the two, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, उभौ both, विशल्यौ excellent, असम्भ्रान्तौ relieved of the pain, वरे well known, ता those, उभौ two, धनुषी bows, जगृहतुः seized hold.

text: ततो विष्फारयानस्य रामस्य धनुरुत्तमम् । बभूव तुमुलः शब्दो राक्षसानां भयावहः ॥६-७५-३४॥
translation: Then Rama drew the best of bow, that created fear among the Rakshasas by its tumultuous sound.
word_meanings: ततः then, रामः च Rama, उत्तमम् best, धनुः bow, विस्फारयामानस्य drew, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, भयावहः out of fear, तुमुलः tumultuous, शब्दः sound, भभूव created.

text: अशोभत तदा रामो धनुर्विष्फारयन् महत् । भगवानिव सङ्क्रुद्धो भवो वेदमयं धनुः ॥६-७५-३५॥
translation: Then, great Rama stretching his bow in great fury shone as though the divine Lord Siva was stretching his bow with imprints of Vedas.
word_meanings: तदा then, महत् great, धनुः bow, विष्फारयन् bending, रामः Rama, वेदमयम् signs of Vedas, धनुः bow, सङ्कृद्धः in great fury, भगवान् divine, भवःइव Lord Siva, अशोभत shone.

text: उद्घुष्टं वानराणां च राक्षसानां च निस्वनम् । ज्याशब्दस्तावुभौ शब्दावति रामस्य शुश्रुवे ॥६-७५-३६॥
translation: That sound of the twang of Rama's bow could be heard very high over and above the sounds of the Vanaras and Rakshasas.
word_meanings: रामस्य Rama's, ज्याशब्दः that sound, वानराणाम् for the Vanaras, उद्घुष्टम् above, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, निस्स्वनं च sounds, तौ those, उभौ two, अतिशुश्रुवे very high.

text: वानरोद्घुष्टघोषश्च राक्षसानां च निस्वनः । ज्याशब्दश्चापि रामस्य त्रयं व्याप दिशो दश ॥६-७५-३७॥
translation: The sound of Rama's bow twang, the clamour of the Vanaras as well as the wailing of Rakshasas, all the three could be heard in all ten directions.
word_meanings: वानरोद्घुष्टघोषः च shouts of the vanaras, राक्षसानाम् Rakshasas, निस्स्वनः च wailing also, रामस्य Rama's, ज्याशब्दश्चापि by that sound, त्रयम् three, दश ten, दिशः directions, व्याप्य spread.

text: तस्य कार्मुकमुक्तैश्च शरैस्तत्पुरगोपुरम् । कैलासशृङ्गप्रतिमं विकीर्णमपतद्भुवि ॥६-७५-३८॥
translation: The entrance gate of Lanka, which was like Kailasa, crumbled and fell by the shaft released from the bow of Rama.
word_meanings: कैलासशृङ्गप्रतिमम् the entrance gate of the city that was like Kailasa, तत्पुरगोपुरम् which resembled, तस्य its, कार्मुकमुक्सैश्च shaft released from bow, शरैः arrows, विशीर्णम् crumbled, भुवि on the ground, अपतत् fallen.

text: ततो रामशरान् दृष्ट्वा विमानेषु गृहेषु च । सन्नाहो राक्षसेन्द्राणां तुमुलः समपद्यत ॥६-७५-३९॥
translation: Seeing Rama's arrows on the highrise mansions and houses, the Rakshasa leaders started preparing for comb at out of fear.
word_meanings: ततः then, विमानेषु on the high rise mansions, गृहेषु च and houses, रामशरान् Rama's arrows, दृष्टवा seeing, राक्षसेन्द्राणाम् Rakshasa leaders, सन्नाहः preparing, तुमुलः feared, समपद्यत started.

text: तेषां सन्नह्यमानानां सिंहनादं च कुर्वताम् । शर्वरी राक्षसेन्द्राणां रौद्रीव समपद्यत ॥६-७५-४०॥
translation: As the Rakshasa leaders were preparing (for attack) and emitting leonine roar, night came upon like the night of Rudra (night of final dissolution).
word_meanings: सन्नह्यमानानाम् as they were preparing, सिंहनादम् leonine, कुर्वताम् doing, तेषाम् by them, राक्षसेन्द्राणाम् Rakshasa leaders, शर्वरी night, रौद्रीव Rudra's, समपद्यत came upon.

text: आदिष्टा वानरेन्द्रास्तु सुग्रीवेण महात्मना । आसन्नद्वारमासाद्य युध्यध्वं प्लवगर्षभाः ॥६-७५-४१॥
यश्च वो वितथं कुर्यात्तत्र तत्र ह्युपस्थितः । स हन्तव्यो हि सम्प्लुत्य राजशासनदूषकः ॥६-७५-४२॥
translation: Sugriva the great king of Vanaras commanded all the bulls among Vanaras, to encounter after reaching the gate of Lanka. "He who is staying wherever they are does not obey the king's command will be killed for being guilty of flouting the command", ordered Sugriva to the Vanaras.
word_meanings: ते they, वानरेन्द्राः Vanara king, महात्मना great soul, सुग्रीवेण by Sugriva, आदिष्टाः commanded, प्लवगर्षभाः bulls among monkeys, आसन्नम् reaching, द्वारम् gate, आसाद्य reached, युध्यध्वम् encounter, वः or, यः he who, तत्रतत्र here and there, व्यवस्थितःअपि staying there, वितथम् false, कुर्वात् do, राजशासनदूषकः one who does not obey this king's order, सः he, अहिसंफ्लुत्य guilty of flouting, हन्तव्यः be destroyed, तेषु for them.

text: तेषु वानरमुख्येषु दीप्तोल्कोज्ज्वलपाणिषु । स्थितेषु द्वारमासाद्य रावणं मन्युराविशत् ॥६-७५-४३॥
translation: Holding burning torches in hand the Vanara chiefs reached and standing at the gate, saw that Ravana was overtaken by anger.
word_meanings: दीप्तोल्कोज्ज्वलपाणिषु holding burning torches in hand, तेषु they, वानरमुख्येषु Vanara chiefs, द्वारम् gate, आसाद्य reaching, स्थितेषु standing, रावणम् Ravana, मन्युराविशत् overtaken by anger.

text: तस्य जृम्भितविक्षेपाद्व्यामिश्रा वै दिशो दश । रूपवानिव रुद्रस्य मन्युर्गात्रेष्वदृश्यत ॥६-७५-४४॥
translation: The ten directions were disturbed violently by his yawning and his wrath was perceptible like Rudra' s form in his limbs by his wrath.
word_meanings: तस्य his, जृम्भितविक्षेपात् violent disturbance, दश ten, दिशः directions, व्यामिश्राःवै yawning, गात्रेषु limbs, रुद्रस्य Rudra's, रूपवान् form, मन्युः wrath, अदृश्यतइव perceptible like.

text: स निकुम्भं च कुम्भं च कुम्भकर्णात्मजावुभौ । प्रेषयामास सङ्क्रुद्धो राक्षसैर्बहुभिः सह ॥६-७५-४५॥
translation: Seized with anger, he sent for Kumbha and Nikumbha, both the sons of Kumbhakarna and many Rakshasas.
word_meanings: सङ्कृद्धः becoming very angry, सः he, कुम्भं च Kumbha and, निकुम्भं च Nikumbha, कुम्भकर्णात्मजौ Kumbhakarna's sons, उभौ both, बहुभिः many, राक्षसैस्सह Rakshasas, प्रेषयामास sent for.

text: यूपाक्षः शोणिताक्षश्च प्रजङ्घः कम्पनस्तथा । निर्ययुः कौम्भकर्णिभ्यां सह रावणशासनात् ॥६-७५-४६॥
translation: Yupaksha, Sonithaksha, Prajangha, Kampana set out with both the sons of Kumbhakarna.
word_meanings: यूपाक्षः Yupaksha, शोणिताक्षश्च Sonithasksha, प्रजङ्घः Prajangha, तथा similarly, कम्पनः Kampana, रावणशासनात् by Ravana's command, कौम्भकर्णिभ्यांसह Kumbhakarna's sons, निर्ययुः set out.

text: शशास चैव तान् सर्वान् राक्षसान् सुमहाबलान् । नादयन् गच्छतात्रैव जयध्वं शीघ्रमेव च ॥६-७५-४७॥
translation: Roaring like a lion, he ordered all the Rakshasas of extraordinary strength to proceed instantly.
word_meanings: सः he, महाबलान् extraordinary strength, तान् them, सर्वान् all, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, शशास च ordered, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, सिंहनादम् lion roar, नादयन् roaring, अद्यैव now, गच्छत go.

text: ततस्तु चोदितास्तेन राक्षसा ज्वलितायुधाः । लङ्काया निर्ययुर्वीराः प्रणदन्तः पुनःपुनः ॥६-७५-४८॥
translation: Ordered by him again and again, the Rakshasa warriors went from Lanka with glowing weapons offering salutations to him.
word_meanings: ततः then, तेन by him, चोताः , ज्वलितायुधाः glowing weapons, वीराः warriors, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, पुनःपुनः again and again, प्रणदन्तः offering salutations, लङ्कायाः from Lanka, निर्ययुः departed.

text: रक्षसां भूषणस्थाभिर्भाभिः स्वाभिश्च सर्वशः । चक्रुस्ते सप्रभं व्योम हरयश्चाग्निभिः सह ॥६-७५-४९॥
translation: The Rakshasas by the effulgence of ornaments and by themselves illumined all over the sky like monkeys did with torches.
word_meanings: रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, भूषणस्थाभिः by the ornaments, सर्वशः all over, र्भाभि splendour, स्वाभिश्च their own, ते they, अग्निभिस्स्ह torches also, हरयः च monkeys, व्योम sky, सप्रभम् by that glow, चक्रुः went.

text: तत्र ताराधिपस्याभा ताराणां च तथैव च । तयोराभरणस्था च बलयोर्द्यामभासयन् ॥६-७५-५०॥
translation: There the radiance of the moon and stars and the splendour of their ornaments brightened the sky.
word_meanings: तत्र there, ताराधिपस्या Lord of stars, आभा light, तथैव च like that, ताराणाम् stars, भा light, तयोः both, अभराणाभा च splendour of ornaments, बलयो two armies, र्द्याम sky, अभासयन् brightened.

text: चन्द्राभा भूषणाभा च गृहाणां ज्वलतां च भा । हरिराक्षससैन्यानि भ्राजयामास सर्वतः ॥६-७५-५१॥
translation: The moon light and the splendour of the ornaments, also the light of shining ocean and dwellings lit up the Vanara and Rakshasa armies.
word_meanings: चन्द्राभा moon light, भूषणाभा च splendour of ornaments, सागरः ocean, गृहाणाम् dwellings, पुनः again, सर्वतः everywhere, हरिराक्षससैन्यानि monkey and Rakshasa army, भ्राजयामास shone brilliantly.

text: तत्र चोर्ध्वं प्रदीप्तानां गृहाणां सागरः पुनः । भाभिः संसक्तपातालश्चलोर्मिः शुशुबे ऽधिकम् ॥६-७५-५२॥
translation: There the waves of the ocean shone brightly getting united with the fire of half burnt houses.
word_meanings: तत्र there, चलोर्मिः waves, सागरः of the ocean, पुनः again, अर्धप्रदीप्तानाम् half burnt, गृहाणाम् houses, भाभिः shone, संसक्तसलिलः united with water, अधिकम् very, शुशुभे bright.

text: पताकाध्वजसंसक्तमुत्तमासिपरश्वधम् । भीमाश्वरथमातङ्गं नानापत्तिसमाकुलम् ॥६-७५-५३॥
दीप्तशूलगदाखड्गप्रासतोमरकार्मुकम् । तद्राक्षसबलं घोरं भीमविक्रमपौरुषम् ॥६-७५-५४॥
ददृशो ज्वलितप्रासं किङ्किणीशतनादितम् । हेमजालाचितभुजं व्यामिश्रितपरश्वधम् ॥६-७५-५५॥
translation: Then the Rakshasa army appeared terrific, fixed with flags and poles, equipped with best of axes, horses yoked to formidable chariots and elephants different kinds of foot soldiers, distinguished by wielding shining tridents, maces, swords spears and lances warriors of frightening valour and prowess holding shining barbed missiles hundreds of tiny bells tied to the chariots and elephants making noise warriors endowed with arms decorated with gold, with axes and weapons to pierce arrows fixed to the bows, with an abundance of fragrance.
word_meanings: पताकध्वजसंसक्तम् fixed with flags and poles, उत्तमासिपरश्वधम् equipped with the best of axes, भीमाश्वरथमातङ्गम् formidable chariots, horses and elephants, नानापततिसमाकुलम् different kinds of foot soldiers, दीप्तशूलगदाखडगप्रासतोमरकार्मुकम् distinguished by shining tridents, maces, swords, spears and lances, bows, घोरविक्रमपौरुषम् warriors of frightening valour and prowess, ज्वलितप्रासम् shining barbed missiles, किङ्किणीशतनादितम् hundreds of bells tied round the chariots, elephants, हेमजालाचितभुजम् endowed with arms of warriors decorated with gold, व्यावेष्टितपरश्वधम् axes to kill, व्याघूर्णितमहाशस्त्रम् weapons to pierce through, बाणसंसक्तकार्मुकम् arrows fixed to the bows, गन्धमाल्यमधूत्सेकसम्मोदितमहानिलम् fragrant with abundance of sandal, तत् that, राक्षसबलम् Rakshasa army, भीमम् terrific, ददृशे appeared.

text: व्याघूर्णितमहाशस्त्रं बाणसंसक्तकार्मुकम् । गन्धमाल्यमधूत्सेकसम्मोदितमहानिलम् ॥६-७५-५६॥
translation: Then the Rakshasa army appeared terrific, fixed with flags and poles, equipped with best of axes, horses yoked to formidable chariots and elephants different kinds of foot soldiers, distinguished by wielding shining tridents, maces, swords spears and lances warriors of frightening valour and prowess holding shining barbed missiles hundreds of tiny bells tied to the chariots and elephants making noise warriors endowed with arms decorated with gold, with axes and weapons to pierce arrows fixed to the bows, with an abundance of fragrance.
word_meanings: पताकध्वजसंसक्तम् fixed with flags and poles, उत्तमासिपरश्वधम् equipped with the best of axes, भीमाश्वरथमातङ्गम् formidable chariots, horses and elephants, नानापततिसमाकुलम् different kinds of foot soldiers, दीप्तशूलगदाखडगप्रासतोमरकार्मुकम् distinguished by shining tridents, maces, swords, spears and lances, bows, घोरविक्रमपौरुषम् warriors of frightening valour and prowess, ज्वलितप्रासम् shining barbed missiles, किङ्किणीशतनादितम् hundreds of bells tied round the chariots, elephants, हेमजालाचितभुजम् endowed with arms of warriors decorated with gold, व्यावेष्टितपरश्वधम् axes to kill, व्याघूर्णितमहाशस्त्रम् weapons to pierce through, बाणसंसक्तकार्मुकम् arrows fixed to the bows, गन्धमाल्यमधूत्सेकसम्मोदितमहानिलम् fragrant with abundance of sandal, तत् that, राक्षसबलम् Rakshasa army, भीमम् terrific, ददृशे appeared.

text: घोरं शूरजनाकीर्णं महाम्बुधरनिस्वनम् ॥६-७५-५७॥
तद्दृष्ट्वा बलमायान्तं राक्षसानां सुदारुणम् । सञ्चचाल प्लवङ्गानां बलमुच्चैर्ननाद च ॥६-७५-५८॥
translation: Crowded with fierce warriors coming like thundering rainy clouds, the Rakshasas, and the monkey troops coming forward made loud noises with an elevated tone.
word_meanings: घोरम् fierce, शूरजनाकीर्णम् crowded with warriors, महाम्बुधरनिस्स्वनम् like rainy. cloud thundering, सुदारणम् dreadful, आयातम् coming, तत् that, राक्षसानांबलम्, Rakshasa army, दृष्टवा seeing, प्लवङ्गानाम् monkeys, बलम् troops, सञ्चचाल coming forward, उच्चैः elevated, ननाद च making loud noise.

text: जवेनाप्लुत्य च पुनस्तद्बलं रक्षसां महत् । अभ्ययात् प्रत्यरिबलं पतङ्गा इव पावकम् ॥६-७५-५९॥
translation: The great army of Rakshasas rushed towards the hostile army just as moths flew up towards flame.
word_meanings: रक्षसाम् Rakshasas, महत् great, तत् बलंपुनः again that army, जवेन speed, आफ्लुत्य moths, पतङ्गापावकम् fly towards flame, प्रत्यरिबलम् hostile army, प्रत्ययात् rushed.

text: तेषां भुजपरामर्शव्यामृष्टपरिघाशनि । राक्षसानां बलं श्रेष्ठं भूयस्तरमशोभत ॥६-७५-६०॥
translation: Their Clubs and Asanis brandished by rubbing with their arms, the great army of Rakshasas appeared very bright.
word_meanings: तेषांराक्षसानाम् by the Rakshasas, भुजपरामर्शव्यामृष्टपरिघाशनि Clubs and Asanis brandished by rubbing with the arms, श्रेष्ठम् great, बलम् army, भूयः appeared, परम् very, अशोभत brightly.

text: तत्रोन्मत्ता इवोत्पेतुर्हरयो ऽथ युयुत्सवः । तरुशैलैरभिघ्नन्तो मुष्टिभिश्च निशाचरान् ॥६-७५-६१॥
translation: Thereafter the monkeys eager to fight with night rangers rose as if gone mad striking the night rangers with trees and rocks.
word_meanings: अथ and now, तत्र there, युयुत्सवः eager, हरयः monkeys, निशाचरान् night rangers, तरुशैलैः with trees and rocks, मुष्टिभिः च and fists, अभिघ्नन्तः striking, उन्मत्ताःइव as if gone mad, उत्पेतुः rose up.

text: तथैवापततां तेषां कपीनामसिभिः शितैः । शिरांसि सहसा जह्नू राक्षसा भीमदर्शनाः ॥६-७५-६२॥
translation: When the Rakshasas showed up in that manner, the monkeys approaching them cut off their heads instantly with sharp swords.
word_meanings: तथैव in that manner, दर्शना showed up, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, आपतताम् approaching, तेषांकपीनाम् those monkeys, शिरांसि head, सहसा instantly, शितैः sharp swords, जह्रुः cut off.

text: दशनैर्हृतकर्णाश्च मुष्टिनिष्कीर्णमस्तकाः । शिलाप्रहारभग्नाङ्गा विचेरुस्तत्र राक्षसाः ॥६-७५-६३॥
translation: The Rakshasas with ears bitten off by the teeth of the monkeys, skulls smashed with fists, and limbs broken with blows of rocks they moved about.
word_meanings: तत्र there, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, दशनैः teeth, हतकर्णाः , ears bitten off मुष्टिः with fist, निष्कीर्णमस्तकाः skulls smashed, शिलाप्रहारभग्नाङ्गाः limbs broken with blows of rocks, विचेरुः moved about.

text: तथैवाप्यपरे तेषां कपीनामभिलक्षिताः । प्रवीरानभितो जघ्नू राक्षसानां तरस्विनाम् ॥६-७५-६४॥
तथैवाप्यपरे तेषां कपीनामसिभिः शितैः । हरिवीरान्निजघ्नुश्च घोररूपा निशाचराः ॥६-७५-६५॥
translation: In the aforesaid manner the Vanaras struck more night rangers of terrific appearance, great heroes in front of them with sharp swords.
word_meanings: तथैव in the same way, घोररूपाः of terrific appearance, अपरे more, निशाचराः night rangers, शितैः sharp, असिभिः with swords, तेषाम् those, कपिनाम् Vanaras, प्रवीरान् great heroes, अभितः in front, जघ्नुः struck.

text: घ्नन्तमन्यं जघानान्यः पातयन्तमपातयत् । गर्हमाणं जगर्हे ऽन्यो दशन्तमपरो ऽदशत् ॥६-७५-६६॥
translation: One struck another, who was striking the other. One threw down another who was throwing the other. One abused another reproaching contemptuously, and one bit his rival biting the other.
word_meanings: घ्नन्तम् struck, अन्यम् other, अन्यः other, जघान striking, पातयन्तम् throwing down, अपातयत् thrown, गर्हमाणम् reproach contemptuously, अन्यः other, जगर्हः abused, दशन्तम् one who is biting, अपरः other, अदशत् bitten.

text: देहीत्यन्यो ददात्यन्यो ददामीत्यपरः पुनः । किं क्लेशयसि तिष्ठेति तत्रान्योन्यं बभाषिरे ॥६-७५-६७॥
translation: There they conversed this way with one another 'One said hit me and another one offered to hit,', again another intervened and said, 'Why are you crying?' meaning I offer resistance, one said 'Why are you suffering like this?'.
word_meanings: तत्र there, अन्यः others, देहीति hit me, अन्यः other, ददाति I am hitting, अपरःपुनः again other, ददामीति intervened, किंक्लेशयसि who are you crying, तष्ठइति suffer like this, अन्योन्यम् one another, बभाषिरे conversed with each other.

text: विप्रलम्बितवस्त्रं च विमुक्तकवचायुधम् । समुद्यतमहाप्रासं यष्टिशूलासिसङ्कुलम् । प्रावर्तत महारौद्रं युद्धं वानररक्षसाम् ॥६-७५-६८॥
translation: Highly enraged Vanaras and Rakshasas fought with them, raiment slipping, shields and weapons dodged, huge lances lifted to fight. They used fists, tridents, spears, and swords.
word_meanings: वानररक्षसाम् Vanaras and Rakshasas, महारौद्रम् highly enraged, युद्धम् fight, विप्रलम्भितशस्त्रम् raiment slipped, विमुक्तकवचायुधम् shields and weapons dodged, समुद्यतमहाप्रासम् huge lances were lifted up, यष्टिशूलासिसङ्कुलम् fists, tridents swords and spears, प्रावर्तत were used.

text: वानरान् दश सप्तेति राक्षसा जघ्नुराहवे । राक्षसान् दश सप्तेति वानराश्चाभ्यपातयन् ॥६-७५-६९॥
translation: In that fight the Rakshasas killed the Vanaras at the rate of ten to seven and the Vanaras struck down Rakshasas at the rate of ten to seven.
word_meanings: आहवे in that fight, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, दश ten, सप्त seven, इति like this, वानरान् Vanaras, जघ्नुः struck, वानराश्च Vanaras, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, दश ten, सप्त seven, इति like this, अभ्यपातयन् kept killing.

text: विस्रस्तकेशवसनं विध्वस्तकवचध्वजम् । बलं राक्षसमालम्ब्य वानराः पर्यवारयन् ॥६-७५-७०॥
इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे पञ्चसप्ततितमः सर्गः ॥ ७५ ॥६-७५-७१॥
प्रवृत्ते सङ्कुले तस्मिन् घोरे वीरजनक्षये । अङ्गदः कम्पनं वीरमाससाद रणोत्सुकः ॥६-७६-१॥
translation: While the fierce fight brought destruction of heroes in the ongoing combat, Angada eager to fight, assailed gallant Kampana.
word_meanings: घोरे fierce, वीरजनक्ष्ये destruction of heroes, तस्मिन् in that, सङ्कुले combat, प्रवृत्ते ongoing,अङ्गदः Angada, रणोत्सुकः eager to fight, वीरम् gallant, कम्पनम् Kampana, आससाद assailed.

text: आहूय सो ऽङ्गदं कोपात् ताडयामास वेगितः । गदया कम्पनः पूर्वं स चचाल भृशाहतः ॥६-७६-२॥
translation: Kampana struck Angada challenging himin anticipation. He swiftly hurled a mace in anger and hurt him grievously and Angada reeled.
word_meanings: सःकम्पनः that Kampana, अङ्गदम् at Angada, आहूय challenging, पूर्वम् in anticipation, गदया mace, वेगितः swiftly, कोपात् in anger, ताडयामास hurled, भृशाहतः grievously hurt, सः he, चचाल reeled.

text: स सञ्ज्ञां प्राप्य तेजस्वी चिक्षेप शिखरं गिरेः । अर्दितश्च प्रहारेण कम्पनः पतितो भुवि ॥६-७६-३॥
translation: Rejuvenated Angada, after gaining consciousness acquired a mountain peak and shattered Kampana with a blow. wounded Kampana fell down.
word_meanings: तेजस्वी rejuvenated, सः he, संज्ञाम् regaining consciousness, प्राप्य acquired, गिरेः mountain, शिखरम् peak, चिक्षेप shattered, कम्पनः Kampana, प्रहारेण blow, अर्दितः wounded, भुवि ground, पतितः fell.

text: ततस्तु कम्पनं दृष्ट्वा शोणिताक्षो हतं रणे । रथेनाभ्यपतत् क्षिप्रं तत्राङ्गदमभीतवत् ॥६-७६-४॥
translation: Then seeing Kampana killed, Sonitaksha, a fearless hero, quickly reached Angada by chariot.
word_meanings: ततः then, शोणिताक्षः Sonitaksha, रणे in war, हतम् killed, कम्पनम् Kampana, दृष्टवा seeing, तत्र there, अबीतवत् fearless hero, रथेन by chariot, अङ्गदम् to Angada, क्षिप्रम् quickly, अभ्यपतत् reached.

text: सो ऽङ्गदं निशितैर्बाणैस्तदा विव्याध वेगितः । शरीरदारणैस्तीक्ष्णैः कालाग्निसमविग्रहैः ॥६-७६-५॥
translation: He (Sonitaksha) swiftly pierced with pointed shafts resembling fire raging at the time of dissolution and struck Angada with arrows known by names, Ksura, Ksurapra, Naracha, Vatsadanta, Silimukha, Karni, Salya, vipada and many sharp arrows.
word_meanings: सः he, वेगितः swiftly, शरीरदारणैः piercing shafts, तीक्ष्णैः pointed, कालाग्निसमविग्रहैः resembling fire raging at the time of dissolution, निशितैः sharp, बाणैः shafts, अङ्गदम् Angada, विव्याध struck, क्षुरक्षुरप्रनाराचैः known as Ksura, Ksurapra, Naracha, वत्सदन्सैः Vatsadanta, शिलीमुखैः Silimukha, कर्णिशल्यविपादैःच Karni, Salya, Vipada, निशितैः sharp, बहुभिश्च many, शरैः arrows.

text: क्षुरक्षुरप्रैर्नाराचैर्वत्सदन्तैः शिलीमुखैः । कर्णिशल्यविपाठैश्च बहुभिर्निशितैः शरैः ॥६-७६-६॥
translation: He (Sonitaksha) swiftly pierced with pointed shafts resembling fire raging at the time of dissolution and struck Angada with arrows known by names, Ksura, Ksurapra, Naracha, Vatsadanta, Silimukha, Karni, Salya, vipada and many sharp arrows.
word_meanings: सः he, वेगितः swiftly, शरीरदारणैः piercing shafts, तीक्ष्णैः pointed, कालाग्निसमविग्रहैः resembling fire raging at the time of dissolution, निशितैः sharp, बाणैः shafts, अङ्गदम् Angada, विव्याध struck, क्षुरक्षुरप्रनाराचैः known as Ksura, Ksurapra, Naracha, वत्सदन्सैः Vatsadanta, शिलीमुखैः Silimukha, कर्णिशल्यविपादैःच Karni, Salya, Vipada, निशितैः sharp, बहुभिश्च many, शरैः arrows.

text: अङ्गदः प्रतिविद्धाङ्गो वालिपुत्रः प्रतापवान् । धनुरग्र्यं रथं बाणान् ममर्द तरसा बली ॥६-७६-७॥
translation: Courageous son of Vali, the mighty Angada encountered with vigour and crumbled the formidable bow (of Sonitaksha), his chariot and arrows.
word_meanings: प्रतिविद्धाङ्गः encountered, वालिपुत्रः Vali's son, प्रतापवान् courageous, बली mighty, अङ्गदः Angada, उग्रम् formidable, धनुः bow, रथम् chariot, बाणान् arrows, तरसा vigour, ममर्द crumbled.

text: शोणिताक्षस्ततः क्षिप्रमसिचर्म समाददे । उत्पपात दिवं क्रुद्धो वेगवानविचारयन् ॥६-७६-८॥
translation: Thereupon enraged Sonitaksha, quickly sprang up to the sky at high speed with sword and shield.
word_meanings: ततः there upon, शोणिताक्षः Sonitaksha, क्षिप्रम् quickly, असिचर्म sword, समाददे shield, दिवम् to the sky, क्रुद्धः enraged, वेगवान् at high speed, अविचारयन् unhesitatingly, उत्पपात sprang up.

text: तं क्षिप्रतरमाप्लुत्य परामृश्याङ्गदो बली । करेण तस्य तं खड्गं समाच्छिद्य ननाद च ॥६-७६-९॥
translation: Mighty Angada springing up at a higher speed grasped his (Sonitaksha) hand and irritated him with a sword making loud noise.
word_meanings: बली mighty, अङ्गदः Angada, क्षिप्रतरम् at a higher speed, आफ्लुत्य springing up, तम् him, परामृश्य grasped, करेण by hand, तस्य his, खङ्गम् sword, आच्छिद्य irritated, ननाद च making loud noise.

text: तस्यांसफलके खड्गं निजघान ततो ऽङ्गदः । यज्ञोपवीतवच्चैनं चिच्छेद कपिकुञ्जरः ॥६-७६-१०॥
translation: Then Angada pierced his sword on the fl at surface of his shoulder diagonally and cut him with his sword.
word_meanings: ततः then, अङ्गदः Angada, तस्य his, अंसफलके fl at surface, खडगम् sword, निजघान pierced, कपिकुञ्जरः monkey leader, एनम् in that way, यज्ञोपवतवत् diagonally, चिच्छेद cut him.

text: तं प्रगृह्य महाखड्गं विनद्य च पुनःपुनः । वालिपुत्रो ऽभिदुद्राव रणशीर्षे परानरीन् ॥६-७६-११॥
translation: Vali's son, seizing that great sword again and again, roaring to finally terminate the remaining Rakshasas, went forward.
word_meanings: वालिपुत्रः Vali's son, तंमहाखडगम् that great sword, प्रगृह्य seizing, पुनःपुनः again and again, विनद्य च roaring, परीन् to final termination, अरीन् enemy, रणशीर्षे left over in the fight, अभिदुद्राव went forward.

text: आयसीं तु गदां वीरः प्रगृह्य कनकाङ्गदः । शोणिताक्षः समाविध्य तमेवानुपपात ह ॥६-७६-१२॥
translation: Sonitha adorned with golden armlets taking hold of iron mace rushed behind Angada.
word_meanings: वीरः hero, कनकाङ्गदः adorned with golden armlets, सः he, शोणिताः Sonitha, समाविध्य recovering, आयसीम् iron, गदाम् mace, प्रगृह्य taking hold, तमेव with that, अनुपपात ह rushed behind.

text: प्रजङ्घसहितो वीरो यूपाक्षस्तु ततो बली । रथेनाभिययौ क्रुद्धो वालिपुत्रं महाबलम् ॥६-७६-१३॥
translation: Then mighty Yupaksha, and Prajaghna for his part in fury assailed mighty Angada's chariot.
word_meanings: ततः then, वीरः hero, बली mighty, यूपाक्षस्तु Yupaksha also, प्रजङ्घसहितः Prajagna for his part, क्रुद्धः angry, महाबलम् mighty, वालिपुत्रम् Angada, रथेन chariot, अभिययौ assailed.

text: तयोर्मध्ये कपिश्रेष्ठः शोणिताक्षप्रजङ्घयोः । विशाखयोर्मध्यगतः पूर्णचन्द्र इवाभवत् ॥६-७६-१४॥
translation: Angada, the foremost of Vanaras, coming between both Sonitaksha and Prajaghna shone like a full moon between the Visakha stars.
word_meanings: तयोः both of them, शोणिताक्षप्रजङ्घयोः Sonitaksha and Prajaghna, मध्ये midst, कपिश्रेष्ठः foremost of monkeys, विशाखयोः Visakha, मध्यगतः coming in between, पूर्णचन्द्रःइव like full moon, आभवत् shone.

text: अङ्गदं परिरक्षान्तौ मैन्दो द्विविद एव च । तस्य तस्थातुरभ्याशे परस्परदिदृक्षया ॥६-७६-१५॥
translation: Both Mainda and Dwivida (maternal uncles of Angada) took position for the protection of one another facing the enemy.
word_meanings: मैन्दः Mainda, द्विविदःएव even Dwivida, अङ्गदम् Angada, परिरक्षन्तौ for protection, परस्परदीदृक्ष्या one another to hold in check, तस्य his, अभ्याशे facing the enemy, तस्थतुः took position.

text: अभिपेतुर्महाकायाः प्रतियत्ता महाबलाः । राक्षसा वानरान् रोषादसिचर्मगदाधराः ॥६-७६-१६॥
translation: Rakshasas wielding swords and mace, endowed with stupendous strength and of huge body agitated and assailed Vanaras.
word_meanings: महाकायाः of huge body, महाबलाः stupendous strength, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, प्रतियत्ताः vigilant, असिचर्मगदाधराः wielding sword and mace, रोषात् agitated, वानरान् Vanaras, अभिषेतुः assailed.

text: त्रयाणां वानरेन्द्राणां त्रिभी राक्षसपुङ्गवैः । संसक्तानां महद्युद्धमभवद्रोमहर्षणम् ॥६-७६-१७॥
translation: A momentous war took place between the three Rakshasas (Prajaghna, Yupaksha and Sonitaksha) and Vanara chiefs (Angada, Dwivida and Mainda) that caused horripilation.
word_meanings: त्रिभिः three, राक्षसपुङ्गवैः Rakshasa leaders, संसक्तानाम् momentous, त्रयाणाम् with the three, वानरेन्द्राणाम् Vanara chiefs, रोमहर्षणम् horripilation, महत् momentous, युद्धम् war, अभवत् took place.

text: ते तु वृक्षान् समादाय सम्प्रचिक्षिपुराहवे । खड्गेन प्रतिचिच्छेद तान् प्रजङ्घो महाबलः ॥६-७६-१८॥
translation: In the comb at the Vanaras seizing hold of trees hurled violently and mighty Prajaghna with his sword shattered them
word_meanings: आहवे in the combat, ते they, वृक्षान् trees, समादाय taking, सम्प्रचिक्षिपुः at that time shattered, महाबलः mighty, प्रजङ्घः Prajaghana, खडगेन with sword, तान् them, प्रतिचिच्छेद violently hurled.

text: रथानश्वान् द्रुमैः शैलैस्ते प्रचिक्षिपुराहवे । शरौधैः प्रतिचिच्छेद तान् यूपाक्षो निशाचरः ॥६-७६-१९॥
translation: In that war the Vanaras hurled trees, rocks on chariots and horses and Yupaksha encountered them and tore them.
word_meanings: आहवे in that war, रथान् chariots, अश्वान् horses, द्रुमान् trees, शैलान् rocks, प्रतिचिक्षिपुः encountered, निशाचरः night rangers, यूपाक्षः Yupaksha, तान् them, शरौघैः tore them चिच्छेद , shattered.

text: सृष्टान् द्विविदमैन्दाभ्यां द्रुमानुत्पाट्य वीर्यवान् । बभञ्ज गदया मध्ये शोणिताक्षः प्रतापवान् ॥६-७६-२०॥
translation: Heroic and courageous Sonitaksha tore the trees hurled by Dwivida and Mainda in midway by his mace and crushed them.
word_meanings: वीर्यवान् heroic, प्रतापवान् courageous, शोणिताक्षः Sonitaksha, द्विविदमैन्दाभ्याम् with Dwivida and Mainda, उत्पाट्य hurled, सृष्टान् tearing, द्रुमान् trees, गदया by mace, मध्ये midway, बभञ्ज crushed.

text: उद्यम्य विपुलं खड्गं परमर्मनिकृन्तनम् । प्रजङ्घो वालिपुत्राय अभिदुद्राव वेगितः ॥६-७६-२१॥
translation: Prajaghna taking up a huge sword went forward swiftly and assailed Angada.
word_meanings: प्रजङ्घः Prajaghna, परमर्मनिकृन्तनम् that which can pierce into private parts, विपुलम् huge, खडगम् sword, उद्यम्य taking up, वेगितः swiftly, वालिपुत्राय Angada's, अभिदुद्राव went forward and assailed.

text: तमभ्याशगतं दृष्ट्वा वानरेन्द्रो महाबलः । आजघानाश्वकर्णेन द्रुमेणातिबलस्तदा ॥६-७६-२२॥
translation: Then Vanara leader Angada who was endowed with extraordinary strength, seeing Prajaghna of stupendous power coming forward, hit him with Aswakarna tree.
word_meanings: तदा then, महाबलः endowed with extraordinary strength, अतिबलः of stupendous power, वानरेन्द्रः Vanara leader, अभ्याशगतम् coming forward, तम् him, दृष्टवा seeing, अश्वकर्णेव Aswakarna, द्रुमेण tree, आजघान hit him.

text: बाहुं चास्य सनिस्त्रिंशमाजघान स मुष्टिना । वालिपुत्रस्य घातेन स पपात क्षितावसिः ॥६-७६-२३॥
translation: Angada hit the shoulder of Prajaghna which held the sword, with his fist. By that blow the sword got broken and dropped down
word_meanings: सः he, Angada, अस्य his, सनिस्त्रिंशम् which held the sword, बाहुम् shoulders, मुष्टिना with his fist, आजघान hit him, वालिपुत्रस्य Angada, घातेन by the blow, सःअसिः that sword, क्षितौ broken, पपात fell.

text: तं दृष्ट्वा पतितं भूमौ खड्गमुत्पलसन्निभम् । मुष्टिं संवर्तयामास वज्रकल्पं महाबलः ॥६-७६-२४॥
translation: Seeing the pestle shaped sword fallen on the ground, mighty Prajaghna clenched his fist, which was as hard as the thunderbolt.
word_meanings: भूमौ on the ground, पतितम् fallen, मुलसन्निभम् pestle shape, तंखङ्गम् that sword, दृष्टवा seeing, महाबलः mighty, वज्रकल्पम् hard as thunderbolt, मुष्टिम् fist, सम्वर्तयामास clenched.

text: ललाटे स महावीर्यमङ्गदं वानरर्षभम् । आजघान महातेजाः स मुहूर्तं चचाल ह ॥६-७६-२५॥
translation: Sonitaksha of extraordinary energy hit at the forehead of highly valiant Angada. For a while Angada was unable to move.
word_meanings: महातेजाः of extraordinary energy, सः he, Sonitaksha, महावीर्यम् highly valiant, वानरर्षभम् Vanara bull, अङ्गदम् Angada, ललाटे forehead, आजघान hit, सः he, मुहर्तम् for a while, चचाल ह unable to move.

text: स सञ्ज्ञां प्राप्य तेजस्वी वालिपुत्रः प्रतापवान् । प्रजङ्घस्य शिरः कायात् खड्गेनापातयत् क्षितौ ॥६-७६-२६॥
translation: Son of Vali, who was full of vigour, on regaining consciousness hit Prajaghna on the head and trunk and made him fall down.
word_meanings: तेजस्वी full of vigour, प्रतापवान् courageous, सः he, वालिपुत्र Vali's son, संज्ञाम् regaining, प्राप्य hit, खङ्गेना by the sword, प्रजङ्घस्य Prajaghna's, शिरः head, कायात् his trunk, पातयत्क्षितौ made to fall down.

text: स यूपाक्षो ऽश्रुपूर्णाक्षः पितृव्ये निहते रणे । अवरुह्य रथात् क्षिप्रं क्षीणेषुः खड्गमाददे ॥६-७६-२७॥
translation: Instantly alighting from the chariot, Yupaksha seeing the uncle exhausted and hurt, eyes filled with tears, he wielded the sword.
word_meanings: रणे in fight, पितृव्ये uncle, निहते fallen hurt, सः he, यूपाक्षः Yupaksha, अश्रुपूर्णाक्षः eyes filled with tears, क्षीणेषुः exhausted, क्षिप्रम् instantly, रथात् chariot, अवरुह्य alighting, खङ्गम् sword, आददे wielded.

text: तमापतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य यूपाक्षं द्विविदस्त्वरन् । आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो जाग्राह च बलाद्बली ॥६-७६-२८॥
translation: Observing Yupakasha fallen and rushing quickly, furious Dwivida struck him in the bosom with force and caught him
word_meanings: द्विविदः Dwivida, त्वरन् quickly, आपतन्तम् fallen, तंयूपाक्षम् Yupakasha, सम्प्रेक्ष्य observing, क्रुद्धः furious, उरसि bosom, आजघान marched, बली , बलात् with force, जग्राह caught.

text: गृहीतं भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा शोणिताक्षो महाबलः । आजघान गदाग्रेण वक्षसि द्विविदं ततः ॥६-७६-२९॥
translation: Then seeing the brother caught, mighty Sonitaksha struck Dwivida in the bosom by a mace.
word_meanings: ततः then, गदाग्रेण with the mace, शोणिताक्षः Sonitaksha, महाबलम् of great strength, भ्रातरम् brother, गृहीतम् being caught, दृष्टवा seeing, द्विविदम् Dwivida, वक्षसि from the bosom, आजघान struck.

text: स गदाभिहतस्तेन चचाल च महाबलः । उद्यतां च पुनस्तस्य जहार द्विविदो गदाम् ॥६-७६-३०॥
translation: Dwivida, though mighty reeled and could not move when struck by Sonitaksha. He got up and again and snatched the mace from Sonithaksha.
word_meanings: गदा mace, तेन by that, अभिहतः reeled, महाबलः mighty, सःद्विविदः that Dwivida, सञ्चचाल not move, पुनः again, उद्यताम् uplifted, तस्य his, गदाम् mace, जहार snatched.

text: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे वीरो मैन्दो वानरयूथपः । यूपाक्षं ताडयामास तलेनोरसि वीर्यवान् ॥६-७६-३१॥
translation: In the meantime, valiant Vanara leader Mainda arrived and struck with his palm on the chest of Yupaksha.
word_meanings: एतस्मिन् अन्तरे in the meantime मैन्दः Mainda, वानरयूथपः Vanara leader, वीरः hero, आगमत् arrived, वीर्यवान् valiant, तलेन by palm, यूपाक्षम् Yupaksha, उरसि chest, ताडयामास struck.

text: तौ शोणिताक्षयूपाक्षौ प्लवङ्गाभ्यां तरस्विनौ । चक्रुतुः समरे तीव्रमाकर्षोत्पाटनं भृशम् ॥६-७६-३२॥
translation: In that fight, courageous Sonitaksha and Yupaksha contested with the two monkeys pulling one another violently and throwing intensely.
word_meanings: समरे in that fight, तौ the two, तरस्विनौ courageous, शोणिताक्ष्यूपाक्षौ Sonitaksha and Yupaksha, प्लवङ्गाभ्याम् monkeys, भृशम् violently, तीव्रम् intense, आकर्षोत्पाटनम् one another pulling and over throwing, चक्रतुः contested.

text: द्विविदः शोणिताक्षं तु विददार नखैर्मुखे । निष्पिपेष च वगेन क्षितावाविध्य वीर्यवान् ॥६-७६-३३॥
translation: Valiant Dwivida, for his part, tore Sonitaksha on his face with his nails, and quickening his pace threw him on the surface of the ground and bruised him.
word_meanings: वीर्यवान् valiant, द्विविदः Dwivida, नखैः nails, शोणिताक्षम् Sonitaksha, मुखे face, विददार tearing, वेगेन quickening his pace, क्षितौ on the surface of the ground, आविध्य thrown with force, निष्पिपेष च bruising.

text: यूपाक्षमपि सङ्क्रुद्धो मैन्दो वानरयूथपः । पीडयामास बाहुभ्यां स पपात हतः क्षितौ ॥६-७६-३४॥
translation: Vanara leader, Mainda on his part, angrily pierced Yupaksha many times who fell on the ground dead.
word_meanings: वानरयूथपः Vanara leader, मैन्दः Mainda, अभिसङ्कृद्धः getting very angry, यूपाक्षम् Yupaksha, बाहुभ्याम् many times, पीडयामास pierced, सः he, हतः dead, क्षितौ on the ground, पपात fell.

text: हतप्रवीरा व्यथिता राक्षसेन्द्रचमूस्तदा । जगामाभिमुखी सा तु कुम्भकर्णसुतो यतः ॥६-७६-३५॥
translation: Then many heroes died, Rakshasa king's army was distressed and went towards where Kumbhakarna's son was fighting.
word_meanings: तदा then, हतप्रवीरा heroes dead, सा many, राक्षसेन्द्रचमूः Rakshasa king's army, व्यथिता distressed, कुम्भकर्णसुतः son of Kumbhakarna, यतः like that, अभिमुखी went towards, जगाम went.

text: आपतन्तीं च वेगेन कुम्भस्तां सान्त्वयच्चमूम् ॥६-७६-३६॥
translation: Kumbha quickly restored the confidence of the troops. Then energetic Kumbha seeing the eminent heroes of Rakshasa army struck down, he found a favourable opportunity and drew up an excellent strategy and performed an extremely difficult deed in the battlefield.
word_meanings: कुम्भः Kumbha, वेगेन quickly, आपतन्तीम् restored confidence, तांचमूम् of the troops, सान्त्वयत् , अथ and then, तेजस्वी energetic, कुम्भः Kumbha, महावीर्यैः great hero, लब्धलक्षैः favourable opportunity, प्लवंगमैः monkeys, निपातितमहावीराम् eminent heroes struck down, रक्षश्चमूम् of Rakshasa army, दृष्टवा seeing, ततः then, रणे in the battlefield, सुदुष्करम् very difficult, अथोत्कष्टम् drawn up excellent, कर्म task, चक्रे performed.

text: अथोत्कृष्टं महावीर्यैर्लब्धलक्षैः प्लवङ्गमैः । निपातितमहावीरां दृष्ट्वा रक्षश्चमूं ततः । कुम्भः प्रचक्रे तेजस्वी रणे कर्म सुदुष्करम् ॥६-७६-३७॥
translation: Kumbha quickly restored the confidence of the troops. Then energetic Kumbha seeing the eminent heroes of Rakshasa army struck down, he found a favourable opportunity and drew up an excellent strategy and performed an extremely difficult deed in the battlefield.
word_meanings: कुम्भः Kumbha, वेगेन quickly, आपतन्तीम् restored confidence, तांचमूम् of the troops, सान्त्वयत् , अथ and then, तेजस्वी energetic, कुम्भः Kumbha, महावीर्यैः great hero, लब्धलक्षैः favourable opportunity, प्लवंगमैः monkeys, निपातितमहावीराम् eminent heroes struck down, रक्षश्चमूम् of Rakshasa army, दृष्टवा seeing, ततः then, रणे in the battlefield, सुदुष्करम् very difficult, अथोत्कष्टम् drawn up excellent, कर्म task, चक्रे performed.

text: स धनुर्धन्विनां श्रेष्ठः प्रगृह्य सुसमाहितः । मुमोचाशीविषप्रख्यान् शरान् देहविदारणान् ॥६-७६-३८॥
translation: He (Kumbha), the foremost wielder of bow, taking up the bow, remaining fully composed released arrows that resembled poisonous serpents capable of tearing the flesh.
word_meanings: धन्विनाम् wielder of bow, श्रेष्ठः foremost, सः he, धनुः bow, प्रगृह्य taking, सुसमाहितः fully composed, आशीविषप्रख्यान् resembling poisonous serpents, देहविदारणान् capable of tearing the body, शरान् arrows, मुमोच released.

text: तस्य तच्छुशुभे भूयः सशरं धनुरुत्तमम् । विद्युदैरावतार्चिष्माद्द्वितीयेन्द्रधनुर्यथा ॥६-७६-३९॥
translation: Those best arrows fixed to the bow were shining like the cloud with flashes of lightning, and like a second bow of Indra.
word_meanings: सशरम् those arrows, उत्तमम् best, तस्य his, तत् that, धनुः bow, विद्युदैरावतार्चिष्मत् shining like the cloud with flashes of lightning, द्वितीयेन्द्रधनुः second bow of Indra यथा like that, भूयः shone, शुशुभे released.

text: आकर्णाकृष्टमुक्तेन जघान द्विविदं तदा । तेन हाटकपुङ्खेन पत्रिणा पत्रवाससा ॥६-७६-४०॥
translation: Then he struck Dwivida with a golden shafted arrow that was loosened to kill by stretching the bow till the ear and released.
word_meanings: तदा then, आकर्णाकृष्टमुक्तेन stretched till the ear and released, हाटकपुङ्खेन fixed with wings, पत्त्रवाससा arrow loosened to kill, तेन by that, पत्रतिणा golden shafted arrow, द्विविदम् Dwivida, जघान struck.

text: सहसा ऽभिहतस्तेन विप्रमुक्तपदः स्फुरन् । निपपाताद्रिकूटाभो विह्वलः प्लवगोत्तमः ॥६-७६-४१॥
translation: Struck all of a sudden, the foremost Vanara (Dwivida) alarmed, fell with legs, outstretched, trembling.
word_meanings: तेन by that, सहसा sudden, अभिहतः struck, त्रिकूटाभः Trikuta, प्लवगोत्तमः foremost of Vanara, विह्वलन् alarmed, वप्रमुक्तपदः legs outstretched, स्फुरन् trembling, निपपात fell.

text: मैन्दस्तु भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा भग्नं तत्र महाहवे । अभिदुद्राव वेगेन प्रगृह्य महतीं शिलाम् ॥६-७६-४२॥
translation: Seeing the brother shattered in the great combat, Mainda on his part seizing a huge rock rushed swiftly.
word_meanings: मैन्दःतु Maindaaslo, तत्र there, महाहवे great comb at भग्नम् shattered, भ्रातरम् brother, दृष्टवा seeing, महतीम् huge, शिलाम् rock, प्रगृह्य taking, वेगेन swiftly, अभिदुद्राव rushed.

text: तां शिलां तु प्रचिक्षेप राक्षसाय महाबलः । बिभेद तां शिलां कुम्भः प्रसन्नैः पञ्चभिः शरैः ॥६-७६-४३॥
translation: The mighty Vanara (Mainda) for his part hurled the rock to crush the Rakshasa. Kumbha attacked him with five sharp arrows and rock got broken.
word_meanings: महाबलः mighty, ताम् him, शिलाम् rock, राक्षसाय Rakshasa, प्रचिक्षेप hurled to crush, कुम्भः Kumbha, प्रसन्नैः sharp, पञ्चभिः five, शरैः arrows, तांशिलाम् that rock, बिभेद broken.

text: सन्धाय चान्यं सुमुखं शरमासीविषोपमम् । आजघान महातेजा वक्षसि द्विविदाग्रजम् ॥६-७६-४४॥
translation: Haughty Kumbha, fixed a charming arrow resembling a venomous serpent and struck at Dwivida's brother.
word_meanings: महातेजाः haughty, सुमुख arrow म् charming, आशीविषोपमम् resembling venomous serpent, अन्यम् another, शरम् arrow, सन्धाय fixing, द्विविदाग्रजम् Dwivida's brother, वक्षसि on the chest, आजघान struck.

text: स तु तेन प्रहारेण मैन्दो वानरयूथपः । मर्मण्यभिहतस्तेन पपात भुवि मूर्च्छितः ॥६-७६-४५॥
translation: That blow hit the Vanara leader in his private parts, and Mainda lost consciousness and fell down.
word_meanings: वानरयूथपः Vanara leader, सःमैन्दः that Mainda, तेन by that, प्रहरेण blow, तेन his, मर्मणि private, अभिहतः hit, मूर्छितः lost consciousness, भुवि ground, पपात fell.

text: अङ्गदो मातुलौ दृष्ट्वा पतितौ तु महाबलौ । अभिदुद्राव वेगेन कुम्भमद्युतकार्मुकम् ॥६-७६-४६॥
translation: Seeing the two maternal uncles fallen, Angada, who was endowed with great strength, attacked Kumbha, wielding a bow.
word_meanings: अङ्गदः Angada, पथितौ fallen, महाबलौ endowed with great strength, मातुलौ maternal uncle, दृष्टवा seeing, उद्यतकार्मुकम् wielding bow, कुम्भम् Kumbha, वेगेन quickly, अभिदुद्राव attacked.

text: तमापतन्तं विव्याध कुम्भः पञ्चभिरायसैः । त्रिभिश्चान्यैः शितैर्बाणैर्मातङ्गमिव तोमरैः ॥६-७६-४७॥
translation: Kumbha seeing Angada advancing towards him, with five steel arrows and three shafts pierced him just as an elephant is pierced with lances.
word_meanings: कुम्भः Kumbha, आपतन्तम् coming towards, तम् him, पञ्चभिः five, आयसैः steel arrows, शितैः hundred, अन्यैः other, त्रिभिःबाणैः threeshafts, तोमरैः lances, मातङ्गमिव like elephant, विव्याध pierced.

text: सो ऽङ्गदं विविधैर्बाणैः कुम्भो विव्याध वीर्यवान् । अकुण्ठधारैर्निशितैस्तीक्ष्णैः कनकभूषणैः ॥६-७६-४८॥
translation: Kumbha, a valiant hero pierced Angada continuously with several sharp and pointed arrows decked with gold.
word_meanings: सः he, वीर्यवान् valiant, कुम्भः Kumbha, अकुण्ठधारैः unobstructed, निशितैः sharp, तीक्ष्णैः pointed, विविधैः several, कनकभूषणैः gold ornaments, बाणैः arrows, अङ्गदम् Angada, विव्याध pierced.

text: अङ्गदः प्रतिविद्धाङ्गो वालिपुत्रो न कम्पते । शिलापादपवर्षाणि तस्य मूर्ध्नि ववर्ष ह ॥६-७६-४९॥
translation: Vali's son was not shaken by the strike, showered rain of rocks and trees on his (Kumbha) forehead.
word_meanings: प्रतिविद्धाङ्गः not shaken by attack, वालिपुत्रः Vali's son, अङ्गदः Angada, न कम्पते not shaken, तस्य his, मूर्ध्नि forehead, शिलापादपवर्षाणि rain of rocks and trees, ववर्ष ह showered.

text: स प्रचिच्छेद तान् सर्वान् बिभेद च पुनः शिलाः । कुम्भकर्णात्मजः श्रीमान् वालिपुत्रसमीरितान् ॥६-७६-५०॥
translation: Prosperous Kumbhakarna's son also shattered the rocks hurled on him, breaking them.
word_meanings: श्रीमान् prosperous, कुम्भकर्णात्मजः Kumbhakarna's son, सः he, वालिपुत्त्रसमीरितान् rained by Vali's son, तान् those, सर्वान् all, प्रचिच्छेद shattered, शिलाःपुनः rocks and again, बिभेद च broken also.

text: आपतन्तं च सम्प्रेक्ष्य कुम्भो वानरयूथपम् । भ्रुवोर्विव्याध बाणाभ्यामुल्काभ्यामिव कुञ्जरम् । तस्य सुस्राव रुधिरं पिहिते चास्य लोचने ॥६-७६-५१॥
translation: Kumbha observing the Vanara leader coming towards him attacked him with fire sticks and pierced his eyebrows.
word_meanings: कुम्भः Kumbha, आपतन्तम् coming towards, वानरयूथपम् Vanara leaders, सम्प्रेक्ष्य observing, उल्काभ्याम् fire sticks, कुञ्जरम् इव like elephant, बाणाभ्याम् with arrows, भ्रुवोः eyebrows, विव्याध pierced.

text: अङ्गदः पाणिना नेत्रे पिधाय रुधिरोक्षिते । सालमासन्नमेकेन परिजग्राह पाणिना ् । सम्पीड्य चोरसि स्कन्धं करेणाभिनिवेश्य च । किञ्चिदभ्यवनम्यैनमुन्ममाथ यथा गजः ॥६-७६-५२॥
तमिन्द्रकेतुप्रतिमं वृक्षं मन्दरसन्निभम् । समुत्सृजन्तं वेगेन पश्यतां सर्वरक्षसाम् ॥६-७६-५३॥
translation: All the Rakshasas seeing the tall tree, which was like Mandara mountain, resembling Indra's banner hurriedly was about to let loose.
word_meanings: सर्वरक्षसाम् all Rakshasas, पश्यताम् seeing, इन्द्रकेतुप्रतिमम् resembling Indra's banner, मन्दरसन्निभम् like the Mandara mountain, तंवृक्षम् that tree, वेगेन hurriedly, समुत्सृजन्तम् impatiently.

text: स बिभेद शितैर्बाणैः सप्तभिः कायभेदनैः ॥६-७६-५४॥
अङ्गदो विव्यथे ऽभीक्ष्णं ससाद च मुमोह च ॥६-७६-५५॥
translation: Kumbha shattered Angada with seven sharp arrows capable of tearing the body. Angada, pained by that screamed and lost his senses.
word_meanings: सः he, कायभेदनैः tearing the body, शितैः sharp, सप्तभिः seven, बाणैः arrows, चिच्छेद shattered, सः , अङ्गदः that Angada, अभीक्ष्णम् immediately, विव्यथे pained, ससादच screaming, मुमोह च lost senses.

text: अङ्गदं व्यथितं दृष्ट्वा सीदन्तमिव सागरे । दुरासदं हरिश्रेष्ठं रामायन्ये न्यवेदयन् ॥६-७६-५६॥
translation: Seeing the foremost Vanara, Angada who was difficult to encounter fell and like sinking into the ocean of despondency, the foremost Vanaras submitted to Rama.
word_meanings: व्यथितं tormented, सीदन्तम् sinking into despondency, सागरम् इव like into an ocean, दुरासदम् difficult to encounter, अङ्गदम् Angada, दृष्टवा seeing, हरिश्रेष्ठाः foremost of monkeys, रामाय to Rama, न्यवेदयन् submitted.

text: रामस्तु व्यथितं श्रुत्वा वालिपुत्रं रणाजिरे । व्यादिदेश हरिश्रेष्ठान् जाम्बवत्प्रमुखांस्ततः ॥६-७६-५७॥
translation: On hearing that Angada was tormented in the battlefield and pained he ordered Jambavan and the best of monkey leaders to help him.
word_meanings: ततः then, रामः Rama, रणाजरे in the battlefield, वालिपुत्रम् Vali's son, व्यथितम् pained, श्रुत्वा hearing, जाम्बवत्प्रमुखान् Jambavan and other leaders, हरिश्रेष्ठान् best of monkeys, व्यादेश ordered.

text: ते तु वानरशार्दूलाः श्रुत्वा रामस्य शासनम् । अभिपेतुः सुसङ्क्रुद्धाः कुम्भमुद्यतकार्मुकम् ॥६-७६-५८॥
translation: On hearing Rama's command, the enraged Vanara tigers took up bows to attack Kumbha.
word_meanings: ते those, वानरशार्दूलाः Vanara tigers, रामस्य Rama's, शासनम् command, श्रुत्वा hearing, सुसङ्कृद्धाः very angry, उद्यतकार्मुकम् took up his bow, कुम्भम् Kumbha, अभिपेतुः to attack.

text: ततो द्रुमशिलाहस्ताः कोपसंरक्तलोचनाः । रिरक्षिषन्तो ऽभ्यपतन्नङ्गदं वानरर्षभाः ॥६-७६-५९॥
translation: Bulls among Vanaras then took trees, and rocks in hand, with their eyes red in anger started for the protection of Angada.
word_meanings: ततः then, वानरर्षभाः bull among Vanaras, द्रुमशिलाहस्ताः trees, rocks taking in hand, कोपसंरक्तलोचनाः eyes red in anger, अङ्गदम् Angada, रिरक्षिषन्तः for the protection, अभ्यपतन् started.

text: जाम्बवांश्च सुषेणश्च वेगदर्शी च वानरः । कुम्भकर्णात्मजं वीरं क्रुद्धाः समभिदुद्रुवुः ॥६-७६-६०॥
translation: Jambavan, Sushena, Vegadarsi and other heroic Vanaras, full of anger also rushed to assail Kumbhakarna's son.
word_meanings: जाम्बवांश्च Jambavan and others, सुषेणश्च Sushena, वानरः Vanaras, वेगदर्शी च Vegadarsi, क्रुद्धाः angry, वीरम् hero, कुम्भकर्णात्मजम् Kumbhakarna's son, समभिदुद्रुवुः also rushed.

text: समीक्ष्यापततस्तांस्तु वानरेन्द्रान् महाबलान् । आववार शरौघेण नगेनेव जलाशयम् ॥६-७६-६१॥
translation: Perceiving that great army of Vanara leaders are advancing, Kumbha obstructed them with a volley of arrows just like a mountain obstructing the path of torrent.
word_meanings: आपततः advancing, महाबलान् great army, तान् them, वानरेन्द्रान् Vanara leaders, समीक्ष्य perceiving, जलाशयम् torrent, नगेनेव like a mountain, शरौघेण with volley of arrows, आववार obstructed.

text: तस्य बाणपथं प्राप्य न शोकुरतिवर्तितुम् । वानरेन्द्रा महात्मानो वेलामिव महोदधिः ॥६-७६-६२॥
translation: The Vanara leaders could not bear the range of arrows of Kumbhaka, just as a tide can't overstep the shore of an ocean.
word_meanings: महात्मानः great self, वानरेंद्राः Vanara leader, तस्य his, बाणपथम् range of arrows, प्राप्य reaching, महोदधिः great ocean, वेलाम् इव like tide, अतिवर्तितुम् overstep, न शेकुः become unsuccessful.

text: तांस्तु दृष्ट्वा हरिगणान् शरवृष्टिबिरर्दितान् । अङ्गदं पृष्ठतः कृत्वा भ्रातृजं प्लवगेश्वरः ॥६-७६-६३॥
translation: Seeing the Vanara army pained by the rain of arrows, Sugriva, the Lord of Vanaras having Angada in his rear, swiftly rushed and assailed Kumbhakarna's son just like a lion roaming in the mountains attacks elephants.
word_meanings: शरवृष्टिभि rain of arrows, अर्दितान् pained, तान् them, हरिगणान् Vanara army, दृष्टवा seeing, प्लवगेश्वरः Lord of Vanaras, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, भ्रातृजम् brother's son, अङ्गदम् Angada, पृष्ठतःकृत्वा in the rear, रणे in combat, वेगवान् endowed with speed, केसरी lion, शैलसानुचरम् roaming in the mountains, नागमिव like elephant, वेगेन swiftly, कुम्भमाहवे Kumbhakarna's son, अभिदुद्राव assailed.

text: अबिदुद्राव वेगेन सुग्रीवः कुम्भमाहवे । शैलसानुचरं नागं वेगवानिव केसरी ॥६-७६-६४॥
translation: Seeing the Vanara army pained by the rain of arrows, Sugriva, the Lord of Vanaras having Angada in his rear, swiftly rushed and assailed Kumbhakarna's son just like a lion roaming in the mountains attacks elephants.
word_meanings: शरवृष्टिभि rain of arrows, अर्दितान् pained, तान् them, हरिगणान् Vanara army, दृष्टवा seeing, प्लवगेश्वरः Lord of Vanaras, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, भ्रातृजम् brother's son, अङ्गदम् Angada, पृष्ठतःकृत्वा in the rear, रणे in combat, वेगवान् endowed with speed, केसरी lion, शैलसानुचरम् roaming in the mountains, नागमिव like elephant, वेगेन swiftly, कुम्भमाहवे Kumbhakarna's son, अभिदुद्राव assailed.

text: उत्पाट्य च महाशैलानश्वकर्णान् धवान् बहून् । अन्यांश्च विविधान् वृक्षांश्चिक्षेप च महाबलः ॥६-७६-६५॥
translation: Mighty strong he was, uprooting Aswakarna and many other several kinds of trees he hurled at them (Rakshasas).
word_meanings: सः he, महाबलः mighty strong, अश्वकर्णान्दवान् Aswakarna, बहून् many, महाशैलान् huge trees, उत्पाट्य uprooting, विविधान् several, अन्यान् others, वृक्षान् च trees, चिक्षेप hurled them.

text: तां छादयन्तीमाकाशं वृक्षवृष्टिं दुरासदाम् । कुम्भकर्णात्मजः शीघ्रं चिच्छेद निशितैः शरैः ॥६-७६-६६॥
translation: Frenzied Kumbhakarna's son was torn under the shower of trees that covered space with sharp arrows which was difficult to approach.
word_meanings: शीघ्रं frenzied, कुम्भकर्णात्मजः Kumbhakarna's son, आकाशम् space, छादयन्तीम् covering, दुरासदाम् difficult to approach, ताम् them, वृक्षवृष्टिम् shower of trees, निशितैः sharp, शरैः arrows, चिच्छेद torn asunder.

text: अभिलक्षेण तीव्रेण कुम्भेन निशितैः शरैः । आचितास्ते द्रुमा रेजुर्यथा घोराः शतघ्नयः ॥६-७६-६७॥
translation: The sharp arrows aimed at the target by Kumbha covered the trees and they shone like dreadful Sataghnis.
word_meanings: अभिलक्षेण aimed at the target, तीव्रेण violently, कुम्भेन by Kumbha, निशितैः sharp, शरैः arrows, अचितास्तेद्रुमा covered with trees, ते those, घोराः dreadful, शतघ्नयःयथा like Sataghnis, रेजुः shone.

text: द्रुमवर्षं तु तच्छिन्नं दृष्ट्वा कुम्भेन वीर्यवान् । वानराधिपतिः श्रीमान् महासत्त्वो न विव्यथे ॥६-७६-६८॥
translation: Valiant hero, the prosperous and noble Sugriva, the chief of Vanaras did not get distressed when tormented with rain of trees.
word_meanings: वीर्यवान् valiant hero, श्रीमान् prosperous, महासत्वः very noble, वानराधिपतिः Vanara chief, कुम्भेन at Kumbha, सञ्छिन्नम् tormented, तत् that, द्रुमवर्षम् rain of trees, दृष्टवा seeing, न विव्यथे not distressed.

text: निर्भिद्यमानः सहसा सहमानश्च तान् शरान् । कुम्भस्य धनुराक्षिप्य बभञ्जेन्द्रधनुष्प्रभम् ॥६-७६-६९॥
translation: He snatched the bow of Kumbha forcibly which was like Indra's rainbow, pulled it and broke, while tolerating the pain of the arrows.
word_meanings: निर्भिद्यमानः snatching, सः he, तान् them, शरान् arrows, सहमानः tolerating the pain, कुम्भस्य Kumbha's, इन्द्रधनुष्प्रभम् like Indra's rainbow, धनुः bow, सहसा forcibly, आक्षिप्य pulling, बभञ्च broke.

text: अवप्लुत्य ततः शीघ्रं कृत्वा कर्म सुदुष्करम् । अब्रवीत् कुपितः कुम्भं भग्नशृङ्गमिव द्विपम् ॥६-७६-७०॥
translation: Then Sugriva leapt into the chariot, which was a difficult deed to perform, saw Kumbha who was like an elephant and whose tusks were broken and spoke.
word_meanings: ततः then, शीघ्रम् speedily, अवफ्लुत leaping, सुदुष्करम् very difficult, कर्म deed, कृत्वा having done, कुपितः angry, भग्नशृङ्गम् peak broken, द्विपम् इव flame like, कुम्भम् elephant, अब्रवीत् spoke.

text: निकुम्भाग्रज वीर्यं ते बाणवेगवदद्भुतम् । सन्नतिश्च प्रभावश्च तव वा रावणस्य वा ॥६-७६-७१॥
translation: "Oh, elder brother of Nikumbha! Your valour, speed of your arrows, compliance, and glory is wonderful like that of Ravana's."
word_meanings: निकुम्भाग्रज elder brother of Nikumbha, ते your, वीर्यम् valour, बाणवेगवत् by the speed of your arrow, अद्भुतम् wonderful, सन्नतिश्च compliance, प्रभावश्च glory, तववा of yours, रावणस्यवा or Ravana's.

text: प्रह्लादबलिवृत्रघ्नकुबेवरुणोपम । एकस्त्वमनुजातो ऽसि पितरं बलवृत्ततः ॥६-७६-७२॥
translation: "You are equal to Prahlada, Bali, Indra, Kubera and Varuna in might. You alone have taken over like your father."
word_meanings: प्रह्लादबलिवृत्रघ्नकुबेरवरुणोपम Prahlada, Bali, Indra, Kubera, Varuna, त्वम् you, एकः alone, बलवत्ततम् equal in might, पितरम् father's, अनुजातः like father, असि are.

text: त्वामेवैकं महाबाहुं चापहस्त मरिन्दमम् । त्रिदशा नातिवर्तन्ते जितेन्द्रियमिवाधयः ॥६-७६-७३॥
translation: "Oh! mightyarmed, Kumbha! wielding pike in hand, you are a tamer of enemies, you alone are the one that gods are not able to overcome, a pre eminent one who has gained over senses, highly intelligent, exhibiting your prowess and deeds before me."
word_meanings: महाबाहुम् mighty armed, शूलहस्तम् wielding pike in hand, अरिन्दमम् tamer of enemies, त्वाम् you, एकमेव you alone, त्रिदशाः gods, जितेन्द्रियम् one who has overcome senses, आधयः pre eminent, नातिवर्तन्ते not able to overcome, महाबुद्धे highly intelligent, विक्रमस्व prowess, मम me, कर्माणि deeds, तः those, पश्यत: exhibit.

text: विक्रमस्व महाबुद्धे कर्माणि मम पश्यतः ॥६-७६-७४॥
translation: "Oh! mightyarmed, Kumbha! wielding pike in hand, you are a tamer of enemies, you alone are the one that gods are not able to overcome, a pre eminent one who has gained over senses, highly intelligent, exhibiting your prowess and deeds before me."
word_meanings: महाबाहुम् mighty armed, शूलहस्तम् wielding pike in hand, अरिन्दमम् tamer of enemies, त्वाम् you, एकमेव you alone, त्रिदशाः gods, जितेन्द्रियम् one who has overcome senses, आधयः pre eminent, नातिवर्तन्ते not able to overcome, महाबुद्धे highly intelligent, विक्रमस्व prowess, मम me, कर्माणि deeds, तः those, पश्यत: exhibit.

text: वरदानात् पितृव्यस्ते सहते देवदानवान् । कुम्भकर्णस्तु वीर्येण सहते च सुरासुरान् ॥६-७६-७५॥
translation: "Your uncle Ravana is able to withstand the Devas and Danavas by virtue of the boons and Kumbhakarna was able to with stand gods and demons by virtue of his courage."
word_meanings: ते your, पितृव्यः uncle, वरदानात् by the boons, देवदानवान् Devas and Danavas, सहते with stand, कुम्भकर्णस्तु Kumbhakarna also, वीर्येण courage, सुरासुरान् gods and demons, सहते with stand.

text: धनुषीन्द्रजितस्तुल्यः प्रतापे रावणस्य च । त्वमद्य रक्षसां लोके श्रेष्ठो ऽसि बलवीर्यतः ॥६-७६-७६॥
महाविमर्दं समरे मया सह तवाद्भुतम् । अद्य भूतानि पश्यन्तु शक्रशम्बरयोरिव ॥६-७६-७७॥
translation: "Just as the wonderful conflict between Indra and Sambara let the beings witness the mighty comb at between me and you."
word_meanings: अद्य now, समरे in combat, मयासह with me, तव your, अद्भुतम् wonderful, महाविमर्दम् mighty encounter, शक्रम्बरयोरिव Indra and Sambara like, भूतानि beings, पश्यन्तु witness.

text: कृतमप्रतिमं कर्म दर्शितं चास्त्रकौशलम् । पातिता हरिवीराश्च त्वया वै भीमविक्रमाः ॥६-७६-७८॥
translation: "By an unequal deed done by you in the efficiency in the use of weapons has been exhibited. The monkey heroes of terrific valour have been made to fall."
word_meanings: त्वया your, अप्रतिमम् unequal, कर्म deed, कृतम् done, अस्त्रकौशलं च efficiency in the use of weapons, दर्शितम् exhibited, भीमविक्रमाः of terrific valour, एते of those, हरिवीराश्च monkey heroes, पातिताः made to fall.

text: उपालम्भभयाच्चापि नासि वीर मया हतः । कृतकर्मा परिश्रान्तो विश्रान्तः पश्य मे बलम् ॥६-७६-७९॥
translation: "O Stalwart! You have not been finished by me for the fear of reproaching. You are exhausted by your deeds and resting. Having rested, witness my strength now."
word_meanings: वीर stalwart, कृतकर्मपरिश्रान्तः exhausted by your deeds and resting, मया by me, उपालम्भभयात् fear of reproaching, हतः finished, नअसि are not, विश्रान्तः having rested, मे my, बलम् strength, पश्य witness.

text: तेन सुग्रीववाक्येन सावमानेन मानितः । अग्नेराज्याहुतस्येव तेजस्तस्याभ्यवर्धत । ततः कुम्भस्तु सुग्रीवं बाहुभ्यां जगृहे तदा ॥६-७६-८०॥
translation: Sugriva's words of flattering royalty captivated Kumbha's fire of energy, which doubled like fire fed with ghee.
word_meanings: सावमानेन slighted, तेन by the, सुग्रीवाक्येन Sugriva's words, मानितः flattered, राज्याहुतस्य royalty captivated, अग्नेःइव like fire, तस्य his, तेजः fire of energy, अभ्यवर्धत increased.

text: गजाविवाहितमदौ निश्वसन्तौ मुहुर्मुहुः । अन्योन्यगात्रग्रथितौ कर्षन्तावितरेतरम् । सधूमां मुखतो ज्वालां विसृजन्तौ परिश्रमात् ॥६-७६-८१॥
translation: Thereafter Kumbha held Sugriva's shoulders. They were like two intoxicated elephants holding one another's limbs and rubbing each other and breathing heavily. In exertion they let out from their face fire mixed with smoke.
word_meanings: ततः thereafter, कुम्भः Kumbha, बाहुभ्याम् shoulders, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva's, जगृहे held, तदा then, अहतमदौ intoxicated, गजाविव like elephants, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, निश्श्वसन्तौ breathing heavily, अन्योन्यगात्रग्रथितौ holding one another's limbs, इतरेतरम् one another, कर्षन्तौ rubbing each other, परिश्रमात् in exertion, मुखतः from face, सधूमाम् smoke, ज्वालाम् flames, विस्पजन्तौ let out.

text: तयोः पादाभिघाताच्च निमग्ना चाभवन्मही । व्याघूर्णिततरङ्गश्च चुक्षुभे वरुणालयः ॥६-७६-८२॥
translation: Then by the trampling of their feet the earth sank down, the abode of Varuna (ocean) was agitated with rolling waves.
word_meanings: तयोः those two, पादाभिघातात् by the trampling of their feet, मही earth, निमग्ना sank, अभवत् down, वरुणालयः abode of Varuna (ocean), व्याघूर्णिततरङ्गः rolling waves became, चुक्षुभे agitated.

text: ततः कुम्भं समुत्क्षिप्य सुग्रीवो लवणाम्भसि । पातयामास वेगेन दर्शयन्नुदधेस्तलम् ॥६-७६-८३॥
translation: Then Sugriva lifted Kumbha and threw him into the ocean quickly, to show him the bottom.
word_meanings: ततः then, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, कुम्भम् Kumbha, समुत्क्षिप्य threw into ocean, उदधेः lifted, तलम् bottom, दर्शयन् to show, वेगेन quickly, लवणाम्भसि into the ocean, पातयामास threw him.

text: ततः कुम्भनिपातेन जलराशिः समुत्थितः । विन्ध्यमन्दरसङ्काशो विससर्प समन्ततः ॥६-७६-८४॥
translation: By Kumbha falling into the ocean, it got swollen to the form of Vindhya and Mandara mountain and water flowed all over.
word_meanings: ततः then, कुम्भनिपातेन by the fallen Kumbha, समुत्थितः from the ocean, जलराशिः ocean, व्निध्यमन्दरसङ्काशः form of Vindhya and Mandara, समन्ततः all over, विससर्प flowed.

text: ततः कुम्भः समुत्पत्य सुग्रीवमभिपत्य च । आजघानोरसि क्रुद्धो वज्रवेगेन मुष्टिना ॥६-७६-८५॥
translation: Then Kumbha hit Sugriva in anger with his fist at the speed of a thunderbolt on his chest.
word_meanings: ततः then, कुम्भः Kumbha, समुत्पत्य rising up, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, अभिपद्य च hit him, क्रुद्धः in anger, वज्रवेगेन at thunderbolt speed, मुष्टिना with fist, उरसि on the chest, आजघान struck.

text: तस्य चर्म च पुस्फोट बहु सुस्राव शोणितम् । स च मुष्टिर्महावेगः प्रतिजघ्ने ऽस्थिमण्डले ॥६-७६-८६॥
translation: The armour of Sugriva slit open, and blood flowed at high speed and excessively. The first hit of Kumbha hit the skeletal framework of Sugriva in return.
word_meanings: तस्य his, चर्म च armour, पुस्फोट slit open, शोणितं blood, बहुसुस्राव flowed excessively, महावेगः at high speed, सःमुष्टिः his fist, अस्थिमण्डले skeletal framework, प्रतिजघ्ने in return struck.

text: तदा वेगेन तत्रासीत्तेजः प्रज्वलितं मुहुः । वज्रनिष्पेषसञ्जाता ज्वाला मेरौ यथा गिरौ ॥६-७६-८७॥
translation: Then by the speed of the hit on Sugriva's chest by Kumbha's fist a flame burst forth like the flame of Meru Mountain.
word_meanings: तदा then, तत्र there, वेगेन speedily, महत् great, तेजः flame, मेरोःगिरेः Meru mountain, वज्रनिष्पेषसञ्जाता force of the fist like thunderbolt, ज्वालायथा like flame, प्रज्वलितम् burst forth.

text: स तत्राभिहतस्तेन सुग्रीवो वानरर्षभः । मुष्टिं संवर्तयामास वज्रकल्पं महाबलः ॥६-७६-८८॥
translation: Then mighty Sugriva, the bull among Vanaras, hit by the fist, clenched his fist adamantly.
word_meanings: तत्र there, तेन by that, अभिहतः hit, महाबलः mighty, वानरर्षभः bull of Vanaras, सः he, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, वज्रकल्पम् adamant, मुष्टिम् fist, सम्वर्तयामास clenched.

text: अर्चिस्सहस्रविकचं रविमण्डलसप्रभम् । स मुष्टिं पातयामास कुम्भस्योरसि वीर्यवान् ॥६-७६-८९॥
