translation: Sugriva, the champion pressed his first which shone like the Sun encircled with rays on the chest of Kumbha.
word_meanings: वीर्यवान् champion, सः he, अर्चिः Sun, चरविमण्डलसप्रभम् shone like disc encircled, मुष्टिम् fist, कुम्भस्य Kumbha's, उरसि chest, पातयामास pressed.

text: स तु तेन प्रहारेण विह्वलो भृशताडितः । निपपात तदा कुम्भो गतार्चिरिव पावकः ॥६-७६-९०॥
translation: By the blow of Sugriva, that Kumbha was pained severely and overcome by fear he fell like fire which has lost its glow.
word_meanings: सःकुम्भः that Kumbha, तेन by that, प्रहारेण blow, भृशताडितः pained severely, विह्वलः overcome with fear, तदा then, गतार्चिः glow gone, पावकःइव like fire, निपपात fell.

text: मुष्टिना ऽभिहतस्तेन निपपाताशु राक्षसः । लोहिताङ्ग इवाकाशाद्दीप्तरश्मिर्यदृच्छया ॥६-७६-९१॥
translation: Struck by the fist of Sugriva, the Rakshasa fell just as the glowing planet endowed with brightness accidentally fell from the sky.
word_meanings: तेन by that, मुष्टिना fist, अभिहतः struck, राक्षसः Rakshasa, दीप्तरमशिः glowing planet, लोहिताङ्गः endowed with brightness, यदृच्छया accidentally, आकाशादिव from the sky, आशु has, निपपात fallen.

text: कुम्भस्य पततो रूपं भग्नस्योरसि मुष्टिना । बभौ रुद्राभिपन्नस्य यथा रूपं गवां पतेः ॥६-७६-९२॥
translation: Struck in the chest by Sugriva's fist, Kumbha fell down and shone like the Sun god over powered by Rudra।।
word_meanings: उरसि chest, मुष्टीना by fist, भग्नस्य broken, पततः fallen, कुम्भस्य Kumbhas, रूपम् form, रुद्राभिपन्नस्य over po were d by Rudra, गवांपतेः Lord of the sky, the Sun god, रूपंयथा like that form, बभौ shone.

text: तस्मिन् हते भीमपराक्रमेण प्लवङ्गमानामृषभेण युद्धे । मही सशैला सवना चचाल भयं च रक्षांस्यधिकं विवेश ॥६-७६-९३॥
इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे षट्सप्ततितमः सर्गः ॥ ७६ ॥६-७६-९४॥
निकुम्भो भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा सुग्रीवेण निपातितम् । प्रदहन्निव कोपेन वानरेन्द्रमवैक्षत ॥६-७७-१॥
translation: Seeing his brother struck down by Sugriva, Nikumbha gazed at him as if to burn him in wrath.
word_meanings: निकुम्भः Nikumbha, भ्रातरम् brother, सुग्रीवेण by Sugriva, निपातितम् struck down, दृष्टवा seeing, कोपेन in wrath, प्रदहन्निव as if burning, वानरेन्द्रम् Vanara king, अवैक्षत gazed

text: ततः स्रग्दामसन्नद्धं दत्तपञ्चाङ्गुलं शुभम् । आददे परिघं वीरो नगेन्द्रशिखरोपमम् ॥६-७७-२॥
translation: Then the hero Nikumbha, girded with flowers measuring five digits in breadth, took an auspicious club like the peak of Mahendra mountain.
word_meanings: ततः then, वीरः hero, स्रग्दामसन्नद्धम्collected together, girded with flowers, दत्तपञ्चाङ्गुलम् measuring five digits in breadth, शुभम् auspicious, महेन्द्रशिखरोपमम् like the peak of Mahendra mountain, परिघम् club, आददे took

text: हेमपट्टपरिक्षिप्तं वज्रविद्रुमभूषितम् । यमदण्डोपमं भीमं रक्षसां भयनाशनम् ॥६-७७-३॥
translation: It was decked with a gold band, encrusted with diamonds and corals, in the form of Yama's rod, a fierce one which dispelled fear.
word_meanings: हेमपट्टपरिक्षिप्तम् decked with golden band, वज्रविद्रुमभूषितम् encrusted with diamonds and corals, यमदण्डोपमम्, like the rod of Yama, भीमम् fierce रक्षसाम् Rakshasa, भयनाशनम् dispelled fear

word_meanings: निशाचरः night ranger, रथम् chariot, प्रदक्षिणंकृत्वा after having gone round, सूतम् charioteer, आरुरोह ascended मेmy, रथम्chariot, शीघ्रम् quickly, आवह get, सञ्चोदयामास drive the chariot

text: अथ तान् राक्षसान् सर्वान् मकराक्षो ऽब्रवीदिदम् । यूयं सर्वे प्रयुद्ध्यध्वं पुरस्तान्मम राक्षसाः ॥६-७८-९॥
translation: Thereafter, Maka raksha spoke to all Rakshasas, 'All of you be ahead of me and fight violently'.
word_meanings: अथ and then, मकराक्षःMaka raksha, तान् his, सर्वान् all, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, यूयम् all of you, सर्वे all, ममmy, पुरस्तात् ahead, प्रयुध्यध्वम् fight violently

text: अहं राक्षसराजेन रावणेन महात्मना । आज्ञप्तः समरे हन्तुं तावुभौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ॥६-७८-१०॥
translation: "I will kill both Rama and Lakshmana in the battle, by the order of Ravana, the king of Rakshasas."
word_meanings: अहम् I, राक्षसराजेन by Rakshasa king's, महात्मना great self, रावणेन to Ravana, समरे in battle, तौ those, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, उभौ both, हन्तुम् will kill, आज्ञप्तः by his order

text: अद्य रामं वधिष्यामि लक्ष्मणं च निशाचराः । शाखामृगं च सुग्रीवं वानरांश्च शरोत्तमैः ॥६-७८-११॥
translation: "Now I shall put an end to Rama and Lakshmana, Sugriva and the Vanaras with the best of arrows."
word_meanings: निशाचराः night ranger, अद्य now, रामम् Rama, लक्ष्मणं च and Lakshmana, शाखामृगम् Vanara, सुग्रीवं च Sugriva also, वानरान् च Vanaras also, शरोत्तमैः best of arrows, वधिष्यामि will put an end

text: अद्य शूलनिपातैश्च वानराणां महाचमूम् । प्रदहिष्यामि सम्प्राप्तः शुष्केन्धनमिवानलः ॥६-७८-१२॥
translation: "Going there now, I will terminate the great Vanara army with these pikes just as drywood is burnt by fire."
word_meanings: अद्य now, सम्प्राप्ताम् going there, वानराणाम् Vanaras, महाचमूम् great army, अनलः fire, शुष्केन्धनमिव burns dry wood, शूलनिपातैः with these pikes, प्रदहिष्यामि will burn

text: मकराक्षस्य तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं ते निशाचराः । सर्वे नानायुधोपेता बलवन्तः समागताः ॥६-७८-१३॥
translation: On hearing Maka raksha's words all the mighty Rakshasas came with different kinds of weapons.
word_meanings: मकराक्षस्यMaka raksha, तत् then, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा on hearing, बलवन्तः mighty, ते they, निशाचराः Rakshasas, सर्वे all, नानायुधोपेताःarmed with different weapons, समाहिताःcame

text: ते कामरूपिणः सर्वे दंष्ट्रिणः पिङ्गलेक्षणाः । मातङ्गा इव नर्दन्तो ध्वस्तकेशा भयानकाः ॥६-७८-१४॥
translation: Those who could change their form at will, cruel, with protruding teeth, yellow eyes, dishevelled hair, of frightful appearance, huge like elephants surrounding the son of Khara went joyously forward shaking the earth.
word_meanings: कामरूपिणः who could change their form at will, क्रूराः cruel, दंष्ट्रिणः protruding teeth, पिङ्गलेक्षणाः yellow eyes, ध्वस्तकेशाःdishevelled hair, भयावहाःfrightful appearance, महाकायाः huge body size, ते they, ततः then, मातङ्गाःइव like elephants, महाकायम् of huge size, खरात्मजम् son of Khara, परिवार्य surrounding, हृष्टाःjoyously, वसुन्धराम् earth, चालयन्तःshaking, अभिजघ्नुःwent forward

text: परिवार्य महाकाया महाकायं खरात्मजम् । अभिजग्मुस्ततो हृष्टाश्चालयन्तो वसुन्धराम् ॥६-७८-१५॥
translation: Those who could change their form at will, cruel, with protruding teeth, yellow eyes, dishevelled hair, of frightful appearance, huge like elephants surrounding the son of Khara went joyously forward shaking the earth.
word_meanings: कामरूपिणः who could change their form at will, क्रूराः cruel, दंष्ट्रिणः protruding teeth, पिङ्गलेक्षणाः yellow eyes, ध्वस्तकेशाःdishevelled hair, भयावहाःfrightful appearance, महाकायाः huge body size, ते they, ततः then, मातङ्गाःइव like elephants, महाकायम् of huge size, खरात्मजम् son of Khara, परिवार्य surrounding, हृष्टाःjoyously, वसुन्धराम् earth, चालयन्तःshaking, अभिजघ्नुःwent forward

text: शङ्खभेरीसहस्राणामाहतानां समन्ततः । क्ष्वेलितास्फोटितानां च ततः शब्दो महानभूत् ॥६-७८-१६॥
translation: There was a beating of drums, blowing of thousands of conchs, clapping of arms and great sound was heard.
word_meanings: तत्र there, आहतानाम् beating of drums, शङ्खभेरीसहस्राणाम्blowing of thousands of conches, क्षेवळितास्फोटितानां च clappings of arms, महान् great, शब्धः sound, समन्ततःe very where, अभूत् heard

text: प्रभ्रष्टो ऽथ करात्तस्य प्रतोदः सारथेस्तदा । पपात सहसा चैव ध्वजस्तस्य च रक्षसः ॥६-७८-१७॥
translation: There, the long whip dropped from the charioteer's hand and the Rakshasa's standard had fallen suddenly by divine will.
word_meanings: अथ and there, तदा then, तस्य his, सारथेःcharioteer, करात् hand, प्रतोदःlong whip, प्रभ्रष्टःdropped down, तस्यरक्षसः that Rakshasa, ध्वजः standard, सहसाsuddenly, दैवात् by divine will, पपात fallen

text: तस्य ते रथयुक्ताश्च हया विक्रमवर्जिताः । चरणैराकुलैर्गत्वा दीनाः सास्रमुखा ययुः ॥६-७८-१८॥
translation: His horses yoked to the chariot went giving up their valour, faltering feet, desperate and shedding tears.
word_meanings: तस्य his, रथसंयुक्ताः yoke binding the chariot, ते they, हयाःhorses, विक्रमवर्जिताःgiven up their valour, आकुलैःfaltering, चरणैः feet, गत्वा going, दीनाःdesperate, सास्रमुखाः shedding tears, ययुःwent

text: प्रवाति पवनस्तस्मिन् सपांसुः खरदारुणः । निर्याणे तस्य रौद्रस्य मकराक्षस्य दुर्मतेः ॥६-७८-१९॥
translation: At the departure of evil minded and angry Maka raksha, dreadful and violent wind blew carrying with crumbling dust.
word_meanings: रौद्रस्य angry, दुर्मतेः evil minded, तस्यमकराक्षस्य that Maka raksha, तस्मिन् निर्याणे at his departure, सपांसुः crumbling dust, खरदारुणः dreadful and violent, पवनः wind, प्रवाति blowed.

text: तानि दृष्ट्वा निमित्तानि राक्षसा वीर्यवत्तमाः । अचिन्त्य निर्गताः सर्वे यत्र तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ॥६-७८-२०॥
translation: Seeing those portents incidentally and not taking into account those Rakshasas went where Rama and Lakshmana were.
word_meanings: वीर्यवत्तमाः exceedingly valiant, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, सर्वे all, तानि them, निमित्तानि incidentally, दृष्टवा seeing, अचिन्त्य not taking into account, तौ those, रामलक्ष्मणौ Rama and Lakshmana, यत्र there, निर्गताःwent

text: घनगजमहिषाङ्गतुल्यवर्णाः समरमुखेष्वसकृद्गदासिभिन्नाः । अहमहमिति युद्धकौशलास्ते रजनिचराः परितः समुन्नदन्तः ॥६-७८-२१॥
इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे अष्टसप्ततितमः सर्गः ॥ ७८ ॥६-७८-२२॥
निर्गतं मकाराक्षं ते दृष्ट्वा वानरयूथपाः । आप्लुत्य सहसा सर्वे योद्धुकामा व्यवस्थिताः ॥६-७९-१॥
translation: On seeing Maka raksha all the Vanara chiefs returned, jumped, and stood ready enthusiastically to fight.
word_meanings: सर्वे all, ते those, वानरपुङ्गवाःVanara chiefs, निर्गतम् returning, मकराक्षम् Maka raksha, दृष्टवा seeing, आप्लुत्य jumped, योद्धुकामाः enthusiastic to fight, अवस्थिताःstood ready

text: ततः प्रवृत्तं सुमहत् तद्युद्धं रोमहर्षणम् । निशाचरैः प्लवङ्गानां देवानां दानवैरिव ॥६-७९-२॥
translation: Then ensued a battle between Rakshasas and Vanaras whichcaused horripilation, just like the battle between Devas and Danavas.
word_meanings: ततः then, प्लवङ्गानाम् Vanaras, निशाचरैः Rakshasas, देवेनाम् Devas, दानवैरिवDanavas, तत् there, सुहत् together, रोहर्षणम् one's hair stand to raise, युद्धम् battle, प्रवृत्तम् ensued

text: वृक्षशूलनिपातैश्च शिलापरिघपातनैः । अन्योन्यं मर्दयन्ति स्म तदा कपिनिशाचराः ॥६-७९-३॥
translation: Then monkeys as well as Rakshasas fought hurling trees and pikes and bringing down rocks and clubs physically hurting each other.
word_meanings: तदा then, कपिनिशाचराः monkeys and Rakshasas, वृक्षशूलनिपातैः च trees and pikes, शिलापरिघपातनैःbringing down rocks and clubs, अन्योन्यम् one another, मर्दयन्तिस्म physically hurting each other.

text: शक्तिखड्गगदाकुन्तैस्तोमरैश्च निशाचराः । पट्टिशैर्भिन्दिपालैश्च निर्घातैश्च समन्ततः ॥६-७९-४॥
translation: Those prowlers, then ight rangers discharging javelins, swords, maces, spears, lances, small swords, bhindi Palas, shafts, nooses, mallets and staff and other weapons on the lions among the monkeys, caused destruction.
word_meanings: रजनीचराःnight rangers, तेनिशाचराःthose prowlers, शक्तिखडगगदाकुन्तैjavelins, swords, maces, spears, तोमरैश्च lances, पट्टसै: small swords, भिण्डिपालैश्चbhindi Palas (slings for throwing stones), बाणपातैःshafts, पाशमुद्गरदण्डैः च nooses, mallets, and staffs, निखातैःcollection, तथा like that, अन्यैश्च and other weapons, समन्ततः discharging, कपिसिंहानाम् lions among monkeys, कदनम् destruction, चक्रुःcaused

text: पाशमुद्गरदण्डैश्च निखातैश्चापरे तदा । कदनं कपिवीराणां चक्रुस्ते रजनीचराः ॥६-७९-५॥
translation: Those prowlers, then ight rangers discharging javelins, swords, maces, spears, lances, small swords, bhindi Palas, shafts, nooses, mallets and staff and other weapons on the lions among the monkeys, caused destruction.
word_meanings: रजनीचराःnight rangers, तेनिशाचराःthose prowlers, शक्तिखडगगदाकुन्तैjavelins, swords, maces, spears, तोमरैश्च lances, पट्टसै: small swords, भिण्डिपालैश्चbhindi Palas (slings for throwing stones), बाणपातैःshafts, पाशमुद्गरदण्डैः च nooses, mallets, and staffs, निखातैःcollection, तथा like that, अन्यैश्च and other weapons, समन्ततः discharging, कपिसिंहानाम् lions among monkeys, कदनम् destruction, चक्रुःcaused

text: बाणौघैरर्दिताश्चापि खरपुत्रेण वानराः । सम्भ्रान्तमनसः सर्वे दुद्रुवुर्भयपीडिताः ॥६-७९-६॥
translation: Vanaras perturbed terribly by the volley of arrows of Khara's son were stricken with fear and ran.
word_meanings: खरपुत्रेण by Khara's son, बाणौघैः by volley of arrows, अर्धिताः stricken, सर्वे all, वानराः Vanaras, सम्भ्रान्तमनसः perturbed terribly, भयपीडिताः stricken with fear, दुद्रुवुःran

text: तान् दृष्ट्वा राक्षसाः सर्वे द्रवमाणान् वलीमुखान् । नेदुस्ते सिंहवद्धृष्टा राक्षसा जितकाशिनः ॥६-७९-७॥
translation: The monkeys saw all the arrogant Rakshasas roaring like lions and running as though triumphed.
word_meanings: सर्वे all, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, तान् their, द्रवमाणान् running, वलीमुखान् monkeys, दृष्टवा seeing, नेदुः arrogant, ते they, राक्षसाः Rakshasas, सिम्हवत् like lion roar, दृष्टा seeing, जितकाशिनःas if triumphed

text: विद्रवत्सु तदा तेषु वानरेषु समन्ततः । रामस्तान् वारयामास शरवर्षेण राक्षसान् ॥६-७९-८॥
translation: Thereafter, seeing the Vanaras running all over, Rama stopped the Rakshasas by rain of arrows.
word_meanings: तदा then, तेषु them, वानरेषु Vanaras, समन्ततःall over, विद्रवत्सु running, रामःRama, शरवर्षेण by rain of arrows, तान् them, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, वारयामास stopped.

text: वारितान् राक्षसान् दृष्ट्वा मकराक्षो निशाचरः । क्रोधानलसमाविष्टो वचनं चेदमब्रवीत् ॥६-७९-९॥
translation: Seeing the intercepted Rakshasas, the night ranger Maka raksha was overtaken by fire of anger spoke these words.
word_meanings: वारितान् intercepted, राक्षसान् Rakshasas, दृष्टवाseeing, निशाचरःnight ranger, मकराक्षःMaka raksha, क्रोधानलसमाविष्टःovertaken by fire of anger, इदम् this, वचनं च words, अब्रवीत्spoke

text: तिष्ठ राम मया सार्धं द्वन्द्वयुद्धं ददामि ते । त्याजयिष्यामि ते प्राणान् धनुर्मुक्तैः शितैः शरैः ॥६-७९-१०॥
translation: "Rama Stop. Duel will take place with me. I will give you sharpened arrows from my bow and relieve you of your life."
word_meanings: राम Rama, तिष्ठ stop, मयासार्धम् with me will take place, शितैः sharpened, शरैः arrows, द्वन्ध्वयुद्धम् duel fight, भविष्यति will give you, धनुर्मुक्स्सैः arrows release from my bow, तेyou, ददामि will give you, प्राणान् life, त्याजयिष्यामि relieve you

text: यत्तदा दण्डकारण्ये पितरं हतवान् मम । मदग्रतः स्वकर्मस्थं दृष्ट्वा रोषो ऽभिवर्धते ॥६-७९-११॥
translation: "Then in Dandakaranya my father was killed. Now for the samereason you are in front of me. Seeing you my anger is increasing."
word_meanings: तदा then, दण्डकारण्ये in D and akaranya, मम my, पितरम् father, यत् there, हतवान् was killed, तत् that, स्वकर्मस्थम् for the same cause, अग्रतःin front, दृष्टवा seeing, रोषःanger, अभिवर्धते is increasing

text: दह्यन्ते भृशमङ्गानि दुरात्मन् मम राघव । यन्मया ऽसि न दृष्टस्त्वं तस्मिन् काले महावने ॥६-७९-१२॥
translation: "O Evil minded Raghava! at that time, I did not see you in D and aka forest. My limbs are burning in anger."
word_meanings: दुरात्मन् evil minded, राघव Raghava, तस्मिन् काले at that mean time, त्वम् your, मया by me, महावने in the great forest (D and aka), यत् there, न दृष्टः no seen असि by, मम me, अङ्गानि limbs, भृशम् in anger, दह्यन्ते burning

text: दिष्ट्या ऽसि दर्शनं राम मम त्वं प्राप्तवानिह । काङ्क्षितो ऽसि क्षुधार्तस्य सिंहस्येवेतरो मृगः ॥६-७९-१३॥
translation: "Rama! To my good fortune it became possible for me to see you here. Just as a hungry lion waits for an animal, I am waiting for you."
word_meanings: राम Rama, दिष्ट्या good fortune, त्वम् you, इह here, मम my, दर्शनम् seen, प्राप्तवान् became possible, क्षधार्तस्य hungry, सिंहस्य lion's, इह here, मृगःइव like animal, काङ्क्षितःwaiting for you, असि I am

text: अद्य मद्बाणवेगेन प्रेतराङ्विषयं गतः । ये त्वया निहता वीराः सह तैश्च समेष्यसि ॥६-७९-१४॥
translation: "Now by the speed of my arrow I will send you totherealm of Yama and there you will be along with the demons killed by you."

text: हर्षः कामश्च दर्पश्च धर्मः क्रोधः शमो दमः । अर्थादेतानि सर्वाणि प्रवर्तन्ते नराधिप ॥६-८३-३९॥

text: येषां नश्यत्ययं लोकश्चरतां धर्मचारिणाम् । ते ऽर्थास्त्वयि न दृश्यन्ते दुर्दिनेषु यथा ग्रहाः ॥६-८३-४०॥

text: त्वयि प्रव्रजिते वीर गुरोश्च वचने स्थिते । रक्षसा ऽपहृता भार्या प्राणैः प्रियतरा तव ॥६-८३-४१॥

text: अयमनघ तवोदितः प्रियार्थं जनकसुतानिधनं निरीक्ष्य रुष्टः । सहयगजरथां सराक्षसेन्द्रां भृशमिषुभिर्विनिपातयामि लङ्काम् ॥६-८३-४४॥
इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे त्र्यशीतितमः सर्गः ॥ ८३ ॥६-८३-४५॥
राममाश्वासयाने तु लक्ष्मणे भ्रातृवत्सले । निक्षिप्य गुल्मान् स्वस्थाने तत्रागच्छद्विभीषणः ॥६-८४-१॥

राघवं च महात्मानमिक्ष्वाकुकुलनन्दनम् । ददर्श मोहमापन्नं लक्ष्मणस्याङ्कमाश्रितम् ॥६-८४-४॥
translation: He (Vibheeshana) saw the great soul, the delight of the Ikshvaku race deluded, distressed, and lying on the lap of Lakshmana.

translation: "O Noble one! On hearing Hanuman that Sita is killed by Indrajith, Rama is deluded', said Lakshmana to Vibheeshana."
word_meanings: सौम्य noble, राघवः Raghava, हनुमद्वचनात् Hanuman's words, सीता Sita, इन्द्रजिता by Indrajith, हता killed, इति this, श्रुत्यैव on hearing, ततः then, मोहम् deluded, उपागतः became

word_meanings: विभीषणःVibheeshana, कथयन्तम् started telling, सौमित्रिम् Saumithri, सन्निवार्य restraining, विसंज्ञम् unconscious, रामम् to Rama, पुष्कलार्थम् full of meaning, इदंवाक्यम् this, अब्रवीत् spoke

text: मनुजेन्द्रार्तरूपेण यदुक्तं च हनूमता । तदयुक्तमहं मन्ये सागरस्येव शोषणम् ॥६-८४-९॥
translation: "I think that what has been spoken by Hanuman as truth (that Sita has been killed) is like drying up an ocean."
word_meanings: मनुजेन्द्र Lord of humans, आर्थरूपेण thinking to be true, हनूमता from Hanuman, सु, यत् that which, उक्त spoken, तत् those, सागरस्य ocean's, शोषणम् इव drying up, अयुक्तम् not possible, अहम् I, मन्ये think

text: अभिप्रायं तु जानामि रावणस्य दुरात्मनः । सीतां प्रति महाबाहो न च घातं करिष्यति ॥६-८४-१०॥
translation: "O mighty armed Rama! with reference to Sita, you do not know Ravana's opinion. He will never kill Sita."
word_meanings: महाबाहो mighty armed, सीतांप्रति with reference to Sita, दुरात्मनः evil minded, रावणस्य Ravana's, अभिप्रायम् opinion, जानामि do not know, घातम् killing, न करिष्यति will never do

text: याच्यमानस्तु बहुशो मया हितचिकीर्षुणा । वैदेहीमुत्सृजस्वेति न च तत् कृतवान् वचः ॥६-८४-११॥
नैव साम्ना न दानेन न भेदेन कुतो युधा । सा द्रुष्टुमपि शक्येत नैव चान्येन केनचित् ॥६-८४-१२॥
वानरान् मोहयित्वा तु प्रतियातः स राक्षसः । चैत्यं निकुम्भिलां नाम यत्र होमं करिष्यति ॥६-८४-१३॥
हुतवानुपयातो हि देवैरपि सवासवैः । दुराधर्षो भवत्येव सङ्ग्रामे रावणात्मजः ॥६-८४-१४॥
तेन मोहयता नूनमेषा माया प्रयोजिता । विघ्नमन्विच्छता तत्र वानराणां पराक्रमे ॥६-८४-१५॥
ससैन्यास्तत्र गच्छामो यावत्तन्न समाप्यते । त्यजेमं नरशार्दूल मिथ्यासन्तापमागतम् । सीदते हि बलं सर्वं दृष्ट्वा त्वां शोककर्शितम् ॥६-८४-१६॥
इह त्वं स्वस्थहृदयस्तिष्ठ सत्त्वसमुच्छ्रितः । लक्ष्मणं प्रेषयास्माभिः सह सैन्यानुकर्षिभिः ॥६-८४-१७॥
एष तं नरशार्दूलो रावणिं निशितैः शरैः । त्याजयिष्यति तत् कर्म ततो वध्यो भविष्यति ॥६-८४-१८॥
तस्यैते निशितास्तीक्ष्णाः पत्रिपत्राङ्गवाजिनः । पतत्रिण इवासौम्याः शराः पास्यन्ति शोणितम् ॥६-८४-१९॥
तं सन्दिश महावाहो लक्ष्मणं शुभलक्षणम् । राक्षसस्य विनाशाय वज्रं वज्रधरो यथा ॥६-८४-२०॥
मनुजवर न कालविप्रकर्षो रिपुनिधनं प्रति यत् क्षमो ऽद्य कर्तुम् । त्वमति सृज रिपोर्वधाय वाणीममररिपोर्मथने यथा महेन्द्रः ॥६-८४-२१॥
समाप्तकर्मा हि स राक्षसाधिपो भवत्यदृस्यः समरे सुरासुरैः । युयुत्सता तेन समाप्तकर्मणा भवेत् सुराणामपि संशयो महान् ॥६-८४-२२॥
इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे चतुरशीतितमः सर्गः ॥ ८४ ॥६-८४-२३॥
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा राघवः शोककर्शितः । नोपधारयते व्यक्तं यदुक्तं तेन रक्षसा ॥६-८५-१॥
translation: Immersed in grief, Raghava could not make out the words spoken by Vibheeshana.
word_meanings: शोककर्शितः immersed in grief, राघवः Raghava, तस्य his, तत् those, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वा having heard, तेन by that रक्षसा Rakshasa, यत् which, उक्तम् was, व्यक्तम् spoken, नोपधारयते could not know

word_meanings: तदा then, प्रविष्टम् entered, शराग्निना like fire of arrows, निर्दहन्तम् consuming, रामम् Rama, महाघोराः most dreadful, अम्बरे sky, मेघाः clouds, सूर्यमिव like sun, नाधिजग्मुःnot approach

text: कृतान्येव सुघोराणि रामेण रजनीचराः । रणे रामस्य ददृशुः कर्माण्यसुकराणि च ॥६-९४-२०॥
translation: The night rangers were able to see Rama's terrible action which was difficult for others only after he had performed not otherwise (as they could not see his quick movement).
word_meanings: ते those, रजनीचराः night rangers, रणे in war, रामेण by Rama, कृतानि deeds, सुघोराणि terrible, असुकराणि difficult for others, रामस्य Rama's, कर्माण्येव his action, ददृशुः could not see

text: चालयन्तं महानीकं विधमन्तं महारथान् । ददृशुस्ते न वै रामं वातं वनगतं यथा ॥६-९४-२१॥
translation: They could not see Rama while he was moving and breaking huge chariots as one would not be able to see the trees in the forest when the wind blew fast.
word_meanings: ते those, महासैन्यम् great army, चालयन्तम् moving, महारथान् huge chariots, विधमन्तम् breaking, रामम् Rama, वनगतम् blowing in the forest, वातंयथा wind like, न ददृशुः not see

text: छिन्नं भिन्नं शरैर्दग्धं प्रभग्नं शस्त्रपीडितम् । बलं रामेण ददृशुर्न रामं शीघ्रकारिणम् ॥६-९४-२२॥
translation: They saw the army shattered, broken into pieces, tormented with darts by Rama but could not make out Rama who was very fast in action.
word_meanings: रामेण by Rama, शरैः arrows, छिन्नम् shattered, भिन्नम्into pieces, शस्त्रपीडितम् tormented with darts, बलम् army, ददृशुःbeheld, शीघ्रकारिणम् one who is very fast in action, रामम् Rama, न not make out

text: प्रहरन्तं शरीरेषु न ते पश्यन्ति राघवम् । इन्द्रियार्थेषु तिष्ठन्तं भूतात्मानमिव प्रजाः ॥६-९४-२३॥
translation: Just as created beings experience their senses and do not perceive their soul, the army experienced the hitting of Raghava by their senses but were not able to perceive him who was hitting them.
word_meanings: शरीरेषु in the body, प्रहरन्तम् hitting, राघवम् Raghava, ते they, इन्द्रियार्थेषु experienced through sense objects, तिष्ठन्तम् enjoying, भूतात्मानम् created beings, प्रजाःइव like people, न पश्यन्ति not able to perceive

text: एष हन्ति गजानीकमेष हन्ति महारथान् । एष हन्ति शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः पदातीन् वाजिभिः सह ॥६-९४-२४॥
translation: 'Rama is here killing elephants', 'Here is Rama destroying chariot warriors', 'Rama is killing horses, foot soldiers with sharp arrows', saying like that, the Rakshasas were striking one another in the battle. Being there where Rama was, they were mistaking one another for Rama there because of the socalled resemblance and attacking one another.
word_meanings: एषः in that way, गजानीकम् elephants, हन्तिkilling, एषः in the same way, महारथान् mighty chariot warriors, हन्ति destroying, एषः so also, तीक्ष्णैः sharp, शरैः arrows, वाजिभिःसह including horses, पदातीन् foot soldiers, हन्ति killing, इति thus, सर्वे all, तेराक्षसाः those, रणे in battle, रामस्य Rama's, सदृशान् staying there, कुपिताःangry, राघवस्य Raghava's, सादृश्यात् resembled, अन्योन्यम् one another, जघ्नुःattacked

text: इति ते राक्षसाः सर्वे रामस्य सदृशान् रणे । अन्योन्यं कुपिता जघ्नुः सादृश्याद्राघवस्य ते ॥६-९४-२५॥

translation: In the battle those Rakshasas could see a thousand Ramas at one place and again one Rama alone at another place

translation: While Rama was going around in circles with his bow, the Rakshasas were confused, and saw the golden ends of the bow to be like a burning fire stick circling and could not see Rama.

text: शरीरनाभिसत्त्वार्चिः शरीरं नेमिकार्मुकम् । ज्याघोषतलनिर्घोषं तेजोबुद्धिगुणप्रभम् ॥६-९४-२९॥
translation: People saw Rama in the form of wheel exterminating the Rakshasas on the battlefield, which had the body of Sri Rama as its navel, his strength as its glow, the arrows as spokes, his bow as belly, the twangling of the bowstring as its sound, his virtues and effulgence as the power of his mystic missiles in war. Rama was seen as a wheel of time spirit by the people.

text: अनीकं दशसाहस्रं रथानां वातरंहसाम् । अष्टादश सहस्राणि कुञ्जराणां तरस्विनाम् ॥६-९४-३१॥

translation: "Rama who can work without getting tired put an end to thousands of Rakshasa warriors with his sharp glowing arrows decked with gold. प्राप्तं दुःखं महद्घोरं क्लेशं च निरयोपमम् । अद्य सर्वमहं त्यक्ष्ये निहत्वा रावणं रणे ॥६-१०१-५१॥
यदर्थं वानरं सैन्यं समानीतमिदं मया । सुग्रीवश्च कृतो राज्ये निहत्वा वालिनं रणे ॥६-१०१-५२॥

एवमुक्त्वा शितैर्बाणैस्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणैः । आजघान दशग्रीवं रणे रामः समाहितः ॥६-१०१-५८॥

text: मया तु हितकामेन यशश्च परिरक्षता । स्नेहप्रस्कन्नमनसा प्रियमित्यप्रियं कृतम् ॥६-१०६-१२॥
translation: Wishing your welfare, for your fame and to protect you with a friendly and pleasant feeling I did that which is good for you. You are unpleasant about this action.
word_meanings: हितकामेन wishing your welfare, यशश्च fame, परिरक्षता to protect, स्नेहप्रसन्नमनसा with friendly and pleasant feeling, मया by me, हितम् इति that which is good for you, अप्रियम् unpleasant, कृतम् action

text: नास्मिन्नर्थे महाराज त्वं मां प्रियहिते रतम् । कश्चिल्लघुरिवानार्यो दोषतो गन्तुमर्हसि ॥६-१०६-१३॥
translation: "O King! I who wish your welfare ought not to be blamed like an unworthy and pettyminded person by mistake."
word_meanings: महाराज O king, प्रियहिते with good intention, रतम् remain, माम् me, अस्मिन् I, अर्थे solicit, त्वम् you, कश्चित् indeed, लघुः petty, अनार्यःइव like an unworthy, दोषतः by mistake, गन्तुम् I wish you, न अर्हसि ought not

text: श्रूयतां त्वभिधास्यामि यन्निमित्तं मया रथः । नदीवेग इवाभोगे संयुगे विनिवर्तितः ॥६-१०६-१४॥
translation: "O yes! I will answer you. Please listen. like the river entering the ocean speedily is diverted, I have taken back the chariot from the battle.
word_meanings: इवामंभोभिे into ocean like, नदीवेगःइव like speeding river, संयुगे in war, रथः chariot, यन्निमित्तम् for that reason, विनिवर्तितः taken back, प्रतिदास्यामि will answer you, श्रूयताम् please listen

text: क्षमं तवावगच्छामि महता रणकर्मणा । न हि ते वीर सौमुख्यं प्रहर्षं वोपधारये ॥६-१०६-१५॥
translation: "Great Ravana! After the strenuous task in the battle, there was no exhibition of your valour, and I did not cognize any superiority in your action."
word_meanings: महता great, रणकर्मणा in the task of battle, तव your, श्रमम् strenuous work, अवगच्छामि took cognizance of, ते your, वीर्यसौमुख्यम् valiance, प्रकर्षंवा or superiority, नोपधारये no exhibition

text: रथोद्वहनखिन्नाश्च त इमे रथवाजिनः । दीना धर्मपरिश्रान्ता गावो वर्षहता इव ॥६-१०६-१६॥
translation: "The horses of my chariot were exhausted by dragging, broken down, worn out by the hot sun, and desperate like cows lashed by rain."
word_meanings: मे my, रथवाजिनः chariot horses, रथोद्वहनखिन्नाः exhausted by dragging, भग्नाः broken, वर्षहताः lashed by rain, गावःइव like cows, घर्मपरिश्रान्ताः worn out with the heat of the sun, दीनाः desperate

text: निमित्तानि च भूयिष्ठं यानि प्रादुर्भवन्ति नः । तेषु तेष्वभिपन्नेषु लक्षयाम्यप्रदक्षिणम् ॥६-१०६-१७॥
translation: "Those portents manifesting again and again, that I am seeing, all of them are in the reverse direction (meaning not proptitious)."
word_meanings: नः not, यानि those, निमित्तानि portents, भूयिष्ठम् many, प्रादुर्भवन्ति manifesting, अभिपन्नेषु seeing, तेषुतेषु again and again, अप्रदक्षिणम् in the reverse direction, लक्ष्यामि observable

text: देशकालौ च विज्ञेयौ लक्षणानीङ्गीतानि च । दैन्यं खेदश्च हर्षश्च रथिनश्च बलाबलम् ॥६-१०६-१८॥
translation: "Propitious and unpropitious, time and place, good and evil signs and omens, depression and liveliness of the warrior as well as strength and weakness of the one in the chariot must be ascertained."
word_meanings: बलाबलम् strength and weakness, देशकालौ च in time and place, विज्ञेयौ good and evil, लक्षणानि signs, इङ्गितानि च omens, रथिनः warrior's, दैन्यम् depression, हर्षश्च liveliness, खेदश्च sorrow also

text: स्थलनिम्नानि भूमेश्च समानि विषमाणि च । युद्धकालश्च विज्ञेयः परस्यान्तरदर्शनम् ॥६-१०६-१९॥
translation: "The earths' ups and downs, evenness and ruggedness, difficult locations, the right time and place for war should be known in advance and the inner weakness of the enemy also to be known."
word_meanings: भूमेः, earth's स्थलनिम्नानि ups and downs, समानि stable, विषमाणि च difficult locations, युद्धकालश्च right time of war, विज्ञेयः should be known, परस्य of the enemy, अन्तरदर्शनम् inner weakness

text: उपयानापयाने च स्थानं प्रत्यपसर्पणम् । सर्वमेतद्रथस्थेन ज्ञेयं रथकुटुम्बिना ॥६-१०६-२०॥
translation: "To hold the chariot or advance, to go near the (enemy) or retreat, to return back or advance, everything should be known to the charioteer."
word_meanings: रथस्थेन by the charioteer, रथकुटुम्भिना to hold or advance, उपयानापयाने च coming near or retreating, स्थानम् in seated, प्रत्यपसर्पणम् to return back, एतत् all this, सर्वम् everything, ज्ञेयम् to be known

text: तव विश्रमहेतोश्च तथैषां रथवाजिनाम् । रौद्रं वर्जयता खेदं क्षमं कृतमिदं मया ॥६-१०६-२१॥
translation: "The reason for retreating in this way is to give you rest and relieve the horses from the terrible feat and fatigue. I deserve to be excused for this action."
word_meanings: तव your, विश्रामहेतोः reason is to give rest, तथा in that way, एषाम् all these, रथवाजिनाम् horses of the chariot, रौद्रम् terrific feat, खेदम् fatigue, वर्जयता to relieve, मया by me, इदम् in this way, क्षमम् deserve to be excused, कृतम् for the action

text: न मया स्वेच्छया वीर रथो ऽयमपवाहितः ॥६-१०६-२२॥
भर्तृस्नेहपरीतेन मयेदं यत्कृतं विभो ॥६-१०६-२३॥
translation: "Heroic Lord! I have not brought back this chariot independently (without thinking). I have acted in friendliness to the master (to give rest) not otherwise."
word_meanings: वीर heroic, प्रभो Lord, अयम् I, रथः chariot, मया by me, स्वेच्छया independently, न अपवाहितः not brought back, मया by me, यत् that, कृतम् action, इदम् thus, भर्तृस्नेहपरीतेन with affection to the master

text: आज्ञापय यथातत्त्वं वक्ष्यस्यरिनिषूदन । तत्करिष्याम्यहं वीर गतानृण्येन चेतसा ॥६-१०६-२४॥
translation: "O Tamer of enemies! Order now and in that way, I shall carry out your order in accordance with you wholeheartedly."
word_meanings: अरिषूदन, tamer of enemies वीर warrior, आज्ञापय orders, त्वम् your, तत् like that, यथा so also, वक्ष्यसि order, तत् that, अहम् I, गतानृण्येन in accordance with, चेतसा wholeheartedly, करिष्यामि will carry out

text: सन्तुष्टस्तेन वाक्येन रावणस्तस्य सारथेः । प्रशस्यैनं बहुविधं युद्धलुब्धो ऽब्रवीदिदम् ॥६-१०६-२५॥
translation: Ravana was fully satisfied with the words of the charioteer. He praised the charioteer in many ways and spoke like this desiring to wage war.
word_meanings: तस्यसारथेः by that charioteer, तेनवाक्येन by those words, सन्तुष्टः fully satisfied, रावणः Ravana, एनम् in that way, बहुविधम् many ways, प्रशस्य praised, युद्धलुब्दः desiring to wage war, इदम् thus, अब्रवीत् spoke

text: रथं शीघ्रमिमं सूत राघवाभिमुखं कुरु । नाहत्वा समरे शत्रून् निवर्तिष्यति रावणः ॥६-१०६-२६॥
translation: "Quickly drive the chariot towards Raghava. As a policy, Ravana would never turn back on the battlefield without putting an end to the enemy."
word_meanings: सूत charioteer इमम् this, रथम् chariot, शीघ्रम् quickly, राघवाभिमुखम् towards Raghava, नय as a policy, रावणः Ravana, समरे in battle, शत्रून् enemy, अहत्वा without putting an end, न निवर्तिष्यति never returns back

text: एवमुक्त्वा ततस्तुष्टो रावणो राक्षसेश्वरः । ददौ तस्मै शुभं ह्येकं हस्ताभरणमुत्तमम् ॥६-१०६-२७॥

translation: Fully satisfied with Charioteer's words, Ravana bestowed him with an excellent auspicious ornament of the hand. On hearing Ravana's words, the charioteer advanced the chariot.
word_meanings: तुष्टःराक्षसेश्वरः fully satisfied, रावणः Ravana, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having spoken, ततः then, तस्य his, शुभम् auspicious, एकम् one, उत्तमम् excellent, हस्ताभरणम् ornament of the hand ददौ presented, सःसारथिः to the charioteer, रावणवाक्यानि Ravana's words, श्रुत्वा hearing, न्यवर्तत turned

text: ततो द्रुतं रावणवाक्यचोदितः प्रचोदयामास हयान् स सारथिः । स राक्षसेन्द्रस्य ततो महारथः क्षणेन रामस्य रणाग्रतो ऽभवत् ॥६-१०६-२९॥
इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे षडुत्तरशततमः सर्गः ॥ १०६ ॥६-१०६-३०॥
॥ आदित्यहृदयप्रारम्भः ॥ ततो युद्धपरिश्रन्तं समरे चिन्तया स्थितम् । रावणं चाग्रतो दृष्ट्वा युद्धाय समुपस्थितम् ॥६-१०७-१॥

translation: Then seeing Sri Rama standing and thinking of the war, duly prepared, Rishi Agastya came with Devatas to witness the war with Ravana and spoke as follows.

text: राम राम महाबाहो शृणु गुह्यं सनातनम् । येन सर्वानरीन् वत्स समरे विजयिष्यसि ॥६-१०७-३॥
translation: "O mighty armed Sri Rama! Dear, hear this eternal secret (mantra) which will enable you to win all the enemies in war."
word_meanings: महाबाहो mighty armed, रामराम Rama Rama, सनातनम् eternal, गुह्यम् secret, शृणु hear, वत्स dear, येन because, समरे in war, सर्वान् all, अरीन् enemies, विजयिष्यसे which will enable you to win

text: आदित्यहृदयं पुण्यं सर्वशत्रुविनाशनम् । जयावहं जपेन्नित्यमक्षय्यं परमं शिवम् ॥६-१०७-४॥
translation: "Rama! Listen to this sacred mantra, 'Aditya Hridayam' which can bring victory, which is eternal, very auspicious, and supremely blessed and prolongs life of all by means of which you will destroy all enemies, root out sins, remove anxiety and always bring victory.

text: सर्वमङ्गलमङ्गल्यं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् । चिन्ताशोकप्रशमनमायुर्वर्धनमुत्तमम् ॥६-१०७-५॥
translation: "Rama! Listen to this sacred mantra, 'Aditya Hridayam' which can bring victory, which is eternal, very auspicious, and supremely blessed and prolongs life of all by means of which you will destroy all enemies, root out sins, remove anxiety and always bring victory.

text: रश्मिमन्तं समुद्यन्तं देवासुरनमस्कृतम् । पूजयस्व विवस्वन्तं भास्करं भुवनेश्वरम् ॥६-१०७-६॥
translation: "You worship the Sun God, crowned with rays rising up at the horizon, greeted by all gods and demons, who brings light to all and who is the embodiment of all gods."
word_meanings: रस्मीमन्तम् crowned with rays, समुद्यन्तम् rising up at the horizon, देवासुरनमस्कृत्य greeted by gods and demons, विवस्वन्तम् bring light, भास्करम् sun god, भुवनेश्वरम् embodiment of all gods, पूजयस्वworship

text: सर्वदेवात्मको ह्येष तेजस्वी रश्मिभावनः । एष देवासुरगणान् लोकान् पाति गभिस्तिभिः ॥६-१०७-७॥
translation: "He is the self in all, glorious, he sustains by his rays of light, the gods, suras and the whole world. He is the Lord of all.
word_meanings: एषः he is, सर्वदेवात्मकः self in all, तेजस्वी glorious, रस्मीभावनः by his rays, एषः he in that way, गभस्तिभिः ray of light, देवासुरगणान् for gods and suras, लोकान् for the world, पाति Lord

text: एष ब्रह्मा च विष्णुश्च शिवः स्कन्दः प्रजापतिः । महेन्द्रो धनदः कालो यमः सोमो ह्यपां पतिः ॥६-१०७-८॥
translation: "In the same way, he is the body of Brahma the creator, he is Vishnu also, Shiva also, S Kanda, Prajapati, Mahendra, Kubera, time spirit, Yama, Soma, and Varuna also.
word_meanings: एषः in the same way, ब्रह्मा च Brahma, the creator, विष्णुश्च Vishnu also, शिवः Siva also, स्कन्धः Skanda, प्रजापतिः Prajapati, महेन्द्र Mahendra, धनदः Kubera, कालः Time spirit, यमः Yama, सोमः Soma, अपांपतिः Varuna

text: पितरो वसवः साध्या ह्यश्विनौ मरुतो मनुः । वायुर्वह्निः प्रजापाण ऋतुकर्ता प्रभाकरः ॥६-१०७-९॥
translation: "He is the god of manes, Vasava, Sadhayas, Aswins, Marutha, Manu, wind god, fire god, life of all beings and god of all seasons.
word_meanings: पितरः manes, वसवः Vasava, साध्याः Sadhyas, अश्विनौ Aswinis, मरुतः Marutha, मनुः Manu, वायुः Wind god, वह्निः god of fire, प्रजाः for beings, प्राणः life, ऋतुकर्ता god of seasons, प्रभाकरः Sun god

text: आदित्यः सविता सूर्यः खगः पूषा गभस्तिमान् । सुवर्णसदृशो भानुर्हिरण्यरेता दिवाकरः ॥६-१०७-१०॥
translation: "You are the son of Aditi, the sungod, creator Savitha, the courser in the heavens, the sustainer, the possessor of golden rays, Bhanu, shining with golden rays, the Sun god.
word_meanings: आदित्यः Aditya, सविता Savitha, सूर्यः Sun, खगः sky, पूषा sustainer, गभस्तिमान् rays of light, सुवर्णसदृशः of golden effulgence, भानुः Bhanu, हिरण्यरेताः shining with golden rays, दिवाकरः Sun god

text: हरिदश्वः सहस्रार्चिः सप्तसप्तिर्मरीचिमान् । तिमिरोन्मथनः शम्भुस्त्वष्टा मार्तण्ड अंशुमान् ॥६-१०७-११॥
translation: "You are the possessor of seven green horses, having a thousand rays, having horse Sapta, destroyer of darkness, mitigator of the suffering of all devotees, giver of happiness, destroyer of all names and forms, the infuser of life in the cosmic egg and having the allpervading rays.
word_meanings: हरिदश्वः possessor of green horses, सहस्रार्चिः of thousand rays, सप्तसप्तिः having horse Sapta, मरीचिमान् destroyer of darkness, तिमिरोन्मथनः mitigator of the suffering of devotees, शम्भु: giver of happiness, त्वष्टा destroyer of all names and forms, मार्तण्डकः the infuser of life in the cosmic egg, अंशुमान् all pervading

text: हिरण्यगर्भः शिशिरस्तपनो भास्करो रविः । अग्निगर्भो ऽदितेः पुत्रः शङ्खः शिशिरनाशनः ॥६-१०७-१२॥
translation: "You have the golden cosmic egg in the womb, you are cool, you are the purifier, the ruler of all, bringer of day, who Bears the fire of dissolution in the womb. You are the son of Aditi, blissful personified and destroyer of cold.
word_meanings: हिरण्यगर्भः having golden cosmic egg in the womb, शिशिरः cool, तपनः purifier, भास्करः ruler of all, रविः bringer of day, अग्निगर्भः Bears dissolution in the womb, अदितेः son of Aditi, पुत्रः son, शङ्खः bliss personified, शिशिरनाशनः destroyer of cold

text: व्योमनाथस्तमोभेदी ऋग्यजुस्सामपारगः । घनवृष्टिरपां मित्रो विन्ध्यवीथीप्लवङ्गमः ॥६-१०७-१३॥
translation: "You are the Lord of the sky, dispeller of darkness, the master of the three VedasRig, Yajur and Sama, the sender of rain, the friend of water and the courser of the path of Vindhya swiftly.
word_meanings: व्योमनाथः Lord of the sky,, तमोभेदी dispeller of darkness, ऋग्यजुसामपारगः the master of the three Vedas, Rig, Yajur and Sama vedas, घनवृष्टिः sender of rain, अपाम् of water, मित्रः friend, विन्ध्यवीथीप्लवङ्गमः courser of the path of Vindhya swiftly

text: आतपी मण्डली मृत्युः पिङ्गलः सर्वतापनः । कविर्विश्वो महातेजा रक्तः सर्वभवोद्भवः ॥६-१०७-१४॥
translation: "You are the possessor of heat, adorned with a circle of rays. You are killer of all enemies, tawny destroyer of all, omniscient, lover of all devotees and source of all evolutes.
word_meanings: आतपी possessor of heat, मण्डले circle of rays, मृत्युः killer of all enemies, पिङ्गलः tawny, सर्वतापनः destroyer of all, कविः creator, विश्वः omniscient, महातेजाः resplendant, रक्तः lover of all devotees, सर्वभवोद्भवः source of all evolutes

text: नक्षत्रग्रहताराणामधिपो विश्वभावनः । तेजसामपि तेजस्वी द्वादशात्मन्नमो ऽस्तु ते ॥६-१०७-१५॥
translation: "You are the Lord of all stars and planets. You are the creator of all, resplendent among the splendid, the twelve faces of twelve months. Hail to you.
word_meanings: नक्षत्रग्रहताराणाम् stars, planets, विश्वभावनः creator of all, तेजसामपि resplendent, तेजस्वी among the splendid, द्वादशात्मन् of twelve faces, ते you, नमः hail, अस्तु to you

text: नमः पूर्वाय गिरये पश्चिमे गिरये नमः । ज्योतिर्गणानां पतये दिनाधिपतये नमः ॥६-१०७-१६॥
translation: "Hail to you, rising on the east mountain, setting in the west. Hail to the Lord of all luminaries.
word_meanings: पूर्वायगिरये on the east mountain, नमः hail to you, पश्चिमायअद्रये setting in the west, नमः hail to you, दिनाधिपतयेः Lord of luminaries, नमः hail to you

text: जयाय जयभद्राय हर्यश्वाय नमो नमः । नमो नमः सहस्रांशो आदित्याय नमो नमः ॥६-१०७-१७॥
translation: "Namaskar, Namaskar to the giver of victory, joy born of victory, god having green horses. Hail to you Aditya.
word_meanings: जयाय giver of victory, जयभद्राय joy born of victory, हर्यश्वाय god having green horses, नमःनमः hail to you hail to you, आदित्याय Aditya, नमःनमः namaskar, namaskar

text: नम उग्राय वीराय सारङ्गाय नमो नमः । नमः पद्मप्रबोधाय मार्ताण्डाय नमो नमः ॥६-१०७-१८॥
translation: "Hail to you of terrible form, of valiant one, denoted by the syllable 'AUM'. Namaskar to the awakener of lotuses. Namaskar to the fierce one.
word_meanings: उग्राय of terrible form, वीराय valiant, नमः hail to you, सारङ्गाय denoted by syllable AUM, नमःनमः namaskar namaskar, पद्मप्रबोधाय awakener of lotus, नमः namaskar, मार्ताण्डाय the fierce one, ते to you, नमः namaskar, अस्तु be

text: ब्रह्मोशानाच्युतेशाय सूर्यायादित्यवर्चसे । भास्वते सर्वभक्षाय रौद्राय वपुषे नमः ॥६-१०७-१९॥
translation: "Namskar to you, the ruler of Brahma, Siva and Vishnu, to you the Sun god, the spiritual dwelling light in solar orbit, the consumer of all appearing in the form of Rudra.
word_meanings: ब्रह्मेशानाच्युतेशाय the ruler of Brahma, Siva and Vishnu, सूर्याय Sun god, आदित्यवर्चसे the spiritual light in dwelling, भास्वते in solar orbit, सर्वभक्षाय consumer of all, रौद्रायवपुषे appearing in the form of Rudra, नमः namaskar

text: तमोघ्नाय हिमध्नाय शत्रुघ्नायामितात्मने । कृतघ्नघ्नाय देवाय ज्योतिषां पतये नमः ॥६-१०७-२०॥
translation: "You are the dispeller of darkness, dispeller of cold, dispeller of enemies, your extent is immeasurable. You are the destroyer of the ungrateful, the ruler of lights, the Lord of all and namaskar to you.
word_meanings: तमोघ्नाय dispeller of darkness, हिमघ्नाय dispeller of cold, शत्रुघ्नाय dispeller of enemies, अमितात्मने whose extent is immeasurable, कृतघ्नघ्नाय destroyer of the ungrateful, देवाय god, ज्योतिषाम् ruler of lights, पतये Lord of all, नमः namaskar

text: तप्तचामीकराभाय वह्नये विश्वकर्मणे । नमस्तमोभिनिघ्नाय रुचये लोकसाक्षिणे ॥६-१०७-२१॥
translation: "Namaskar to one possessing the lustre of pure gold, dispeller of darkness, architect of the universe, splendor incarnate in the form of fire in all, witnessor of all actions in the world.
word_meanings: तप्तचामीकराभाय possessing lustre of pure gold, हरये dispeller of ignorance,, विश्वकर्मण architect of the universe, तमोभिनिघ्नाय splendor incarnate in the form of fire in all, रुचये splendor, लोकसाक्षिणे witnessor of all actions in the world, नमः namaskar

text: नाशयत्येष वै भूतं तदेव सृजति प्रभुः । पायत्येष तपत्येष वर्षत्येष गभस्तिभिः ॥६-१०७-२२॥
translation: "Being a creator and destroyer of the world, this Sun god alone radiates, creates thirst by heat and rains to relieve.
word_meanings: प्रभुः Lord, एषःचै being so, भूतम् beings, नाशयति destroys, तदेव this god, सृजति creates, एषः he alone, गभस्तिभिः radiates, पायति thirst, एषः he alone, तपति heats, एषः he alone, वर्षति rains

text: एष सुप्तेषु जागर्ति भूतेषु परिनिष्ठितः । एष एवाग्निहोत्रं च फलं चैवाग्निहोत्रिणाम् ॥६-१०७-२३॥
translation: "He alone pervades the created beings and remains awake in sleep. He alone is the fire sacrifice as well as the fruits obtained from fire sacrifice.
word_meanings: एषः he alone, भूतेषु among beings, सुप्तेषु in sleep, परिनिष्ठितः pervades, जागर्ति awake, एषःचैव he alone, अग्निहोत्रं च is fire sacrifice, अग्निहोत्रिणाम् of fire sacrifice, फलं च fruits

text: वेदाश्च क्रतवश्चैव क्रतूनां फलमेव च । यानि कृत्यानि लोकेषु सर्व एष रविः प्रभुः ॥६-१०७-२४॥
translation: "He is all vedas, as well as all the sacrifices as also the fruits of all sacrifices. He is the supreme controller of all actions in all worlds.
word_meanings: वेदश्च vedas, क्रतवश्चैव sacrifices, क्रतूनाम् of the sacrifices, फलमेव च results, सर्वेषु all, लोकेषु in the worlds, यानि he alone, कृत्यानि of all actions, परमप्रभुः supreme controller

text: एनमापत्सु कृच्छ्रेषु कान्तारेषु भयेषु च । कीर्तयन् पुरुषः कश्चिन्नावसीदति राघव ॥६-१०७-२५॥
translation: "O Raghava! Anyone praying to him will surely not experience grief in straits, in difficulties, in the woods and in times of fear.
word_meanings: राघव Raghava, एनम् any one, आपत्सु in straits, कृच्छ्रेषु in difficulties, कान्तारेषु in the woods, भयेषु in times of fear, कीर्तयन् praise, पुरुषः men, कश्चित् surely, नावसीदति will experience grief

text: पूजयस्वैनमेकाग्रो देवदेवं जगत्पतिम् । एतत्रिगुणितं जप्त्वा युद्धेषु विजयिष्यसि ॥६-१०७-२६॥
translation: "Worship the Lord of the universe, the Lord of Lords. Worship him alone with concentration of mind, three times of the day by chanting his name. You will attain victory in war."
word_meanings: जगत्पतिम् Lord of the universe, देवदेवम् Lord of Lords, एनम् him alone, एकाग्रः with concentration, पूजयस्व if you offer prayers, एतत् by that, त्रिगुणितम् three times of the day, जप्त्वा chant, युद्धेषु in war, विजयिष्यसि will attain victory

text: अस्मिन् क्षणे महाबाहो रावणं त्वं वधिष्यसि । एवमुक्त्वा तदा ऽगस्त्यो जगाम च यथागतम् ॥६-१०७-२७॥
translation: Agastya having spoken in that way to the mighty armed Rama to worship the Sun God and assuring him that the very moment he will be able to kill Ravana, left in the same way.
word_meanings: महाबाहो mighty armed, अस्मिन् your, क्षणे this very moment, थ्वम् you, रावणम् Ravana, वधिष्यसि will kill, अगस्त्यः Agastya, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having spoken, ततः then, यथागतम् left in the same way जगाम went

text: एतच्छुत्वा महातेजा नष्टशोको ऽभवत्तदा । धारयामास सुप्रीतो राघवः प्रयतात्मवान् ॥६-१०७-२८॥
translation: Then Rama endowed with extra ordinary energy having heard Agastya, was very delighted and stopped worry. He remembered Aditya and chanted in his mind.
word_meanings: तदा then, महातेजः extraordinary energy, एतत् being, श्रुत्वा having heard, नष्टशोकः stopped worry, अभवत् became, राघवः Raghava, सुप्रीतः very affectionately, प्रयतात्मवान् greatly delighted, धारयमास remembered and chanted Aditya in his mind

text: आदित्यं प्रेक्ष्य जप्त्वा तु परं हर्षमवाप्तवान् । त्रिराचम्य शुचिर्भूत्वा धनुरादाय वीर्यवान् ॥६-१०७-२९॥
translation: Sipping water three times and looking at Aditya, the valiant Rama getting purified, with devotion chanted the supreme with delight. Then he took up his bow, fixing his eyes at Ravana, and advanced for war with an allout effort determined to destroy Ravana.
word_meanings: वीर्यवान् valiant, आदित्यम् Aditya, प्रेक्ष्य looking, त्रिः three times, आचम्य sipping water, शुचिः clean, भूत्वा with devotion, जप्त्वा chanted, परम् supreme, हर्षम् delight, अवाप्तवान् getting purified, धनुः bow, आदाय took up, रावणम् Ravana, प्रेक्ष्य fixing his eyes, हृष्टात्मा delighted, युद्धार्थम् for the war, समुपागमत् advanced, महता great, सर्वयत्नेन with allout effort, तस्य his, वधे destruction, धृतः determined, भवत् became

text: रावणं प्रेक्ष्य हृष्टात्मा युद्धाय समुपागमत् । सर्वयत्नेन महता वधे तस्य धृतो ऽभवत् ॥६-१०७-३०॥
translation: Sipping water three times and looking at Aditya, the valiant Rama getting purified, with devotion chanted the supreme with delight. Then he took up his bow, fixing his eyes at Ravana, and advanced for war with an allout effort determined to destroy Ravana.
word_meanings: वीर्यवान् valiant, आदित्यम् Aditya, प्रेक्ष्य looking, त्रिः three times, आचम्य sipping water, शुचिः clean, भूत्वा with devotion, जप्त्वा chanted, परम् supreme, हर्षम् delight, अवाप्तवान् getting purified, धनुः bow, आदाय took up, रावणम् Ravana, प्रेक्ष्य fixing his eyes, हृष्टात्मा delighted, युद्धार्थम् for the war, समुपागमत् advanced, महता great, सर्वयत्नेन with allout effort, तस्य his, वधे destruction, धृतः determined, भवत् became

text: अथ रविरवदन्निरीक्ष्य रामं मुदितमनाः परमं प्रहृष्यमाणः । निशिचरपतिसङ्क्षयं विदित्वा सुरगणमध्यगतो वचस्त्वरेति ॥६-१०७-३१॥
इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे सप्तोत्तरशततमः सर्गः ॥ १०७ ॥६-१०७-३२॥
स रथं सारथिर्हृष्टः परसैन्यप्रधर्षणम् । गन्धर्वनगराकारं समुच्छ्रितपताकिनम् ॥६-१०८-१॥
translation: Delighted charioteer drove the chariot of Ravana with speed. It was of the shape of the abode of Gandharvas, capable of destroying enemy's army. It had rows of excellent flags, richly endowed, like the best piece of artwork. It was fixed with flag posts in rows touching the sky and filling space. It was yoked to excellent horses adorned with gold chains and equipped with implements for war. The earth was resounding as it was driven as if to crush the enemy's army and its own army was happy.
word_meanings: सारथिः charioteer, हृष्टः delighted, परसैन्यध्रर्षणम् which can destroy enemy's army, गन्धर्वनगराकारम् like the shape of the abode of Gandharvas, समुच्छ्रितपताकिनम् with rows of excellent flags, परमसम्पन्नैः richly endowed, हेममालिभिः gold chains, वाजिभिः horses, युक्तम् best at work, युद्धोपकरणैः well equipped with implements for war, पूर्णम् round, पताकाध्वजमालिनम् flag posts as if touching आकाशम् the sky, ग्रसन्तमिव as if filling space, वसुन्धराम् earth, नादयन्तम् resounding, परसैन्यानाम् enemy army, प्रणाशम् crushing, स्वसैन्यस्य own army, प्रहर्षणम् happy, रावणस्यरथम् Ravana's chariot, क्षिप्रम् with speed, चोदयामास drove

text: युक्तं परमसम्पन्नैर्वाजिभिर्हेममालिभिः । युद्धोपकरणैः पूर्णं पताकाध्वजमालिनम् ॥६-१०८-२॥

text: ग्रसन्तमिव चाकाशं नादयन्तं वसुन्धराम् । प्रणाशं परसैन्यानां स्वसैन्यानां प्रहर्षणम् । रावणस्य रथं क्षिप्रं चोदयामास सारथिः ॥६-१०८-३॥
translation: Delighted charioteer drove the chariot of Ravana with speed. It was of the shape of the abode of Gandharvas, capable of destroying enemy's army. translation: Like the thunderbolt hurled by the arm of Indra, difficult to obstruct, capable of bringing life to an end, that arrow released by Rama penetrated into Ravana's chest.
word_meanings: वज्रिबाहुविसर्जितः released from thunderbolt hurled by the arm of Indra, वज्रःइव like thunderbolt, दुर्धर्षः difficult, कृतान्तःइव capable of bringing to an end, अवार्यः prevent, सः that, रावणोरसि into Ravana's chest, न्यपतत् penetrated

text: स विसृष्टो महावेगः शरीरान्तकरः शरः । बिभेद हृदयं तस्य रावणस्य दुरात्मनः ॥६-१११-१७॥

text: रुधिराक्तः स वेगेन जीवितान्तकरः शरः । रावणस्य हरन् प्राणान् विवेश धरणीतलम् ॥६-१११-१८॥
translation: That arrow which was capable of putting an end to the body took out Ravana's life and smeared with blood, it entered the earth.
word_meanings: शरीरान्तकरः capable of putting an end to the body, सःशरः that arrow, वेगेन speedily, रावणस्य Ravana's, प्राणान् life, हरन् took out, रुधिराक्तः smeared with blood, धरणीतलम् into the ground, विवेश entered

text: स शरो रावणं हत्वा रुधिरार्दीकृतच्छविः । कृतकर्मा निभृतवत् स्वतूणीं पुनरागमत् ॥६-१११-१९॥
translation: That arrow of Rama, on killing Ravana, soaked in blood, having accomplished the task quietly reentered its quiver.
word_meanings: सःशरः that arrow, रावणम् Ravana, हत्वा on killing, रुधिरार्द्रीकृतच्छविः soaked in blood, कृतकर्मा having accomplished the task, निभृतवत् quietly, स्वतूणीम् its quiver, पुनः again, अविशत् reentered

text: तस्य हस्ताद्धतस्याशु कार्मुकं तत् ससायकम् । निपपात सह प्राणैर्भ्रश्यमानस्य जीवितात् ॥६-१११-२०॥
translation: Thus, when Ravana was killed and lost his life, the bow and arrow in his hand also fell along with his life breath.

text: गतासुर्भीमवेगस्तु नैर्ऋतेन्द्रो महाद्युतिः । पपात स्यन्दनाद्भूमौ वृत्रो वज्रहतो यथा ॥६-१११-२१॥
translation: The king of Rakshasas, who possessed terrific speed and courage, having lost life, fell on earth like Vrttra struck down by thunderbolt.
word_meanings: भीमवेगः terrific speed, महाद्युतिः courageous, नैरृतेन्द्रः king of Rakshasas, गतासुः having gone, वज्रहतः killed by thunderbolt, वृत्रःयथा Vrttra, स्यन्दनात् when struck down, भूमौ on earth, पपात fell

text: तं दृष्ट्वा पतितं भूमौ हतशेषा निशाचराः । हतनाथा भयत्रस्ताः सर्वतः सम्प्रदुद्रुवुः ॥६-१११-२२॥
translation: Seeing their Lord killed and fallen on the ground, the leftover night rangers fled all over in fear.

translation: Seeing Ravana killed, the Vanaras holding trees went roaming on all sides, feeling triumphant.
word_meanings: द्रुमयोधिनः holding trees, वानराः Vanaras, तान् they, सर्वतःall sides, अभिपेतुः roaming, दशग्रीववधम् killed ten headed Ravana, दृष्टवा seeing, वानराः Vanaras, जितकाशिनः triumphant

text: दशग्रीववधं दृष्ट्वा विजयं राघवस्य च । अर्दिता वानरैर्हृष्टैर्लङ्कामभ्यपतन् भयात् । गताश्रयत्वात् करुणैर्बाष्पप्रस्रवणैर्मुखैः ॥६-१११-२४॥

word_meanings: वानरैः by Vanaras, अर्दिताः hurt, भ्रष्टाः lost battle, भयात् out of fear, हताश्रयत्वात् their king being killed, करुणैः piteous, बाष्पप्रस्रवणैः eyes filled with tears, मुखैः face, लङ्काम् Lanka, अभ्यपतन् went towards

text: ततो विनेदुः संहृष्टा वानरा जितकाशिनः । वदन्तो राघवजयं रावणस्य च तद्वधम् ॥६-१११-२५॥
translation: Then the Vanaras, feeling triumphant, got highly excited over Rama's victory and the death of Ravana, and shouted aloud in joy.
word_meanings: ततः then, जितकाशिनः feeling triumphant, वानराः Vanaras, सम्हृष्टाः highly delighted, राघवजयम् Rama's victory, रावणस्य Ravana's, तद्वधं च death of Ravana, वदन्तः shouted, विनेदुः in joy

text: अथान्तरिक्षे व्यनदत् सौम्यस्त्रिदशदुन्दुभिः । दिव्यगन्धवहस्तत्र मारुतः ससुखो ववौ ॥६-१११-२६॥
translation: And then thirty drums of gods sounded in the sky. Divine fragrant pleasant breeze blew.
word_meanings: अथ and now, अन्तरिक्षे in the sky, सौम्याः gods, त्रिदशदुन्धुभिः thirty drums, व्यनदत् sounded, तत्र there, दिव्यगन्धवहः divine fragrance, सुसुखः pleasant, मारुतः breeze, ववौ blew

text: निपपातान्तरिक्षाच्च पुष्पवृष्टिस्तदा भुवि । किरन्ती राघवरथं दुरवापा मनोरमा ॥६-१११-२७॥
translation: Then from heaven, a very pleasing shower of flowers, difficult to know from where, fell on Raghava's chariot covering it and dropped on the ground.
word_meanings: तदा then, अन्तरिक्षात् from the heaven, राघवरथम् on Raghava's chariot, किरन्ती covering, दुरवापा difficult to find out, मनोहरा very pleasing, पुष्पवृष्टिः shower of flowers, भुवि on earth, निपपात fell

text: राघवस्तवसंयुक्ता गगने ऽपि च शुश्रुवे । साधु साध्विति वागग्र्या दैवतानां महात्मनाम् ॥६-१११-२८॥
translation: The gods too praised Sri Rama, the great soul saying, 'Well done, Well done', from the heaven, which was distinctly heard.
word_meanings: महात्मनाम् great soul, देवतानाम् gods too, साधुसाधुइति well done well done, राघवस्तवसंयुक्ता praised Rama, अग्य्रा the foremost, वाक् words, गगने in the heaven, विशुश्रुवे च heard

text: आविवेश महाहर्षो देवानां चारणैः सह । रावणे निहते रौद्रे सर्वलोकभयङ्करे ॥६-१११-२९॥
translation: When Ravana, a terror of all worlds was killed, the Charanas and Devas were filled with great joy.
word_meanings: रौद्रे terror, सर्वलोकभयङ्करे of all worlds, रावणे Ravana, निहते killed, चारणैः Charanas, देवानाम् Devas, महान् great, हर्षः joy, अविवेश filled

text: ततः सकामं सुग्रीवमङ्गदं च महाबलम् । चकार राघवः प्रीतो हत्वा राक्षसपुङ्गवम् ॥६-१११-३०॥
translation: The foremost of the Rakshasas killed, Raghava was pleased and having fulfilled the desire of Sugriva, Angada, Vibheeshana, he made them happy.
word_meanings: राघवः Raghava, राक्षसपुङ्गवम् foremost of the Rakshasas, हत्वा killed, प्रीतः pleased, राघवः Raghava, सुग्रीवम् Sugriva, अङ्गदं च and Angada, विभीषणं च Vibheeshana also, सकामम् their desire fulfilled, चकार made them happy

text: ततः प्रजग्मुः प्रशमं मरुद्गणा दिशः प्रसेदुर्विमलं नभो ऽबवत् । मही चकम्पे न हि मारुतो ववौ स्थिरप्रभश्चाप्यभवद्दिवाकरः ॥६-१११-३१॥
translation: Then the host of gods attained tranquil, quarters brightened, sky became clear, earth no longer shook, wind blew and even the Sun became steady and radiant.
word_meanings: ततः then, मरुद्गणाः hosts of gods, प्रशमम् tranquil, प्रजग्मुः attained, दिशः quarters, प्रसेदुः brightened, नभः sky, विमलम् clear, अभवत् became, मही earth, न चकम्पे no longer shook, मारुतः wind, ववौ blew, दिवाकरःचापि even the Sun, स्थिरप्रभः steady radiance, अभवत् became

text: ततस्तु सुग्रीवविभीषणादयः सुहृद्विशेषाः सहलक्ष्मणास्तदा । समेत्य हृष्टा विजयेन राघवं रणे ऽभिरामं विधिना ह्यपूजयन् ॥६-१११-३२॥
translation: Then all of them (hosts of gods) coming together, accompanied by Lakshmana, Sugriva, Vibheeshana, and Angada along with other friends, happy about the victory in the battle offered prayers to charming Sri Rama in accordance with tradition.
word_meanings: ततः then, सुहृद्विशिष्टाः coming together, सहलक्ष्मणाः accompanied by Lakshmana, सुग्रीवविभीषणाङ्गदाः Sugriva, Vibheeshana, and Angada, रणे in the battle, विजयेन by the victory, हृष्टाः happy, अभिरामम् charming, रामम् Rama, समेत्य friends together, तदा then, विधिना as tradition goes, अभ्यपूजयन् offered prayers

text: स तु निहतरिपुः स्थिरप्रतिज्ञः स्वजनबलाभिवृतो रणे रराज । रघुकुलनृपनन्दनो महौजास्त्रिदशगणैरभिसंवृतो यथेन्द्रः ॥६-१११-३३॥
इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे एकादशोत्तरशततमः सर्गः ॥ १११ ॥६-१११-३४॥
भ्रातरं निहतं दृष्ट्वा शयानं रामनिर्जितम् । शोकवेगपरीतात्मा विललाप विभीषणः ॥६-११२-१॥
translation: Vibheeshana, seeing his brother killed and lying in the battlefield, lamented immersed in sorrow.

text: वीर विक्रान्त विख्यात विनीत नयकोविद । महार्हशयनोपेत किं शेषे ऽद्य हतो भुवि ॥६-११२-२॥
translation: "O valiant, powerful and renowned king! You who were skilled in all fields and in polity, accustomed to a sumptuous bed, why are you lying on ground?"

translation: "Hero! That which was predicted by me earlier, which did not find your favour due to your infatuation, has come true."

text: यन्न दर्पात् प्रहस्तो वा नेन्द्रजिन्नापरे जनाः । न कुम्भकर्णो ऽतिरथो नातिकायो नरान्तकः । न स्वयं त्वममन्येथास्तस्योदर्को ऽयमागतः ॥६-११२-५॥
translation: "Either Prahastha or Indrajith or other Rakshasas, or even Kumbhakarna, an exceeding car warrior, nor Atikaya or Naranthaka or you also did not care for my counsel. Its consequence has come now."

text: बहुमानात् परिष्वज्य काचिदेनं रुरोद ह । चरणौ काचिदालिङ्ग्य काचित् कण्ठे ऽवलम्ब्य च ॥६-११३-८॥
translation: Indeed, out of respect some embraced him and roared aloud, some held his feet and wept, some held his neck and started weeping.
word_meanings: काचित् indeed, बहुमानात् out of great respect, एनम् they, परिष्वज्य embracing, रुरोद ह roared aloud, काचित् some, चरणौ feet, आलम्ब्य holding, काचित् some, कण्ठे neck, अवलम्ब्य च started weeping

text: उद्धृत्य च भुजौ काचिद्भूमौ स्म परिवर्तते । हतस्य वदनं दृष्ट्वा काचिन्मोहमुपागमत् ॥६-११३-९॥
translation: Some lifting their arms threw themselves on ground, some rolled, some beholding the dead Ravana's face became deluded.
word_meanings: काचित् some, भुजौ arms, उत्क्षिप्य throwing herself on ground, भूमौ on ground, सुपरिवर्तते rolled, काचित् some, हतस्य killed, वदनम् face, दृष्टवा seeing, मोहम् in delusion, उपागमत् holding

text: काचिदङ्के शिरः कृत्वा रुरोद मुखमीक्षती । स्नापयन्ती मुखं बाष्पैस्तुषारैरिव पङ्कजम् ॥६-११३-१०॥
translation: One held his head on her lap, and one held his face and looking at it shed tears, like nature covers lotus with dew and roared.
word_meanings: काचित् some, शिरः head, अङ्के lap, कृत्वा holding, मुखम् face, ईक्षती looking, तुषारैः nature sheds dew, पङ्कजम् इव like from lotus, मुखम् face, बाष्पैः tears, स्नापयन्ती flowed, रुरोद roared

text: एवमार्ताः पतिं दृष्ट्वा रावणं निहतं भुवि । चुक्रुशुर्बहुधा शोकाद्भूयस्ताः पर्यदेवयन् ॥६-११३-११॥
translation: Afflicted on beholding their husband Ravana, killed, and lying on the ground, the Rakshasa women again and again cried exceedingly in many ways overcome with grief.
word_meanings: भुवि on the ground, निहतम् killed, पतिम् husband, रावणम् Ravana, दृष्टवा beholding, एवम् in that manner, आर्ताः afflicted, ताः they, बहुधा many, चुक्रुशुः again and again, शोकात् in sorrow, भूयः exceedingly, पर्यदेवयन् overcome with grief

text: येन वित्रासितः शक्रो येन वित्रासितो यमः । येन वैश्रवणो राजा पुष्पकेण वियोजितः ॥६-११३-१२॥
translation: "By whom Indra feared, by whom Yama feared, at whom king Visrava feared, by whom Pushpaka was deprived to Kubera in war, by whom Gandharvas and ascetics were afraid of, by whom high souled Suras were afraid of lies in the battlefield asleep."
word_meanings: येन to whom, शक्रः Indra, वित्रासितः feared, येन to whom, यमः Yama, वित्रासितः feared, येन to whom, राजा king, वैश्रवणः Visrava, पुष्पकेण् Pushpaka, वियोजितः used by winning, येन to whom, रणे in war, गन्धर्वाणाम् Gandharvas, ऋषीणां च and ascetics, महात्मनाम् high souled, सुराणां च and Suras, भयम् fear, दत्तम् bestowed, सःअयम् he this, रणे battlefield, सतः lies, शेते asleep

text: गन्धर्वाणामृषीणां च सुराणां च महात्मनाम् । भयं येन महद्दत्तं सो ऽयं शेते रणे हतः ॥६-११३-१३॥
translation: "By whom Indra feared, by whom Yama feared, at whom king Visrava feared, by whom Pushpaka was deprived to Kubera in war, by whom Gandharvas and ascetics were afraid of, by whom high souled Suras were afraid of lies in the battlefield asleep."
word_meanings: येन to whom, शक्रः Indra, वित्रासितः feared, येन to whom, यमः Yama, वित्रासितः feared, येन to whom, राजा king, वैश्रवणः Visrava, पुष्पकेण् Pushpaka, वियोजितः used by winning, येन to whom, रणे in war, गन्धर्वाणाम् Gandharvas, ऋषीणां च and ascetics, महात्मनाम् high souled, सुराणां च and Suras, भयम् fear, दत्तम् bestowed, सःअयम् he this, रणे battlefield, सतः lies, शेते asleep

text: असुरेभ्यः सुरेभ्यो वा पन्नगेभ्यो ऽपि वा तथा । न भयं यो विजानाति तस्येदं मानुषाद्भयम् ॥६-११३-१४॥
translation: "He, who did not know fear from Asuras or Uragas, experienced fear from a mortal."
word_meanings: यः he who, असुरेभ्यः from Asuras, सुरेभ्योवा or Suras, तथा so also, पन्नगेभ्योऽपि Uragas also, भयम् fear, न विजानाति not known, तस्य his, मानुषात् by human, इदम् thus, भयम् experienced fear

text: अवध्यो देवतानां यस्तथा दानवरक्षसाम् । हतः सो ऽयं रणे शेते मानुषेण पदातिना ॥६-११३-१५॥
translation: "He, whom Devatas, Danavas and Rakshasas could not kill, lies asleep, killed by a mortal who came by walk."
word_meanings: यः he who, देवतानाम् Devatas, तथा so also, दानवरक्षनाम् Danavas, Rakshasas, अवध्यः not be killed, सःअयम् he, पदातिना by walk, मानुषेण by a mortal, रणे in battle, हतः killed, शेते lies asleep

text: यो न शक्यः सुरैर्हन्तुं न यक्षैर्नासुरैस्तथा । सो ऽयं कश्चिदिवासत्त्वो मृत्युं मर्त्येन लम्भितः ॥६-११३-१६॥
translation: "He, who could not be killed by Suras, Asuras or Yakshas, such a hero lies like a weak person devoid of strength, killed by a mortal, is resting."
word_meanings: यः he who, सुरैः Suras, हन्तुम् to kill, न शक्यः not possible, यक्षै: Yaksha, न not, तथा so also, असुरैः Asuras, न not, सः he, अयम् this, असत्त्वः weak, कश्चिदिव like one devoid of strength, मर्त्येन by death, मृत्युम् death, लम्भितः resting

text: एवं वदन्त्यो बहुधा रुरुदुस्तस्य ताः स्त्रियः । भूय एव च दुःखार्ता विलेपुश्च पुनःपुनः ॥६-११३-१७॥
translation: Those women grieving in that way roared aloud, lamenting again and again cried, afflicted by sorrow.
word_meanings: तस्य his, दुःखिताः grieving, ताःस्त्रियःएवम् those women in that way, वदन्त्य: roaring, रुरुदुः aloud, भूयःएव च lamented again, दुःखार्ताः afflicted with sorrow, पुनःपुनः again and again, विलेपुः cried

text: अशृण्वता च सुहृदां सततं हितवादिनाम् । मरणायाहृता सीता घातिताश्च निशाचराः ॥६-११३-१८॥
translation: "You did not listen to the good advice of your dear and good at heart. You brought Sita and destroyed yourself and all of us at a time."
word_meanings: सततम् always, हितवादिनाम् your welfare, सुहृदाम् dear and good at heart, अश्वण्वता not listened, मरणाय death, सीता Sita, आहृता brought, राक्षसाश्च Rakshasas, निपातिताः struck down, आत्मा च yourself, पातितः destroyed, समम् at a time, ते to you, एताःवयम् all of us, इदानीम् this way

text: एताः सममिदानीं ते वयमात्मा च पातिताः । ब्रुवाणो ऽपि हितं वाक्यमिष्टो भ्राता विबीषणः । धृष्टं परुषितो मोहात्त्वया ऽ ऽत्मवधकाङ्क्षिणा ॥६-११३-१९॥
translation: "Even though good advice was given by your dear brother Vibheeshana, in your delusion evidently you sought your own destruction."
word_meanings: हितम् good, वाक्यम् words, ब्रुवाणोऽपि even though told, इष्टःभ्राता dear brother, विभीषणः Vibheeshana, धृष्टम् evidently, आत्मवथकाङ्णा sought your own destruction, त्वया by you, मोहात् in delusion, परुषितः harshly

text: यदि निर्यातिता ते स्यात् सीता रामाय मैथिली । न नः स्याद् व्यसनं घोरमिदं मूलहरं महत् ॥६-११३-२०॥
translation: "If Sita, princess of Mithila had been returned by you, this great destruction of the very root and calamity with you and for us would not have happened."
word_meanings: मैतिली Mythili, सीता Sita, ते to you, रामाय Rama's, निर्यातिता returned, यदिस्यात् if so with you, नः not, मूलहरम् destruction of the very root, इदम् this, महत् great, घोरम् terrific, व्यसनम् calamity, न स्यात् not happened

text: वृत्तकामो भवेद्भ्राता रामो मित्रकुलं भवेत् । वयं चाविधवाः सर्वाः सकामा न च शत्रवः ॥६-११३-२१॥
translation: "If your brother's desire had been fulfilled Rama would have turned to be our friend. We would not have been widows. Our enemy's desire would not have been fulfilled."
word_meanings: न्राता brother, वृत्तकामः desire fulfilled, भवेत् would be, रामः Rama, मित्रकुलम् turned to be friend, भवेत् would have been, वयम् our, सर्वाः all, अध्विनाः not widows, शत्रवः च enemy's, सकामाः that desire, न not

text: त्वया पुनर्नृशंसेन सीतां संरुन्धता बलात् । राक्षसा वयमात्मा च त्रयं तुल्यं निपातितम् ॥६-११३-२२॥
translation: "With evil intention you kept Sita under detention. These Rakshasas and you and us all the three are together destroyed."
word_meanings: नृशंसेन with evil intention, सीताम् Sita, बलात् forcibly, संरुन्धता kept under detention, त्वयापुनः again by you, राक्षसाः Rakshasa, वयम् these आत्मा च and you too, त्रयम् three, तुल्यम् together, निपातितम् destroyed

text: न कामकारः कामं वा तव राक्षसपुङ्गव । दैवं चेष्टयते सर्वं हतं दैवेन हन्यते ॥६-११३-२३॥
translation: "O Foremost of Rakshasas! You have acted according to your desire alone is not sufficient as divine will make you do everything. He is killed whom destiny kills."
word_meanings: राक्षसपुङ्गवः foremost of Rakshasas, कामम् desire, तव of yours, कामकारः acting to your will, न वा by you, सर्वम् all, दैवम् divine, चेष्टयते makes you do, देवेन by divine, हतम् killed, हन्यते kills

text: वानराणां विनाशो ऽयं रक्षसां च महाहवे । तव चैव महाबाहो दैवयोगादुपागतः ॥६-११३-२४॥
translation: "O mighty armed Ravana! For Vanaras, Rakshasas and you too, this destruction in this war has come by divine grace."
word_meanings: महाबाहो mighty armed, रणे in war, वानराणाम् Vanaras, राक्षसानां च Rakshasas also, तव च you too, अयम् this, विनाशः destruction, दैवयोगात् with the divine grace, उपागतः has come

text: नैवार्थेन न कामेन विक्रमेण न चाज्ञया । शक्या दैवगतिर्लोके निवर्तयितुमुद्यता ॥६-११३-२५॥
translation: "In the world, to change the divine course of action, it is not possible with wealth, or will or by prowess or king's orders."
word_meanings: उद्यता to lift up, दैवगतिः divine course, लोके in the world, अर्थेन by wealth, निवर्तयितुम् to stop, न शक्या not possible, कामेन with will, न not, विक्रमेण by prowess, न not, आज्ञया च king's order, न not

text: विलेपुरेवं दीनास्ता राक्षसाधिपयोषितः । कुरर्य इव दुःखार्ता बाष्पपर्याकुलेक्षणाः ॥६-११३-२६॥
इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे त्रयोदशोत्तरशततमः सर्गः ॥ ११३ ॥६-११३-२७॥
तासांविलपमानानांतदाराक्षसयोषिताम् । ज्येष्ठापत्नीप्रियाजीनाभर्तारंसमुदैक्षत ॥६-११४-१॥
translation: Then from among the wives lamenting, the first wife, dear to Ravana gazed at her husband lamenting piteously.
word_meanings: तदा then, तासाम् of them, राक्षसयोषिताम् Rakshasa's wife, विलपमानानाम् lamenting, प्रिया dear, ज्येष्ठापत्नी first wife, दीना piteously, भर्तारम् husband, समुदैक्षत gazed

text: दशग्रीवंहतंदृष्टवारामेणाचिन्त्यकर्मणा । पतिंमण्डोदरीतत्रकृपणापर्यदेवयत् ॥६-११४-२॥
translation: Looking at her husband Ravana killed by Rama of inconceivable exploits, Mandodari piteously lamented there.
word_meanings: अचिन्त्यकर्मणा of inconceivable exploits, रामेण by Rama, हतम् killed, पतिम् husband, दशग्रीवम् ten headed Ravana, दृष्टवा looking, मण्डोदरी Mandodari, तत्र there, कृपणा piteously, पर्यदेवयत् lamented there

text: ननुनाममहाबाहोतववैश्रवणानुज । क्रुद्धस्यप्रमुखेस्थातुंत्रस्यत्यपिपुरन्दरः ॥६-११४-३॥
translation: "O mighty armed Ravana! O, brother of Visrava! When in anger even Purandara was afraid to stand before you, it is well known."
word_meanings: महाबाहो mighty armed, वैश्रवणानुज brother of Visrava, क्रुद्धस्य in anger, तव your, प्रमुखे chief, स्थातुम् to stand, पुरन्दरःअपि even Purandara, त्रस्यति fears, ननुनाम well known

text: ऋषयश्चमहान्तोऽपिगन्धर्वाश्चयशस्विनः । ननुनामतवोद्वेगाच्चारणाश्चदिशोगताः ॥६-११४-४॥
translation: "For fear of you, even great seers, illustrious Gandharvas, Charanas also went in all directions, is well known."
word_meanings: तव your, उद्वेगात् for fear, महान्तः great, ऋषयः seers, यशस्विनः illustrious, गन्धर्वाश्च Gandharvas also, चारणाः Charanas, दिशः directions, गताः went, ननुनाम is well known

text: स त्वंमानुषमात्रेणरामेणयुधिनिर्जितः । न व्यपत्रपसेराजन् किमिदंराक्षसेश्वर ॥६-११४-५॥
translation: "O Lord of Rakshasas! Just by Rama, a mortal, you have been killed in war. Are you not shy of it?"
word_meanings: राक्षसेश्वर Lord of Rakshasas, राजन् king, सःत्वम् you, मानुषमात्रेण just a mortal, रामेण by Rama, युधि in war, निर्जितः killed, न व्यपत्रपसे not shy about it, इदम् for this, किम् why

text: कथंत्रैलोक्यमाक्रम्यश्रियावीर्येणचान्वितम् । अविषह्यंजघानत्वांमानुषोवनगोचरः ॥६-११४-६॥
translation: "Winning the three worlds by your valour, you are glorious, irresistible and beyond reach. How did the wanderer in the forest strike you?"
word_meanings: त्रैलोक्यम् in the three worlds, आक्रम्य occupying, श्रिया glorious, वीर्येण च by your valour, अन्वितम् irresistible, अविषह्यम् beyond the reach, त्वाम् you, वनगोचरः wanderer in forest, मानुषः human, कथम् how, जघान struck you

text: मानुषाणामविषयेचरतःकामरूपिणः । विनाशस्तवरामेणसम्युगेनोपपद्यते ॥६-११४-७॥
translation: "You lived in an inaccessible place and are capable of assuming any form at will. It is not believable how you have been destroyed by Rama."
word_meanings: मानुषाणाम् among humans, अविषये inaccessible, चरतः live, कामरूपिणः capable of assuming any form at will, तव your, विनाशः destroyed, रामेण by Rama, संयुगे in war, नोपपद्यते is not believable

text: न चैतत्कर्मरामस्यश्रद्धधामिचमूमुखे । सर्वतस्समुपेतस्यतवतेनाभिमर्षणम् ॥६-११४-८॥
translation: "You are always well equipped with the army, so such action (killing you) is not possible for Rama."
word_meanings: चमूमुखे army, रामस्य of Rama, एतत् such, कर्म action, न श्रद्धधामि not action, सर्वतः always, समुपेतस्य fully equipped, तव your, तेन therefore, धर्षणम् fight

text: यदैव च जनस्थानेराक्षसैर्भहुनिर्ववृतः । खरस्तवहतोभ्रातातदैवासौ न मानुषः ॥६-११४-९॥
translation: " At Janasthana your brother Khara, who was surrounded by many Rakshasas, was killed by a mortal in the same manner."
word_meanings: जनस्थाने at Janasthana, बहुभिः many, राक्षसैः Rakshasas, वृतः surrounded by, तवभ्राता your brother, खरः Khara, हतः killed, तदैव in the same manner, असौ you, मानुषः mortal, न not

text: यदैवनगरींलङ्कांदुष्प्रवेशांसुरैरपि । प्रविष्टोहनुमान्वीर्यात्तदैवव्यथितावयम् ॥६-११४-१०॥
translation: "To Lanka, which is inaccessible to anyone, Hanuman entered by increasing his valour. Knowing this we worried (that Rama may not be mere mortal)."
word_meanings: यदैव by that action, हनुमान् Hanuman, सुरैरपि even Suras, दुष्प्रवेशाम् difficult to enter, लङ्कांनगरीम् Lanka city, वीर्यात् valour, प्रविष्टः increasing, तदैव like that, वयम् knowing this, व्यथिताः worried

text: वसुधायाहिवसुधांश्रियःश्रींभर्तृवत्सलाम् । सीतांसर्वानवद्याङ्गीमरण्येविजनेशुभाम् आनयित्वातुतांदीनांछद्मनात्मस्वदूषण । अप्राप्यतंचैवकामंमैथिलीसङ्गमेकृतम् पतिव्रतायास्तपसानूनंदग्धोऽसिमेप्रभो ॥६-११४-२४॥

text: हाराजन् सुकुमारंतेसुभ्रुसुत्वक्समुन्नसम् कान्तिश्रीद्युतिभिस्तुल्यमिन्दुपद्मदिवाकरैः । किरीटकूटोज्ज्वलितंताम्रास्यंदीप्तकुण्डलम् मदव्याकुललोलाक्षंभूत्वायत्पानभूमिषु । विविधस्रग्धरंचारुवल्गुस्मितकथंशुभम् तदेवाद्यतवैवंहिवक्त्रं न भ्राजतेप्रभो । रामसायकनिर्भिन्नंरक्तंरुधिरविस्रवैः वीशीर्णमेदोमस्तिष्कंरूक्षस्यन्दनरेणुभिः ॥६-११४-३४॥
translation: "Oh King, My Lord! text: स्निग्धेन्द्रनीलनीलंतुप्रांशुशैलोपमंमहत् केयूराङ्गदवैडूर्यमुक्ताहारस्रगुज्ज्वलम् । कान्तंविहारेष्वधिकंदीप्तांसङ्ग्रामभूमिषु भात्याभरणभाभिर्यद्विद्युद्भिरिवतोयदः । तदेवाद्यशरीरंतेतीक्ष्णैर्नैकशरैश्चितम् पुनर्दुर्लभसम्पर्शंपरिष्वक्तुं न शक्यते । श्वाविधःशलकैर्यद्वद्भाणैर्लग्नैर्निरन्तरम् स्वर्पितैर्मर्मसुभृशंसञ्छिन्नस्नायुबन्धनम् । क्षितौनिपतितंराजन् श्यामंवैरुधिरच्छवि वज्रप्रहाराभिहतोविकीर्णइवपर्वतः ॥६-११४-४२॥
translation: "O king! Your body which is gigantic like a mountain, dark like a sapphire adorned with Keyuras, Angadas, necklaces of cat's eye gems and pearls, which were charming when in the battlefield, and shone brightly on your body with the lustre of your jewels like a rainy cloud with flashes of lightning. It is fixed with numerous arrows cut into pieces by darts and difficult to touch. Since the darts are inserted deep into your vital parts, it is not possible to perform ablution. It is dark, soaked in blood, broken, and crushed like a mountain hit by thunderbolt. Alas, it is not possible to embrace."
